qaphela ukuthi ungamkhohlwa iNkosi, owakulethela ezweni laseYiputa, izwe lapho ubeyindodana yomsebenzi.
Uzogwema iNkosi uNkulunkulu wakho, uzokhonza yena; futhi ngegama lakhe kuphela uzokwenza izibopho zakho.
Musa ukulandela amanye amadini, phakathi kwamadini ezweni elibhekene nawe.
ngoba iNkosi, uNkulunkulu wenu, ophakathi kwenu, nguThixo onokwesaba; uma nilandela amanye amadini, khona-ke inhliziyo yakhe izogqugquzela phezu kwenu, futhi uzokucisha phezu komhlaba.
Mhlawumbe ngeke nizame iNkosi uNkulunkulu wenu, njengokuba niyenzile eMasha.
Uzozigcina ngokuqinile imiyalo kaYehova uNkulunkulu wakho, namasiko akhe, nezimiso zakhe, awawisela kuwe.
Uzokwenza lokho okulungile, nokulungile emehloni kaYehova, ukuze kube lula kuwe, nifike niyithole izwe elingcono, iNkosi abewisele lona ababuphikisi benu,
futhi uzokhipha bonke abaphikisi bakho phambi kwakho, njengoba wathi.
Uma nibuza izingane zenu kusasa, zithi, Ziyini lezi zinqumo, nalezi zimiso, nalezi umthethosivivinywa, okuthi iNkosi uNkulunkulu wethu awawiselayo?
Uzothi kubo, Sibe ngabakhonzi bakaFaro eYiputa; kodwa iNkosi wasikhipha eYiputa ngesandla sakhe esinamandla.
Wathumela iNkosi izibonakaliso ezinkulu, ezibuhlungu, nezimangalo, eYiputa, kuFaro, nomndeni wakhe wonke, phambi kwamehlo ethu.
Wathi, "Sizofika ezweni lenu," waphuma khona, ukuze asize sifike kule lizwe, ukuze lithunyelwe kuthi, izwe ebelibhekwa ngabababa bethu.
Wathi iNkosi kuthi, Sikwenze lezi mithetho zonke, sikhathazeke iNkosi uNkulunkulu wethu, ukuze kube sekuhleni kwethu nsuku zonke, futhi agcine impilo yethu, njengokuba kwenzeka ngalolusuku.
Sizobe silungile phambi kukaYehova uNkulunkulu wethu, uma nje sibhekana nokwenza zonke lezi mithetho phambi kwakhe, njengokuba awiselayo.

Uma iNkosi uNkulunkulu wakho ekulethela izwe okungena kulo ukulithola, futhi ekhuphula izizwe eziningi phambi kwakho: amaHeti, namaGirgasi, namaAmori, namaKanana, namaPerizi, namaHivi, namaJebusi, izizwe ezisixhenxe ezikhulu kunakho konke.
Uma iNkosi uNkulunkulu wakho enikela ngazo phambi kwakho, uzinqobe, uzozibulala ngokugcwele; ngeke ube nesivumelwano nabo, futhi ngeke ube nothando kubo.
Akekho owesifazane phakathi kwabo, ukuze izingane zakho zingabi namadodakazi abo; futhi izingane zakho zingabi namadodakazi abo.
ngoba bazoshintsha izingane zakho, zisuka ekuphileni kwami, ukuze bakhonza izitha ezahlukene; khona-ke inhliziyo kaYehova izogqwala phezu kwenu, futhi uzokulahla ngokushesha.
Le yindlela okufanele niyenze ngayo kubo: Niphule izibingelelo zabo, niphula amatshe abo angcwele, niqonde ama-ashere abo, nikhulule ngomlilo izinhlamvu zabo.

ngoba wena uyisizwe esiyingcwele, esigqugquzelwe kuYehova uNkulunkulu wakho; iNkosi uNkulunkulu wakho wakhetha wena ukuba ube yimpahla yakhe yangempela phakathi kwazo zonke izizwe ezikhona phezu komhlaba.
UNkulunkulu akakuthandeni wena, futhi akakukhetheli wena, ngoba ubukhulu bakho bungaphezu kwazo zonke izizwe; ngoba wena ubencane kunazo zonke izizwe.

Kodwa ngenxa yokuthi iNkosi uzithanda, futhi ngenxa yokuthi wagcina ilizwi lakhe ebelikhuluma ngaye kubaba bakho, yena uThixounguNkulunkulu owenza ukuthi niphume ngesandla esinamandla, ekusikhulula ekusebenzeni kwendlu ka-Farao, ukumkani waseYiputa.

Uzokwazi ukuthi iNkosi uNkulunkulu wakho, yena kuphela uNkulunkulu, uNkulunkulu othembekile, ogcina isivumelwano nothando labo abathandekayo kuye, nalabo abagcine izimiso zakhe, kuze kube yinkulungwane.
Kodwa ubuyisela labo abamxhwele, ebusweni babo, ukuwabulala; akazange athathe isikhathi eside ukubuyisela labo abamxhwele, ebusweni babo.
Hamba, ugcine imiyalo yami, namasiko ami, nezimiso zami, ngizibeka phambi kwakho namhlanje.
Uma nilalela le mithetho, niyigcina, niyenza, iNkosi uNkulunkulu wakho uzogcina kuwe isivumelwano nothando, njengoba esho kwabababa bakho.

Uzokuthandela, uzokubambisana nawe, futhi uzokwenza ubeningi; uzokubambisana nawe ngezingane eziningi, nezithelo ezinhle, nembewu, newayini elisha, ne-olive oil; uzobambisana nezinkomo zakho ngezingulube, nezimvu zakho ngezinkomo, ezweni lakhe akazange asho kubaba bakho ukuba akunike.
Uzobe ungcwele kakhulu kunabo bonke abantu. Amadoda akho nabesifazane bakho ngeke bakwazi ukuba nezingane, futhi izilwane zakho ngeke zikwazi ukuzalwa.
UNkulunkulu uzokukhusela ezindaweni zonke zokugula; ngeke abeke phezu kwakho noma iyiphi yalezi zifo ezibi, owaziyo eYiputa, kodwa azozibeka phezu kwalabo bonke abakuxosha.
Uzozibulala zonke izizwe, iNkosi uNkulunkulu wakho azenza phambi kwakho; ngeke ube nothando kubo, futhi ngeke ubambisene namathikithi abo; ngoba lokhu kuzokuba yingozi kuwe.
Uma ukhuluma enhliziyweni yakho, uthi: Izizwe lezi zinamandla kunathi; singazikhipha kanjani?
Musa ukuwakhathazeka; khumbula kahle konke okwenze iNkosi uNkulunkulu wakho kuFaro, nakubo bonke abantu baseYiputa.

Amehlo akho akubona zonke lezi zinkinga ezinkulu, izibonakaliso, nezimanga, nesandla esinamandla, nomlenze oqinile, iNkosi uNkulunkulu wakho awakhipha ngazo. Ngokusho kwalokho uzokwenza iNkosi uNkulunkulu wakho kuzo zonke izizwe, ongazixolisa ngazo.
UNkulunkulu wakho, iNkosi, uzobeka phakathi kwabo ukukhathazeka, kuze kube yilapho nalabo abafihlayo phambi kwakho belahleka.
Musa ukukhathazeka ngenxa yabo; ngoba iNkosi uNkulunkulu wakho unguwe, uNkulunkulu omkhulu, onokwesaba.
UNkulunkulu wakho, iNkosi, uzozisusa izizwe ezinjalo phambi kwakho, izingcezu ngezingcezu; awukwazi ukuzibulala zonke ngasikhathi sinye, ukuze izinyoni zasendle zingakukhululanga.
UNkulunkulu wakho, iNkosi, uzozinikela phambi kwakho, azoziphazamisa kakhulu, kuze kube yilapho zikhululiwe.
Uzobeka emazulwini abo phambi kwakho, futhi uzobasusa amagama abo ngezansi kwezulu; akukho muntu ozokwazi ukubhekana nawe; uzowabulala bonke.

Uzozibulala ngomlilo izinhlamvu zemimoya yabo; ngeke ufune igolide noma isiliva elikhona kuyo, futhi akufanele lithathwe kuwe, ukuze lingaba yingozi kuwe; ngoba iNkosi uNkulunkulu wakho unenkani ngalokho.
Ungayingenisi indlu yakho nanye yalezi zinto ezingathandeki, ukuze ungabi necala ngazo; kodwa ungayithandabuzi ngokuphelele, futhi uyenze ibe yingozi kuwe, ngoba iyinto engathandeki.
Hambani, nigcine yonke imiyalelo engikulethela yona namhlanje, ukuze niphile, nikhule, ningene, niyithathe njengentando yenu izwe iNkosi abewisele lona ababuphikisi benu.

Uzokhumbula ukuthi iNkosi, uNkulunkulu wakho, wakulethela le minyaka emashumi mane yonke indlela esiqhingini, ukuze akuhloniphe, ukuze akwazi ukuthi yini enhliziyweni yakho, noma ngabe uzogcina umthetho wakhe noma cha.
Wakucindezela, wakwenza ube nendlala, wakudlalisa nge-manna, ongayazi wena nababa bakho; ukuze akufundise ukuthi umuntu akaphila ngokudla kuphela, kodwa ngawo wonke amazwi aphuma emlonyeni kaYehova.
Izigqoko zakho azisebenzisi isikhathi eside, futhi izinyawo zakho aziphuzi eminyakeni emashumi mane.
Uzokwazi ngokomoya wakho ukuthi, njengobaba oqeqesha umntwana wakhe, iNkosi uNkulunkulu wakho uqeqesha wena, futhi uyakuqeqesha.
Uzolalela imiyalo kaYehova uNkulunkulu wakho, uzohamba ngendlela yakhe ethandekayo, uzoba nomona.
ngoba iNkosi uNkulunkulu wakho ekulethela izwe elilungile, izwe elinabantu abahamba ngezintaba nezimpophoma, amanzi aphuma emhlabathini ophansi, asuka emadolobheni nasezikhungweni.
izwe lengulube, neshubhu, namaviniga, nemifino, nama-granate; izwe le-olive oil, nemvubelo.
Uzodla khona ukudla okunenani elikhulu, futhi awudingi lutho; kuzoba nensimbi emadolobheni ayo, futhi uzoba nobhedu ezindaweni zayo eziphakeme.
Uzodla, uthobele, bese ubonga iNkosi uNkulunkulu wakho ngenxa yezwe elingcono alikunike lona.
Hamba, ugweme ukukhohlwa iNkosi uNkulunkulu wakho, ukuze ungagcinanga imiyalo yakhe, namalungiselelo akhe, nezimiso zakhe, engikhuluma ngazo kuwe namuhla.
Uma nidla, futhi nithobele, futhi nikhiphe izakhiwo ezinhle, futhi nihlale kuzo;
uma izingulube zakho nezinkomo zakho zikhula, uma isiliva lakho negolide lakho likhula, futhi zonke izinto zakho zikhula,
ungabi nomsindo, futhi ungayikhohlwa iNkosi uNkulunkulu wakho, owenza ukuba uphume ezweni laseYiputa, izwe lapho ubeyindodana yomsebenzi.
Wakuholela ezweni elikhulu, elibuhlungu, elinabantu abamnyama, nama-scorpions, izwe elibandayo alinamanzi; wakwenza amanzi aphuma emhlabathini oqinile.
Wakudlalisa wena emfuleni nge-manna, engakaze bayiqonde imindeni yenu yababa, ukuze akuhloniphe, ukuze akuxhumane nawe, ukuze kube lula kuwe emazingeni adlule.
Ngakho akufanele utshele inhliziyo yakho ukuthi: "Ngiyithola lokhu ngesandla sami."
Uzokhumbula iNkosi uNkulunkulu wakho; ngoba yena okunika amandla ukuthi ube nobuningi, ukuze aqinise isivumelwano sakhe nababa bakho, njengoba kwenze ngalolu suku.
Uma ukhohlwa iNkosi uNkulunkulu wakho, futhi ulandela izitha zabanye, uzisebenzele, uzibophezele kubo; ngikuqinisekisile wena namuhla, ukuthi ngokuqinisekile uzobiwa.
Ngokungafani nezizwe, okuthi iNkosi azilahle phambi kwenu, nizohlaliswa, ngenxa yokuthi ningawulalela amazwi kaYehova uNkulunkulu wenu.
Yithi, Isirayeli: Uzodlula namhlanje umfula iYorodani, ungene ezweni lamazwe amakhulu kakhulu kuwe, namazwe anamandla kunawe, amadolobha amakhulu anezindonga ezifinyelela emkhathini.
Babantu abanamandla, abaphakade kakhulu; yibo abanganaki. Uwazi umlando wabo, futhi ufunde ukuthi kwathiwa: Ngabe kukhona ongakwazi ukubhekana nabanganaki?

Uzokwazi lokhu namuhla, ukuthi iNkosi uNkulunkulu wakho, yena ohamba phambi kwakho, njengomlilo obulalayo; yena uzozibulala, futhi uzozicindezela phambi kwakho; wena uzozisusa, uzozicima ngokushesha, njengokuthi iNkosi akutshelelayo.

Uma iNkosi uNkulunkulu wakho ewazikhipha phambi kwakho, ungathi enhliziyweni yakho, uthi, Ngokuba ngilungile, iNkosi ungingenise ukuze ngiyithathe lelizwe; kodwa ngenxa yokuthi la mazwe angcolile, iNkosi uyawasusa phambi kwakho.

Akufanele ungene uthathe izwe labo ngenxa yobulungisa bakho, noma ngenxa yobuhlakani benhliziyo yakho; kodwa ngenxa yokuthi lezi zindawo ziyizwe ezibi, uNkulunkulu wakho, iNkosi, uzozisusa phambi kwakho, ukuze aqinise igama lakhe ebelilisho kubaba bakho, uAbrahama, noIsake, noYakobi.
Uzokwazi ukuthi uNkulunkulu wakho, iNkosi, akakunikela wena leli lizwe elihle ukuze uligcine, ngenxa yobulungisa bakho; ngoba nibantu abanemilenze emide.

Khumbula, ungakhohlwa lutho, ukuthi yini ekwenzeni iNkosi uNkulunkulu wakho ahlukumezeke emhlabathini; kusukela ngosuku lokuphuma kwenu eYiputa, kuze kube sekufikeni kwenu kulo mhlaba, niye naphezu koNkulunkulu.
Nalapho emfuleni iSinayini, niyenzile iNkosi agweme, ukuze akubize.

lapho ngiye ezweni eliphakeme, ukuze ngizithole izicwebezela zegolide, izicwebezela zomnqophiso owenzayo iNkosi nani; ngahlala ezweni eliphakeme izinsuku ezimashumi amane namahora amashumi mane; angidlanga ukudla, angiphuze amanzi.

Waminika iNkosi izicwebezeli ezimbili zegolide, ezibhalwe ngesandla sikaThixo; nazo zonke lezi zinto ebezibhalwe ngazo, yimazwi onke akhuluma ngawo iNkosi kuni emfuleni, phakathi kwengcindezi, ngosuku lokuhlangana kwenu.
Kwathi lapho kuphelile izinsuku ezimashumi amane nemini eyisishiyagalombili, iNkosi wanikeze izinhlamvu ezimbili zamatshe, izincwadi zesivumelwano.
Wathi iNkosi kuye, Nquma, zula lapha ngokushesha; ngoba abantu bakho abawethula ezweni laseYiputa baphucukile; baphoqelekile ukuba bangabi nalokho engibawiselayo; benze isithombe esitsheni segolide.
Wathi futhi iNkosi kuye, Ngibona abantu labo; bona, isandla sabo sinzima kakhulu.
Lahla mina, ngizowabulala, futhi ngisuse igama labo ngezansi kwesibhakabhakeni; futhi ngizokwenza ube yizwe elinamandla kakhulu, likhulu kunalo.
Ngase ngibuyele, ngakhuphuka emfuleni, futhi umfula ugcwele umlilo; izicwebezeli ezimbili zomnqumo zazisemandleni ami.
Ngabheka, futhi ngabona ukuthi ningene emthethweni kaYehova uNkulunkulu wenu. Niyenzile idolo elifana nenyama yomuntu; nisuka ngokushesha enhliziyweni yendlela iNkosi awawiselayo.
Ngazithatha izicwebezelayo ezimbili, ngazisusa ezinyaweni zami, ngazibulala phambi kwamehlonu.

Kwathi lapho, ngase ngibeke ubuso bam phambi koYehova amahora angamashumi amane nezinsuku ezingamashumi mane; angidlanga ukudla, angiphuzi amanzi, ngenxa yobubi benu bonke obenyulile, engikwenzayo okubi emehloni kaYehova, ukuze ngimkhuze.
Ngiye ngakhathazeka ngenxa yobuhlungu benhliziyo kaYehova, ngoba wayenethemba lokuthi uzokulahla; kodwa iNkosi wandiphendula.
UYehova wagwema no-Aron, efuna ukumbulala; futhi ngathandaza ngo-Aron ngesikhathi salokho.
Ngiyithathe ingulube, leyo ndoda engalungile oyenzayo, ngiyishise emlilweni; ngayinciphisa, ngayithambisa ibe yimpuphu encane kakhulu, ngayibeka emifuleni ephuma emanzini entaba.
NaseTabera, naseMasha, naseKibrothi-hataava, nalapho niyenzile iNkosi agweme.

Nalapho iNkosi engithumelele khona eKadeshe-barnea, esithi, Yiya, niyithole izwe engikulethela. Kodwani, naphezu kwalokhu, ningakholwanga emandleni kaYehova uNkulunkulu wenu, ningawulalelanga umlomo wakhe;
Ube uphikisana noNkulunkulu kusukela mhla ngikwazanga ukukubona.
Kwathi lapho, ngibeke ubuso bam phambi kukaNkulunkulu amahora angu-40 namasonto angu-40; ngoba iNkosi wathi ukuthi uzokususa.

Ngiye ngathandaza kuYehova, ngithi, Nkosi yami uThixouNkulunkulu, ungabi yingozi abantu bakho, abantu bakho abathandekayo, owabasindisa ngokunamandla akho amakhulu, owabakhipha eYiputa ngesandla sakho esinamandla.
Khumbula abakhonzi bakho, uAbrahama, noIsake, noYakobi; ungabonanga ikhanda labo bantu, noma ububi babo, noma ukudlwengula kwabo.

Uma kungenjalo, abantu belizwe owawusikhipha kulo, bangathi, Ngokuba iNkosi akakwazanga ukuwangenisa ezweni awayewazinikela ngalo kubo, futhi ngenxa yokuthi wabakhohlisa, waphuma waya kubabulala emfuleni.
Bakho abantu bakho, abantu bakho abakhethiwe, owabakhipha ngamandla akho amakhulu, nangomlomo wakho onamandla.
Kwathi ngaleso sikhathi iNkosi wathi kuye, Uzokhehla wena izinhlamvu ezimbili zamatshe, njengezinhlamvu zangaphambilini, ungene enhliziyweni yami emfuleni; futhi uzokwenza ibhokisi lemithi.
Ngizobhalela ezitsheni lezi amazwi akhona ezitsheni zokuqala, owazibophayo; bese uzibeka ebhokisini.
Kwathi ngakwenza ibhokisi lemithi ye-acacia, futhi ngazibopha izinhlamvu ezimbili zegolide, njengezinhlamvu zokuqala, ngaya efulethini, ngizithwale izicwebezela ezibini ezandleni zami.

Wabhala phezu kwazo izicwebezelayo, ngokusho kokubhala kwakhe kuqala, amazwi alishumi, awakhuluma ngawo kuni emfuleni, phakathi kwengcindezi yomlilo, ngosuku lokuhlangana kwenu; wanikela ngazo iNkosi.
Ngiye ngabuyela, ngaphuma emfuleni, ngazibeka izibhengezo ebhokisini engikwenzayo, zihlala khona, njengokuba iNkosi angiwisele umthetho.
Basuka e-Eshboni, idolobhana lakwaJahani, bahamba befika eMosera; khona lapho wafa uAron, wabanjwa khona; uEleazaru unyana wakhe waba ngumpristi endaweni yakhe.
Basuka khona bahamba befika eGudgoda, bese besuka eGudgoda befika eYotbata, izwe elinabantu abaningi.
Ngaleso sikhathi iNkosi wahlukanisa isizwe sakwaLevi, ukuba sithathe ibhokisi lesivumelwano soNkulunkulu, ukuthi sihlale phambi koThixo, sisebenzele, sibabaze ngegama lakhe, kuze kube manje.
Ngenxa yalokho, amaLevi angeke abe nengxenye phakathi kwazo zonke izizwe; iNkosi nguwo umfelokazi wabo, njengokuthi iNkosi uNkulunkulu wakho wathi kubo.
Ngase ngihlala enhliziyweni yentaba, nsuku nezinsuku ezingu-40 nobusuku obungu-40, njengokuthi ngangihlale khona ekuqaleni; futhi iNkosi ungiphendula ngalo mzuzu wokugcina ukuthi angakulahli.
Kwathi iNkosi wathi kuye, Yiya, zulazisa labo bantu, ukuze bafike bathathe isibopho sezwe engisho ngaso kubaba babo ukuthi ngizolibanikeza lona.

Manje ke, isiSirayeli, yini ofuna yona iNkosi uNkulunkulu wakho kuwe? Ukuthi ugweme iNkosi uNkulunkulu wakho, uhambe ngezinqumo zakhe, uthandane naye, usebenzele iNkosi uNkulunkulu wakho intliziyo yakho yonke nomoya wakho wonke;
ukuze ugcine imiyalo kaYehova, nezimiso zakhe, engikhuluma ngazo kuwe namuhla, ukuze niphile.
Bheka, izulu, nezulu eliphakeme likaNkulunkulu wakho, kanye nomhlaba nanoma yini ekhona kuwo.
Kodwa-ke, iNkosi wabathandela abahlengikazi bakho, wathandana nabo, wakhetha isizukulwane sabo phezu kwazo zonke izizwe, njengokuba kwenzeka namuhla.
Ngakho shintsha inhlonipho yakho, futhi ugweme ukuba unqulo.

Ngokuba iNkosi uNkulunkulu wakho, yena uNkulunkulu ongaphezu kwazo zonke izitha, noMlawuli ongaphezu kwazo zonke iziphathimandla; yena uNkulunkulu omkhulu, onamandla, onokwesaba; akabhekanga isizwe, athathenga inkokhelo.
Uthi: "Iqiniso liwukuthi, uMuhammadu S.A.W. unenhlanhla yokuphila isikhathi eside ezweni lakwa-Arabhu, futhi ubaba wakhe ungumuntu othembekile.
Nithandani nabangani benu, ngoba nibengabangani bami ezweni laseYiputa.
Uzogwema iNkosi uNkulunkulu wakho, uzowukhonza yena; uzozibophezela kuye, futhi uzonikela ngegama lakhe.
yena uNkulunkulu wakho, owenza kuwe zonke lezi zinto ezinkulu, nezibuhlungu, amehlo akho azibonayo; yena uNkulunkulu wakho, owenza wena zonke lezi zinto ezinkulu, nezibuhlungu.
Abazali bakho bebengamashumi asixhenxe, lapho bekhuphuka eYiputa; kodwa manje iNkosi uNkulunkulu wakho wakwenza nikhulu njengezinkanyezi zezulu.
Uzothanda iNkosi uNkulunkulu wakho, ugcine izibopho zakhe, nezimiso zakhe, namalungiselelo akhe, nemiyalo yakhe yonke.

Kuze kube manje, khumbula izinto ozaziyo; ngoba angikhuluma nabantwana bakho, abangaziyo noma abazibonayo zonke izenzo zokuthi iNkosi uNkulunkulu wakho akuhloniphe wena; babone ubukhulu bakhe, nesandla sakhe esinamandla, nesifuba sakhe esiqinile,
noma izibonakaliso, futhi izinto azenzayo eYiputa kuFaro, ukumkani waseYiputa, nezwe lakhe lonke.

Bathi: "Akekho umuntu owaziyo ukuthi iNkosi wakwenzani namaphoyisa aseYiputa, namabhayisikili abo, nama-carriages abo, lapho ephonsa khona amanzi eMfula iSundu phezu kwabo, lapho bekuzilandelana nabo; futhi iNkosi wababulala bonke, kuze kube manje.
Akekho owabona lokho akwenzayo kuwe ezweni lezulu, kuze kube sekufikeni kwenu lapha,

futhi ukuthi akwenzeni uDathani noAbironi, oonyana bakaElibha, baseRubheni, lapho izwe livula umlomo walo phambi kwamadodana kaSirayeli onke, lawathela, labo nabangane babo, nezindawo zabo zokuphumula, nezilwane zabo zonke.
Ngokuba izandla zenu zabona zonke lezi zinto ezinkulu, iNkosi azenzayo.
Nizigcine zonke imithetho engikushoyo kuwe namuhla, ukuze nikwazi ukungena, niyithathe njengentando yenu izwe elidlula kulo, niyithathe njengentando yenu.
ukuze nihlale isikhathi eside phezu kwezwe, okuthi iNkosi awasho ukuthi azolibazisa ababuphikisi benu nabangani babo, izwe elishayelayo ubisi nengulube.
Ngokuba izwe okungena kulo ukulithola, alifana neYiputa, lapho niphuma khona; lapho ufaka khona isitshalo sakho, futhi uyihlanza ngesandla sakho, njengezihlahla zesitshalo.
Kodwa-ke, izwe odlula kulo ukulithatha liyilizwe lezintaba nezigodi ezidla amanzi asuka emkhathini.
Izwe iNkosi uThixouNkulunkulu wakho eligqugquzela ngalo; amehlo akhe ahlala kuwo, kusukela ekuqaleni konyaka kuze kube sekupheleni konyaka.
Uma nje nizilungisa, nilalela umthetho ongiwisela wena namuhla, ukuthi nithandane noYehova uNkulunkulu wenu, nikhonzane naye intliziyo yenu yonke nomoya wenu wonke;
Uzothumela imvula ezweni lakho ngesikhathi sayo, emveni kobusika nonyaka omusha, ukuze uqoqe izithelo zakho, newayini lakho elisha, ne-olive yakho.
Uzonikeza izithelo ezindaweni zakho, ukuze uzidle izinyoni zakho; uzodla ngokugcwele.
Khumbula ukuthi ngeke ukhohlwe ukuba ushintshe ukukhonza futhi uthandane nabanye amasiko.

Uma nikwenza njalo, khona-ke inkohliso kaYehova izoqhuma phezu kwenu; uzovala izulu, ukuze kungabi nemvula, futhi umhlaba ungakhiqizi izithelo zakhe; futhi nizofa ngokushesha ezweni elimnandi iNkosi akunika lona.
Ngakho, gcinani le ncwadi engqondweni yenu, futhi uyibeke ezinyaweni zenu njengophawu, futhi uyigqoke emilenzeni yenu njengenkumbulo.
Zifundise izingane zakho. Xhumana ngazo uma uhlala ekhaya futhi uma uhamba ngezinyawo, lapho uphumula khona futhi lapho uvuka khona.
Uzozibhalela phezu kwezingqimba zendlu yakho, namasango akho;
ukuze nihlale isikhathi eside, ninezingane zenu, ezweni iNkosi awathi abazakwabo ukuthi azolibazisa ngalo, njengokuba izulu likhona phezu kwezwe.
Uma nje niyigcina le mithetho yonke engikulethela yona, ukuthi niyithande iNkosi uNkulunkulu wenu, nihambe ngendlela yakhe ethanda ngayo, niyibambe ngokuqinile;
khona-ke iNkosi uzozisusa zonke lezi zizwe phambi kwakho, nawe uzozithola izizwe ezinkulu kunawe, ezinamandla kunawe.
Kusukela emfuleni i-Euphrates, kuze kube selwandle olukhulu, kuzobe yizwe lakho. Kuze kube yilapho uzobeka khona ingalo yakho, lizobe lizweni lakho.
Wonke umuntu ngeke akwazi ukumelana nawe; iNkosi uNkulunkulu wakho uzobeka indlala yakho phezu kwazo zonke izizwe zelizwe, lapho uzoya khona, njengokuba wathi kuwe.
Bheka, namuhla ngizokulethela ukhetho phakathi kokusindisa nokufa.
Uma ulandela amazwi kaYehova uNkulunkulu wakho, engikushoyo kuwe namuhla, uzoba nokuthula.
Uma ningenakulalela imiyalelo kaYehova uNkulunkulu wenu, futhi nisuka endlela engikulethela yona namuhla, nilandele izitha zabanye awaziyo, khona-ke ningabi necala.
Uma iNkosi uNkulunkulu wakho ekulethela izwe ohamba kulo ukulithola, uzobeka isivuno phezu komfula iGerizim, futhi usazise inkohlakalo phezu komfula iEbali.
Enyakatho-mpumalanga yeYorodani, lapho ilanga liphuma khona, ezweni lamaKanana ahlala emfuleni iYorodani, eduze kweGalgali, ngaphesheya kwezihlahla ezinkulu zeMore.
Ngokuba nihamba phezu kweYorodani, ukuze nifike nithathe isibopho sezwe iNkosi uNkulunkulu wenu akunika lona; bese niyithatha isibopho sayo, nihlala kuyo.
qaphela ukuthi ugcine zonke izimiso nemithetho engikunika yona manje.
Lawa amasiko nezimiso, okufanele nizigcine nizenza, ezweni iNkosi, uNkulunkulu wababa bakho, akunike lona ukuba liyikhaya lakho, zonke izinsuku zokuphila kwenu phezu komhlaba.
Uzobulala zonke izindawo, lapho izizwe ozakuzikhipha kuzo zikhonza khona amasiko abo, emadolobheni amahle, nasezindaweni eziphakeme, nangaphansi kwanoma yimuphi umnqumo ogqamile.
Uzophonsa phansi izibingelelo zabo, uzobopha amatshe abo angcwele, futhi uzokhipha emlilweni ama-ashere abo; uzothosa izithombe zemikhosi yabo, futhi uzosusa amagama abo kuzona zonke lezi zindawo.
Ungawukhonzanga iNkosi uNkulunkulu wakho, njengokuba bakhonza khona amadini abo.
kodwa uhambe uye endaweni ongayikhetha iNkosi uNkulunkulu wakho, phakathi kwezizwe zakho zonke, ukuze abeke khona igama lakhe; uzofuna indawo yokuhlala kwakhe, uye kuyo.
Niziveze khona izipho zenu zokungcola, neziboshwa zenu, nengxenye yeshumi yenu, nezibopho zenu, neziboniso zenu, nezibopho zenu ezithandekayo, nezibeleko zezinkomo zenu, nezibopho zengulube zenu.
Nidla khona phambi koYehova uNkulunkulu wenu, ninezingane zenu, nithokozele zonke izinto ozenzayo ngezandla zenu, ngenxa yokuthi iNkosi uNkulunkulu wakho akubabazile.
Akufanele nikwenze njengoba sikwenza lapha namuhla, lapho wonke umuntu esenza konke okucabanga ukuthi kulungile.
ngoba namanje ningafiki endaweni yokuphumula, ezweni iNkosi uThixouNkulunkulu wenu akunika lona ukuba ngumhlaba.
Uma nje nidlula iJordani, nihlala ezweni iNkosi uNkulunkulu wenu akunika lona ukuba liyikhaya lenu; futhi akunikeze ukuphumula kuzo zonke izitha zenu ezingqondweni zenu, ukuze nihlale niphephile.

Kulapho iNkosi uNkulunkulu wakho ekhetha khona igama lakhe ukuba lihlale khona, uzozisa zonke izinto engikutshela ngazo: izipho zakho ezibomvu, nezipho zakho zokudla, nezipho zakho zeshumi, nezipho zakho eziphezulu, nanoma yiziphi izinto ezinhle kakhulu ozenzayo kukaNkulunkulu.
Nizothokozela khona phambi koYehova uNkulunkulu wenu, ninezingane zenu, nezingane zenu, nabangani benu, nabangani bezinkomo zenu, noLevi ohlala ezindaweni zenu, ngoba angeke abe nengxenye yakhe.
Khumbula ukuthi angeke ubeke izipho zakho ezibomvu lapho ufuna khona.
Kuleyo ndawo iNkosi azoyikhetha esinye sezizwe zakho, khona-ke uzozinikela khona; kuzo zonke izinto engikutshele ngazo, uzozenza khona.

Uzokwazi ukunyamalala, futhi udle inyama kuwo wonke amasango akho, ngokugcwele isifiso senhliziyo yakho, ngokwesiqiniseko sokubambisana iNkosi uNkulunkulu wakho akunika sona; ongcolileyo naye ohlanzekile uzodla ngayo, njengokudla kwengulube noma ingulube.
Kodwa-ke, awudingi ukudla igazi lakhe; uzolisusa phezu komhlaba njengemanzi.

Akufanele udle kuwo wonke amasango akho, ishumi lembewu yakho, noma iwayini lakho elisha, noma uphethiloli wakho, noma okuzalwa kuqala kwezingulube zakho, noma izinkomo zakho, noma nanoma yisiphi isibingelelo sakho, noma izipho zakho ezithandekayo, noma isipho sakho esiphezulu.

Kodwa phambi koYehova uNkulunkulu wakho uzozidla, wena nonyana wakho, nendodana yakho, nomkhonzi wakho, nenkosikazi yakho, namaLevi asezindaweni zakho ezingaphakathi; futhi uzojabula phambi kukaNkulunkulu uNkulunkulu wakho ngazo zonke izinto ozenzayo.
Uzobhekana noLevi, ukuze ungamkhohlwa ngaso sonke isikhathi lapho uhlala khona ezweni lakho.
Uma iNkosi uNkulunkulu wakho ebanzisa izwe lakho, njengokuba wathi kuwe, bese ucabanga ukuthi ufuna ukudla inyama, uthi, Ngifuna ukudla inyama; khona-ke ungadla inyama ngokuya ngenhliziyo yakho.

Uma indawo oyikhethayo iNkosi uNkulunkulu wakho ukuba libekwe kuyo igama lakhe, isendaweni encane kuwe, khona-ke ungadla emifuleni yakho yonke, njengoba ngikuwisele umthetho ngayo, kusuka ezilwaneni zakho zengulube noma zezinkomo, ongazinika iNkosi.
Uzodla ngayo, njengoba udla ngayo inkomo noma ingulube; umuntu ongcolile nomuntu ohlanzekile bazodla ngayo.
Kodwa uqiniseke ukuthi awudlanga igazi, ngoba igazi liyimpilo. Awudingi ukudla inhliziyo kanye nenyama.
Ungadlanga igazi. Uzolibazisa phezu komhlaba njengamanzi
Ungayidla, ukuze kube lula kuwe, nawe izingane zakho ngemuva kwakho; ngoba uzokwenza lokho okulungile emehloni kaYehova.
Uzothatha izinto zakho ezingcwele, nezibopho zakho, uhambe uye endaweni ongayikhethela iNkosi.

Uzonikela ngezipho zakho ezibomvu, inyama negazi, esibhedlela sikaYehova uNkulunkulu wakho; kodwa igazi lezinto zakho ezibomvu kumele litholwe eduze kwesibhedlela sikaYehova uNkulunkulu wakho; inyama yakho uzoyidla.

Hamba ugcine, ulalele la mazwi onke ngikutshela wona; ukuze kube lula kuwe, nawe izingane zakho ngemuva kwakho, kuze kube sesikhathi eside, uma wenza okulungile, nokulungile emehlo kaYehova uNkulunkulu wakho.
UYehova uNkulunkulu wakho uzozisusa zonke izizwe phambi kwakho, ezweni okungena kulo ukulithola; futhi uma uzinqobe, ube khona ezweni labo.

bhekana nabo, ukuze ungabi yingozi, ulandele indlela yabo, ngemuva kokulahleka kwabo phambi kwakho; futhi akufanele ubuze ngemithandazo yabo, uthi: Ngokufana nokuthi lezi zizwe zazenza kanjani imibhishobho yazo, sizokwenza kanjalo.

Ungamkhonzi iNkosi uNkulunkulu wakho ngendlela yabo; ngoba konke okungathandeki kukaNkulunkulu, okungukuthi, izinto angeke azithandane ngazo, bakwenza ezingcweleni zabo; ngisho namadodana abo namakhosikazi abo bayawasindisa ngomlilo ezingcweleni zabo.
Hamba ubheke ukuthi wenze konke engikushoyo kuwe. Ungayitholi lutho kuyo, futhi ungayisusa lutho kuyo.
Uma kukhona umprofeti noma umuntu ochaza iphupho, angavela phakathi kwenu futhi akubhekele uphawu oluyiqiniso noma umbono.
Uma kwenzeke izimpawu, noma isimanga, akhuluma ngazo, bese ethi, Siyalandela izitha zabanye, izitha ongazaziyo, futhi siyazikhonza;
ngeke ulalele umprofeti lowo, noma umphuphi lowo; ngoba iNkosi uNkulunkulu wenu uyayihlola, ukuze akwazi ukuthi nithandani iNkosi uNkulunkulu wenu ngentliziyo yenu yonke, nangemphefumlo wenu wonke.
Uzolandela iNkosi uNkulunkulu wakho, uzomkhathalela; uzogcina izimiso zakhe, uzozilalela; uzowukhonza yena, futhi uzozibophezela kuye.

Lo mprofeti, noma lo mphuphi, kumele abulawe; ngoba wakhuluma ukuthi nizizwe ningakholwa kuYehova uNkulunkulu wenu, owenza ukuba niphume ezweni laseYiputa, ukuze nikhululwe endlu yobugebengu, futhi wafuna ukunisusa enhliziyweni yenu ekuhambeni enhliziyweni kaYehova uNkulunkulu wenu. Uzokhipha lokhu okubi phakathi kwenu;

Uma udade wakho, noma unyana wakho, noma intombi yakho, noma intombazane yakho, noma umngane wakho othandekayo, bafuna ukukhohlisa wena ngokufihlakeleyo, bethi, "Siye futhi sikhonza amanye amagugu," okuyinto awuzange wazi wena nababa bakho;
izitha zakwa-abantu abajikeleze wena, noma ngabe eduze noma kude, kusukela engxenyeni eyodwa yezwe kuya kwesinye.
Musa ukunikela kubo noma ukulalela kwabo. Ungazizwa ubuhlungu ngenxa yabo. Ngakho-ke, akufanele ubagcine noma ubasize.
Uzowabulala ngaso sonke isikhathi. Isandla sakho kufanele sibe sokuqala ukuwahlasela, futhi ngemuva kwalokho izandla zabantu bonke.
Uzobeka amatshe phezu kwabo, baphile; ngoba befuna ukukususa kuYehovaivelwe uNkulunkulu wakho, owakulethela ezweni laseYiputa, izwe lapho ubengumkhonzi.
Bazokwazi bonke isiSirayeli, bakhathazeke, futhi akukho muntu phakathi kwenu ozoqhubeka ekwenzeni lokhu okubi.
Uma ukhuluma ngalinye lamadolobha akho, akunika wona iNkosi uNkulunkulu wakho ukuba uhlale kuwo,
Ngokuba kwaphuma phakathi kwenu abantu ababi kakhulu, ababekhohlisa abantu basendaweni yabo, bethi, "Thina sizokhonza amanye amagugu ngaphandle kwakho," ongakaze wazi.
Uma kwenzeka ukuthi lokhu kuyiqiniso, futhi kuqinisekiswe ukuthi lokhu okubi kwenzeke phakathi kwenu,
kufanele ubulala bonke abantu balo dolobha ngeqhwa. Uzolimaza ngokuphelele, nanoma ubani ohlala kulo kanye nezilwane zalo.

Uzoqoqa zonke izinto ezithathwe kulo mzi, uzibeke phakathi kwedolobhana lakhe elivulekile; uzowuphonsa umlilo lo mzi wonke, nanoma yini ekhona kuwo, ibe ngumnikelo wokudla kuYehova uNkulunkulu wakho; kumele ibe yindawo yokuphazamiseka kuze kube sekupheleni, ngeke iphinde ibuyiselwe.
Akufanele nigcine lutho oluyigugu, ukuze iNkosi ashintshe inhliziyo yakhe ebuhlungu, futhi anibonise inhlonipho nothando, futhi akusize ukuthi nikhule kakhulu, njengoba wathi kubazali benu.
Uma nje ulalela izwi likaYehova uNkulunkulu wakho, ukuthi ugcine zonke izenzo zakhe engikwenzayo namuhla, ukuze wenze okulungile emehlo kaYehova uNkulunkulu wakho.
Niye izingane zikaYehova uNkulunkulu wenu; uma umuntu efa, ningeke nigwebe ikhanda lenu, noma nigwebe isifuba senu.
ngoba wena uyisizwe esikhethekile, isizwe esingcwele kuYehova uNkulunkulu wakho; iNkosi usazikhethela ukuba ube yimpahla yakhe ekhethekile phakathi kwazo zonke izizwe ezikhona phezu komhlaba.
Akufanele nidle noma yini engathandeki kuNkulunkulu.
Lezi yizinto eziphilayo ongazidla: inkomo, nengulube, nobhontshisi,
i-deer, i-gazelle, i-roe deer, i-wild goat, i-ibex, i-antilope, kanye ne-mountain sheep.
Ungadla noma yiluphi uhlobo lwenyama elinekhanda elihlukaniswe ngamaphiko amabili futhi elinquma ukutya.

Kodwa phakathi kwazo zonke izinyoni ezinyamalalayo, noma ezinamakhopho aphindwe kabili, ngeke nidle i-engeli, noma ingulube, noma inkomo, ngoba zinyamalalayo, kodwa azinamakhopho aphindwe kabili; zizoba zimbi kuwe.
Ingulube nayo ingcolile kuwe. Inezinyawo ezihlukanisiwe kodwa ayidlanga ubisi. Ungadli inyama yazo noma udinge izicubu zabo.
Kuzo zonke izilwane eziphila emanzini, ungadla noma yini equkethe ama-fins nama-scales.
Uma kukhona okunye okungaba nezinhlangothi ezimbili noma ezintathu, futhi kungase kube khona izinhlangothi ezimbili noma ezintathu.
Ungadla noma iyiphi inkomo ehlanzekile.
Lezo ziyizinyoni ezingadlanga: i-eagle, ne-vulture, ne-osprey,
i-red kite, i-falcon, noma yiluphi uhlobo lwe-kite,
noma yiluphi uhlobo lwe-raven
i-ostrich, i-owl, i-seagull, noma yiluphi uhlobo lwehawk,
i-owl encane, i-owl enkulu, i-horned owl,
i-pelican, i-vulture, i-cormorant,
i-stork, noma yiluphi uhlobo lwe-heron, i-hoopee, ne-bat.
Zonke izinhlanzi ezindizayo zingcolile kuwe. Ungazidla.
Kodwa-ke ungadla noma iyiphi inhlanzi ehlelekile.

Uma uthola into efile, awukwazi ukuyidla; ungayinika umngane wakho ohlala eziteshini zakho, ukuthi ayidle, noma uyithengise kumngani wakho; ngoba wena ungumuntu ongcwele ohlukanisiwe kuYehova uNkulunkulu wakho. Awukwazi ukubhaka ingulube emlilweni womntwana wayo.
Ngawo wonke unyaka qiniseka ukuthi ubeka phansi ingxenye yesishiyagalombili yazo zonke izitshalo ozikhiqizayo emithini yakho.

Uzodla ishumi lembewu yakho, newayini lakho elisha, nophethiloli lwakho, kanye nalabo abazalwa kuqala emihlambini yakho yamadodakazi akho, namakati akho, phambi koYehova uNkulunkulu wakho, endaweni akhetha kuyo ukuba lihlale khona igama lakhe; ukuze ufunde ukukhathazeka ngoYehova uNkulunkulu wakho yonke imihla.

Uma iNkosi uNkulunkulu wakho ekubambisana nawe, khona-ke indawo akhetha ngayo igama lakhe izoba eduze kakhulu kuwe, futhi indlela ibe yindilinga kakhulu, ukuze ungayithutha khona inkomishi yakho yeshumi.
bese uyithengisa ngemali, uthathe imali yakho emlenzeni wakho, uye endaweni iNkosi uNkulunkulu wakho azoyikhetha.

Uzothenga ngalemali yonke into oyifunayo inhliziyo yakho, inkomo, nengulube, newayini, neziphuzo ezishisayo, noma iyiphi enye into oyifunayo inhliziyo yakho; uzodla khona phambi koYehova uNkulunkulu wakho, wena nomndeni wakho, futhi ujabulise.
ULevi, ohlala ezindaweni zakho zokudlela, ungawukhohlwa; ngoba yena akakho umfelokazi wakhe.
Ngokuphela konyaka ngamunye wesithathu, nizothola ishumi eliphelele lembewu yonyaka lowo, niyigcine emizini yenu.

Uzofika khona uLevi, ongeke abe nengxenye yakhe, nomunye umhlali, nomntwana omncane, nowesifazane ezindaweni zakho zokungenisa izivakashi; bazodla futhi bathobele, ukuze iNkosi uNkulunkulu wakho akubabazise ngaso sonke isenzo sakho esiwenzayo.
Ekupheleni kweminyaka eyisithupha, kufanele ubuyisele emuva wonke ama-debt.

Lokhu kufanele kwenzeke: wonke umuntu odlulisa imali kumngane wakhe, umSirayeli, kumele alungise; akudingeki ukuthi akhokhele umndeni wakhe noma isihlobo sakhe, ngoba isikhathi sokubuyiselwa kukaNkulunkulu sisholwe.
Ungacela ukukhokhelwa kwamanye amazwe, kodwa kufanele ubuyisele noma iyiphi inkontileka umngane wakho waseSirayeli edinga kuwe.
Akufanele kube khona umuntu ohlwempu phakathi kwakho; ngoba iNkosi uzokubambisana nawe ngokukhulu, ezweni iNkosi uNkulunkulu wakho akunika lona ukuba libe yilungelo lakho.
uma nje ulalela izwi likaYehova uNkulunkulu wakho, ukuthi ugcine ukwenze la mazwi onke ngikuwisela wona namuhla.
ngoba iNkosi, uNkulunkulu wakho, uzokubambisana nawe, njengoba ekushoyo; futhi uzodlulisa izimali ezizwe eziningi, kodwa wena awuzodlulisa. Uzolawula izizwe eziningi, kodwa azizokuphatha wena.

Uma kukhona umhlwempu phakathi kwabazalwane bakho, nganoma iyiphi idolobhana lakho, ezweni iNkosi uNkulunkulu wakho akunika lona, ungabi nomsindo emlonyeni wakho, futhi ungagcini ngesandla sakho kulowo mhlwempu.
Ngaleyo ndlela, ube nesandla esivulekile futhi ubanikeze ngokukhululekile konke okudingayo.

Hamba, ugweme ukuba kube khona imibono emibi enhliziyweni yakho, ukuthi: "Unyaka wesixhenxe, unyaka wokubuyiselwa imali, usekude," futhi ugweme ukubopha umlomo wakho kulabo abampofu phakathi kwabazalwane bakho, abantu bakaSirayeli, ukuze ungawahlinzeki ngalutho; uma kungenjalo, bazokhala kuYehova ngenxa yakho, futhi ube nesono.
Uzonikela kubo ngokugcwele, ungabi nenhliziyo ebuhlungu uma unikela; ukuze iNkosi uNkulunkulu wakho akubabazise ngenxa yalokho kuwo wonke umsebenzi wakho, nakunoma yini oyenzayo.
Bazohlala abantu abahlwempu ezweni; ngakho ngikuwisela umthetho, ukuthi uvule isandla sakho kubo bonke abazalwane bakho, labo abahlwempu ezweni lakho, bomndeni wakwaSirayeli.
Uma ethe wathengwa kuwe umngane wakho, oHebhere, indodana noma indodakazi, futhi esebenza kuwe iminyaka emihlanu; ngonyaka wesixhenxe uzowushiya aphume emlonyeni wakhe.
Uma ninika izibopho zabo, akufanele nizishiye zisondelene.
Uzonikela kubo ngenyama yakho, nendawo yokudla kwakho, nomshini wakho wokucindezela iwayini; uzonikela kubo ngokuya ngokuthi iNkosi uThixouNkulunkulu wakho akubhekele wena.
Uzokhumbula ukuthi ube ngumkhonzi ezweni laseMisri, futhi iNkosi uNkulunkulu wakho wamkhulula; ngakho ngikutshela lokhu namuhla.
Uma ngabe umkhonzi wakho ekhuluma kuwe, ethi, Ngingakushiya, ngenxa yokuthi uthanda wena nomndeni wakho, futhi uthanda ukuphumula nawe.
bese uthatha isibhamu esijulile, uyibophe emlonyeni wakhe emnyango; futhi uzobe ngumkhonzi wakho nsuku zonke. Ngokufana nalokho wenze nomkhonzi wakho.

Akufanele ucabange ukuthi kunzima ukukhulula umkhonzi wakho, ngoba iminyaka eyisishiyagalombili yomsebenzi wakhe ilingana neminyaka emithathu yomsebenzi womuntu okhokhelwa imali; futhi iNkosi uNkulunkulu wakho uzokubambisana nawe kuwo wonke umsebenzi wakho.

Uzonikela kuYehova uNkulunkulu wakho wonke owesifazane oqale ibele lakhe, phakathi kwezingulube zakho nezimvu zakho; awusebenzisi oqale ibele lakhe phakathi kwezilwane zakho eziphilayo emisebenzini yakho, futhi awugqugquzeli oqale ibele lakhe phakathi kwezimvu zakho.
Uzozidla phambi koYehova uNkulunkulu wakho, wena nomndeni wakho, ngonyaka ngamnye, endaweni azoyikhetha.
Uma isilwane sinomthwalo, uma sithi sifile, noma simnyama, noma sinomthwalo othile omkhulu, ungawunikelanga kuYehova uNkulunkulu wakho.
Ezindaweni zakho zedolobha, nizokudla; lowo ongcolile nolowo ohlanzekile bangadla, njengokudla ingulube noma ingulube efile.
Kodwa-ke, awudingi ukudla igazi lakhe; uzolisusa phezu komhlaba njengemanzi.
Yenza iPasha kuYehova uNkulunkulu wakho enyangeni ka-Abib; ngoba ngonyaka ka-Abib iNkosi uNkulunkulu wakho waphuma kuwe emazweni aseYiputa ekuseni.
Uzonikela ngoPasha kuYehova uNkulunkulu wakho, ngenyama yomntwana wakho noma ngenyama yenkomo yakho, endaweni ongayikhetha iNkosi ukuba lihlale khona igama lakhe.

Akufanele uyidle nokudla okunamakhowe. Izinsuku ezisixhenxe uzodla ukudla okungamakhowe, ukudla kobuhlungu; ngoba uphuma eYiputa ngokusheshayo; ukuze uzicabangele izinsuku zakho zonke, usuku lokuphuma kwakho eYiputa.
Akudingeki ukuthi kube khona ukhilimu ezweni lakho lonke, izinsuku ezisixhenxe; futhi inyama oyinikelayo ngemini yokuqala ekuseni, akudingeki ukuba ihlale kuze kube ngubusuku.
Awukwazi ukubhiyozela iPasha kuphi naphi ezindaweni zakho, okuthi iNkosi uNkulunkulu wakho akunikeze kuzo.
Kulapho iNkosi uNkulunkulu wakho ekhetha khona igama lakhe ukuba lihlale khona, lapho uzolibazisa khona ngobusuku, lapho ilanga liphuma khona, ngesikhathi sosuku lokuphuma kwakho eYiputa.
Uzoyibhaka, uyidle endaweni iNkosi uThixouNkulunkulu wakho azoyikhetha; kusasa nizobuya ezindaweni zenu.
Izinsuku eziyisishiyagalombili uzodla ukudla okunamafutha ancane; ngosuku oluyisixhenxe kuzoba khona isibingelelo esigcwele kuYehova uNkulunkulu wakho; ngeke wenze lutho.
Bhala amaviki ayisishiyagalombili kusukela ngesikhathi uqala ukugoqa izithelo ezindlini.
Uzoyenza izinsuku zosuku lokuphumula kuYehova uNkulunkulu wakho, ngomnikelo osuka enhliziyweni yakho; uzowunikela ngokuya ngezinhlanhla zeNkosi iNkosi uNkulunkulu wakho awakulethela.

Uzowujabulela phambi kweNkosi uNkulunkulu wakho, endaweni akhetha kuyo ukuba lihlale khona igama lakhe, wena nonyana wakho, nenkosikazi yakho, nomkhonzi wakho, nomkhonzi wakho, noLevi ongaphakathi eziteshini zakho, nomunye umuntu, nowesilisa noma wesifazane, nowesifazane noma isifazane esihlala phakathi kwakho.
Khumbulani ukuthi nibe ngabakhonzi ezweni laseMisri, futhi nigweme ukwenza lokhu.
Uzokwenza usuku lwezindlu zokuhlala usuku oluyisixhenxe, lapho uzoqoqa khona izithelo zakho emgodini wakho, nobisi lwakho emgodini wokudla.
Uzowujabulela lo mcimbi wakho, wena nonyana wakho nonkosikazi wakho, umkhonzi wakho nonkosikazi wakho, nomLevi, nomningi, nomnaphakade, nendodakazi yowesifazane, abasezindaweni zenu.

Izinsuku ezisixhenxe uzokwenza isikhumbuzo kuYehova uNkulunkulu wakho, endaweni ongayikhethela iNkosi; ngoba iNkosi uNkulunkulu wakho uzobabalisa zonke izithelo zakho, nemisebenzi yonke yezandla zakho, ukuze ube nothando olugcwele.

Izinsuku ezintathu ngonyaka uzovela wonke umuntu wakho owesifazane phambi koYehova uNkulunkulu wakho, endaweni akhetha kuyo; emcimbini wokudla okungabhakiwe, nomcimbini wamaviki, nomcimbini wezindlu zangasese. Akukho muntu ozofika phambi kweNkosi ngesandla esisha.
Uzonikela wonke umuntu ngokuya ngamandla akhe, ngokwezinhlekelele iNkosi uNkulunkulu wakho awakulethela.
Uzobeka abavikeli nabaphathi emindenini yenu, kuwo wonke amadolobhana akho, awanikayo iNkosi uNkulunkulu wakho; bazophatha abantu ngokufanele.
Mhlawumbe ngeke ushintshe isinqumo, noma uthathe isikhalazo, noma uthathe inkokhelo; ngoba inkokhelo ivala amehlo owaziyo, futhi iguqula amagama abo abalungile.
Uzolandela inkohliso, inkohliso kuphela, ukuze uphile, futhi ube yilungu lezwe iNkosi uNkulunkulu wakho akunika lona.
Uma ukwakha isibingelelo kuYehova uNkulunkulu wakho, akufanele ubeke itshe le-Ashera elinamatshe eduze kwalo;
futhi ngeke ubeke itshe elingcwele, ngoba iNkosi uNkulunkulu wakho ubakhohlisa.
Awuzonikela kuYehova uNkulunkulu wakho inkomo, noma ingulube, enecala nanoma yisiphi isibopho; ngoba iNkosi uNkulunkulu wakho uyayixosha.

Uma kutholakala umuntu, indoda noma indodakazi, ngaphakathi kwanoma iyiphi yezindawo zakho eziphakathi, iNkosi uNkulunkulu wakho akunika zona, ekwenzeni okubi ngamehlo kaYehova uNkulunkulu wakho, ephula isivumelwano sakhe;
Kuze kube sengathi baye bakhonza amanye ama-mighty, futhi babekezela kubo, noma ilanga, noma uLwezi, noma izinkanyezi ezulu, okuyinto ngiwavimbele.
Uma kuthunyelwe kuwe ngalolu daba, noma uma ukuzwa ngalolu daba, khona-ke uhlole ngokucophelela; futhi uma kuyiqiniso, uma kutholakale ukuthi lokhu okubi sekwenzeke eSirayeli,
khona-ke uthathe indodana noma indodakazi eyenze le nto embi, uyiveze emgwaqeni wedolobha lakho, uyitshele, aze afe.
Uma kukhona umuntu ofuna ukufa, kufanele abulawe ngokusho kwamasosha amabili noma amathathu; uma kukhona umuntu ofuna ukufa, kumele abulawe ngokusosha komuntu owodwa.
Amasosha kumele abe yibo abakuqala ukushaya ngombhoshongo lowo muntu, bese bonke abantu kufanele bahlanganyele kulo. Kuzosuswa lokhu okubi phakathi kwenu.

Ezinye izingxabano ezifika phambi kwezinkantolo zakho zasendaweni zingaba nzima kakhulu ukuthi uzigweme, njengezingxabano zokubulala, noma zokuthi ngubani onelungelo emdlalweni, noma zokulimala. Ngaleyo ndlela uzithathele indawo iNkosi uNkulunkulu wakho azoyikhetha.
Uzohamba ufike kubapristi, abaLevi, nommeli ozoba khona ngaleso sikhathi; uzobuza isinqumo sabo, futhi bazokutshela isiphetho sabo.
Uzosebenza ngesinqumo abakulethelayo, lapho iNkosi ekhetha khona. Khumbula ukukwenza konke okuthe bakusho kuwe.
futhi ulandele imithetho yabo, kanye nesinqumo sabo, futhi akufanele ushintshe kusuka kwabo ngakwesokudla noma ngakwesobunxele.

Wonke umuntu, uma ehamba ngesandla sakhe esiqinile, futhi engawulalela umpristi, ohlala khona ekhonza iNkosi uNkulunkulu wakho, noma ummeli, kumele abulawe; ngakho-ke uzosusa okubi ezweni lakwaSirayeli.
Futhi abantu bonke bazokubona, futhi bazokhathazeka, futhi ngeke baphinde babekezela.
Uma usufike ezweni iNkosi uThixouNkulunkulu wakho akunika lona, ube yilungu layo, uhlala kulo; bese uthi, Sibeke ukumkani phezu kwethu, njengokuba zikhona izizwe zonke ezimi ngaso sonke isikhathi.

Uma kunjalo, qiniseka ukuthi uyakwenza ube ngukumkani lowo iNkosi uNkulunkulu wakho ozowukhetha; kumele abe yindodana yakho; ngeke ubeke phezu kwakho umuntu ongaphandle, ongasekho phakathi kwabaSirayeli.
Akufanele ukumkani ahlanganise amahhashi amaningi, futhi abuyisele abantu eYiputa ukuze abe nemahhashi amakhulu; ngoba iNkosi uthi kuwe: Awuzobuya ngaleyo ndlela njalo.
Akudingeki ukuthi athathe amadoda amaningi, ukuze inhliziyweni yakhe ingaphazamisi iNkosi; futhi akudingeki ukuthi agcine igolide nesilivere eningi.
Uma ehlala esihlalweni sakhe sobukhosi, kufanele abhale ikopi yalo mthetho encwadini yakhe, evela kwikopi eligcinwe ezinyaweni zabapristi abaLevi.
Uzoyigcina, futhi uzoyifunda yonke imihla yokuphila kwakhe, ukuze afunde ukukhathazeka kuYehova uNkulunkulu wakhe, ukuthi agcine akwenze zonke izimiso zalo mthetho nalawo malungiselelo.

Akekho ozocabanga ukuthi ungcono kunabo bonke abantu bakaSirayeli, futhi angeke ashintshe isandla sakhe sokudla noma isandla sakhe sakwesobunxele; kodwa yena nomndeni wakhe bazolawula ezweni likaSirayeli iminyaka emide.
Abapristi abaLevi, bonke isizwe sakwaLevi, ngeke babe nengxenye ezweni lakwaSirayeli; bazodla iminikelo yokushiswa kaYehova, leyo yinxalenye yabo.
Bazobe bengathola izwe phakathi kwezizwe, ngoba iNkosi nguye ozoba yingxenye yabo, njengokuthi wathi kubo.
Lokhu okuzothathwa ngababhishobhi kulabo abantu abanikela ngenhlanhla yabo, noma ingulube, noma inkomo: umlenze, nemilenze emibili, nesisu.
Banikeze nezinto zokuqala zembewu yakho, newayini lakho elisha, nophethiloli lwakho, nezingulube zakho ezincane.
Ngokuba iNkosi uNkulunkulu wakho wakhetha labo, nabangane babo ngemuva kwabo, phakathi kwezizwe zenu zonke, ukuba bahlale bekhonza ngegama iNkosi nsukuzonke.
ULevi angasuka kuwo wonke amadolobha aseSirayeli, lapho ehlala khona, afike endaweni iNkosi azoyikhetha, ngenxa yothando lwakhe lokuya kuyo.
Ake asebenze khona ngegama likaYehova uNkulunkulu wakhe, njengabo bonke abazalwane bakhe abaLevi, abasebenza khona phambi kukaYehova.
Kudingeka athole inkontileka elinganayo yokudla, ngisho nakuba unemali evela ekuthengiseni izimpahla zomndeni wakhe.
Uma usufike ezweni iNkosi uNkulunkulu wakho akunika lona, ungafundi ukukwenza ngokwezinto ezibi zazo zonke izizwe.
Akufanele kube khona umuntu phakathi kwenu onikela unyana wakhe noma intombi yakhe emgodini, noma okhuluma ngezinkanyezi, noma okhuluma ngezinhlamvu, noma osebenza ngesihluku, noma owenza izimanga,
noma enza izimanga abantu, noma ekhuluma namaphupho, noma uyisizi, noma ezama ukuxoxa nabantu abafileyo.
Wonke umuntu owenza zonke lezi zinto, iNkosi uyazixosha; ngenxa yazo zonke lezi zinto ezingathandeki, iNkosi uThixouNkulunkulu wakho ubasusa phambi kwenu.
Uzobe uthembekile ngokuphelele kukaNkulunkulu wakho.
Uma izizwe ozikhiphayo zilalela abantu abanezintshisekelo, nalabo abaivelisayo; kodwa iNkosi uNkulunkulu wakho akakuvumele ukuthi wenze lokhu.
UNkulunkulu wakho, iNkosi, uzokulethela umprofeti ovela emiphakathini yakho, efana nami; yena nizomulalela.

Ngokuya ngento oyicelayo kuYehova uNkulunkulu wakho emfuleni iSina, ngosuku lokuhlangana kwenu, esithi, Akufanele siphinde sibe nezwi leNkosi uNkulunkulu wethu, noma siphinde sibone lomlilo omkhulu, ukuze singafa.
Wathi iNkosi kuye, Kulungile lokho abakushoyo.
Ngizobavusa umprofeti phakathi kwabo, njengokho wena; ngizobeka amagama ami emlonyeni wakhe, azokhuluma nabo zonke izinto engikumwisela kuzo.
Uma umuntu engalalelanga amazwi ami, akhulumayo umprofeti ngegama lami, ngizowubeka engozini yena.
Kodwa umprofeti uma ekhuluma ngegama lami, into engingeke ngimwise ukuthi akhulume ngayo, noma uma ekhuluma ngegama labanye abangcwele, lowo mprofeti kufanele aphele.
Uzothi, Ngabe singazi kanjani ukuthi umlayezo awukho osuka kukaNkulunkulu?
Uma umprofeti ekhuluma ngegama lika-Yehova, futhi lokho akushoyo akwenzeki, noma akwenzekile, khona-ke lo mbhalo awukho kukaNkulunkulu. Lo mprofeta ukhulume ngokuzinikela kwakhe; ungamkhohlwa.
UYehova uNkulunkulu wakho uzozibulala zonke izizwe, ezinika wena izwe labo; futhi uma uzinqobe, bese uhlala emizini yabo nasezikhungweni zabo.
ukhetheni imiphakathi emithathu enkingeni yenu, ezweni iNkosi uThixouNkulunkulu wenu akunika lona ukuba lilungu lenu.
Uzozenza izitezi, uhlukanise izwe lakho, elikunika lona iNkosi uNkulunkulu wakho ukuba libe yikhaya lakho, zibe yizingxenye ezintathu; ukuze wonke lowo obulala umuntu ahambe esinye salezi zifunda.
Le yimithetho yomuntu obulala umuntu futhi ehamba khona ukusindisa impilo yakhe: kumele abulawe umngane wakhe ngengozi, ngaphandle kokuxosha kwangaphambili.

Njengesibonelo, umuntu angaya emfuleni nomngane wakhe ukusika umnqumo. Uma ecindezela i-ax ukuze akhuphule umnqumo, intamo ingahamba ngaphandle kwesandla futhi ihlasele umngane wakhe ibulala yena. Lo muntu angahamba kusinye salezi zindawo futhi agcine impilo yakhe.

Uma kungenjalo, umshado womuntu oshonile onesibopho sokuxolisa umbulalayo ungamlandela ngejubane. Uma uhambo lude, angamuthola futhi amhole, nakuba umuntu akafanele ukufa, ngoba akazange athande umngane wakhe ngaphambi kwalokho.
Ngalokho ngikutshela ukuthi ukhethe izifunda ezintathu.
UNkulunkulu wakho, iNkosi, akwenze izwe lakho libe likhulu kakhulu, njengoba esho kwababa bakho, futhi akunikeze lonke izwe lakhe, njengoba esho kubo.

uma nje ugcina ukwenzela zonke lezi mithetho, ngikuwisela umthetho ngayo namuhla, ukuthi uyithande iNkosi uNkulunkulu wakho, ukuba uhambe phambi kwakhe yonke imihla; khona-ke uzozikhethela ezinye izizwe ezintathu, ngaphandle kwalezi zithathu.
Uzokwenza lokhu, ukuze umuntu ongenacala angafa ezweni iNkosi uNkulunkulu wakho akunika lona ukuthi ube yintando yakho; futhi ungabi necala lokufa kwakhe.
Uma kukhona umuntu othandana nomndeni wakhe, efihlakele, efuna ukuwubulala, bese ehamba esinye salezi zifundazwe.
futhi, uma efika emzini wakhe, amaphoyisa azothumela ukuwathola, ukuthatha kuye ngaphandle komgwaqo, futhi wanikela kuye umlingani wakhe, ukuze agweme ingozi yokuphila.
Akufanele ukhathazeke ngaye, kodwa kufanele uhlanze isizwe sakwaSirayeli ekufakeni abantu abangenacala, ukuze kube lula kuwe.
Ungayihambisanga imikhawulo yomngane wakho, eyabe ibekwe yimiphakathi yangaphambilini kwakho, ezweni ozoba nalo, ezweni iNkosi uNkulunkulu wakho akunika lona ukuze ulithathe.
Umshayeli owodwa akakwazi ukukhombisa umuntu ukuthi unecala, noma enze inkohlakalo. Ubufakazi bokuthi isinqumo sizothathwa ngemilomo yabantu ababini noma abathathu.
Uma umshushisi okhohlisayo ehlala phezulu ukusola umuntu ngecala,
labo bantu ababili ababhekene necala kumele bahlale phambi kukaYehova, phambi kwabavikeli nabasenkantolo abazobe bekhona ngesikhathi salokho.
Uma kubhekwa ukuthi lo mshushisi ungumkhohlisi, ekhuluma ubuxoki mayelana nomunye wesizwe samaSirayeli,
bese ungenza kulowo okhuluma ngokungeqiniso, njengokuthi lowo okhuluma ngobugebengu wayefuna ukukwenza komunye umuntu. Uzosusa okubi phakathi kwenu.
Nabo bonke abanye abantu bazokubona, futhi bazokhathazeka; ngeke kube khona umuntu ozoqhubeka ekwenzeni lokhu okubi phakathi kwenu.
Akufanele ukhathazeke ngabo. Ubuhlungu kufanele bulinganise necala: impilo ngempilo, inhliziyo ngenhliziyo, izinyo ngezinyo, isandla ngesandla, ingalo ngenyawo.

Uma usuya empilweni yokulwa nabaphikisi bakho, bese ubona amabhayisikili, namabhasi, nomphakathi omkhulu kunawe, ungabakhohlwa; ngoba iNkosi, uNkulunkulu wakho, owakulethela ezweni laseYiputa, unguwe.
Uma ufuna ukungena emdlalweni, umpristi kufanele afike ngaphambilini futhi akhulume nomndeni.
Uzothi, Lila, isiSirayeli; namuhla niphumani ukubhekana nabaphikisi benu emdlalweni. Ungabi nenhliziyo ebuhlungu, ungabi nomoya, noma ukhathazeke, futhi ungabi nomsindo ngenxa yabo.
Ngokuba iNkosi uNkulunkulu wenu, yena ohamba nani; yena ozobhekana nabahlukumezayo ngenxa yenu, ukuze akusindise.
Bathi abaphathi kubo bonke abantu, bethi, Ingabe kukhona umuntu owenza indlu entsha, futhi angayilungiseleli? Uzobuyela ekhaya lakhe; kungase kube wukufa emkhosini, futhi omunye umuntu ayenze.
Ingabe kukhona umuntu otshala iviniga, akayidla isithelo sayo? Uzobuyela ekhaya lakhe; noma ngabe uzofa emkhosini, futhi omunye umuntu uzodla isithelo sayo.
Ingabe kukhona owesifazane owazibophezela kuye, kodwa akazange azinikele kuye? Ake ahambe ekhaya lakhe; noma ngabe uzofa emdlalweni futhi omunye umuntu azonikela yena.
Uma kukhona umuntu okhathazekile, noma elahlekile ithemba lakhe, kufanele ahambe ekhaya, ukuze nabangani bakhe abazobe belahleka ithemba labo.
Uma abaphathi beqedile ukukhuluma nemikhosi, kufanele bakhethe abaholi abazoyiongoza.
Uma uhamba ukuhlasela idolobha, kuqala unikeza abantu bayo isiqiniseko.
Uma bekuvuma, futhi bekuvulela wena amasango abo, khona-ke bonke abantu abakhona bazobe bengabasebenzi bakho, basebenze kuwe.
Uma bengeke bakulethe isiqiniseko kuwe, futhi bangakuhlasela, khona-ke hlanganisana nabo bese uqala ukuwahlasela.
Uma iNkosi uNkulunkulu wakho ekulethela phambi kwakho, uzobulala wonke umuntu okhona ngeqhwa.

Kodwa izifazane, nezincane, nezilwane ezifuywayo, nanoma yini ekhona kulo dolobha, uzozithatha wena; uzozidla zonke izimpahla zobugebengu obusuka kuma-aphoyintimenti akho, okuthi iNkosi uNkulunkulu wakho akunikeze zona.
Uzokwenza njalo namadolobha onke asendaweni engaphandle kwakho, amadolobha angaba yiyo imiphakathi yezwe elinokude nawe.
Kodwa ezindaweni zezizwe, azininika iNkosi uNkulunkulu wakho ukuba zibe yindawo yakho yokuhlala, ungashiyanga lutho oluphilayo.
Uzozibulala ngazo zonke izinto, amaHeti, nama-Amoreti, namaKanana, namaPerizi, namaHivi, namaJebhusi, njengoba iNkosi uNkulunkulu wakho akuwisele umthetho.
ukuze bangakufundisi ukuthi nilandele zonke izinto ezingathandeki, abazenzayo kumathikithi abo; futhi nigweme iNkosi uNkulunkulu wenu.

Uma ubhekene nedolobha futhi uhlasele isikhathi eside ukulithatha, akusho ukuthi ungalimaza izihlahla zayo ngokuzisusa nge-axe. Ungadla izithelo zazo, ngakho-ke akufanele uzisuse. Ingabe izihlahla zesihlabathi abantu, ukuze uhlasele?
Uma nje ungazi ukuthi imithi yakho ayikhiqizi ukudla, ungayisusa, uyisebenzisele ukwakha izindlu zokugqugquzela lo mzi obhekene nawe empilweni, kuze kube yilapho iwela.
Uma kutholakala umuntu obulawe, eshonile emhlabathini, ezweni iNkosi uNkulunkulu wakho akunika lona ukuba ube yintando yakho, futhi akukho muntu owaziyo ukuthi ubani owabulala.
Abaphathi bakho nabameli bakho kumele baphume futhi balinganise ubude obusuka kulowo mphefumulo kuya ezifundeni ezincane.
Ngakho-ke, abaphathi bedolobhana elinabantu abaningi kufanele bathathe inkomo encane engakaze isebenze futhi engakade igqoke intambo.
Kuyadingeka ukuthi bagweme umfula ohambayo, lapho izwe alizange lihlolwe noma lisetshenzisiwe khona. Kulesi siqhingi kufanele baphula intamo yengulube encane

Bazofika ababhishobhi, oonyana bakaLawi; ngoba iNkosi uNkulunkulu wakho wabakhethe ukuba basebenze naye, futhi ukuba babembezele ngegama lakhe; nabo bazobe belungisa zonke izingqungquthela, nanoma yisiphi isinqumo secala.
Lapho-ke bonke abaphathi bedolobhana elibhekene nenyama kumele bahlanze izandla zabo phezu kwengulube encane ohlangothini lwayo lwaphucuka emfuleni.
Bazothi: "Asikho isandla sethu esibulala lo muntu, futhi amehlo ethu awabonile lokhu kwenziwa.
Nkosi, usindise abantu bakho isiSirayeli, owabakhululayo; ungawafaki engozini abantu bakho isiSirayeli, ukuba babulala umuntu ongenacala. Bazokhululwa ngenxa yokubulala kwabo.
Ngaleyo ndlela nizohlanza inhliziyo yenu, ningabi necala lokubulala umuntu ongeivele; ngoba nikwenze lokho okulungile emehlo kaYehova.
Uma usuya empilweni yokulwa nabaphikisi bakho, futhi iNkosi uThixouNkulunkulu wakho awazinikela kuwe, bese uthatha abantu abafileyo;
ungabona phakathi kwabafileyo indodakazi ebukekayo, uthandane naye, futhi ufuna ukumshada.
Yazisa ekhaya lakho. Uzodinga ukuba ahlanze ikhanda lakhe futhi athathe izicubu zakhe,

futhi ugqoke izicathulo zakhe, lapho wathathwa; futhi kufanele ahlale ekhaya lakho, futhi ukhathazeke ubaba wakhe nomama wakhe usuku lonke; futhi ngemva kwalokho ungaya kuye, ube indodana yakhe, naye abe indodana yakho.

Uma ungathandanga yena, vumelani ukuthi ahambe lapho efuna khona. Ungamthengi ngemali, noma ukwenze abe ngumkhonzi, ngoba uyamkhohlisa; kodwa uma uthandana naye, vumelani ukuthi ahambe lapho efuna khona.
Uma kukhona umuntu onezifazane ezimbili, ethandana nomunye wazo, kodwa engathandani nomnye wabo, futhi bazalwa naye izingane, khona-ke owesifazane omdala uyisifazane ongathandeki.

Uma enikela ngempahla yakhe kubantwana bakhe, akufanele anikezele ilungelo lokuzalwa lokuqala kumntwana womyeni wakhe othandekayo endaweni yomntwana womyeni wakhe ongathandani naye, owayengumzali wokuqala.

Uzothatha unyana wakhe, owesifazane angeke amthande, abe ngumzali wokuqala, futhi uzomnika inkontileka ephindwe kabili yezinto zakhe zonke. Lo mntwana nguphawu lokuqala lwesiqiniseko sobaba wakhe, futhi ilungelo lomzali wokuqala liwuwo.
Uma ngabe umuntu unendodana enobugebengu, engavumelani noyise noma nomyeni wakhe; futhi uma bemutshela, akawatholi amagama abo.
Ubaba wakhe nomama wakhe kumele bathathe yena, futhi babengele kuye abaphathi emgwaqeni wedolobha lakhe.
Bathi kumadodana edolobhaneni lakhe, Lo mntwana wethu ubuhlungu kakhulu, uivelele, akaze athobele ilizwi lethu; futhi udla kakhulu, usela.
Amadoda wonke edolobhaneni lakhe azomgqugquzela ngomlilo, aze aphele. Uzokhipha lokhu okubi phakathi kwakho; bonke isiSirayeli bazokubona, futhi bazokhathazeka.
Uma umuntu esenza inkohlakalo efanele ukufa, futhi ebulawa, futhi isidumbu sakhe siboshwe emgodini,

ngeke ushiye umphefumulo wakhe ekhonjisiwe emgodini nsuku zonke, kodwa uzowufihla ngalolusuku olulodwa; ngoba wonke umuntu okhonjisiwe emgodini unqunywe nguNkulunkulu. Ngakho awuzoyiphazamisa izwe iNkosi uNkulunkulu wakho akunika lona ukuthi libe yikhaya lakho.
Uma ubona inkomo noma ingulube yomngane wakho ehamba, ungaze uyenze ukuthi awubonile. Kubalulekile ukuthi uyibuyisele kumnikazi wayo.
Uma umnikazi ahlala eduze kwakho, noma uma awuyazi ukuthi ngubani ophethe imoto, thola imoto bese uyigcina ekhaya kuze kube yilapho umnikazi efika efuna yona. Ngemuva kwalokho uyibuyisele.
Yenza okufanayo uma uthola inkomo yabo, isigqoko sabo, noma iyiphi enye into abayilahle. Ungazi ukuthi awuyiboni.
Uma ubona inkomo noma ingulube yomngane wakho waseSirayeli iwela phansi emgwaqweni, ungaze ucabange ukuthi awuzange uyibone. Qiniseka ukuthi usiza umnikazi ukuba aphinde ayibeke phezulu.
Uwesifazane ngeke agqoke izicathulo zamadoda, futhi umfazi ngeke agqoke izicathulo zabesifazane; ngoba uNkulunkulu wakho, iNkosi, unqume wonke umuntu owenza lokhu.
Uma uthola i-nest yezinyoni eduze kwendlela, emthini noma ezweni, futhi umama uhlala phezu kwezilwane ezincane noma amaqanda, akufanele uthathe umama kanye nezingane.
Ungathatha izingane, kodwa uqiniseke ukuthi ushiya umzali wakhe ahambe, ukuze konke kuqhubeke kahle nawe futhi ube nokuphila okude.
Uma ukwakha ikhaya elisha, kubeka umgwaqo omncane ngaphesheya kwesiivele, ukuze ungabi necala lokufa komnye umuntu uma ewela phansi.
Ungase ubeke izithelo ezimbili ezihlukene evinini sakho; ngoba uma ukwenza njalo, imbewu yakho yonke izolahleka, kanye nembewu oyithumeleyo, kanye nokudla kwevini.
Ungagqugquzeli ngengulube nebhontshisi eziboshwe ndawonye.
Ungagqoki izicathulo ezenziwe ngendwangu nelinen ethosiwe ndawonye.
Yenza ama-tassels emakhoneni amane we-cloak ogqoke.
Uma umuntu eshada indodana yendoda, ehlala naye, bese ebuyela emuva kuye.
Wathi: "Ngimshadele lo mfana, kodwa lapho ngiye embhedeni naye ngathola ukuthi angeke abe yindodakazi." (Izwi lika-Allah lizwakala)
Ngemuva kwalokho ubaba nomama wesifazane kumele baveze isiqiniseko sokuthi wayeyindodakazi kubaholi bedolobha esitezi.
Ubaba wakhe uzothi kubo abaphathi, Ngimnike lo muntu intombi yami ukuba abe ngumkakhe; kodwa yena washintsha uhlangothi.

futhi, uma yena ukhuluma ngaye izinto ezibi, esithi: "Ngithole ukuthi indodana yakho ayikho intombazane," khona-ke, lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi indodana yami ayikho intombazane. Ngaleyo ndlela, umzali wakhe kufanele wandise isigqoko phambi kwabaphathi edolobhaneni.
Abaphathi balo dolobhana kumele bathathe lo muntu bagweme.

Bazothi, "Uzokhokhelwa imali eyizinkulungwane zezinhlamvu zesilivere, futhi uzonikezwa ubaba wowesifazane; ngoba lo muntu waveza igama elibi kulowo wesifazane waseSirayeli. Uzohlala yena indodakazi yakhe; ngeke ayishiye yonke imihla yakhe.
Uma isinqumo siyiqiniso, futhi asikho isiqiniseko sokuthi indodakazi yakhe ibiyindodakazi,

khona-ke kufanele athathwe, afike emgwaqeni wendlu yakhe ubaba wakhe, futhi abantu edolobhaneni lakhe kumele bagweme kuye ngetshe, ukuze aphele; ngoba yena wakwenza okubi ezweni lakwaSirayeli, ukuba nowesifazane emndenini wakhe ubaba wakhe. Ngaleyo ndlela uzosusa iphutha phakathi kwenu.
Uma kwenzeka umuntu etholakale egqugquzela indodana yomyeni wakhe, kufanele bafa bonke, indodana nowesifazane; ukuze ususe okubi ezweni laseSirayeli.
Uma umuntu ehlangana nowesifazane osemncane, ongasekho emzini wakhe, futhi abulawe naye, bese ethola ukuthi umndeni wakhe unenhlanhla.

Uzobeka labo bobabili emgwaqeni wale dolobhana, ubeke amatshe phezu kwabo, bafe. Ubeke intombazane ngaphansi kwamatshe ngenxa yokuthi yahlala edolobhaneni, futhi akazange anikeze insindiso; nowesifazane ngaphansi kwamatshe ngenxa yokuthi wamisa indodakazi yomuntu ozayo; ukuze ususe okubi phakathi kwenu.
Uma umuntu ehlangana nowesifazane osemshadweni, emzini wakhe, bese umnyanzela ukuba ahlale naye, khona-ke lowo owenza lokhu kuphela ozofa.
Akufanele ukwenze noma yini kulesi sifazane, ngoba ayikho inkohliso yakhe efanele ukufa. Le nkinga ifana nomuntu obulala umngane wakhe,
ngoba indodana yakhe yatholakale ezweni. Uwesifazane okhulelwe wakhala, kodwa kwakungekho muntu ongamsiza.
Uma umuntu ehlangana nowesifazane osemncane, ongasekho emshadweni wakhe, wathatha indodakazi yakhe, wahlala naye, futhi batholakale.
Uzokhokhela ubaba wakhe amashekeli amashumi mahlanu egolide, futhi uzomshada naye, ngenxa yokuthi wamkhohlisa; ngeke amshiye isikhathi esigcwele sokuphila kwakhe.
Akufanele umuntu athathe indodana yobaba wakhe, angeke akhohlise ubaba wakhe, abe naye.
Akunamuntu ophindwe, noma ohlukaniswe izitho zakhe zocansi, angafika engqungqutheleni kaYehova.
Wonke umuntu ozalwa ngendodana yowesifazane, ngeke afike engqungqutheleni kaYehova; ngisho nomndeni wabo, kuze kube yiminyaka eyishumi, ngeke afike.
U-Amoni noma u-Mowabi angeke afike engqungqutheleni kaYehova; ngisho nohlobo lwawo oluyishumi ngeke lifike kulo.
ngenxa yokuthi bekungakuhlanganiseni ngenyama namanzi emgwaqeni, lapho niphuma eYiputa; futhi baqasha uBhileham, unyana kaBeore, wasePethore eMesopotamia, ukuba akulambe.
Kodwa iNkosi, uNkulunkulu wakho, akafuni ukulalela uBhileham; kodwa iNkosi, uNkulunkulu wakho, waguqula lo mthetho ube wusizo kuwe, ngoba iNkosi, uNkulunkulu wakho, ukuthanda wena.
Uma uphila, akufanele uzame ukuwasiza ukuthi babe nokuthula noma baphumelele.
Uma uthandana nomuntu wase-Edom, ungamthandeki; uma uthandana nomuntu waseMisiya, ungamthandeki; ngoba uhlala ezweni labo.
Nabantwana abazalwa kubo, kuze kube yiminyaka emithathu, bangaya engqungqutheleni kaYehova.
Uma nisesiteshini sokulwa nabaphikisi bakho, hlalani kude nanoma yini eyenza ukuba nibi.
Uma kukhona umuntu phakathi kwakho ongeke ahlanzeke, ngenxa yento ekwenzekile kuye ekuseni, kufanele aphume ngaphandle kwekhabhinethi, ahlale khona.
Kodwa uma kufike ubusuku, kufanele ahlanzwe ngamanzi, futhi lapho ilanga liphuma khona, angabuya esitezi.
Kube khona indawo ngaphandle kwekamva lapho ungaya khona egumbini lokugezela.
Nciphisa i-shovel kanye namathuluzi akho. Uma usuya egumbini lokugezela, xhuma umngcele ngale nto, bese uvala izidakamizwa zakho.

ngoba iNkosi, uNkulunkulu wakho, ehamba phakathi kwekhabhinethi yakho, ukuze akulondoloze wena, futhi abeke phambi kwakho izitha zakho; ngakho ikhebhini lakho kumele libe lingcwele, ukuze angabona lutho olubi phakathi kwenu, aze ahambe.
Uma umkhonzi esuka kumnikazi wakhe, futhi wafika kuwe ukuphepha, awukwazi ukubuyisela kuye umnikazi wakhe.
Uzohlala phakathi kwenu ezweni lakhe, lapho ethanda khona; futhi mna-ke angeke nimubisele.
Akukho mntu wesiSirayeli owesifazane noma owesifazane ongase abe ngumqambi wethempeli.
Ungayingenisi imali yowesifazane, noma izimali zowesifazane, endlwini kaYehova uNkulunkulu wakho, ukuze ukhokhele noma iyiphi induduzo; ngoba iNkosi uNkulunkulu wakho unokuthobeka kubo bonke.
Mhlawumbe uzoba nemali, noma ukudla, noma iyiphi enye into ongayithola imali ekhokhwayo.

Uzokwazi ukuthatha inzalo kumuntu ongaphandle kwezwe, kodwa akufanele uthathe inzalo emndenini wakwaSirayeli; khona-ke iNkosi uNkulunkulu wakho uzokubambisana nawe kuwo wonke umsebenzi wakho, ezweni okungena kulo ukulithola.
Uma usenza isibopho kuYehova uNkulunkulu wakho, ungabi nesikhathi sokuyifeza; ngoba iNkosi uNkulunkulu wakho uzoyifuna kuwe, ukuze ungabi nobubi, uma ungayenzanga.
Kodwa uma ukhetha ukuthi ungakwenza isivumelwano, ngeke ube necala.
Uma ukhuluma ukuthi uzokwenza konke lokhu, qiniseka ukuthi uyakwenza; ngoba uma ubeke isibopho kukaNkulunkulu wakho ngomlomo wakho, kufanele uyigcine.
Uma ufika ezindaweni zewayini zomngane wakho, ungadla izithelo eziningi njengoba ufuna, kodwa akufanele ubeke lutho emgodini.
Uma usuya ezindaweni zokudla zenkosikazi yakho, ungakwazi ukuqoqa imbewu ngesandla sakho, kodwa awudingi ukuqoqa izithelo zayo ngesiqhingi.
Uma umuntu eshada indodakazi, futhi engathandani nayo, ngenxa yokuthi wathola icala elibi ngaye, khona-ke ubhalela isitifiketi sokuzibophezela, wamnika, wamshiya ekhaya lakhe.
Ngemuva kokushiya indlu yakhe, angaba nguwesifazane wesifazane.
uma umfazi wakhe wesifazane ebuyela kuye, abhalele incwadi yokwahlulela, amnikeze yona, amshiye ekhaya lakhe; noma ngabe umyeni wakhe wesifazane uzofa.

Umfazi wakhe wokuqala, owawumshiya, ngeke aphinde abe ngumkakhe; ngoba yena wanyamalala, ngoba lokhu kungenxa yobubi ebusweni bukaYehova. Ngakho-ke ngeke ubeke izwe elinikwe nguYehova uNkulunkulu wakho ukuba libe yikhaya lakho.
Uma umuntu ekhulelwe, akufanele adluliselwe emkhosini noma abe nomsebenzi othile. Ngonyaka owodwa ukhululekile ukuba ahlale ekhaya futhi enze indodana yakhe entsha ijabulise.
Ngakho-ke, akufanele uthathe amatshe emishini amabili, noma ngisho namatshe emishini aphezulu kuphela, njengenkokhelo yezimali. Lokhu kuzothatha indlela yokuphila yomntu.
Uma umuntu etholakale ethatha umngane wakhe waseSirayeli, ekwenza abe ngumkhonzi, noma ethengisa umkhonzi wakhe, lowo othatha umkhonzi kufanele aphele; ngakho-ke uzosusa okubi phakathi kwenu.
Uma kwenzeka kuvela isifo esibi, kufanele ucabangele kakhulu ukuthi wenze konke okuzokuzifundisa amaLevi, abapristi; kumele ucabangele ukuthi wenze konke ongangibawiselayo.
Khumbula lokho iNkosi uNkulunkulu wakho akwenze kuMireyamu, ngesikhathi niphuma eYiputa ngendlela.
Uma udlulisa umngane wakho noma yini, ungangeni ekhaya lakhe ukuze uthathe into abanika yona njengenkokhelo.
Uhlale ngaphandle, futhi uvumele umuntu ofuna ukuwudlulisa ukuthi akulethe kuwe.
Uma umuntu ehlwempu, akufanele uhambe ukuphumula ngenkathi ugcina isiqinisekiso sabo.
Ngiyakucela, uphinde ubabuyisele izicathulo zabo ngaphambi kokuphuma kwelanga, ukuze baphumule kuzo; khona-ke bazokubambisana nawe, futhi uNkulunkulu wakho, iNkosi, uzobona ukuthi wenza kahle.
Uma ufisa ukuba umqashi wakho, noma umqashiivelwa wakho, noma ilungu lakho, noma isivakashi sakho esihlala ezindaweni zakho zokuqasha, akufanele ube necala.
Uzobanika umholo wabo ngosuku ngalunye, ngaphambi kokuphuma kwelanga; ngoba bangamahlwempu, futhi bafuna umnikelo wokudla; ukuze bangaze bekhala kuwe kuYehova, nawe ube nesono.
Abazali bangafa ngenxa yomsebenzi owenza izingane zabo, futhi izingane zingafa ngenxa yomsebenzi owenza abazali babo. Wonke umuntu uyafa ngenxa yesono sakhe.
Ngakho-ke, akufanele uthathe inkontileka ngemali encane, futhi akufanele uthathe inkontileka ngemali enkulu.
Uzokhumbula ukuthi ube ngumkhonzi ezweni laseMisri, futhi iNkosi uNkulunkulu wakho wakukhulula khona; ngakho ngikutshela ukuthi wenze lokhu.

Uma uvuna izithelo zakho ezweni lakho, bese ukhohlwa iqoqo elilodwa lembewu, ungabuyeli ukulithola; uyishiye kulowo ongaphandle kwezwe, nengane yomama, nowesifazane; ukuze iNkosi uNkulunkulu wakho akubabazise kuwo wonke umsebenzi wezandla zakho.
Uma uvuna izithelo zakho ze-olive, akufanele uphinde uhlele amaqabunga akho; kufanele ushiye okushiwo kulowo ohlala ezweni elilodwa, noyemalume, nowesifazane.
Uma uvuna izithelo evinini sakho, awukwazi ukugibela ivini lakho kathathu; uzozishiya kulowo ovela kwamanye amazwe, nengane yomalume, nendodakazi.
Uzokhumbula ukuthi nibe ngabakhonzi ezweni laseMisri; ngakho ngikutshela ukuthi wenze lokhu.
Uma abantu bekhala, kufanele bathathe icala enkantolo, futhi abameli bazothatha isinqumo ngecala. Bamele bamemezele ukuthi umuntu ongekho emthethweni ulungile kanti lowo owinile akalungile.
Uma umuntu owinile efanele ukudlwengula, khona-ke ummeli kufanele ambeke phansi futhi amdlwengula phambi kwakhe, ngenani lemicibisholo elinganayo necala lakhe.
Akufanele umqokeleli agweme ukubulala abantu abangumashumi amane; uma ekwenza ngaphezu kwalokhu, khona-ke umndeni wakho uzogxekwa phambi kwakho.
Musa ukuvala umlomo wengulube ukuze uyivimbele ekudleni ngenkathi icindezela izithelo.

Uma kukhona abazalwane abaphila ndawonye, futhi omunye wabo efa ngaphandle komntwana, indodakazi yakhe ayidingi ukushada umuntu ongaphandle kwemindeni yabo. Owesifazane wendodakazi yakhe kumele atshade naye futhi enze umsebenzi wakhe njengenkosikazi.
Owesifazane oneminyaka eyisishiyagalombili ubudala uzothatha igama lomyeni wakhe owafa, ukuze igama lakhe lingacishiswe emaSirayeli.

Uma umuntu engathandanga ukumnika indodakazi yomngane wakhe, khona-ke indodana yomngane wakhe izoya esiphethweni somnyango kwabakhulu bedolobha lakhe, ithi, Umngane wami wesifazane akafuni ukubeka igama lomfana wakhe wesifazane eSirayeli; akafuni ukungifeza inkontileka yomndeni.
Bazothi labo abakhulu edolobhaneni lakhe, bamwise, bakhulume naye; futhi uma eqhubeka esithi, Angifuni ukumnika indodakazi,

udadewabo wowesifazane kufanele afike kuye phambi kwabaholi, aphuze isigqoko sakhe esingaphansi kwenyawo lakhe, aphuze emlonyeni wakhe, futhi akhulume, athi, Kunjalo okuzokwenziwa umuntu ongeke alungise inkosi yakhe.
Ngaleso sikhathi, umndeni wakhe uzoziwa eSirayeli njengo "umndeni womntu owesifazane wezinkinobho zakhe zasuswa."
Uma abantu bephikelelana, futhi indodana yomunye wabo ifike isindise umfazi wakhe kulowo omphilela yena, yafinyelela yawubamba umyeni wakhe ngemisipha yakhe,
udinga ukucima isandla sakhe. Ungakhathazeki ngaye
Musa ukuthwala izinto ezimbili ezihlukene emgodini wakho, eyodwa enzima nenye elula.
Musani ukubeka endlwini yenu imilinganiselo emibini, enye enkulu nenye encane.
Uzosebenzisa izilinganiso ezilungile, nezilinganiselo ezifanele, ukuze uhlale isikhathi eside ezweni iNkosi uNkulunkulu wakho akunika lona.
Ngokuba iNkosi uNkulunkulu wakho unqume wonke umuntu owenza izinto ezinjalo, wonke umuntu onecala.
Khumbula lokho akwenzayo ama-Amaleki kuwe, lapho usuka eYiputa, ngendlela yakho.
futhi, lapho ukhathazekile futhi elahlekile, bahlangana nawe emgwaqeni, futhi wahlasela bonke abancane, futhi akazange agweme uNkulunkulu.

Uma iNkosi, uNkulunkulu wakho, ekunika isikhala kusuka kuwo wonke amagugu akho asendaweni yakho yonke, ezweni iNkosi, uNkulunkulu wakho, ekulethela wena ukuba liyilungelo lakho lomhlaba, uzowususa umqondo ka-Amaleki ngezansi kwesibhakabhakeni. Musa ukukhohlwa!
Uma usufike ezweni iNkosi uThixouNkulunkulu wakho akunika lona ukuthi libe yikhaya lakho, usayithola, ube khona kulo;
thola izithelo zokuqala zazo zonke izinto ozivuna ezweni iNkosi uNkulunkulu wakho akunika lona, uzibeke emgodini, uye endaweni ongayikhetha iNkosi uNkulunkulu wakho ukuba lihlale khona igama lakhe.
Uzohamba ufike kumpristi ozoba khona ngaleso sikhathi, uthi kuye, Ngithi namhlanje kuYehova uNkulunkulu wakho, ukuthi ngifike ezweni iNkosi abewisela iziboshwa zethu ukuba lisinike.
Umbingeleli uzothatha ibhokisi esandlani sakho, awubeke phambi kwesibingelelo sikaYehova uNkulunkulu wakho.

Uzothi phambi kweNkosi iNkosi uNkulunkulu wakho, Ubaba wami waba nguSirayeli ohamba ngezinyawo, wafika eYiputa, wahlala khona, yena nomndeni wakhe, abantu abambalwa kuphela; waba khona lapho abe yizwe elikhulu, elinamandla, elinabantu abaningi.
Kodwa amakhosikazi ase-Egypt wakwenza nathi kabi, futhi wakwenza ukuba sihlupheke, futhi wakwenza sisebenze kanzima njengezinja.
Sacela iNkosi, uNkulunkulu wakwababa bethu; waphendula iNkosi izingcingo zethu, wabona ukuhlupheka kwethu, nomsebenzi wethu onzima, nokuthi sacindezelwa.
Wathi iNkosi wasikhipha eYiputa ngesandla esinamandla, nomlenze oqinile, ngothando olukhulu, ngezibonakaliso nezimanga.
Wenza ukuthi sifike kule ndawo, wasisinika leli lizwe, izwe elishayela ubisi nojusi.
Manje ke, Nkosi yami, ngikulethela imbewu yokuqala yezwe ongisinika lona; ubeke isitsha phambi koYehova uNkulunkulu wakho, ukhonze, uyeke ukuthandaza kuye.
Uzojabulela zonke izinto ezinhle iNkosi uNkulunkulu wakho awakulethela wena nomndeni wakho, nawe, nalabaLevi, nalowo ohlala phakathi kwenu.

Ngomnyaka wesithathu, owunyaka wezingxenye ezilishumi, uma uqedile ukunikela izingxenye eziyishumi zazo zonke izimpahla zakho zokutshala, uzozinikeza umLevi, nomhlali wasemiphakathini, nowesimo sezulu, namadodakazi; bazodla ezindaweni zakho zokungena, baphuze.

Uzothi kuYehova uNkulunkulu wakho, Ngithathe endlwini yami izinto ezingcwele, ngazinikela kumaLevi, nomuntu ovela kwamanye amazwe, nomnaphakade, namadodakazi, njengokuba uxhumane nami; angishintshi emthethweni wakho, noma ngiwukhohlwe.

Ngingeke ngidle ngaleso sikhathi, uma sengifile; futhi ngingeke ngisuse ngaleso sikhathi, uma sengingcolile; futhi ngingeke ngibeke ngaleso sikhathi kulabo abafileyo. Ngitholele izwi likaYehova uNkulunkulu wami; ngakwenza konke okungiwisela umthetho ngalo.
Thola ezulu, endaweni yakho engcwele, futhi ubambise abantu bakho baseSirayeli, kanye nezwe elisinike lona, njengokuthi washo kubaba bethu, izwe elishayela ubisi nojusi.
Namhlanje iNkosi uNkulunkulu wakho ukuwisela umthetho, ukuthi wenze la malungiselelo nalawo mthetho; uzowagcina, uzowalungisa ngentliziyo yakho yonke, nomoya wakho wonke.
Namhlanje ukhuluma ukuthi iNkosi abe nguThixo wakho, futhi ukuba uhambe ngezinqumo zakhe, futhi ugcine izimiso zakhe, namalungiselelo akhe, nezimiso zakhe, ukuze uzithobe.
UNkulunkulu usaziveza namuhla ukuthi uzoba abantu bakhe, ube yindawo yakhe ekhethekile, njengoba wathi, ukuze ugcine zonke izimiso zakhe.
Uzokwenza uphakame ngaphezu kwazo zonke izizwe azenzayo, ukuze ube yintandokazi, negama, nobuhle; uzobe ngumuntu ongcwele kuYehova uNkulunkulu wakho, njengokuthi washo.
UMoses namadoda amakhulu aseSirayeli bamisa abantu, besithi, Nigcine yonke imiyalo yami engikhuluma ngayo namuhla.
Ngosuku lapho nidlula khona iJordani, nifike ezweni iNkosi uThixouNkulunkulu wenu akunika lona, kufanele nibeke phezu kwazo amatshe amakhulu, nizigqoke ngeqhwa.

Uzobhalela phezu kwazo zonke izindaba zalo mthetho, uma udlula, ukuze ufike ezweni iNkosi uNkulunkulu wakho akunika lona, izwe elifulathelayo umnqumo nemvubelo, njengokuthi iNkosi uNkulunkulu wababa bakho wathi kuwe.
Uma nidlula iJordani, nizibeke ezitsheni lezi, njengoba ngikuwisela umthetho ngayo namuhla, emfuleni uEbhali, nizihlanganise ngeqhwa.
Uzokwakha khona isibingelelo kuYehova uNkulunkulu wakho, isibingelelo samatshe; ngeke usebenzise isandla sakho sensimbi kuwo.
Uzokwakha isibingelelo sikaYehova uNkulunkulu wakho ngezintaba zesizwe, ezingezitsheliwe; uzonikela phezu kwayo izipho zokudlwengula kuYehova uNkulunkulu wakho.
Uzonikela khona izipho zokuthula, uzozidla, ujabulise phambi koYehova uNkulunkulu wenu.
Uzobhalela ematsheni owazibeke khona zonke izithiyo zalesi mthetho, uzibhalele ngokucacile.
Wathi uMoses, nalaba bapristi abaLevi, kubo bonke abantu bakaSirayeli, besithi: Yihlazani, nikhulume, abantu bakaSirayeli; namuhla niye waba ngabantu bakaYehova uNkulunkulu wenu.
Uzolalela ilizwi likaYehova uNkulunkulu wakho, ugcine imiyalo yakhe nemithetho yakhe, engikuwiselayo namuhla.
UMoses wamisa abantu ngalolusuku olulodwa, wathi,
Uma nidlula iJordani, basuke behlala phezu komfula uGarizim, ukubambisa abantu: uSimeoni, noLevi, noYuda, noIssakha, noYosefu, noBhenjamin.
Lawa madodakazi azohlala emfuleni i-Ebhali, ukuze abeke izimangalo: uRubhen, noGadi, noAsere, noZebuloni, noDani, noNaphtali.
Lawa maLevi azothi kubo bonke abantu bakaSirayeli,

Kubi nakakhulu lowo owenza isigodlo, noma ukhonkolo, noma igolide, futhi amise endaweni efihlakeleyo; ngoba yimisebenzi yezandla zomuntu osebenza ngesandla, futhi iNkosi unquma ngayo. Baphendule abantu bonke, bethi, Ameni.
Kubi umuntu okhohlisa ubaba wakhe noma umama wakhe; futhi abantu bonke bazothi, Amen.
Uma umuntu eshintsha umkhawulo wenkosikazi yakhe, ulahlekile; futhi abantu bonke bazothi, Amen.
"Kubi kakhulu uma umuntu ehamba ngendlela engalungile umuntu omnyama." Bathi abantu bonke, "Amen!"
Ubi umuntu ongeke alungise isinqumo somuntu ongaphandle kwezwe, noma udadewabo, noma umkakhe; futhi abantu bonke bazothi, Amen.
Utholwe umuntu ohlala nowesifazane kababa wakhe, ngoba ukhohlisa ubaba wakhe. Bathi bonke abantu: Amen.
Uma umuntu ethandana nanoma iyiphi inhlanzi, ulahlekile; futhi abantu bonke bazothi, Amen.
Uma umuntu ehlala nenkosikazi yakhe, noma ibe yindodana yobaba wakhe, noma ibe yindodana yomama wakhe, uzobiwa. Abantu bonke bazothi, Amen.
Uzophazamiseka lowo ohlala nenkosikazi yakhe; abantu bonke bazothi, Amen.
Kubi umuntu obulala umngane wakhe ngokufihlakeleyo. Bathi bonke abantu, Amen.
Utholwe wonke umuntu othatha umshwalense, ukuze abulala umuntu ongenacala. Bathi abantu bonke, Amen.
Utholwe wonke umuntu ongeke agcine amazwi lawa mthetho, akwenze; futhi abantu bonke bazothi, Ameni.

Uma nje ulalela ngokugcwele izwi likaYehova uNkulunkulu wakho, ukuthi ugcine ukwenze zonke izimiso zakhe, engizokuwisela umthetho ngazo namuhla, khona-ke iNkosi uNkulunkulu wakho uzokwenza ube phezulu phezu kwazo zonke izizwe emhlabeni.
Zizofika kuwe zonke lezi zipho, zibe nawe, uma ulalela izwi likaYehova uNkulunkulu wakho.
Uzoba ngcwele edolobhaneni, futhi uzobe ngcwele ezweni.
Uzosindisa izingane zakho, nezitshalo zezwe lakho, nezingulube zezilwane zakho eziphilayo, nezimbuzi zezinkomo zakho, nezimvu zezinkomo zakho, nezingulube zamakati akho.
Ibhokisi lakho kanye nebhodlela lakho lokubhaka lizosindisa.
Uzobe uhlanzekile uma ufika, futhi uzobe uhlanzekile lapho uphuma.
UNkulunkulu uzokwenza ukuthi izitha zakho ezikuhlaselayo zihlaselwe phambi kwakho; zizofika kuwe ngandlela eyodwa, kodwa kuzohamba kude nawe ngandlela yesithupha.
UNkulunkulu uzobambisana nawe ezindaweni zakho zokugcina ukudla, nakwazo zonke izinto ozenzayo; uNkulunkulu uNkulunkulu wakho uzokubambisana nawe ezweni lakhe alikunika lona.
UNkulunkulu uzokwenza ube ngumuntu ongcwele kuye, njengoba ekusho kuwe, uma ugcina izimiso zikaYehova uNkulunkulu wakho, uhamba ngezinqumo zakhe.
Futhi kuzobona zonke izizwe zezulu ukuthi wena ukaNkulunkulu, futhi bazokukhathazeka ngawe.
UNkulunkulu uzokwenza ube nezingane eziningi, nezilwane eziningi, nokudla okuningi, ezweni lakhe iNkosi abewisela iziboshwa zakho ukuba likulethe.

UNkulunkulu uzovula izulu, indawo yakhe yokugcina izinto ezinhle, ukuze asize imvula ezweni lakho ngesikhathi sayo, futhi asindise yonke imisebenzi yezandla zakho; uzodlulisa izizwe eziningi, kodwa wena awuzodluliswa.

UNkulunkulu uzokwenza ube yinhloko yakho, hhayi ibe yimpumputhe yakho; uzoba phezulu kuphela, awunakho ukuwa phansi; uma nje ulalela imiyalo kaYehova uNkulunkulu wakho, engikulethela yona namuhla, ukuze uyigcine.
Ungagcini nje ngokudla noma ngokwesobunxele, ekuphileni kwakho nganoma yisiphi isinqumo ngisibeka phambi kwenu namhlanje, ukuze ulandele izitha zabanye, uzikhonza.

Kodwa uma ungeke ulalele izwi likaYehova uNkulunkulu wakho, ukuze ugcine ukwenze zonke izimiso zakhe nezibopho zakhe, engikulethela wena namhlanje, kuzofika phezu kwakho zonke lezi zibulala-zinambuzane, zizokufinyelela.
Uzobiwa emzini, futhi uzobiwa nasezweni.
Ibhokisi lakho kanye nebhodwe lekhofi lizophazamisa.
Abantwana bakho bazobiwa, kanye nembewu yezwe lakho, nezingulube zezinkomo zakho, namaqanda emvubelo yakho.
Uzophazamiseka uma ufika, futhi uzophazamiseka lapho uphuma.

UNkulunkulu uzothumela phezu kwakho ukubi, nokungabaza, nokuphazamiseka kuwo wonke umsebenzi owenzayo, kuze kube yilapho uphela khona, futhi ube sengozini ngokushesha, ngenxa yobugebengu obukwenzele ngami.
UNkulunkulu uzokwenza izifo ezibulalayo zixhunywe kuwe, kuze kuphoqeleke ukuthi ukhululwe ezweni okungena kulo ukulithola.
UNkulunkulu uzokushaya ngobuhlungu, nokushisa, nokuvuvukala, nomlilo, nesimo sezulu esibandayo, nokulimala kwezithelo zakho, nezifo ezibulalayo; zizokuzilandela kuze kufike ukuphelelwa.
Isibhakabhaka esiphezulu kwekhanda lakho sizoba segolide, futhi umhlaba ongaphansi kwamadolo akho uzoba sensimbi.
Kusukela emkhathini, iNkosi uzama ukuthutha inkungu nothuli phezu kwezwe lakho, kuze kube yilapho uphela khona.
UNkulunkulu uzokwenza ukuthi uhlaselwe ngamehlo abasolwa bakho. Uzofika kubo ngendlela eyodwa, kodwa uzokushiya ngezindlela eziyisithupha; futhi uzoba wumbono obuhlungu kuwo wonke amazwe asezulu.
Izicubu zakho zizoba ukudla kwazo zonke izilwane eziphilayo, nezilwane zasendle, futhi ngeke kube khona umuntu ozoziphoqa ukuthi zihambe.
UNkulunkulu uzokushaya ngezinhlayiya zaseYiputa, nezilonda, nezingqungquthela, nobuhlungu obukhulu obungenakulinywa.
UNkulunkulu uzokushaya ngobuhlungu benhliziyo, nokungabonakali, nokuphazamiseka kwengqondo.

Ngobusuku obuphakathi uzozizwa indlela yakho eduze njengomuntu omnyama emthunzini. Awuzophumelela kunoma yini oyikwenzayo. Usuku ngalunye uzoba nesimo esibi futhi uzalwe, futhi akukho muntu ozokusiza.
