Uzobhishizwa indodakazi, kodwa omunye umuntu uzoyithatha, futhi uzoba nowesifazane; uzokwakha indlu, kodwa awuhlali kuyo; uzotshala iviniga, kodwa awukwazi ukuyodla inyama yayo.
Inkomo yakho izotholwa phambi kwakho, kodwa awukwazi ukuyidla; ibhokhwe lakho lizothathwa kuwe, ngeke libuyiselwe kuwe; amaqanda akho azonikezwa izitha zakho, futhi angeke kube nomuntu ozozikhulula.
Amadodakazi akho namakhosikazi akho azonikezwa isizwe esisha, futhi amehlo akho azophuza ngenxa yabo yonke imihla; kodwa ngeke kube khona amandla akho.
Abantu ongabazi bazodla imbewu yezwe lakho, kanye nento osebenzele ngayo. Uzophathwa ngokubi futhi ucindezelwe yonke ubomi bakho.
Izinto ozibonayo zizokushaya umlomo.
UNkulunkulu uzokushaya izinyawo zakho nemilenze yakho ngezinhlungu ezibuhlungu, ezingapheli; kuzoqala ezindaweni zamehlo akho kuze kube phezulu kwekhanda lakho.
UNkulunkulu uzokulethela wena nokumkani owenzayo phezu kwakho, ezweni elingaziwo wena nababa bakho; khona-ke uzokhonza khona izitha zabanye, imithi negolide.
Uzobe sewubuhlungu, ube yizinkondlo, ube yindawo yokugxekwa phakathi kwazo zonke izizwe lapho iNkosi ezokuthumela khona.
Uzotshala izithelo eziningi ezindaweni zakho, kodwa uzovuna okuncane, ngoba izinyosi zizozidla.
Uzotshala izihlahla zezinkomo, futhi uzozilungisa; kodwa ngeke uphuze iwayini, futhi awukwazi ukuqoqa amazambane, ngoba izinyosi zizozidla.
Uzothola izihlahla ze-olive ezweni lakho lonke, kodwa ngeke usebenzise i-olive; ngoba izithelo ze-olive zizophuka.
Uzozala oonyana nabenzana, kodwa ngeke ube nabo; ngoba bazothunyelwa empilweni.
Izinyoni zizodla zonke izihlahla zakho, nezithelo zezwe lakho.
Abakwamanye amazwe abahlala phakathi kwakho, bazokhuphuka phezulu futhi phezulu phezu kwenu; kodwa nizowela phansi futhi nizowela.
Bazokudlulisa wena, kodwa wena awukwazi ukudlulisa kubo; bazobe yinhloko, futhi wena uzobe uyisisu.

Futhi kuzofika phezu kwakho zonke lezi zinhlamvu, zikulandelela, zikufinyelela, kuze uphele; ngenxa yokuthi awuzange ulalele izwi likaYehova uNkulunkulu wakho, ukuba ugcine imiyalo yakhe, nezimiso zakhe, awawisele kuwe.
Lezo zinto zizobe ziyiphawu, nobufakazi kuwe kanye nabangane bakho bosuku oluzayo.
UNkulunkulu wakho, iNkosi, akakusebenzeli ngothando nokuzijabulisa, ngenxa yokudla kwakho konke.

Uzokhonza izitha zakho, okuthi iNkosi azithumelele kuwe; uzodla ukudla, futhi uzophuza amanzi, futhi uzogqoka impahla emnyama, futhi uzolahlekelwa yizinto zonke. Uzobeka intambo yensimbi emlenzeni wakho, kuze akukhulule.
UYehova uzokulethela phezu kwakho izwe elivela kude, ezindaweni eziphesheya kwezilwandle zezulu; lizophuma lihamba njenge-eagle; lizoba yizwe ongeke uqonde ulwimi lwalo.
izwe elinobugebengu obungabonakali, elingeke lihloniphe umuntu omdala futhi alikwazi ukuxolisa umuntu omncane.
izodla izingulube zenyama yakho, nembewu yezwe lakho, kuze uphele; ngeke ishiye kuwe inkukhu, noma isiphuzo sewayini, noma uphethiloli, noma izinkomo zakho, noma amaqanda akho, kuze uphele.

Uzobhekana nezindawo zakho zokungena zonke, ezweni lakho lonke, kuze kube yilapho izindonga zakho eziphakeme neziqinile, ongazithembela kuzo, ziwela phansi; futhi uzobhekana nezindawo zakho zokungena zonke, ezweni lakho lonke, iNkosi uNkulunkulu wakho akunika lona.
Uzodla izingane zakho, inyama yamadodana akho namadodakazi akho, awakulethela iNkosi uNkulunkulu wakho, ngenxa yobuhlungu obukhulu obungaba khona lapho umshayeli wakho ekwenzela wena.
Nakuba umuntu othandekayo phakathi kwakho, noma ngabe mkhulu kangakanani, ngeke agweme udadewabo, noma indodakazi yakhe, noma izingane zakhe.
Angeke abagibele omunye wabo inyama yabantwana bakhe, ongayidla; ngoba lokhu kuphela okuzoshiywa kuye, ngenxa yobuhlungu obuzokucindezela ngawo umshayeli wakho ezindaweni zakho zonke.

Owesifazane othandekayo phakathi kwenu, othandekayo ngokwanele ukuthi angeke azame ukugoqa umhlaba ngenyawo lakhe, ngeke abe nothando lomndeni wakhe othandana naye noma unyana wakhe noma intombi yakhe.
Uzodla ngokufihlakeleyo imbewu yebele lakhe, nezingane zakhe azazile; ngoba ngeke abe nokudla okunye, ngenxa yobuhlungu obukhulu obuzokwenza ubuxoki bakho ezindaweni zakho eziphakathi.
Uma ningazibophezela ekwenzeni zonke izithiyo zalo mthetho obhalwe kulo ncwadi, ukuze nigweme leli gama elingcwele, elithakazelisayo, iNkosi uNkulunkulu wenu;
khona-ke iNkosi uzokulethela wena nomndeni wakho izinkinga ezinkulu, izingqinamba ezikhulu nezihlala isikhathi eside, nezifo ezinkulu nezihlala isikhathi eside.
Uzokuletha phezu kwakho zonke izifo zesiYiputa, ongazethemba ngazo; zizokuthobeka kuwe.
Nazo zonke izifo, nazo zonke izinkinga, ezingabhalwe encwadini yalo mthetho, iNkosi uzoziletha phezu kwakho, kuze kukhululwe.
Nakuba bekukhona phakathi kwenu abantu abaningi njengezinkanyezi ezisemathunjini, nizoshiywa nincane kakhulu, ngenxa yokuthi awazitholanga amazwi kaYehova uNkulunkulu wakho.

Ngokungafani nalapho iNkosi ethanda khona ukukwenza kahle nikhule, ngaleyo ndlela uzothanda khona iNkosi ukuba nikhulule niphele; futhi nizoqhutshwa ngaphandle kwezwe okungena kulo ukuthi niyithathe njengentando yenu.
UNkulunkulu uzokusakaza phakathi kwezizwe zonke, kusukela engxenyeni eyodwa yezulu kuya kwesinye sazo; khona-ke uzokhonza khona amanye amasiko, ongawazi wona wena nababa bakho, imithi netshe.
phakathi kwazo zonke izizwe, ngeke uthole isikhala, noma indawo yokuphumula kwenyawo lakho; khona-ke iNkosi uzokunika khona inhliziyweni ekhathazayo, namadolo akhathazayo, nomoya othakazelisayo,
Impilo yakho izohlala ingozi. Uzogcwele ubuhlungu ekuseni nakusihlwa, ungaqinisekanga ukuthi uzophila.
Uzothi ekuseni, Ngiyethemba ukuthi kube yimini; futhi ekuseni, Ngiyethemba ukuthi kube yimini; ngenxa yobuthakathaka obugcwele intliziyo yakho, nezimo ozibona ngamehlo akho.

UNkulunkulu uzokubuyisela eYiputa ngezinqanawa, ngendlela engikusho ngayo ukuthi ngeke uphinde uhambe kuyo; khona-ke uzothengisa wena nomndeni wakho izitha zakho njengezikhonzi namadodakazi, kodwa akuzobakho othenga.
Lawona amazwi omhlangano, iNkosi awawisela umthetho ngawo uMoses, ukuba akwenze nabantu bakaSirayeli ezweni laseMowabi, ngaphezu komhlangano obewenza nabo emfuleni iSina.
UMoses wababiza bonke oonyana bakaSirayeli, wathi kubo: Amehlo enu akubona konke okwenze iNkosi ezweni laseYiputa kuFaro, nakwabo bonke abaphathi bakhe, nezwe lakhe lonke.
Wabona izinkinga ezinkulu, izibonakaliso ezimangazayo, nezimanga ezinkulu.
Kodwa-ke, iNkosi akakubeni nani intamo eqondayo, noma amehlo ebonayo, noma izindlebe ezikhulumayo, kuze kube manje.
Kwaba iminyaka emashumi mane ngikuholela ezweni elimnyama; ngaleso sikhathi izigqoko zakho azisebenzi, nezicathulo zakho azisebenzi emilenzeni yakho.
Ukudla kwenyama, noma utshwala, noma isiphuzo esiphuzayo, ningawadla; ukuze nikwazi ukuthi yena iNkosi uNkulunkulu wenu.
Uma nifika kulo mhlaba, uSihoni ukumkani waseHeshboni, noOgi ukumkani waseBhashani, baphuma bezama ukusihlasela; kodwa sawanqoba.
Siyithathe izwe labo, salibanika amaRubheni, namaGadi, kanye nengxenye yesizwe sikaManase, ibe yindawo yabo.
Hamba ugcine amazwi la mazwi, ukuze uphumelele konke okwenzekayo.
Nihlala namuhla phambi koYehova uNkulunkulu wenu, nina abakhulu benu, nezizwe zenu, namadoda amakhulu enu, nabaphathi bakho, bonke amadodana aseSirayeli;
kanye nezingane zakho, namabhishobhi akho, nabangani bakho abahlala emigodini yakho, abavuna imithi yakho, nabathwala amanzi akho.
Uhlala lapha, ukuze ungene emthethweni noYehova uNkulunkulu wakho, emthethweni owenza nawe namuhla, ukuze aqinise izibopho zakhe.
Wakwenza wena namhlanje ube ngumuntu wakhe, futhi yena abe uNkulunkulu wakho, njengokuthi wakhuluma kuwe, nababa bakho uAbrahama noIsake noYakobi.
Angikwenzanga lo mthethweni, ngethemba lakhe, nawe kuphela
abasekhona lapha nathi namuhla phambi koYehova uNkulunkulu wethu; futhi nalabo abangasekho lapha nathi namuhla, ngizokwenza kanjalo.
Niyazi ukuthi sahlala kanjani eYiputa, nokuthi sahamba kanjani phakathi kwezizwe, ngandlela-thile sifike lapha.
Wabona izinto zabo ezithakazelisayo, nezitho zabo ezidumile zokhuni nodonga, igolide nesiliva.

Ngiyakuqinisekisa ukuthi angeke kube phakathi kwenu indoda, noma indodakazi, noma inkosikazi, noma isizwe, eseziphendukile inhliziyo yayo kuYehova uNkulunkulu wethu namhlanje, ukuba ihambe isebenzele izitha zazo zonke lezi zizwe.

Uma umuntu onjalo ekhuluma ngamazwi alo mthetho, angeke abe nesiqiniseko esingokoqobo emlonyeni wakhe, athi: Ngizohlala ngiphephile, noma ngabe ngihamba ngendlela yami yobugebengu. Lokhu kuzoletha ukulimala ezweni elimanzi, kanye nezwe elisha.

UNkulunkulu ngeke avume ukuxolisa umuntu onjalo, kodwa ubuhlungu bakhe nothando lwakhe luzophuma kulowo muntu njengomlilo, futhi zonke izibulala-zinambuzane ezibhalwe kulolu ncwadi zizoba phezu kwawo; futhi uNkulunkulu uzocima igama lakhe ngezansi kwezulu.
UYehova uzowahlukanisa phakathi kwezizwe zonke zakwaSirayeli, abe yingozi kubo, ngokuya ngazo zonke izibulala-zinambuzane zesivumelwano ezibhalwe kulo ncwadi yomthetho.
Bazobona izingane zenu ezizayo ngemuva kwenu, kanye nomunye umuntu ovela ezweni elisendaweni ende, zonke izinkinga zezwe, nezifo iNkosi abezithumelele kulo.

Izwe lonke lizoba wumlilo we-sulfure ne-salt; ngeke kube khona into etshalayo, noma ikhulayo, noma iyiphi inhlanzi ekhulayo. Kuzobe sengathi ukulimala kukaSodoma noGomora, noAdama noZeboyim, okwenzeke lapho iNkosi abulala khona ngobuhlungu bakhe obukhulu.
futhi izizwe zonke zizothi, Kungani na iNkosi ekwenze lokhu kule lizwe? Kungani na ubuhlungu bakhe bukhulu?

futhi bazophendula bethi, Ngenxa yokuthi bashiye umgomo kaYehova uNkulunkulu wababa babo, owenza nabo, lapho wabakhipha ezweni laseYiputa; ngenxa yokuthi bashiya umgomo kaYehova uNkulunkulu wababa babo.
Baye behamba, bakhonza amasiko amanye, bawukhonze, amadini abengawayazi; amadini angeke iNkosi abewanikela kuwo.
Ngenxa yalokho, inkani likaYehova livutha phezu kwalolu lizwe, ukuze ahole kuyo zonke izibulala-zinambuzane ezibhalwe kulolu ncwadi.
Wabasusa ezweni labo, wabathulisa ezweni elilodwa, ngenxa yobuxoki nobubi obukhulu, kuze kube yilapho bakhona manje.
Izinto ezifihlakele ziyizinto zikaYehova uNkulunkulu wethu; kodwa izinto azivezayo, ziyizinto zethu nabantwana bethu kuze kube sekupheleni, ukuze sigcine zonke izenzo zalo mthetho.
Uma zonke lezi zivumelwano, nalezi zula, ngizibeke phambi kwakho, zifika kuwe, uzozikhumbula phakathi kwezizwe lapho iNkosi uNkulunkulu wakho ezokusakaza khona.
Uma ubuyela kuYehova uNkulunkulu wakho, wena nezingane zakho, futhi umlalela ngenhliziyo yakho yonke, nangomphefumulo wakho wonke, ukuze wenze zonke izinto engikulethela umthetho ngazo namuhla;
futhi iNkosi uNkulunkulu wakho uzokubuyisela ezindaweni zakho eziboshwe kuzo, futhi uzokuzinikela kuwe, futhi uzokuqoqa phakathi kwazo zonke izizwe, lapho awazihlukanisile khona.
Uma ngabe abathunywa bakho befika ekugcineni kwezwe ngezansi kwesibhakabhaka, uzokuqoqa khonakho iNkosi uNkulunkulu wakho, futhi uzokubuyisela.
UNkulunkulu wakho, iNkosi, uzokulethela izwe labababa bakho, ube yindawo yakho yobukhosi; uzokwenza kube ngcono kuwe, futhi uzokwenza ube mkhulu kunabababa bakho.
UYehova uNkulunkulu wakho uzoshintsha intliziyo yakho, nentliziyo yezizukulwane zakho, ukuze uyithande intliziyo yakho yonke, nomoya wakho wonke, uphile.
UYehova uNkulunkulu wakho uzozibeka zonke lezi zinto ezibi phezu kwazo zonke izitha zakho, abakuxoshayo, abakwenzayo.
Uzobuya ulalele izwi likaYehova, ugcine yonke imiyalo yakhe engikuwiselayo namuhla.

UNkulunkulu wakho, iNkosi, uzokwenza uphumelele yonke imisebenzi yezandla zakho; uzokubambisana nawe ngezingane eziningi, nezilwane eziningi, nembewu eminingi. UThixo wakho uzophinde ajabulele ukukwenza okuhle kuwe, njengokuba wajabulela ukukwenza okuhle kubaba bakho,

uma unquma ukulalela izwi likaYehova uNkulunkulu wakho, ukuba ugcine izimiso zakhe nezibopho zakhe ezibhalwe kulo ncwadi yomthetho; uma ubuyela kuYehova uNkulunkulu wakho intliziyo yakho yonke nomoya wakho wonke.
Ngikuwisela umthetho wena namhlanje, akunzima kuwe, futhi angeke kube ngaphezu kwakho.
Akusezulu, ukuze ubuze: "Ubani ozoba phezulu esibhakabhakeni aze ayithole, futhi akhuluma nathi, ukuze sikwazi ukuyenza?"
Nakho akusenyakatho yolwandle, ukuze utshele: "Ubani ozodlula emivelweni yolwandle aze ayithole futhi ayifundise nathi, ukuze sikwazi ukuyilalela?"
Kodwa ilizwi likude kakhulu nawe, libe emlonyeni wakho, libe enhliziyweni yakho, ukuze uyenze.
Bheka, namuhla ngikubeke phambi kwakho phakathi kokuphila nokunethezeka, nokufa nokulahleka.

(Ngenxa yokuthi ngikutshela namuhla ukuthi uthande iNkosi uNkulunkulu wakho, uhambe ngendlela yakhe, ugcine imiyalo yakhe, nezibopho zakhe, namalungiselelo akhe;) ukuze niphile nikhule, futhi iNkosi uNkulunkulu wenu akuberekise ezweni okungena kulo ukulithola.
Kodwa uma inhliziyweni yakho ibuyela emuva, futhi ungakutholi ukulalela, bese ukhohlwa, ubhujiswa emathinini amanye, ukhonza kuwo;
Ngikuxwayisa wena namuhla, ukuthi ngokuqinisekile uzolahleka; ngeke uhlale isikhathi eside ezweni odlula kulo umfula iYorodani ukulithatha.

Ngithi, ngisho ukuthi, ngiyaziveza izulu nezwe njengamasosha phakathi kwenu namhlanje, ukuthi ngimise phambi kwakho impilo nokufa, nokusindisa nokulahlwa; ngakho-ke ukhethe ukuphila, ukuze uphile wena nabantwana bakho.

Uzokhetha ukuthanda iNkosi uNkulunkulu wakho, uzowulalela umlomo wakhe, uzozibophezela kuye; ngoba iNkosi ngukuphila kwakho, futhi uzokunika iminyaka eminingi phezu kwezwe ebelisho ukuthi lizolibazisa obaba bakho, uAbrahama noIsakha noYakobi.
Wahamba uMoses, wakhuluma la mazwi kuwo wonke amaSirayeli.
Wathi kubo, Ngineminyaka engu-120 ubudala manje; ngeke ngikwazi ukudlula phambi kwenu ezweni lenu. UNkulunkulu uthe kuye: "Uzohamba ngaphezu kweYordan."
UYehova, uNkulunkulu wakho, yena ozodlula phambi kwakho; yena uzozibulala lezi zizwe phambi kwakho, nawe uzozinikela izwe labo. UYoshuwa, yena ozodlula phambi kwenu, njengoba iNkosi esho.
UNkulunkulu uzokwenza kubo, njengokuthi wenza kuSihoni noOgi, abaphathi bama-Amori, abewabulala nabo nezwe labo.
UYehova uzozinikela phambi kwenu, nikwenze kubo konke okungiwisela umthetho ngalo.
Beka amandla, ube namandla; ungakhathazeki, futhi ungagxeki ngenxa yabo; ngoba iNkosi uNkulunkulu wakho uhamba nawe; akakushiyeli, akakushiya.

UMoses wabiza uYoshuwa, wathi kuye phambi kwamadodana aseSirayeli onke: "Beka isandla sakho esiqinile, futhi ube nothando olukhulu; ngoba wena uzongena nalabo abantu ezweni loNkulunkulu owawuthi kubaba babo ukuthi azobanikela kulo; wena uzowahlukanisa phakathi kwabo ngokwemifelokazi.
UNkulunkulu, yena ohamba phambi kwakho, uzoba nawe; akakushiyanga, akakushiyelanga. Musa ukukhathazeka, ungabi nenhliziyo ebuhlungu.
Wabhala uMoses lo mthetho, wawunikeza ababhishobhi, oonyana bakaLawi, abathwala ibhokisi lesivumelwano sikaYehova, kanye nabaholi bonke baseSirayeli.
Wathi uMoses kubo, Ngokuphela konyaka owodwa oyisixhenxe, ngesikhathi sosuku lwezindlu ezifileyo, lapho kuphele khona iminyaka eyisithupha,
uma befika bonke isiSirayeli, ukuboniswa phambi koYehova uNkulunkulu wakho, endaweni akhetha kuyo; uzofunda lo mthetho emlonyeni wabo bonke isiSirayeli.

Zihlanganiseni abantu, amadoda nababhishobhi, namantombazane, nabantwana, nomuntu ovela kwamanye amazwe ohlala ezindaweni zenu, ukuze balalele, futhi bafunde ukukhathazeka kuYehova uNkulunkulu wenu, ukuthi bagcine bayenze yonke imithetho yalomthetho.
Nabantwana babo, abangazi lo mthetho, bakwazi ukuwulalela, bafunde ukukhathazeka kuYehova uNkulunkulu wenu, yonke imihla engihlala ngayo phezu kwezwe elidlula eJordani, niya kuyo ukulithola.
Wathi iNkosi kuMoses, Bona, usuku lwakho lokufa luyafika; thinta uYoshuwa, uye ekhempini yokuhlangana, ukuze ngimwise khona. Baye ke uMoses noYoshuwa, bahlala ekhempini yokuhlangana.
Wabonakala iNkosi efulethini, emgodini wezulu; futhi izulu lahlala phezu komngcele wefulethi.

Wathi iNkosi kuMoses, Bheka, uzolala nababa bakho; futhi izwe elinjalo lizongikhohlisa; lizolandela izitha zakwamanye amazwe ezweni elizoya kulo, lizomishiya, lizophula umnqophiso wami engiwenza nalo.

Ngosuku olulodwa ubuhlungu bami buzoqhuma phezu kwawo, futhi ngizowashiya, ngizifihla isithombe sami kubo, futhi bazophazamiseka; nezimo ezibi nezinkinga eziningi zizofika kuye; futhi uzothi ngalolu busuku, Ingabe lezo zinkinga azikho ngenxa yokuthi uNkulunkulu wethu akasekho phakathi kwethu?
Ngaleso sikhathi ngizofihla ubuso bam, ngenxa yobubi bonke obuzokwenza; ngoba bazobuyela emadini amanye.
Manje ke, bhala le ngithixo, uyifundise oonyana bakaSirayeli; bayenze ibe yingoma yabo, ukuze ibe ngumvikeli wami kubo.

Ngizowangenisa ezweni elifulathelayo ubisi nengulube, njengoba ngithi kubaba bakhe, azodla futhi akhuleke; uzobhekana namagugu amanye, azowakhonza, futhi uzongikhohlisa, futhi uzophula umnqophiso wami.

Uma befika phezu kwabo izimo ezibi nezinkinga eziningi, khona-ke lesi singoma sizobe sikhona njengesivivinyo kubo; ngoba isizukulwane sabo asizosikhohlwa. Ngizi ukuthi bacabangani namanje, ngaphambi kokuba ngibangenise ezweni engikhuluma ngalo.
Wabhala uMoses leli ngoma ngalolusuku, wafundisa oonyana bakaSirayeli.
Wathi iNkosi kuYoshuwa, unyana ka-Nun, Ube nokuthula, ube nomsindo; ngoba wena uzowafaka amadodana aseSirayeli ezweni engikhuluma ngalo kubo ngesandla sami, futhi ngizobe nawe.
Waphela uMoses ebhala amazwi alo mthetho encwadini, kusukela ekuqaleni kuya kukuphela kwayo.
Wathi uMosis kulabo abaLevi, abebethwala ibhokisi lesivumelwano sikaYehova, wathi,
Niyithathe le ncwadi yomthetho, niyibeke ngaphesheya kwebhokisi lomhlangano kaYehova uNkulunkulu wenu; lihlale khona, libe yisisulu kuwe.
Ngiyazi ukuthi wena uyisitha, futhi ikhanda lakho liqinile. Ngokuba manje ngiphila phakathi kwenu, nisitha iNkosi; ngaphezu kwalokho, uma ngifa, ningasitha yini?
Zihlanganisani ngimi bonke abaphathi bezizwe zenu, nabaphathi bakho bonke, ukuze ngikhulume kubo la mazwi, futhi ngiveze izulu nezulu zibe yisisulu phezu kwabo.

ngoba ngiyazi ukuthi ngemuva kokufa kwami, nizophazamiseka kakhulu, nisuka endlela engibawiselayo; futhi ingozi izofika kuwe ezinyangeni ezedlule, uma nikwenza okubi emehloni kaYehova, ukuze niyandise ubuhlungu ngemisebenzi yezandla zenu.
Wathi uMoses ngamazwi onke la mazwi engoma leyo, waqala akhuluma kuwo wonke umkhosi wakwaSirayeli, kuze kube sekuphele.
Lilalelani, izulu, ngizokhuluma; lilalelani, umhlaba, amagama olomo wami.
Imfundiso yami ikhuphuke njengemvula, futhi amagama ami akhuphuke njengamanzi abandayo, njengemvula ehlanzekile phezu kweqhwa elisha, njengemimoya emikhulu phezu kwezitshalo ezincane.
Ngizokhuluma igama likaYehova, Nihloniphe ubukhulu bukaThixo wethu!
UNkulunkulu ngumlilo, futhi umsebenzi wakhe uphelele. Wonke umsebenzi wakhe ulungile. UThixo othembekile, akakwenzanga lutho olubi. Ulungile futhi ufanele.
Kodwa bakwenza okubi kuye, ngenxa yobubi babo, futhi abazange babe izingane zakhe. Usuku lomndeni okhohlakeleyo, futhi ephindwe kabili.
Ingabe lokhu kungenxa yokuthi nikhokhela iNkosi, abantu abakhohlakeleyo nabangacabangi? Akukabi yini yena uBawo wenu, owenza wena ukuba wakhe? Wakwenza, wakwenza.
Khumbula izinsuku zangaphambilini, cabanga ngezizukulwane ezedlule. Buza ubaba wakho, futhi uzokutshela; buza abakhulu bakho, futhi bazokuchaza.
Ngoba lapho oNgcwele enikela khona izizwe ngezindawo zazo, lapho ehlukanisa khona imbewu yomuntu, wamisa umkhawulo wezizwe ngokwenani lamadodana kaSirayeli.
Ngokuba inkontileka kaYehova yiyo abantu bakhe; uYakobi, inkontileka yakhe ekhethiwe.
Wamuthola ezweni lesiqhingi, ezweni elingenalutho, elinabantu abaningi. Wamlinda, wabhekana naye. Wamuvikela njengawo wonke amehlo akhe.
Ngokufana ne-eagle ecindezela ikhaya layo, futhi ihamba phezu kwezingane zayo, wafaka amaphiko akhe ukuwaqoqa, wabathwala emilenzeni yawo.
UYehova kuphela owayemqondisa, akukho Nkulunkulu ongaphandle naye.
Wathi: "Uzohamba phezu kwezintaba eziphakeme zezwe, uzodla izithelo zezintaba; uzodla imbewu ephuma emhlabathini, nophethiloli ovela emhlabathini oqinile.
Ukudla kwakho kwakungubisi lwezinkomo, nobisi lwamakhoboka, nenyama yezinkomo, nenyama yobhontshisi, nenyama yomnqumo waseBhashani, nenyama yengulube engcono kakhulu; uphuze iwayini elihlanzekile.
Wakhula uJeshurun, wanyamalala. Ukhule waba mkhulu, ube nomthwalo omkhulu, wawugcwele ukudla; washiya uNkulunkulu owenzayo, wayalela iNtaba eyayimsindisa.
Bakwenza abe neze ngemikhosi yangaphandle, futhi bakwenza abe neze ngezinhlamvu zabo.
Banikela ku-demon, okungukuthi, hhayi uNkulunkulu, kubangcwele abazange bayazi, abangcwele abatsha abaye bavela nje, abangcwele abazange bakhathazeke ngabanye.
Ukhohlwe iRock owawungubaba wakho. Ukhohlwe uNkulunkulu owakuzalile wena.
Wakubona iNkosi, wabakhohlisa, ngenxa yokuthi izingane zakhe, amadodana akhe namadodakazi akhe, babembuza.
Wathi, Ngizofihla ubuso bam kubo, ngibone ukuthi kwenzekani ekugcineni kwabo; ngoba yimindeni ephindwe kabili, izingane ezingathembeki.

Bamimisa enhliziyweni yami ngezinto ezingaba nguThixo, bamimisa enhliziyweni yami ngezinhlamvu zabo ezingenalutho; ngakho ngizomimisa enhliziyweni yabo ngezinto ezingaba yizwe, ngizomimisa enhliziyweni yabo ngezwe elingaqondi.
Ngokuba indlala yami umlilo waqala, oza kukhuphuka kuya ezingeni eliphansi, futhi uzodla izwe kanye nemikhiqizo yayo, futhi uzomisa izikhulu zezintaba.
Ngizobeka phezu kwabo inhlekelele, futhi ngizisebenzisele zonke izinhlamvu zami.
Bazophuka ngenxa yokudla, futhi bazodla ngenxa yesifo esibulalayo; futhi ngizothumela phezu kwabo izilwane eziphila ezindaweni ezishisayo, nezinyamazane ezinobuthi ezihamba ngamanzi.
Ngaphesheya, ikhebula lizobulala izingane zabo. Kungaphakathi kwezindlu zabo, ubuhlungu buzohlasela. Amantombazane namantombazane amancane azofa, izinsana namadoda amakhulu anezinwele ezimnyama.
Ngithe ngizowasakaza ngaphesheya, futhi ngizisuse zonke izikhumbuzo zabo ezweni.
Ngiye ngikhathazekile, ukuthi bangathi abasoli babo; ukuthi bangathi abasoli babo, Ngamandla ethu sinqobe; uNkulunkulu akakwenzanga lokhu konke.'
Isirayeli yizwe elingenangqondo, akukho kuqonda kubo.
Uma bekufanele babe nengqondo futhi bakwazi lokhu! Uma bekufanele bacabange ukuthi yini ezoba kwenzeka kubo ekugcineni!
Ingabe umuntu oyedwa angagqugquzela abantu abangu-1, noma ababili bangagibela abantu abangu-10 000? Uma iNtaba yabo ingabathengise, uma iNkosi engawashiya.
Umlilo wabo awufana nomlilo wethu. Naphezu kokuxoshwa kwethu, bavumelana nalokho.
Imbewu yabo ivela ezindaweni zakwaSodoma, nasezintweni zakwaGomora; izithelo zabo zigcwele ubuthi, futhi amaqabunga abo abuhlungu.
Isiphuzo sabo sifana ne-poison yama-snake, i-venom ebulalayo yama-cobras.
"Angazigcinanga kanjani lezi zinto ezindaweni zami zokugcina?
Nginakho ukubuyisela, futhi nginakho ukubuyisa; ngesikhathi esifanele izinyawo zabo zizoba zimbi. Imini yabo yokulimala ifinyelele, nokufa kwabo kukhawulelwe kubo.
UNkulunkulu uzolungisa abantu bakhe, futhi uzobabaza abakhonzi bakhe, uma ebona ukuthi amandla abo aphelile, futhi akukho ozoshiywa, noma umkhonzi noma okhululekile.
Uzothi: "Yebo, kuphi amagugu abo, abaye behamba kuwo ngokuphephile?
labo abadla ubisi lwamabhishi abo, futhi baphuze iwayini lamabhishi abo? Lawa amasiko azovuka, azokusiza; azokuvikela!
Ngiyabona manje ukuthi ngimi, ngimi kuphela; akukho uNkulunkulu othile ngaphandle kwami. Ngibulala, futhi ngiphila; ngidlwengula, futhi ngiphilisa; akukho muntu ongasindisa esandla sami.
Ngikhuphula isandla sami esibhakabhakeni, futhi ngibekele lokhu: Ngokuqinisekile, njengoba ngiphila kuze kube sekupheleni,
lapho ngizomisa khona ikhebula lami elikhanyayo, futhi ngiyithathele ukuxolisa, ngizobuya ngazo izitha zami, futhi ngizogwema labo abangikhohlisa.
Ngizokwenza amathonsi ami aphuze igazi, futhi isikhephe sami sidla inyama; igazi labo ababulawayo nalabo abathathwayo, kanye nekhanda labaphathi bobubi.
Yiba nomvuzo, nimazwe, nabantu bakhe; ngoba uzobuyisela labo ababulala abakhonzi bakhe, futhi uzobhekana nabaphikisi bakhe, futhi uzohlanza izwe lakhe nomndeni wakhe.
Wafika uMoses, noYoshuwa unyana ka-Nun, wabhala wonke amazwi alo ingoma, ukuze abantu bakwazi ukulalela.
Waphela uMoses ekhuluma la mazwi onke phambi kwabaSirayeli bonke,
Wathi kubo, Nizibeke engqondweni yenu zonke lezi zinto engikhuluma ngazo phambi kwenu namhlanje; nizitshele izingane zenu ukuthi zihlole ukuzenza zonke izimiso zalomthetho.
La mazwi angeke abe lutho kuwe, ngoba yimpilo yakho; uma uwenza la mazwi, uzohlala isikhathi eside ezweni lenu elidlulayo iJordani, ukuze ulinqobe.
Wathi iNkosi kuMoses ngosuku olulodwa, esithi,
Hamba ufike ezindaweni eziphakeme ze-Abarim, emfuleni weNebo waseMowabhi, obhekene neJericho, ubone izwe likaKanana, elinika oonyana bakaSirayeli ukuba libe yindawo yabo yokuhlala.
Uzofa phezu kwalo mntaba, lapho ufike khona, uzohlangane nabantu bakho abafile phambi kwakho; njengokuthi uAron, umngane wakho, washona emfuleni iHori, wahlangane nabantu bakhe.
ngoba ningikhohlise phambi kwamadodana aseSirayeli, ezindaweni zamanzi zeMeriba yaseKadeshe, esiqhingini saseZin; ningangingcwele phakathi kwamadodana aseSirayeli.
Uzobona izwe ngamehlo akho kuphela; ngeke ungene ezweni enginika lona oonyana bakaSirayeli.
Lokho wukubambisana kukaMoses, umuntu kaThixo, kwabaSirayeli ngaphambi kokuba aphele.

Wathi, UNkulunkulu uvela emfuleni iSina, waphuma phezu kwabo njengolanga oluvela eSeyiri; wakhanya kusukela emfuleni iParan; wafika namakhulu amawaka abantu abangcwele, nomlilo oqhumayo ngakwesobunxele kwakhe.
Uthanda abantu bakhe; bonke abangcwele bakhe bangaphakathi esandla sakho, behlabela emadolo akho, futhi wonke umuntu uthola amazwi akho.
UMoses wasinikeze imithetho, impahla yabantu bakaYakobi.
UYehova waba ngukumkani eJeshuruni, lapho behlangana khona abakhulu bomphakathi, zonke izizwe zakwaSirayeli.
URubhen aphile, angafanga; abantu bakhe bangase bancane.
Wathi kuYuda, UNkulunkulu, lalela inkulumo kaYuda, uyibuyisele kubo bonke abantu bakhe; ubhekane nabo ngezandla zakhe, umsize ekuphileni kwakhe nababi bakhe.
Wathi ngoLevi, Nkosi, iThummim yakho ne-Urim yakho yiyo umkhonzi wakho othembekile; uyamcindezela eMasha, wagwema ngamanzi kaMeriba.
Wathi kubaba wakhe nomama wakhe, Ngingawakhathali. Akazange akhethe uhlangothi lwabangane bakhe, noma lwabantwana bakhe; ngoba balalela amagama akho, bagcina umnqophiso wakho.
Bazofundisa uYakobi izimiso zakho, namasiko akho eSirayeli; bazonikela ngenkabi phambi kwakho, nezipho zokudlwengula phezu kwesiqalo sakho.
UNkulunkulu, usindise zonke izifiso zakhe, futhi uthande umsebenzi wezandla zakhe; cindezela imilenze yalabo abaphikisayo kuye; cindezela labo abangamkhathali yena, ukuze bangavumi ukuvuka.
Ngaye uBhenjamin wathi, Owesifazane othandekayo kuYehova ahlale ephephile naye; uNkosi igcina yena nsuku zonke, futhi owesifazane othandekayo kuYehova uhlala phakathi kwemilenze yakhe.
Wathi ngoYosefu, UNkulunkulu usize izwe lakhe ngezinto ezinhle zezulu eziivelwe phezulu, ngeqhwa, namanzi amahle angaphansi kwayo.
Ingabe inezithelo ezinhle kakhulu ilanga lizozisa futhi izithelo ezingcono kakhulu ngaso sonke isikhathi,
ngemiklomelo engcono kakhulu yezintaba zakudala kanye nezimali zezingqimba eziphilayo,

futhi ngezinto ezingcono emhlabeni, kanye nanoma yini ekhona kuyo, futhi ngothando lomuntu obonakala emgodini womlilo. Nazo zonke lezi zipho baphumule phezu kwekhanda uYosefu, phezu imilenze yowesifazane phakathi kwabazalwane bakhe.

Ubuhle bakhe bufana nengulube ezalwa kuqala; amakhopho akhe afana namakhopho omnqumo omnyama; ngazo uzozibulala izizwe, nazo zonke ezisentshonalanga yezwe. Lokho kuyizinkulungwane zamaphesenti kaEfrayim, nokho kuyizikhulu zamaphesenti kaManase.
Wathi ngoZebuloni, Yijabulise, oZebuloni, lapho uphuma khona; futhi wena, Issakare, ezindaweni zakho.
Bazobiza izizwe ziye emfuleni, futhi bazonikela khona ngezipho ezifanele; futhi bazodla ngezinto ezinhle zasezilwandle, nezimali ezifihlakele emhlabathini.
Wathi ngoGadi, Kubabaleke lowo owenza izwe likaGadi libe likhulu! UGadi uhlala khona njengosizi, ephuza isisu nekhanda.
Wakhetha indawo engcono kakhulu yezwe, futhi umnikelo wombuso wagcinwa kuye; lapho behlangana khona abaphathi bezinhlanga, walungisa isinqumo sikaYehova, nemithetho yakhe kwaSirayeli.
Wathi ngoDani, UDani ungumntwana wengulube, uphuma eBhashani.
Wathi ngoNaphtali, UNaphtali ugcwele inhlonipho kaYehova, futhi ugcwele isivuno sakhe; uzothola izwe enyakatho nasentshonalanga.
Wathi ngo-Asere: U-Asere ungcwele kunabo bonke izingane; athandeke kubazalwane bakhe, futhi izwe lakhe libe likhulu nge-oyile.
Izingcezu zezingcingo zakho zibe yinsimbi nesiliva, futhi amandla akho abe nsuku zonke zokuphila kwakho.
Ayikho into efana noNkulunkulu kaJeshurun, ohamba phezu kwezulu ukuze akusize, ngaphezu kwezinkuni ngobuhle bakhe.
UNkulunkulu ohlala isikhathi eside uyisizinda sakho, futhi izinyawo zakhe ezihlala isikhathi eside zingaphansi kwakho; wakhipha umshayeli wakho phambi kwakho, wathi: "Khumbulana nabo!"
Bazohlala uSirayeli ephephile, futhi imbewu kaYakobi izohlala yona kuphela, ezweni lengulube newayini elisha, lapho isibhakabhaka sikhuphuka khona.

Kuhle wena, isiSirayeli! Ubani ofana nawe, abantu abasindiswe nguYehova? Nguye umgoqo wakho, nosizo lwakho, nekhebula lakho elikhanyayo. Abaphikisi bakho bazokuhlangula phambi kwakho; uzohamba phezu kwezintaba zabo.
Waphuma uMoses emazweni aseMowabi, wafika emfuleni iNebo, engxenyeni ephezulu yePisga, ebhekene neJericho; khona-ke iNkosi wambonisa izwe lonke, kusukela eGiliyadi kuya eDani,
yonke iNaphtali, nezwe likaEphrayim noManase, nezwe lonke lakwaYuda, kuze kube selwandle oluphakathi,
iNtshonalanga enyakatho, kanye nofula lonke laseJericho, lo mzi wezintaba-mlilo, kuze kube yiSoari.
Wathi iNkosi kuye, Le yilizwe engikhuluma ngalo ku-Abrahama, noIsake, noYakobi, ngathi, Ngizolibazisa izizukulwane zakho; ngikubonise ngamehlo akho, kodwa awuzodlula kuyo.
Wafa khona uMoses, umkhonzi kaYehova, ezweni laseMowabi, njengokuthi iNkosi.
Wamu葬la emfuleni waseMowabi, ebhekene neBhete-peori; akukho muntu owaziyo isibhedlela sakhe kuze namuhla.
UMoses wayeneminyaka engu-120 ubudala, lapho efa khona; amazwana akhe ayemnene kakhulu futhi anamandla.
Bathi ke amadodana aseSirayeli: Silele uMoses ezindaweni eziseduze zakwaMowabi izinsuku ezingama-30, kuze kube sekuphele isikhathi sokulingisa nokuzingela uMosis.
UYoshuwa unyana kaNune wagcwele umoya wolwazi, ngoba uMosis wayemise izandla zakhe phezu kwakhe; futhi abafundisi bakaSirayeli bamlalela, bakwenza njengoba iNkosi abewisela umthetho uMoses.
Ngaleso sikhathi, akazange akhuleke eSirayeli umprofeti ofana noMoses, owaziwa nguYehova ngamehlo akhe.
Wonke lo mqondiso, nololo phawu oludumile, iNkosi wamthumela wona ukuba akwenze ezweni laseYiputa, kuFaro, nakwabo bonke abaphathi bakhe, nezwe lakhe lonke.
Akukho muntu owazibophezele ekwenzeni izinto ezimangazayo, ezifana nalezi azenzayo uMoses phambi kwabaSirayeli.
Josh: Kwathi, ngemuva kokufa kukaMoses, umkhonzi kaYehova, iNkosi wathi kuYoshuwa, unyana kaNune, umkhonzi kaMosis:
Wathi, Umkhonzi wami uMoses usefile; ngakho manje zulazula, uyeke lo mfula iYorodani, wena nomphakathi lowo wonke, ufike ezweni enginika lona oonyana bakaSirayeli.
Yonke indawo lapho nibeka khona inyawo lenu, ngiyikulethelani, njengoba ngithi kuMoses.
Ukusuka esiqhingini, naseLibanoni, kuya emfuleni omkhulu i-Euphrates, yonke indawo yamaHithi, kuze kube lwandle olukhulu, lizoba yizwe lakho.
Akukho muntu ozokwazi ukubhekana nawe zonke izinsuku zakho. Ngizobe nawe, njengokuba ngibe noMosesi; ngeke ngikushiye, futhi ngeke ngikushiye.
Uzobe unamandla, ube nobuqili; ngoba wena uzoba ngumqondisi wale ndoda, ukuze ithathe izwe engigunyazile ababa babo.

Uma nje unamandla, ube nothando olukhulu kakhulu, ulinde ukukwenza konke umthetho owawuthiwe nguMoses, umkhonzi wami; ungaseki kuwo ngakwesokudla noma ngakwesobunxele, ukuze wenze kahle lapho uhamba khona.
Le ncwadi yomthetho kufanele ihlale engqondweni yakho, futhi uyicabangele ekuseni nakusihlwa, ukuze ugcine ukwenze konke okubhalwe kulo; khona-ke uzophumelela, futhi uzophumelela.
Ngikutshele, uhlale uqinile, ube nenhliziyo enamandla; ungakhathazeki, futhi ungabi nomsindo; ngoba iNkosi uNkulunkulu wakho ukhona nawe kuwo wonke amadolobha ohamba kuwo.
Wathi uYoshuwa kubaholi babantu: "Niyigcine le ncwadi.

Wathi, Yiya phakathi kwesikhashana, utshele abantu ukuthi, Nilungiselele isidlo sakusihlwa; ngoba ngemuva kwezinsuku ezintathu nizodlula ngaleyo Yordani, ukuze nifike niyithathe izwe iNkosi uNkulunkulu wenu akunika lona.
Wakhuluma uYoshuwa nezizwe zakwaRubhen, nezizwe zakwaGadi, nengxenye yesizwe sikaManase.
Wathi, Khumbulani ukuthi uMoses, umkhonzi kaYehova, wathi kuni, UNkulunkulu wenu, iNkosi, wakunika isikhala, wamnika leli lizwe.

Izifazane zenu, nezingane zenu, nezilwane zenu zizohlala kulolu mhlaba, owabanikela wona uMoses ngaleso siqhingi saseJordani; kodwa bonke abantu bakho abanamandla bazodlula phambi kwabazalwane benu, begqoke izithuthi zabo, balungiselele ukuwasiza;

kuze kube yilapho iNkosi abanika khona isiphumulo, njengabanikezayo niye, futhi nabo bathathe izwe iNkosi uNkulunkulu wenu alibanikela ngalo; ngemva kwalokho nizobuyela ezweni lenu elihlala kulo, elinikeziwe ngalesi siqhingi sikaYoshuwa, umkhonzi kaYehova.
Baphendula uYoshuwa, bethi, Zonke izinto ozithumelele zona sizozenza, nalapho usithumelela khona sizoya.
Sizokulalela wena, njengoba sikwenzele uMoses ngazo zonke izinto; kodwa iNkosi uNkulunkulu wakho abe nawe, njengokuba ube noMoses.
Wonke umuntu ongeke athobele umyalo wakho, futhi alalele amagama akho, uzofa; kodwa ube nokuthula, ube nomphefumulo onamandla.

UYoshuwa, unyana ka-Nun, wathumela abantu ababi abazobhekana naye eSitiyini, wathi kubo ngokufihlakeleyo: "Nihambe nibone izwe, kanye neJerikho." Baye bafika ekhaya lendodakazi yowesifazane okuthiwa nguRahabhi, bahlala khona.
Kwathi kwathunywa ukumkani waseJericho, kwathiwa, Bheka, abantu baseSirayeli bafika lapha kusasa, ukubheka izwe.
Wathumela ukumkani waseJericho ku-Rahabhi, esithi, Thola abantu abafike ekhaya lakho; ngoba bafika ukubheka izwe lonke.
Uwesifazane wathatha labo bantu ababi, wabafihla; wathi, Bafika kuyena abantu, kodwa angizange ngizi ukuthi bavela phi.
Kuze kube yisikhathi sokuvala umgwaqo wedolobha, lapho kwafika khona ubusuku obumnyama, laba bantu basuka. Angikaze ngizi ukuthi baye kuphi; landelana nabo ngokushesha, ungabathola."
Wathi, "Uzobona ukuthi ngizozi. Uthe: 'Kulungile!'" Wayewathatha esitezi, wabafihla ngezansi kwezihlahla ze-linseed ayezibeke khona.
Bathi abantu bakakumkani, bewalandela ngendlela yolwandle lweYorodani; bese bephuma, kwavalwa isango..
Ngaphambi kokuba amaphoyisa aphumule, uRahabhi wanyuka waya kubo esitezi.
Wathi kubo, Ngiyazi ukuthi iNkosi wakunikezile leli lizwe; futhi inhliziyo yethu ihlukumezeke ngenxa yenu, nalabo bonke abahlali balesi siqhingi baphazamiseka ngenxa yenu.

Sithe sazi ukuthi iNkosi wenza amanzi eMfuleni oMthubi aphuke phambi kwenu, lapho niphuma khona eYiputa; futhi sithe sazi ukuthi nani nakwenze kuSihoni noOgi, abaphathi ababi bama-Amori, ngaphesheya kweYorodani, ukuthi ningawaphelisa kangako.

Kwathi lapho sazi khona, inhliziyweni yethu yalahleka, futhi inhliziyo yethu yalahleka ngenxa yenu; ngoba iNkosi uNkulunkulu wenu, yena kuphela uNkulunkulu esibhakabhakeni phezulu, nasemhlabeni ngezansi.
Ngakho manje, ngicela, bengitshele ngeNkosi ukuthi uzongilungisa imindeni yami, njengobaki mina ngangikuhlelile wena; ngininikeze isibonakaliso esiqinisekile ngempela.
ukuthi uzosindisa impilo yobaba wami, nomama wami, nabangani bam, nezinganeki zami, namakhaya abo onke; ukuze usisindise ekufaneni.gorha.
Bathi abantu kuye, Impilo yethu ifana nokuphila kwakho; uma ungazitshela umuntu lutho ngale nto esiyenzayo, lapho iNkosi esininika lona izwe, sizokwenza nawe ngothando neqiniso.
Wabakhuphula ngentambo ngefasitela; ngoba indlu yakhe yakhiwa esitezi sedolobha dolobha, yena ke wayehlala esitheni.
Wathi kubo, Yiya entaba-mlilo, ukuze bangakutholani labo abazokuzilandela; fihlakeni khona izinsuku ezintathu, kuze babuye labo abazozilandela; bese ke nihambe indlela yenu.
Bathi kuye, "Sizobe sikhululekile ngalesi sinqumo okwenze savuma.
Uma nje, uma sifika kulolu lizwe, ungayibopha le nhlanganisela emnyama kulethebhu ebesikhupha ngayo; bese ufaka ubaba wakho nomama wakho nabangane bakho, nemindeni yenu yonke ekhaya lakho.
Uma umuntu ephuma ekhaya lakho, ephuma emgwaqeni, uzofa ngecala lakhe, futhi sizohlala singenacala; kodwa uma kukhona okunye okubi Dilini lakho, sizohlala singenacala.
Uma utshela omunye umuntu lokho esikwenzayo, khona-ke sizoba ngekho emthethweni owawunze sizizwe.
Wayethi, "Kube njalo njengoba usho." Wabasusa, basuka, waveza intambo ebomvu efasiteleni.
Baye befika emfuleni, bahlala khona izinsuku ezintathu, kuze kube sekuphele ukulandela kwabo; futhi labo abalandelana nabo bafuna yonke indlela, kodwa bangawatholanga.
Baphuma emadolobheni, badlula, befika kuYoshuwa, unyana kaNune; bakhuluma kuye konke okube sekwenzekile kubo.
Bathi kuYoshuwa, "UNkulunkulu umise izwe lonke esandla sethu; nalabo bonke abahlali balo mhlaba baphoqeleka ukuba bahambe ngenxa yethu."
UYoshuwa wavuka ekuseni, wasuka eSitimu, waya eYordan, yena nemindeni yamadodana kaSirayeli naye; bamisa khona isikhashana ngaphambi kokuba badlule.
Ngemuva kwezinsuku ezintathu abaqondisi basuka ekamelweni
Wathi kulabo abantu: "Uma nibona abapristi, amaLevi, bethwala ibhokisi lesivumelwano sikaYehova uNkulunkulu wenu, khona-ke nizophuma ezindaweni zenu, niyilandele.
Kodwa gcina isikhala esingu-kilomitha eyodwa phakathi kwakho nebhokisi. Ungayifinyeleli eduze kwayo. Ngemuva kwalokho uzozi ukuthi indlela " ehamba ngayo, ngoba awuzange ube ngale ndlela ngaphambi."
Wathi uYoshuwa kubo bonke abantu, Buyiselani; ngoba ngoMsombuluko iNkosi uzokwenza phakathi kwenu izinto ezimangazayo.
Wathi uYoshuwa kwababhishobhi, Nithathe ibhokisi lesivumelwano, nihambe phambi kwalabo abantu. Bayithatha, bahamba phambi kwabo;
Wathi iNkosi kuYoshuwa, Namuhla ngizoqala ukukwenza ube mkhulu phambi kwamehlo eSirayeli bonke, ukuze bakwazi ukuthi ngikhona nawe, njengokuba ngikhona noMoses.
Uzothi kubo ababingeleli abathwala ibhokisi lesivumelwano, Nithi, Uma nifika esiphethweni samanzi aseJordani, hlalani emfuleni.
Wathi uYoshuwa kubo bonke oonyana bakaSirayeli, "Njimani lapha, nilalele amazwi kaYehova uNkulunkulu wenu."
Wathi, Ngalokhu nizokwazi ukuthi uNkulunkulu ophilayo usephakathi kwenu, futhi ukuthi ngeke asuse phambi kwenu amaKanana, namaHeti, namaHivi, namaPerizi, namaGiregasi, namaAmori, namaJebusi.
Bheka, ibhokisi lesivumelwano soNkulunkulu wezwe lonke lizohamba phambi kwenu, lifike eJordani.
Ngokuba nithatheni abantu abalishumi elinambini eziqhingini zakwaSirayeli, umuntu ngamunye eqenjini ngalinye.
Uma nje izinyawo zababhishobhi abathwala ibhokisi likaYehova, uNkulunkulu kamhlaba wonke, zifinyelela emanzini eJordani, amanzi aphumayo azohlala, azohlala emgodini owodwa.
Basuka ke abantu ezindaweni zabo, badlula iJordani, nababambiqhaza abathwala isiqu sesivumelwano behamba phambi kwabo.
Kwaba yisikhathi sokuvuna, lapho iJordane idlula zonke izintaba zayo. Uma abapristi abathwali isiqubulo befika emfuleni, bese izinyawo zabo zifinyelela enkabeni yamanzi;

Kwathi lapho amanzi aphumayo ehla khona, wamisa ukuphuma kwakhe. Amanzi asuka emzini ka-Adam, osendaweni yase-Zarethani, aqala ukungena emgodini owodwa. Amanzi asuka emgodini woMfula oMfushane aphela ngokugcwele. Abantu badlula eJericho.

Abapristi abathwala ibhokisi lesivumelwano sikaYehova bahlala beqinile endaweni emnyama phakathi kweYorodani, futhi bonke isiSirayeli badlula ndawonye endaweni emnyama, kuze kube sekuphele abantu bonke.
Kwathi lapho abantu bonke beqedile ukudlula iJordani, iNkosi wathi kuYoshuwa,
"Chofoza abantu abalishumi elinambini, umuntu ngamunye isizwe,
bese ukhuluma kubo, uthi, Nciphisani amatshe alishumi elinambini phakathi kweYorodani, lapho izinyawo zababhishobhi zahlala khona; nizithatheni nani, nizibeke endaweni yenu yokuhlala le busuku.
Wabiza uYoshuwa amadoda alishumi elinambini, ayewakhethela ezweni laseSirayeli, owesifazane oyedwa ngaleso sizwe.
Wathi kubo uMoses, Ngeni ngaphambili kwebhokisi likaYehova uNkulunkulu wenu, nifike ephakathi kweYorodani; niyithathe "itshe" elilodwa ngalinye phezu komlenze wenu, isonto ngalinye lakwaSirayeli.
Lokhu kuzoba yiphawu phakathi kwenu, ukuze uma izingane zenu zithi, Ngosuku oluzayo: Ziyini lezi zinto?

Uzokhuluma kubo, usithi: "Ulwandle lweYorodani lwagcwala amanzi phambi kwebhokisi lesivumelwano sikaYehova; lapho lidlula eYorodani, amanzi lagwazwa; futhi amatshe lawa azoba ngumlando wamaSirayeli kuze kube sekupheleni."

Bakwenza ke oonyana bakaSirayeli njengokuthi uYoshuwa kubo; bathatha amatshe alishumi elinambini emaphakathi kweYordan, njengabesithi iNkosi kuYoshuwa, isizwe ngasinye sithole itshe elinye; bazisa ezindaweni zabo zokuphumula, bamisa khona.
UYoshuwa wabeka futhi amatshe alishumi elinambini phakathi kweJordani, lapho abapristi abathwali ibhokisi lesivumelwano behlala khona; zikhona nanamuhla.
Bathi labo ababhishobhi abathwala ibhokisi, bahlala phakathi kweYorodani, kuze kube sekuphele konke iNkosi abewisela umthetho ngalo uYoshuwa, njengoba uMosis abewisela umthetho ngawo uYoshuwa.
Kwathi lapho abantu bonke bedlule khona, ibhokisi. UNkulunkulu wadlula, kanye nababhishobhi, phambi kwamehlo kwabantu.
Badlula uRubhen, noGadi, nengxenye yesizwe sikaManase, begqoke izikhali, phambi kwamadodana aseSirayeli, njengokuthi uMoses wabatshele.
Badlula phambi kweNkosi, ezindaweni ezihlaba umxhwele zaseJericho, ukubhekana nokulwa, abantu abangumakhulu amane anamashumi amahlanu, abagqoke izibhamu.
Ngosuku olulodwa iNkosi wavusa uYoshuwa phambi kwamehlo eSirayeli bonke; bagwema yena yonke imihla yakhe, njengokuba begweme uMoses.
Wathi iNkosi kuYoshuwa,
Uthi uMosis kuMoses, "Ubatshele abapristi abathwala ibhokisi lemithetho yomthetho, ukuthi bakhuphuke emfuleni iJordani.
Wathi uYoshuwa kubabhishobhi, Nikhuphuke eYordan.

Kwathi lapho ababhishobhi abathwala ibhokisi lesivumelwano sikaYehova bekhuphuka emfuleni, bese amadolo abo edlula endaweni encibilikayo, amanzi o Dilimane abuyela emuva, adlule phezu kwezintaba zayo, njengakuqala.
Baphuma abantu eYordan ngomhla wesithupha wenyanga yokuqala, bamisa isikhashana eGalgali, enyakatho-mpumalanga yeYericho.
Wathi uYoshuwa amatshe amabili alishumi elinambini, ababewathatha eYordan, wababeka eGilgal.
Wathi kubo bonke abantu bakaSirayeli, Kuze kube kusasa, uma izingane zenu zibuza abazali babo, zithi, Ziyini lezi zitshe?
sithi kubo, 'Israyeli wadlula iJordani endaweni emanzi.'
ngoba iNkosi uNkulunkulu wenu wamisa umfula iYorodani phambi kwenu, kuze nidlule, njengokuba wamisa ulwandle olumnyama phambi kwethu, kuze sidlule.
ukuze zonke izizwe zezulu zikwazi ukuthi amandla kaYehova amkhulu, futhi ukuze nigweme iNkosi uNkulunkulu wenu nsuku zonke.

Kwathi lapho bonke abaphathi bama-Amori, ababesenyakatho yeJordani, kanye nabo bonke abaphathi bama-Kanana abeselwandle, beva ukuthi iNkosi wamisa umfula iYorodani phambi kwabantwana bakaSirayeli, kuze kube sethule; khona-ke inhliziyweni yabo yalahleka, futhi amehlo abo awakwazi ukuzivikela ngenxa yamaSirayeli.
Ngaleso sikhathi iNkosi wathi kuYoshuwa, Yenza izinkomishi zamatshe egolide, uthathe isibopho samadodana kaSirayeli kabili.
Wathi uYoshuwa, ekwenzeni izibha>i zegolide, watholisa amadodana aseSirayeli endaweni ebizwa ngokuthi yiNtaba Yezinyamakazi.
Lokhu kwaba wukuthi, bonke abantu abaphuma eYiputa, bonke amadoda okulwa, babefile emfuleni, besuka ezweni elimnyama.
futhi bonke amadoda aphumayo eYiputa, babetholwe; kodwa labo abazalwa emfuleni, lapho besuka khona eYiputa, abatholwe.

Ngokuba iminyaka emashumi mane abantu bakaSirayeli behamba emifuleni, kuze kube sekuphele bonke abantu abanamandla okulwa ababephuma eYiputa; ngenxa yokuthi abazange balalela izwi likaYehova. UNkulunkulu waphakamisa isandla sakhe, wathi: "Asikubonile leli lizwe, elishayela ubisi nengulube, elizolimnika,"
UYoshuwa wathungatha oonyana babo, abewaphakamisa uNkulunkulu endaweni yabo; ngoba abazange bathweswe ithanga, ngenxa yokuthi bebengathethwa ngesandla.
Kwathi lapho abantu bonke betholwe khona, bahlala emgodini, kuze kube sekuphele ukwelashwa kwabo.
Wathi iNkosi kuYoshuwa, Namhlanje ngiyisuse phezu kwenu inkohliso yama-Egipta; ngakho kwabizwa igama lesi sifundazwe ngokuthi iGalgali, kuze kube manje.
Bathi, "Sizokwenza iPasha ngomhla wesishiyagalombili wenyanga, uma siphuma eGilgal, ezindaweni eziseduze neJerikho."
Kwathi ngosuku olulandelayo iPasika, badla ukudla okuvela ezweni, ubisi olungavuthwanga, nenyama ethosiwe.
I-manna yamiswa ngosuku ngemuva kokudla kwabo ukudla okuvela ezweni. Abantu baseSirayeli abazange babe ne-manna. Lo nyaka badla izithelo zaseKanana.

Kwathi lapho uYoshuwa ebhekene neJerikho, waphakamisa amehlo akhe, wabona umuntu esemile phambi kwakhe, eneqhwa. UYoshuwa waya kuye, wathi kuye, Ingabe wena uyingane yethu, noma uyingane yalabo abasengozini?
Wathi yena, Akunjalo; ngifika njengomkhuluwa womkhosi kaYehova. UYoshuwa wehla ngobuso bakhe phansi ezweni, wathandaza, wathi, Ingabe kukhona okuthile oyinkosi yami ofuna ukumtshela umkhonzi wakhe?
Wathi uNdunankulu womkhosi kaYehova, Thola izicathulo zakho; ngoba indawo ohlala kuyo iyingcwele. UYoshuwa wakwenza njalo.
Izingcingo zaseJericho zavalwa ngenxa yamadodana aseSirayeli; akukho muntu ophumayo, akukho muntu ophumayo.
Wathi iNkosi kuYoshuwa, Thola, ngikulethe esandla sakho iJericho, nokumkani wayo, namadoda amakhulu ayo.
Hamba ujikeleze lo mzi kanye nabantu bakho bonke abahlaselayo. Yenza lokhu izinsuku ezine.

Uzobeka abapristi abasebathathu bethwala amabhungane ayisixhenxe ekhanda lengulube phambi kwebhokisi lesivumelwano. Ngosuku lwesine, nizojikeleza lo mzi izikhathi ezisixhenxe; futhi abapristi bazophuza amabhungane.
Uma ubona ukuthi baphuza iphoyinti elilodwa, khona-ke abantu bonke kumele baphuze iphoyinti elilodwa; khona-ke umgwaqo wedolobha uzowela phansi, futhi wonke umuntu uzongena kuwo.
UYoshuwa unyana ka-Nun wababiza ababhishobhi, wathi kubo, Nciphisani ibhokisi lesivumelwano, futhi ababhishobhi abayisithupha bathathe amabhungane phambi kwebhokisi likaYehova.
Wathi kubo bonke abantu, Yinikele, nijikeleze lo mzi, nalabo abagqoke izithukuthe zihambe phambi kwesibuko sikaYehova.
Kwathi, lapho uYoshuwa ekhuluma abantu khona, amabhishobhi asixhenxe, aphethe amabhungane esixhenxe, wadlula phambi koYehova, ephuza amabhuzane akhe; ibhokisi lesivumelwano soNkulunkulu lalandela.
Amadoda agqoke izikhali ayehamba phambi kwamabhishobhi aphonsa ama-trumpets, futhi umgwaqo ongezansi walandela ibhokisi. Le sikhathi sonke ama-trumpets ahlala ephuca.
Wathi uYoshuwa kubo bonke abantu, Mhlawumbe ngeke nivuke, noma nikhuphule izingcingo zenu, noma nikhulume lutho, kuze kube yilapho ngikutshele khona ukuthi nivuke; khona-ke nivuke.
Wabeka ibhokisi likaYehova lijikeleze lo mzi kabili; abantu babuyela esiteji, baphumula khona ekuseni.
UYoshuwa wavuka ekuseni, abapristi baphakamisa ibhokisi likaNkulunkulu.

Nabo ababhishobhi abayisixhenxe, abanezinhlamvu zezinhlamvu eziyisishiyagalombili, bahamba phambi kwebhokisi likaYehova, bephuza izinhlamvu zezinhlamvu; nalabo abagqugquzelayo behamba phambi kwabo, nalabo abasemuva belandela ibhokisi, bephuza izinhlamvu.
Ngosuku lwesibili bajikeleza idolobha kabili,. Babuyela esitezi esiphansi; bakwenza njalo usuku olune.

Ngosuku oluyisixhenxe, bavuka ekuseni, bajikeleza idolobha ngendlela efanayo; kodwa ngaleso sikhathi bajikeleze izikhathi ezisixhenxe. Kwakungusuku olulodwa lapho bejikeleza khona izikhathi ezisixhenxe.
Kwathi ngesikhathi esiyisixhenxe, lapho ababhishobhi bephuza khona amaphoyinti, uYoshuwa wathi kubo bonke abantu, Bukelani! UNkulunkulu usekuletheleni lo mzi.

Lo mzi, nezinto zonke ezingaphakathi kuwo, kumele zihlukaniswe ngokugcwele kukaNkulunkulu; kodwa uRahabhi owesifazane, naye wonke umuntu ohlala ekhaya lakhe, kufanele agcinwe, ngoba wafihla labo abathunyelwe ngathi.
Uma uthatha noma yini yazo, uzoba yingozi emkhosini wakwaSirayeli; uma uthatha noma yini yazo, uzoba yingozi emkhosini wakwaSirayeli.
Yonke isiliva, negolide, nanoma yini eyenziwe ngobhedu noma ngensimbi, ingcwele kukaNkulunkulu; kufanele ifike emgodini kaYehova.

Baphoqa ababhishobhi ukuthi baphuze amabhungane, abantu ke baphoqa. Bekuthe bezwa umsindo wamabhungane, baphoqa ngokukhulu, isakhiwo sawela phansi; bonke abantu baphoqeleka ukuba bafike ngokushesha, bathatha lo mzi.
Babulala ngaso sonke isikhathi konke okukhona kulo mzi, amadoda nabesifazane, abancane nobudala, namakhoboka, nezingulube, nezinkomo, ngesandla sabo.
Wathi uYoshuwa kulabo bantu ababi, abaye babheka izwe, wathi, Ngeni endlwini yomfelandawonye, niyiphumeze yena nomndeni wakhe wonke, njengokuba nithe naye.
Baye baphuma, bakhipha uRahabhi, nobaba wakhe, nenkosikazi yakhe, nabangane bakhe, nabo bonke abawinile; bakhipha futhi imindeni yabo yonke, bababeka ngaphandle komkhosi wakwaSirayeli.
Bawuthutha wonke lo mzi, nanoma yini ekhona kuwo; kodwa isiliva, negolide, nezinto zesibhakabhaka, nezinsimbi, bazibeka emthonjeni wendlu kaNkulunkulu.

UYoshuwa wagcina uRahabhi, indodakazi yowesifazane, nomndeni wakhe, nalabo bonke ababengowabo; yena wahlala phakathi kwabaSirayeli kuze kube ngalolu busuku, ngenxa yokuthi wafihla labo abathunyelwe nguYoshuwa ukubheka iJericho.

Kwathi lapho, uYoshuwa washaya abantu ngesandla, wathi: "Umuntu ozama ukwakha lo mzi, iJericho, kufanele abulawe phambi koYehova; umzali wakhe omkhulu kumele aphele uma emisa isisekelo sayo, nomntwana wakhe omncane kumele aphele uma emisa amasango ayo."
Waye iNkosi noYoshuwa, wathola igama elikhulu ezweni lonke.
Kodwa amakhosi aseSirayeli wathatha izinto ezingcwele, futhi uAchan, unyana Karmi, unyana Zabdi, unyana Zerah, esifundazweni saseYuda, wathatha ezinye zazo; ngakho iNkosi wagwema amaSirayeli kakhulu.
UYoshuwa wathumela abantu kusuka eJericho kuya e-Ai, elibhekene neBethe-aweni, enyakatho yeBhetelehem, wathi kubo: "Niya phezulu, niyibone izwe." Baye ke labo bantu babheka i-Ai.
Babuyela kuye uYoshuwa, bathi kuye, Akufanele abantu bonke bahambe; thumela amadoda angamashumi amabili noma amakhulu amathathu ezweni lase-Ai; ungagcini abantu bonke, ngoba kukhona abantu abancane.
Baye benyuka abantu abangaphezu kukamakhulu amathathu, babaleka phambi kwamadoda ase-Ai.

Amadoda ase-Ai abulala phakathi kwabo abantu abangumashumi amathathu anesithandathu. Bawalandela emnyango, bafika eShebarim, babahlasela emadolobheni aphansi; futhi inhliziyweni yabantu yaqhuma, yaba ngamanzi.
UYoshuwa waxosha izigqoko zakhe, wehla ngobuso bakhe phansi ezweni phambi kwebhokisi likaYehova kuze kube sebusuku; nadla rauna bonke abakhulu bakaSirayeli, babeka uthuli ezinyaweni zabo.

Wathi uYoshuwa, "Ngiyaxolisa, Nkosi yethu iNkosi, yini ekwenzeni wena ukudlulisa la maqembu abantu phezu kweJordani, ukuze usithumelele esihlalweni sama-Amori, ukuthi asihlukumeze? Uma kungenjalo, singeke sahlala ngaphesheya kweJordani.
Nkosi, yini engikushoyo manje, lapho isiSirayeli sibuye sihambe phambi kwababi bakhe?
Uma bekubona labo baseKanana, nalabo bonke abasezweni lonke, bazosibamba ngazo zonke izingcezu zethu, basuse igama lethu phezu komhlaba; yini ongayikwenza ngegama lakho elikhulu?
Wathi iNkosi kuYoshuwa, Nquma; yini na isizathu sokuba ulele ngobuso bakho?

Amakhosi aseSirayeli abulawe; baphula umnqophiso wami, owawubatshela wona. Bathatha izimpahla eziboshwe ngokugcwele, bephuza futhi bezifihla phakathi kwazo zonke izinto zabo. UNkulunkulu wathi kuMosis:

Ngenxa yalokho, abantu bakaSirayeli abakwazi ukumelana nababi babo; babuyela emuva, babaleka, ngoba nabo bahlukaniswe ngokugcwele. Ngami ngeke ngihlale phakathi kwenu nsuku zonke, ngaphandle kokuthi nisuse konke okuhlukaniswe phakathi kwenu.

Hamba, ugcine abantu bengcwele; uthi kubo, Uhlale ungcwele kuze kube ngoMsombuluko; ngoba iNkosi, uNkulunkulu kaSirayeli, uthe: Zikhona phakathi kwenu izinto ezilahlekile, isiSirayeli; ngeke nikwazi ukumelana nezitha zenu, kuze nizisuse.
Emini, bhekani phambili isizwe ngesizwe. Isizwe esikhethiwe nguYehova sizobhekana phambili ngomndeni ngomndeni. Umndeni okhethiwe nguYehova uzokubhekana phambili ngowesifazane nowesifazane.
Uma umuntu etholakele enezinto ezilahliwe, uzothunyelwa emgodini, naye nezinto zakhe zonke, ngenxa yokuthi waphula isivumelwano sikaYehova, futhi wenza into engalungile eSirayeli.
Ngosuku olulandelayo ekuseni uJoshua wabeka isizwe sakwaSirayeli esihamba phambili ngesizwe ngasinye, futhi isizwe sakwaYuda sakhethwa.
Kwafika imindeni yakwaYuda, kwathathwa imindeni kaZera. Imindeni kaZera yafinyelela umuntu ngamuntu, kwathathwa inkosikazi kaZabdi.
Kwafika umndeni ka-Zabdi, umuntu ngamuntu; wathathwa uAkani unyana kaKarmi, unyana ka-Zabdi, unyana ka-Zeraha'i, wesizwe sikaYuda.
Wathi uYoshuwa ku-Akani, "Unyana wami, ngikucela ukuthi unqume ukubonga iNkosi, uNkulunkulu kaSirayeli, futhi unqume ukumhlonipha; khuluma ngalokho okwenze; ungangifihlanga.
Waphendula u-Akani uYoshuwa, wathi, Kweqiniso, ngifile kuYehova uNkulunkulu kaSirayeli; futhi ngakwenza njalo.

Ngabona phakathi kwazo zonke izinto ezithunyelwe, isigqoko esisha esivela eBhabheli, nesibhamu segolide esingamakhilogremu ayisishiyagalombili, nengilazi yesiliva engamakhulu amahlanu amakhilogramu; ngafuna ukuthatha lezi zinto, futhi zathathwa. Ngokuba zigcinwe emhlabathini enhliziyweni yami, igolide lingaphansi kwayo.
Wathumela uYoshuwa abathunywa, bahamba befika esitezi; kwabonakala ukuthi lifihlakele esitezi sakhe, nemali ingaphansi kwayo.
Bazithatha esitezi, bazisa kuYoshuwa, nakwamadodana kaSirayeli onke, bazibonela phambi koYehova.

Wathatha uYoshuwa u-Akani unyana kaZera, negolide, namabhulukwe, nesibhamu segolide, namadodana akhe, namakhosikazi akhe, nezimvu zakhe, nezinkomo zakhe, nezingulube zakhe, netente lakhe, nazo zonke izinto zakhe, waya eGolini lika-Akhore, yena noSirayeli bonke.
Wathi uYoshuwa, "Uyini lo monakalo owenzayo kuthina? UNkulunkulu uzokwenza umonakalo kuwe namuhla." Amadodakazi aseSirayeli wonke ayemshaya ngetshe; amanye amaSirayeli ayemshaya ngomlilo.
Bamisa phezu kwakhe umquba omkhulu wamatshe, kuze kube manje; wabuyela iNkosi emlilweni wakhe onamandla; ngakho kwabizwa igama lesi sifundazwe ngokuthi iGoli lika-Akhori, kuze kube ngalolu busuku.

Wathi iNkosi kuYoshuwa, Musa ukukhathazeka, ungabi nenhliziyo ebuhlungu; thola bonke abantu abahamba nawe, uye e-Ai; bona, ngikulethela phambi kwakho ukumkani wase-Ai, nabantu bakhe, nodolobha lakhe, nezwe lakhe.
Uzoyenza i-Ai nenkosi yayo, njengokuba wenza eJericho nenkosi yayo; kodwa namuhla uzoba nempahla yayo, nezilwane zayo, ukuze uzigcine wena; ubeke abantu ababhekene nawe emuva komzi.
UYoshuwa wamisa isandla sakhe, waya e-Ai, yena nomndeni wakhe wonke. Wakhetha uYoshuwa abantu abakhulu abangumakhulu amathathu, wabathumela ebusuku.
Wathi kubo, Nquma ukuthi nizifihla eduze kwedolobhana, futhi nilinde; ningase nihambe kude nalo; nihlale nihlelekile bonke.
Ngizonyuka ngifike kulo mzi, mina nemindeni yami yonke; futhi uma abantu base-Ai bephuma bezibhekana nathi, njengokuthi bakwenze ngaphambilini, sizobaleka phambi kwabo.
Bazothutha phambilina, kuze kube yilapho siwasusa emzini; ngoba bazothi, Baphuma phambi kwethu, njengaleso sikhathi sangaphambilini.
bese uphuma ezindaweni zakho ezifihlakeleyo, uthathe lo mzi; uNkulunkulu wakho, iNkosi, uzowunikela esandla sakho.
Uma sewuthathe lo mzi, uzowuphonsa emlilweni; ukwenze konke okushoyo iNkosi. Lokhu ngikuwisele umthetho ngalo.
Wabasusa uYoshuwa, basuka behamba. Baye ezindaweni zabo ezifihlakeleyo, bahlala phakathi kukaBhethele ne-Ai, ngasenyakatho ye-Ai; kodwa uYoshuwa waphumula ngaloo busuku phakathi kwabantu.
Wavuka uYoshuwa ekuseni, waqoqa abantu, waya e-Ai, yena nabaholi bakaSirayeli.
Wahamba wonke amadoda amakhulu, wafinyelela edolobhaneni, wamisa isibhedlela esisenyakatho ye-Ai; kwabe kukhona umfula phakathi kwabo nedolobha.
UYoshuwa wathatha abantu abangumakhulu amahlanu, wababeka emgodini phakathi kukaBhethele neAi, enyakatho yedolobha.
UJoshua waphuma ngaleyo busuku, waya efulethini. Amadodana kaJoshuwa ahlala endaweni yawo, iqembu eliphambili lisenyakatho yedolobha, kanti labo ababhekene nalo lisenyakatho.

Kwathi lapho ukumkani wase-Ai ebona khona lokhu, waphuma ngokushesha emveni kwemini, yena namadodana akhe wonke, ukubhekana nabaSirayeli, ezindaweni ezibhekene neGoli laseYorodani; awazi ukuthi kukhona abantu abafihlakele emuva komzi.
Wathi uYoshuwa, naye wonke amakhosi aseSirayeli, wacabanga ukuthi banqobiwe; waphuma waya esiqhingini.
Baphuma bonke abantu base-Ai, balandelana. Balandelela uYoshuwa, besuka emzini, babuyela ezweni labo.
Akukho muntu osele eHayi, noma eBhetheleli, ongaphumanga ngemuva kwaSirayeli; bashiya lo mzi uvulekile, belandela iSirayeli.
Wathi iNkosi kuYoshuwa, Nciphisa isibhamu esisesandlani sakho kuze kube yi-Ai; ngoba ngizosinika wena lo mzi. UYoshuwa waphakamisa isibhamu sakhe kuze kube yi-Ai.
Kwathi lapho ekwenzela khona lokhu, labo abafihlakele bavuka ngokushesha, baphuma befika enkabeni yedolobha, balimaza idolobha, balimaza umlilo.

Amadoda ase-Ayi abheka emuva, wabona ukuthi umphunga wedolobha unyuka ezulu; kwakungasekho ithuba labo lokuphuma ngaso sonke isikhathi; ngoba abantu bakaSirayeli abasuka ezweni laseGibhithe babuyela emuva.
UYoshuwa noSirayeli bonke bebona ukuthi labo ababhekene nabo bathathe lo mzi, futhi ukuthi umphunga uphuma kulo mzi; babuyela emuva, bahlasela abantu base-Ai.

Baphuma namadoda edolobhaneni labo, babhekana nabo; abantu base-Ayi babekwa phakathi kwabo, futhi amaSirayeli aye ngapha nangapha. Amakhosi aseSirayeli awabulala, kuze kube kungekho muntu ohlalayo, noma ongamshiya.
Kodwa ukumkani wase-Ai bawuthatha ephilayo, bamletha kuYoshuwa.

Uma isiSirayeli siqedile ukubulala bonke abantu base-Ai, ezindaweni zasemaphandleni, emhlabathini lapho bebengawalandela khona; futhi wonke umuntu washona ngeqhwa, sabuya isiSirayeli sonke sabuyela e-Ai, sabulala bonke abakhona kuyo.
Bafa ngalolusuku abantu abangu-12 amadoda nabesifazane, bonke abantu baseAi.
UYoshuwa akazange akhuphule isandla sakhe, ebesiphakamisa isibhamu sakhe, kuze kuphele wonke umuntu ohlala e-Ai.
Kodwa izinyoni, nempahla yedolobha labaSirayeli bayithathe yaba yibo; njengokuthi iNkosi wathi kuYoshuwa.
Wathi uYoshuwa wayala i-Ai, wayenza ibe yindawo elahlekile kuze kufike lemini.

Wabeka ukumkani wase-Ayi emgodini, wahlala khona kuze kube semini. Usuku luphela, uYoshuwa wabatshela ukuthi bathathe ikhanda lakhe, balifuthe emnyango wedolobhana, bakhiphe phezu kwalo inqwaba enkulu yamatshe, eyakhona namuhla.
Ngaleso sikhathi uYoshuwa wakwakha isibingelelo kuYehova, uNkulunkulu kaSirayeli, emfuleni i-Ebali,

njengoba uMoses umkhonzi kaYehova abewisela umthetho ngawo oonyana bakaSirayeli, (njengoba kubhalwa encwadini yomthetho kaMosis), isibingelelo samatshe agcwele, impahla yensimbi engangeni kuwo;kuba banikela phezu kwawo izipho zokuncibilika, nezibopho zokuthula kukaNkulunkulu.
Wabhala khona uYoshuwa incwadi yomthetho, owawubhalwe nguMoses, wabhalela ematsheni phambi kwamadodana kaSirayeli.

Wonke umndeni wakwaSirayeli, namadodakazi abo, nabaphathi babo, namajaji abo, behlala ngaso sonke isibambo sesivumelwano sikaYehova, ngaso sonke isibambo esibhekene nalaba bapristi baseLevi abathwala isibambo; ingxenye yabo yahlala eduze komfula iGerizim, nengxenye yabo yahlala eduze komfula i-Ebali. UMoses, umkhonzi kaYehova, wabatshela njalo, lapho abantu bakaSirayeli beqashwa khona.
Wafunda uYoshuwa wonke la mazwi omthetho, isipho sokubambisana nesilayezo, ngokwezinto ezibhalwe encwadini yomthetho.
Wafunda amazwi onke aMoses abewiselayo, akashiyenga lutho; wafunda kuwo wonke umhlangano wamaSirayeli, namabhishobhi, namadodakazi, nezingane, nezivakashi ezihlala phakathi kwabo.

Kwathi lapho bekubona bonke abavikeli enyakatho yeJordani, abavikeli ezindaweni eziphakeme, nabavikeli ezindaweni eziphansi, nalabo bonke abavikeli emfuleni omkhulu kuze kube yiLibanoni, abavikeli bamaHeti, nama-Amori, namaKanana, namaPerizi, namaHivi, namaJebusi.
Bahlangana ndawonye, bahlasela uYoshuwa nabaSirayeli.
Kwathi lapho abantu baseGibeoni beva ukuthi uYoshuwa wenzani eJerikho naseHayi,
Bathi: "Siyibona le nto, kodwa asikho isizathu sokuba siyibone." Bathi: "Akukho sizathu sokuba siyibone." Bathi: "Kulungile.
Bagqo vindebe elisha elinezinkinobho nezicathulo zakudala. Inyama yabo yonke yayimanzi futhi ikhula.
Bafika kuYoshuwa esiteji, eGalgali, bathi kuye namadodana aseSirayeli, Sivela ezweni elisendaweni ende; sicela ukwenzele isiqiniseko sokuthula.
Bathi amadoda aseSirayeli kuwo wonke la maHivi, Kungathi wena uhlala eduze kwethu; kungani sizokwenza umhlangano nawe?
Bathi kuYoshuwa, "Siyimi abakhonzi bakho." Wathi uYoshuwa kuye, "Ubani wena? Uvela kuphi?"
Bathi kuye, Sivela ezweni elide kakhulu thina abakhonzi bakho, ngenxa yegama likaYehova uNkulunkulu wakho; futhi sazi zonke izinto zakhe, nazo zonke izinto azenzayo eYiputa,
kanye nalokho akwenze kwabakumkani abangu-2 bama-Amori ngaphesheya kweJordani, uSihon ukumkani waseHeshboni, noOg ukumkani wakwaBashani, owahlala eAshtarothi.
Bathi nathi abaphathi bethu, nabantu bonke bezwe lethu, Nithatheni isiphuzo sokuhamba, nihambe nihlangane nabo, rauze ukuthi, Siyimikhonzi yenu; sicela niyenze sivumelwano nathi.
Lo mhluzi wawufudumele uma sawufaka ekhaya ngosuku lapho sisuka khona ukuze sifike kufike kuwe. Kodwa bona ukuthi ukhipheka kanjani futhi umnyama kangako manjero.
Lawa mabhodlela omnqumo ayesha lapho sawugcwalisa khona, kodwa bheka ukuthi aphukile kanjani. Amabhulukwe ethu nezicathulo zethu ziphukile ngenxa yohambo olude kakhulu."
Amadodakazi kaSirayeli athole ukudla kwabo, kodwa awabuza iNkosi ukuthi angakwenzani.
UYoshuwa wakwenza nabo isiqiniseko, wathi: "Sizobavumela ukuba baphile;" futhi abaphathi bezindlu zakwaSirayeli baphikisa ngokuthi bazoyigcina.
Ngosuku oluthathu ngemuva kokwenza lo mthetho, abaSirayeli bafunda ukuthi labo bantu babe yimindeni yabo.
Basuka ke oonyana bakaSirayeli, bafika emini yesithathu emizini yabo: eGibehoni, naseKefira, naseBherothi, naseKiriyati-yearimi.
Amadodakazi aseSirayeli akazange ahlasele, ngenxa yokuthi abaphathi babo babebaphikisa ngoNkulunkulu iNkosi, uNkulunkulu kaSirayeli; abantu bonke ke baphuca-phuca phezu kwabo.
Baphendula abaphathi, bathi, Sithe sabaphikisa ngeNkosi iNkosi uNkulunkulu kaSirayeli; ngakho-ke namuhla asikwazi ukuwashaya.
Sizokwenza lokhu: Sizobagcina bephila, ukuze kungase kuthuthele phezu kwethu inkohliso ka-Allaah ngenxa yobuxoki bethu.
Bathi labo abakhulu, Bahlale bephila. Baye babe ngamahhashi, nabahleli amanzi kubo bonke abantu, ngokwesinqumo salabo abakhulu;
UYoshuwa wababiza abantu baseGibheyoni, wathi kubo, Kungani na ukuthi nithi, Sihlala eduze kwenu? Nakho nihlala lapha phakathi kwethu.
Ngokuba manje niyindoda elahlekile; futhi kuzobe kukhona phakathi kwenu abakhonzayo, abavuna imithi, nabathwala amanzi ekhaya likaThixo wami.

Baphendula bathi kuYoshuwa, bethi, Ngokungafani nalokho okuthunyelwe kuthi, ukuthi iNkosi, uNkulunkulu wakho, wathi kuMoses, umkhonzi wakhe, ukuba aninike leli lizwe lonke, futhi ukuba aphelise bonke abantu balo, abasuka ezweni lenu; neze sikhathazekile kakhulu ngempilo yethu ngenxa yenu, sakwenza lokhu.
Ngokuba thina singaphansi kwesandla sakho; yenza nathi njengoba kubukeka sengathi kuyiqiniso kuwe.
Wakwenza njalo uYoshuwa, wabavikela phambi kwamadodana aseSirayeli, abawabulalanga.
Wathi uYoshuwa ngalolusuku lwawo, wabeka labo baseGibeboni ukuba babe ngamahhashi, nabenzi bamanzi abantu, nesihlalo sobukhosi sikaYehova, ezindaweni ezokhetha kuzo iNkosi, kuze kube yilapho.

Kwathi lapho uAdoni-zedeki, ukumkani waseYerusalem, ekwazi ukuthi uYoshuwa wathatha iAi, wayibulala ngokuphelele; njengoba akwenzele iJericho nokumkani wayo, njalo ayenzile iAi nokumkani wayo. Wathola futhi ukuthi abantu baseGibheyone bamisa uxolo nabaSirayeli, bahlala phakathi kwabo.
Wakhathazeka kakhulu, yena nomndeni wakhe; ngoba iGibeyon ibiyidolobha elikhulu, njengelinye lamadolobha asebukhosini, likhulu kunaye-Ai, futhi bonke abantu bayo babe ngamadoda amakhulu.
U-Adoni-zedekhi ukumkani waseYerusalem wathumela kuHoham ukumkani waseHebroni, noPiram ukumkani waseYarmuthi, noJaphia ukumkani waseLakishi, noDebiri ukumkani waseEgloni.
Wathi, Yeza, ningisize ngihlasele iGibehoni; ngoba yenze ukuthula noYoshuwa nabantwana bakaSirayeli.
Baphuma ke abaphathi bama-Amori ababili, abaphathi baseYerusalem, nabaseHebroni, nabaseYarmuthi, nabaseLakishi, nabaseEgloni, nabo bonke amabutho abo, bahlanganisana, bahlasela iGibheyon.

Bathumela abantu baseGibeoni kuYoshuwa esibhedlela eGalgali, bethi, "Ungayishiya isandla sakho emkhondweni wakho; ndiza ngokushesha usindise nathi, usizakale nathi, ngoba bonke abavikeli baka-Amori abahlala emadolobheni asezindulini bahlanganisana nathi."
Waphuma uYoshuwa eGileyadi, yena nomndeni wakhe wonke, nabo bonke abantu bakhe abakhulu.
Wathi iNkosi kuYoshuwa, Musa ukukhathazeka ngabo; ngoba ngibamise esandla sakho; akukho muntu kubo ozokwazi ukumelana nawe.
UYoshuwa waphuma eGilgal, wahamba yonke ibusuku, wabathatha ngaso sonke isikhathi.
UYehova wabaphazamisa phambi kwaSirayeli; bahlasela kakhulu eGibehoni, bewalandela ngendlela yokuya eBhetho-horoni, bababulala kuze kube yi-Azeka ne-Makeditha.

Baphuma ezweni laseSirayeli, besuka eBhethoroni, iNkosi wabathulisa phezu kwabo imvula enkulu yeqhwa kusukela emkhathini, kuze kube se-Azeka; bafa. Abafile ngenxa yeqhwa babeningi kunabo abafile ngesandla samaSirayeli.

UYoshuwa wakhuluma kuYehova ngosuku lapho iNkosi enikela khona ama-Amori phambi kwamadodana kaSirayeli, wathi phambi kwamadodana kaSirayeli onke: "Ilanga, hlala phansi phezu kweGibehoni; inyanga, hlala phansi phezu koLwandle lwe-Ajaloni."

Ilanga lahlala khona, nenyanga yahlala khona, kuze kube yilapho isizwe sinqobe ubuxoki bayo. Lokhu kubhalwe encwadini ka-Yashar. Ilanga lahlala phakathi kwesibhakabhaka, lilinde usuku oluphelele ngaphambi kokuphuma.
Akubekho usuku olufana nalo, ngaphambi kwalo, noma ngemuva kwalo, lapho iNkosi ephulaphule khona ingoma yomuntu njengaleyo; ngoba iNkosi wayebhekana noSirayeli.
Wabuyela uYoshuwa, naye wonke amaSirayeli, esitezi esiphakeme eGilgal.
Ke kaloku labo bukhosi abahlanu baphuma, bafihlakela embuzweni waseMakeda.
Kwathi kwathunyelwe uYoshuwa, kwathiwa: Abakumkani abahlanu bafunwa befihlakele emgodini eMakedha.
Wathi uYoshuwa, Nciphisani amatshe amakhulu emlonyeni wale ngobo, nibeke khona abantu ukuba bagcine.
Kodwa-ke, musa ukuphumula; landelani izitha zenu, nihlasele ezinyaweni zabo; ningaze nizivumele zifike emizini yabo; ngoba iNkosi uNkulunkulu wenu wazisa esandlani.
UYoshuwa namadodana kaSirayeli bahlasela ngamandla amakhulu, baphoqeleka ukuba bangabikho. Abambalwa abaphilayo babuyela emizini yabo enezindlu zangasese.
Baye bonke abantu babuyela kuYoshuwa esiteji, eMakeda, bephephile; kwakungekho muntu owaziyo lutho ngamadodana aseSirayeli.
Wathi uYoshuwa, Vula umlomo wale ngobo, niziveze kum labo bamabukhosi abanguhlanu.
Bathi ke, bathathe labo madodana amahlanu besuka emgodini: amakhosi aseJerusalema, ne-Hebrone, noYarmuthi, naLakishi, naEgloni.

Kwathi, lapho baphuma khona labo bakwaSirayeli kuye uJoshua, wabiza wonke amadoda aseSirayeli, wathi kubo abaphathi bemikhosi ababehamba naye: "Njimani nibeke izinyawojeli zenu ezinyaweni zalabo ababingeleli." Bafika ke, babeka izinyawojeli zabo ezandleni zawo.
Wathi kubo uYoshuwa, Musani ukukhathazeka, noma ukuba nenhliziyo ebuhlungu; zinikele, nibe nothando olukhulu; ngoba lokhu kuzokwenza iNkosi ngazo zonke izitha zenu ongazinqoba.
UYoshuwa wahlasela labo bukhosi, wababulala, wababopha emathinini amane; babebopha emathinini kuze kube semini.

futhi, lapho ilanga liphuma, uJoshua wamisa ukuba bathathwe ngezansi izihlahla, futhi wabeka kubo emgodini lapho babefihle khona. futhi, amatshe amakhulu abekwe phezu umlomo womgodini, futhi kukhona kuze kube manje.

Wathatha uYoshuwa iMakedha ngalolusuku, wabulala ukumkani wayo ngeqhwa, naye wonke umuntu ohlala kulo mzi, wamqubula ngokuphelele; akazange ashiye noma ngubani ophilayo. Wakwenza kukumkani weMakedha njengokuba wayekwenze kukumkani waseJericho.
Wahamba uYoshuwa, naye wonke amaSirayeli, esuka eMakedha waya eLibna, wahlasela.

UYehova wanikela iLibna nenkosi yayo esandla sakwaSirayeli; uYoshuwa wabulala wonke umuntu ohlala kulo mzi ngeqhwa, akazange ashiye lutho oluphilayo. Wakwenza ukumkani walo njengoba wayekwenze kumkani waseJericho.
Wahamba uYoshuwa, naye wonke amaSirayeli, eLibna waya eLakishi, wamisa isibhedlela phezu kwayo, wahlasela.
Wabeka iNkosi iLakishi esandleni sakwaSirayeli; uYoshuwa wayithatha ngosuku olulandelayo, wabulala wonke umuntu ohlala kuyo ngeqhwa, ngokwezinto zonke azenzayo eLibna.
Ngaleso sikhathi uHoram, ukumkani waseGezeri, waya eLakishi ukusiza; kodwa uYoshuwa wamshaya yena nomndeni wakhe, akazange amshiye umuntu.
Wadlula uYoshuwa, naye wonke amaSirayeli, kusuka eLakishi waya eEgloni, wamisa isibhedlela phezu kwayo, wahlasela.
Bayithatha ngalolusuku olulodwa, babulala wonke umuntu okhona ngeqhwa; uYoshuwa wayisaphazamisa ngokugcwele, njengoba wayeyenze eLakishi.
Waphuma uYoshuwa, naye wonke amaSirayeli, eEgloni waya eHebroni, wahlasela.

Bayithatha, babulala ukumkani wayo, nalabo bonke abakhona kuyo, namabhishi ayo, ngeqhwa; akazange ashiye umuntu ophilayo, njengoba bekwenze ku-Egloni; bayenze ibe yindawo engcwele, nayo yonke into ekhona.
Wabuyela uYoshuwa, naye wonke amaSirayeli, wahlasela iDebiri.

Bawuthatha lo mzi, nokumkani wakhe, namadolobhana akhe; babulala wonke umuntu ohlala kuwo ngeqhwa; akazange ashiye noma ngubani. UYoshuwa wenza kuDebiri nokumkani wayo njengokuthi wakwenza eHebroni, neLibna nokumkani wayo.

UYoshuwa wahlasela izwe lonke, indawo entaba-mlilo, neNtshonalanga enyakatho, nezindawo ezisempumalanga, neziqhingi, nazo zonke iziphathimandla zazo; akazange ashiye umuntu ophilayo, wabulala konke okuphefumulayo, njengoba iNkosi, uNkulunkulu kaSirayeli, abewisela umthetho.
Wawahlasela uYoshuwa kusukela eKadeshe-barnea kuya eGaza, nezwe lonke laseGosheni, kuze kube eGibeyon.
UYoshuwa wahlasela labo bonke abavikeli kanye nezwe labo ngasikhathi sinye; ngoba iNkosi, uNkulunkulu kaSirayeli, wayebhekana noSirayeli.
Wabuyela uYoshuwa, naye wonke amaSirayeli, esitezi esiphakeme eGilgal.
UYabini ukumkani waseHazori, ekubona lokhu, wathumela kuYobhabhi ukumkani waseMadoni, nakumkani baseShimroni, nakumkani baseAkshaphi, wathi,
nakwabavukeli abasemadolobheni asenyakatho, ezindaweni ezisempumalanga yeJordani, ngaphesheya kolwandle lwaseGaliliya, nasezindaweni ezisenyakatho-ntshonalanga, nasezindaweni zaseDori ngasenyakatho.
Wathumela nakwa-Kanana enyakatho nentshonalanga, nakwa-Amori, nakwa-Hethi, nakwa-Perizi, nakwa-Yebhusi ezindaweni eziphakeme, nakwa-Hivi ngezansi komfula iHermon, endaweni yaseMizpa.
Baphuma nabo yonke imikhosi yabo, inqwaba enkulu yamabhishobhi, efana nezingcezu zeqhwa ezisentshonalanga yolwandle; namabhayisikili namahhashi amakhulu.
Lawa mabukhosi onke ahlangana, wamisa isibhedlela ezindaweni ezingaphansi kwamanzi aseMerom, ukubhekana noSirayeli.

Wathi iNkosi kuYoshuwa, Ungabakhathazeki ngenxa yabo; ngoba ngoMsombuluko ngalolu sikhathi ngizowanikela bonke abafileyo phambi kwamadodana aseSirayeli. Izikebhe zabo uzozibopha izinyawo, nezithuthuthu zabo uzozishisa ngamanzi.
Wafika ke uYoshuwa, naye wonke amakhosi akhe, ngaso sonke isikhashana kubo ezindaweni zamanzi aseMeromu, wahlasela.

Wabanikela iNkosi esandla sakwaSirayeli. Bawahlasela, babalandela kuze kube yiSidon enkulu, neMisrephothi-mayim, naphezu kweGoli laseMizpa; babulala bonke abahlala kuyo, abazange bashiye muntu ophilayo.
Wathi uYoshuwa kubo, njengokuthi iNkosi kuye: izikebhe zabo wazenza zinemilenze emide, futhi izithuthuthu zabo wazenza zinemlilo.
Kusukela lapho uYoshuwa wabuyela, wahlasela iHazori, wabulala ukumkani wayoyo ngeqhwa; ngoba uHazori ube yinhloko yalezi zizwe zonke.gorha.
Bawubulala wonke umuntu ogwini lwesibhakabhaka, bawuphelisa ngokuphelele; akukho lutho oluphilayo lwahlala khona; futhi uYoshuwa washiswa iHazori.
UYoshuwa wathatha zonke lezi zifundazwe, namadodakazi azo, wababulala ngeqhwa, wabasusa ngaso sonke isikhathi, njengoba uMoses umkhonzi kaYehova abewisela umthetho.
Kodwa-ke, imiphakathi yamaSirayeli eyakhiwa phezu kwezimpophoma zawo, ayikho eye yashiswa yiSirayeli, ngaphandle kweHazori; uYoshuwa wawushisa.
Impahla yonke yalezi zifunda, nenyama yabo bonke abantu bayo, bayithatha yaba yimali yabo; kodwa wonke umuntu wababulala ngesandla sekhephu, kuze kube wukuphela kwento ephilayo, bengayishiya.
Wathi iNkosi kuMosis, umkhonzi wakhe, ukuthi akwenze njalo; wathi uMosis kuye uYoshuwa, futhi uYoshuwa wabaphulaphule. Akukho lutho lwazo zonke izinto awawiselayo iNkosi uMoses.

Wathatha uYoshuwa leli lizwe lonke, indawo entaba-mlilo, nezweni lonke laseNtshonalanga, nezwe lonke laseGosheni, nezindawo eziphansi, neGoli leJordani, nendawo entaba-mlilo yamaSirayeli nezindawo zayo eziphansi,
kusukela emfuleni iHalaka, ohamba eSeiri, kuze kube nguBaali-Gadi, ensimini yaseLibanoni ngezansi komfula uHermon; wathatha bonke abaphathi babo, wababulala.
Ngosuku olude uYoshuwa wabhekana nabo bonke abaphathi.
Akukho mzi owodwa owenza uxolo nabaSirayeli, ngaphandle kwabaHivi abahlala eGibehoni. AbaSirayeli bathatha wonke la madolobha ngempi.
UYehova wabacindezela intliziyo yabo, bahlasela amaSirayeli, ukuze aboshwe ngokuphelele, bangabi nesondlo, njengoba iNkosi abewisela umthetho uMosese.
Ngaleso sikhathi uYoshuwa waya, wasusa ama-Anakhi emadolobheni amahle, eHebroni, naseDebiri, naseAnabi, namadolobheni amahle aseYuda, naseSirayeli onke; uYoshuwa wabaphazamisa ngazo zonke izizwe.
Akukho okunye okushiwo ngama-Anakhi ezweni lakwaSirayeli, ngaphandle kweGaza, neGathi, neAshdodi.
Wathatha uYoshuwa izwe lonke, njengokuthi iNkosi kwathi kuMoses; wabanika uYoshuwa amaSirayeli izwe labo, ingxenye yabo, ngokwesizwe sawo. Izwe laphumula empilweni.

Nalaba bamakhosi ezweni labo, abasolwa ngamadodana kaSirayeli ngaleso siqhingi saseYorodani, ngasenyakatho-mpumalanga, abathathe izwe labo, kusukela emfuleni uArnoni kuya emfuleni uHermon, nezindawo zonke ezisempumalanga yesiqhingi seJordani:

uSihon, ukumkani wama-Amori, owahlala eHeshboni; wayelawula kusukela eAroeri, okungenani kwengubo ka-Arnon, naphakathi kwengubo, nengxenye yeGiliyadi, kuya emfuleni iYabhoki, umkhawulo wamadodana a-Amoni.
Walawula futhi umfula waseJordani osentshonalanga, kusukela emfuleni weGalili kuya eMfuleni Wokufa, kuze kube yiBethi-yeshimothi, nakwesokunxele eduze kwePisga.
Bathathe futhi izwe lika-Ogi ukumkani waseBhashani, owesifazane wesifazane, owahlala eAshtarothi noEdrei.
Wayelawula intaba iHermon, neSaleka, noBashan wonke, kuze kube yisiphezu seGeshuri neMaaka, naphezu kwengxenye kaGiliyadi, kuze kube yisiphezu kaSihon ukumkani waseHeshboni.
UMosis, umkhonzi kaYehova, nabantwana bakaSirayeli babewahlasela; uMosis, umkhonzi kaYehova, wabanika izwe labo labaRubheni, nabaGadi, nengxenye yesizwe sikaManase, ibe yindawo yabo.

Nalaba bamakhosi abawahlasela uYoshuwa namadodana kaSirayeli ngasenyakatho yeJordani, kusukela eBaali-Gadi emfuleni waseLibanoni kuze kube yilapho intaba iHalaka, enyukela eSeiri. UJoshua wabanika isizwe sakwaSirayeli indawo yabo yaba yinkontileka yazo;

Ihlanganisa izwe eliphakeme, nezindawo eziphansi zasenyakatho, nofula laseYorodani, neziqhingi zezulu, nesiqhingi samanzi abandayo, neNtshonalanga, izwe lamaHithi, nama-Amori, nama-Kananani, namaPerizi, namaHivi, namaJebusi.
ukumkani waseJericho, owodwa; ukumkani wase-Ai, eBetheli, owodwa;
ukumkani waseYerusalem, owodwa; ukumkani waseHebroni, owodwa;
ukumkani waseYarmuthi, owodwa; ukumkani waseLakishi, owodwa;
ukumkani wase-Egloni, owodwa; ukumkani waseGezeri, owodwa;
ukumkani waseDebiri, owodwa; ukumkani waseGeder, owodwa;
ukumkani waseHorma, owodwa; ukumkani waseAradi, owodwa;
ukumkani waseLibna, owodwa; ukumkani waseAdulamu, owodwa;
ukumkani waseMakeda, owodwa; ukumkani waseBhethele, owodwa;
ukumkani waseTaphua, owodwa; ukumkani waseHepher, owodwa;
ukumkani wase-Afeki, owodwa; ukumkani waseLasaroni, owodwa;
ukumkani waseMadoni, owodwa; ukumkani waseHazori, owodwa;
ukumkani waseShimron, uMeron, owodwa; ukumkani waseAkshaphu, owodwa;
ukumkani waseTaanakhi, owodwa; ukumkani waseMegido, owodwa;
ukumkani waseKedesh, owodwa; ukumkani waseYokneamu eKarmeli, owodwa;
ukumkani waseDori, ezindaweni eziphakeme zeDori, omunye; ukumkani wamaGoyim eGalgali, owodwa;
ubukhosi baseThirsa, omunye; kwabakho bonke abaholi abathathu nambili.
Kwathi lapho uYoshuwa eneminyaka emikhulu, ehlala iminyaka emininzi, iNkosi wathi kuye, Ubaba, namuhla ubudala kakhulu, futhi izwe lisele liningi ukulinqoba;
Le yilizwe elisele, yonke imiphakathi yamaFilisti, namaGeshuri;

kusukela emfuleni i-Shihori, esiqhingini saseYiputa esisenyakatho kuze kube yisiqhingi se-Ekrona, esihlanganiswe njengezwe lakwaKananani. Kuhlanganisa nelizwe labaphathi beFilistijeli abahlanu eGaza, naseAshdodi, naseAshkeloni, naseGathi, nase-Ekroni, kanye nomhlaba wamaAvithi
Kwathi enyakatho-mpumalanga, izwe lonke lakwaKanana, kusukela eAraha, eliyindawo yamaSidoni, kuze kube yi-Afeki, kanye nesiqhingi sama-Amoreti;
futhi izwe labaseGibaleni, neLibanoni yonke enyakatho-mpumalanga, kusukela eBhaali-Gadi ngezansi komfula iHermon, kuze kube seHamati.

Ngizowasusa bonke abahlala emadolobheni amahle, kusukela eLibanoni kuze kube yiMisrephothi-mayim, wonke amaSidoni; ngizowakhipha phambi kwamadodana kaSirayeli; uqiniseke ukuthi ngizobanika izwe labaSirayeli njengempahla yabo, njengoba ngikutshele.
Ngakho manje uhlukanise leli lizwe phakathi kwezizwe eziyisishiyagalombili, nengxenye yesizwe sikaManase.
Ingxenye yamadodana kaManase, uRubhene noGadi, bathathe izwe, labo uMosis wabanike lona ngaphesheya koMfula iYorodani; uMosis, umkhonzi kaNkulunkulu, wabanika lona.
Kusuka e-Aroere, enhliziyweni yomfula i-Arnoni, nedolobhana eliphakathi komfula, nalapho kungena khona yonke intaba yase-Medeba, kuze kube yiDiboni;
kanye namadolobha onke kaSihon, ukumkani wama-Amori, owahlala eHeshboni, kuze kube yisiqhingi sama-Amoni.
futhi iGiliyadi, nomhlaba wamaGeshuri, namaMaaka, yonke intaba kaHermon, neBashana lonke, kuze kube yiSaleka;
izwe lonke lika-Ogi eBhashani, owahlala eAshtarathi noEdrei. Wabe ngumunye walabo abashisayo, uMoses wayewahlasela, wabasusa emazweni abo.
Amadodana kaSirayeli akazange akhuphule abantu baseGeshuri nabaseMahaka; bahlala phakathi kwamadodana kaSirayeli kuze kube yimanje.
Kodwa isizwe sakwaLevi uMoses asikubenisile ingxenye; izipho ezishiswayo zikaYehova, uNkulunkulu kaSirayeli, ziyingxenye yabo, njengoba wathi kubo.
Lokho wukuthi uMoses awanikeze isizwe sakwaRubheni, ngokwemindeni yabo:
Isifundazwe sabo saqala e-Aroere, esisenyakatho yeGoli le-Arnoni, nedolobhana eliphakathi kweGoli le-Arnoni, naleyo ndawo ibandayo yonke eya eMedebha;
kuze kube yiHeshboni, nezifunda zayo zonke eziseduze, ezindaweni zesihlabathi, iDiboni, neBamoth-bhaali, neBeth-bhaali-meoni,
neYahazi, neKedemothi, neMefaathi,
neKiriyatayim, neSibhama, neZerethe-shahari, emfuleni ophakeme,
iBhethe-peori, nezingqimba zePisga, neBhethe-jesimothi.

Nawo wonke amadolobhana ase-Ela, nezwe lonke likaSihon ukumkani wama-Amori, owahlala eHeshboni; ngoba uMoses wahlasela uSihon, nabaholi bakaMidiyani: uEvhi, noRekem, noZure, noHuri, noRebha, abaphathi belizwe, ababesebenza kuSihon.
Babulala noBhileham, unyana ka-Beore, owenza izimanga, ngeqhwa, phakathi kwalabo abafileyo.
Nasenyakatho yesifundazwe sakwaRubheni kwakunguMfula iYorodani. Lezo zidolobhana nezindawo zazo zaba yindawo yomndeni kaRubheni, ngokwemindeni yawo.
Lokho wukuthi uMoses awanikeze isizwe sikaGadi, ngokwemindeni yawo:
Izwe labo lakunguYaseri, namadolobha onke eGiliyadi, nengxenye yezwe lama-Amoni, kuze kube yi-Aroeri elibhekene neRabha.
Yasuka eHeshboni yafika eRamathi-mipha, neBethonim; yasuka eMahanayim yafika emfuleni waseDebiri.

Ezweni laseGibhithe kwakukhona iBeth-harama, neBeth-nimra, neSukhothi, neZaphoni, konke okushiwo nguShehonu ukumkani waseHeshboni. Umkhawulo wayo onyakatho wawunguYorodani, kuze kube yilapho ulwandle lwaseGalilia luphele khona, enyakatho yeJordani.
Lezi ziyidolobhana, nezifundela zazo, ezinikezelwe isizwe sakwaGadi ngokwemindeni yawo.
Lokho wukuthi uMoses awanikeze isizukulwane esisodwa sakwaManase, ngokwemindeni yabo:
Umhlaba wabo wawusuka eMahanayim, waya kuwo wonke uBhashani, lonke izwe lika-Og ukumkani waseBhashani, nazo zonke izifunda zaseYairi ezinguBhashani, ziyizindawo eziyisishiyagalombili.
Ingxenye yeGiliyadi, kanye ne-Ashtarothi ne-Edreyi, imiphakathi yobukhosi ka-Og eBhashani, yanikezwa izingane zikaMakhi unyana kaManase, izingane zesigamu sabantwana bakaMakhi ngokwemindeni yabo.
