Le lizwe uMoses walihlukanise, ezindaweni ezisempumalanga zakwaMowabi, ngaphesheya komfula iYorodani eJericho.
Kodwa isizwe sakwaLevi, uMoses akayinika indawo; iNkosi, uNkulunkulu kaSirayeli, ungumzabalazo wabo, njengoba wathi kubo.

Wathi ke uMosis, ekhuluma ku-Israyeli, wathi: "Izwe laseKanana lahlukaniswa phakathi kwabaSirayeli; uEleazaru umpristi, noYoshuwa unyana kaNune, nabaholi bezindlu zakwababa babo, bahlukanise phakathi kwabo.
Bathi, "Sizothola izwe ngesandla sethu," njengoba iNkosi abewisela umthetho ngoMosesi; banikela ngezandla zabo.
UMoses wabanika isizwe esisodwa nesishiyagalombili imindeni yabo, enyakatho-mpumalanga yeYorodani; kodwa kwabaLevi uMosis akazange abanike phakathi kwabo.
AbaLevi abazange babe nengxenye ezweni, kodwa babenezifunda zokuhlala kuzo, nezifundela zazo ezibhekene nazo, ezakhiwe ngezilwane zabo nasezimpahla zabo.
Bahlukanise ke amadodana aseSirayeli izwe, njengoba iNkosi abewisela umthetho uMoses.
Bafike abantu baseYuda kuYoshuwa eGalgali; wathi kuye uKalebe, unyana kaJefune, umKenizi: Uyazi into ebeyikhuluma ngayo iNkosi kuMoses, indodana kaThixo, ngawe nami, eKadesi-barnea.

Ngineminyaka emashumi mane ngineminyaka, lapho uMoses, umkhonzi kaYehova, engumthumela khona kusuka eKadeshe-bar "iBarnea" ukuba ngibone izwe; ngabuya ngikhuluma ngeqiniso, njengoba kwakuyiqiniso emiphefumlweni yami.
Kwathi labo abaye bahamba nami, babangela ukuthi inhliziyweni yabantu ibe buhlungu; kodwa mina ngalandela iNkosi uNkulunkulu wami ngenhlonipho yami yonke.
Wathi uMosis kuye ngalolu suku, ukuthi: "Izwe olubophele kulo lizobe likhona kuwe, nabantwana bakho, rauya; ngoba usulandela iNkosi uNkulunkulu wami ngenhliziyo yakho yonke.

Ngabona ukuthi iNkosi ungigcine ngiphila iminyaka emashumi mane anesihlanu, njengoba wathi, kusukela kuleso sikhathi akhuluma ngaso kuMosese, lapho amaSirayeli ehamba esiqhingini; manje ngineminyaka eyishumi nesishiyagalombili nesihlanu.
Ngiyaqhubeka nginamandla njengaleso sikhathi lapho uMoses ethumela khona, futhi manje ngizokwazi ukuphuma empilweni yami, njengokuba ngangikhona nalapho.

Ngiyakucela, nginike le ndawo entaba-mlilo, iNkosi awathi ngami ngalolusuku; ngoba sekuyiqiniso ukuthi usazi ukuthi kukhona khona abantu bakaAnaki, nezifunda ezinkulu ezinezindlu zangasese; kodwa ngizowasusa ngesandla soNkulunkulu, njengoba esho.
UYoshuwa wabambisa uKalebe unyana kaJefune, wamnika iHebroni ibe yindawo yakhe.
Ngaleyo ndlela iHebroni yaba ngu Kalebu, unyana kaJefune, umKenizi, kuze kube manje; ngoba wayelandela iNkosi, uNkulunkulu wakwaSirayeli, ngenhliziyo yakhe yonke.
Igama lika-Hebron kwakunguKirihati-arba, ngegama lika-Arba, indodana ka-Anaki; khona-ke izwe laphumula empilweni.
Izwe elinikezwa isizwe sakwaYuda, ngokwemindeni yawo, lifike enyakatho-ntshonalanga kuya emfuleni iEdomu, kuze kube yisiqhingi sikaZini, engxenyeni esempumalanga.
Umgwaqo wabo wasenyakatho uqala engxenyeni esenyakatho ye-Ocean Dead, ebhishi elibheke eningizimu.
wadlula enyakatho-ntshonalanga yeSkorpion Pass, waya eZin, wafika enyakatho-ntshonalanga yeKadesh Barnea, wadlula eHezron, wafika eAdar, wajika waya eKarka.
Wadlula e-Azmoni, walandela umfula. Yaphela emfuleni. Lo mkhawulo ube yimikhawulo yabo yasenyakatho.
Umkhawulo wasenyakatho ube yiMfula oMfushane, kuze kube yimpuphu yeJordani. Umkhawulo wasentshonalanga wawuqala ebhishi laselwandle lapho iJordani iphuma khona.
wanyuka waya eBeth-hogla, wadlula eBeth-arabha ngasenyakatho, waya esitsheni sikaBohani unyana kaRubhen.
wadlula eDebiri, wasuka emfuleni i-Akhore, wabuyela ngasenyakatho waya eGalgali, obhekene nebanga eliphakeme le-Adummim, elasenyakatho yomfula; wadlula emanzini ase-En-shemesi, waphela e-En-rogeli.

Kusukela lapho umkhawulo unyuka waya emfuleni ka-Ben Hinnom, enyakatho yedolobha laseJebhusi elibizwa ngokuthi yiJerusalema; wafika esiphethweni somfula waseHinnom osesiqhingini saseNfensivi ngaseningizimu.
Kusuka phezulu komfula, umkhawulo wahamba waya emfuleni waseNeftoha, waya emadolobheni aseNtaba ka-Ephron, wehla waya eBhala (leyo yiKiriyati-yearimi).
Yasuka eBhala, yabuyela ngasenyakatho, ifike emfuleni uSeyiri; yadlula enkabeni yasenyakatho yomfula iYearimi (yena uKeshaloni), yawela eBhethe-shemesi, yadlula eTimna.
wadlula engxenyeni yasenyakatho ye-Ekroni, wehla waya eShikereni, wadlula emfuleni iBaala, wafika eYabneel, waphela elwandle.
Lo mkhawulo wasenyakatho usuka enkabeni yolwandle olukhulu. Lo mkhawulo waba yimiphakathi yamadodana kaYuda, ejikeleze izwe, ngokwemindeni yawo.
UYehova wamnika uKhalebe, unyana kaJefune, umfelokazi phakathi kwamadodana kaYuda, iKiriyati-arba (leyo yiHebroni), uArba owayengubaba kaAnaki, njengoba iNkosi abewisela umthetho uYoshuwa.
UKalebe wakhipha eHebrone abaAnaki abathathu: uSheshai, noAhimana, noTalmai, izingane zika-Anaki.
Waphuma khona, wahlasela labo abahlala eDebiri (igama layo kwakunguKiriyati-seferi).
Wathi uKalebe, Uma umuntu ehlasela iKiriyati-seferi, bese uyithatha, ngizomunika intombi yami iAksha ukuba ngumkakhe.
Wayinqoba uOthniyeli, indodana kaKenazi, umngane kaKalebe; ke kaloku uKalebe wamnika inkosikazi yakhe i-Aksha ukuba ibe ngumkakhe.
Wayefika ku-Othniyeli, wamangalisa ubaba wakhe ukuthi afune indawo yokulima. Waphuma enyangeni yakhe, wathi kuye uKalebe, Ufuna yini?
Wathi yena kuye, Ungisize; ngoba ungisizile izwe elinabantu abaningi, nginikeze futhi izimpophoma zamanzi " . Ke kalobe wamnika izimpophoma eziphezulu nezimpophoma ezisephansi.
Lokho wumhlaba owanikezwa isizwe sakwaYuda, ngokwemindeni yawo.
Nasenyakatho, ngaphesheya komfula i-Edom, kwakukhona amadolobha abo: uKabseyeli, noEdere, noYagure,
iKina, neDimona, neAdada,
noKedeshe, noHasoro, noIthnani,
uZiphe, noTelemem, noBealothi,
iHazori-hadatha, neKeriyothi-hezroni, leyo yiHazori;
uHaman, noShema, noMolada,
uHazari Gadda, noHeshmoni, noBethe-pelethi,
uHazari-shuali, noBeershebha, neBiziyothiya,
noBhala, noIyim, noEzem,
uEltoladi, noKeshili, noHorma,
iSikelage, neMadmana, neSansana,
iLebhaothi, neShilhimu, neAyini, neRimoni; zonke izidolobhana zazimashumi mabini nanye nezifundazwe zawo.
Ezindaweni eziphansi zasenyakatho kwakuyi-Eshtaoli, neZora, neAshna,
iZanoa, neEnganimu, neTaphuwa, neEnamu,
neJarmuthi, neAdulami, neSokho, ne-Azeka,
iShaaraim, ne-Adithaim, neGedera (igama layo nguGederothayim), izidolobhana ezilishumi elinamihlanu nezifunda zawo.
futhi uZenan, noHadasha, noMigdali-Gadi,
neDilihane, neMizpa, neYokteyeli,
neLakishi, neBozkhathi, neEgloni,
i-Kabbon, i-Lahmas, ne-Kitlish,
neGederoti, neBhethe-dagoni, neNaama, neMakedha: izidolobhana ezilishumi elinamihlanu nezifunda zawo.
futhi iLibna, ne-Ether, ne-Ashan,
Iphtah, Ashnah, Nezib,
iKeyila, ne-Akzib, ne-Maresha: amadolobhana ayisishiyagalombili namabhishi awo.
Kwathi u-Ekron, namadolobhana awo, nezifunda zayo,
futhi konke okusenyakatho ye-Ekroni, eduze ne-Ashdodi, nezifundazwe zawo.
futhi iAshdodi, namadolobha ayo, nezifundela zayo; neGaza, namadolobha ayo, nezifundela zayo, kuze kube ufula lwaseMisri, nolwandle olukhulu.
Ezweni lezintaba kwakunguShamir, noJattir, noSokho,
neDana, neKiriyati-sana (leyo yiDebiri),
u-Anabhe, no-Eshtemohi, no-Anime,
iGosheni, neHolon, neGilohi: amadolobhana alishumi elinanye namabhishi awo.
bese iArabhu, neDumah, neEshan,
neJanim, neBeth-tappuah, neAfeka,
iHumetha, neKiriyati-arba (leyo yiHebroni), noSihore: imiphakathi eyisishiyagalombili nezifundela zazo.
futhi uMaoni, noKarmeli, noZipho, noJutha,
neJezreyeli, neYokdeyam, neZanoa,
iKayini, neGibeha, neTimna: izidolobhana ezilishumi nezifunda zawo.
futhi uHalule, noBeth-zur, noGedori,
Kwaba khona amadolobhana ayisishiyagalombili nezifundazwe zazo.
futhi iKiriyati-bhaali, (leyo yiKiriyati-yearimi), neRabha: izifundazwe ezimbili nezifundela zazo.
Esiqhingini kwakunguBeth-Arabha, noMiddin, noSekakah,
I-Nibshan, nedolobhana le-Salt, ne-En Gedi: amadolobhana ayisishiyagalombili namabhishi abo.
Kodwa abakwa-Yebhusi, abahlali eYerusalem, abangawasusanga amadodana kaYuda; ngakho amaJebushi ayehlala phakathi kwamadodana kaYuda eYerusalem kuze kulesi sikhathi.

Umhlaba wabo umndeni kaYosefu wawusuka emfuleni iJordani, ngaseJericho, enyakatho-ntshonalanga yamanzi aphumayo aseJericho; wanyuka waya eJirekhi, waya esiqhingini nezindawo eziphakeme, waya eBhetheli.
Kusuka eBhetheleli, (leyo yiLuzi), kwadlula ezweni lama-Arhithi kuya ku-Atara.
wadlula ezweni lamaJaflethi, enyakatho-mpumalanga, waya eBeth-horoni eseningizimu, waya eGezeri, waphela emfuleni.
UManase noEphrayim, izingane zikaYosefu, bathathe izwe labo.
Le yindawo yama-Ephrayi, ngokwemindeni yabo; umkhawulo wabo enyakatho wawusuka ku-Ataroth Addar waya eBethoroni ophezulu,
Kusuka eMikmetathi, ngasenyakatho, waya emazweni asempumalanga, waya eTaanathi-shilo, wadlula kuwo, wafika eJanoa, ngasempumalanga.
Wakhuphuka eYanoa waya e-Ataroti neNaara, wafika eJericho, waphuma eJordani.
NgaseTaphua, umkhawulo usuka enyakatho waya emfuleni iKanaha, waphela elwandle. Lowo ngumhlaba wesizwe sikaEphrayim, ngokwemindeni yawo.
Wazihlanganisa namadolobha onke, namadolobhana, ahlukaniswe uEphrayim, ezweni likaManase.
Abakanani abahlala eGezeri, abazange bazikhuphe; behlala iKanana phakathi kwamadodana ka-Ephrayi kuze kulesi sikhathi; baphinde babe yimisebenzi yomsebenzi.
Lolu mhlaba wabekwa isizwe sikaManase, umzali kaYosefu. UMakhire ubaba kaGileyadi, umzali kaManase; ngoba imindeni kaMakhire ibiyimikhosi enamandla kakhulu, yathola iGileyadi noBashan.

Le lizwe latholakale kwalabo abashiwo uManase, ngokwemindeni yabo: kwaba ngu-Abiezer, no-Heleki, no-Asriyeli, no-Shekem, no-Heferi, no-Shemida; labo bamadodakazi kaManase, unyana kaYosefu, ngokwemindeni yabo.

Kodwa uZelofehadi, indodana kaHeferi, indodana kaGileyadi, indodana kaMakhiri, indodana kaManase, akazange abe namadodakazi, kodwa kwaba nezingane; futhi igama lamadodakazi akhe leli: uMahla, noNowa, noHogla, noMilka, noTirsa.

Bafike ku-Elazare umbingeleli, noYoshuwa unyana kaNune, nabakhulu, besithi, UYehova wathi kuMoses ukuba anikeze izwe phakathi kwabazalwane bethu. Wabanika ke uYoshuwa ilizwe phakathi kwabazalwane babo, njengoba iNkosi abewiselayo.
Wathola uManase amafelokazi alishumi, ngaphandle kweGiliyadi neBhashani enyakatho yeYorodani.
ngoba izingane zamadodakazi kaManase zathola indawo phakathi nabantwana babo; futhi izwe likaGiliyadi laliyindawo yamaSirayeli asendaweni yaseManase.
Isifundazwe sikaManase sasuka eAshere, safika eMikmetathi enyakatho-mpumalanga yeShekhemi, sadlula emazweni asentshonalanga kulabo abahlala eEntappuah.
Izwe elibhekene neTaphua lalinguManase; kodwa idolobhana laseTaphua, elingene emkhawulweni kaManase, linguEfraim.

Kwathi lapho umkhawulo ukhuphuka khona, wafika emfuleni iKana. Enyakatho yomfula kwakukhona amadolobhana kaEfrayim, kodwa lakhiwa phakathi kwamadolobhana kaManase. Umkhawulo kaManase wawusuka engxenyeni yasentshonalanga yoMnyangweni, waya elwandle.

UEphrayim wathola isifunda esisenyakatho, uManase wathola isifunda esisentshonalanga; futhi umfula wawuyimikhawulo yasenyakatho kaManase. Wafinyelela eAshere ngasempumalanga, no-Issakare ngasempumalanga.
Nasezindaweni zakwa-Issakha nezakwa-Ashere, uManase wathola iBeth-shan, no-Ibleam, nalabo baseDori, nalabo baseEndori, nalabo baseTaanakhi, nalabo baseMegido, ngaye ngaye namabhishi akhe.
Amakhosi aseManase awakwazanga ukuhlasela amadolobhana lawo, ngoba amaKananani ayefuna ukuhlala ezweni labo.
Kwathi lapho amaSirayeli ekhula enamandla, wabeka abantu baseKanana ukuba basebenzele; kodwa akazange awakhuphule.
Bathi amadodana kaYosefu kuYoshuwa, Kungani na usinike imbewu eyodwa kuphela yezwe, thina abantu abakhulu, ngoba iNkosi uswelele kakhulu?
Wathi uYoshuwa kubo, Uma niningi kakhulu, futhi indawo entaba-mlilo kaEphrayimi incane kuwe; zulazelani ezweni lemithi, nizoqeda izihlahla zenu ezweni labasePerizi nabaseRefayi.

Bathi kubo, Le ndawo entaba-mlilo incane kakhulu ukuthi siyifinyelele; futhi bonke abaKanani abahlala ezindaweni eziphansi banesithuthuthu sensimbi, nalabo baseBeth-shan nasezifundeni zaso, nalabo baseGoli laseJizreyeli.
Wathi uYoshuwa kubonyana bakaYosefu, kwa-Ephrayim nakwaManase, esithi, Nibantu abaningi, ninamandla kakhulu; ngeke nibe nengxenye eyodwa.
Futhi idolobhana eliphakeme elinabantu abafileyo lizoba lakho; ulihlanze, libe lakho lonke. Uzokhipha abantu baseKanana, nakuba banezithuthi zensimbi, futhi banamandla.
Ibandla lonke lakwaSirayeli lahlangana eShilo, bamisa khona itente lengqungquthela; futhi leli lizwe liyindawo yabo.
Kodwa izizwe ezisixhenxe zakwaSirayeli azikaze zithole inkontileka yabo yelizwe.
Wathi uYoshuwa kwabaSirayeli, Ngabe nizohlala isikhathi esingakanani, ngaphambi kokuba nihambe nithathe izwe, elinikeziwe nguYehova, uNkulunkulu wababa kwenu?
Khetha abantu abathathu eqenjini ngalinye. Ngizobathumela ukuba bahambe ngezwe futhi babhale incazelo yayo, bebonisa ukuthi ingahlukaniswa kanjani. Bazobuya kimi.
Bazohlukanisa izwe libe yizingxenye ezisixhenxe; uYuda uzohlala ezweni lakhe elasenyakatho, nabangane bakaYosefu bazohlala ezweni labo elasenyakatho.
Babhaleni izingxenye ezisixhenxe, nizithumelele lapha kimi; ngizobeka khona isinqumo senu lapha phambi koNkulunkulu wethu iNkosi.

Kodwa amaLevi angeke abe nengxenye phakathi kwenu, ngoba ukukhonza njengombingeleli kukaNkulunkulu kuyingxenye yabo; futhi uGadi, noRubhene, nengxenye yesizwe sikaManase, bathole imbewu yabo ngaphesheya kweJordán, enyakatho-ntshonalanga, oMoses, umkhonzi kaYehova, wabanika.
Wathi uYoshuwa kubo bonke abantu abasuka, wathi kubo: "Nihambe nizulazule izwe, nilibhale ngezansi; bese nibuya nami, ngizobeka izikhundla zenu lapha eShilo phambi koYehova."
Baye ke labo madoda bahamba izwe lonke, babhale la lizwe encwadini, ngedolobha ngalinye lihlukaniswe ngezingxenye ezisixhenxe; babuyela kuYoshuwa esibhedlela eShilo.
UYoshuwa wabeka isinqumo kubo phambi koYehova eShilo; uYoshuwa wahlukanisa khona izwe phakathi kwamadodana aseSirayeli, ngokwesizwe ngasinye.
Kwaphuma isizwe sakwaBhenjamin, ngokwemindeni yawo, isipho sokuqala; kwathi phakathi kwelizwe lakwaYuda nelizwe lakwaYosefu, kwakuyindawo yabo.
Ngasenyakatho, umkhawulo wabo wawuqala eJordani, wehla ngasenyakatho-ntshonalanga yeJericho, wadlula emadolobheni asentshonalanga, waphuma entaba-mlilo yaseBethe-Aweni.
Wadlula khona enyakatho-ntshonalanga yeLuz, leyo yiBetheleli; wahla waya eAtaroth-adare, emfuleni osentshonalanga yeBethoron esephansi.

Kusuka enhliziyweni ebhekene neBeth-horon, ngasempumalanga, umkhawulo ujikeleza ngasempumalanga kuze kube yilapho udlula khona eKiriyati-bhaali (lezo ziyiKiriyathi-yearimi), emzini wamaYuda. Lokho kwakuyingxenye yasempumalanga.
Icala lasenyakatho laqala esigabeni seKiriyati-yearimi ngasenyakatho, lifike emfuleni wamanzi kaNeftoha.
Kwathi lapho umkhawulo uphuma khona, wadlula engxenyeni esenyakatho yeGoli likaRephayimi, wafika esiqhingini saseHinom, ngasempumalanga yedolobhana laseJebhusi, waya eEn-rogeli.
Wabuyela ngasenyakatho, waya e-En-shemesi, wadlula eGili-lothi, elibhekene ne-pass of Adummim, wakhuphuka etsheni likaBohani unyana kaRubhen.
Yaye yadlula engxenyeni yasenyakatho yendawo ebheke umfula iJordani, yawela emfuleni.
Yathi yadlula enyakatho ye-Beth Hoglah, yaphela enyakatho yolwandle olufileyo, lapho iJordani iphuma khona. Lokho kwaba umkhawulo wasempumalanga.
IJordani yaba yimikhawulo engxenyeni esenyakatho. Lokho kwakuyimikhawulo yomhlaba obekwe izizwe zikaBhenjamin ngazo zonke izingcezu.
Isizwe sikaBhenjamin, ngokwenkundla yawo, kwakukhona izidolobhana ezilandelayo: iJericho, neBethogla, neEmek-keziz,
neBhethe-araba, neZemarayimu, neBetheli,
uAvwimu, noPhara, noOfraha,
iKefari-amoni, neHofeni, neGiba: izidolobhana ezilishumi elinambini nezifunda zawo.
futhi iGibeboni, neRama, neBherothi,
iMizpa, neKefira, neMoza,
i-Rekem, i-Irpeel, i-Taralah,
Nase-Ela, naseHalephu, nedolobhana laseJebhusi (eliwuJerusalema), kanye noGibeha naKiriyati; izifundazwe ezilishumi elinamihlanu nezifundeni zazo. Lokho kwakuyindawo yabafazi bakaBhenjamin.
Iphutha lesibili laphuma lesizwe sakwaSimeoni, ngemindeni yawo; ilizwe labo liphakathi kwezwe likaYuda.
Izwe labo lahlanganisa iBeer-shebha, ebizwa nangokuthi iShebha, neMolada,
uHazari-shuhali, noBalahi, noEzem,
uEltoladi, noBethuli, noHorma,
iSikelage, neBeth-markabhothi, neHazari-Susha,
iBhethe-libaothi, neSharuheni: izidolobhana ezilishumi elinamithathu nezifunda zawo.
futhi i-Ayin, ne-Rimon, ne-Ether, ne-Ashan; kwakukhona izifundazwe ezine nezifundela zawo.
kanye nezifunda zonke ezibhekene nalawo madolobhana, kuze kube yiBahalathi-beeri (lezo ziyiRama enyakatho). Lowo ngumhlaba wesizwe samaSimeoni ngokwemindeni yawo.
USimeoni wathola indawo yakhe ezweni likaYuda, ngoba izwe likaYuda liningi kakhulu kunalo; ngakho uSimeoni wathola indawo yakhe phakathi kwezwe likaYuda.
Iphutha lesithathu laphuma kuZebuloni, ngokwemindeni yawo; umkhawulo wabo wafika eSaridi.
Wahamba enyakatho waya eMarala, wafinyelela eDabheshethi, wafika enkabeni yeJokneam.
Kusuka eSaridi yashintsha ibheke eningizimu, ifike ezweni likaKisloth-taboro, yadlula eDaberathi, yafika eJaphia.
Kusuka khona lapho yadlula enyakatho ifike eGathe-hepher, neEth-kazin, yaphuma eRimoni, yabuyela eNea.
Enyakatho, umgwaqo udlula eHannathon futhi waphela eValley of Iphtah El.
Kwabe kukhona iKathathi, neNahalali, neShimroni, neIdala, noBethelehemu; kwaba khona izidolobhana ezilishumi elinambini nezifunda zawo.
Lawa madolobhana namabhishi azo, yindawo kaZabuloni ngokwemindeni yawo.
Iphutha lesine laphuma ku-Issakare, ngohlobo lwawo.
Izwe labo lahlanganisa iJezreyeli, noKesulothi, noShunem,
uHapharayim, noSiyone, noAnaharathe,
iRabhithi, neKishiyoni, ne-Ebezi,
neRemethi, ne-Enganimi, ne-Enhada, neBeth-pazezi.
futhi umkhawulo ufike eTabhori, neShahazuma, neBethe-shemesi, waphela eYodhani; izidolobhana ezilishumi elinamihlanu nezifunda zawo.
Lezi ziyizindawo zezwe lakwa-Issakhar, ngohlobo lwazo, ngamadolobheni azo.
Iphutha lesihlanu laphuma lesizwe sakwa-Asheri, ngohlobo lwaso.
Izwe labo lahlanganisa iHelekathi, neHali, noBetheni, neAkshaphu,
I-Allammelek, i-Amad ne-Mishal. Enyakatho umgwaqo uthinta iCarmel noShihor Libnath.
Yasuka yajika ibheke emazweni asempumalanga, ifike eBeth-dagoni, yafinyelela eZebuloni, neGoli lika-Ifta-eli, yadlula eBet-emeki naseNeyeli, yafika eKabuli ngasekhohlo.
Yafika e-Abdon, ne-Rehoboth, ne-Hamon, ne-Kana, kuze kube yiSidon enkulu.
Kwathi lapho umkhawulo ujika waya eRama, wadlula eTire, idolobhana elinomgwaqo omkhulu; kwathi lapho ujika waya eHosa, waphela emfuleni, ezweni lase-Akzib.
Ihlanganisa futhi i-Ummah, ne-Afhek ne-Rehoboth. Kwabe kukhona amadolobhana ayishumi nambili nezifunda zawo.
Lezi zidolobhana nezifundazwe zazo, yizizwe zakwa-Asheri ngokwemindeni yawo.
Isinqumo sesishiyagalombili saphuma kuNaphtali, ngohlobo lwawo.
Umkhawulo wabo wawusuka eHelephu, no-Eden eZaanannim, waya eAdami-nekeb, neYabneel, wafika eLakumi, waphela eJordani.
Kwathi lapho umkhawulo udlula ngasenyakatho, waya eAznothi-tabhori, wafika eHukok; wafinyelela kuZebuloni emazweni asempumalanga, noAshere emazweni asentshonalanga, noYuda emazweni asentshonalanga.
Amadolobhana anezindlu zangasese aye yiSidimu, neZeri, neHamathi, neRakathi, neKinereti,
ne-Adama, ne-Rama, ne-Hazori,
noKedesh, noEdrei, noEnhazori,
I-Iron, neMigdal-eli, noHorem, naBeth-anathi, naBeth-shemeshi; izidolobhana ezilishumi elinamihlanu nezifunda zawo.
Lezi zidolobhana nezifundela zazo, izwe lesizwe sakwaNaphtali ngokwemindeni yawo.
Iphutha lesixhenxe laphuma isizwe sakwaDan, ngohlobo lwaso.
Izwe labo lahlanganisa iZora, ne-Eshtaoli, ne-Ir Shemesh,
iShaalabini, ne-Ayaloni, ne-Ithala,
ne-Elon, ne-Timna, ne-Ekron,
ne-Eltekeke, neGibhethoni, neBahalathi,
u-Yehude, noBhene-beraki, neGathi-rimoni,
NgiJarkon noRakkon, nendawo ebhekene neJoppa.

Kodwa abazalwane baka-Dan, bekhathazekile ngenxa yokuthatha izwe labo, bakhuphuka, bahlasela i-Leshemi, bayithatha, bayibulala ngeqhwa, bahlala khona. Baguqula igama le-Leshemi libe ngu-Dan, ngokusho kwegama lika-Dan ubaba wabo.
Lezi ziyizindawo zezwe lakwaDani, ngohlobo lwabo nohlobo lwabo; lezi zindawo nezifundela zazo.
Uma beqedile ukuhlukanisa izwe ngamafelokazi ayo, abaSirayeli banikeza uYoshuwa, unyana kaNune, amafelokazi phakathi kwabo.
Bamunika isixeko ebesicela, iTimnathi-seraha, ezindaweni eziphakeme zakwaEfrayim, njengoba iNkosi abewisela umthetho ngawo. Wawukwakha lo mzi, wahlala kuwo.

Lawa amafelokazi omhlaba, alowo uElezare umbingeleli, noYoshuwa unyana ka-Nun, nabaholi bezizwe zakwaSirayeli, abawudlulisa ngezinhlamvu eShilo phambi koYehova, emgwaqeni wesitezi sokubambisana; futhi baqedile ukuhlukaniswa kwelizwe.
Wathi iNkosi kuYoshuwa,
Uthi kuSirayeli: Bakhetheni imiphakathi yokuthula, engikhuluma ngayo kuwe ngesandla sikaMoses.
Noma ngubani obulala umuntu ngengozi, ngaphandle kokufunayo, kufanele ahambe esinye salezi zifunda, khona-ke uzobe esephephile lapho kusuka kumngane wakhe ofuna ukuthatha inkohliso.

Uzohamba esinye sezizwe, ahlale emgwaqeni wedolobha, aveze ukuthi kwenzekani abaphathi bedolobha labo. Baze bathabathele kubo emazweni abo, babanike indawo yokuhlala phakathi kwabo; futhi uma befika emigwaqweni yedolobha nezindawo eziphakeme kakhulu zedolobha labo, bazothi: "Kungaba khona umuntu ophilayo ezweni lethu."
Uma umngane ofuna ukuxoshwa ewalandela, abaphathi kumele bangamnikela umuntu, ngoba babulala umngane wabo ngengozi futhi bebengabakhohlisa ngaphambilini.
Uzohlala kulo mzi kuze ahlale enkantolo phambi kwebandla, kuze kube sekufa umbingeleli omkhulu ozoba khona ngaleso sikhathi; bese uzobuya ezweni lakhe, emzini wakhe, lapho waphuma khona.
Bamisa khona iKedesh eGalili, endaweni entaba-mlilo yaseNaphtali, noShekheme endaweni entaba-mlilo yaseEfraim, neKiriyati-arba (leyo yiHebroni), endaweni entaba-mlilo yaseYuda.

Enyakatho-mpumalanga yeJordani, ngaphesheya kwezilwandle kweJericho, bakhetha iBeseri ezindaweni eziseduze zesihlabathi, ezweni lakwaRubheni, neRamoti eGiliyadi, ezweni lakwaGadi, noGolani eBhashani, ezweni lakwaManase.

Lezi ziyizindawo ezikhethiwe kubo bonke amadodana aseSirayeli, nalabo abavela kwamanye amazwe abahlala phakathi kwabo; ukuze wonke umuntu obulala umuntu ngengozi abe khona lapho, futhi angabulawa yindoda yakhe efuna ukubulala, ngaphambi kokuba enze isinqumo phambi komphakathi.
Bafika khona abaphathi bezindlu zakwaLevi ku-Elazare umpristi, noYoshuwa unyana kaNune, nabaphathi bezindlu zakwamadodana aseSirayeli.

Bathi kubo eShilo, ezweni laseKanana, bethi, UNkulunkulu utshele ngesandla sikaMoses, ukuthi sinikezwe izidolobhakazi ukuze sihlale kuzo, nezifundela zazo ezibhekene nazo, ukuze sizigcinele izinkomo zethu.
Bathi ke oonyana bakaSirayeli, banikela kulabo abaLevi ezweni labo lezi zifundazwe nezindawo zazo zomhlaba, njengoba iNkosi abewisela umthetho.
Kwaphuma isinqumo sokuqala emindenini yamaKahati; kwafika amaLevithi, oonyana baka-Aron umbingeleli, emazweni aseYuda, naseSimeoni, naseBhenjamini, izizwe ezilishumi elinamithathu.
Amanye amalungu omndeni ka-Ephrayi, kanye noDani naphezu kwengxenye yesizwe sikaManase wathola izidolobhana ezingushumi.
Amadodana kaGershoni athole ezindaweni zomndeni wakwa-Issakare, nomndeni wakwa-Asere, nemindeni yakwaNaphtali, naphezu kwengxenye yesizwe sikaManase eBhashani, idolobhakazi elilodwa nesithathu.
Namadodana kaMerari, ngokwemindeni yabo, ayethola emazweni aseRubheni, naseGadi, naseZebulun, amadolobha ayishumi nambili.
Bathi ke abazalwane bakaSirayeli banikeza amaLevi la madolobhana kanye nezindawo zawo zokudlela, ngokuhluza, njengoba iNkosi abewisela umthetho ngomlomo kaMoses.
Ezindaweni zakwaYuda nakwaSimeoni banikela ngamadolobhana alandelayo, a zavrwa ngezansi.
Baye badlula kubo oonyana baka-Aron, abasezinhlanganiso zakwaKehati phakathi kwabaLevi; ngoba isinqumo sokuqala saphuma kubo.
Babanika iKiriyati-arba, uArba owayengubaba ka-Anaki, ezweni lasendulo lakwaYuda, kanye nezindawo zayo zasendaweni ezungeze yona. (I-Kiritathi-arba iyi-Hebron.)
Kodwa izwe lemizana, nezindawo zokuhlala ezijikeleze lo dolobhana, ziye zanikezwa uKalebe, unyana kaJefune.
Wabanikeza oonyana baka-Aron, umbingeleli, iHebrone, umzi wokuthula kulowo obulala umuntu, kanye neLibna.
iYattir, ne-Eshtemoa,
i-Holon, neDebiri,
kanye ne vindebe lazo, no-Ayin, no-Juta, no-Bethe-shemesi; ngalezi zinhlanga ezimbili amadolobhana ayisithoba.
Ezweni likaBhenjamin banikela kubo eGibehoni, neGeba,
kanye noAnathothi namabhishi alo, neAlmoni namabhishi alo: izifundazwe ezine.
Ngazo zonke lezi zifunda, izizwe zika-Aron zababhishobhi zathola idolobhana elilodwa nesishiyagalombili kanye nezindawo zawo.
Amanye amaqembu emindeni yamaKahati, amakhosikazi kaLevi, wathola izidolobhana ezisuka kwisizukulwana sikaEphrayimi.
Bathola iShekhemi, ezweni eliphakeme likaEphrayimi, umzi wokuphepha kulowo obulala umuntu, neGezeri;
kanye neKibsayim, neBethoron; ngayinye yazo izifunda zayo. Ziyidolobhana elinhlanu.
Ezweni lakwaDan, bathola i-Eltekeh, neGibbethoni,
ne-Aijaloni, ne-Gathi-rimoni; ngayinye yazo nezindawo zayo zokudlela: izidolobhana ezine.
Engxenyeni yesizwe sikaManase, iTaanakhi nezindawo zayo zokudlela, neGati-rimoni; izidolobhana ezimbili.
Wonke amanye amaqembu omndeni wakwa-Kehati wathola idolobhana elilodwa kanye nezindawo zawo.
Nasezinhlanga zakwaGershoni, eziLevini, kwabe sekuyindawo yokuzivikela yomuntu obulalayo eGolani eBhashani, kanye neBe-eshtara; ngazo zonke lezi zidolobhana ezimbili.
Esifundazweni sika-Issakha, babe neKishiyon, noDaberathi,
iJarmuthi, ne-En Gannim, ngasinye sazo nesizinda saso; kwakungumadolobhana amane.
Ezweni lika-Ashere bathola uMishali, noAbdon,
neHelekathi, neRehobhi; ngayinye yazo izifunda zayo. Ziyidolobhana elilodwa.
Ezweni lakwaNaphtali kwaba nguKedesh eGalilile, idolobhana lokuzivikela lomuntu obulalayo, neHamothi-dor, neKarthani, ngazo zonke izifundazwe zayo; zimadolobha amathathu.
Ngazo zonke izizwe zakwaGershoni kwakukhona idolobhana elilodwa nesishiyagalombili nezindawo zayo zokudlela.
Imindeni yama-Merari, okunye kwabaLevi, yathola ezweni likaZebuloni iYokneam, neKartha,
kanye neDimna, neNahalal; ngayinye yazo inendawo yayo. Ziyidolobhana elilodwa.
Ezweni lakwaRubheni bathola uBezere, noYahazi,
neKedemothi, neMefaathi; ngalinye lazo namagatsha alo: izidolobhana ezine.
Esifundazweni sikaGadi bathola iRamothi eGileyadi, idolobha eliphephile kulowo obulala umuntu, neMahanayim;
futhi iHeshboni neYazeri, ngazo zonke lezi zidolobhana ezine.
Ngazo zonke izizwe zakwaMerari, eziphakathi kwezizwe zakwaLevi, kwabe sekuyizindawo eziyisithupha.
Ngazo zonke izifundazwe zakwaLevi, ezweni lamadodana kaSirayeli, kwakuyizindawo ezingu-48 kanye nezifundela zayo.
Kuzo zonke lezi zifunda, ngayinye yazo inezindawo zomhlaba ezibhekene nazo. Le nto yayiqiniso kuzo zonke.
Wathi iNkosi wabanika amaSirayeli izwe lonke, ebewaphikisa ngaso ukuthi uzolibazisa ababuphikisi babo; balimaza la mhlaba, bahlala kuwo.

Wabanikeza iNkosi isikhala ngaso sonke isikhathi, ngokwezinto zonke awazinikela ngazo kubaba babo; kwakungekho muntu okwazi ukubhekana nabo phakathi kwabo bonke ababi; wabeka iNkosi ababi babo bonke esandla sabo.
Akukho lutho lwamazwi amahle, awashoyo iNkosi kubo bonke abantu bakaSirayeli; konke kwakwenzeka.
Wathi uYoshuwa, "Njengoba isizwe sikaRubhen, nesizwe sikaGadi, kanye nengxenye yesizwe sikaManase,
Wathi kubo, Nikwenze konke uMosis, umkhonzi kaYehova, awawisela umthetho ngawo, nimikele amazwi ami ngazo zonke izinto engikhuluma ngazo.
Ngalezo zinsuku eziningi, kuze kube ngalolusuku, ningawashiya abazalwane benu amaSirayeli; nigcineni umsebenzi kaNkulunkulu, uNkulunkulu wenu, owawuthi ukwenze.

Ngiyabona ukuthi iNkosi, uNkulunkulu wenu, usandulela induduzo abazalwane benu, njengoba wathi; ngakho-ke manje nibuyeni ezweni lenu elisemthethweni, elininikezwe nguMoses, umkhonzi kaYehova, ngasenyakatho yeJordani.

Kodwa ugcine ngokuqinile ukuba wenze imithetho, kanye nomthetho, okuyinto Moses wathi kuwe, ukuba uthande iNkosi uNkulunkulu wakho, futhi uhambe ezindaweni zakhe, futhi ugcine imiyalo yakhe, futhi ahlale engqondweni yakho yonke, futhi ukukhonza kwakhe ngenhliziyo yakho yonke, nengqondo yakho yonke.
UYoshuwa wabasabisa, wabasusa; basuka beya endaweni yabo.

UMoses wanikela isizwe esisodwa sakwaManase eBhashani, futhi uYoshuwa wabanika isiqhingi esifanayo nabangani babo ngasempumalanga yeJordane. Nokho lapho uJoshua ebewathumela khona emakhaya abo, wathi:
Wathi, Yiya ekhaya lakho ngempahla yakho enkulu, nezilwane eziningi, nesiliva, negolide, nobhedu, nensimbi, nezigqoko eziningi; uhlukanise nabangani bakho ithonya lezinto ozenzayo ezinkingeni zenu.

Baye ke amaRubheni, namaGadi, nengxenye yesizwe sikaManase, besuka eShilo, ezweni likaKanana, babuyela eGileyadi, ezweni labo elihlala kulo, lapho babehlala khona, ngaphandle kwamadodana kaSirayeli, njengoba iNkosi abewisela umthetho ngoMosese.
Bafika eGili-lothi, enhliziyweni yeJordani, ezweni laseKanana; bahlanganisa khona isibingelelo esisha, esikhulu kakhulu.
Bathe amaSirayeli ezwa abantu bethi, Bheka, uRubhen noGadi, nengxenye yesifundazwe sikaManase, bakwakha isibingelelo emgwaqweni waseKanana, enhliziyweni yoMfula iYorodani, ngaphesheya kwaSirayeli.
Kwathi lapho abantu baseSirayeli bekubona lokhu, ibandla lonke lahlanganisana eShilo, ukuba lizobe lihlasela.
Bathumela uPhinehasi, unyana ka-Elazare umpristi, ezweni laseGiliyadi, kwabaseRubheni, nabaseGadi, nengxenye yomndeni wakwaManase.
Bathumela naye abaholi abalishumi, umuntu oyedwa ezweni ngalinye lakwaSirayeli; wonke umuntu waba yinhloko yomndeni wakwaSirayeli.
Baye bafika eGileyadi kubo bonke abantu baseRubheni, noGadi, nengxenye yesizwe sikaManase, bathi kubo,
Ibandla lonke likaYehova lithi, Ingabe niyiphula umthetho kaThixo wakwaSirayeli? Ingabe namanje nisuka ekuphileni ukulandela iNkosi, nikha isibingelelo, ukuze nigweme ukumnika?
Akukancane-ke kuthina ukulimala kwePeori? Kuye kulesi sikhathi samanje asikuhlanjwanga ngaso, ngenxa yobhubho elingenayo phakathi kwabantu bakaYehova.
Futhi manje nizobuya nisuka emzini kaYehova; ngoba uma namuhla niyiphula imithetho kaYehova, ngoMsombuluko uzoba nomsindo ngebandla lonke lakwaSirayeli.

Uma izwe lempahla yenu lingcolile, vuka nifike ezweni likaYehova, lapho ihholo likaYehova lihlala khona, niyihlukanise nathi; kodwa mthweleni iNkosi, noma nani, ngokwakha isibingelelo esisodwa ngaphandle kwesibingelelo sikaYehova uNkulunkulu wethu.
Khumbula uAkani unyana kaZera, ngoba wakwenza okubi ezintoni eziboshiwe; khona-ke kwafika inkohliso phezu kwebandla lonke lakwaSirayeli. Akazange aphele yena kuphela ngenxa yakhe.
Waphendula uRubhene, noGadi, nengxenye yesizwe sikaManase, waphendula abaholi bezizwe zakwaSirayeli, wathi,
UNkulunkulu onamandla, iNkosi! UThixo onamandla, iNkosi; yena uyazi, futhi bakwazi naSirayeli. Uma sikwenze lokhu ngenxa yobugebengu, noma ngenxa yokungakholwa kukaNkulunkulu, ungasixoli namuhla.
Uma sakha lesi sibhedlela sokuba siyeke ukulandela iNkosi, noma ukunikela phezu kwayo ngezipho ezibomvu, noma ngezipho zokudla, noma ngezipho zokusindisa, iNkosi ngokwakhe agweme.
Ngakho-ke sakwenza lokhu, ngoba sikhathazekile, ukuthi bangathi izingane zenu ngosuku olulandelayo kuzingane zethu, zithi, Nini na phakathi kwenu noYehova uNkulunkulu kaSirayeli?

UYehova wenza iJordani ibe yimikhawulo phakathi kwethu nenu, nimadodana kaRubhen namadodana kaGadi; wena awunayo inkontileka noNkulunkulu. Ngaleyo ndlela izingane zenu zingazisusa izingane zethu ekukhonzeni uNkosi.
Ngalokho sathi, Sizokwakha isibingelelo, hhayi izipho zokudlwengula, noma izinkondlo;

kodwa ukuze kube yisibonakaliso phakathi kwethu nabanye, kanye nezizukulwane zethu ezizayo, ukuthi sikhonza iNkosi phambi kwakhe ngezinsizakalo zethu zokudlwengula, namabhishi ethu, nezipho zethu zokuthula; ukuze izingane zenu zingaze zithi ngosuku olulandelayo kubantwana bethu, Ningenayo inkontileka noYehova.

Sathi ke, Uma bekhuluma nathi noma ngezingane zethu ngalolu hlobo kusasa, sizophendula ngokuthi: "Njengoba nibona isifanekiso sesibhedlela sikaYehova, ebesiyenziwe abazali bethu; ayizange ibe yisondlo esiqhumayo, futhi ayizange ibe yisondlo sokudla; kodwa ibilokhu ikhona njengobufakazi phakathi kwethu nenu.

Asikho isinqumo sethu ukuthi sigweme uMoya oNgcwele, noma ukuthi sibuyele emuva ngalesi sikhathi, ngokwakha isibingelelo esisha somnikelo wokushiswa, nomnikelo wokudla, noma isibingelelo, ngaphandle kwesibingelelo sikaYehova uNkulunkulu wethu esikhona phambi kwendlu yakhe.
Kwathi lapho uPhinehasi, indodana kambingeleli, namadoda amakhulu ebandla, abaphathi bezizwe zakwaSirayeli, beva amazwi amakhosikazi kaRubhen noGadi noManase, kwaba kuhle kubo.

Wathi kubo uPhinehasi, unyana ka-Elazare umpristi: Namhlanje siyazi ukuthi iNkosi unesibopho nathi, ngokuba ningabi nento engalungile ngaye ngalolu daba; manje nisindise oonyana bakaSirayeli emlonyeni kaYehova.
Wabuya uPhinehasi, unyana ka-Elazare umpristi, namadodana akhe, besuka eRubheni naseGadi eGiliyadi, babuyela kubo bonke abantu baseSirayeli ezweni laseKanana, bakhuluma nabo.
Bathokozela oonyana bakaSirayeli, babonga uNkulunkulu; futhi abazange baphinde bakhulume ngokuhamba nabo emkhosini, ukuze babhubhise izwe lakwaRubhen nakwaGadi, lapho behlala khona.
Bathi amadodana kaRubhen namadodana kaGadi igama lesibingelelo libizwa ngokuthi yiShati, besithi, LiyiShati phakathi kwethu, ukuthi iNkosi nguThixo.
Kwathi sekudlule isikhathi eside, iNkosi wamisa amaSirayeli emlonyeni wababi babo bonke ababhekene nabo ngazo zonke izinsuku. UYoshuwa ke wayekhulu kakhulu.
Wabiza wonke amaSirayeli, abakhulu babo, nabaphathi babo, namagoli abo, nabaqondisi babo, wathi kubo, Ngiye ngikhulu kakhulu.
Nabona konke okwenze iNkosi uNkulunkulu wenu kuzo zonke lezi zizwe, ngenxa yenu; uINkosi, uNkulunkulu wenu, yena owabhekana nabo ngenxa yenu.
Bheka, ngikulethela izwe lezizwe eziseleyo, kanye nezizwe engizinqobile, kusukela emfuleni uYorodani kuze kube lwandle olukhulu enyakatho, ukuze lihlukaniswe phakathi kwezizwe zenu.
UNkulunkulu wakho, iNkosi, yena ozozisusa phambi kwenu, uzozibulala; nizothola izwe labo, njengokuthi uNkulunkulu wenu, iNkosi, wathi kuwe.
Ngiyakucela, uqiniseke kakhulu, ugcine ukukwenza konke okubhaliwe encwadini yomthetho kaMoses; ungasekhombi kuyo ngakwesokudla noma ngakwesobunxele.
Ungazihlanganisi nezwe elisele phakathi kwenu, futhi ungakhulumanga ngegama likaThixo wabo, noma wenze isipho ngazo, noma usebenzele, noma uzibophezele kubo.
kodwa niyibambe ngokuqinile izandla zenu kuYehova uNkulunkulu wenu, njengokuba nikwenza kuze kube manje.
UNkulunkulu wakhipha phambi kwenu izizwe ezinkulu, ezinamandla; akukho muntu okwaziyo ukubhekana nani kuze kube manje.
Omunye wenu unquma ukuhlasela abantu abangu-1; ngoba iNkosi, uNkulunkulu wakho, yena obhekana nabo ngenxa yenu, njengoba esho.
Ngakho-ke, qaphela kakhulu ukuthi uthande iNkosi uNkulunkulu wakho.
Uma nje nibuya, nizibophezele ezindleleni zalezi zintokazi, ezikiweni zenu, futhi nizibophezele kubo, nizibophezele ngempela;

kwazi ukuthi iNkosi uNkulunkulu wakho ngeke aphinde azikhuphule lezi zizwe phambi kwenu; kodwa zizoba yizinkundla zenu, nezingcezu zenu, nezicubu ezimilelweni yenu, kuze niphele ezweni elihle lezo iNkosi uNkulunkulu wenu awakunika lona.

Manje ngizohamba ngendlela yomhlaba wonke. Uyazi ngenhliziyweni yakho yonke, nangemphefumulo wakho wonke, ukuthi akukho lutho lwamazwi angcono onke iNkosi uThixouNkulunkulu wakho awasho ngawe; konke kwafika, akukho lutho lwamazwi alungile aphume.

Kodwa, njengokuba zonke izithiyo ezilungileyo iNkosi uNkulunkulu wenu awakhuluma ngazo zifike kuwe, njalo-ke uzoziletha phezu kwenu zonke izithiyo zakhe ezibi, kuze akukhulule nisuka kule lizwe elihle alinika lona.

Uma niphula umthethosivivinywa kaYehova uNkulunkulu wenu, owabawiselayo ukuthi niwugcine, futhi niya kukhonza izitha zakwamanye amazwe, nizibophezele kuzo; khona-ke inhliziyo yoMoya oNgcwele merina phezu kwenu, nizophela ngokushesha ezweni elingcono alikunikezile.
UYoshuwa waqoqa zonke izizwe zakwaSirayeli eShekem, wababiza abakhulu bakwaSirayeli, nabaphathi babo, nabahlengikazi babo, nabangani babo. Bafika behlala phambi koThixo.

Wathi uYoshuwa kubo bonke abantu, Usho lokhu iNkosi uNkulunkulu kaSirayeli: Ezweni elisentshonalanga yeMfula i-Euphrates bahlala ngaphambilini abazalwane benu, uTerah, ubaba kaAbrahama, noNahore; bakhonza) bekhonza izitha ezahlukene.
Ngathatha ubaba wenu uAbrahama ngaphesheya komfula, ngahamba naye ezweni lonke lakwaKanana, ngakwenza abe yizizukulwane eziningi, ngamnika uIsake.
Kwa-Isakha ngabanika uYakobi noEsau; kwa-Esau ngabanika intaba iSeyiri, ibe yindawo yakhe; kodwa uYakobi nomndeni wakhe bawela eYiputa.
Kwathi ngathumela uMoses noAron, ngahlasela iMisri ngezinto engizenzayo phakathi kwayo; futhi ngemuva kwalokhu ngizikhipha.
Kwathi lapho ngikhipha khona abazali benu ezweni laseYiputa, nifika emfuleni; futhi abaMishi balandela emuva kwabo ngemoto, namabhayisikili, kuze kube eMfuleni Omnyama.

Baze bathandaza kuYehova, yena wabeka umnyama phakathi kwenu nabaseYiputa, waveza amanzi phezu kwabo, awashisa. Amehlo enu akubona konke engikwenzele ama-Egyptians; futhi nihlala esiqhingini isikhathi eside.
Nginiholela ezweni lama-Amori, abehlala ngaphesheya kweYorodani; baphikisana nani, kodwa ngibanikela enhliziyweni yenu, ngiwabulala phambi kwenu, niyithathe izwe labo.
UBalaka unyana kaSipore, ukumkani wakwaMowabi, wehlisa isandla sakhe, wahlasela amaSirayeli; wathumela ebiza uBhileham unyana kaBeore, ukuthi akulambe.
Ngathi angifuni ukulalela uBhileham; yena wabasazela, futhi wabasazela; ngawusindisa wena ebusweni bukaBalaka.
Wadlula uYorodani, wafika eJericho; abantu baseJericho baphikisana nani, nama-Amori, nama-Perizi, nama-Kananani, nama-Hethi, nama-Girgasi, nama-Hivi, nama-Yebhusi; kodwa ngawanikela esandla sakho.
Nami ngathumela izinyosi phambi kwenu, zazikhuphula, nazo zonke iziphathimandla ezimbili zesizwe sama-Amori; awuzange wenze lokhu ngeqhwa lakho, noma ngeqhwa lethu.
Nami ngabanikeza izwe elingeke nisebenze kulo, namadolobha angeke niwakhile, nihlala kuwo; nidla izimbali zesilimo sewayini nezithelo ze-olive engakaze nizithole.
Manje ke, nigweme iNkosi, niwusebenzele intliziyo yenu yonke, nangokweqiniso; nisuse izitha abababa benu ababezikhonza ngaphesheya komfula i-Efrayi, naseYiputa, nisebenzele iNkosi.

Uma kwenzeka ukuthi kubuhlungu kuwe ukukhonza iNkosi, khetheni namhlanje ofuna ukukhonza yena; noma ngabe izitha abazibophezela ngazo abazali benu ezweni elisentshonalanga yeMfula i-Eufrate, noma izithiyo zabaAmoreyi abahlala izwe labo; kodwa mina nomndeni wami sizokhonza uNkosi.
Baphendula abantu, bethi, Akufanele sishiye iNkosi, sisebenzele amanye amadini.

UNkulunkulu wethu, iNkosi, nguye owenza ukuthi sikhuphuke nathi nababa bethu ezweni laseMisiya, ezweni lendlu yobugebengu; wazenza lezi zinto ezinkulu phambi kwethu, wagcina isinqumo sethu yonke indlela esihamba ngayo, phakathi kwazo zonke izizwe ezisidlula kuzo.
Ngokuba iNkosi wakhipha phambi kwethu zonke izizwe, nama-Amori ahlala kulolu lizwe; futhi nathi sizokhonza iNkosi, ngoba yena uNkulunkulu wethu.
Wathi uYoshuwa kubo bonke abantu, Ningeke nikwazi ukukhonza iNkosi; yena uNkulunkulu ongcwele, uNkulunkulu onokwesaba; ngeke agweme ukwenqaba kwenu nobubi benu.
Uma nishiya iNkosi, nikhonza amadini angaphandle, yena uzobuyela ekuphileni kwenu, futhi azokuphoqa ukuba nihlupheke, aze akulahle, ngemva kokuba ekwenzeni kahle kuwe.
Bathi ke abantu kuYoshuwa, Akunjalo; sizokhonza iNkosi.
Wathi uYoshuwa, Niyibo abavikeli phezu kwenu, ukuthi niwazikhethela ukuba nisebenzele iNkosi. Baphendule bathi, Siyabe ngabavikeli;
UYoshuwa wathi kubo: "Ngakho-ke, nisuse izitha zakwamanye amazwe eziphakathi kwenu, nibeke intliziyo yenu kuYehova uNkulunkulu kaSirayeli.
Bathi abantu kuYoshuwa, "Sizokhonza iNkosi uNkulunkulu wethu, futhi sizowulalela.
Wakwenza uYoshuwa isivumelwano nabantu ngalolusuku, wabeka kubo izimiso nemithetho eShekem.
WabhalaDZI uYoshuwa lezo zinto encwadini yomthetho kaThixo, wathatha itshe elikhulu, wayimisa ngaphansi komnqumo omkhulu osendaweni engcwele kaYehova.

Wathi uMoses kubo bonke abantu, Thola, itshe leli lizobe ngubufakazi bethu; ngoba lalalela zonke izinto akhuluma ngazo nathi iNkosi; futhi lizobe ngubufakazi benu, uma niyiphula umthetho kaNkulunkulu wenu.
UYoshuwa wakhipha abantu, wonke umuntu ezweni lakhe.
Ngaleso sikhathi uYoshuwa, unyana kaNune, umkhonzi woNkulunkulu, wafa, eneminyaka engumakhulu ayisishiyagalombili.
Bamu葬le ezindaweni zakhe, eTimnathi-seraha, enhliziyweni yamazulu kaEfrayim, ngasempumalanga yentaba iGaash.
AbaSirayeli bakhonza iNkosi zonke izinsuku zokuphila kukaYoshuwa, nazo zonke izinsuku zokuphila kwabakhulu abaphila ngemuva kwakhe, ababebona konke okwenze iNkosi kuboSirayeli.

Namahlombe kaYosefu, abebewathuthela kuwo amadodana aseSirayeli eYiputa, awabulale emfuleni iShekheme, kuleyo ndawo yomhlaba eyayithengiswe nguYakobi kubonyana bakaHamori udadewabo waseShekheme ngezimali ezingu-100 zegolide.
Wafa u-Eleazare, unyana ka-Aron; wabanjwa eGibeha, emfuleni owawunikezwe uPhinehasi unyana wakhe, ezindaweni eziphakeme zakwa-Ephrayi.
Judg: Ngemuva kokufa kukaYoshuwa, babuza amadodana aseSirayeli iNkosi, bethi, Yikuphi isizwe esizohamba kuqala ukubhekana nathi namaKanani?
Wathi iNkosi, UYuda kumele afike; bona, ngimise izwe esandla sabo.

Bathi amadodana kaYuda kumadodana kaSimeoni, abazalwane babo, besithi, Yiya nathi ezweni elithunyelwe thina, ukuze sihlangane nabantu baseKanana, futhi sihambe nawe ezweni lakho. Wahamba ke uSimeoni nabo.
Baphuma ke amaYuda, wabeka iNkosi izandla zabo abaKanani nabasePerizi; babulala abantu abangumakhulu ayisishiyagalombili eBezeki.
Bathola khona u-Adoni-bezekhe, babhekana naye, bahlasela amaKanani namaPerizithi.
U-Adoni-bezeke wabaleka, kodwa balandela emuva kwakhe, bagwema izinyawo zakhe ezincane nezikhulu.

Wathi u-Adoni-bezekhe, "Inkundla yami igcwele amakhosana amashumi asixhenxe obukhosi, abanezinkinobho zezandla zabo kanye nezinkinobho zezinyawo zabo ezicutshiwe; baqoqa izibiyeli ngezansi kwetafula lami. UNkulunkulu ungikhokhela ngokufana nalokho engikwenzayo kubo." Bamuthwa eYerusalem, wafa khona.
Bahlasela iJerusalema, bayithatha, babulala abantu bayo ngeqhwa, bamisa umzi ngomlilo.
Ngemuva kwalokho, abantu baseYuda bakhuphuka babhekana nabaKanana abahlala ezindaweni eziphakeme, nasenyakatho-ntshonalanga, nasezintabeni eziphansi.
Bahlasela amaKanani ahlala eHebroni, (igama layo kwakunguKiriyati-arba), babulala uSheshai, noAhimani, noTalmai.
Basuka khona bahlasela abantu base-Debiri (igama layo kwakunguKiriyathi-seferi).
Wathi uKalebe, Uma umuntu ehlasela iKiriyati-seferi, bese uyithatha, ngizomunika intombi yami iAksha ukuba ngumkakhe.
Wayinqoba uOthniyeli, indodana kaKenazi, umngane omncane kaKalebe; ke kaloku uKalebe wamnika inkosikazi yakhe i-Aksha ukuba abe nguwesifazane.
Yafika ku-Othniyeli, yamangalisa ubaba wayo ukuthi afune indawo yokulima; waphuma enyangeni yakhe, wathi kuye uKalebe, Ufuna yini?
Wathi yena kuye, Ungisize; ngoba ungisizile izwe elinabantu abaningi, nginikeze futhi izimpophoma zamanzi " . Ke kalobe wamnika izimpophoma eziphezulu nezimpophoma ezisephansi.

Baye bahamba namadodakazi kaMoses, amaKenithi, asuka edolobhaneni lezintaba-mlilo, kanye namadodakazi kaYuda, befika esiqhingini sikaYuda, ezweni laseNtshonalanga elibhekene ne-Arad; baye bahlala ndawonye nabo.
Kwathi kwadlula uYuda nabangane bakhe abasuka eSimeoni, bahlasela amaKanana ahlala eSephathi, babulala wonke lo mzi; ngakho kwabizwa igama lakhe ngokuthi iHorma.
UYuda wahlasela futhi iGaza, ne-Ashkelon, ne-Ekroni, ngayinye nezwe layo elijikeleze.
Wabe iNkosi noYuda; bathatha indawo entaba-mlilo, kodwa abakwazi ukuhlasela abantu abahlala ezindaweni eziphansi, ngoba babe nezithuthi zokulwa zensimbi.
Wabanika uKhalebe iHebroni, njengokuthi uMoses; wakhipha khona oonyana baka-Anaki abathathu.
Amadodana kaBhenjamini akazange akhuphule amaJebhusi ahlala eYerusalem; ngakho amaJebusi ayehlala phakathi kwamadodana kaBhenjamini eJerusalema kuze kufike lomhla.
Amakhosi kaYosefu afike eBhetelehem, iNkosi waba nabo.
Bathumela abantu ukuba babhekane noBethelehi, okuthiwa ngaphambilini nguLuzi.
Babona abaphenyi umuntu ophuma edolobhaneni, bathi kuye, Sibonise indlela yokungena edolobhaneni, futhi sizokwenza wena ukuba uthande.
Wabakhombisa ke, babulala abantu bedolobha ngeqhwa; kodwa lo muntu nomndeni wakhe wonke wavumela ukuthi ahambe.
Wahamba waya ezweni lamaHithi, wakhiwa khona umzi, wabiza igama lakhe ngokuthi iLuz; lelo liyigama layo kuze namuhla.
Kodwa-ke, uManase akazange akhuphule abantu baseBeth-shan, nabaseTaanakh, nabaseDor, nabaseIbleam, nabaseMegido namadolobhana abo; kodwa abaKanani baqhubeka behlala kulolu lizwe.
Kwathi lapho amaSirayeli enamandla, wabeka abaKanani ukuba basebenzele; kodwa akazange awakhuphule wonke.
No-Ephrayim akawasusanga amaKanana ahlala eGezeri; kodwa amaKanana ayehlala phakathi kwabo.
UZebuloni akawasusanga nalabo abahlali eKitroni, noma eNahaloli; behlala phakathi kwabo aBakanani, kodwa babe yimisebenzi yomsebenzi.
U-Asere akazange akhuphule abantu abahlala eAkko, noma eSidon, noma eAhlab, noma eAkzib, noma eHelbah, noma eAfek, noma eRehobhi.
Bahlala abantu baka-Asere phakathi kwamaKanana ezweni labo, ngoba bebengabasusanga.
UNaphtali akawasusanga amadolobha aseBhethe-shemeshi, noma aseBhethe-anathi; bahlala phakathi kwabaKanani belizwe; kodwa abantu baseBhethe-shemeshi, nabaseBhethe-anathi, babe yimisebenzi yabo.
Futhi ama-Amori wacindezela abantu bakaDan ezindaweni eziphakeme, futhi akazange abonise ukuba bakhuphuke emadolobheni.
Bathi ama-Amori: "Sizohlala emfuleni i-Heres, e-Ajalon ne-Shaalbim; kodwa uma izingane zikaYosefu zikhulu kakhulu, sizoba nomthwalo kuma-Amori."
Umgwaqo we-Amorites usuka eScorpion Pass kuya eSela nangaphezulu.

Waphuma umbingeleli kaYehova eGalgali waya eBokimi, wathi, Nginikhuphule nisuka eYiputa, futhi nginisize nifike ezweni engithembise ngamazwi obaba benu; futhi ngithi, Angeke ngiphule umnqophiso wami nani, kuze kube yisikhathi esizayo.
futhi ningeke niyenze inkontileka nabantu balesi sifundazwe, kodwa nizophonsa phansi izibingelelo zabo. Kodwa-ke, ningamlalela; yini le nto eninikele kuyo?
Ngakho ngithi, Ngami ngeke ngibakhuphe phambi kwenu; bazobe yizicubu ezinhliziyweni zenu, futhi amadini abo azoba yizinkundla kuwe.
Kwathi, lapho isithunywa sikaYehova sikhuluma ngalezo zinto kubo bonke amadodana kaSirayeli, abantu baphuma bekhala.
Babiza igama lesi sifundazwe ngokuthi iBokim, futhi banikela khona emkhondweni kuYehova.
Uma uYoshuwa eshiye abantu, basuka bonke amakhosikazi aseSirayeli, wonke umuntu ezweni lakhe.
Bakhonza ke abantu iNkosi zonke izinsuku zokuphila kukaYoshuwa, nazo zonke izinsuku zokuphila kwabakhulu abaphila ngemuva kwakhe, ababebona yonke le nto enkulu kaYehova, ayeyenza kuboSirayeli.
UYoshuwa unyana kaNune, umkhonzi kaYehova, wafa, eneminyaka eyikhulu nesishiyagalombili.
Bamu葬le ezindaweni zakhe, eTimnathi-heresi, esiqhingini sakwaEfraim, esisenyakatho yenduli kaGaash.
Kwathi, ngemuva kokufa kwaleso sizukulwana sonke, kwavuka isizukulwana esisha, esingamqondi iNkosi, noma iyiphi into ayeyenza kuSirayeli.
Bakwenza ke oonyana bakaSirayeli okubi emehloni kaYehova, bakhonza amaBaali.
Bashiya iNkosi, uNkulunkulu wababa babo, owabasusa ezweni laseMizi-Yiputa, balandela izitha zamazwe asendaweni yabo, bakhonza izitha zamazwe asendaweni yabo; futhi babulala iNkosi.
Bashiya iNkosi, bakhonza uBahali ne-Ashtorethi.
UYehova, ngenxa yengcindezi yakhe yabaSirayeli, wabanikela esidlangalaleni ezandleni zabahlaseli, babulalana nabo. Wabathengisa ezimpini zabo zonke izinhlangothi; abakwazi ukumelana nabo.
Ngaso sonke isikhathi lapho amaSirayeli ephuma khona ukubhekana nokulwa, isandla sikaYehova sakuba phezu kwabo, sababulala, njengokuthi washo kubo, futhi njengokuthi awaphikisile.
Wathi iNkosi wavusa abavikeli, abaphathi, ababebasindisa kulabo abahlaselayo.

Kodwa-ke, abazange baphulaphule abehluleli babo; babengakholwa kuYehova, bekhonza izitha zakwamanye amazwe, bezinikela kuzo. Basuka ngokushesha endlela ababehamba ngayo ababuphikisi babo, belandela imithetho kaYehova; abangayisebenzisi indlela ababeya ngayo abuphikisi babo.

Kwathi lapho iNkosi evusa khona ummeli kubo, iNkosi ube nowemthetho lowo, wabasindisa emathunjini abo zonke izinsuku zokuphila kommeli lowo; futhi iNkosi wababaleka ngenxa yabo, njengoba bephuca ngaphansi kwalabo ababebacindezela, nalabo ababebaphazamisa.

Kodwa lapho ummeli efa, abantu babuyela emuva, futhi wakwenza okubi kakhulu kunabazali babo. Balandela izitha zabanye, ukukhonza, nokuzibophezela kubo; abazange bayeke imicabango yabo emibi, noma indlela yabo engalungile.
UYehova wagwema amaSirayeli, wathi, Le lizwe liphumile isivumelwano sam, engiwisela ngaso ababuphikisi babo, bangangilalelanga.
Ngakho-ke, ngeke ngiphinde ngikhuphe phambi kwabo noma iyiphi izwe elishiye uYoshuwa lapho efa khona.
Ngizozama ngabo isiSirayeli, ukuthi bangagcina yini indlela kaYehova, behamba ngayo, njengokuthi ababa babo bahambe ngayo.
Ngakho iNkosi wabashiya labo mazwe; akawasusa ngokushesha, akawanikela esandlani sikaYoshuwa.
Lezi yizo izizwe ashiye iNkosi ezweni, ukuze azibonele izinganekwane zakwaSirayeli, labo abazange badlule kuwo wonke amabhishobhi aseKanana.
Wakwenza lokhu nje ukuze afundise ukulwa ezizukulwaneni ezintsha zabaSirayeli abazange banqobe emdlalweni ngaphambili.
Abaphathi abahlanu beFilisti, nabenzi bonke baseKanana, nabaSidoni, namaHivi ahlala entaba yaseLibanoni, kusukela emfuleni iBaale-Hermon, kuze kufike eHamati.
Waze wabashiya, ukuze abhekane nabo amadodana aseSirayeli, ukuthi bangawuphula kanjani umyalo kaYehova, owawuthi kubaba babo ngoMosesi.
AbaSirayeli bahlala phakathi kwamaKanana, namaHeti, namaAmoreti, namaPerizi, namaHivi, namaJebusi.
Bazala izingane zabo, banikela izingane zabo kubo; bakhonza amadini abo.
Bakwenza lokho okubi emehloni kaYehova, bakhohlwa iNkosi uNkulunkulu wabo, bakhonza amaBaali nama-Ashere.
Wagwema iNkosi isizwe samaSirayeli, wabathengisa kuKushan-risathaim, ukumkani waseAram Naharaim, eMesopotamia; bakhonza amaSirayeli iminyaka esibhozo.
Bacela iNkosi, wavusa umuntu wabasindisa, u-Othniyeli, unyana kaKenazi, umngane omncane kaKalebe.
UMoya kaYehova wehla phezu kwakhe, waba ngummeli wakwaSirayeli, waya emkhosini; iNkosi wamnika esandla sakhe uKushan-risathaim, ukumkani waseAram; wabulala uOthniel.
Izwe laphumula iminyaka emashumi mane, kuze kube sekufa uOthniel unyana kaKenazi.
Baphinde bakwenza oonyana bakaSirayeli lokho okubi emehloni kaYehova; ngenxa yokuthi bekwenze lokhu okubi, iNkosi waqinisa uEgloni ukumkani wamaMowabi phezu kwaSirayeli.
U-Egloni waqoqa nabo oonyana baka-Amoni nabangane baka-Amaleki, waya wahlasela isizwe samaSirayeli, bathatha idolobhana lezintaba.
Bakhonza amaSirayeli uEgloni ukumkani wakwaMowabi iminyaka eyisishiyagalombili.

Baphinde bathandaza oonyana bakaSirayeli kuYehova, wabeka kubo umsindisi, uEhude unyana kaGera, wesizwe sikaBhenjamini, indodana yokwesobunxele; bathumela kuye oonyana bakaSirayeli ukuba athathe inkontileka yabo ku-Egloni ukumkani wakwaMowabi.
U-Ehud wakwenza ikhebula elinobubanzi obuyimitha emibili, waligqugquzela emlenzeni wakhe wesobunxele ngezansi kwezigqoko zakhe.
Wanikeza umnikelo ku-Egloni ukumkani wakwaMowabi, owayengumuntu onzima kakhulu.
U-Ehude, lapho eqedile ukunikela, wathumela abantu abawuthwala.
Wabuyela emuva, waya eGilgal, lapho kwakukhona khona ama-Astarte, wathi, "Nginento engifuna ukukusho kuwe, Nkosi yami." Wathi ubukhosi: "Nquma!" Baphuma bonke abakhonzi bakhe.
U-Ehude wafika kuye, lapho ehlala khona ekamelweni elibandayo esitezi esiphezulu sendlu yakhe. Ujikelele u-Ehude, wathi: "Nginolwazi oluvela kuThixo kuwe." Ubukhosi besuka endaweni yabo,
U-Ehud wafinyelela ngesandla sakhe sasekhohlo, wasusa isikhephe ekhanda lakhe lasekunene, wayibeka emlonyeni womkakhe.
Naphezu kwalokho, isandla sayo safika ngemuva kwekhebula, futhi uphethiloli wavala phezu kwayo. U-Ehude akazange asuse isigwebo, saphuma emlenzeni wakhe.
Waphuma ke u-Ehude, wavala imingcele yegumbi eliphakeme ngemuva kwakhe, wavala izintambo zayo.
Waphuma, wafika umkhonzi wakhe, wathola iminyango yegumbi eliphakeme litshixiwe; bathi ke, Uzohlala egumbini eliphansi, ephumula.
Balinde kuze kube sengozini, kodwa yena akazange avule amafasitela. Ngakho bathathe isici futhi wavala. Kwakhona umnikazi wabo wahlala esitezi, efile.
Kusukela lapho, u-Ehud waphuma, waya eSeira, wadlula phezu kwezinhlamvu zesiliva.
Kwathi lapho efika khona, waphonsa isibhamu ezindaweni eziphakeme zakwaEfraim. Baphuma naye amadodana kaSirayeli emadolobheni aphezulu, no-Ehud ephethe kubo.

Wathi kubo, "Niya kulandelana nami; ngoba iNkosi usandulela izandla zenu umfowabo uMowabi." Baphuma belandela yena, bathatha iziqhingi zaseJordani ezibhekene neMowabi, abavumelanga umuntu ukuthi adlule.
Ngaleso sikhathi babulala eMowabhi abantu abangumakhulu ayisishiyagalombili, bonke abesilisa abanothando; akazange ahambe umuntu.
UMowabhi wabekwa ngaphansi kwabaSirayeli ngalolu suku, futhi izwe laphumula iminyaka eyisibhozo.
Emva kuka-Ehude kwafika uShamgari unyana kaAnathi, owabulala abantu bakaFilisti abangamakhulu amathandathu ngentambo yenkomo; naye wasindisa amaSirayeli.
Kwathi, ngemuva kokufa kuka-Ehude, baphinde bakwenza okubi emehloni kaYehova.
Wabathengisa iNkosi emkhosini kaYabini ukumkani wakwaKanana, owahlala eHazori; umphathi womkhosi wakhe wayenguSisera, owayehlala eHaroshethi Haggoyim.
U-Sisera wayenezimoto zensimbi ezingumakhulu asithoba, wahlasela amaSirayeli ngobuhlungu iminyaka eyishumi nambili. Baphoqa iNkosi ukuba asize.
Ngaleso sikhathi uDebora, umprofeti, indodana kaLapidothi, wayelawula isizwe sakwaSirayeli njengommeli.
Wahlala ngaphansi komnqumo kaDebora, phakathi kweRama neBheteli, ezweni eliphakeme likaEfrayim. Bafika kuye amadodana aseSirayeli ukuba axazulule izinkinga zabo.

Wathumela wabiza uBaraka, unyana ka-Abinoamu, waseKedesh eNaphtali, wathi kuye, UYehova, uNkulunkulu kaSirayeli, uthi, Yiya uhlanganise abantu abangumakhulu ayisishiyagalombili abasuka eNaphtali noZebuloni, ubaveze emfuleni iTabori.
Ngizothikisa uSisera, umphathi wenkosi kaYabini, namabhayisikili akhe namadodana akhe, kuze kube emfuleni iKishon, ngiwubeke esandla sakho.
Wathi yena uBharaki, Uma usuya nami, ngizoya; kodwa uma ungahamba nami, angizokuhambe.
Wathi uDebora: "Kulungile, ngizohamba nawe; kodwa ngeke ube nobudumo kulolu hambo, ngoba iNkosi uzonikela uSisera kuwesifazane." Wahamba uDebora noBharaki waya eKedesh.
UBharaki wahlanganisa uZebuloni noNaphtali eKedeshi; abantu abangumakhulu ayisishiyagalombili babemlandela, waya naye noDebora.
UHebhere, umKenisi, washiya amaKenithi, izingane zikaHobabu, udadewabo kaMoses, wamisa itente lakhe eduze kwe-altare eZaananim, enhliziyweni yeKedesh.
USisera wathola ukuthi uBaraka, unyana ka-Abinoamu, usefike emfuleni iTabhore.
USisera wahlanganisa zonke izimoto zakhe zensimbi, ezingumakhulu asithoba, nabantu bakhe bonke, kusukela eHaroshethe Haggoyim kuya emfuleni iKishon.

Wathi uDebora kuBharaki, Yiya; namuhla wusuku lapho iNkosi abeke khona uSisera esandleni sakho. UNkulunkulu usehamba phambi kwakho. Waphuma ke uBharaki ezweni laseTabhori, namadoda amawaka ayisishiyagalombili emveni kwakhe.
Kwathi lapho ehamba khona uBaraka, iNkosi wavusa uSisera, nazo zonke izimoto zakhe, nezwe lakhe, phambi kweqhwa likaBaraka. USisera wehla esihlalweni sakhe semoto, wabaleka ngenyawo.
UBaraka walandela izithuthi zokulwa, nomndeni kaSisera, waya eHaroshethe-ha-goyim; bonke abantu bakaSisera babulawa ngeqhwa. Akukho muntu osele.
USisera ke wabaleka ngenyawo, waya esitezi sikaJayeli, indodana kaHebhere umKenithi; ngoba kwakungukuthula phakathi kukaYabini ukumkani waseHazori nomndeni kaHebhere.
Waphuma uJayeli, wabhekana noSisera, wathi kuye, Ngeza, nkosi yami, ngeze, ungabi nalo uloyiko. Wafika ke ekhempini yakhe, yathi yena, Yimi ngizowugqoka.
Wathi, "Nceda ungisize amanzi, ngoba nginomkhuhlane." Yavula ibhodlela lobisi, wamnika utshwala, waphinde wamgqoka.
Wathi kuye, Thola umngcele wesitezi; uma umuntu efika ebuza ukuthi, Ingabe kukhona umuntu lapha? Uzothi, Akukho.

UJayeli, indodana ka-Hebhere, yathatha isibopho setente, namahhashi, yafika kuye ngezwi elincane; yena ke wayelele embhedeni, ehloniphekile kakhulu; wabeka isibopho phezu kwekhanda lakhe ezweni, waza wafa.
UBaraka wafika, elandela uSisera. Yayeli yaphuma ibhekane naye, yathi: "Thina, ngizokukhombisa umuntu ofunayo." Waphuma ke yena, futhi ngabona uSisera esefile, umkhonto wetente usesifuba sakhe;
Ngomhla owodwa uNkulunkulu wahlasela uYabini, ukumkani wakwaKanana, phambi kwabaSirayeli.
Amadodana kaSirayeli aqhubeka enamandla kakhulu kuYabini ukumkani wakwaKanana, kuze kube wukuphela kwakhe.
Kwathi ngalolusuku uDebora noBaraka unyana ka-Abinoam bakhuluma lo mdlalo, bethi:
Uma abaphathi baseSirayeli behamba phambili, futhi abantu bezinikela ngokuzithandela, thandani iNkosi!
Yithi, ngikutsheleni, nikumkani; ngikukhulumeni, nibaphathi: Ngizongoma kuYehova, ngizokhuluma ngoNkulunkulu kaSirayeli.
Nkosi, lapho uphuma khona eSeyiri, lapho usuka khona ezweni laseEdomi, izwe lalimaza, amazulu ashaya amanzi, namazulu ashaya amanzi.
Izingqimba zanyamalala phambi kweNkosi, eSinayi, phambi kweNkosi uNkulunkulu kaSirayeli.
Ezikhathini zika-Shamgar, unyana ka-Anath, ezinsuku zikaJayeli, izitezi ezinkulu zazingenalutho. Abahamba ngezinyawo behamba ngemizila emincane.
Ukuphila kwedolobhana kwamiswa e-Israyeli. Kwamiswa kuze kube ngifika, uDeborah, kuze kube ngifika njengomama e-Israyeli.
Bakhetha izitha ezintsha, kwafika ukulwa eziteshini zedolobha. Akukho isigqoko noma isikebhe esibonakale phakathi kwamaphesenti angamashumi amane aseSirayeli.
Intliziyo yami ihamba nabaphathi bakaSirayeli, abanikela ngokuthanda kwabo phakathi kwabantu. Lola iNkosi!
Nibahamba ngezinkomo ezimhlophe, nihlala emigodini ehlelekile, nihamba ngendlela, cabangani ngalolu daba!

Bathi, Ngaphezu kwengxolo yabagibeli, ezindaweni zokugeza amanzi, bakhuluma ngezikhululo zeNkosi, izikhululo zabahlali bakhe baseSirayeli. Ake abantu bakaYehova bakhuphuka befika emigwaqeni yedolobha.
Khumbula, khumbula, uDeborah! Khumbula, khumbula, ubhale ingoma! Khumbula, uBaraka! Thola abasolwa bakho, unyana ka-Abinoam!
Kwathi labo abancane, abaseleyo, bawela kulabo abadume kakhulu; abantu bakaYehova bawela kum, behlasela labo abakhulu.
Bavela ku-Ephrayim, abasuka kuma-Amaleki; basuka eBhenjamin, nabo bonke abantu bakho. Bavela ku-Makhire, abaphathi, nabasuka eZebulun, labo abathwala isibhamu sokumkani.
Abaphathi baka-Issakare babe noDebora. U-Issakare ube noBaraka, ehamba emuva kwakhe ezweni. Emindenini yakwaRubhen kwakukhona ukucabanga okuningi, nokubhekana ngenhliziyo.
Kungani na nihlala phakathi kwezindawo zokudla izinkomo, nilalela izingulube zezinkomo ezivuthayo? Emindenini yakwaRubhene kwakukhona ukukhathazeka okuningi.
UGiliyadi wahlala enyakatho-mpumalanga yeJordani, futhi uDan, kungani uhlala eduze kwezinqanawa? UAshere wahlala emfuleni, wahlala emigwaqweni yakhe.
Kodwa abantu bakaZebuloni, kanye noNaphtali, babeka ubomi babo enhliziyweni yabo.
Bafika amabukhosi, babhekana nokulwa; babhekana nokulwa amakhosi aseKanana eTaanakhe, ngamanzi aseMegido; kodwa abathathenga imali yesiliva.
Izinkanyezi zabhekana nokulwa emkhathini, Zabhekana nokulwa noSisera ezindaweni zabo zezulu.
Umfula i-Kishon wabasusa, umfula omusha, umfula i-Kishon. Yiya phambili, inkanuko yami, ube namandla!
Kwathi amakhowa emahhashi ahlaba umxhwele njengoba amahhashi akhe anamandla ehamba futhi ehamba.
Wathi uMoya oyiNgcwele: "Lahla iMeroshe, lahla abantu bayo ngokujulile; ngoba abafikanga ukusiza iNkosi, ukuze basize iNkosi ngalabo abanamandla.
Ungcwele phakathi kwabesifazane, uJayeli, indodana ka-Hebhere waseKeni; ungcwele phakathi kwabesifazane abahlala ezindlini.
Wacela amanzi, yena wamnika ubisi. Emgodini omuhle waletha i-cream kuye.
Wathatha ngesandla sakhe isibambo sesitezi, futhi ngesandla sakhe sokudla wathatha i-hammer yomqambi. Washaya uSisera, wehlisa ikhanda lakhe, waphula, waphuza icala lekhanda lakhe.
Enyangeni yakhe washaya phansi. Washona futhi wahlala khona. Enyangeni yakhe washaya phansi futhi washona. Kulapho washaya khona, lapho washona khona, efile.
Udadewabo kaSisera wabheka ngaphandle kwefasitela, waphuma emnyango, wathi, Yini ukuthi imoto yakhe ithathe isikhathi eside ukubuya? Yini ukuthi izingulube zemoto yakhe zihamba kancane?
Owesifazane owaziyo kakhulu waphendula yena, futhi wayeqhubeka etshela ngokwakhe,

Bazothola futhi bahlukanise izinto abazithathele: indodana eyodwa noma ezimbili ngaye wonke umuntu, izicathulo ezimibalabala njengento elahlekile kaSisera, izicathulo ezimibalabala ezenziwe ngesandla, izinhlamvu ezimbili zezicathulo ezenziwe ngesandla zengalo yami, zonke zithathwe njengento elahlekile.
Ngalokhu, Nkosi, baphile bonke abakhohlisi bakho; kodwa labo bonke abakuthandela, babe njengelanga lapho liphuma khona enamandla ayo. Nokho izwe laphumula iminyaka engamashumi amane.
Bakwenza ke oonyana bakaSirayeli okubi emehloni kaYehova; wathi, Wabanikela esandleni sikaMidiyani iminyaka eyisithupha.
Aba-Midiyani babenamandla kakhulu futhi banzima, ngakho-ke amaSirayeli akwenzela indawo yokuzifihla emadolobheni, ezindaweni zokugcina izinto kanye nezindawo eziqinileyo.
Ngaso sonke isikhathi lapho abantu bakaSirayeli betshala khona izithelo zabo, amaMidiyani nama-Amaleki, nalabo abavela emazweni asempumalanga, bafika bahlasela.
Bamisa isibhedlela kulolu mhlaba, babulala izithelo, kuze kufike eGaza; abashiyanga noma yini ephilayo ezweni lakwaSirayeli, noma inkomo, noma ingulube, noma idlovu.
Bafika, nabo bonke abantu babo, nezilwane zabo, namakamelo abo, njengamakhoboka akhulu kakhulu; abakwazi ukulinganisa inani labo, namahhashi abo; bafika ezweni, belimaza.
UMidiyani wakwenza amaSirayeli abe mnyama kakhulu, ngaleyo ndlela abaSirayeli baphoqa iNkosi ukuba asize.
Uma amaSirayeli ekhala kukaNkulunkulu ngenxa Midian,
wathumela kubo umprofeti, wathi kubo: Uthi lokhu iNkosi, uNkulunkulu kaSirayeli: Ngizikhuphule nisuka eYiputa, ezweni lendlu yomsebenzi.
Nginisindise ebusweni beMisiya, futhi ngabakhipha esihlalweni senu; ngibasusa phambi kwenu, ngabanika izwe labo.
Nami ngathi kuni, Ngiye iNkosi uNkulunkulu wenu; ningazibophezeli izitha zakwaAmora, ezweni labo nihlala kulo. Kodwa-ke, ningamlalela.
Wafika uMoya oNgcwele, wahlala ngaphansi kwesihlahla sika-Ofra, esibe nguYowashi, ongumzali ka-Abiezer. UGideyon, unyana wakhe, wayewubhaka umnqumo emgodini wotshwala, efuna ukuwufihla kumaMidiyani.
Umbingeleli kaYehova wambona uGideyon, wathi kuye, UNkulunkulu unguwe, wena onamandla amakhulu.

Waphendula uGideyon, wathi, Ngikucela, nkosi yami; uma iNkosi esesikweni lethu, kungani sithole lezi zinto zonke? Zikhona yini zonke izinto ezimangazayo, obaba bethu abakhuluma ngazo nathi, bethi, UNkulunkulu akasisikhuphi ezweni laseYiputa? Kodwa manje iNkosi usishiye, asisidlulise kumadodana kaMidiyani.
Wabhekana naye iNkosi, wathi, Yiya ngesandla sakho esinamandla; uzosindisa amaSirayeli ezandla zikaMidiyani; ngiyakuthumela.
Wathi uGideyon, Ngiyabonga, Nkosi yami; ngizosindisa kanjani isizwe samaSirayeli? Bheka, inkosikazi yami incane kunabo bonke eManase, futhi ngiyindodana encane kakhulu.
Wathi iNkosi kuye, Ngizobe ngikhona nawe; uzowabulala bonke abantu baseMidiyani njengamuntu owodwa.
(Gideon) waphendula wathi: "Uma uthandana nami, nginike uphawu lokuthi wena kuphela okhuluma nami.
Ngiyakucela, ungeke uhambe, kuze ngibuye, ngithole isipho sami, ngisibeke phambi kwakho. Wathi iNkosi, Ngizohlala, kuze ubuye.

Wathi uGideyon, ephuma ngaphakathi, wapheka ingulube encane, futhi wenza amakhowe angabi nenyama; wabeka inyama emgodini, namanzi ebhodweni, wazisa kulowo mqondisi phantsi kwesihlahla se-oak, wanikela ngazo.
Wathi yena uMoya oNgcwele kuye, Thola inyama nenyamakazi, uyibeke phezu kwalo mqolo, uthele isiphuzo phezu kwayo. UGideyon wakwenza njalo.
Wathi umbingeleli kaYehova, ngaso isiphelo sesandla sakhe, wacindezela inyama nenyamakazi; kwaphuma umlilo emhlabathini, wawudla inyama nenyamakazi. Umbingeleli kaYehova wehla, wahamba.
Wabona uGideyon ukuthi iyindodakazi kaYehova, wathi, Akunjalo, Nkosi yami uThixouNkulunkulu, ngibone indodana kaYehova ibhekene nemehlo.
Wathi iNkosi kuye, Kulungile; ungakhathazeki; ngeke uphile.
Wakha khona uGideyon isibingelelo kukaNkulunkulu, wabiza igama layo ngokuthi: UNkulunkulu ngukuthula; likhona kuze kube yimanje eOfra yama-Abiezer.

Kwathi ngobusuku balo, iNkosi wathi kuye, Thola inkomo yomshado kababa wakho, inkomo yesithathu, eneminyaka eyishumi nesishiyagalombili ubudala; phula isibingelelo sikaBahali, esibekiwe ngubaba wakho, uyeke itshe le-Ashera elikhona.
bese ukwakha isibingelelo esifanele kuYehova uNkulunkulu wakho, phezu kwalo mhlaba ophakeme; futhi uthathe inkomo yesithathu, uyinikeze njengesondlo somlilo, ngemithi ye-Ashera oyitshelile.

Wathi uGideyon, ethatha abantu abalishumi phakathi kwabangane bakhe, wakwenza njengokuthi iNkosi kuye; kodwa wayekhathazekile ngenxa yomndeni wakhe, namadoda asedolobhaneni lakhe, wakwenza ngobusuku, akwenzenga ekuseni.
Bavuka abantu bedolobha ekuseni, babona ukuthi isibingelelo sikaBahali sithunyelwe phansi, futhi i-Ashera engaphansi kwayo isiketsheziwe, nengulube yesithathu isetshenziswe esibingeleni.
Baze babuzana, bethi, Ubani owakwenza lo msebenzi? Ke kaloku, lapho befuna futhi bebuza khona, kwathiwa kubo, UGideyon unyana kaYoashi wenza lowo msebenzi.
Bathi abantu bedolobha kuYowashi, Thola unyana wakho ngaphandle, ukuze aphile; ngoba waphonsa phansi isibingelelo sikaBhaali, futhi wehlise i-ashere ekhona.

Wathi uYoashi kubo bonke abantu ababhekene naye, Ingabe nizobhekana noBahali? Ingabe nifuna ukumsindisa? Uma umuntu ebhekana noBahali, uzofa ekuseni; uma uBahali unguThixo, akwazi ukuxosha isandla sakhe, uma umuntu ephula isibambo sakhe.
Wabizwa uGideyon ngalolusuku ngegama elithi Yerub-bhaali, kusho ukuthi: "UBahali abhekane naye," ngoba waphula isibingelelo sikaBahali.
Bahlangana bonke abantu baseMidiyani, namadodakazi aseAmaleki, namaSirayeli aseMpumalanga, badlula iJordani, bamisa isikhashana ezweni laseJezreeli.
Wafika uMoya kaYehova kuGideyon, waphonsa iphoyinti, wababiza abantu base-Abhiezer ukuba balandele.
Wathumela abathunywa ezweni lonke likaManase, wathi kubo: "Niya kumlandela," futhi wathumela ku-Ashere, noZebuloni, noNaphtali; bona nabo bafika ukubhekana naye.
Wathi uGideyon kuThixo, Uma ufuna ukusindisa amaSirayeli ngesandla sami, njengokuthi washo,

bheka, ngizobeka isikhumba sengulube esitezi sokudla; uma kuzoba khona umswakama ebusweni besikhumba kuphela, futhi indawo yonke ibe yimpuphu, khona-ke ngizokwazi ukuthi uzosindisa amaSirayeli ngesandla sami, njengoba usho.
Nokho, lokhu kwakuyiqiniso. UGideyon wavuka ekuseni ngosuku olulandelayo, wacindezela i-fleece futhi wacindezela amanzi abandayo, isitsha esigcwele amanzi.
Wathi uGideyon kuThixo, UNkulunkulu, ungabi nobuhlungu ngami; ngizocela into eyodwa kuphela: ngizozama ingulube kathathu; ngenza ingulube ibe yindilinga, futhi izwe libe lindi.
Wakwenza uNkulunkulu njalo ngalolu busuku; ingulube kuphela eyashisa, kodwa yonke indawo yamanzi.
UYerub-bhahali, okunguGideyon, wavuka ekuseni, yena namadodana akhe wonke, bamisa isikhani eMfula iHarode. Isiqhingi sakwaMidiyani besingasenyakatho yabo, emfuleni, enhliziyweni yeMore.
Wathi iNkosi kuGideyon, Abantu bakho baningi kakhulu kunami, ukuze ngibafake esandlani sabantu baseMidiyani; ukuze isiSirayeli singaba nomsindo ngami, sisithi, Sisindiswe ngesandla sethu.

Ngakho-ke, khuluma emphakathini, usithi: Wonke umuntu okhathazekile, noma onqobile, kufanele abuye, aphume emfuleni iGiliyadi. Basuka abantu abangumashumi amabili nambili amawaka, behlala abantu abangumakhulu amathathu.

Wathi iNkosi kuGideyon, Bakhona abantu abaningi kakhulu; zulazisa emazingeni amanzi, ngizowahlukanisela khona kuwe. Uma ngithi, Lo mntu kufanele ahambe nawe, uzoya; kodwa uma ngithi, Lo mntu ngeke ahambe nawe, ngeke ahambe.
Wathi uGideyon, wakhuphula labo abantu eduze kwamanzi; wathi iNkosi kuye, Yahlukanisa labo abadla amanzi ngolimi lwabo, njengokudla kwenja, nalabo abaguquguqukayo ukudlela.
Abantu abangumakhulu amathathu baphuza amanzi, bewuletha ngezandla zabo emlonyeni wabo; bonke ababoshiwe babhujiswa ukudla.
Wathi iNkosi kuGideyon, Ngalabo abantu abangumakhulu amathathu abaphuza amanzi, ngizokusindisa, futhi ngibamise amaMidiyani esandla sakho; wonke umuntu osele kufanele ahambe ezweni lakhe.
Wathi uGideyon, washiya labo abami baseSirayeli ezindaweni zabo, wagcina labo amashumi amathathu; bathatha ukudla kwabo, namahhashi abo. Isikhulu samaMidiyani sahlala ngezansi kwakhe emfuleni.
Wathi iNkosi kuGideyon ngobusuku balo, Yiya zula eqenjini; ngoba ngilinikela emandleni akho.
Uma ukhathazekile ukuhlasela, zulazula esiteshini sakho kanye nomkhonzi wakho uPurha.

Wathi uSolomoni ku-Abhisalomu, "Njengoba ngikutshela lokho, lalela ukuthi yini abakushoyo; uma bekwenza njalo, uzokwazi ukunqoba icamp." Waphuma yena noPhura, umkhonzi wakhe, wafika esiphethweni se-camp, lapho kwaba khona amaphoyisa.

Bakhona amaMidiyani, nama-Amaleki, nalabo bonke abavela emazweni asempumalanga, bemi emigwaqweni, bafana nezingqungquthela; futhi izingwegwe zabo zaziningi, zafana nenhlabathi enkabeni yolwandle; kwakungekho muntu owazibala.

Wafika uGideyon, lapho umuntu etshela umngane wakhe iphupho lakhe. Wathi, "Nginephupho, ngibona inkomishi yobisi lwesithelo sengulube isuka emgwaqeni waseMidiyani, yahlasela ihholo, lajika, liwela phansi."
Waphendula udadewabo, wathi, Akufanele kube yisandla sikaGideyon, unyana kaYowashi, umSirayeli; uNkulunkulu wabeka esandlani sakhe iMidiyani nesiteji sonke.

Kwathi lapho uGideyon ekhuluma ngalolu phupho, nokuqonda kwalo, wehlise ikhanda lakhe, wathandaza, wabuyela esibhedlela sakwaSirayeli, wathi, Nquma; ngoba iNkosi ubeke isibhedlela samaMidiyani esandla sakho.
Wawahlukanisa amadoda angumakhulu amathathu abe ngamaqembu amathathu, wanikela kuwo wonke umuntu iphoyinti, nebhodlela elisha lodonga, elinesibhakabhaka esingenayo.
Wathi kubo, Ningiboneni, nikwenze lokho engikwenzayo; uma ngifika esiphethweni sendawo yokucampana, niyenze ngokufana nalokho engikwenzayo.
Uma ngiphuza amaphoyinti, mina nalabo bonke abaye nami, niphuze ninamaphoyinti enhliziyweni yesitezi, nithi, UNkulunkulu noGideyon.

Wafika uGideyon, namadoda angumakhulu amabili ahamba naye, esigabeni sesitezi esiphakathi kobusuku, lapho beqala khona ukushintshana kwamaphoyisa; baphuza amaphoyinti abo, baphula izibhodlela ezisezandla zabo.
Baphuza amaphoyinti abo, baphula amabhodlela abo, bethatha izibhamu ngesandla sabo sokudla, namaphoyinti ngesandla sabo sesobunxele, bethi, Ikhebula likaYehova noGideyon!
Wahlala wonke umuntu endaweni yakhe, ngaso sonke isiqhingi sakwaMidiyani; bonke abantu basemikhosini yakwaMidiyani babaleka, begwaza.

Kwathi lapho amabhungane angumakhulu amathathu ephuthuma khona, iNkosi wenza ukuthi amadoda asesitezi abuye abhekene namadodana akhe ngeqhwa; futhi izwe laphuma lihamba kuze kube yiBeth-shitha, liya eTserera, lifike esiphethweni se-Abele-mehola, eduze kweTabhatha.
Amadodakazi kaSirayeli asuka eNaphtali, naseAshere, nakwaManase wonke, ahlangana, alandela amaMidiyani.

UGideyon wathumela abathunywa ezindaweni eziphakeme zakwaEfraim zonke, esithi, Nciphisani ukubhekana nabaMidiyani, nithathe amanzi aseYorodani phambi kwabo, kuze kube yiBeth-bara. Baphuma bonke abantu baseEfrayim, bathatha amanzi aseYorodani kuze kube yiBeth-bara.

Bathatha namadodana ababili aseMidiyani, uOrebhi noZebhebi; babulala uOrebhi eqololweni laseOrebhi, noZebhebi emgodini wewayini waseZebhebi. Balandela amaMidiyani, baletha ikhanda lika-Orebhi noZebhebi kuGideyon, owayeseJordani.
Bathi abantu baka-Ephrayim kuGideyon, Yini le nto oyikwenzele thina? Kungani na ukuthi, uma usuye ukubhekana neMidiyani, ungasibizanga? Baze bakhuluma naye ngothando.
Wabaphendula wathi kubo, Ngikwenze kuphi ngifana nani? Ingabe imbewu ye-Ephrayim engase ibe ngcono kunayo yonke imbewu yomndeni wami, uAbiezer?
UNkulunkulu wabeka ezandla zenu abaphathi baseMidiyani, uOrebhi noZebhebi; yini engikwazi ukuyenza ngaphezu kwenu? Wathi ke, Yaphela inkohliso yabo kuye.
Wafika uGideyon emfuleni iYorodani, wadlula, yena namadodana akhe amakhulu amathathu. Bakhulule kakhulu, kodwa baqhubeka nokulandela.
Wathi kubo bonke abantu baseSukhothi, Nize ninike abantu bami inkomishi yesonka; ngoba belahlekile, futhi ngilandela uZebha noZalmuna, abaphathi bakaMidiyani.
Bathi abaphathi baseSukhothi, Uthathe uZebha noZalmuna yini? Kungani na ukuthi sinike inkomishi imindeni yakho?
Wathi uGideyon, "Uma iNkosi enikela uZebha noZalmuna ngesandla sami, ngizodla inyama yenu ngezinkuni zesihlabathi nezingqimba."
Waphuma khona waya ePhenuyeli, wababuza ngale ndlela; baphendule ngokuthi abantu baseSukhothi babephendula.
Wathi kubo bonke abantu basePhenuyeli, Uma ngibuya ngokuthula, ngizowuvala lo mbhoshongo.

UZebha noZalmuna babe eKarkore, nabo neqembu labo elinamaphesenti angama-15; laba bonke abashiwo emikhosini yamaSirayeli asenyakatho. Babulawa abantu abangumakhulu amabili anamashumi amahlanu abanokhebesi.
UGideyon wehla ngendlela yabahlali besitezi, enyakatho-mpumalanga yeNobha neYogbeha, wahlasela isizwe ngesithakazelo, sabona ukuthi baphephile.
UZebha noZalmuna, amakhosi amabini aseMidiyani, basuka; yena ke wabalandela, wabathatha, wabulala imindeni yabo yonke.
Wabuya uGideyon unyana kaYoashi, esuka emdlalweni, wafika esiqhingini saseHeres.
Wathatha indodana esuka eSukhothi, wabuza umbuzo; yabhala kuye amagama abaholi beSukhothi, namadoda amakhulu abo, abeyizinkulungwane nesishiyagalolunye.

Wafika ke uGideyon kubo bonke abantu baseSukhothi, wathi, Bheka, kukhona uZebha noZalmuna; ningiphoxekile ngalokho, nithi, Ingabe sekuyisikhathi sokuthatha uZebha noZalmuna? Kungani na ukuthi sinike inkomishi abantu bakho abakhubazekile?
Wathatha abakhulu bedolobha, wafundisa abantu base-Sukkoth isifundo ngokuwagwema ngezinhlamvu zomhlaba kanye nezingqimba.
Waphula futhi inkundla yasePhenuyeli, wabulala abantu bedolobha.
Wathi kuZebha noZalmuna, Ubani lowo muntu owabulala eTabhori? Baphendula bathi, Bafana nawe; wonke umuntu ubukeka njengendodana yomphathi.
Wathi uGideyon, Abazalwane bami bebengabantwana bakamama wami; njengoba iNkosi ephilayo, uma nibagcinela ubomi babo, ngingeke ngikususe.
Wabhekana noYetere, unyana wakhe omdala, wathi, Ubulala labo; kodwa akazange asuse ikhebula lakhe, ngoba wayeneminyaka encane, wakhathazeka.
Wathi uZebha noZalmuna, Thola, yenza wena; ngoba umuntu uhlukaniswa ngokunamandla akhe. Wafika uGideyon, wababulala, wathatha amatshe enyanga asuka ezindlebeni zazo izinkomo.
Bathi amadoda aseSirayeli kuGideyon, Uzolawula phezu kwethu wena, nonyana wakho, nonyana womntwana wakho; ngoba usisindise ebusweni bama-Midiyani.
Wathi kubo uGideyon, Ngizobe sengilawula phezu kwenu, naye unyana wami uzobe sengilawula phezu kwenu; iNkosi uzoba ngumphathi wenu.
Kodwa yena wathi, "Nginesicelo esisodwa. Wonke ngamunye wenu nginike i-earring kusuka kuzinto ozithathele empilweni." Kwakungumthetho we-Ismailites ukuba agqoke ama-earrings wegolide.
Bathi: "Sizothanda ukuwanika." Ngakho bakhuphula ihembe, futhi wonke umuntu wabeka umlenze phezu kwayo kusuka lokho athathe.
Ubunzima bezinhlamvu zegolide ebeziwu-20 amakhilogremu, ngaphandle kwemihlobiso nezingcezu nezicathulo ezibomvu ababezigqoka amakhosi aseMidiyani, kanye namabhande emilenze yamagcebo abo.
UGideyon wayenza igolide, wayibeka emzini wakhe e-Ofra; futhi bonke isiSirayeli babhikishela uNkulunkulu ngaleyo nto. Yaba yingozi kaGideyon nomndeni wakhe.
Ngalokho, iMidiyani yahlaselwa ngamadodana aseSirayeli, ayikwazi ukubuyela emuva. Ngosuku lokuphila kukaGideyon izwe laphumula iminyaka emashumi mane.
UYerubahali unyana kaYoashi wabuyela ekhaya lakhe, wahlala khona.
Waba nguGideyon oonyana bakhe abamashumi asixhenxe, ngoba wayenamadodakazi amaningi.
Uwesifazane wakhe, owahlala eShekem, wazala naye unyana, wathi igama lakhe nguAbimeleki.
Wafa uGideyon unyana kaYowashi, eneminyaka emihle yobudala; wabanjwa emgodini kaYowashi ubaba wakhe, eOfra yama-Abiezeriti.
Ke kaloku, ngemva kokufa kukaGideyoni, abaSirayeli babuyela ekuphileni okungalungile, bekhonza amaBaali, bamisa uBaale-berithi njengomdali wabo.
Bakhohlwa iNkosi uNkulunkulu wabo, owabasindisa ezindaweni zabo zonke ezingqondweni.
Bathi: "Akekho umndeni kaYerubhahali, okunguGideyon, abawuthobele, ngenxa yezinto ezinhle zonke azenzayo kuSirayeli.
UAbhimeleki, unyana kaYerubahali, waya eShekem, kwabangane benkosikazi yakhe; wathi kubo, nakwabo bonke abazalwane benkosikazi yakhe, ethi,

Nibuze bonke abantu baseShekem, nithi, Kulungile yini kuwe, ukuthi bonke oonyana bakaYerubahali abamashumi asixhenxe babe ngabaphathi bakho, noma umuntu oyedwa abe ngumholi wenu? Khumbulani ukuthi nginyama yenu namafutha enu.
Bathi abazalwane bakamama wakhe kubo bonke abantu base-Shekem, balandela uAbhimeleki; ngoba besithi, Uyindodakazi yethu.
Banikeza uAbhimeleki amashekeli esiliva ayishumi nesishiyagalombili, asuka ethempelini likaBhaali-berithi; waqasha ngawo abantu abakhohlisi, abengenangqondo, balandela.

Wafika endlwini yobaba wakhe, eOfra, wabulala abazalwane bakhe abamashumi asixhenxe, oonyana bakaYerubhahali, phezu kodonga olulodwa; kodwa uYothamu, unyana omncane kaYerubhahali, waphuma, wafihlakala.
Bahlangana bonke abantu baseShekhemi, nabaseBeth-Milo, esitezi esiphakeme esiseShekhemi, bakwenza uAbhimeleki ukumkani.
Bathi kuYothama, wanyuka esigabeni esiphezulu somfula iGarizim, wathi kubo, Ningilalelani, nibemi baseShekhemi, ukuze uNkulunkulu aniphendulele.
Ngosuku oluthile izihlahla zaphuma, zifuna ukuthi zikhethene ukumkani kubo; zathi ezitshalweni ze-olive, Yiwe ube ngukumkani wethu.
Wathi umnqumo kubo, Ngizoshiya yini uphethiloli wami, obhekwa nguThixo nomuntu, ngiye ngaphesheya kwezihlahla eziphakeme?
Bathi amajikijolo omnqumo, Thola ube ngukumkani wethu.
Isihlahla somnqumo saphendula, sathi kuye, Ngizoshiya kanjani isithelo sami esimnandi nesihle, ngihambe ngihamba phezu kwezihlahla?
Bathi amatshe esihlahla somnqumo, Thola, ube ngukumkani wethu.
Isihlahla sikavini saphendula, sathi kuye, Ingabe ngizoshiya iwayini lami elisha, elithokozisa uNkulunkulu nomuntu, ukuze ngihambe ngaphesheya kwezihlahla?
Bathi izihlahla zonke kulowo mnqumo, Thola ube ngukumkani wethu.

Wathi umnqumo emathinini, Uma ngempela nifuna ukuthi ngibe ngukumkani wenu, nifike niphumule ngaphansi kwesithunzi sami; kodwa uma kungenjalo, khona-ke umlilo ungaphuma kumnqumo, ube yimoto yamatshe eLibanoni.
Manje, ngabe ukwenze ngokweqiniso, futhi ngenhliziyo ethembekile, lapho wenza khona uAbhimeleki ukumkani? Ingabe ube nobulungisa kuYerubhahali nomndeni wakhe? Ingabe wakwenza ngokufanele kuye?
Ngiyakhumbula ukuthi ubaba wami wabhekana nokulwa ngenxa yenu, wamisa impilo yakhe engozini ukuze akusindise ku-Midyan.

Kodwa-ke namhlanje nibuyele emndenini wakwababa wami, nibulala izingane zakhe eziyisixhenxe phezu kwetshe elilodwa, nakwenza uAbhimeleki, unyana wowesifazane wakhe, ukumkani phezu kwabahlali baseShekem, ngenxa yokuthi ungumngane wenu.
Uma ke, namuhla, nikwenzele uYerubhobhaali nomndeni wakhe ngokweqiniso, ngokuthembekile, khona-ke, uphile uAbhimeleki, naye aphile niphila.
Uma kungenjalo, khona-ke umlilo uphume eAbhimeleki, uvale abantu baseShekhemi nabaseBeth-Milo; futhi umlilo uphume ebantwini beShekhemi nabaseBeth-Milo, uvale uAbhimeleki.
Waphuma uYothamu, wabaleka waya eBeeri, wahlala khona; ngoba wayekhathazekile ngenxa ka-Abhimeleki udadewabo.
U-Abhimeleki waba ngukumkani phezu kwaSirayeli iminyaka emithathu.
Wathumela uNkulunkulu umphefumulo ombi, wabangela ukungqubuzana phakathi kuka-Abhimeleki namadodakazi aseShekem; babuya behlasela u-Abhimeleki.
Wakwenza njalo uNkulunkulu, ukuze igazi labo lamadodana ayishumi nesishiyagalombili kaYerubhahali libuyiselwe ku-Abhimeleki, odadewabo, owawabulala, nakwabemi baseShekem, ababemsizala ukukwenza.

Bathi abantu base-Shekem, ukuze bagweme ukubulalana naye, babeka abantu ezindaweni eziphezulu zezindawo eziphakeme, futhi bonke abahamba ngazo bewuthatha wonke umuntu odlula eduze kwawo; kwathunyelwe ku-Abimeleki.
UGaali unyana ka-Ebedi waya eShekhemi, yena nodadewabo; abantu baseShekhemi bathembela kuye.
Baphuma ezindaweni, baqoqa izithelo, bazenza zibe yizipho; bafika ethempelini likaThixo wabo, badla, baphuze, babulala uAbhimeleki.

Wathi uGaali unyana ka-Ebedi, Ubani uAbhimeleki, nobani uShekemu, ukuthi sisebenze naye? Akukabi yini yena indodana kaYerubhahali, futhi akukabi yini uZebulu umphathi wakhe? Basebenzela indlu kaHamori, ubaba kaShekemu; kungani sisebenzele uAbimeleki?
Ngiyafisa ukuthi labo bantu babe ngaphansi kwami, ukuze ngibasuse. Wathi ku-Abhimeleki, Zihlanganiseni bonke abantu bakho, niphume!
