UZebulu, umphathi wedolobhana, lapho elalela khona amazwi kaGaali unyana ka-Ebedi, waphoqa kakhulu.
Wathumela abathunywa ku-Abhimeleki, esithi, Bheka, uGahali unyana ka-Ebedi nabazalwane bakhe bafika eShechem; bona, bewucindezela lo mzi phezu kwakho.
Ngakho namhlanje ekuseni, wena namadodana akho kufanele nifike nifihle emazweni.
Ngobusuku, lapho ilanga liphuma khona, hlasela lo mzi; bese ubona ukuthi uGaali namadodana akhe ephuma ukubhekana nawe, wenze kubo konke okusemandleni.
Waphuma uAbhimeleki ekuseni, naye wonke amakhosi akhe, wafihla eShechem, waba ngamaqembu amane.
UGaali unyana ka-Ebedi waphuma, wahlala emgwaqeni womnyango wedolobhana, lapho uAbhimeleki nomndeni wakhe bephuma khona ezindaweni zabo zokuzifihla.
Wabona uGaali, wathi kuZebulu, "Njengoba abantu bephuma emadolobheni," waphendula uZebulu, "ubona isithunzi samadolobheni, futhi ucabanga ukuthi yibo abantu."
UGaali waphendula wathi, "Njengoba abantu bephuma ephakathi kwezwe, futhi iqembu elinye livela emgwaqweni osuka enkabeni yomnqumo. "
Wathi uZebulu kuye, Kuphi namuhla inkulumo yakho enkulu, othi, Ubani uAbhimeleki, ukuthi sisebenzele yena? Ingabe bangaba yibo abantu obabambisana nabo? Thola uphume ubhekane nabo!
Waphuma uGaali, wathatha abantu baka-Shekem, wabhekana noAbhimeleki.
U-Abhimeleki wamlandela, uGaali wehla, washaya abantu abaningi, bawela kuze kube yilapho kungena khona isango.
Wahlala uAbhimeleki e-Aruma, futhi uZebulu wakhipha uGaali nabazalwane bakhe e-Shekhem, ukuze bangahlali khona.
Kwathi ngosuku olulandelayo, abantu base-Shekem baphuma ezweni; kwabikwa ke ku-Abhimeleki.
Wathatha abantu bakhe, wabahlukanise abe ngamaqembu amathathu, wafihla ezweni; futhi lapho ebona abantu bephuma emzini, wavuka, wahlasela.
U-Abhimeleki neqembu lakhe lafika, lahlala emgwaqeni wokungena edolobhaneni; futhi amaqembu amabili ahlasela labo abasezindaweni zasemaphandleni, wababulala.
U-Abhimeleki wahlasela lo mzi ngalolusuku lonke, wawuthatha, wambulala wonke umuntu ohlala kuwo; wehlisa lo mzi, wayibhaka ngamanzi.
Kwathi lapho abantu baseSikheme, abasesitezi esiphakeme, bekubona lokhu, bafika ezindaweni eziqinile zendlu ka-Elberithi.
U-Abhimeleki wazwa ukuthi bahlangana khona.

Wakhuphuka, yena namadoda akhe onke, waya emfuleni iSalmon; wathatha inkomishi yakhe, wamisa amaqabunga, wabeka ezinyaweni zakhe. Wathi kubo bonke abantu ababenabo, Yize, nikwenze lokho okubona ukuthi ngikwenza.

Bathi bonke abantu, bamisa izihlahla, balandela u-Abhimeleki, babeka phezu kwendlu ephakeme, bayiphonsa emlilweni, nayo yonke idolobhana eliphakathi kwayo. Wafa wonke umuntu ohlala esitezi esiphezulu saseShekem, amadoda nabesifazane ayizinkulungwane.
U-Abhimeleki wahamba waya eThebhesi, wayiqoqa yonke, wayithatha.
Ngaphakathi kwedolobha kwakukhona inkundla eqinile, futhi bonke abantu bedolobha, amadoda nabesifazane, baphuma kuyo, bavala isango labo, banyuka phezulu esitezi senkundla.
U-Abhimeleki waya esitezi esiphakeme, wahlasela isitezi esiphezulu. Wafika emgwaqeni wesitezi esiphakeme ukuze avule umlilo kuso;
Uwesifazane washaya itshe elikhulu lokugaya phezu kwekhanda lakhe futhi waphuca intamo yakhe.
Wathi kulowo omncane ophethe isibhamu sakhe, Nciphisa ikhebula lakho, usindise; ukuze abantu bangathi, Uwesifazane wabulala yena. Wathi lowo omncane wathi kuye, Usindise.
Babona amaSirayeli ukuthi u-Abhimeleki ufile, basuka bonke ezweni labo.
Ngalokhu uNkulunkulu wabuyisela ku-Abhimeleki ububi bakhe, obukwenzela ubaba wakhe, lapho ebulala khona abazalwane bakhe abamashumi asixhenxe.
Futhi uNkulunkulu wababuyisela abantu baseShekhemi ngenxa yobubi babo bonke; kwafika phezu kwabo isibhamu sikaYothamu, unyana kaYerubahali.
Ngosuku luka-Abhimeleki, kwavuka uThola, indodana kaPhuha, indodana kaDodo, wabasindisa isizwe samaSirayeli; wayengumJuda wase-Issakare, wahlala eShamire, ezweni eliphakeme likaEphrayi.
Waphatha isizwe sakwaSirayeli iminyaka eyishumi nambili nesithathu; wafa, wabanjwa eShamiri.
Emva kwakhe kwavela uYahiri waseGileyadi, waba ngumthetho wakwaSirayeli iminyaka eyishumi nambili nambili.
Waba nezingane ezingu-30, abahamba ngezinkomo ezingu-30; balawula ezindaweni eziyisishiyagalombili zaseGiliyadi (zibizwa ngokuthi yizintaba zikaYahiri kuze kube namuhla).
Wafa uYahiri, wabanjwa eKamoni.

Baphinde bakwenza oonyana bakaSirayeli lokho okubi emehloni kaYehova, bekhonza amaBaali, nama-Ashtorethi, nama-Aram, nama-Sidon, namaMowabi, namadodana ka-Amoni, namaFilisti; bashiya iNkosi, bangawusebenzisi.
UYehova wagwema amaSirayeli, wabathengisa emaFilistini nakwa-Amoni.

Ngaleso sikhathi izizwe ezinjalo zahlasela, zabulala amadodana aseSirayeli, iminyaka eyisibhozo nesishiyagalombili, wonke amadodana aseSirayeli ahlala ngaphesheya koMfula iYorodani, eGiliyadi, ezweni lama-Amori.
Badlula namadodana ka-Amoni iJordani, bahlasela uYuda noBhenjamini noEfrayim; futhi amaSirayeli ahlupheke kakhulu.
Baphoqa ke oonyana bakaSirayeli kuYehova, bethi, Siwuhlwele wena; sishiye uNkulunkulu wethu, sakhonza amaBaali.
Wathi iNkosi, Uma befika ama-Egyptians, nama-Amorites, nama-Ammonites, namaFilisti,
Aba-Sidoni, naba-Amaleki, nama-Maoni, baphoqeleka ukuthi banikeze isandla sabo kuwe; futhi wena ukhala ngami, ngingakusindisi yini?
Kodwa-ke, ningishiya, nikhonza amasiko amanye; ngakho-ke ngeke ngikusindise.
Chofoza emadini akho, awazikhethele wena; azokusindisa ngesikhathi sobuhlungu bakho.
Bathi ke oonyana bakaSirayeli kuYehova, Sifile; yenza nathi konke okulungile emehlo akho; kodwa manje sicela usindise.
Basusa izitha zakwamanye amazwe eziphakathi kwabo, bakhonza iNkosi. UNkulunkulu akakwazi ukumelana nokubona isizwe samaSirayeli sihlupheka.
Amadodakazi ka-Amoni aqoqwa, wamisa isibhedlela eGileyadi; futhi amaSirayeli ahlangana, wamisa isibhedlela eMizpa.
Bathi abaholi bezizwe zaseGiliyadi, umuntu nomuntu, ukuthi: Ubani na ozoqala ukulwa nabantu baka-Amoni, uzobe nguMengameli wabahlali bonke baseGiliyadi.
UJephthah waseGiliyadi ube ngumuntu onamandla amakhulu; ubaba wakhe wayenguGiliyadi, futhi udadewabo wayengumfana ohamba ngezinja.
Umfazi kaGileyadi wazala naye izingane, zakhula zikhulu; bakhipha uYephtha, bethi kuye, Awuzothola inkontileka emndenini wethu, ngoba ungumntwana wowesifazane wesizwe.
Waphuma uJephthah ezindaweni zabazalwane bakhe, wahlala ezweni lase-Tobhi. Bahlangana naye abantu ababi, baphuma nabo, behlasela.
Ngaleso sikhathi, ama-Amoni aqala ukulwa nabaSirayeli.
Kwathi lapho, abakhulu baseGiliyadi bahamba, ukuba babuyisele uJephthah ezweni laseTobhi.
Bathi kuye, Thola, ube ngumholi wethu, ukuze sihlangane nabantu baka-Amoni.
Wathi kubo uJephtha, Ingabe ningangixoli, nimimise endlwini yobaba wami? Kungani na ke ukuthi nifike kimi manje, uma nisengozini?
Bathi kubo abakhulu baseGileyadi, Ngenxa yalokho sibuyela kuwe manje; phuma nathi, ubhekane nabantwana baka-Amoni, ukuze ube yinhloko yabahlali bonke baseGileyadi.
Wathi uJephthah, Uma ngibuyela wena ukubhekana namadodakazi ka-Amoni, futhi iNkosi anginikela kuwo, ngabe ngizoba nguMengameli wenu?
Bathi abakhulu baseGiliyadi, UYehova uzoba ngubufakazi phakathi kwethu, uma singakwenza njalo njengoba uthi.
Wahamba uJephthah namadoda amakhulu eGiliyadi, abantu bakwenza abe yinhloko yabo, abe nguMengameli wabo; wakhuluma amazwi akhe wonke phambi koYehova eMizpa.
Wathumela uJephthah abathunywa kuye ukumkani wakwa-Amoni, esithi, Uyini umthwalo wakho nami, wukuthi wafika ukuhlasela izwe lami?

Waphendula ukumkani wakwa-Amoni abathunywa bakaJephtha, wathi, AbaSirayeli bathathe izwe lami, lapho bephuma eYiputa, kusukela eArnoni kuya eYabhoki, kuze kube yiJordani; ngakho namuhla uphinde uzibuyisele ngokuzola.
UJephthah wathumela abathunywa emuva ukumkani wezingane ze-Ammon,
wathi, Lokhu kusho uJephthah: Isirayeli asithathenga izwe lakwaMowabi, noma izwe lakwa-Amoni.
Kwathi, lapho amaSirayeli ephuma eYiputa, bedlula emifuleni yaseGibhithe, bafike emfuleni oMnyama, bafika eKadeshi.

Bathumela abathunywa ukumkani wase-Edom, bethi, Sicela uvumele sidlule ezweni lakho; kodwa ukumkani wase-Edom akakutholi. Bathumela futhi ukumkani wakwaMowabi ngomthetho owodwa, naye akakuvumeli; ngakho bahlala amaSirayeli eKadesi.
Basuka behamba esiqhingini, bajikeleza iEdomu neMowabi; badlula ngasenyakatho yeMowabi, bamisa isikhashana ngaphesheya kwe-Arnoni. Bengafika ezweni lakwaMowabi, ngoba i-Arnoni ibingumkhawulo wabo.
Wathumela amaSihoni, ukumkani wama-Amori, obehlala eHeshboni, wathi kuye: Size sihambe ngezwe lakho, sifike endaweni yethu.
Kodwa uShehoni akakholwanga kuSirayeli ukuba adlule ezweni lakhe; waqoqa wonke umkhosi wakhe, wamisa isibhedlela eYahazi, wabhekana noSirayeli.
Wabeka iNkosi, uNkulunkulu kaSirayeli, uShehoni nomndeni wakhe wonke esandla sakwaSirayeli; babulala bonke abantu bakhe. USirayeli wathola izwe lonke lama-Amori ahlala kulolu lizwe.
Bayithatha yonke, kusukela eArnoni kuya eYabhoki, nasuka esiqhingini kuze kube iJordani.
Ngokuba iNkosi, uNkulunkulu kaSirayeli, wakhipha ama-Amori phambi kwabantu bakhe baseSirayeli; wena ke unelungelo elinjani lokuthatha indawo yabo?
Uzothatha yini lokho okunikezwa nguKemoshi, uNkulunkulu wakho? Ngalokho sizothatha konke okunikezwe nguYehova uNkulunkulu wethu.
Ungcono yini wena kunaBalaka, unyana kaSipore, ukumkani wakwaMowabi? Ingabe wabhekana namakhosikazi aseSirayeli, noma wabhekana nabo?
Iminyaka eyikhulu namashumi amathathu abantu bakaSirayeli behlala eHeshboni, nase-Aroeri, nezifundela zayo, namadolobhana onke asendaweni yaseArnoni; kungani ke ningazithola ngaleso sikhathi?
Ngingeke ngikubisele, kodwa wena ungenza okubi, ngoba uhamba ngami. UYehova, ummeli, agweme namhlanje phakathi kwamadodana kaSirayeli namadodana ka-Amoni.
Nokho ukumkani wakwa-Amoni akazange ayiqonde incwadi kaJephtha, eyamthumela yona.
Wafika uMoya kaYehova kuJephtha, wadlula eGiliyadi noManase, wadlula eMizpa eGiliyadi, wadlula namadodana ka-Amoni.
UJephthah wenza isibopho kukaNkulunkulu, wathi: "Uma unikela izingane zakwa-Amoni esandla sami,
noma yini ephuma emgwaqeni wasekhaya, ifike ngiyihlangane nami, uma ngibuya ngokuphephile ekuphileni namadodana ka-Amoni, izobe yiyo yeNkosi; futhi ngizoyinikela ibe ngumnikelo wokushiswa.
Wahamba uJephthah, wahlasela amadodana ka-Amoni; iNkosi wabanikela esandla sakhe.
Wabulala izizwe ezingu-20, kusukela eAroeri kuya enkabeni yeMinithi, kuze kube yi-Abeli-kerami; wahlasela ngamandla amakhulu. Babekwa ngaphansi kwesandla samaSirayeli.

Kwathi lapho uJephthah efika ekhaya lakhe eMizpa, ngubani na ozophuma ahlangana naye, ngaphandle kwendodana yakhe, edanisa ngosayizi wezinkomo? Waye yena kuphela indodana yakhe. Akekho omunye unyana noma intombi.
Wakubona, waxosha izigqoko zakhe, wathi, Hayi, inkosikazi yami; ungenza buhlungu obukhulu, nobuhlungu obukhulu, ngoba ngibekele iNkosi isibopho, futhi angeke ngiyiphule.
Wathi yena, Ubaba wami, ubulale ithemba kuYehova; ngenza kimi ngokufana nalokho okwenzelayo, njengoba iNkosi ebeke emuva izimpi zakho ezizungeze oonyana baka-Amoni.
Wathi, "Nceda ungisize isikhalazo esisodwa kuphela. Nceda ungisize izinyanga ezimbili ukuze ngihambe emadolobheni nabangani bam futhi ngilile ngoba angikaze ngife."
Wathi, "Ungaya," wavumela ukuba ahambe iminyaka emibini. Wahamba naye nabangane bakhe ezindaweni eziphakeme futhi bakhala ngokuthi ngeke abe nendodana.
Wabuya ubaba wakhe ngemuva kwezinyanga ezimbili, wakwenza kuye njengoba esho. Akekho umuntu owesifazane ayengena naye. Kulokhu kwavela isiko ezweni lakwaSirayeli,
ukuthi ngonyaka ngamunye izimfana zakwaSirayeli ziphuma ngezinsuku ezine, ukuze ziyikhumbula intombi kaJephtha waseGileyadi.

Amadodana ka-Ephrayim ahlanganisa amaqembu abo, adlula eZafoni, wathi kuYephtha, Kungani na ukuthi uhambe ukubhekana nabantu baka-Amoni, ungasikhombiseni ukuthi sizohamba nawe? Sizovala indlu yakho ngaphakathi kwakho.
Waphendula uJephtha, wathi: Nginempi enkulu phakathi kwami nami nomndeni wami namadodana ka-Amoni; ngakubiza wena, kodwa awungisindisi ebusweni babo.
Uma ngibona ukuthi ningangisizanga, ngabeka impilo yami enhliziyweni yami, ngadlula ngibhekane namadodakazi ka-Amoni; futhi iNkosi wandisindisa. Ngabe ke kungani nifika namuhla ningihlasela?"
UJephthah waqoqa bonke abantu baseGiliyadi, wabhekana noEfrayim; futhi amadoda aseGiliyadi awahlasela, ngoba ama-Efrayim ayethi, Nibasubathi abasuka eGiliyadi, nisuka ku-Efrayim nakumaManase.

Amadoda aseGiliyadi athathe iziqhingi zeJordani eziya eEphrayim. Ngaso sonke isikhathi lapho umuntu osuka ku-Ephrayim ekhuluma, ethi, Ngizodlula, amadoda aseGiliyadi ayembuza, ethi, Ingabe unguye u-Ephrayim? Uma esethi, Hayi,

Bathi: "Kulungile, sithi uSibholethe." Uma esho ukuthi uSibholethe, ngenxa yokuthi akakwazi ukuveza igama ngokucacile, bathatha yena, bambulala emfuleni iYorodani. Kwabulawa abantu abangumashumi amane nambili amawaka kuEfrayim ngalo mzuzu.
UJephthah waba ngummengameli wakwaSirayeli iminyaka eyisishiyagalombili. Wafa uJephthah waseGiliyadi, washiswa emzini waseGiliyadi.
Emva kwakhe, u-Ibzan waseBethelehemu waongoza isiSirayeli.

Waba namadodana amashumi amathathu, nezingane ezilishumi elinambini. Wabeka izingane zakhe esikoleni kwabanye abantu ngaphandle kwendlu yakhe; wathola amadodana akhe amantombazane amashumi amathathu ngaphandle kwendlu yakhe. U-Ibsan waba nguMengameli wamaSirayeli iminyaka eyisithupha.
Wafa ke u-Ibzan, wabanjwa eBethelehemu.
Ngemuva kwakhe, u-Elon waseZabuloni waba ngummengameli wakwaSirayeli iminyaka elishumi.
Wafa uElon, wabanjwa eAyaloni, ezweni likaZebulun.
Emva kwakhe, uAbdon, unyana kaHileli, wasePirathoni, waba nguMengameli wamaSirayeli.
Wabe nabantwana abangumashumi amane, nabangani abangumashumi amathathu, abahamba ngezinkomo eziyisixhenxe; waphatha isizwe samaSirayeli iminyaka eyisibhozo.
Wafa uAbdon, unyana kaHileli, wabanjwa ePirathoni, eEphrayim, ezweni eliphakeme lama-Amaleki.
Baphinde bakwenza oonyana bakaSirayeli okubi emehloni kaYehova; iNkosi wabanikela esandla samaFilisti iminyaka emashumi amane.
Kwabe kukhona umuntu okuthiwa nguManawo, waseZora, wesizwe sakwaDan; indodana yakhe yayingenazo izingane, ayizange ikhule.
Wabonakala kuye umbingeleli kaYehova, wathi kuye, Thola ukuthi awunabantwana; kodwa bheka, uzokhulelwa, futhi uzozala indodana.
Ngakho qaphela ukuthi ungadli iwayini, noma uphuze isiphuzo esinobuthi, futhi ungadla nanoma yini engalungile.

Futhi, bheka, uzokhulelwa, uzala indodana, futhi akufanele ikhanda lakhe lifinyelelwe ngentambo; ngoba lo mntwana uzobe Nazirithi kaThixo kusukela emlenzeni wakhe; futhi yena uzoqala ukusindisa amaSirayeli kusuka kumaFilisti.

Waphuma umfazi, waya kumuntu wakhe, wathi kuye, Kwangifika indodana kaThixo; yabona, isithombe sayo safana nesithunywa sikaThixo, samangalisa kakhulu; ngayibuza ukuthi ivelaphi, naye angitshelanga igama lakhe.

Wathi kuye, Khona-ke uzokhulelwa, uzala indodana; ngakho-ke ungadlanga iwayini noma isiphuzo esingcolileyo, futhi ungadli lutho olubi; ngoba lo mntwana uzobe nguNazireli kaThixo kusukela emlenzeni wakhe kuze kube yilapho efa khona.
Wathandaza uManawo kuYehova, wathi, Ngiyabonga, Nkosi yami, ukuthi umuntu kaThixo owathumelelayo aphinde afike kuthi, afundise ukuthi sizokudla kanjani umntwana oza kuza.
UThixo waphendula uManawothi; futhi umprofeti kaThixo wabuya waya kumkakhe, lapho ehlala khona ensimini; kodwa indodana yakhe, uManawothi, akazange abe naye.
Wayehamba ngokushesha, watshela indodana yakhe, wathi, Yabona, lowo muntu owafika kwami mhla kathathu, uvela.
Wavuka uManawo, walandela indodana yakhe, waya kulowo muntu, wathi kuye, Ingabe wena owakhuluma nendodana yami? Wathi yena, Ngami.
Wathi uManawothi kuye, "Uma kwenzeka lokho okushoyo, yini okufanele siyenze ngokuphathelene nalo mfundi?"
Waphendula umbingeleli kaYehova, wathi, Inkosikazi yakho kumele ikwenze konke okungiwiselayo.
Akudingeki ukuthi aphuze lutho oluvela emvini, futhi akudingeki ukuthi aphuze iwayini, noma utshwala, futhi akudingeki ukuthi aphuze lutho olubi; kumele agcine konke engikumwiselayo.
Wathi uManawothi kuyisengathi kaYehova, Nceda ulinde, kuze silungiselele wena inkomo encane.
Wathi uMoya oNgcwele kuye, Nakuba ngihlala, angidla ukudla kwakho; kodwa uma ulungiselela isiphuzo esiqhumayo, uyinike iNkosi. UManawo awazi ukuthi ube yiNkosi yoMoya oNngcwele.
Wathi uManawothi kuyisengathi kaYehova, Ithini igama lakho, ukuze sikwazi ukukuhlonipha uma kwenziwa amazwi akho?
Wathi, "Ngabe ubuza igama lami? Kuyinhle kakhulu ukukuqonda."
Wathi uManawo, athathe inkunzi yengulube, nomnikelo wokudla, wanikela ngazo kuYehova phezu komlilo. UNkulunkulu wenza into emangalisayo phambi kwamehlo kaManawo nomkakhe.
Kwathi lapho umlilo ekhuphuka emgodini wesitezi esiphakade, wanyuka umlingisi kaYehova emgodini. UManowa nowesifazane bakhe bekubona lokhu, bawela phansi ngobuso babo.
Umbingeleli kaYehova akabonakali uManawothi nowesifazane wakhe; ngaleso sikhathi uManawothi waqonda ukuthi ube yimbingeleli kaYehova.
Wathi kunkosikazi yakhe: "Sizofa, ngoba sabona uNkulunkulu!"

Kodwa indodana yakhe yaphendula, ethi, Uma iNkosi efuna ukusibulala, akakwazanga ukuba nesibopho sokudla kwethu nokuphuza kwethu; akakwazanga ukusibonisa zonke lezi zinto, noma ukusitshela konke lokhu.
Uwesifazane wazala indodana, wathi igama lakhe nguSamsoni. Wakhula, futhi iNkosi wamsindisa.
Waqala uMoya kaYehova ukuba khona kuye eMahanaye-Dan, phakathi kweZora neEshtaoli.
Waphuma uSamsoni waya eTimna, wabona khona indodakazi yaseFilisti.
Wabuya, watshela ubaba wakhe nomama wakhe, wathi, Ngibona indodakazi yaseFilisti eThimna; namuhla niyithathe ngiyithathe ibe ngumfazi wami.

Wathi ubaba wakhe nonina kuye, Ingabe ayikho indodakazi efanele phakathi kwabangane bakho, noma phakathi kwabantu bethu bonke? Uzohamba yini wena kulabo baseFilisti abangenakutholwa, ukuze uthathe indodana? Wathi uSamsoni kuyise, Yithole yena kimi; ngoba uyayithanda.
Abazali bakhe babengazi ukuthi lokhu kungenxa kaYehova, ngoba wayefuna ukubhekana nabaseFilisti; futhi ngaleso sikhathi amaFilisti ayelawula isizwe samaSirayeli.
Waphuma uSamsoni nobaba wakhe nomama wakhe, waya eTimna. Bafika emavinini aseTimna, kwabonakalisa ingulube encane isuka emgwaqeni, ikhuluma kuye.
UMoya kaYehova wehla phezu kuka-Shamshon, wamisa ingulube ngezandla zakhe ezimnyama, njengokuthi umuntu amise inkomo encane; kodwa akatshela ubaba wakhe, noma udadewabo, into ayeyenza.
Waphuma, wakhuluma nomkakhe, wathandana naye kakhulu.
Ngosuku oluthile, lapho ebuyela khona ukushada naye, washintsha indawo ukuze abhekane nenyama yengulube. Kuyo kwakukhona inqwaba yamakhowe namafutha omnqumo.

Wathi, "Ingane yami," waphendula yena, "uma ngikutshela ukuthi udadewethu u-Abhimeleki uthathe ingulube, ngizoyidla." Wathi, "Ubaba wami nomama wami bafuna ukuthenga ingulube, kodwa akazange anitshele ukuthi wathatha ingulube emlonyeni wengulube.
Waphuma ubaba wakhe ukuba abone indodakazi yakhe, wakwenza khona isidlo, njengokuba kwaba njalo phakathi kwamadodana.
Kwathi lapho abantu bekubona, bakhetha amadoda amashumi amathathu ukuba abe ngabangane bakhe.

Wathi kubo uSamsoni, Ngizokutshela inkulumo; uma ningichaza kulolu suku oluyisixhenxe lwesidlo sakusihlwa, ngizokunika izigqoko ezimhlophe ezingamashumi amathathu, nezicathulo ezahlukene eziyishumi nambili.
Uma ningangitshelanga, ngizodinga ukuthi ninikele izicathulo ezingu-30 zesikhumba esimhlophe kanye nezigqoko eziyi-30 zokushintshana. Bathi ke kubo: Sebenzisa inkulumo yakho ukuze siyicabangele;
Wathi, Kusuka kulowo odla kwaphuma ukudla, futhi kulowo onamandla kwaphuma okumnandi. Kwaba zinsuku ezintathu bengeke bakwazi ukuveza isixazululo.

Ngosuku oluyisixhenxe, bethi kubo indodana kaShamshon, Thola umyeni wakho ukuba acacisele iphupho lethu; uma engakwenzanga lokhu, sizokusindisa wena nendlu yobaba wakho ngomlilo. Ufuna ukusibulala yini ukuthi uthumelele lapha?

Wathi indodana ka-Shamshon kuye, ethi, Ungikhohlisa; awuthandani nami; ubeke iphupho emphakathini wami, kodwa wawungazitshela. Wathi yena, Ngingeke ngikutshele ubaba wami noma umama wami; kungani ngikutshele wena?
Wathi yena, "Imini eyisishiyagalombili izinsuku ezisixhenxe umkhosi. Ngosuku lwesine, waveza kuye, ngoba wayeqhubeka ukucindezela kuye, futhi waveza umbuzo wakhe abantu bakhe.

Ngosuku oluyisixhenxe, ngaphambi kokuba ilanga liphele, abantu basemzini bathi kuye: Yini emnandi kunamafutha omnqumo? Ingabe yini enamandla kunalelinyoni? Wathi kubo uSamsoni, Uma bekungaba sekuyintombi yami engenhla, ningeke nithole impendulo yombuzo wami.

UMoya kaYehova wehla phezu kwakhe, waya e-Ashkeloni, wabulala abantu abamashumi amathathu, wathatha izinto zabo, wabanika izigqoko zabo labo abachazayo isifinyezo; wabuyela ekhaya lakhe ubaba wakhe, enhliziyweni yakhe igcwele inkohliso.
Nokho indodana ka-Samson yanikezwa omunye wabalingani bakhe, owayengumuntu wakhe ongcono.
Kwathi lapho kuhlanzekile ukuthi imbewu yengulube ivuna, uSamsoni wathatha inkomo encane, waya emndenini wakhe. Wathi, "Ngizoya ekamelweni lakhe." Kodwa ubaba wakhe akazange amvumele ukuba afike.
Wathi: "Ngiqinisekile ukuthi uyamkhohlisa, ngakho ngamnika umngane wakho. Ingabe inkosikazi yakhe encane ayihle kakhulu? Nceda uyithathe endaweni yakhe."
Wathi kubo uSamsoni, Ngalokhu ngizobe sengilungile, uma ngenza okubi kulabo baseFilisti.
Waphuma, wathola izimvu ezimakhulu amathathu; wazibopha ingulube ngengulube, ngamadodakazi amabili, wabeka isibhakabhaka kulowo mntwana.
Wamisa amabhande, wakhipha izimvu ezihamba phambili phakathi kwezinkomo zakwaFilisti; wabulala izinkomishi zokudla okuthosiwe, nezinkomo ezihamba phambili, namachibi e-olive.

Bathi amaFilisti, Ubani owakwenza lokhu? Baphendula bathi, USamsoni, umngane wowesifazane waseTimna; ngoba indodakazi yakhe yanikezwa umngane wakhe. Baye ke amaFilisti, babulala yena nobaba wakhe ngomlilo.
Wathi kubo uSamsoni, Ngokuba nikwenze lokhu, ngeke ngiphumule, kuze kube yilapho ngibuyele ekuphileni kwenu.
Wabahlasela, wabulala abantu abaningi phakathi kwabo; waphuma ke, wahlala emgodini weqhwa lase-Etham.
Bafika amaFilisti, bamisa isibhedlela ezweni laseYuda, basakazeka eLehi.
Bathi abantu baseYuda, Yini na ukuthi nifike nibhekane nathi? Baphendula bathi, Siye safika ukubopha uSamsoni, ukuze sikwenze njengoba esenze kuthi.

Kwathi abantu abangumakhulu amathathu baseYuda bahla embuzweni weqhwa lase-Etham, bathi kuShamshon: Awazi yini ukuthi amaFilisti alawula phezu kwethu? Uthini lo msebenzi owenza kuthi? Waphendula uShamshon, wathi, Ngabe ngibasebenzela njengokuba bengisebenzele?
Bathi kuye, Sifike ukukubopha, ukuze sikunikeze isandla sakwaFilisti. Wathi uSamsoni, Ngicela, zinikele ngami ukuthi ningangibulala nizo.
Bathi kuye, Siyavuma. Sizokubopha nje, futhi sizokulethela kubo; kodwa asikubulalanga. Bawubopha ngentambo ezimbili ezisha, bawuphakamisa ehlathini, waphuma lapho, waya ezweni laseSirayeli.

Wafika eLehi, kwathi amaFilisti aphuma emveni kwakhe, eshaya ngamandla. UMoya kaYehova wehla phezu kwakhe, futhi izibopho ezimilenzeni zakhe zashintsha zibe njengezinkuni ezishisayo, zisuka ezandleni zakhe.
Wathola ikhanda elisha lengulube, walimaza abantu abangu-elilodwa ngalo.
Wathi uSamsoni, Ngiziguqule zibe izidumbu ngemilenze yengulube, ngizibeke izingcezu phezu kwezingcezu; ngemilenze yengulube ngabulala abantu abangumakhulu.
Kwathi lapho eqedile ukukhuluma, wakhipha ikhanda lakhe; ngakho kwabizwa igama lesi sifundazwe ngokuthi iRamat-lehi.
Uthe: "Uwenzile umkhonzi wakho lo kubuyiso olukhulu; manje ngizofa yini ngendlala, futhi ngifike enhliziyweni yalabo abangenakulinganiswa?"

UNkulunkulu wavula indawo encane eLehi, amanzi aphuma kuyo. Lapho uSamsoni edla khona, amandla akhe abuyela emuva, futhi wayezizwa ephila kabusha. Ngakho kwabizwa ngokuthi i-En Hakkore, okusho ukuthi i-Spring of the Caller. Ikhona eLehi.
USamsoni waphatha isizwe sakwaSirayeli iminyaka eyishumi nambili, ezikhathini zabaFilisti.
Ngosuku olulodwa uSamson wahamba waya eGaza, lapho ebona khona indodakazi yowesifazane, waphuma wahlala naye.

Bathi abantu baseGaza, besithi, USamsoni usekhona. Bangabaleke khona ezindaweni ezishisayo, babhekane naye yonke ibusuku emgwaqeni wedolobhana; futhi bangene ngokuthula wonke ubusuku bonke, bathi: Uma kuphele isibhakabhaka sizowubulala.

USamsoni wahlala khona kuze kube sebusuku obuphakathi. Wavuka, wabamba amasango emnyango wedolobhana, namahlombe amabili, wavula amehlo akhe ngazo zonke izingxenye zawo; wazifaka ezinyaweni zakhe, wazisa phezulu emfuleni obhekene neHebrone.
Isikhathi esithile ngemuva kwalokho, wathandana nowesifazane eValley of Sorek okuthiwa uDelila.

Bafike kuye abaphathi bamaFilisti, bathi kuye, Khangela, uma ungamxhumanisa nawe, ukuze akutshele ukuthi yikuphi amandla akhe amakhulu, nokuthi singawunqoba kanjani, ukuze sikwazi ukuwubopha, futhi sikwazi ukumsindisa; sizokunika wonke umuntu wethu amashekeli ayikhulu nesishiyagalombili egolide.
Wathi uDalilaya kuSamsoni, Ngicela, ngisazise ukuthi yikuphi amandla akho amakhulu, nokuthi ungaboniswa kanjani.
Wathi uSamsoni kuye, Uma umuntu engibophe ngezingcezu eziyisixhenxe zezinkomo eziluhlaza, ezingabi ziqhekekile, khona-ke ngizoba mncane, ngifana nomuntu onje.
Bathi abaphathi bamaFilisti bakulethela izintambo ezimnyama eziyisixhenxe, ezingabi zimanzi; wagwema uDavide ngazo.

Wathi yena kuye, "Samson, amaFilisti baya phezu kwakho!" Kodwa wavala intambo yakhe ngesandla sakhe, njengokuba intambo ivala uma ifika ezungeze umlilo. Ngakho isifihla-buso sekhono lakhe akazange akwazi ukubona.
Wathi uDalida ku-Samsoni, Ungikhohlisa; bengixosha. Manje ke, ngikucela, utshele ukuthi ungaboshwa kanjani.
Wathi, "Uma kukhona umuntu uveza ngamandla ngentambo ezintsha ukuthi akazange asebenzise, ngizobe encane njengenoma ubani."
Wathatha uDalida intambo ezintsha, wamkhonze ngazo. Wathi kuye, "AbaFilisti baya kuwe, uSamsoni!" Kodwa yena wasusa izintambo ezisuka emilenzeni yakhe, wazenza zibe yizintambo zocingo.

Wathi uDalilaya kuSamsoni, "Ungikhohlakele ngalezo zinsuku zonke, futhi ungikhohlisa; tshelani ukuthi ungaxhunywa kanjani." Wathi yena kuye, "Uma unquma ukubopha izinwele zami ezisixhenxe emgodini wakho, bese uzicindezela ngezinkinobho, khona-ke ngizoba mkhulu njenganoma yimuphi umuntu."
Wayehlala ephumula, wabeka izinwele zakhe emlonyeni wakhe, wazigqugquzela ngentambo. Yathi kuye: "USamsoni, abaFilisti baya kuwe!" Wavuka embhedeni wakhe, wakhipha intambo noboya bemikhono yakhe.
Wathi kuye, Ungathi kanjani ukuthi, Ngikuthandela, uma ungenasiqiniseko ngami? Lokho wusuku lwesithathu ukuthi ungikhohlisa, futhi awufuni ukungitshela isizathu sokuzinikela kwakho okukhulu.
Wayeqhubeka nokwenza ubuhlungu kuye ngosuku ngalunye kuze kube yilapho etholakale enesifo sokufa.

Wathi yena kuye, "Akukho mshini wokugqugquzela ikhanda lami; ngoba ngiyiNazirisi kaThixo kusukela enyameni yami; uma ngigqugquzelwe ikhanda lami, khona-ke amandla ami azondishiya, futhi ngizobe sengincane njenganoma yimuphi umuntu."

Wabona uDalida ukuthi waveza kuye zonke izinto zakhe, wathumela kubaholi bamaFilisti, esithi, Yeni namuhla; ngoba angitshela zonke izinto zakhe. Bafika khona abaphathi bamaFilisti, bethwala imali ngesandla sabo.
Yathi: "Uzohlala kuphi?" Wathi yena: "Ngizohlala kuphi?" Wathi: "Uzohlala kuphi?" Wathi: "Uzohlala kuphi?"
Wathi, USamsoni, abaFilisti baphikisa kuwe. Wavuka embhedeni wakhe, wathi, Ngizophuma ngalezo zinsuku zokuqala, futhi ngizikhulise; kodwa akawazi ukuthi iNkosi ubemshiya yena.
Bathi amaFilisti amthatha, baphuca imehlo akhe, bamthabatha waya eGaza, bamkhonze ngezingcingo zegolide, wabeka emgodini wokugcina izinto.
Kodwa-ke, izinwele ekhanda lakhe zaqala ukukhula futhi ngemuva kokuba zikhishwe.
Bahlangana abaphathi bamaFilisti, ukuba balungiselele isibingelelo esikhulu kuDagoni uNkulunkulu wabo, futhi ukuthi baphumule; ngoba bethi, UNkulunkulu wethu unikeze esandla sethu uSamsoni umfowabo.
Kwathi lapho abantu bekubona, babonga uNkulunkulu wabo, bathi: "UNkulunkulu wethu ubeke emandleni ethu umfowabo wethu, lowo obulalayo izwe lethu, nommelwane wethu omkhulu.
Bathi, uma inhliziyo yabo isendaweni ephakeme kakhulu, bathi: "Thindani uShamshon, ukuze adlala nathi!" Bemwisela uShamshon emgodini, wadlala kubo; babeka phakathi kwezinhlamvu.
Wathi uSamsoni kulowo mfundi owenza isandla sakhe, Nquma ukuthi ngizibonele izikhonkwane ezigcina indlu, ukuze ngizibeke phezu kwazo.
Indlu yayigcwele amadoda nababhishobhi; bonke abaphathi bamaFilisti babekhona, futhi esitezi kwakukhona abantu abangamakhulu amathathu amadoda nababhishobhi abheka uSamsoni.

Wathandaza uSamsoni kuYehova, wathi, Ngiyabonga, Nkosi yami uThixouNkulunkulu, ngingathandabuzi ukungikhumbula; ngiyakucela, Nkosi yami uThixouThixo, ngibe nokuzibophezela ngaleso sikhathi nje kuphela, ukuze ngibuyele ngamehlo ami amabini emaFilistini ngesandla esisodwa.
USamsoni wehlisa isandla sakhe, wafinyelela emikhondweni emibini ephakathini, eyayiyisisekelo sendlu, wabeka isandla sakhe sokudla phezu kwesinye sazo, nesandla sakhe sobunxele phezu kwesinye sazo.

Wathi uSamsoni, Ngizofa nami nabaseFilisti; washaya ngesandla sakhe samandla wonke, futhi ithempeli lawela phezu kwabaphathi kanye nabantu bonke abangaphakathi kulo. Wabulala abantu abaningi ngesikhathi sokufa kwakhe kunalapho ephila khona.

Baye ke abazalwane bakhe, nendlu yonke yobaba wakhe, bewuthatha, bawuthwala, bawufihla emgodini kaManowa ubaba wakhe, phakathi kweSora ne-Eshtaoli. UShamshon waba ngummeli wakwaSirayeli iminyaka emashumi mahlanu.
Kwabe kukhona umuntu okuthiwa nguMikha, owayehlala ezweni lemifula ka-Ephrayim.

Wathi kunkosikazi yakhe, "Umuntu uthathe kusuka kuwe amashekeli ayikhulu nesishiyagalombili egolide, futhi ngakulalela ukuthi unqume lo mshayeli; namuhla ngithole lemali, ngiyitholile." Unkosikazi wakhe waphendula wathi, "UNkulunkulu akubabaze wena, mwana wami!"

Wathi uSirayeli kuyise: "Imali enjalo ngiyinikela kuYehova, umngane wami, ukuze enze itshe elicwebezelwe ngegolide; ngakho-ke manje ngiyibuyisele kuwe." Wathi uSirayeli kuyise: "Imali enjalo ngiyinikela kuYehova, umngane wami, ukuze enze itshe elicwebezelwe ngegolide.
Wayibuyisela isiliva emnene wakhe. Wathi umnene wakhe, athathe ama-shekeli ayikhulu amabili, wamthumela kulowo osebenza ngegolide, wakwenza ngazo isithunzi; safakwa endlwini kaMika.
UMikha wayene-altare, wakwenza i-ephod nezinhlamvu zasekhaya; wamisa omunye wabonyana bakhe abe ngumpristi wakhe.
Ngaleso sikhathi, kwakungekho ukumkani ezweni lakwaSirayeli; wonke umuntu wayekwenza okulungile emehlo akhe.
Kwaba khona umuntu omncane waseLevi osuka eBethlehem, emzini wakwaYuda, osuka emndenini wakwaYuda, wahlala khona.
Washiya uBhetheleyimu waseYuda, efuna indawo yokuhlala kuyo; wafika ekhaya likaMikha ezweni eliphakeme laseEphrayimi.
Wathi kuye uMika, Uvela phi? Waphendula wathi, NginguLevi osuka eBhethele-yimu yaseYuda, ngifuna indawo yokuhlala kuyo.

Wathi kuye uMika, Uhlale nami, ube ngubaba wami nombingeleli wam; futhi ngizokunikela ngeshekeli eziyisithupha zesiliva ngonyaka ngamunye, nokugqoka izicathulo kanye nekudla kwakho. Wenza njalo lo mLevi.
Wavuma uLevi ukuba ahlale naye; waba ngumuntu omncane njengomunye wabantwana bakhe.
UMika wamisa uLevi, lo mshado waba ngumpristi wakhe, wahlala ekhaya lakhe.
Wathi uMikha: Manje ngiyazi ukuthi iNkosi uzongilungisa, ngoba lo mLevi ube ngumpristi wami.
Ngaleso sikhathi kwakungekho ukumkani eSirayeli, futhi ngaleso sikhathi isizwe samaDani safuna indawo esihlala kuyo; ngoba asikaze sithole inkontileka phakathi kwezizwe zakwaSirayeli.

Bathumela abantu abahlanu, amadodana kaDan, emindenini yabo, amadoda anamandla amakhulu, kusukela eZora ne-Eshtaoli, ukuba ahlolisise izwe, ukuze athole ukuthi linjani. Bathi kubo, Yezani niphenye izwe. Bafika emadolobheni amahle aseEfraim, baphumula ekhaya likaMika.
Bafika efulethini likaMikha, bakwazi ilizwi lowesifazane waseLevi; bafike bethi kuye, Ubani owakulethela lapha? Yini oyenza kulo mhlaba? Kungani na ukhona lapha?
Wathi kubo lokho akwenzele uMikha, wathi, "Ungiqeshile, ngibe ngumpristi wakhe."
Bathi kuye: "Njengoba sicela uNkulunkulu wethu, uma uhambo lwethu lulungile."
Wabaphendula umbingeleli, wathi kubo, Yiya ngokuthula; indlela yenu ibhekene noNkulunkulu.

Basuka ke labo bantu bomibili, bafika eLayisi; babona ukuthi abantu baseLayisi behlala khona ngokunethezeka, ngokwendlela yabaSidoni, bekhululekile futhi bephephile; babe nezinto zonke ezidingekayo kubo, kwakungekho muntu owenza lutho olubi kubo. Behlala kude nabaseSidoni, abazange benze noma yini nanoma ubani.
Baye bebuyela eSora nase-Eshtaoli, futhi abahlobo babo babuza labo bantu, bathi, Utholani yini?
Bathi kubo, Yeza, sizobhekana nabo; thina sabona izwe, ukuthi lihle kakhulu. Kungani na ke nihlala khona? Musani ukulindela; chofoza, nithathe izwe.
Uma ufike khona, uzothola abantu abakwazi ukucabanga lutho, futhi izwe libanzi; futhi Allah uyinikeze ezandla zenu, izwe elinokuningi kunalokho okufunayo.
Basuka ke eSora ne-Eshtaoli abantu abangumakhulu ayisishiyagalombili, abalungiselelwe ukulwa, besuka ezweni likaDan.
Kwathi lapho behamba khona, bamisa isicampu eKiriyati-yearimi ezweni laseYuda; ngakho kwabizwa igama lesicampu saseKiritayi-yearimi ngegama elithi Mahane-dan kuze kube manje.
Basuka khona bahamba befika ezweni eliphakeme lika-Ephrayim, befika endlini kaMikha.

Bathi labo bantu abahlanu abasuke bebhekele izwe laseLayisi, kubazalwane babo, bathi: Ingabe niyazi ukuthi esinye sezindlu ezinjalo sine-ephod, ne-teraphim, nesithombe esicwebezelwe, esigqokwa ngegolide? Ngakho-ke qaphelani ukuthi yini okufanele niyenze.
Basuka khona, befika endlwini yowesifazane waseLevi, endaweni kaMikha, bacela usizo kuye.
Amadoda angumakhulu ayisishiyagalombili aseDani, agqoke izikhali zokulwa, ahlala emgwaqeni wokungena.
Amadoda amane asuke ebhekele izwe, afike, athathe isithunzi, ne-ephodi, nezidalwa zasekhaya; kodwa umbingeleli wahlala emgwaqeni wesango, nalabo abantu abangumakhulu amathandathu abagqoke izikhali.
Bafika endlwini kaMika, bathatha isithunzi, ne-ephod, nama-teraphim, kanye nesithombe segolide. Wathi kubo umbingeleli, Nikwenzani lokhu?

Bathi kuye, Khumbula, ungasho lutho; hlangana nathi, ube ngubaba wethu nombingeleli wethu. Akulungile yini ukuthi ube ngumbingeleli wezwe lonke nendlu yonke yamaSirayeli, noma ukuba umbingeleli wendlu kamuntu oyedwa?
Wajabula umbingeleli kakhulu, wathatha i-ephod, nezinhlamvu zendlu kaThixo, nomfanekiso ongcwele, waya phakathi kwabantu.
Babuye basuka, bebeka izingane zabo, izilwane zabo kanye nempahla yabo phambi kwabo.
Basuka behamba kude kakhulu nendlu kaMikha, bahlangana abantu abahlala eduze kukaMikha, bafinyelela amadodana kaDan.
Kwathi, lapho bekhuluma kulandelana kwabo, abantu bakaDan babuyela emuva, bathi kuMikha: Uyini umehluko phakathi kwakho nomuntu othile, wukuthi umeme abantu bakho ukubhekana?
Wathi yena, Nithathe amadini ami engiwenzayo, namabhishobhi ami, nisuka; yini engase ngiyithole? Ingabe ukhuluma ukuthi, Kuphi okubi kuwe?
Bathi abantu baka-Dan, "Ungagxeki nathi, ukuze abanye abantu abakhohlakelayo bagweme wena, futhi wena nomndeni wakho ulahlekelwa ubomi bakho.
Baye ke abantu bakaDan behamba ngendlela yabo. Wabona uMika ukuthi banamandla kunaye, wabuya waya ekhaya lakhe.
Bathi ke bona, bathathe izinto azenzayo uMikha, nakubabhishobhi wakhe, bafika eLayisi, kulabo bantu abaphilile, abangasazi lutho; babulala ngaso isandla sekhephu, bamisa umzi wabo.

Akukho muntu owabasiza, ngoba behlala eduze neSidon, futhi abazange babe nokuxhumana nanoma ubani ongaphandle kwalowo mzi. Ube efulethini eliphakathi kweBethe-Rehobhi. Bawukwakha lo mzi, bahlala khona.
Babiza igama lakhe ngokuthi iDan, ngokusho kwegama likaDan ubaba wabo, owesifazane waseSirayeli; kodwa kuqala igama lomzi lalinguLayish.
Wathi uYonathan, unyana kaGershoni, unyana kaMoses, naye nomndeni wakhe babe abapristi ezweni laseDani, kuze kube yilapho izwe lithunyelwe emgodini.
Baqhubeka besebenzisa isithombe esifana nomlilo, uMikha abesenza, yonke isikhathi lapho indlu kaThixo ibe eShilo.
Ngaleso sikhathi kwakungekho ukumkani eSirayeli. Kwaba khona umLevi ohlala ezindaweni eziphakeme zaseEphrayim, wathatha indodakazi yowesifazane waseBethelehemu yaseYuda, waba ngumkakhe.
Yathi yena, iphikisane naye; yaphuma kuye, yabuyela endlwini yobaba wakhe, eBethelehemu yaseYuda. Yahlala khona izinyanga ezinhlanu.

Umfazi wakhe waphuma waya kuye, ekhuluma naye ngothando, ecela ukuba abuye. Wathatha nomkhonzi wakhe, namadodakazi akhe amabini. Wayemthwala endlwini yobaba wakhe; futhi ubaba wakhe, lapho ekubona khona, wamjabulela.
Nokho ubaba wakhe, oyise wesifazane, wamkhuthaza ukuba ahlale naye. Wahlala naye iminyaka emithathu, edla, edla, ephumula khona.
Ngosuku lwesine bavuka ekuseni, waqala ukuphuma. Wathi ubaba wowesifazane kundodakazi yakhe, Ukudlale kuqala, ukuze ube nenhliziyo enamandla; bese uzama ukubuyela.
Bahlala khona bedla, baphuze ndawonye. Wathi ubaba wendodakazi: "Njengoba uhlale lapha ekuseni," waphendula yena, "uzoba nokuthula."
Kwathi lapho lo mntu evuka esuka khona, ubaba wakhe wesifazane wamkhuthaza ukuba ahlale khona, wahlala khona nalolo busuku.
Kwathi lapho evuka ngobusuku obuyisihlanu ukuba ahambe, ubaba wakhe wathi kuye, "Ukudla, futhi uqinise inhliziyo yakho; ulinde kuze kube semini." Badla khona bonke.

Wavuka lowo muntu, naye umngane wakhe, nomkhonzi wakhe, ukuba ahambe. Wathi ubaba wakhe-ke, ubaba wesifazane, ukuthi, Bheka, kufike isikhathi sokuphumula; ngikucela uhlale lapha ekuseni, ngoba usuku luphelile; hlala, ujabulele impilo yakho, bese uphuma emini, uye ekhaya lakho.
Wathi lowo muntu, engathandanga ukuphumula ekuseni, wavuka, waya eJebhusi (lapho iJerusalema likhona), naye namadodakazi akhe amabini, nenkosikazi yakhe.
Bafika eJebhusi, futhi usuku lwadlulile. Wathi umkhonzi kunkosi wakhe: Yiya, sihlale ekuseni kulo mzini wamaJebhusi, ukuze siphumule.
Wathi umnikazi wakhe, Akufanele sifike edolobhaneni lakwamanye amazwe, lapho kungekho abantu baseSirayeli; kodwa sizohamba kuze kube yiGibeha.
Wathi ke, Yeza, sifike eGibeha noma eRama, sihlale ekuseni ngalinye lalawo madolobha.
Baye behamba, futhi ilanga laphuma, bafika eGibiha, elingumBenjamini.
Bahlala khona eGibeha, baphumula khona. Baye behlala emgwaqeni womuzi; kodwa kwakungekho muntu owawuzowathatha ekhaya ukuze baphumule.
Kwathi ngobusuku, kwafika umuntu omdala osuka emsebenzini wakhe ezindaweni ezishisayo; lo muntu uvela emadolobheni asogwini lwaseEphrayim, wahlala eGibeha; abantu bendawo babenguBenjamin.
Kwathi lapho ebheka khona, wabona umuntu ohamba ngebhayisikili esitezi sedolobhana. Wabuza ukuthi: "Uyaphi? Uvela phi?"

Wathi kuye, Sihamba sisuka eBhetheleyimu yaseYuda siye ezindaweni eziseduze zendawo entaba-mlilo kaEfrayim, lapho ngihlala khona; ngafika eBhetheleyimu yaseYuda, futhi manje ngiya endlini kaYehova; kodwa akukho muntu ongithathe ekhaya.
Sinezinkomo zethu imbewu nokudla, futhi sinenkomishi newayini nathi, nami umkhonzi wakho, nalowo mfundi ohamba nathi; akukho lutho esiludingayo.
"Ukwamukela ekhaya lami," kusho indodana encane. "Ngizobhekana nanoma yini oyidingayo. Kodwa-ke, awudingi ukuchitha ekuseni esitezi."
Wathi ke yena, wamngenisa endlwini yakhe, wamisa izinkomo zakhe; futhi bahlamba izinyawo zabo, badla, baphuze.

Futhi lapho bedlala khona, bona, abantu ababi edolobhaneni layo, bahlanganisa ikhaya, futhi baphoqa umnyango, watshonalela umuntu omdala, umnikazi wendlu, wathi, "Uzokhipha indodana yakho, owafika ekhaya lakho, ukuze sihlale naye."
Waphuma umnikazi wendlu, wathi kubo, Akunjalo, abazalwane bami, ningabi nalutho olubi; lo muntu ungumngane wami; ungenzi lokhu okubi.
Bheka, inkosikazi yami, indodakazi yami, nowesifazane wakhe; ngizobakhipha lapha kuwe; ukwenze konke okuthandekayo enhliziyweni yakho kubo; kodwa kulowo muntu akufanele wenze lutho olubi.
Amadoda awathandanga ukumlalela. Wathatha uLevi indodakazi yakhe, waphuma waya kubo; bona bayamshaya, bayambulalana naye yonke imini, kuze kube yilapho kuvuka khona, beyawushiya.
Usuku lufika, wabuyela uwesifazane ekhaya lapho umnikazi wakhe ehlala khona, wawela emgwaqweni, wahlala khona kuze kube yimini.
Wavuka unkosikazi wakhe ekuseni, wavula umbhoshongo wendlu ukuba ahambe indlela yakhe, yabona indodakazi yakhe encane ilele emgwaqweni wokungena, izandla zayo zisesigabeni somnyango.
Wathi kuye, Thola, sihambe. Kwangasekho impendulo yakhe; wamisa udadewabo phezu kwebhodlela lakhe, waphuma waya ekhaya.
Kwathi lapho efika ekhaya lakhe, wathatha isikebhe, wayihlukanisa ibe yizingxenye ezingu-12 ngazo zonke izingxenye zayo; wabathumela kuwo wonke amazwe aseSirayeli.

Wathi wonke umuntu okubonayo, omunye nomunye wakhe, Akukaze kwenzeke noma kubonakale lokhu, kusukela ngosuku abaSirayeli baphuma khona ezweni laseYiputa. Kuze kube manje, kufanele senze okuthile; sikhuluma!
Baphuma bonke amadodana aseSirayeli, asuka eDani kuya eBheri-shebha, kanye nezwe laseGiliyadi, bahlangana ndawonye njengomuntu owodwa phambi koYehova eMizpa.
Bathi abaholi bezizwe zonke zamadodana kaSirayeli, bafike engqungqutheleni yomphakathi kaThixo; kwaba ngumakhulu amane amawaka abantu abahamba ngezinyawo, abagqoka isandla.
Bathe amaBhenjamini ezwa ukuthi abantu bakaSirayeli bafike eMizpa, bathi kubo: Sitshele ukuthi kwenzeka kanjani lokhu okubuhlungu.
ULevi, indodana yowesifazane obulawayo, waphendula wathi, Ngiye eGibeha yaseBhenjamini, mina nenkosikazi yami, ukuze siphumule.
Bafika abantu baseGibeha emini, bengilandela, bajikelezisa indlu, befuna ukungibulala; futhi babhikishe indodakazi yami yowesifazane, yafa.
Ngayithatha, ngayiqoqa, ngayithumela emazweni onke aseSirayeli; ngoba bekwenze lokhu okubi nokungathandeki eSirayeli.
Manje ke, nikhulumeni, nitsheleni ngithi yini, bonke abantu bakaSirayeli.
Baphuma bonke abantu, besuka ndawonye njengendoda eyodwa, bethi, Akukho muntu ozayo ekhaya lakhe phakathi kwethu; akukho muntu obuyela endlini yakhe.
Le yinto esizoyenza eGibeha; sizonyuka siyihlasele, njengokuthi isinqumo sisho.

Sizothatha abantu abalishumi emashumini kuwo wonke amazwe kaSirayeli, futhi umuntu omakhulu ezigidini, nomuntu okhulu kumakhulu ayisishiyagalombili, ukuze bathuthe izinto ezidingekayo emkhosini; futhi uma umkhosi ufika eGibeha yaseBhenjamini, bazowubulala ngenxa yobugebengu bonke obubekiwe eSirayeli.
Bahlangana bonke amadoda aseSirayeli emzini, ehlanganisana njengendoda eyodwa.
Izizwe zakwaSirayeli zathumela abantu kuzo zonke izizwe zikaBhenjamin, zithi, Yini le ngozi enkulu eyenziwe phakathi kwenu?
Ngokuba namuhla, banikelani labo bantu ababi baseGibeha, ukuze sibashise, futhi sisuse lokhu okubi emazweni aseSirayeli. Amadodana kaBhenjamini akazange aphendule kulabo amadodana abo aseSirayeli;
Basuka emizini yabo, bahlangana eGibeha, ukuba bahlangane namadodana kaSirayeli.

Bathi amakhosi aseBhenjamin, emini leyo, baqoqa emazweni abo abantu abangumakhulu ayisishiyagalombili namashumi amabili anesithandathu amawaka, abanesandla esinamandla, ngaphandle kwabahlali baseGibeha abangamakhulu asixhenxe.
Ngaphakathi kwabo bonke abezobe bekhona amadoda amashumi ayisishiyagalombili akhethiwe, abasekhohlo; ngaye ngamunye wabo wayekwazi ukushaya itshe ngesandla sakhe esisodwa, futhi angabi nephutha.
Ngaphandle kukaBhenjamini, amaSirayeli aqoqe abantu abangumakhulu amane amaphesenti, bonke abaqeqeshiwe.
Baya eBhetheleli, babuza uNkulunkulu, bethi, Nguwubani phakathi kwethu ozohamba kuqala ukubhekana noBenjamini? Waphendula iNkosi wathi, UYuda uzohamba kuqala.
Kwathi ekuseni kwavuka amaSirayeli, bamisa isikhashana eGibeha.
Baphuma amaSirayeli, babhekana nabantu bakaBhenjamini, bamisa isikhundla sokulwa nabo eGibeha.
Baphuma abantu bakaBhenjamin eGibeha, babulala amadodana kaSirayeli amashumi amabili nambili amawaka emgwaqeni ngalolusuku.
Amadodakazi aseSirayeli, eqinisa amehlo abo, babuyela endaweni yabo, lapho babehlala khona ngosuku lokuqala.
Baphuma ke amadodana aseSirayeli, bavuma phambi koYehova kuze kube sebusuku; babuza iNkosi, bethi, Ingabe sizobuyela ukuyobhekana noBenjamini, odadewethu? Waphendula iNkosi wathi, Yeka ukubopha.
Kwathi ngosuku olulandelayo, abaSirayeli bafika bahlasela uBhenjamin.
Amadodana kaBhenjamin aphuma eGibeha, awabhekane nabo ngaleso sikhathi; babulala abantu baseSirayeli abangumakhulu ayisishiyagalombili anamashumi asibhozo. Bonke labo abagqoka ikhebula.

Baye ke bonke amadodana aseSirayeli, izwe lonke, bafika eBhetheleli, bekhala khona phambi koYehova; baphumula ngalolusuku kuze kube sebusuku, banikela ngenhlanhla ngomnikelo wokushiswa nomnikelo wokuthula kuYehova.
Baye babuza amadodana aseSirayeli iNkosi ukuthi angakwenzani. Ezikhathini zalo, ibhokisi lesivumelwano sikaThixo lahlala khona,

futhi uPhinehasi, unyana ka-Eleazaru, unyana ka-Aron, wahlala phambi kwayo. Bathi ke kubo: Ingabe sizobuyela ukubhekana nomndeni wethu, oonyana bakaBhenjamin, noma sizoyeka? Waphendula iNkosi wathi, Yiya; ngoba kusasa ngibanikela esandla sakho.
Wabeka amaSirayeli abantu abafihlakele eGibeha yonke.
Ngosuku lwesithathu benyuka babhekana namadodakazi kaBhenjamin, bamisa isikhundla esibhekene neGibeha, njengokuba babekwenzele ngaphambili.

Baphuma amadoda aseBhenjamini abhekane nabo, waqhutshwa esuka kulo mzi; baqala bebulala abantu baseSirayeli, njengangaphambilini, ezindaweni ezivulekile, nasezinxanxatheleni, enye ihamba eBheteli, nenye ihamba eGibeha, abantu abangumashumi amathathu.
Bathi abantu bakaBhenjamini, Sizowahlasela njengaleso sikhathi sangaphambilini. Amadodana kaSirayeli athi, Siyahamba, siyisuse idolobha ezindaweni zokuhamba ngezinyawo;
Basuka bonke amadoda aseSirayeli ezindaweni zabo, bamisa amaqembu abo eBhaali-thamari; futhi abantu baseSirayeli abafihlakele baphuma ezindaweni zabo enyakatho yeGibeha.
Kwathi lapho, amashumi amabili amawaka amadoda amakhulu eSirayeli wahlasela Gibeah. Ukulwa kwaba nzima kakhulu, futhi abantu Benjamini awazi ukuthi ingozi yafika.
UYehova wahlasela uBhenjamin phambi kwaSirayeli, futhi amaSirayeli abulala abantu abangumashumi amabili anesihlanu anamakhulu ayisishiyagalombili eBhenjamin ngalolu busuku, bonke abagqoka ikhanda.
Amadodana kaBhenjamin akubona ukuthi bahlaselwe; ngoba amadoda aseSirayeli ayewashiya amaBhenjamini, thisha abantu ababezifihla eGibeha.
Bathi labo abafihlakele, bafika eGibeha ngaso sonke isikhathi, basakazeka, babulala bonke abahlala kulo mzi ngeqhwa.
Amadodakazi kaSirayeli ayesho nalabo abafihlakeleyo ukuthi bazothumela umsindo omkhulu osuka kulo mzi, njengophawu.
Amadoda aseSirayeli abuyela emuva emdlalweni; futhi amaBhenjamini ayeqala ukuhlasela amadodana aseSirayeli, abe ngamaphesenti angama-30. Bathi ke: Sizowabulala njengasempini yokuqala;
Kwathi lapho isibhakabhaka somlilo siqala ukunyuka ezweni, abantu bakaBhenjamin babheka emuva, bebona ukuthi isibhakabhaka sezwe lonke sikhuphuka esibhakabhakeni.
Amadoda aseSirayeli abuyela kubo, futhi amadoda aseBhenjamini akhathazekile; ngoba bebona ukuthi ubuhlungu bufike kubo.
Baye babaleka phambi kwamadodana aseSirayeli, besuka esiqhingini; kodwa abakwazi ukuphuma emdlalweni. Amadodana aseSirayeli aphuma emizini yabo, waqala ukuwabulala khona.
Babhekene nabantu bakaBhenjamini, baphoqeleka ukuba bahambe eduze kwabo, futhi baphazamiseka kakhulu ezindaweni ezisentshonalanga yeGibeha.
Bafa abantu abangu-18 baseBhenjamini, bonke abesilisa abanamandla.
Amanye amaSirayeli abuye, wabaleka waya esiqhingini, waya emfuleni i-Rimon. Babulala abantu abangumakhulu amahlanu emigwaqweni, balandela kuze kube yiGidomu, babulala abantu abangumakhulu amabili.
Ngawo wonke amaBhenjamini abulawa ngalolusuku abantu abangu-25 abagqoka ikhebula, bonke abesilisa abanothando.
Ke kaloku abantu abangumakhulu amathandathu babuyela, babaleka besuka ezweni laseNdiya, befika emfuleni iRimoni; bahlala eMfuleni iRimoni iminyaka emihlanu.
Baphinde babuyela ezweni likaBhenjamini, babulala zonke izingxenye zazo ngesandla sekhephu, nabantu, nenyama, nanoma yini ebeyitholayo; futhi yonke idolobhana labo lafika kulo, lalibabula ngomlilo.
Amadodakazi aseSirayeli abeke isibopho eMizpa, bethi, Wonke umuntu wethu ngeke anikeze intombi yakhe indodana kaBhenjamin.
Bahamba abantu, bafika eBheteli, behlala khona phambi kukaThixo kuze kube sebusuku, bekhala ngezwi elikhulu kakhulu.
Bathi, Nkosi, uNkulunkulu kaSirayeli, kungani kwenzeka lokhu kuSirayeli? Kungani ke ukuthi kube nezwe elilodwa eliseSirayeli namuhla?
Ngosuku olulandelayo, abantu bavuka ekuseni, bakwakha khona isibingelelo, banikela ngenhlanhla ngomnikelo wokushiswa, nenhlanhla yokuthula.

Bathi ke amadodana aseSirayeli, Nguwubani phakathi kwezizwe zonke zamadodana aseSirayeli ongeke afike engqungqutheleni phambi koYehova? Bebebeke isibopho sokuthi wonke umuntu ongeke afike phambi koYehova eMizpa, kumele aphele.
Bathi ke amakhosikazi aseSirayeli, bakhathazeka ngenxa yabangani babo, amadodana kaBhenjamin, bathi: Namuhla kutholwe isizwe esisodwa eSirayeli.
Ngabe sizothola kanjani abesifazane labo abashiwo, uma sesivumile ngeNkosi ukuthi asize sibe nendodana yethu ibe ngumfazi wabo?
Bathi ke, Yimiphi imiphakathi yamaSirayeli engafikanga kuYehova eMizpa? Bebona ukuthi akukho muntu osuka eYabhesi-gileyadi owafika emgodini ukuze ahlangane.
Bathe babala abantu, futhi bona, kwakungekho muntu eJabhesi-Gileyadi.
Bathuthela khona abantu abangu-12, abakhethiwe phakathi kwamadodana abo, bethi kubo: "Niya eYabhesi iGiliyadi, nibulala wonke umuntu ohlala kuyo ngeqhwa, nabesifazane nezingane.
Bathi: "Kulokhu okufanele ukwenze," bathi, "ukubulala wonke indoda nowesifazane oneminyaka engamashumi ayisishiyagalombili ubudala.
Bathola phakathi kwalabo abahlala eYabheshi-gileyadi amadodakazi angamakhulu amane, angeke abe nowesifazane, bawathatha waya esibhedlela eShilo, ezweni laseKanana.
Kwathi ibandla lonke lithuthela ezweni laseBhenjamini, bekhuluma nabo ngokuthula, ehlathini leRimoni.
Babuya ke abantu bakaBhenjamin ngaleso sikhathi, banikezwa abesifazane baseYabhesi-Gileyadi, labo ababoshwe; kodwa kwakungekho okunembile kubo bonke.
Bathi abantu bakhathazekile ngoBhenjamini, ngoba iNkosi ubewenza isikhala phakathi kwezizwe zakwaSirayeli.
Bathi abakhulu bebandla, Amadodakazi aseBhenjamini abulawe; kungani sizothola amadodakazi kwalabo abaseleyo?
Bathi, "Kumele kube nomzali kulabo abasele eBhenjamini, ukuze isizwe esiseSirayeli singasuswe."
Kodwa-ke, asikwazi ukuwanika izingane zethu ukuba zibe ngamadodana; ngoba sithe sathi, Ubani na onikela indodakazi yakhe kuBhenjamin?
Kodwa bona, kukhona isikhumbuzo sonyaka sikaNkulunkulu eSilo, esisenyakatho yeBhetelehem, enyakatho-mpumalanga yendlela esuka eBethelehem iye eShechem, nasenyakatho yeLebona.
Bathi ke kumadodana kaBhenjamini, Yeza ufihla ezindaweni zokutshala izithelo
bese ubheka, lapho izintombazane zaseShilo ziphuma zidlale, zulazula ezindaweni zokutshala iwayini, nithatheni wonke umuntu indodakazi phakathi kwabesifazane baseShilo, niye ezweni likaBhenjamin.

Uma ubaba babo noma abazalwane babo bafika bekhala nathi, sizothi, 'Nceda ube nobulungisa kubo ngenxa yethu. Siyazi ukuthi asizange sithathe amadoda labo emdlalweni, futhi awunikeze izingane zakho kubo; ngakho akuyona iphutha lakho ukuphula isivumelwano sakho.' "

Bakwenza njalo amadodana kaBhenjamin, wathatha wonke umuntu owesifazane wesifazane esidlangalaleni, wamthatha abe ngumfazi wakhe; babuyela ezweni labo, baphinde bakwakha imiphakathi yabo, bahlala kuyo.
Kwathi lapho, abaSirayeli basuka khona, bebuyela ezweni labo, wonke umuntu ezweni lakhe, kuwo wonke umndeni wakhe.
Ngaleso sikhathi, kwakungekho ukumkani ezweni lakwaSirayeli; wonke umuntu wayekwenza okulungile emehlo akhe.
Ruth: Ngosuku lwama-Israyeli, lapho amajaji elawula khona izwe, kwakukhona undlala ezweni. Wahamba umuntu othile waseBethelehemu yaseYuda, wahlala ezindaweni zaseMowabi, yena nowesifazane wakhe, nabantwana bakhe ababi.

Igama lomuntu lalinguElimeleki, negama lenkosikazi yakhe nguNaomi, namagama oonyana bakhe ababili nguMahloni noKilyoni; babe yimi Ephrathi abasuka eBethlehem yaseYuda. Baye emazweni aseMowabi, bahlala khona.
Wafa uElimeleki, indodana kaNaomi; washiywa yena nonyana bakhe ababi.
Bathatha izingane zakwaMowabi; igama elilodwa liyi-Orpa, elinye liyi-Ruthi. Bahlala khona iminyaka eyishumi.
futhi uMahlone noKilyone bafa. UNaomi washiywa kuphela, ngaphandle kwabantwana bakhe ababi kanye nomkakhe.
UNaomi, lapho ehlala khona eMowabhi, walalela ukuthi iNkosi usevele waveza isipho sakhe abantu bakhe; wavuka ke yena nabangane bakhe ababili, babuyela ezweni laseMowabi.
Waphuma khona lapho ehlala khona, yena nezingane zakhe ezimbili ezincane, wathatha isinqumo sokubuyela ezweni lakwaYuda..
Wathi uNaomi kuzinkanyezi zakhe ezimbili, Yeni nibuye, inene ngayinye endlwini yomkakhe; iNkosi anibonise inhlonipho, njengokuba ningabonisi inhlonipho kubantu benu abafileyo, nami.
UYehova aninikeze nihlale ndawonye endlu yowesifazane omusha. Wathi uSirayeli, "Ngubani na lowo muntu?" Yathi, "Ngingu-Abrahama."
Bathi kuye: "Akekho, thina sizobuyela nawe ezweni lakho."
Wathi uNaomi, Yeni, izingane zami; kungani ningahamba nami? Ingabe ngizothola abanye oonyana ukuba babe amadodana yenu?
Yiya ekhaya, izingane zami. Ngikhulu kakhulu ukuthi ngibe nowesifazane othile. Nakuba ngicabanga ukuthi kukhona ithemba lami, nakuba ngibe nowesifazane ngoLwesihlanu futhi ngazala amadodana,
Ingabe ungeke ulinde kuze bakhule? Ingabe uzohlala ungashadile ngenxa yabo? Akunjalo, izingane zami, ngoba inhliziyo yami ibuhlungu kakhulu kunenu; ngoba isandla sikaYehova sisemandleni ami.
Wathi u-Orpa, ephoqelela inkosikazi yakhe; kodwa u-Ruthi waqhubeka naye. U-Orpa wathi ku-Ruthi: "Kulungile.
Wathi uNaomi, Yabona, inkosikazi yakho ibuyela kubomi bayo, noNkulunkulu wayo; buye ulandele inkosikazi yakho.

Wathi uRuthi, Ungangitshela ukuthi ngikushiye, noma ukuthi ngibuye ngakho; ngoba lapho uzoya khona ngizoya, futhi lapho uzohlala khona ngizohlala; abantu bakho bazoba ngabantu bam, noNkulunkulu wakho uzoba uNkulunkulu wam.
Ngizofa lapho ufile khona, futhi ngizibulale khona; iNkosi angihloniphe ngalokhu, angihloniphe ngokunye, uma kukhona okuzomisa wena nomi ngaphandle kokufa.
UNaomi, lapho ebona ukuthi uRuthi unesinqumo sokuthi ahambe naye, wayeka ukumcela.
Bahamba ke labo madoda amabili, kuze bafike eBethelehemu; futhi lapho befika khona, idolobha lonke laqhutshwa ngenxa yabo; kwathi amabhishobhi: Ingabe uNaomi lo?
Wathi kubo, Musani ukungibiza ngokuthi uNaomi; ngisabizwa ngokuthi uMara, ngoba uNkulunkulu Onamandla onke ungenza impilo yami ibe nobuhlungu.
Ngiye ngigcwele, kodwa iNkosi ungibuyisele ngingenalutho. Yini ukuthi ningazibiza ngokuthi nguNaomi? UNkulunkulu ukhuluma ngami; lowo Onamandla onke ungenza kube nzima kum."
Wabuya ke uNaomi eMowabhi, naye noRuthi umMoabithi, indodakazi yakhe; bafika eBhetheleyimu lapho kuqalwa khona ukuvuna isobho.
Wabe uNaomi unenkosikazi yomndeni wakhe, ebizwa ngokuthi nguBowazi, indodana ka-Elimeleki, indoda enamandla.
Wathi uRuthi, isiMowabhi, kuNaomi, Ngizophuma ngiya ezweni, ngiqoqe izithelo ezishisayo, ngemuva komuntu ongithandela. Wathi uNaomi kuye, Iya, inkosikazi yami.
Waphuma ke, waqala ukuqoqa ezindaweni ezingaphansi kwalabo abavuna; kwathi lapho ethola khona isitshalo sikaBowazi, owesifazane wase-Elimeleki, waqala ukuqoqa.
Ngalokhu uBhohazi efika eBethlehem, wathi labo abavuna: UYehova abe nani. Baphendula bathi: UYehova akubabaziseni.
Wathi uBhohazi kulowo ophethe izisebenzi zakhe, Ubani lo mfana?
Waphendula lo muntu, wathi, Lowo nguwesifazane waseMowabhi, owabuya noNaomi eMowabi.

Wayethi, 'Nceda ngizoqoqa izithelo ezishisayo phakathi kwamabhande angaphansi kwalabo abasebenzayo.' Yafika ezweni, yaqhubeka isebenze kusukela ekuseni kuze kube manje, ngaphandle kokuphumula okuncane emgodini.
Wathi uBhoazi kuRuthi, Ngikutshele, inkosikazi yami; ungaya ezweni elilodwa ungenzi isivuno, futhi ungasuka lapha, uhlale nabangani bami.
Uzobona lapho amadoda avuna khona, bese ulandela ngemuva kwabesifazane. Ngithi kumadoda ukuthi angakuthintani; futhi uma uthandana, ungaya uphuze amanzi ezitsheni abantu abagcwele. "
Uthe yena, "Injani le nto oyenzayo, ukuthi ungazizwa ngami, nami sengumzweli?"

Waphendula uBhohazi, wathi: Kuroziboshwa kimi konke okwenzele umkakhe, kusukela lapho indodana yakho iphele; ukuthi washiya ubaba wakho nomama wakho, nezwe lakho, waya kwabanye abantu ongawazi ngaphambilini.
UYehova akuhlole umsebenzi wakho, futhi ukhokhelwe ngokugcwele nguYehova, uNkulunkulu wakwaSirayeli, owafika ukuzohlala ngaphansi kwamaphiko akhe.
Wathi yena, Ngatholakele inhlonipho phambi kwakho, nkosi yami; ngoba ungisindisele, futhi ukhuluma ngothando nomkhonzi wakho, nakuba angiyena umkhonzi wakho.

Wathi yena uBhohazi, ngesikhathi sokudla, Hamba uye lapha, uphuze inkomishi yenkomo, uyifake emlilweni. Yase ihlala ndawonye nalabo abavuna, wanikela kuyo izithelo ezithosiwe; yadla konke okufunayo, futhi kwashiya okusele.
UBowashi wathi kulabo abahamba naye, Uma evuka eqoqa izithelo, ayisekho ubuhlungu kuye; uma ephuma eqoqa izithelo phakathi kwezinkomishi, angeke abe nobunzima.
Naphezu kwalokho, khipha ezinye izihlahla zakhe ezisuka emigodini futhi uzishiye aze azithole. Ungamtshela ukuthi ahambe."
Wathi uRuthi, waqoqa izithelo ezweni kuze kube sebusuku; washaya imbewu yakhe, yafika ibe ngamakhilogremu ayisishiyagalombili.
Wathi uRuthi, uma efika enkabeni yedolobha, inkosikazi yakhe yabona ukuthi waqoqa kuphi. URuthhi naye wakhipha, wamnika okushiwo uRuthi, ngemuva kokuba ephuze.

Wathi udadewabo, "Uyaphirozi?" Udadewabo wathi kuye, "Uyaphi udadewabo?" Wathi udadewabo, "Uyaphi udadewabo?" Udadewabo wathi, "Udadewabo," waphendula uRubheth, "ukhuluma ngomuntu osebenza naye; igama lakhe nguBhowazi.

Wathi uNaomi kunkosikazi yakhe,rozibopheke yena iNkosi; ngoba akazange agweme ukukhombisa uthando lwakhe kubantu abaphilayo nalabo abafileyo. Yathi yena, Lo muntu ungumngane wethu othile, futhi ngumunye wabahlobo bethu, uzosilungisa.
Wathi uRuthi umMowabhi, "Uthi futhi kuye: 'Qhubeka nabangani bam, kuze baqedele yonke imbewu yami.' "
Wathi uNaomi kuRuthi inkosikazi yakhe, Kulungile kuwe, intombi yami, ukuba uhambe nalabo abasebenza naye, ukuze ungabi necala ezweni lomuntu othile.
Wahlala ke uRuthi eduze kwamadodakazi kaBowazi, eqoqa izithelo, kuze kube sekuphele ukuvuna imbewu yeshubhu nokudla kwengulube; wahlala naye nomkakhe.
Wathi uNaomi, umkakhe kaRuthi, kuye, Inkosikazi yami, ngizokuthola indlu lapho uzohlala khona, ukuze uhlale khona.
UBowazi, owesifazane owasebenza naye, ungumngane wethu; namuhla uzoba ehlukanisile imbewu nofulawa emgodini wokulima.
Ngakho, ukugeza, futhi ugqoke iphunga, futhi ugqoke izicathulo zakho ezingcono kakhulu. bese uya esitezi sokudla; kodwa akusho ukuthi uzokwazi ukuthi ukhona, kuze kube sekuphele ukudla notshwala.
Uma ephumula, qaphela indawo lapho ephumula khona; bese uya, uvule izinyawo zakhe, uphumule; yena uzokutshela ukuthi yini ongayikwenza.
Waphendula uRuthi wathi, Ngizokwenza konke okushoyo.
Wayehamba ehlathini lamahhashi, wakwenza konke owesifazane wakhe wayemtshela ukuthi akwenze.
UBhohazi, lapho eqedile ukudla nokuphuza, waphuma, waya embhedeni, wahlala eduze kwengcindezi yengulube. Wafika uRuthi ngokuthula, waveza izinyawo zakhe, walala.
Ephakathi kobusuku, kukhona okungenzeka ukuthi kube yingozi kulowo muntu. Ushintshile, futhi kwakukhona indoda ehlala emadolo akhe!
Wathi yena, Ngiwubani wena? Wathi yena, Ngami uRuthi umkhonzi wakho; cindezela phezu kwami isibambo sendwangu yakho, ngoba ungumzali wami, futhi ungangisindisa.
Wathi yena, UYehova akubabale wena, intombi yami; le nto yothando ingaphezu kwayo yonke eyangaphambilini; ngoba awuzange ulandele abancane, noma abakhulu noma abancane.
Ngakho manje, inkosikazi yami, ungakhathazeki; konke okushoyo ngizokwenza kuwe; ngoba bonke abantu edolobhaneni lami bayazi ukuthi wena uwesifazane onengqondo.
Kuyiqiniso ukuthi ngiwumuntu ovikela imindeni yenu angakusindisa, kodwa kukhona omunye umuntu onemindeni eminingi engifana nayo.

Uhlale lapha ekuseni, uma efuna ukukwenza umsebenzi wakhe wokuvikela imindeni yakho, kulungile. Ake akubuyisele wena; kodwa uma engathandanga, njengoba unguNkulunkulu ophilayo, ngizokwenza. Uhlale lapha kuze kube kusasa.
Wahlala emadolo akhe kuze kube ekuseni, wavuka ke ngaphambi kokuba umuntu akwazi ukuwaqonda. Uthe yena, "Akukho muntu ozokwazi ukuthi indodana ifike esitezi sokudla."
Wathi ke yena, Nciphisa ngezansi isigqoko sakho, futhi ubeke phezu kwayo. Yakwenza njalo; wafaka kuyo amaphesenti ayisishiyagalombili embewu yengulube, wayibeka phezu kwayo, wabuyela edolobhaneni.
Wafika uRuthi kunkosikazi yakhe, wabuza uNaomi, ethi, Kube kanjani, inkosikazi yami? Yathi ke yena kuye zonke izinto azenzayo yena uBowasha.
Wathi, "Unginikeza lezi zinkomishi eziyisishiyagalombili zezinkomo, wathi: 'Ungaya kunkosikazi yakho ngesandla esingenalutho.'"
Wathi uNaomi, Uhlale lapha, intombi yami, kuze wazi ukuthi kwenzekani; ngoba lo muntu ngeke aphumule, kuze kube sekuphele le nto namuhla.
UBhohazi wehla emnyango, wahlala khona; kwafika udadewabo owaziwayo, wathi kuye: "Hlela lapha, nkosikazi yami, uhlale." Wahamba ke, wahlala khona.
Wathi uBhohazi, ethatha abantu abalishumi phakathi kwabakhulu bedolobhana, wathi, "Nihlale lapha." Bahlala khona.
Wathi kulowo olawula imindeni, ethi, UNaomi, owabuya eMowabhi, uthengisa inqwaba yembewu, eyayingu-Elimeleki, umngane wethu.

Ngicabanga ukuthi kufanele ngikutshele ngakho, futhirozindela ukuthi uyithengise phambi kwalabo abantu abahlala lapha, kanye nangaphambili kwezikhulu zabantu bam. Uma ufuna ukuyithenga, yenza njalo; kodwa uma awufuni ukuyithenga, khuluma nami, ukuze ngikwazi. Akukho muntu onelungelo lokuyithenga ngaphandle kwakho, futhi mina ngilandelayo emgqeni." Wathi: "Ngizoyithenga,"
Wathi uBhoazi, Ngosuku oluthile lapho uthenga khona imbewu kuNaomi, kufanele uthathe noRuthi isiMowabhi, indodakazi yowesifazane, ukuze igama lowesifazane ligcinwe phezu kwempahla yakhe.
Kulesi, umndeni ovikela wathi, "Ngakho-ke angikwazi ukuyithenga, ngoba ngizobeka imali yami engozini. Ungayithenga wena ngokwakho. Angikwazi ukuyenza."

Ezikhathini ezedlule eYisrayeli, lokhu kwakuyisiko lokubuyisa kanye nokuhweba ngempahla: ukuze kube yiqiniso, umuntu owodwa wasusa isiketi sakhe futhi wamnika omunye. Lokhu kwaba yindlela izinqumo zakwenziwa ngayo eYisrayeli.
Wathi umphathi wendlu kuBowazi, Yithenge wena. Wakhuphula khona isigqoko sakhe.
Wathi uBhoazi kwabakhulu, nakubo bonke abantu, Niyibo abavikeli namuhla, ukuthi ngithengise yonke into ka-Elimeleki, neKilyoni, neMahloni, esandla sikaNaomi.

Ngiyathenga futhi uRuthi umMowabhi, indodana kaMahloni, ukuba ube nguwesifazane wami; ukuze igama lokufa ligcinwe phezu kwempahla yakhe, ukuze igama lakhe lingagcini emndenini wakhe, noma edolobhaneni lakhe. Niyisihlalo namhlanje.

Bathi amadoda amakhulu, nalabo bonke abantu erozina isango, Siyishushisi; iNkosi akwenze indodakazi yakho efika ekhaya lakho ibe njengoRakeli noLeya, abasungule ikhaya lakwaSirayeli; ube nempumelelo eEfrata, ube negama eBethlehem.
Umndeni wakho ube njengomndeni kaPerezi, owazalwa nguThamari kuYuda, ngenxa yabantwana abazokunika iNkosi ngalo mntwana.
Wathatha uBhoazi uRuthi, waba nguwesifazane wakhe. Wathandana naye; futhi iNkosi wamvumela ukuba akhulelwe, wazala indodana.
Bathi amadodana akhe kuNaomi, Kuhloswe iNkosi, ongeke akushiyele wena namuhla umngane womndeni, ukuze kube negama lakhe eSirayeli.
Uzowuvuselela umphefumulo wakho, futhi uzoba ngumlingani wakho emshadweni wakho; ngoba inkosikazi yakho, oyithandayo wena, engcono kuwe kunezingane ezisixhenxe, ikhulela yena.
Wathi uNaomi, wathatha ingane emlenzeni wakhe, wamsiza.
Bathi amadodana abo, UNaomi unendodakazi; babiza igama lakhe ngokuthi u-Obedi. Wabe nguyise kaYese, owayengubaba kaDavide.
Lokho wumndeni kaPerezi: uPerezi waba ngumzali kaHeshroni,
uHeshron waba ngumzali ka-Ram, u-Ram waba ngubaba ka-Aminadabhi,
u-Aminadabhi waba ngubaba kaNahashon, u-Nahashon waba ngubaba kaSalmon;
uSalmon waba ngubaba kaBohazi, uBohazi waba ngubaba kaObedi,
U-Obedi waba ubaba kaYese, no-Jese waba ubaba kaDavide.
1Sam: Kwabe kukhona umuntu okuthiwa uElkana, waseRamathaim-zophim, ezindaweni eziphakeme zakwaEfraim, indodana kaYerohamu, indodana kaElihu, indodana kaThohu, indodana kaZuphu, wesizwe sikaEphrayim.
Wabe nabesifazane ababi, uHanna noPhenina. UPhenina ube nezingane, kodwa uHanna akazange abe nazo.

Uthe uElkana waphuma edolobhaneni lakhe, waya eSilo, ngonyaka ngamunye, ukuze abulawe, futhi ahlonishwe iminikelo kuYehova wemikhosi; kwabekho khona oonyana bakhe ababini, uHofeni noPhinehasi, abaphazamisi beNkosi.
Uthe uma uElkana enikela, wanikeza indodana yakhe iPenina, namadodakazi akhe wonke, nezingane zakhe zonke, inqwaba.
UHanna ke wamnika inkontileka ephindwe kabili, ngoba wayemthanda, nakuba iNkosi ubemvimbela ukuba abe nengane.
Kodwa uPeni-na, umlingani wakhe, wamangalisa yena, ngenxa yokuthi iNkosi wamvimbela ukuba abe nezingane.
Kwaba njalo ngonyaka, lapho enyuka khona uHanna endlwini kaYehova, uPenina wayemxosha, kuze kube yilapho egxeka, engadlanga.

Wathi kuye uElkana, indodana yakhe: UHannah, yini ekwenzeni ukuthi ulime? Yini ekwenzeni ukuthi ungadlanga? Yini ekwenzeni ukuthi ube nenhliziyo ebuhlungu kakhulu? Ingabe angingcono kuwe kunezingane ezilishumi?+
UHanna wavuka, lapho beqedile ukudla nokuphuza eShilo; uEli umpristi wayesesitezi sakhe, enhliziyweni yomnyango wendlu kaYehova.
UHanna wathandaza kukaNkulunkulu, ekhala ngokujulile.

Wakwenza isibopho, wathi, Nkosi yama-Amoni, uma ubona ukuhlupheka komkhonzi wakho, futhi ungikhumbula, futhi ungamkhohlwa umkhonzi wakho, kodwa unikeza umkhonzi wakho indodana, khona-ke ngizonikela kuye iNkosi zonke izinsuku zokuphila kwakhe; angeke kube khona inkomo ekhanda lakhe.
Kwathi ngesikhathi ethandaza kuYehova, uEli wabheka umlomo wayo.
UHannah wayethandaza enhliziyweni yakhe. Imilenze yakhe ihamba, kodwa umsindo wakhe awukwazi ukuwuzwa; ngakho uEli wacabanga ukuthi usele.
Wathi kuye, Uzohlala isikhathi esingakanani ungenawo utshwala? Nciphisa iwayini lakho!
Waphendula uHanna, wathi, Akunjalo, nkosi yami; ngoba ngiwo indodana ebuhlungu kakhulu emlonyeni wayo; angidlanga iwayini, noma isiphuzo esinamandla, kodwa ngawukhipha umoya wami kuYehova.
Ngakho, uma ucabanga ukuthi umkhonzi wakho nguwesifazane ongalungile, ngingakutshela ukuthi ngangithandaza lapha ngenxa yobuhlungu bam.
Waphendula uEli, wathi, Iya ngokuthula; futhi uNkulunkulu wakwaSirayeli akunikeze isipho sakho osicela kuye.
Wathi yena, Ngizothola inhlonipho emlonyeni wakho umkhonzi wakho. Waye ehamba indlela yakhe, wadla ukudla, futhi ubuso bakhe abubonakali buhle.
Bavuka ekuseni kakhulu, bathandaza phambi koYehova, babuyela ekhaya labo eRama. UElkana wathanda uHanna indodakazi yakhe; futhi iNkosi wamkhumbula.
UHanna wakhulelwa, wazalelwa unyana, wathi igama lakhe nguSamuweli, esithi, Ngokuba ngiwucela kuYehova.
Uthe uElkana indodana yakhe, yena nomndeni wakhe wonke, beyihamba phezulu ukunikela ngomnikelo wonyaka kuYehova, nokufeza isibopho sakhe.
Ke yena uHanna akayeki ukuya, wathi kumfazi wakhe, Uma ingane ikhululiwe, ngizoyithatha ngiyibeke phambi kukaYehova, aze ahlale khona kuze kube sekupheleni.

Wathi kuye uElkana, indodana yakhe, Yenza njengoba kubukeka sengathi kulungile emehlo akho; hlala lapha, kuze kube yilapho ungoyisa khona; kodwa iNkosi agcine amazwi akhe. Wayehlala khona, wanomsosha unyana wakhe, kuze kube yilapho ungoyisa khona.

Kwathi, lapho wayeka ubisi, wathatha naye umntwana, njengoba wayencane kakhulu, kanye nengulube eneminyaka emithathu yobudala, kanye nesipuni esisodwa soshizi, kanye nebhodlela elilodwa lewayini, wamletha endlwini kaYehova eShilo.
Banikela inkomo, baletha lo mntwana ku-Eli.
Wathi uHanna kuye, Ngicela, nkosi yami; njengoba uphila inhliziyo yakho, ngiwo indodana ehlala lapha eduze kwakho ithandaza kuYehova.
Ngibe ngicela ngalo mntwana, futhi iNkosi unginikela ngesicelo sam kuye.
Ngaye manje ngiwunikela kuYehova; uzobe unikezelwe kuNkosi zonke izinsuku zokuphila kwakhe. Bakhonza khona iNkosi.
Wathandaza uHana, wathi, Intliziyo yami igcwele induduzo kuYehova, ngoba iNkosi ungenza nginamandla; futhi ngizoba nomsindo ezimpini zami, ngenxa yokuthi ungisindise.
Akukho ongcwele njengoYehova, akukho ngaphandle kwakho; akukho mlilo njengeNkosi yethu.
Uma ukhuluma, ungabi nezwi elibi; uma ukhuluma, ungabi nezwi elibi liphuma emlonyeni wakho. UYehova nguThixo owaziyo zonke izinto, futhi uyayilinganisela yonke imisebenzi yomuntu.
Amagobolondo amabhishobhi anamandla ahlushwa, kodwa labo abaphumile bathola amandla.

Abaningi basebenza ukuthenga ukudla, kodwa labo abakhuluphekayo bangabi namahlwempu; uwesifazane ongeke abe nezingane wazala izingane eziyisishiyagalombili, kodwa uwesifazane onezinsana eziningi uyafa.
UNkulunkulu ubulala, futhi usindisa; enza abantu bakhuphuke emgodini wokufa, futhi aphinde abophe.
UNkulunkulu enza abamnyama, futhi enza abamhlophe; wenza abaphansi, futhi enza abaphezulu.

Uphakamisa omnyama emhlabathini, futhi ukhuphula umhlwempu emgodini wezinto ezilahlekile. Wabamisa phakathi kwabakhulu, wababeka endaweni ephakeme. Isisekelo sezulu yiso iNkosi, nalapho abeke khona izwe lonke.
Uzogcina izinqumo zabangcwele bakhe, kodwa labo abakhohlisayo bazoshiywa emthunzini. Akukho muntu ophumelelayo ngesandla sakhe sodwa.

labo ababhekana noYehova, bazobizwa bephukile; uzobe ephonsa inkungu phezu kwabo kusuka esibhakabhakeni. UYehova uzogwema izwe lonke, futhi uzonika amandla ukumkani wakhe, futhi uzoqinisa okhethiwe wakhe.
Wahamba uElkana ekhaya lakhe, waya eRama; kodwa lo mntwana wahlala ekhonza iNkosi phambi kukaEli umpristi.
Amadodakazi ka-Eli ayeba bantu ababi, akazange acabange ngoYehova.

Kulokhu kwaba khona indlela ababhishobhi ababeyiphatha ngayo abantu; lapho umuntu enikela khona insindiso, umkhonzi webhishobhi wayefika ngesikhathi isidlo sibandayo, ephethe i-fork enezinhlangothi ezintathu.
Wathi, "Uzoyibeka emgodini, noma ebhodweni, noma esiqandisini; futhi konke okuvela emgodini, uzowuthatha umnikelo wakhe wokudla." Bakwenza njalo kubo bonke abantu bakaSirayeli abafika eShilo.

Kuze kube ngaphambili kokuba isisindo siqhume, kwafika umkhonzi kambingeleli, wathi kulowo onikelayo: Ninikele inyama yokubhaka umbingeleli; ngoba ngeke athathe kusuka kuwe inyama ethosiwe, kodwa inyama emisiwe.
Uma umuntu wathi kuye, "Kufanele kuqala kuqhume i-fat, bese uthatha noma yini oyifunayo," yena waphendula, "Akekho, nginike manje; uma ungakwenza, ngizoyithatha ngesandla."
Waba mkhulu kakhulu umdlavuza walezo zintatheli emehlo kaYehova, ngenxa yokuthi bakhohlisa umnikelo kaYehova.
USamuweli ke wayesebenza phambi koYehova, ube yindodana egqoke i-ephodi yelinen, nebhande lenkosi.
Ngawo wonke unyaka umkakhe wayemenza isigqoko esincane, wazisa kuye lapho ehamba khona nowesifazane wakhe ukunikela ngesondlo sonyaka.
UEli wabasabalalisa uElkana nowesifazane wakhe, wathi, "UNkulunkulu akunikeze wena ingane ngalesi sifazane, endaweni yomuntu obewucela, owanikela kuYehova." Baye babuyela ekhaya.
UYehova wayemthanda uHanna; wakhulelwa, wazalelwa oonyana abathathu, nezingane ezimbili. Umntwana uSamuweli waba mkhulu phambi koNkulunkulu, wakhula ezweni lonke.
UEli wayeneminyaka emikhulu kakhulu, wafunda zonke izinto azenza ngazo izingane zakhe kubo bonke isiSirayeli, futhi ukuthi behlala nababhishobhi abasebenza emgwaqeni wetente lokuhlangana.
Wathi kubo, Kungani na nikwenza izinto ezinjalo? Ngokuba ngizizwa ngazo zonke izenzo zenu ezibi, ezingenziwa ngabantu.
Akunjalo, izingane zami; ngoba izindaba engikuzizwa ngazo phakathi kwabantu bakaYehova azilungile; nizibeka engozini.

Uma umuntu ephuca umuntu, uNkulunkulu uzowuxazulula; kodwa uma umuntu ephuca kuYehova, ngubani ozoba ngummeli wakhe? Kodwa abazalwane bakhe abangamlalela ubaba wabo, ngoba iNkosi wayefuna ukuwabulala.
Wakhula uSamuweli umntwana, waqhubeka ethandeka kukaNkulunkulu, nakwabanye abantu.
Kwafika umuntu kaThixo ku-Eli, wathi kuye, Uthi iNkosi ukuthi: Angikaze ngibonakaliswe kanjani emndenini wakwababa wakho, lapho bengumkhonzi kaFaro eYiputa?.

Nami ngakhetha ubaba wakho phakathi kwezizwe zonke zakwaSirayeli, ukuba abe ngum祭zi wami, ukuze afike esiqongweni sami sokudla, ukuthi ancibilikisile insindiso, futhi agqoke i-ephodi phambi kwami; namanje nginike indlu yoyise wonke amadini omlilo kaSirayeli.

Kungani na ke ukuthi nigweme izipho zami, nezipho zendlu yami? Kungani na ukuthi nihloniphe izingane zenu ngaphezu kwami, ukuze nikhulule izandla zenu ngezinto ezingcono kakhulu zezipho zonke zomphakathi wami waseSirayeli?"

Ngathi iNkosi, uNkulunkulu kaSirayeli, uthi: Ngibe ngithi, Umndeni wakho uzongikhonza njengompristi kuze kube sekupheleni; kodwa manje iNkosi uthi: Akufanele kwenzeke njalo; ngoba labo abangihloniphayo ngiyabahlonipha, kodwa labo abangikhohlisayo bazobiwa.
Isikhathi sizofika lapho ngizokucisha khona amandla akho, namandla omndeni wakho, ukuze akukho muntu emndenini wakho ozohlala kuze kube yikhulu.
Uzobona ubuhlungu emndenini wami; ngoba uma kwenziwa okuhle kuSirayeli, ngeke kube khona umuntu ophila isikhathi eside emndenini wakho.

Nabo bonke phakathi kwenu, abangeke ngibalungise, ukuthi bangasebenzisi isibhedlela sami, bazoletha ubuhlungu emilenzeni yenu, nobuhlungu enhliziyweni yenu; futhi izingane zenu zonke zizofa ezinyangeni zabo zokuqala.
Uzothola isibonakaliso ngalokhu okuzokwenzeka kubo bonke oonyana bakho ababi, uHofeni noPhinehasi; bazofa mhla owodwa.
Ngami ngizomisa umpristi othembekile, ozokwenza konke okusemandleni ami; ngaye ngizonikeza ikhaya elihlala isikhathi eside, futhi bazokhonza ukumkani wami okhethiwe kuze kube sekupheleni.
Nabo bonke abashiywe emndenini wakho bazofika, babhujiselwe phambi kwakhe, befuna iyunithi yemali, nengxenye yenkukhu, bethi, Ngicela, nginikeze umsebenzi wami njengompristi, ukuze ngidle ukudla.
Wathi uSamuweli, lo mntwana, esebenza kuYehova ngaphansi kuka-Eli. Ezikhathini zalokho, amazwana asuka kuYehova ayencane kakhulu, futhi kwakungekho ukukubona okuningi.
Ngobusuku obuthile, uEli, omehlo akhe ebengabonanga kahle, wahlala endaweni yakhe ejwayelekile.
USamuweli wayelele endlwini kaYehova, lapho ibhokisi lesinqumo sikaThixo likhona; futhi isibani saNkulunkulu asikuphelile.
Wabiza iNkosi uSamuweli; waphendula uSamuweli wathi, Ngikhona.
Wahamba waya ku-Eli, wathi, "Ngikhona, ngoba ungisibiza." Wathi u-Eli, "Angikusibiza; buyela emuva, uphumule!" Waphuma waphumula.
USawule wavuka, waya ku-Eli, wathi, "Ngikhona, ngoba ungisibiza." Wathi uEli: "Ungane wami, angikubizenga; buyela uphumule!"
USamuweli ke akazange akwazi iNkosi, ngoba ilizwi likaYehova alikade livela kuye.
USamuweli wavuka, waya ku-Eli, wathi, Ngikhona, ngoba ungisibiza. Waqonda u-Eli ukuthi nguYehova okhuluma nomuntu omncane.
Wathi uEli kuSamuweli, Iya, phumula; futhi uma ekubiza, uthi, Ukhuluma, uNkulunkulu wami, ngoba umkhonzi wakho unquma. USamuele ke waya, waphumula endaweni yakhe.
Wafika iNkosi, wahlala khona, wayalela ngokuthi: USamuweli, uSamuweli! Wathi uSamuweli, Bheka; ngoba umkhonzi wakho ulalela.
Wathi iNkosi kuSamuweli, Thola, ngizokwenza ezweni laseSirayeli isinqumo, ukuthi wonke umuntu okubonayo, izingcezu zakhe zize zivutha.
Ngaleso sikhathi ngizokwenzela uEli konke okungisho ngaye ngomndeni wakhe, kusukela ekuqaleni kuze kuphele.
Ngithi kuye ukuthi ngizogwema umndeni wakhe kuze kube sekupheleni ngenxa yesono awaziyo. Owesifazane wakhe wazama ukuzibulala, futhi akawavimbeli.
Ngabe ngathi kumndeni ka-Eli, Ngithi: Isono somndeni ka-Eli ngeke sibuyiselwe ngesonka noma ngomnikelo.
Wahlala uSamuweli embhedeni kuze kube ekuseni, wavula khona iminyango yendlu kaYehova; wakhathazeka ukuba atshele uEli lokho okuboniswayo.
Wamubiza uEli, wathi, USamuweli, unyana wami. Waphendula uSamuweli, ethi, Ngikhona.
Wathi uEli, "Iyini le nto akushoyo kuwe?" Wathi uEli, "Ungangifihlanga; uNkulunkulu akwenze lokhu nalokhu, futhi akwenze okuningi, uma ungazifihla ngaso sonke isinqumo sakhe.
Wathi uSamuweli kuye yonke into, akawufihlanga lutho kuye. UEli wathi, Nguye iNkosi; akwenze konke okulungile engqondweni yakhe.
Waye iNkosi noSamuweli; wakhula, wakwenza zonke izinto azenzayo uSamuweli.
Waqonda wonke amaSirayeli, kusukela eDani kuya eBheri-shebha, ukuthi uSamuweli ungumprofeti kaYehova.
UNkulunkulu waqhubeka ebonakala eShilo, wavela khona kuSamuweli ngezwi lakhe.
Kwafika ke igama likaSamuweli kuwo wonke amaSirayeli. Baphuma amaSirayeli, babhekana nabaFilisti emdlalweni; abaSirayeli bamisa isibhedlela e-Ebenhazere, namaFilisti e-Afeki.
Bathi amaFilisti alungiselela ukubhekana noIsrayeli, bahlasela iSirayeli, babulala abantu abangumakhulu amane ezindaweni zokulwa.

Bafika abantu esiteshini, bathi abakhulu bakaSirayeli, Kungani na iNkosi ukuthi abeke amaFilisti phambi kwethu namuhla? Siyithule lapha esiqongweni sesivumelwano sikaNkulunkulu eShilo, ukuze sihambe nathi, futhi sisindise emazweni ethu amahlazo.

Bathuthela ke abantu eShilo, bakhipha ibhokisi lesivumelwano sikaYehova wezizwe zonke, ohlala esihlalweni sakhe sebukhosi phakathi kwamakerubi; kwabe khona uHofeni noPhinehasi, oonyana ababini baka-Eli, nebhokisi lesivumelwano sikaThixo.
Kwathi lapho ibhokisi lesivumelwano sikaYehova lifika esiteji, amaSirayeli onke aphuca ngezwi elikhulu, kuze kube yilapho umhlaba uqhuma.
Bathi amaFilisti, lapho bezwa khona lo msindo, bathi, Yini le nto yokushayisa esiteji samaHebhere? Bathe bakwazi ukuthi ibhokisi likaYehova lifike esiteji.
Baze bakhathazeka amaFilisti, bethi, UNkulunkulu ufike eqenjini labo. Okungaba khona! Akukho lutho olunjalo luye lwakwenzeka ngaphambili.
Sisengozini; ngubani na ozosisindisa esandla salabo bangcwele abanamandla? Bawo labo abaye babulala ama-Egipta ngazo zonke izinhlobo zezifo ezweni lezulu.
Beka isandla sakho esiqinile, nibe madodana, ningabi ngabakhonzi bamaHebhere, njengoba bebengabakhonzi benu. Beka isandla sakho esiqinile, nibe madodana, nife!

AbaFilisti babhekana, futhi amaSirayeli ahlaselwa. Wabuya wonke umuntu ehhovisi lakhe; kwakukhona ukunqoba okukhulu kakhulu. AmaSirayeli walahlekelwa abantu abangumakhulu amathathu abahamba ngezinyawo.
Ibhokisi likaThixo lathathwa, namadodana amabili ka-Eli, uHofeni noPhinehasi, bafa.
Ngosuku olulodwa, umuntu othile waseBhenjamin waphuma emgwaqeni, waya eShilo; izigqoko zakhe zaphucuka, kwakukhona uthuli phezu kwekhanda lakhe.

Kwathi lapho efika khona, ngabona ukuthi u-Eli ehlala embhedeni wakhe engxenyeni yendlela, ebheka phambili; ngoba inhliziyweni yakhe ikhathazekile ngebhokisi likaThixo. Wafika lo mntu edolobhaneni, waveza konke lokhu okwenzekile, futhi idolobhakazi lonke lakhala.
Wathi uEli, lapho ezwa khona lo msindo, "Iyini le nto?" Lo muntu wahamba waya ku-Eli.
oneminyaka eyisishiyagalombili nesishiyagalolunye ubudala, futhi amehlo akhe ayephumile, ngakho-ke akakwazi ukubona.
Wathi ku-Eli, "Ngivela empilweni yami; ngiphuma kulolu busuku." Wathi u-Eli, "Kungaba yini lokhu, unyana wami?"

Waphendula umthunywa, wathi, AmaSirayeli ahambe phambi kwabaFilisti, futhi kwabe sekwenzeke ukubulawa okukhulu phakathi komphakathi; namadodana akho amabili, uHofeni noPhinehasi, bafa, futhi ibhokisi likaThixo lithathwe.
UEli, lapho ekhuluma ngasendleleni kaThixo, wehla emuva emgodini wesango esuka esibhedlela sakhe, wagwazeka umlenze wakhe, wafa; ngoba wayeneminyaka emashumi mane elawula isizwe samaSirayeli.

Uthe udadewabo, indodakazi ka-Phinehasi, wayekhulelwe, futhi wafika isikhathi sokubeletha. Ke kaloku, lapho ekhuluma ngezindaba zokuthi ibhokisi likaThixo lithathwe, nokuthi udadewabo nowesifazane wakhe bafa, waqala ukukhulelwa, wazalwa ngobuhlungu obuningi.
Wathi, "Ungakhathazeki; uzali indodana." Kodwa yena akazange aphendule noma ukucabangela ngaso sonke isikhathi. Nokho, lapho wavuka, wathola ingane yakhe.
Wabiza igama lakhe ngegama lika-Ikhabhodi, esithi, Ubuhle busuka eSirayeli. Yathi lokhu ngenxa yokuthi isibuko sikaThixo sathathwa, futhi ngoba ubaba wakhe nowesifazane bakhe babefile.
Wathi, Ubuhle buphuma eSirayeli; ngoba isikhokelo sikaThixo sithathelwe.
Kwathi amaFilisti athathe ibhokisi likaThixo, lasuka e-Ebenezere lafika eAshdodi.
Bafaka ibhokisi likaThixo ethempelini likaDagon, umbingeleli wabo, babeka eduze kwesithombe sikaDagon.
Bavuka abantu base-Ashdodi ngobusuku obulandelayo, babone uDagon ekhoneni lakhe elibukhali ezweni, phambi kwebhokisi likaYehova; baphakamisa uDagon, bambeka endaweni yakhe.

Bavuka ngobusuku obulandelayo, babona uDagon ehlanzekile ebusweni bakhe emhlabeni phambi kwebhokisi likaYehova; intamo yakhe nezandla zakhe ziboshwe, zibekwe emgwaqeni wesango, futhi ikhanda lakhe kuphela elisele.
Ngenxa yalokho ababhishobhi bakaDagon, nanoma ubani ophuma ethempelini likaDagon eAshdodi, bangase bagweme ukufinyelela emgwaqweni, kuze kube namuhla.
Isandla sikaYehova sasinda phezu kwabahlali base-Ashdodi nezindawo ezingaphansi kwayo, waza wabangela ubuhlungu kubo, wababulala ngezinhlayiya ezinkulu.
Bathe abantu baseAshdodi bebona lokhu, bathi, Isikhombi soNkulunkulu wakwaSirayeli asihlale sihlala lapha nathi; ngoba isandla sakhe sinzima kithi nakweDagon, uNkulunkulu wethu.
