Bahlangana khona bonke abaphathi bamaFilisti, bathi kubo, Sikwenzeni kuphi ibhokisi leNkosi uNkulunkulu kaSirayeli? Baphendula bethi, Nciphisa ibhokisi leNkosi uNkulunkulu kaSirayeli lifike eGathi. Bafaka khona khona ibhokisi leNkosi uNkulunkulu kaSirayeli,
Kodwa lapho beyihambisa khona, isandla sikaYehova safika kulo mzi, sawuphazamisa kakhulu; wabulala abantu balo mzi, abancane nababadala, ngamahlombe aphukile.
Bathumela khona ibhokisi likaThixo e-Ekron. Kwathi lapho lifika e-Ekron, abantu base-Ekron baphoqa, bethi, Lithunyelwe nathi ibhokisi loMdali wakwaSirayeli, ukuze lisindise mina nemindeni yethu.

Bahlanganisa bonke abaphathi bamaFilisti, bethi, Yisuseni ibhokisi likaThixo kaSirayeli, liphinde libuye endaweni yayo, ukuze lingasindisi mina nomndeni wami. Umlilo wokufa ugcwele lo mzi, ngoba isandla sikaNkulunkulu sinzima kakhulu kuwo.
Nabo abazange bafe, bahlaselwa yizilonda; futhi inkulumo yedolobha yafika esibhakabhakeni.
Ibhokisi likaYehova lahlala ezweni lamaFilisti iminyaka eyisikhombisa.
Bathi amaFilisti, babiza ababhishobhi babo nabangani babo, besithi: Sikwenzeni kuphi isibambo sikaYehova? Sitsheleni ukuthi siyibuyisele kanjani endaweni yayo.

Bathi kubo, Uma niyithumela ibhokisi likaThixo kaSirayeli, ningayithumeli ingasebenzi; kodwa zinikele kuye umnikelo wesono; khona-ke nizophiliswa, futhi nizokwazi ukuthi kungani isandla sakhe singeke sishintshe kusuka kuwe.

Bathi abaFilisti, Sizothumela yini isondlo sokuhlukunyezwa kuye? Baphendula bathi, Izingqungquthela zegolide eziyisishiyagalombili, nezinhlanzi zegolide eziyisishiyagalombili, ngaye ngamnye wabaphathi bamaFilisti abane; ngoba ubuhlungu obufanayo bukhona phakathi kwenu na PNu.
yenzani izifanekiso zezinhlayiya, nezibonakaliso zezinhlanzi ezibulala izwe, ninikeze ukuthula kuThixo kaSirayeli; kungase kube khona ukuthi asuse isandla sakhe phezu kwenu, nasemhlabeni wenu.
Kungani na ukuthi nigweme inhlonipho yenu, njengokuthi iMisra neFaro, lapho uNkulunkulu ewenza khona izinto ezinzima kubo, bengazivumela kanjani izingane zakwaSirayeli ukuba zihambe indlela yabo?
Ngakho-ke, thola imoto entsha elungiselelwe, ngezinkomo ezimbili ezibe nezingane futhi ezingazange zihlolwe. Hlela izinkomo kwimoto, kodwa khipha izingane zabo bese uzibeka phansi.
Nciphisa ibhokisi leNkosi, ulibeke phezu kwemoto; ubeke eduze kwayo ibhokisi elinezinto zegolide ozithumelelayo njengomnikelo wesono; uyithumelele indlela yayo.

bhekani; uma ihamba phambili ezweni layo, eBethe-shemesi, khona-ke iNkosi uletha phezu kwethu lo monakalo omkhulu; kodwa uma ingabi njalo, sizokwazi ukuthi ayikho isandla sakhe esithule nathi. Kube yingozi kuphela.
Bakwenza njalo, bathatha izinkomo ezimbili ezinamadodakazi, bazibophezela ebhasini, baveza amadodakazi abo.
Babeka ibhokisi likaYehova phezu kwemoto, kanye nebhodlela eliqukethe izinyamazane zegolide, namamodeli wezinhlayiya.

Wathi uNdikhoyo kuSawule: "Uya eBhethe-shemeshi," futhi izingulube zahamba ngokuqondile, zisuka eBet-shemeshi. Zihlala emgwaqweni, ziphuza igazi ngaso sonke isikhathi; azishintshi ngakwesokudla noma ngasekhohlo.
Amadoda aseBhethe-shemeshi, lapho eqotha khona imbewu yabo emfuleni, waphakamisa amehlo akhe, wabona ibhokisi, waba mnandi.
Imoto yafika ezindaweni zikaYoshuwa waseBethe-shemesi, yahlala khona eduze kwengcindezi enkulu; abantu bamisa imithi yemoto, banikela izinkomo zibe ngumnikelo wokushiswa kuYehova.

Bakhuphula khona ibhokisi likaYehova, naleyo bhokisi elinezinto zegolide, bazibeka phezu kwengcindezi enkulu; futhi abantu baseBhethe-shemeshi banikela ngomnikelo wokushiswa ngalolusuku lwawo, banikela ngenhlanhla kukaNkulunkulu.
Babona lokhu bonke abaphathi bamaFilisti abahlanu, babuyela e-Ekroni ngalolusuku.
Lezi ziyizilonda zegolide, abaFilisti bazisa umnikelo wesono kuYehova; ngazo zonke izifundazwe: ngoAshdodi, noGaza, noAshkeloni, noGathi, noEkroni.

futhi inani lezi zimvu zegolide, ngokuya ngenani lamadolobha amaFilisti, okungukuthi, idolobhana elihlanganisiwe, kanye nezindawo zasemaphandleni. Umlilo omkhulu, lapho babeka khona ibhokisi likaYehova, ukhona kuze kube manje, ezindaweni zikaYoshuwa waseBhethe-shemesi.

Wabulala abantu baseBhethe-shemeshi, ngenxa yokuthi babheka ebhokisini likaYehova; wababulala abantu abangumakhulu amahlanu anamashumi asixhenxe. Lawo madoda ahlupheka kakhulu ngenxa yokubulala okukhulu okwenzeke kubo iNkosi.
Bathi abantu baseBhethe-shemeshi, Nguwubani ongakwazi ukuhlala phambi kukaNkulunkulu, lowo uNkulunkulu ongcwele? Ingabe ibhokisi lizohamba kuphi?
Bathumela abathunywa kubo bonke abahlala eKiriyati-yearimi, bethi, AbaFilisti babuyisele isihlalo sobukhosi sikaYehova; zinikele, niyithatheni ifike edolobhaneni lenu.
Bafika ke abantu baseKiriyati-yearimi, baphakamisa ibhokisi likaYehova, babe lifike endlwini ka-Abinadabu, emfuleni; futhi bamisa uElazare, unyana wakhe, ukuba agcine ibhokisi likaYehova.
Ibhokisi lahlala eKiriyati-yearimi isikhathi eside, iminyaka eyishumi nambili; futhi bonke abantu bakaSirayeli babuyela kuYehova.

Wathi uSamuweli kubo bonke abantu bakaSirayeli, ethi, Uma nizobuyela kuYehova ngenhliziyo yenu yonke, khiphani izitha zakwamanye amazwe eziphakathi kwenu, nama-Ashtorethi, nizinikela ngokugcwele kuYehova, niwusebenzele yena kuphela; naye uzokusindisa ebusweni bamaFilisti.
Bathi ke amadodana aseSirayeli asuse amaBaali abo, nama-Ashtorethi abo, bakhonza iNkosi kuphela.
Wathi uSamuweli, Zihlanganisani bonke isiSirayeli eMizpa, ngizothandaza kuYehova ngenxa yenu.
Bahlangana eMizpa, baqoqa amanzi, balivalela phambi koYehova; baphuza amanzi ngalolusuku, bethi, Sithole isono kukaNkulunkulu. USamuweli walungisa amaSirayeli eMizpa, waba ngummeli.
Bathe abaFilisti beva ukuthi isizwe samaSirayeli sihlangane eMizpa, bakhuphuka abaholi babo ukubhekana nabo. Amadodakazi kaSirayeli ayewaqonda la mazwi, waphoqa ukuba aboshwe yimikhosi yamaFilisti.
Bathi kubo uSamuweli, "Akekho ongeke agweme ukudumisa kuYehova uNkulunkulu wethu ngenxa yethu, ukuze asisindise ebusweni bamaFilisti."
Wathi uSamuweli, athathe inkomo encane, wanikela ngayo yonke, ibe ngumnikelo wokushiswa kuYehova; wathandaza kuYehova ngenxa yamaSirayeli, iNkosi wamphendula.

Kwathi lapho uSamuweli enikela khona ngenhlanhla yokudlwengula, amaFilisti afika ukuhlasela amaSirayeli; kodwa iNkosi wehlisa umsindo omkhulu phezu kwamaFilisti ngalolu busuku, wabaphazamisa kakhulu, babulawa phambi kwaSirayeli.
Baphuma amadoda aseSirayeli eMizpa, walandela amaFilisti, wababulala kuze kube yilapho ngezansi kweBet-kar.
Wathi uSamuweli, ethatha itshe elilodwa, waligqugquzela phakathi kweMizpa neShen; wathi igama lakhe ngu-Ebenezere, esithi, UYehova usisiza kuze kube manje.
Ngaleyo ndlela abaFilisti bahlaselwa, bangafikanga ezweni lakwaSirayeli; futhi isandla sikaYehova sakuba phezu kwabaFilisti zonke izinsuku zokuphila kukaSamuweli.

Kwaba khona ukuthula phakathi kukaSirayeli namadodana ka-Amoni; futhi amadolobha, abaFilisti ababewathathe kuSirayeli, abuyiselwe kwaSirayeli, kusukela e-Ekronni kuya eGathi; futhi isizwe sakwaSirayeli sabuyiselwa kumaFilisti.
Waqhubeka uSamuweli ephatha isizwe samaSirayeli zonke izinsuku zokuphila kwakhe.
Wahamba ngonyaka wonke, esuka eBhetheleli waya eGalgali, waya eMizpa, walungisa amaSirayeli kuwo onke lamadolobha.
Wabuyela eRama, lapho kwakuyikhaya lakhe, waphuma khona nakwaSirayeli, wakwakha khona isibingelelo kuYehova.
Kwathi lapho uSamuweli eneminyaka emikhulu, wabeka izingane zakhe zibe ngamagoli kuSirayeli.
Igama lomzali wakhe nguYoweli, negama lowesifazane wakhe nguAbiha; babe ngamagoli eBhe-shebha.
Kodwa-ke, udadewabo abazange bahambe ngendlela yakhe. Babe bathanda imali, bathatha izipho, futhi baguqula inqubekelaphambili.
Bahlangana bonke abakhulu baseSirayeli, bafika kuSamuweli eRama.
Bathi kuye, Sekuyisikhathi sakho sobudala, futhi izingane zakho azikho eziphilayo njengezingane zakho; ngakho-ke unganqume nathi ukumkani, njengazo zonke izizwe.
Bathi ke, Sinike ukumkani ukuba akhulume nathi. USamuweli wakhathazeka kakhulu, wathandaza iNkosi.
Wathi iNkosi kuye, Lingisa zonke izinto ezikhuluma ngazo lezi zinto abantu; akukubi ukuthi bakunqume wena, kodwa benqume mina ukuba ngibe ngukumkani wabo.
Ngokungafani nalokho abakwenzayo kusukela ngosuku lapho ngibakhuphe khona eYiputa, kuze kube manje, bemishiya, bakhonza amadini amanye.
Ngakho-ke, lalela amazwi abo; kodwa ukhulume nabo ngokuqinile, wazise ukuthi uzokwenzani ukumkani olawula phezu kwabo.
Wathi uSamuweli kuwo wonke amazwi kaYehova kubo bonke abantu ababemcela ukumkani.
Wathi, Lolu hlobo luzokwenziwa ngukumkani olawula phezu kwenu; uzothatha izingane zenu, azozibeka ezimotoni zakhe, namabhayisikili akhe; bazohamba phambi kwezimoto zakhe.

Uzobeka abanye kubo abaphathi bezinkulungwane, nabanye abaphathi bezinkulungwane eziyisishiyagalombili; abanye bazomisa izihlahla zakhe, futhi bazovuna imbewu yakhe; abanye bazokwenza amathuluzi empi, kanye nengxenye yemoto yakhe.
Uzothatha izingane zenu ukuze zikhiqize iziphuzo, futhi zilungiselele ukudla.
Uzothatha izitshalo zenu ezingcono, nezivinine zenu, nezihlahla ze-olive zenu, azinikeze abaphathi bakhe.
Uzothatha ishumi lembewu yenu, nembewu yewayini yenu, azozinika abaphathi bakhe nabasebenzi bakhe.
Uzothatha abakhonzi benu, nezisebenzi zenu, nezingane zenu ezingcono kakhulu, namabhuzane enu, azowasebenzisa emisebenzini yakhe.
Uzothatha ingxenye yesishiyagalombili yezingulube zenu, futhi nizoba ngabakhonzi bakhe.
Ngosuku olulodwa nizokhala ngenxa yombuso wenu owazikhethela wona; kodwa iNkosi ngeke akuphendule ngalolusuku.
Akekho umuntu ofuna ukulalela uSamuweli; bathi, Ngabe sizodinga ukumkani phezu kwethu?
Sizobe sifana nezinye izizwe zonke, sibe nokumkani ukuba ahambe phambi kwethu, futhi aphume ebusweni bethu, abe nemibhikisho yethu.
Wathi uSamuweli, ekhuluma ngamazwi onke abantu, waveza kuYehova.
Wathi iNkosi, Nciphisa izingcingo zabo, wamisa ukumkani kubo. USamuweli wathi kwabaSirayeli, Yiya wonke umuntu edolobhaneni lakhe.
Kwabe kukhona umuntu wesizwe sikaBhenjamin, igama lakhe nguKishi, indodana ka-Abiyeli, indodana ka-Zerori, indodana ka-Bekorathi, indodana ka-Afiya; ube ngumntu onamandla amakhulu.
UKishi ubenomntwana okuthiwa nguShawule, indodakazi ebukekayo. Akukho mntu eSirayeli obukekayo kunaye; waphakama ikhanda ngaphezu kwabanye bonke.
Kwathi ngosuku oluthile, amabhungane kaKishi ubaba kaSawule elahlekile; wathi ke uKishi kuSawule unyana wakhe, Thola omunye wabakhonzi wakho nawe, uye ufune amabhungane.

USawule wadlula ezindaweni eziphakeme zakwaEfrayim, nasendaweni yaseShalisha, kodwa abakwazi ukuzithola. Bafika ezindaweni zaseShaalim, kodwa izidumbu azikho khona. Wadlula ezweni laseBhenjamini, kodwa bangeke bazithole.
Bafika ezweni lase-Zuphu, uSawule wathi kulowo mntwana owahamba naye: Yiya, sihambe; uma kungenjalo, ubaba wami uzoyeka ukukhathazeka ngezinkomo, aze akhathazeke ngathi.
Wathi kuye, Thola, kukhona umuntu kaThixo kulo mzi, futhi udume kakhulu; konke akushoyo kwenziwa. Siyaye khona manje; mhlawumbe uzositshela indlela esihamba ngayo.
Wathi uSawule kulowo osebenza naye, Uma sihamba, yini esizoyinika lowo muntu? Ngokuba isidlo sethu saphela emithonjeni yethu; asikho nesipho esizoyisa kumntu kaThixo. Sitholani?
Waphendula lo mkhonzi wathi kuye, Thola lapha ngezansi kweshekeli elilodwa legolide; ngizolimalela lowo muntu kaThixo, ukuze acacisele indlela esihamba ngayo.
Esikhathini esedlule eSirayeli, uma umuntu ehamba ukubuza uNkulunkulu into ethile, bethi, "Hlela, sihambe kulowo okubonayo," ngoba umprofeti wanamuhla wayebizwa ngokuthi ubona.
Wathi uSawule kulowo mkhonzi wakhe, Kulungile; ndiza, sihambe. Basuka ke beya edolobhaneni lapho umntu kaThixo wayehlala khona.
Bathi, "Ngakho-ke," wathi uMosis, "uma behamba phambili ezindaweni eziphakeme zedolobha, bahlangana namadodakazi aphumayo ukuqoqa amanzi.
Bathi kuye, Ukhona; bheka, uhambe phambi kwakho. Yiya ngokushesha, ngoba manje nje wafika edolobhaneni lethu, ngoba abantu banesibingelelo esihlalweni sezulu.

Uma nje nifika edolobhaneni, nizomuthola ngaphambi kokuba afike enkabeni yokudlela; ngoba abantu ngeke baqale ukudla kuze afike, ngoba yena kumele abe yiNkosi yomnikelo wokudla; futhi ngemuva kwalokho bazodla labo abamenywe. Chofoza phezulu manje; uma sekuyisikhathi, nizomuthola.
Baye benyuka bafika edolobhaneni. Bafika lapho, kwabonakalisa ukuthi uSamuweli wayehamba ukuwathola, esuka ethempelini.
Imini ngaphambi kokuba uSawule afike, iNkosi ubewutshela uSamuweli, esithi,

Ngosuku oluthile ngalolu sikhathi, ngizokulethela umuntu ezweni likaBhenjamini; uzowuphazamisa abe ngumholi phezu kwabantu bam baseSirayeli; naye uzowasindisa abantu bami ezinyaweni zesiFilisti. Ngibone abantu bami, ngoba inkulumo yabo ifike kuye.
Kwathi lapho uSamuweli ebona uSawule, iNkosi wathi kuye, Lowo ngumuntu engikutshele ngawo; yena ozolawula abantu bam.
Wafika uSawule kuSamuweli emnyango, wathi, Ngicela, ngisazise ukuthi ikuphi indlu yombona.
Wathi uSamuweli, Ngimi lowo obonayo; zula phambi kwami ethempelini, ngoba namhlanje uzodla nami ukudla; futhi ngesonto ngizokushiya uhambe, ngizokutshela konke okusenhliziyoni yakho.
Uma kukhulunywa ngezinkomo ozilahle ngosuku oludlule, ungakhathazeki ngazo, ngoba zitholeke; futhi yini leyo efuna yona izwe lonke laseSirayeli? Awukho wena, nomndeni wonke kayise wakho?
Waphendula uSawule, wathi, Ngami nginguBhenjamini, mkhulu kunabo bonke isizwe samaSirayeli, futhi inkosikazi yami incane kunazo zonke izinkosikazi zikaBhenjamini; kungani ukhuluma ngalokhu?
USamuweli wabeka uSawule nomkhonzi wakhe embhedeni, wababeka phezulu phakathi kwabamenywa, abantu abangamashumi amathathu.
Wathi uSamuweli kulowo opheki, Thola le ngxenye yokudla engikulethelayo, engingakutshele ngayo ukuthi uyibeke phansi.

Wathi umpheki, athathe isifuba, nalokho kwakukhona kuso, wamisa phambi kukaSawule. Wathi uSamuweli, Thola lokhu okugcinwe kuwe; dle, ngoba kugcinwe kuwe ngalolu daba, kusukela ngosuku lapho ngithe khona: "Ngimemele abantu." USawule wadla noSamuweli ngalolusuku.
Kwathi lapho bephuma khona ethempelini, bafika edolobhaneni, uSamuweli wakhuluma noSawule phezu kwendlu yakhe.
Bavuka ngobusuku bokuqala, uSamuweli wayalela uSawule phezu kwendlu yangasese, wathi: "Thinakela, ngizokushiya uhambe." USawule wehla, waphuma naye noSamuweli.

Kwathi, lapho behamba ekugcineni komgwaqo, uSamuweli wathi kuSawule, Uthi yini kumngane wakho ukuba ahambe phambi kwethu? Wakwenza njalo; wathi uSamuweli, Uma kunjalo, hlala lapha, ukuze ngikutshele ilizwi likaThixo.
Wathi uSamuweli, ethatha ibhodlela elincane le-oyile, walifutha phezu kwekhanda lakhe, wamxosha, wathi, UNkulunkulu unciphise wena ukuba ube ngumholi abantu bakhe.

Uma uphuma ngimi namuhla, bona, uzothola abantu ababili emgodini kaRakeli eZilza, enhliziyweni kaBhenjamini; bazokutshela ukuthi: Izidlovukazi ozidlulele uzifuna zithe zatholakala, futhi ubaba wakho usazizwa ekhathazekile ngenxa yenu, esithi, Ngingakwenzani ngonyana wami?

Uzoqhubeka khona lapho, kuze ufike emthini omkhulu waseTabori; khona-ke uzothola khona abantu abathathu besuka eBhetelehem. Omunye uzothwala izinkomo ezincane ezintathu, nomunye uzothwala amakhowe amathathu, nomunye uzothwala ibhodlela lewayini.
Bazokuhalalisela, futhi bakulethe izithelo ezimbili; uzozithola kuzona.

futhi, ngemva kwalokho, uzofika eGibeha kaThixo, lapho kukhona isibhedlela samaFilisti; futhi, uma ufinyelela kulo mzi, uzothola iqembu amaprofeta aphuma emgodini ophakeme, bedlala ngezinhlamvu, nezingcweti, neziphuzo, nama-harps, futhi bekhuluma ngokuprofeti.
futhi uMoya kaYehova uzofika kuwe, nawe uzoprofetisa nabo; futhi uzoshintshwa ube umuntu othile.
Uma lezi zibonakaliso zenzeka, ukwenze konke okudingeka kwenziwe; ngoba uNkulunkulu uya nawe.
Hamba udlule phambi kwami eGalgali; ngizofika kuwe, nginikeze izipho ezibomvu nezipho zokuthula. Uzohlala usuku oluyisixhenxe, kuze ngifike kuwe, ngikutshele ukuthi yini okufanele uyikwenze.
Kwathi lapho uSawule ebhekene noSamuweli, uNkulunkulu washintsha intliziyo kaSawule; futhi lezi zibonakaliso zonke zafika ngalolusuku.
Wafika uSawule nomkhonzi wakhe eGibeha, yabona iqembu lamaprofeti lihlangana naye. UMoya kaThixo wehla phezu kwakhe, waqala ukushumayela phakathi kwabo.
Bathi labo bonke ababemthanda ngaphambilini, bebona ukuthi yena uprofetisa phakathi nabaprofeti, bathi omunye kulowo: Uthini lo mwana kaKishi? Ingabe noSawule unguye wabaprofeti?
Waphendula umuntu oyedwa ohlala khona, wathi, Ubani ubaba wabo? Ngalokho kwathiwa, Ingabe noSawule ungumprofeti?
Kwathi lapho uSawule eqedile ukuprofeti, waya endaweni yokuzinikela.
Wathi udadewabo kaSawule kuye, wathi kuye nomuntu wakhe osebenza naye, Niyaphi na? Wathi yena, Sifuna izinkomo; futhi sabona ukuthi azikho, safika kuSamuweli.
Wathi udadewabo kaSawule, Ngitshele ukuthi uSamuweli uthe yini kuwe?
Waphendula uSawule, wathi: "Uthi wazitshela ukuthi izinkomo zitholakale." Kodwa uSawule akazange azitshele isinqumo sikaSamuweli sokuthi uzobe ngukumkani.
USamuweli wahlanganisa bonke abantu bakaSirayeli phambi koYehova eMizpa.
Wathi kubo, Usho lokhu iNkosi, uNkulunkulu kaSirayeli: Ngiwakhuphule amaSirayeli eYiputa, futhi ngiwasindise emathunjini aseYiputa, nasezandleni zazo zonke izizwe eziphazamisayo.

Kodwa-ke, namhlanje nigweme uNkulunkulu wenu, owakusindisa kuzo zonke izimo zenu ezibi nezinkinga zenu, nithi, Uzobeka ukumkani phezu kwethu; ngakho-ke manje, zinikele phambi kukaNkulunkulu ngezizwe zenu, nangenkolo yenu.
USamuweli wabeka zonke izizwe zakwaSirayeli zibheke phambili, futhi isizwe sikaBhenjamin sathathwa ngesandla.
Wabeka isizwe sakwaBhenjamin esihamba phambili, isizukulwane ngasizukulwane; futhi isizukulwane sakwaMatri sathathwa. Sathathwa uSawule unyana kaKishi. Baye bamfuna, kodwa akatholakalanga.
Babuza iNkosi, bethi, Ingabe lo mntu wafika lapha? Wathi iNkosi, Yebo, ufihlakele phakathi kwezinto ezisetshenziswayo.
Baye behamba, baphuma naye; futhi lapho ehlala phakathi kwabantu, waphakama ikhanda ngaphezu kwanoma ubani kubo.
Wathi uSamuweli kubo bonke abantu, "Ubonani lo muntu owazikhethela yena iNkosi? Akunamuntu ofana naye phakathi kwalabo bonke abantu." Bathi ke bonke abantu, "Kube nokuphila ukumkani!"
Wathi uSamuweli kulabo abantu umthetho wombuso, wabhala kuwo encwadini, wayibeka phambi koYehova. USamuele wabasusa bonke abantu, wonke umuntu waya ekhaya lakhe.
USawule wabuyela ekhaya lakhe, waya eGibeha, yena nomndeni wakhe, abantu abanothando, amehlo abo ahlotshiswe nguNkulunkulu.
Bathi abanye abantu ababi, Ingabe lo muntu uzosisindisa kanjani? Bemkhohlisa, futhi bengenazo izipho kuye; kodwa uSawule wanyamalala.
Waphuma uNahasi umAmoni, wahlasela iYabhesi-Gileyadi. Bathi kuye bonke abantu baseYabhesi, Yenza isiqiniseko nathi, sizokukhonza wena.
Wathi uNahashi umAmoni kuye, Ngalokhu nje ngizokwenza inxanxathela nani: ukuthi ngiphuze ngamehlo enu onke akunene, ukuze ngibeke ukungcola ezweni lonke likaSirayeli.
Bathi kuye abakhulu baseYabheshi, Sivumele usuku oluyisixhenxe, ukuze sithumelele abantu ezweni lonke laseSirayeli; uma kungenjalo umuntu ozosisindisa, sizophuma thina.
Befika labo abathunyelwe eGibeha, lapho uSawule ehlala khona, batshela abantu la mazwi; futhi bonke abantu bekhala.
Ngabona uSawule efika emazweni, elandela izinkomo zakhe. Wathi uSawule, "Kuthini na labo bonke abantu? Kungani bekhala?" Bathi kuye, "Amadoda aseYabheshi asho ukuthini?"
Kwathi lapho uSawule ekubona amazwi abo, wafika phezu kwakhe umoya kaThixo, waza waba namandla.

Wathatha izinkomo ezimbili, wazenza iziqephu, wabathumela ngeziqephu ngezandla zabathunywa ezweni lonke likaSirayeli, esithi, Uma umuntu engalandela uSawule noSamuweli, lokhu kuzokwenziwa ngezinkomo zakhe. Ubuhlungu bukaYehova belubopha abantu; baphuma bonke bengamuntu oyedwa.
USawule wababala eBezeki; kwaba ngumakhulu amathathu amaphesenti amadoda aseSirayeli, namaphesenti amathathu amadoda aseYuda.

Bathi kulabo abathunyelwe, bathi kubo: "Kungezwa abantu baseYabhesi eGileyadi ukuthi: 'Ngokulandelayo uma ilanga liqala ukushisa, nizosindiswa.'" Besuka labo abathunyelwe, bakhuluma ngalokhu kubantu baseYabhesi, futhi babe mnandi kakhulu.
Bathi kubo amadodana ka-Amoni, NgoMsombuluko sizophuma siye kuwe, ukwenze nathi konke okungekuhle emehlo akho.

Kwathi ngosuku olulandelayo, uSawule wahlukanisa abantu bakhe abe ngamaqembu amathathu. Bafika esiteshini sama-Amoni ngaphambi kwemini, babulala bonke abahlala khona, kuze kube yilapho ekuseni kakhulu; futhi labo abafayo bahlukaniswa, ukuze bangabi nababili phakathi kwabo.
Bathi abantu kuSamuweli, Nguwubani lowo owathi, Ingabe uSawule uyakuba ngukumkani wethu? Thola lapha, sizowabulala.
Wathi uSawule, Akukho muntu ozofa namuhla; ngoba namhlanje iNkosi wasindisa isiSirayeli.
Wathi uSamuweli kubo bonke abantu, Yeni, sihambe siye eGalgali, siphinde sibeke khona uSawule njengomphathi.
Baye bonke abantu eGalgali, bakwenza uSawule waba ngukumkani phambi koYehova; banikela khona izipho zokuthula phambi koYehova. USawule namadodana aseSirayeli wonke babe nenjabulo enkulu.
Wathi uSamuweli kuwo wonke amakhosi aseSirayeli, Ngikulalela konke okungithembisile, futhi ngikulethela ukumkani.
Manje ninenkosi ezokuphatha. Ngami, ngineminyaka emikhulu kakhulu, futhi ubuso bami bumnyama, nabangani bam bakhona lapha phakathi kwenu. Ngibe ngumholi wenu kusukela ngasencane kuze kube manje.

Ngilokhu ngikhona; khuluma ngami phambi kweNkosi, futhi phambi komphathi wakhe okhethiwe. Ngathatha yini inkomo yomngani wami? Ngathatha yini ibhokhwe yomngani wami? Ngakhohlisa yini umngani wami? Ngaphazamisa yini umngani wami? Ngathola yini umnikelo kumngani wami ukuze ngigweme ukubheka phambili? Uma ngikwenze noma yiziphi zalezi zinto, ngizozibuyisela.
Bathi kuye, Awunakusikhohlisa, awunakusicindezela, futhi awuthathenga lutho kumuntu.
Wathi kubo uSamuweli, UYehova ube ngumholi phakathi kwenu, futhi ukumkani wakhe okhethiwe abe ngumholi namuhla, ukuthi ningathola nalutho esandla sami. Bathi, UNkulunkulu ube nguMengameli.
Wathi uSamuweli kubo bonke abantu, UNkulunkulu nguwo owenza uMoses no-Aron, nowakhipha abazali benu ezweni laseYiputa.
Manje, hlalani lapha; ngoba ngizobhekana nani phambi kukaNkulunkulu ngezinto zonke ezilungile iNkosi awazenzayo kuwe, nababa bakho.
Kwathi lapho uYakobi efika eYiputa, abazalwane benu bekhala kuYehova; wathumela iNkosi uMoses noAron, bakhipha abazalwane benu emazweni aseYiputa, babeka lapha endaweni.
Baze bakhohlwa iNkosi uNkulunkulu wabo; wabathengisa kuSisera, umphathi womkhosi waseHazori, namaFilisti, nokumkani wakwaMowabi; bahlaselana nabo.
Baphoqa iNkosi, bethi, Sithole isono, ngoba sishiye iNkosi, sakhonza amaBaali nama-Ashtorethi; kodwa manje sisindise ebusweni bomshayeli wethu, futhi siyakukhonza.
Wathumela iNkosi uYerubahali, noBhedan, noJephthah, noSamuweli; wakwenza ukuthi nikhululwe ezimpini zenu zonke ezingcebeni zenu, nihlale niphephile.
Uma nibona ukuthi uNahashe ukumkani wakwa-Amoni useza kuni, nithi kuye: Akunjalo, kodwa kufanele kube ngukumkani olawula phezu kwethu; naphezu kokuthi iNkosi uNkulunkulu wenu ungumkani wenu.
Futhi manje, bhekani, ubukhosi obuwakhethayo, obuwucelayo; bhekani, iNkosi wamisa ukumkani phezu kwenu.

Uma nje nimthanda iNkosi, niwukhonza, niwuphulaphule umthetho wakhe, futhi ningayiphula imiyalelo yakhe; uma nilandela iNkosi uNkulunkulu wenu, niwe nokumkani olawula phezu kwenu, khona-ke kuzobe sekuhleni.
Uma nithi, Akufanele silalele amazwi kaYehova; uma nithi, Sizophula umthetho wakhe, isandla sakhe sizoba phezu kwenu, njengokuba kwaba phezu kwababanu.
Manje ke, hlalani, nibone le nto enkulu iNkosi ozoyenza phambi kwezindlebe zenu!
Ngizobiza iNkosi, ukuze anikeze inkungu nemvula; futhi nizokwazi ukuthi yini le nto ebuhlungu enhliziyweni yenu engiyenze phambi kweNkosi, lapho nicela khona ukumkani.
USamuweli wehlalela iNkosi, futhi iNkosi wathumela inkungu nemvula ngalolusuku olulodwa; abantu bonke bakhathazeka ngoYehova noSamuweli.
Bathi abantu bonke kuSamuweli, Buza iNkosi uNkulunkulu wakho ngezisebenzi zakho, ukuze singafa; ngoba sithembise isono sethu sonke ngalesi sinqumo esibi sokucela ukumkani.
Wathi uSamuweli, Musa ukukhathazeka; kungenxa yokuthi wenza konke lokhu okubi; kodwa-ke ungagcini ngokulandela iNkosi, kodwa usebenzele iNkosi intliziyo yenu yonke.
"Musa ukubhekana nabo, ngoba ngeke bakwazi ukukunika inzuzo noma usizo."
UYehova ngeke ashiye abantu bakhe, ngenxa yegama lakhe elikhulu; ngoba iNkosi wathanda ukukwenza ube yindawo yakhe.
Ngami-ke, ngeke ngibe nephutha phambi kukaNkulunkulu, uma ngiyeka ukuthandaza ngenxa yenu; kodwa ngizokuzifundisa indlela engcono neyeqiniso.
Ngiyakucela nje ukuthi nigweme iNkosi, niwusebenzele ngobuqotho inhliziyweni yenu yonke; futhi nizicabangele zonke izinto zakhe ezikhulu azenzayo kuwe.
Uma nje niqhubeka nokwenza okubi, nizosuswa niye nomphathi wenu. "
USawule ubeneminyaka engama-30 ubudala lapho eqala ukumkani; waba ngukumkani phezu kwaSirayeli iminyaka engamashumi amane nabini.

USawule wakhetha abantu abangumakhulu amathathu eSirayeli; abekhona naye abantu abangumakhulu amabili eMikmasi, nasezindaweni eziphakeme zaseBheteli, futhi abekhona naye uYonatan unyana wakhe eGibeha kaBhenjamin. Amanye amadoda awashiya, waya ekhaya lakhe.
UYonathani wahlasela isibhedlela samaFilisti eGibeha, futhi amaFilisti akubona. Wathi uSawule waphonsa umbhoshongo phezu kwezwe lonke, esithi, Lawa maHebhere azolalela.

Bathe bonke amaSirayeli bakhuluma ngokuthi, USawule wahlasela isibhedlela samaFilisti; futhi namanje amaSirayeli abe yinto engathandeki kulabo abaFilisti. Baphoqelela abantu ukuba bafike eGalgali kuSawule.

Bahlangana amaFilisti ukubhekana noIsrayeli, nemoto ezingu-30, namabhayisikili ayizinkulungwane eziyisishiyagalombili, nabantu abaningi njengamatshe esiqhingini selwandle; benyuka bamisa isibhedlela eMikmash, ngasenyakatho yeBhethaweni.
Babona isizwe sakwaSirayeli ukuthi sisemngciphekweni, futhi inkosi yabo icindezelwe kakhulu, bafihla ezindaweni ezishisayo, nasezintaba-mlilo, nasezingqimba-mlilo, nasezingqimba-mhlaba.
Baningi abaHebheru babedlula iJordani, befika ezweni likaGadi neGileyadi. USawule wahlala eGalgali; bonke abantu bakhe ababenabo bakhathazeka kakhulu.
Walinde izinsuku ezisixhenxe, ngokwesikhathi uSamuweli esinqumile; kodwa uSamuweli akazange afike eGalgali, abantu bakaSawule baqala ukushiya.
Wathi uSawule, Ninikele isonka esiqhutshwayo, nezipho zokuthula. Wanikela ngosonka esiqhutshwayo;
Kwathi lapho eqedile ukunikela khona, kwafika uSamuweli; waphuma uSawule ukubamthokozele.
Wathi uSamuweli, Ukwenze kuphi? Wathi uSawule, Ngabona ukuthi abantu besuka ngami, futhi wena ungafikanga ngesikhathi esinqunyiwe, futhi amaFilisti ahlanganisane eMikmash;
Ngithi, Manje bazongihlasela amaFilisti eGilgal, futhi angizange ngibuze iNkosi; ngakho ngacabanga ukuthi kufanele nginikeze isonka esiqhutshwayo.
Wathi uSamuweli, Ukwenze kahle; awugcinenga umyalo kaYehova uNkulunkulu wakho owawukuwisela wona. Uma ubewugcinele, wayekuqinise ubukumkani bakho phezu kwaSirayeli kuze kube sekupheleni.

Kodwa manje ubukumkani bakho abuzohlala isikhathi eside; iNkosi usethole umuntu ngokwenhliziyo yakhe, wabhekana naye ukuba abe ngummengameli kwabahlali bakhe; ngoba wena awugcinenga umthetho kaYehova.
USamuweli waphuma eGilgal, waya eGibeha kaBhenjamin. USawule wababala abantu ababenabo, kwaba ngamakhulu ayisishiyagalombili.
USawule noYonatan unyana wakhe, namadodana abo, bahlala eGibeha yaseBhenjamini; kodwa amaFilisti ayeseMikmasha.
Baphuma esiteji samaFilisti, bahlukaniswe abe ngamaqembu amathathu; elinye iqembu libhekene ne-Ofra, ezweni laseShuali.
omunye usuka eBethoroni, nomunye usuka emfuleni waseZeboyim, obhekene nesiqhingi.
Ngakho-ke, kwakungatholakali umuntu osebenza ngegolide ezweni lonke likaSirayeli; ngoba amaFilisti ayethi, Uma kungenjalo abaHebhere bangakwenza amacwecwe noma izibhamu.
Amadodakazi kaSirayeli wonke ayewela eFilisti, ukuze aqinise izitsha zakhe, nezibhamu zakhe, nama-apile akhe, namahhashi akhe.

Intengo yaba ngamaphesenti amabili engxenyeni yesithathu yeshekeli yokusika ama-ploughs nama-hoes, namaphesenti amathathu engxenyeni yesithathu yeshekeli yokusika ama-forks nama-axis kanye nokulungisa izintambo zengulube.
Kwathi ngosuku lokulwa, kwakukhona umuntu othile phakathi kwamadodana kaSawule noYonathani, oneqhwa noma inqwaba esandlani sakhe; kwaba khona uSawule noYonatan unyana wakhe kuphela.
Ke kaloku kwaphuma iqembu labantu baseFilisti, besuka eMikmashheni.
Ngosuku oluthile uYonathani, indodana kaSawule, wathi kulowo ophethe isibhamu sakhe: Yiza, sidlule eqenjini labaseFilisti elisemaphandleni; kodwa akawutshela ubaba wakhe.
USawule wayehlala enhliziyweni yeGibeha, ngaphansi komnqumo eMigron; kwabekho naye amadoda angamakhulu amathandathu.

Kwabekho phakathi kwabo uAhiya, owayegqoka i-ephodi, indodana ka-Ahitubhu, umshado ka-Ikhabhodi, indodana kaPhinehasi, indodana ka-Eli, ukumkani kaYehova eShilo; futhi akukho muntu owaziyo ukuthi uYonathan wasuka.
Kwaba khona isibhakabhaka esiphakeme ngakwesobunxele nakwesokudla, lapho uYonathan efuna ukudlula khona, ukuze afike emgodini wamaFilisti; igama elinye libizwa ngokuthi yiBozezi, kanti elinye iShene.
Omunye uphakama ngasenyakatho, ebhekene neMikmash; omunye uphakama ngasentshonalanga, ebhekene neGeba.

Wathi uYonathani kulowo wesifazane othwala isibhamu sakhe, Yeza, sidlule esiteshini salabo abangatholanga; kungase kube ukuthi iNkosi akwenzele okuthile; ngoba akukho okungeke kuvimbele iNkosi ekusindiseni abantu abaningi noma abancane.
"Yenza konke okusemandleni akho," kusho umthwalo wakhe wensimbi. "Chofoza phambili. Nginenhliziyo yakho nengqondo."
Wathi uYonathani, Siyahamba, sidlule kulabo abantu, sibonise kubo.
Uma bethi kuthi, Thumelani lapha, kuze sifike kuwe; khona-ke sizohlala lapho sikhona, futhi asizikhuphuli kubo.
Uma bethi, Nciphisani nathi; khona-ke sizokhuphuka; ngoba lokhu kuzoba yisibonakaliso sethu sokuthi iNkosi wabanikela emlenzeni wethu.
Babonisana nabo bobabili emkhosini wamaFilisti. Bathi amaFilisti, "Njengoba abaHebhere bephuma ezigodini, lapho befihla khona."

Bathi amadoda asesiteji kuYonathani, nomuntu ophethe isithuthuthu sakhe, sithi, Yindeni nathi, futhi sizokuzifundisa. Wathi uYonathani komuntu ophethe isithuthuthu sakhe, Yiya phezulu ngemuva kwami; ngoba iNkosi wabanikela esandlani samaSirayeli.

UYonathani wehla ngezandla zakhe nezinyawo zakhe, nomuntu ophethe isibhamu sakhe walandela emuva kwakhe; futhi abaFilisti bawela phambi kukaYonathani, nomuntu ophethe isibhamu sakhe wababulala emuva kwakhe.
Kulesi simo sokuqala, uJonathan nomuntu ophethe isibhamu sakhe babulala abantu abangu-20 endaweni elingana nengxenye yobukhulu bendawo encane.

Kwaba khona ubuhlungu obukhulu emikhosini yamaFilisti, emgwaqeni, nasezindaweni zomhlaba. Nabo bonke ababhikishe emgwaqweni, nalabo abahlaselayo, bakhathazeka; futhi izwe licindezelwa, ngenxa yobuhlungu obuvela kuThixo.
USaule ohlala eGibeha, eBhenjamini, wabona inkosi ihamba ngaso sonke isikhathi.
Wathi uSawule kubo bonke abantu ababenabo, Nibala abantu, nibone ukuthi ubani osuka kuthiwe. Bathe babalwa, bona, uYonathani nowesifazane ophethe isibhamu sakhe abakho.
Wathi uSawule ku-Ahiya, Nciphisa lapha ibhokisi likaThixo; kwabe sekuphakathi kwabaSirayeli ngalolu xesha.
USawule ekhuluma nombingeleli, kwabonakala ukuthi umsindo emgwaqweni wamaFilisti ukhula futhi ukhula; uSawule wathi kumbingeleli, Sula konke okwenze.
Wahlangana uSawule nabantu bakhe bonke, wafika emdlalweni, wathola amaFilisti ephazamisekile, ngaso sonke isikhathi, ahlaselana ngeqhwa.
Baningi namadoda aseHibhuri, abelokhu ehamba nabaFilisti ngaphambilini, afike nabo esibhedlela, washintsha uhlangothi, waya kumaSirayeli, waba nguSawule noYonathani.
Bathe bonke amadoda aseSirayeli afihlakele ezweni eliphakeme laseEphrayime, akubona ukuthi abaFilisti babaleka, waqala ukulwa, wabalandela.
Wasindisa iNkosi isizwe samaSirayeli ngalolu busuku. Ukulwa kwadlula eBhethe-Aweni.

Amadoda aseSirayeli ayephukile ngalolu busuku; ngoba uSawule wabeka abantu emkhondweni, esithi, Utholwe umuntu odla ukudla ngaphambi kokuphuma kwelanga, kuze kube yilapho ngithole inkohliso ezimpini zami. Ngakho bonke abantu abazange badla ukudla.
Wonke umkhosi wafika emfuleni, futhi kwakukhona ujusi ezweni.
Baye befika emfuleni, babone ujusi uphuma emlonyeni wabo; kodwa akukho muntu okwaziyo ukuwubeka emlonyeni wabo, ngoba babekhathazekile ngenxa yesinqumo.

UYonathani ke akakwazi ukulalela ukuthi ubaba wakhe wabeka isizwe ngaphansi komshado, ngakho waphakamisa ikhanda lentambo esesandlani sakhe, wayifaka emgodini wengulube; waveza isandla sakhe emphinjeni yakhe, futhi amehlo akhe akhanya.
Wathi omunye kubo kuye, uthi: Ubaba wakho wabeka isandla sakhe esiqinile emkhosini, esithi, Kulahlekile wonke umuntu odla ukudla namuhla; ngakho abantu bahlupheka.
Wathi uYonathani, Ubaba wami unqobile izwe; bhekani ukuthi amehlo ami akhanya kanjani, ngoba ngadla inkomishi encane yalo mhlophe.
Kungakuhle yini uma abantu bedla namuhla isiphuzo esithathwe ezimpilweni zabo, ukuze sikwazi ukubulala abantu abaningi baseFilisti?
Kwathi ngalolu busuku amaSirayeli ahlasela amaFilisti, esuka eMikmasi waya eAyaloni; futhi abaSirayeli balahleka.
Basuka bathatha izinkomo, namahhashi, nengulube, namabele, bazibulala phezu komhlaba, badla inyama negazi layo.
Wathi umuntu kuSawule, "Njengoba labo bantu besenza isono phambi koYehova, bedla inyama negazi kuyo." USawule wathi, "Uyihloniphile; cindezela lapha phansi itshe elikhulu!"

Wathi uMosis, Yiya phakathi kwalabo abantu, sithi kubo, Ninikele nami wonke umuntu inkomo yakhe, noma ingulube yakhe, nizibulala lapha, nizidle; futhi ningabi nesono kuYehova, nidla inyama enegazi. Wathatha khona wonke umuntu inkomo yakhe ngaleyo busuku, wayizibulala khona.
Wakha uSawule isibingelelo kuYehova; kwaba yilapho waqala khona ukwakha isibingelelo kuNkulunkulu.

Wathi uSawule, "Siye kulandela abaFilisti ngobusuku, futhi sizobalaza phakathi kwabo kuze kube yimini; ngeke sishiye umuntu ophilayo kubo." Baphendula bathi, "Yenza konke okulungile engqondweni yenu." Wathi umbingeleli, "Sizobuza uNkulunkulu lapha.
USawule wabuza uNkulunkulu, esithi, Ngizohamba ngilandela abaFilistimi? Ingabe uzobanikela esandlani sakwaSirayeli? Kodwa uNkulunkulu akazange amphendule ngalolusuku.
Wathi uSawule, "Nifike lapha, bonke abaphathi bezinkomo, ukuze sibone ukuthi yini isono esibekiwe namuhla.
Ngokuba iNkosi, umsindisi wakwaSirayeli, ephilayo, noma ngabe nguYonathan, unyana wami, kufanele aphele. Akukho muntu owaziyo phakathi kwamadodana lawo.
Wathi uSawule kuwo wonke amadoda aseSirayeli, Nihlale lapha; nami noYonathani unyana wami sihlale lapha. Baphendula abantu, bathi, Ukwenzeni konke okulungile emehlo enu.
USawule wathandaza kuYehova, uNkulunkulu kaSirayeli, wathi, Siphendule ngokucacile. Watholakalela uYonathani noSawule, futhi laba bantu bahlanzwa.
Wathi uSawule, Thola isibhamu phakathi kwami noYonathani unyana wami. UJonathani wathathwa.
Wathi uSawule kuYonathani, Ngitshele ukuthi yini oyenze. UYonathani wathi kuye, Ngadla ijusi elilodwa ngengxenye yesandla sami; namuhla ngizofa!
Wathi uSawule, "UNkulunkulu akwenze lokhu nokunye okuningi, uma ungafanga, Jonathan."

Bathi abantu kuSawule, Uzofa yini uYonathani, owenza lo kulwa olukhulu ezweni laseSirayeli? Akufanele kube njalo; njengoba iNkosi ephilayo, angeke izinwele zakhe zibe ngaphansi komhlaba, ngoba wakwenza lokhu namhlanje ngesandla sikaThixo. Basindisa ke labo bantu uYonathani, akafanga.
Wabuya uSawule, walandela amaFilisti; babuyela ezweni labo langempela.

USawule waba ngukumkani phezu kwaSirayeli, wabhekana nezitha zakhe ngazo zonke izingcezu: namaMowabi, namadodakazi ka-Amoni, neEdomu, namakhosi aseSobha, namaFilisti; lapho ebuyela khona, wayewahlasela.
Wagquma ukulwa, wahlasela ama-Amaleki, wavikela isiSirayeli kulabo ababebathutha.
Onyana bakaSawule: uYonathani, noIshivi, noMalki-shuha; igama lenkosikazi yakhe lalinguMerabhi, negama lendodakazi yakhe linguMikhayeli.
Unkosikazi wakhe wayengu-Ahinoamu intombi ka-Ahimahazi; umphathi wesibhakabhaka sikaSawule waba ngu-Abner, unyana ka-Neri, owesifazane kaSawule.
UKishi ubaba kaSawule, noNeri ubaba ka-Abner, babe yizingane zikaAbiyeli.
Ngazo zonke izinsuku zokuphila kukaSawule, kwakukhona ukulwa okunzima kakhulu namaFilisti; ngaso sonke isikhathi lapho uSawule ebona khona umuntu onamandla, noma indodana yothando, wayemthatha.
Wathi uSamuweli kuSawule, "Ngithunyelwe nguYehova ukuthi ngikukhiphe wena ube ngukumkani phezu kwabantu bakhe baseSirayeli; namuhla ke lalela ilizwi likaNkulunkulu.
Usho lokhu iNkosi wezizwe zonke, uthi: Ngizobhekana namadodakazi ka-Amaleki ngenxa yezinto azenzayo ezweni lakwaSirayeli, lapho ahlasela khona amaSirayeli, ngesikhathi bephuma eYiputa.
Hamba manje, uhlasele ama-Amalekhi, upheleze ngokugcwele yonke into yabo; ungawathandeki; ubulala amadoda nabesifazane, izingane nezingane ezinyathelisayo, izinkomo nengulube, izikelemu nezinkomo.
USawule waqoqa abantu eTelayimu, wababala; kwaba ngumakhulu amabili amawaka amadoda ahamba ngezinyawo, namadodana kaYuda amakhulu ayisithupha.
USawule waya edolobhaneni lakwa-Amaleki, wamisa isikhala esibheke emfuleni.

Wathi uMosis kwabaKenisi, Yiya, shiya ama-Amaleki, ukuze ngikusindise wena kanye nabo; ngoba wena wabonisa ubulungisa kubo bonke abantu bakaSirayeli, lapho bephuma eYiputa. Basuka ke abaKenisi phakathi kwa-Amaleki.
USawule wahlasela ama-Amaleki, kusukela eHavila kuya eShure, eningizimu yeYiputa.
Wathatha uAgagi, ukumkani wama-Amaleki, ephilayo, wabulala bonke abantu bakhe ngeqhwa.

Kodwa uSawule namadodana akhe baxosha uAgagi, namakhowe angcono, namakhowe amakhulu, nezingulube ezinomsoco, nezinkomo, konke okungcono; abafuni ukuzisola ngokugcwele; kodwa konke okubi, nento encane, bazisola ngokugcwele.
Kwafika ke igama likaYehova kuSamuweli, lithi,
Wathi uSamuweli: "Kungibuhlungu ukuthi ngakwenza uSawule ube ngukumkani, ngoba ushintshile engilandela, akazange enze amazwi ami." USamuweli wakhathazeka kakhulu, wathi kuYehova yonke le busuku.
Wavuka ke uSamuweli ekuseni, waya ebhekana noSawule. Bathi kuye: "USawule useKarmeli, futhi wamisa khona isikhumbuzo sakhe, waphuma waya eGalgali." USawule wathi kuSamuweli: "Kulungile! Kulungile!"
Wafika uSamuweli kuye, wathi uSawule, UYehova akubabaze; ngikwenzele umthetho kaNkulunkulu.
Wathi uSamuweli, Ngabe yini le nto yokubhema kwengulube enhliziyweni yami? Ingabe yini le nto yokubhaka kwezinkomo engingayibona?
Waphendula uSawule, wathi: Kusuka ku-Amaleki babuya nabo; ngoba begcine okungcono kwezingulube nezimvu, ukuze babe yisondlo kuYehova uNkulunkulu wakho; kodwa konke okunye sakuvama.
Wathi uSamuweli kuSawule, Kulungile; ngizokutshela ukuthi yini leyo iNkosi engikutshele yona ngobusuku obudlule. Wathi uSawule, Ubani?
Wathi uSamuweli, Ngabe wena, lapho ubencane emehlo akho, awuzange ube yinhloko yezizwe zakwaSirayeli? UYehova wakwenza ube ngukumkani phezu kwaSirayeli.
Wakuthumela wena iNkosi, wathi, Iya, zulazula ngaso sonke isikhathi labo ababusi base-Amaleki; bhekana nabo, kuze kube wukuphela kwabo.
Kungani na ukuthi ungamlalela iNkosi? Kungani na ukuthi uhambe uhamba-hamba, wenze okubi emehloni kaYehova?
Wathi uSawule, "Ngenakho ngitholele ilizwi likaYehova; ngahamba ngendlela iNkosi angisithumelele yona, ngabulala wonke ama-Amaleki, ngabuyisela uAgagi ukumkani wabo.
Bathatha amakhowe, namabhokhwe, empilweni yazo zonke izinto ezilahliwe, ukuze banikela kuYehova uNkulunkulu wakho eGiligali.

Wathi uSamuweli, Ingabe iNkosi uthanda izipho zokudlwengula nezipho zokudla, njengokuba ethanda ukulalela uMoya oNgcwele? Ukulalela kungcono kunesibopho sokudla, nokulalela kungcono kunamafutha omnqumo.
Ukwephula umthetho kufana nokwenza izimanga, futhi ukukhohlisa kufana nokukhonza amatshe; ngenxa yokuthi ushiye igama likaYehova, naye ushiye wena ukuba ungukumkani.
Wathi uSawule kuSamuweli, Nginqunyelwe, ngoba ngaphula umthetho kaYehova, namazwi akho; futhi ngibe nomoya wabo bonke abantu, ngabavumela.
Manje ke, ngiyakucela, usindise isono sami; buyela nami, ngizibophezele kuYehova.
Wathi uSamuweli kuye, Ngizobuyelanga nawe; ngoba usuke wakhohlisa ilizwi likaYehova, futhi iNkosi usekukhohlise wena ukuthi ungaba ngukumkani phezu kwaSirayeli.
Kwathi lapho uSamuweli ebhekene nokuphuma, uSawule wathatha isibambo sakhe, saqhuma.
Wathi uSamuweli kuye, UYehova usale ubukumkani bamaSirayeli kuwe namuhla, wawunikeze umngane wakho ongcono kunakho konke.
UNkulunkulu onguMhlonishwa waseSirayeli akakhohlisi, futhi akashintshi ingqondo yakhe; ngoba uNkulunkulu awumuntu oshintsha ingqondo yakhe.
Wathi yena uSawule, Ngibizile; kodwa ngikucela, ngihloniphe ngami phambi kwabakhulu bezinhlanga zami, futhi phambi kwamadodana aseSirayeli; buyela nami, ukuze ngiwukhonze iNkosi uNkulunkulu wakho.
Wabuya uSamuweli elandela uSawule, wathandaza uSawule kuYehova.
Wathi uSamuweli, "Ninikele ku-Agagi ukumkani wama-Amaleki." U-Agagi wafika kuye ngethemba elikhulu, wathi, "Kuyinto ecacile ukuthi ibuhlungu bokufa budlule."
Wathi uSamuweli, Njengekhephu lakho elihlukumeza izingane zabesifazane, ngaleyo ndlela ubaba wakho uzohlukumeza izingane phakathi kwabesifazane. USamuele wabulala uAgagi phambi koYehova eGilgal.
USamuweli wehla waya eRama, uShawule wafika ekhaya lakhe eGibeha kaShawule.
USamuweli akazange aphinde abone uSawule, kuze kube yimini yokufa kwakhe; kodwa uSamuweli wahlupheka ngenxa kaSawule; futhi iNkosi wakhathazeka ngokuba wenza uSawule ukumkani phezu kwaSirayeli.

Wathi iNkosi kuSamuweli, Ingabe usuzokhala isikhathi esingakanani ngenxa kaSawule, uma ngiwuphoqisile ukuba angeke abe ngukumkani phezu kwaSirayeli? Ugcwalise isikhunta sakho ngophethiloli, uye; ngiyakuthumela kuYese waseBethelehemu, ngoba ngithole omunye owesifazane wakhe ukuthi abe ngumphathi.
Wathi uSamuweli, Ngabe ngizohamba kanjani? Uma uSawule engazi, uzongibulala. Wathi iNkosi, Thola inkomo encane nawe, uthi, Ngiye ukunikela ngenhlanhla kukaNkulunkulu;
Ngizokukhombisa ukuthi yini okufanele uyenze, futhi wena uzowuphazamisa lowo ngizokutshela wona.
Wakwenza uSamuweli njengoba wathi iNkosi. Yafika eBethelehemu, baphuma amadoda amakhulu edolobhaneni layo, akhathazekile, wamthola, bethi kuye, Ufika kanjani ngokuthula?

Wathi uSamuweli, "Kulungile; ngifikile ukunikela ngenhlanhla kuYehova; zinikeleni, nifike nami emkhondweni." Wazinikela uYese nabantwana bakhe, wababiza emkhondweni, wathi kubo, "Njengoba niphila, nizophila.
Bafika, uSamuweli ebona uElibha, wathi: "Kulungile ukuthi lo nguwo okhethiwe nguYehova ukuba ahlale lapha phambi kukaYehova."

Wathi iNkosi kuSamuweli, Ungambhekanga ngobuhle bakhe, noma ngokuphakama kwakhe; ngoba ngiwubeke phansi. UNkulunkulu akabhekanga ngobuso bomuntu; ngoba umuntu ubheka izinto ezingaphandle, kodwa uNkulunkulu ubheka intamo.
UYese wabiza uAbinabadi, wamhambisa phambi kukaSamuweli. Wathi uSamuweli, "UNkulunkulu akawakhethi nawo la maqembu."
Wathi uYese: "Uzohamba naye uShama," kodwa uSamuweli wathi, "iNkosi akawakhethi nalowo."
Wathi uYese, wabeka izingane zakhe ezisixhenxe zihambe phambi kukaSamuweli; kodwa uSamuweli wathi kuye, UYehova akawakhethi lawa.

Wathi uYese, Ingabe lezo zonke izingane zakho? Wathi uJese, Kushiwo ukuthi, Ukhona oncane; yena ugcina izinkomo. Wathi uSamuweli, Sebenzisa umphathi ukuba afike, ngoba singeke sihlale sidla ukudla kuze afike.
Wathumela uYese, wamthola; wabona ukuthi isithombe sakhe sikhanya kakhulu, namazinyo akhe abukeka kahle, nobuso bakhe buhle. Wathi iNkosi kuye, Yiya, umhlobise, ngoba lo nguye.
Wathi uSamuweli, ethatha iphoyinti le-oyile, wamenza umhluzi phambi kwabazalwane bakhe. UMoya kaYehova wehla phezu kukaDavide kusukela ngalolusuku naphezu kwalo; wabuya ke uSamuweli waya eRama.
UMoya kaYehova wawusuka kuSawule, uMoya ongcolile osuka eNkosini wamangalisa uSauli.
Bathi abakhonzi bakaSawule kuye, Thola, umphefumulo ombi osuka kuThixo ubuhlungu kuwe.
Ngiyacela ukuthi umnikazi wethu atshele abakhonzi bakhe ukuthi bafune umuntu odlala kahle i-harp, ukuze uma uMoya oyiNgcwele ovela kuThixo efika kuwe, abe ngumuntu odlalayo, futhi ube nempilo.
Wathi uSawule kwabakhonzi bakhe, Bukelani umuntu odlala kahle, nimveze kuye.

Waphendula omunye wamadodakazi, wathi, Ngibone unyana kaYese waseBethelehemu owazi ukubhoza, futhi ungumuntu onamandla amakhulu, nowesifazane ongumnqobi, futhi unomsindo omuhle, naye ungumuntu obukekayo; futhi iNkosi usenakhe.
USawule wathumela abathunywa kuYeshaya, esithi, Thumela kum uDavide, unyana wakho, ohlala ezindleni.
Wathi uYese, ethatha ibhuza elihlanganisiwe nokudla, nebhodlela lewayini, nenyama yenkomo, wazisa kuSawule ngoDavide unyana wakhe.
Wafika uDavide kuSawule, wasebenza kuye. USawule wamthanda kakhulu uDavide; waba ngumphathi wezikhali zakhe.
USawule wathumela kuYeshaya, esithi, Akufanele uDavide ahlale enhliziyweni yami; ngoba unenhlonipho kuye.

Ngaso sonke isikhathi lapho umphefumulo ovela kuThixo efika kuSawule, uDavide wayethatha i-harp yakhe, wadlala; khona-ke uSawule waba nokuthula. Wazizwa engcono, futhi lo mphefumulo omubi wawuyaphuma kuye.
Baqoqa amaFilisti imikhosi yabo ukubhikisha, bahlangana eSokho ezweni laseYuda, bamisa isibhedlela phakathi kweSoko ne-Azeka, e-Efesu Dammim.
USawule namadodana aseSirayeli bahlangana, bamisa isikhashana eGoli lase-Ela, balungiselela ukulwa nabaFilisti.
AbaFilisti bahlala emfuleni owodwa, futhi amaSirayeli ahlala emfuleni owodwa; bekhona umfula phakathi kwabo.
Waphuma ezweni lakwaFilisti umnqobi okuthiwa nguGolida, waseGathi; ubude bakhe kwakuyimitha eziyisishiyagalombili.
Wagqoka isibhamu segolide kanye ne-coat yensimbi eyenziwe ngezinhlayiya zesiliva, eyisisindo esingaphezu kwamakhilogremu ayishumi nesishiyagalolunye.
Ube ne-bronze armor emilenzeni yakhe, futhi i-bronze spear yafakwa emuva kwakhe.

Umcibisholo wakhe, umbhoshongo wakhe, ubukhulu bawo befana nentambo yombukiso, futhi ikhanda lakhe lensimbi lalingamakhilogremu ayisishiyagalombili. Uwesifazane ophethe isibhamu sakhe sahamba phambi kwakhe.
UGoliyati wahlala, wathi kubo bonke abantu baseSirayeli: Yini na ukuthi nisesiteji sokulwa? NginguFilisti, futhi niyimikhonzi kaSawule; khetheni umuntu othile phakathi kwenu, nimkhuphule.
Uma ekwazi ukulwa nami, futhi embulala, khona-ke sizoba ngabakhonzi benu; kodwa uma ngikwazi ukumnqoba, futhi embulala, khona-ke nizobe ngabakhonzi bethu, nisebenzele.
Wathi uFilisti: Namuhla ngizimangalisa izikhulu zakwaSirayeli; ngisinike umuntu, sihlangane.
USawule namadoda amakhulu aseSirayeli wonke akubona amazwi alo mFilisti, baphoqeleka ukuba bakhathazeke kakhulu.
UDavide ubengumntwana kaYese, umEfrati waseBethelehemu eYuda; uJese wayenezingane eziyisishiyagalombili. UYese waba mkhulu kakhulu eminyakeni kaSawule.
Omkhulu wabo bonke oonyana bakaYese, uElibha, omkhulu kubo, no-Abinabadi owesibili, no-Shama owesithathu, balandela uSawule ezweni.
UDavide wayeyindodana encane. Abakhulu abathathu balandela uSawule,
UDavide ke wayehamba esuka kuSawule, waya eBethelehemu, ukuze agcine izinkomo zikababa wakhe.
Lo mFilisti wayefika ekuseni nakusihlwa, ehlala khona izinsuku ezimashumi mane.
Wathi uYese kuDavide, unyana wakhe, Thola le bhokisi lenkomo ethosiwe, nalezi nkomishi eziyisithupha zezinkukhu, uzithumelele abazalwane bakho emgodini.
Thola lezi zingulube ezingu-10 kumphathi weyunithi yabo. Bona ukuthi abazalwane bakho banganjani, bese uthola ezinye izindaba kubo
Bakhona uSawule namadoda amakhulu aseSirayeli eGoli le-Ela, bebhekana nabaFilisti.
UDavide washiya ingulube ngasemini, wazisa izimpahla, waphuma, njengoba uYese abemtshela. Wafika esiteshini samaphoyisa ngesikhathi isizwe sisuka esihlalweni sayo sokulwa, sishaya umsindo wokulwa.
AbaSirayeli nabaseFilisti bahlanganisana, bebhekene nomunye.
UDavide washiya izinto zakhe kumuntu ophethe izimpahla, wahamba eqenjini lempi, wabuza abazalwane bakhe ukuthi bangani.
Wakhuluma nabo, yabona uGoliyati, umnqobi wamaFilisti waseGathi, ephuma emidlalweni yakhe, eshaya ngezwi lakhe elijwayelekile; uDavide walalela.
Amadodakazi aseSirayeli, lapho ebona lo mntu, baphuma phambi kwakhe, bekhathazeka kakhulu.

Bathi amadoda aseSirayeli, Ubona yini lo muntu ophumayo? Uphuma ukukhohlisa amakhosikazi aseSirayeli. Uma umuntu ebulala yena, ukumkani uzomnika impahla enkulu, futhi uzomnika intombi yakhe njengomkakhe, futhi umndeni wakhe awudingi ukuba ukhokhe inzalo eSirayeli.

Wathi uDavide kubo bonke abantu abakhona, esithi, Kuzokwenziwani umuntu obulala lo mFilisti, futhi asuse isidumbu eSirayeli? Ubani lo Mfilisithi ongatholwe ukutholwa, ukuthi agweme amaqembu kaThixo ophilayo?
Bathi kuye ukuthi yini okufanele yenziwe ngomuntu obulalayo.

UElibha, udadewabo omdala, ekhuluma nalabo abantu, wazwa uElibha, udadewabo omkhulu, ukuthi uDavide usekhuluma nabo. Waphoqelela uDavide, wathi: "Iyini inhloso yokufika kwakho lapha? Ngabe ubani owashiya naye amakhowe ambalwa esiqhingini? Ngiyazi inhlonipho yakho, nobubi benhliziyo yakho; ufike ukubhekana nempi kuphela."
Wathi uDavide, Ngakwenza yini manje? Ingabe ngingeke ngikhulume?
Kwathi lapho wabuyela kuye omunye umuntu, wabuza umbuzo ofanayo, futhi abantu baphendule yena njengokuba ngaphambili.
Wathi uDavide ukuthi, "Ngikutshela lokho," kwathiwa kuSawule; wathumela uSawule ukuba afike.
Wathi uDavide kuSawule, "Akukho muntu ongeke akhohlwe ngenxa yalo mFilisti; umkhonzi wakho uzoya nokulwa naye.
Wathi uSawule, Awukwazi ukuyobhekana nalo mFilisti, ukuthi ube nokulwa naye; ngoba wena ungumfundi, yena ke unkosikazi onamandla kusukela emncane.
Wathi uDavide kuSawule, Umkhonzi wakho wagcina izinkomo zikababa wakhe; kwafika ingulube, noma inkomo, yathatha inkomo emndenini.
Ngiye ngayilandela, ngayishaya, ngayikhulula ingulube emlonyeni wayo. Xa yabuyela kum, ngayithatha ngezinwele zayo, ngayibetha, ngayibulala.
Ngiye ngabulala ingulube, futhi ngiye ngabulala ingulube; umkhonzi wakho uzoba njengomunye wabo, nalowo mFilisti ongeke atholwe ukutholwa, ngenxa yokuthi waduduza amaqembu kaThixo ophilayo.
UYehova osindisele enhliziyweni yengulube, nasenhliziyweni yomdlavuza, uzongisindisa futhi engqondweni yalo mFilisti. Wathi uSawule kuDavide, Yiya; iNkosi abe nawe.
USawule wagqoka uDavide izicathulo zakhe, wabeka phezu kwakhe isigqoko sokulwa, wabeka isibhamu segolide ekhanda lakhe.
UDavide wagqoka ikhebula likaSawule phezu kwezicathulo zakhe, wazama ukuhamba; ngoba akazange alisebenzise. Wathi uDavide kuSawule, Ngangikwazi ukuhamba ngale nto, ngoba angiyisebenzisile. Wazisusa.

Wathatha inkomishi yakhe esandlani sakhe, wakhetha izintaba eziyisishiyagalombili eziqinile emfuleni, wazibeka ephaketheni lakhe lenyamakazi; intambo yakhe ibe esandlani sakhe, wafika kulowo mFilisti.
Uthe lo mFilisti, ophethe isibhamu sakhe phambi kwakhe, wafika waya eDavideni.
Wabheka uDavide, wabona ukuthi ungumfundi omusha kuphela, onempilo nobuhle obuhle; wabheka phansi kuye.
Wathi uFilisti kuDavide, Ngiyinja yini mina, ukuthi ungene kum ngezinkomishi? UFilisti wehlaza uDavide ngoThixo wakhe.
Wathi, "Njima lapha, futhi ngizonikela inyama yakho izilwane ezifuywayo kanye namazinyoni!"
Wathi uDavide kulowo mFilisti, Ufika kimi ngeqhwa, nesihlalo somlilo, nesibhamu; kodwa mina ngiya kuwe ngegama likaYehova wezizwe zonke, uNkulunkulu wamabhishobhi aseSirayeli, owawumbulela yena.

Namuhla iNkosi uzokunikela esandla sami, ngizokubulala, ngizokususa ikhanda lakho; futhi namhlanje ngizobeka izicubu zesizwe samaFilisti ezilwaneni eziphilayo nezinyamazane, ukuze umhlaba wonke wazi ukuthi kukhona uNkulunkulu eSirayeli.
Nabo bonke abakhona lapha bayazi ukuthi iNkosi akasindisi ngeqhwa, noma ngemikhosi; ngoba ukunqoba kukaNkulunkulu, futhi uzokunikela esandla sethu.
Kwathi lapho lo Mfilisita ehamba ebhekene naye, uDavide wahamba ngokushesha, waya emgwaqweni wokulwa.
Wafika ebhokisini lakhe, wathatha khona itshe, wehla, wamshaya uFilisti emlonyeni wakhe; itshe lalibanjwa emlonyeni wakhe, waba phantsi ngobuso bakhe emhlabeni.
UDavide wanqoba uFilisti ngentambo netshe, futhi angeke kube nekhebula esandla sakhe; wahlasela lo philistimi, wambulala.

Wahamba uDavide, wahlala phezu kwakhe, wathatha ikhebula likaFilisti, lalimaza lisuka emgodini wayo, wabulala uFilisti, wamisa intamo yakhe ngekhebula. Babona amaFilisti ukuthi umnqobi wabo ufile, babuyela emuva, babaleka.

Amadoda aseSirayeli nawaseYuda aphuma, eshaya ngezwi elikhulu, alandela amaFilisti kuze kufike emgwaqeni waseGathi, namasango ase-Ekron; futhi izicubu zamaFilisti zasakazeka emigwaqweni yaseShaaraim, kuze kufike eGathi nase-Ekron.
Babuya amaSirayeli belandela abaFilisti, bahlasela isibhedlela sabo.
UDavide wathatha ikhanda lomFilisti, waya eYerusalem; izithuthuthu zakhe zazibeka ehhovisi lakhe.

Kwathi lapho uSawule ebona uDavide ephuma ebhekana nalo mFilisti, wathi ku-Abneri, umphathi womkhosi, ethi, U-Abneri, lo mfundi unguye yini? Waphendula u-Abneri, esithi, Kuphila inhliziyo yakho, Nkosi yami, angikazi.
Wathi ukumkani, "Qiniseka ukuthi ngubani unyana lo mfundi?"
Nokho, lapho uDavide ebuya ehlasela umFilisti, uAbheri wamthatha, wamletha phambi kukaSawule; nokho uDavide wagcina ikhanda lomFilisti.
Wathi uSawule kuye, Ungubani unyana wakho, umshado? UDavide wathi, Ngiye unyana womkhonzi wakho uYese waseBethelehemu.
Kwathi, lapho uDavide eqedile ukuxoxa noSawule, uYonathani waba ngumoya owodwa noDavide; wathandana naye njengothando lwakhe.
Ngalowo mhla, uSawule wathatha uDavide naye, akazange amvumele ukuthi abuye endlwini yobaba wakhe.
Wakwenza uYonathani isivumelwano noDavide, ngoba wayemthanda njengomuntu wakhe.
UYonathani wasusa isigqoko sakhe, wamnika uDavide, kanye nezigqoko zakhe zonke, naphezu kweqhwa lakhe, nempucuko yakhe, nesibhamu sakhe.

USawule wathumela uDavide kuwo wonke umsebenzi wakhe, waba nempumelelo enkulu; ngakho uSawule wambeka phezu kwazo zonke izikhulu zomndeni kaSawule. Kwabe kumnandi kubo bonke abantu, nakwabo bonke abavikeli bakaSawule.
Uma bebuya, lapho uDavide wabulala khona umFilisti, kwaphuma amadoda kuzo zonke izifundazwe zakwaSirayeli, ukuhlangabezana noSawule ukumkani, ekhuluma, edansela, nezingcweti, nokuzijabulisa.
Kwathi lapho bedlala khona, bathi: USawule wabulala amawaka akhe, noDavide amashumi amane amawaka akhe.
Wathi uSawule: "Bemnike uDavide amawaka amashumi amabili, kodwa mina nginika amawaka ambalwa. Ingabe angathola lutho ngaphandle kobukhosi?"
Ngaleso sikhathi, uSawule wabhekana noDavide ngesandla esibi.

Kwathi ngosuku olulandelayo, kwafika umphefumulo omubi osuka kuThixo phezu kukaShawule. Wayehamba efulethini lakhe, futhi uDavide wayedlala i-harp, njengoba evame ukukwenza. UShawule ubenesibhamu esandleni sakhe,
Wayisusa, wathi, Ngizowubeka uDavide emgodini. UDavide waphuma kuye izikhathi ezimbili;
USawule wakhathazeka ngoDavide, ngoba iNkosi ube noDavide, kodwa uSaule wayeseshayele.
USawule wasusa uDavide kuye, wammisa njengomphathi wamaphesenti ayikhulu; uDavide wayehamba ezindaweni zokulwa.
Waphumelela kakhulu kuwo wonke umsebenzi wakhe, ngoba iNkosi waye naye.
Kwathi lapho uSawule ebona ukuthi waphumelela kanjani, wakhathazeka kakhulu ngaye.
Kodwa wonke amaSirayeli namadodana kaYuda ayemthanda uDavide, ngoba wayehamba nabo emidlalweni.

Wathi uSawule kuDavide, Thola lapha intombi yami enkulu, uMerabhi; ngizokuyinika wena ukuba ngumkakhe; kodwa ube ngumuntu onamandla kakhulu, uyeke ukunqoba imibhikisho kaYehova. USawule wathi, Ngingawukhuphula umlomo wami kuye; bakwenze amaFilisti.
Wathi uDavide kuSawule, Ngibani nami, nokuthi yini imindeni yami, noma inkosikazi yobaba wami eSirayeli, ukuthi ngibe ngumkakhe wombuso?
Kwafika ke isikhathi sokuthi uMerabhi, intombi kaSawule, anikezelwe kuDavide; wafakwa njengowesifazane ku-Adriyeli waseMehola.
UMikhayeli, intombi kaSawule, wathanda uDavide; kwathi lapho kuthunyelwe khona uSawule, kwamangala.
Wathi uSawule, Ngizomunika yena, ukuze abe yintambo yakhe, futhi abaFilisti bagweme ukumbulala. Wathi uSawule kuDavide, Ngalokhu uzoba ngumngane wami wesifazane.
Wathi uSawule kubo abakhonzi bakhe, Nikhulume noDavide ngokufihlakeleyo, nithi, Thola ukuthi ukumkani uthandana nawe, futhi bonke abakhonzi bakhe bakuthanda wena; namuhla ke ube ngumngane wakhe.
Wathi uDavide, Ingabe kuncane kuwe ukuba ube ngumngane womkakhe? Ngingumuntu ogama lingu-Abhisheki, futhi angikaze ngibhekwe. UDavide wathi kubo: Kunzima yini kuwe ukuba ngumngane womkakhe?
Bathi abakhonzi bakaSawule kuye amazwi kaDavide,

Waphendula uSawule, wathi: Uzothi kuDavide ukuthi, "Ubukhosi abufunanga lutho ngaphandle kwempahla yomtshali-zimali, kodwa isikhumba esincane samaFilisti elinamakhulu amahlanu, ukuze agweme izimpi zakhe."
Bathi abakhonzi bakaDavide lokhu, wathanda uDavide ukuba abe ngumngane womkakhe; futhi ngaphambi kokuba izinsuku ziphele,

Wathatha uDavide abantu bakhe, waphuma, wabulala amaFilisti amakhulu amabili, waveza isikhumba sabo esingenalutho, wababala bonke emkhosini, ukuze abe ngumngane wombuso. USawule wamnika intombi yakhe uMikhayeli ukuba ibe ngumfazi.
Wabona uSawule ukuthi iNkosi ube noDavide, futhi inkosikazi yakhe iMikhayeli ibithanda uDavide.
Waqala ukukhathazeka kakhulu ngoDavide, wahlala eyisitha sikaDavide kuze kube sekuphele impilo yakhe.
Baphuma abaphathi bamaFilisti emdlalweni; futhi lapho bephuma khona, uDavide waphumelela kakhulu kunabo bonke abaholi bakaSawule; futhi igama lakhe laziwa kakhulu.
USawule wakhuluma noYonathani unyana wakhe, nabangane bakhe bonke, ukuthi babulala uDavide; kodwa uYonatan unyana kaSawule wayethanda kakhulu uDavide.
Wathi kuDavide, "USawule ubaba wami ufuna ukukubulala; qaphela ngoMsombuluko, uye ezindaweni ezifihlakeleyo, uhlale khona.
Ngizophuma ngihlale nobaba wami ezweni lapho uzobe ukhona; ngizokhuluma naye ngawe, futhi uma ngibona okuthile, ngizokutshela.
UYonathani wakhuluma ngoDavide kuSawule ubaba wakhe, wathi kuye, Akufanele ukumkani akwenze kabi umkhonzi wakhe uDavide; ngoba akakwenzanga kahle kuwe, futhi enze izinto eziningi ezisiza wena.

Wabeka impilo yakhe engozini, wabulala uFilisti; futhi iNkosi wenza ukusindisa okukhulu kuwo wonke amaSirayeli, nawe wawubona, waba mnandi. Ngabe ke wena ungenza kabi kumuntu ongenacala ofana noDavide, ukumbulala ngaphandle kwesizathu?
USawule walalela uYonathani, wathi, Kuphila iNkosi ukuthi uDavide ngeke abulawe.
UYonatan wabiza uDavide, wamtshela zonke izinto, wamletha kuSawule. Wasebenza uDavide kuSawule njengangaphambili.
Baphinde baqala ukulwa. UDavide waphuma, wabhekana nabaFilisti; wababulala ngokukhulu kakhulu, besuka phambi kwakhe.
Ke kaloku uMoya oyiNgcwele osuka kuYehova wafika kuSawule, lapho ehlala khona ekhaya lakhe, enesibhamu sakhe esandleni sakhe. UDavide wayedlala i-harp;
USawule wazama ukuwubopha edonga ngentambo yakhe, kodwa uDavide wehlulekile, intambo yakhe yafika edonga. Lo busuku uDavide wabaleka, waphuma.
USawule wathumela abantu endlwini kaDavide, ukuba balinde, ukuze bambulala ekuseni; kodwa uMikhayeli, indodana kaDavide, yathi kuye, Uma ungagcini ngempilo yakho namuhla, ngoMsombuluko uzofa.
Wathi uMikhayeli: "Lala ngezansi uDavide ngefasitela." UDavidu wabaleka, waphuma.
Wathi uMikhayeli, athathe i-teraphim, wayibeka phezu kwebhedu, yayigqoka ngendwangu, yafaka inwele yengulube emlonyeni.
Kwathi lapho uSawule ethumela abantu ukuba bathathe uDavide, uMikhayeli wathi, Unesifo.
USawule wathumela abantu ukuba babhekane noDavide, wathi: "Ninikele kuye embhedeni wakhe, ukuze ngiwususe."
Baye befika, babone ukuthi itshe likhona embhedeni, nezinwele zengulube eduze kwekhanda.
Wathi uSawule ku-Mikhayeli, Kungani na ungenza lokhu ngami, washiya umfowabo wami, waphuma? Yathi i-Mikhayeli kuye, Uthi kimi, Lahla, ngizokubulala yini wena?
UDavide wehla, waphuma, waya kuSamuweli eRama, wamtshela zonke izinto azenzayo uSawule kuye. Wahamba yena noSamuweli waya eNayiothi, bahlala khona.
Batshela uSawule, bethi, UDavide useNayothi eRama.

Wathumela abantu ukuba amthathe. Bathe babona ibandla lamaprofeti likhuluma ngezulu, noSamuweli ehlala phezulu phakathi kwabo; khona-ke uMoya kaThixo waba phezu kwamadodana kaSawule, nabo bathetha ngezulu.
Wathi uSawule, uma kwaziwa lokhu, wathumela abantu abaningi; bona nabo baprofetisa. USaule wathumela abantu besibili, bona nabo baprofeta.
Waphuma yena waya eRama, wafika esiqhingini esikhulu esiseSeku, wathi, Ngawaphi uSamuweli noDavide? Bathi kuye: ENayothi, eRama.
Wahamba uSawule waya eNayiothi, eRama. UMoya kaThixo wafika kuye, wahamba futhi, eprofetisa, kuze kwafika eNayiothi.
Wasusa izigqoko zakhe, waphuma ephupheni phambi kukaSamuweli; wahlala ephupheni ngalo lonke usuku nalolo busuku bonke; ngakho kwathiwa, USawule naye ungumprofeti?
Waphuma uDavide eNayothi, eRama, waya kuYonathani, wathi kuye, Ngikwenze kuphi? Ngakwenza kuphi iphutha lami? Ngakwenza kuphi okubi phambi kobaba wakho, ukuthi afuna ukumibulala?
Wathi uYonathani, "Akekho! Awuzofa; cabanga ukuthi ubaba wami akakwenzanga lutho olukhulu noma oluncane, ngaphandle kokungitshela. Ngabe ungazifihla yini lokhu kum? Akunaqiniso!"

Wathi uDavide: "Ubaba wakho uyazi kahle ukuthi ungithanda, ngakho wathi engqondweni yakhe: 'Akufanele uYonathani akwazi lokhu, ukuze angabi nobuhlungu.' Kodwa-ke, njengoba iNkosi ephilayo, futhi wena uphilayo, ngizohlala nje inyawo elinye kude nokufa."
Wathi uYonatan kuDavide, Ngizokwenza wena konke okubona ukuthi ngikwenze.
Wathi uDavide, Khangelani, kusasa kuzoba yinyanga entsha, lapho ngizodla khona ukudla nobukhosi; kodwa ngiya, ngizifihla ezweni kuze kube ngobusuku bosuku oluzayo.

Uma ubaba wakho engazi ukuthi ngikhona, uzothi kuye, UDavide ungicela ngamandla ukuba ahambe ngokushesha eBethlehem, edolobhaneni lakhe; ngoba kukhona khona isibingelelo seminyaka yonke somndeni wakhe wonke.
Uma ethi, 'Kuhle kakhulu,' khona-ke ngiphephile. Kodwa uma elahlekelwa inhliziyo yakhe, ungaqinisekile ukuthi uthathe isigqibo sokungasindisa.

Nakho ke wena, ngicela, ngenza ubuhle ngami; ngoba sekuyisikhathi engingakwenza khona umhlangano nami phambi koNkulunkulu. Uma ngabe kukhona okubi engikwenzayo, bulala mina wena; kungani nanginikela kubaba wakho?
Wathi uJonathane, "Uma ngikwazi ukuthi ubaba wami uthathe isigqibo sokukukhohlisa, angakutshela yini wena?"
Wathi uDavide, Ubani ozongitshela ukuthi uma ubaba wakho ephendula ngokujulile?
Wathi uYonathani, Yeza, siphume ezweni. Baye khona ndawonye;

Wathi uYonathani kuDavide, Ngizobe ngikhuluma ngeNkosi, uNkulunkulu kaSirayeli, ukuthi ngizokwazi ngaleso sikhathi, noma ngosuku olulandelayo, ukuthi ubaba wami ucabangani; futhi uma ethandana nawe, ngeke yini ngithumele ngikutshele?
Uma ubaba wami efuna ukukwenza kahle kuwe, iNkosi angikwenze lokhu nakunye, uma sengikungakuxwayisa ukuthi ngizokushiya ungenawo umonakalo. UYehova abe nawe, njengokuba ube nobaba wami.
Uma ngiphila, bengibonise inhlonipho kaYehova, ukuze ngingeke ngibulawa.
Ngiyakucela futhi, ungagcini ngothando lwakho emndenini wami, kuze kube yilapho iNkosi egqumeni zonke izitha zikaDavide phezu komhlaba.
Wakwenza uYonathani isivumelwano nendlu kaDavide, wathi, UYehova abhekane nabangane bakaDavide.
Wathi uYonatan kuDavide, Uzophinde ukwenze lokhu; ngoba wayemthanda uDavide njengothando lwakhe.
Wathi uYonatan kuDavide, NgoMsombuluko yinyanga entsha; futhi uzobiwa, ngoba isikhala sakho sizoba sithiwe.
Ngosuku olulandelayo, ngobusuku obungamashumi amabili, uhambe uye endaweni ofihlakele kuyo lapho kwaqala khona lokhu okubi, uhlale eduze kwengcindezi ebizwa ngokuthi yi-Ezel.
Ngizoshaya ama-arrows amathathu ngakwesobunxele kwalo, njengokuthi ngizoshaya eqenjini.

Ngizothumela umfana, ngithi kuye, Iya, thola amabhodlela. Uma ngithi kuye, Bona, amabhodlela akhona ngakwesobunxele kwakho, uzisa lapha; khona-ke uya; ngoba, njengoba uphila iNkosi, awunankinga, akukho okubi.
Uma ngithi kulowo mfundi, Thola, amabhodlela angaphandle kwakho; khona-ke kufanele uhambe, ngoba iNkosi uyakushiya.
UNkulunkulu uzoba ngumshushisi phakathi kwami nawe, kuze kube sekupheleni kwezinsuku zokugcina.
Wayifihla uDavide ezweni. Kwafika usuku lwenyanga entsha, ukumkani wahlala ekudlaleni.
UDavide wahlala endaweni yakhe, ngasedonga, ebhekene noYonathani; futhi uAbheri wahlala eduze kukaSawule; kodwa indawo kaDavide yayingenalutho.
USawule akazange akhulume ngalolu busuku; ngoba wathi, Kubekho okuthile okwenzekile kuDavide, ukuze ahlanzeke; ngokuqinisekile ungcolile.

Kwathi ngosuku olulandelayo, ngomhla wesithathu wenyanga, lapho indawo kaDavide ingekho khona, uSawule wathi kuYonathani unyana wakhe, Kungani na ukuthi unyana kaYese afike emdlalweni, noma namhlanje noma kusasa?
Waphendula uYonathani, wathi, UDavide wawungicela ukuthi amvumele ahambe eBhetheleyimu.

Wathi, Ngicela, ngiya; ngoba imindeni yethu ingumnikelo wokudla edolobhaneni, futhi udadewethu ungitshela ukuthi ngizofika. Uma ungumngane wami, vumelani ngiye ngibone udadewethu; ngakho-ke akaze afike embhedeni kabukhosi.

USawule waphoqa uJonathane, wathi kuye: "Umuntu othandekayo, indodakazi yowesifazane okhohlakelayo; angazi yini ukuthi uthathe isandla somntwana kaYese, ukuze kube yingozi kuwe, futhi ibe yingozi nomzali wakho owakuzala?
Ngaso sonke isikhathi lapho unyana kaYese ephila khona emhlabeni, wena nobukhosi bakho ngeke nihlale; thumela ke manje, nimwise lapha kimi, ngoba kumele aphile.
Wathi uJonathane kubaba wakhe, Ingabe kufanele abulawe? Ukwenze kuphi?
Wathi uSawule wamshaya ngentambo, ukuze ambulala. Waqonda uYonathani ukuthi ubaba wakhe wabeka isinqumo sokubulala uDavide.
UYonathani wavuka embhedeni, ekhala kakhulu. Ngosuku lwesithathu lwesikhumbuzo, akayidla ukudla; ngoba wayekhathazekile ngenxa yokuthi ubaba wakhe ubemkhohlisa uDavide.
Kwathi ekuseni kwafika uYonatan, waphuma waya ezweni ukubhekana noDavide, ngesikhathi esibekiwe; wayenendodakazi encane naye.
Wathi kulowo mfundi, Yiya, thola amagobolondo ami; futhi lapho lo mfundi ehamba khona, uYonathani washaya amagobolondo akhe.
Wafika lo mfundi ezweni lapho umcibisholo ka-Yonatan waphuma khona, u-Yonatan wathi ngemuva kwakhe, Uthi, Ingabe umcibisholo awukho eduze kwakho?
Wathi, Yiya ngokushesha! Musa ukuyeka! Wathatha lo mfundi umcibisholo, wabuyela kumnikazi wakhe.
Lo mntwana awazi lutho ngalokhu konke. UJonathan noDavid kuphela abawaziyo.
Wathi uYonathani, wanikela isibhamu sakhe kulowo mfundi, wathi, Yiya, uyithule edolobhaneni.

UDavide wavuka enyakatho-ntshonalanga yodonga, wehla phambi kukaYonathani izikhathi ezintathu, ubuso bakhe bubheke phansi. Baphoqeleka ukuba bathandene, balele ndawonye; kodwa uDavide wayelile kakhulu.

Wathi uYonathani kuDavide, Yiya ngokuthula; thina nawe siphike ngegama likaYehova, sathi, UYehova ube ngumshayeli phakathi kwami nenu, phakathi kwezingane zakho nezingane zami kuze kube sekupheleni. Waphuma uDavide, wabuyela uYonathani edolobhaneni.
Wafika uDavide eNobi ku-Akhimeleki umpristi. U-Akhimeleki, lapho ehlangana naye, wakhathazeka kakhulu, wathi kuye, Yini na ukuthi uhamba wena kuphela? Ingabe akukho muntu okunye nawe?

Waphendula uDavide, wathi ku-Akhimeleki umpristi: "Umkakhe wathumela ngami, wathi kimi: 'Kungeke umuntu akwazi lutho ngento engikulethela yona, noma ngomsebenzi wami.' Kwathi abantu bami, ngibatshela ukuthi bangangibona lapho.
Futhi manje, yini ongayithola lapha? Nceda ungisize izinkomishi eziyisishiyagalombili zokudla, noma okuthile ongakuthola.
Waphendula umbingeleli uDavide, wathi, Akukho ukudla okujwayelekile lapha kimi; kodwa kukhona ukudla okungcwele, uma nje abantu bengeke bahlangane nabesifazane.

UDavide waphendula wathi, "Yebo, izingane zabesifazane zigcinwe ngaphandle kwethu, njengoba ngihlala njalo lapho ngihamba khona. Izimbambo zabantu zingcwele, ngisho nalapho besebenza khona; futhi namuhla! "
Wathi umbingeleli wamnika ukudla okungcwele; ngoba kwakungekho ukudla khona ngaphandle kokudla okuvela esidlangalaleni, okwenziwe phambi kukaYehova, emini lapho kwafakwa khona ukudla okusha.
Kwabe kukhona khona umuntu owodwa wabakhonzi bakaShawule ngalolu busuku, ehlala khona phambi koYehova, uDoegeki waseEdomu, owayengumphathi wezimvu zikaShawule.
Wathi uDavide ku-Akhimeleki, Ingabe unayo lapha isibhamu noma ikhebula? Ngingakaze ngithathe ikhebula lami noma iyiphi enye into; ngoba umsebenzi wokumkani wawunzima.

Wathi umbingeleli, Ikhebula likaGoliathi umFilisti, owawubulala emfuleni i-Ela, likhona, lingene enkingeni engezansi kwe-ephodi; uma ufuna ukuyithatha, uyithathe; ngoba ayikho enye ikhebula laphaya. UDavide wathi, Akunalutho olufana nalo; ngiyinike.
UDavide wehla ngalolu busuku esuka kuSawule, waya ku-Akishi ukumkani waseGathi.
Bathi ke abakhonzi baka-Akishi kuye, UDavide, ukumkani waleli lizwe, akawubani na lowo okhuluma ngaye emidlalweni yabo, besithi, USawule wabulala amawaka akhe, noDavide amashumi amane amawaka akhe?
Wabeka uDavide la mazwi enhliziyweni yakhe, wakhathazeka kakhulu ngenxa ka-Akishi ukumkani waseGathi.
Wathi, "Ngakho-ke, ngicabanga ukuthi uSathane ungumuntu okhohlakeleyo," futhi, lapho ehlala nabo, waqala ukudweba emaphethelweni omgwaqo, futhi, ngaleso sikhathi, imilenze yakhe yaqala ukuphuma.
Wathi u-Akishi kubo bonke abakhonzi bakhe, Babone lo muntu; kubonakala sengathi unengqondo ephindwe kathathu. Kungani na ukuthi nimuveze kuye?
Ingabe bengingeke ngithole abantu abakhohlakelayo, ukuze nifikeni nalowo muntu lapha, ukuba abe ngumuntu okhohlakeleyo phambi kwami? Uzofika yini lo muntu ekhaya lami?"
UDavide waphuma eGathi, waya emgodini ka-Adulam. Bakwazi lokhu abazalwane bakhe, nendlu yobaba wakhe, babuyela kuye khona.
Bahlangana naye bonke labo abasengozini, nalabo abanemali eningi, nalabo abanganeliseki; waba nguMengameli wabo. Kwabe kukhona nabantu abangumakhulu amane naye.
Waphuma khona uDavide waya eMizpa yamaMowabi, wathi ukumkani wamaMowabi, Ngicela ngivumele ubaba wami nomama wami ukuba bahlale nani, kuze ngibone ukuthi uNkulunkulu uzongikwenzani.
Wabathumela kuye ukumkani wakwaMowabi; bahlala naye yonke imihla kaDavide esitezi esiphakeme.
Wathi uGadi umprofeti kuDavide, Ungahlalanga kule ndawo ephephile; buyela ezweni laseYuda. UDavide waphuma, waya emfuleni i-Hereth.

USawule wathola ukuthi uDavide namadodana akhe batholakala. USawule wayehlala phansi ngaphansi kwesihlahla sika-Tamari, eGibeha; umqhele wakhe ubesesandlani sakhe, futhi bonke abakhonzi bakhe babebhekene naye.
Wathi kubo uSawule, "Nikhulume, nimadodana kaBhenjamini! Ingabe yena unyana kaYese uzoninika imifula nemivini? Ingabe uzokwenza ningabaphathi bamakhulu nabangamakhulu?

Ngakho-ke, yini na le nto eninikele ngayo bonke abaphikisayo ngami? Uma unyana wami eyenza isivumelwano noyise kaYese, angeke kube khona umuntu ongitshela yona. Akukho muntu phakathi kwenu ozongitshela ukuthi unyana wami ukhiphe umkhonzi wami, ukuze abambe iqhaza kum, njengamanje.
Waphendula uDogeki, umEdomi, ohlala emehlweni amaphoyisa kaSawule, wathi, Ngibone indodana kaYese ifika eNobi ku-Ahileleki unyana ka-Ahitubhi.
U-Akhimeleki wabuza iNkosi ukuthi angakwenzani uDavide; futhi u-Akhimeleki wamnika ukudla, nokhephe likaGoliyati umFilisti.
Wathumela ukumkani, wabiza u-Akhimeleki unyana ka-Ahitubhi, umpristi, nomndeni wakhe wonke, ababingeleli baseNobi. Bafika bonke kubo ukumkani;
Wathi uSawule, Ngisho namuhla, wena unyana ka-Ahitubhi. Waphendula wathi, Kulungile, mphathi wami.

Wathi uSawule kuye, Kungani nakuthi niphike ngami, wena noyise kaYeshaya, ukuthi unikeze ukudla nekhebula, futhi unqume uNkulunkulu ukuba amsize, ukuze ashintshe ngimi, abe ngumbukeli wami, njengokuba namuhla?
Waphendula u-Akhimeleki ukumkani, wathi, Ngabo bonke abakhonzi bakho, ngubani othembekile njengaye uDavide? Uyinkosikazi yokumkani, nomkhuluwa wakho, nodume kakhulu ekhaya lakho.
Ngabe ngaqala ngicela usizo kuThixo ngenxa yakhe? Akunjalo, ngiyakucela, ungabi necala kumkhonzi wakho, noma kunoma ubani emndenini wami; ngoba umkhonzi wakho awazi lutho ngalolu daba lonke.
Wathi ukumkani, Uzofa ngokuqinisekile, u-Ahileleki, wena nomndeni wonke kababa wakho.

Wathi ukumkani kulabo ababhekene naye, "Bukelani, bulala ababhishobhi bakaYehova; ngoba nabo bathathe isandla sikaDavide. Bathe bazi ukuthi uDavidu uyahamba, kodwa bengingabatshelanga." Kodwa abakhonzi bakakumkani abazange baphakamise izandla zabo ukuwahlasela amabhishobhi kaYehova.
Wathi ukumkani kuDoge, Ubuye, uhlasele abapristi. Wabuya ke uDoge, umEdomu, wahlasela, wababulala abantu abangumashumi asibhozo anesihlanu abagqoka i-ephod yelinen ngalolusuku.
Wahlasela futhi iNobe, umzi wamabhishobhi, ngeqhwa, wabulala amadoda namadodakazi, namantombazane nabantwana abancane, namabhokhwe, namabhubesi, namakhowe.
Nokho uAbhiyathari, indodana ka-Ahileleki, intombi ka-Ahitubhi, waphuma, waya kuDavide.
Watshela uDavide ukuthi uSawule wabulala ababhishobhi bakaYehova.
Wathi uDavide ku-Abhiyathari, Ngazi ngalolu busuku, lapho uDogeki umEdomu ekhona khona, ukuthi ngokuqinisekile uzotshela uSawule; ngiyingozi yomndeni wonke kababa wakho.
Uzohlala nami, futhi ungakhathazeki; umuntu ofuna ukukubulala ufuna nokufa kwami, ngakho uzobe uphephile ngami.
Batshela uDavide, bethi, Bheka, abaFilisti bahlasela iKeyila, bese bethatha izithelo ezindaweni zokudlidliza.
UDavide wabuza iNkosi, esithi, Ngizoya ngihlasela labo Bafilisti? Waphendula iNkosi wathi kuye, Iya, uhlasele labo Bafilisti, usindise iKehila.
Bathi abantu bakaDavide kuye, Siyaxolisa lapha eYuda; kuphi na uma siye eKeyila ukubhekana nomndeni wamaFilisti?
UDavide wabuza iNkosi futhi. Waphendula iNkosi wathi kuye, Yiya eKeyila; ngoba ngizobeka amaFilisti esandleni sakho.
Wahamba uDavide namadodana akhe waya eKeyila, wabhekana nabaFilisti, wathatha izilwane zabo, wababulala ngokubulala okukhulu. UDavide wakhulula abantu baseKeyila.
UAbhiyathari unyana ka-Ahileleki waya kuDavide eKeyila, wathatha i-ephodi emlenzeni wakhe.
Batshela uSawule ukuthi uDavide waya eKeyila, wathi, UNkulunkulu unginikela enhliziyweni yami; ngoba uDavide wabeka isandla sakhe emlonyeni wakhe, afike emzini onezindonga nezintambo.
USawule waqoqa wonke amakhosi akhe emdlalweni, ukuba afike eKeyila, abambe uDavide namadodana akhe.
UDavide, ekwazi ukuthi uSawule unquma okubi kuye, wathi kuAbhiyathari ukumkani, Thola le-ephodi.
Wathi uDavide, Nkosi, uNkulunkulu kaSirayeli, umkhonzi wakho ubone ngokucacile ukuthi uSawule unquma ukuya eKeyila, ukuze asuse lo mzi ngenxa yami.
Ingabe abaphathi baseKeyila bazonginikela kuye? Ingabe uSawule uzowela, njengoba ngikutshele umkhonzi wakho? UNkulunkulu kaSirayeli, Nkosi, sicela usixhumane nomkhonzi wakho. Wathi iNkosi, Uzowela.
Wathi uDavide, Ingabe abaphathi baseKeyila bazongidlulisa mina namadodana ami kuSawule? UYehova wathi, Bazo.
UDavide waphuma eKeyila, yena namadodana akhe, angaphezu kwamakhulu amane; bahamba besuka endaweni kuye endaweni. Batshela uSawule ukuthi uDavide usanda kuphuma eKeyila, kodwa akayeki ukuya khona.
Wahlala uDavide ezindaweni eziqinile zesihlabathi, nasezintaba-mlilo zesihlabathi saseZiphu. USawule wafuna uDavide ngosuku ngalunye; kodwa uNkulunkulu akazange amnike uDavide esandleni sakhe.
UDavide wafunda ukuthi uSawule waya eHoreshi, emfuleni i-Zipho, ukuze agweme ukumbulala.
UYonatan unyana kaSawule waya kuDavide e-Horesh, wamsiza ukuthi athole amandla kuThixo.

Wathi kuye, Musa ukukhathazeka; ngoba uSawule ubaba wami ngeke abeke isandla sakhe phezu kwakho; wena uzobe ungummelwane wakwaSirayeli, nami ngizoba wesithathu kuwe; futhi noSawule ubaba wami naye uyazi.
Bakwenza umnikelo wokudla bobabili phambi koYehova. UYonathan wabuyela ekhaya lakhe, kodwa uDavide wayehlala eHoresh.
Baya kuSawule eGibeha abantu baseZifi, bethi, UDavide akasekho lapha nathi, ezindaweni eziqinile, eHoresh, emfuleni iHakila, osentshonalanga yeJeshimoni?
Manje, Nkosi yakho, zulazula lapho uthanda khona, futhi sizokwazi ukumnika kumkakhe."
Wathi uSawule, UYehova akubabale wena ngenxa yobulungisa obungibonisile.
Iya thola ulwazi oluningi. Thola lapho uDavid ehamba khona futhi ngubani owamubona khona. Kuthelelwe ukuthi unenkani kakhulu.

Ngizohamba nawe. Uma ekhona kulo mhlaba, ngizomuthola phakathi kwezizwe zonke zakwaYuda; futhi uma ekhona lapho, ngizohamba naye. Uma ekhona kulo mhlaba, ngizomuthola phakathi kwezizwe zonke zakwaYuda.
Basuka ke, bafika eZifi phambi kukaSawule; uDavide namadodana akhe babe esiqhingini sama-Mahoni, ezindaweni ezibandayo ezisenyakatho yeJeshimon.
USawule namadodana akhe baqala ukubuza. Bathi kubo uDavide, waphuma waya eqhingini, wahlala esiqhingini iMahoni. USawule akubona lokhu, wafika esiqhingini iMahoni, efuna uDavide.

USawule wayehamba ngaphesheya komfula, uDavide namadodana akhe behamba ngaphesheya komfula, behamba ngejubane, befuna ukuyeka uSawule. Nokho uSawule nendodana yakhe babebhekene noDavide namadodana akhe, befuna ukubabamba.
Kwafika umthunywa kuSawule, ethi, Yiya ngokushesha; ngoba amaFilisti aphikisa izwe.
USawule wayeka ukulandela uDavide, waya ehlasela amaFilisti; ngakho kwabizwa igama lesi sifundazwe ngokuthi iSela-hamahlekhothi.
Waphuma khona uDavide, wahlala ezindaweni eziqinile zase-Engedi.
Kwathi lapho uSawule ebuya enqoleni amaFilisti, kwathunyelwe ukuthi, UDavide usemgwaqweni ka-Engedi.
Wathatha uSawule abantu abangumakhulu amathathu, abakhethiwe phakathi kwamadodana kaSirayeli wonke, waphuma efuna uDavide namadodana akhe ezindaweni eziphakade zezinkomo.
Wafika ezindaweni zokugcina izinkomo ezisendlela, lapho kwakukhona khona intaba. USawule waphuma khona ukuze aphumule; kodwa uDavide namadodana akhe babe eduze kwengubo.

Bathi abantu bakaDavide, Lokho wusuku iNkosi ekhuluma ngalo kuwe, ethi, Ngizowunikela umfowabo esandleni sakho, ukwenze konke okubukeka kukuhle engqondweni yakho. UDavidu wehla ngaso sonke isikhathi, wamisa isibambo sikaSawule.
Kusukela lapho uDavide wacabanga ukuthi unecala, ngenxa yokuthi wasusa isibambo sebhande likaSawule.
Wathi kubo abantu bakhe, UNkulunkulu angeke angivumele ukuthi ngikwenze lokhu kunkosi yami, ukumkani okhethiwe nguYehova, ukuthi ngibeke isandla sami phezu kwakhe; ngoba yena ungumkhonzi kaThixo.
UDavide wavimbela abantu bakhe ngamazwi anjalo, ukuze bangabi nethuba lokulwa noSawule. Waphuma ke uSawule emgodini, waya ezweni lakhe.
UDavide waphuma emgodini, wayalela uSawule, wathi, "Mphathi wami, ukumkani!" USawule ebheka emuva kwakhe, uDavide wehla ngobuso bakhe phansi.
Wathi uDavide kuSawule, Kungani na ukuthi ulalele abantu bekhuluma ngokuthi, UDavide ufuna ukukwenza ububi?

Ubone ngamehlo akho ngalolu busuku, ukuthi iNkosi wakulethela esandla sami kulo mfula; futhi kwathiwa, Ngizokubulala; kodwa ngikuxosha, ngithi, Angeke ngibeke isandla sami kunkosi yami, ngoba ungumkhonzi kaYehova.

Ubaba, bheka, ubone lesi sigqoko sakho esandla sami; ngikucishe isibambo sesigqoko sakho, kodwa angikufani wena. Manje ke, qaphela futhi ubone ukuthi asikubi ngami ukukwenza okubi, noma ukwephula umthetho; angikwenzeli nakanjani iphutha kuwe, kodwa wena ungifuna ukuze uthathe impilo yami.
UYehova agweme phakathi kwami nawe, futhi iNkosi akubuyisele wena isono sakho esingikwenzele; kodwa isandla sami ngeke sikuthathe.
Ngokungafani nezwi elidala, lithi: Kulabo abakwenzayo okubi, kuvela izinto ezibi; ngakho isandla sami ngeke sikuthathe.
Ngawuphi umuntu ophumayo ukumkani wakwaSirayeli? Ngawuphi umuntu oyilandelayo? Ingabe yinja efile, noma inkomo?
UYehova abe ngummeli wethu, athathe isigqibo phakathi kwethu; abhekane necala lami, anikeze intshisekelo yami, amsindise esandla sakho.
Waphela uDavide ekhuluma amazwi lawa, wathi uSawule, Yizwi lakho yini leli, udadewethu uDavide? Wavuya ngezwi elikhulu.
Wathi, "Uyimuntu olungile kunami. Ungiphatha kahle, kodwa mina ngikuphatha kabi; futhi bengikwenza okubi kuwe.
Futhi manje ukhuluma ngalokho okuhle okwenze kimi, ukuthi iNkosi unginikela esandla sakho; kodwa wena awungibulala.
Uma umuntu ethola umshayeli wakhe, angawushiya yini ahambe ngaphandle kokulimala? UYehova akukhokhele kahle, njengoba ukwenze kuye namuhla.
Ngiyazi ukuthi uzoba ngukumkani, futhi ukumkani wakwaSirayeli uzobe uqinile esandla sakho.
Manje ke, ngikutshele ngeNkosi ukuthi awuzoyibulala imbewu yami, futhi awuzoyisusa igama lami emndenini wakwababa wami.
USawule wabuyela ekhaya lakhe, uDavide namadodana akhe benyuka bafike ezindaweni eziqinile.
Wafa uSamuweli, bahlangana bonke isiSirayeli, bamlingisa, wabulawa eRama. UDavide wehla ezweni laseParan.
Kwabe kukhona umuntu othile eMaoni, owayenempahla yakhe eKarmeli; waba mkhulu kakhulu, futhi wayenazo izinkomo ezingu-1, nezimvu ezingu-3. Waqala ke ukusika izingulube zakhe eKarmeli.

Igama lakhe nguNabhali, igama lenkosikazi yakhe uAbhigayeli. Wayewesifazane onolwazi futhi obukeka kahle; kodwa indodana yakhe yayimnyama kakhulu, ibe yindoda engathandeki ekwenzeni izinto zakhe. Wabe ngumngane kaKhalebe.
UDavide wayesele esiqhingini, lapho wathola khona ukuthi uNabhali ugeza izimvu zakhe.
Wathumela amadoda amakhulu alishumi, wathi kubo: "Niya kuNabali eKarmeli, nimtshele ukuthi uphile kanjani.
Nithi kuye, Uphile isikhathi eside; ukuthula nokuphila okuhle kuwe, nendlu yakho, nalabo bonke abakho.
