U-Absalomu wathumela abathunywa ezindaweni zonke zakwaSirayeli, esithi, Uma nje nikulalela umsindo wezinkomo, sithi, U-Absalomu ungumnikazi eHebroni.
Kwaya no-Absalomo amadoda amakhulu amabili eYerusalem, ayemenywe ukuba abe ngabangani. Baye bahamba ngeqiniso labo, bengazi ukuthi kwenzekani.

UAbsalomu, lapho enikela khona izinyamazane, wathumela wathi ku-Ahitopheleli waseGilo, umcebisi kaDavide, ukuthi afike eGilo, emzini wakhe. Nokho isinqumo saqhubeka sinamandla, futhi abantu baphinde bakhula besuka ku-Absalomu.
Kwafika umthunywa kuDavide, wathi, Intliziyo yabantu bakaSirayeli idlulile ku-Absalomu.

Wathi uDavide kubo bonke abakhonzi bakhe ababe naye eYerusalem, Yiya, sihambe; uma kungenjalo, ngeke sibe nomuntu ongeke aphume phambi kuka-Absalomu; zinikele; uma kungenjalo, uzosifinyelela ngokushesha, aze asiholele izinkinga, abulala abantu bedolobha ngeqhwa.
Baphendula abakhonzi bakakumkani, bethi kuye, Kuzo zonke izinto ezithethwa ngummelwane wethu ukumkani, bona abakhonzi bakho.
Waphuma ke ukumkani, naye wonke umndeni wakhe umlandela; kodwa washiya amakhosikazi akhe amashumi amabili, ukuba agcine indlu.
Waphuma ukumkani, nabantu bonke abalandelana naye, bahlala efulethini elilodwa.

Nabo bonke abaphathi bakhe badlula ngaphesheya kwakhe, kanye nabo bonke amaKherethi, namaPhelethi, amaphoyisa kabukhosi; nalabo bantu abangumakhulu ayisishiyagalombili baseGiti, ababemlandela eGathi, badlula ngaphesheya kukankosi.
Wathi ukumkani ku-Itai waseGiti, Yini ukuthi uhambe nathi? Yibuye, uhlale nokumkani omusha; ngoba wena ungumzweli, uphuma ezweni lakho; buyela endaweni yakho.
Ngiyakwenza yini ukuthi uhambe nathi namhlanje, uma ngingazi lapho ngizohamba khona? Yeka, uze uthathe nabangane bakho nawe; futhi iNkosi akubonise wena inhlonipho yakhe neqiniso lakhe.
Waphendula u-Itai ukumkani, wathi, Uphila iNkosi, futhi uphila umphathi wami ukumkani; lapho uzobe khona umphathi wami ukumkani, noma kuphila, noma kufa, khona-ke nomsebenzi wakho uzobe khona.
Wathi uDavide ku-Itai, Yiya, dlula. Wadlula ke u-Itai waseGiti, naye wonke amadoda akhe, nabantwana bonke ababenabo.
Kwathi abantu bonke basezweni bashaya ngezwi elikhulu, lapho abantu bonke bedlula khona. Wadlula ukumkani umfula iKidron, futhi abantu bonke badlula emgwaqeni osuka esiqhingini.

Kwabe khona futhi uTsadoki, nalabo bonke abaLevi naye, bethwala isibambo somthetho kaThixo; bamisa isibambo somthetho kaThixo, noAbhiyathari enikela ngenhlanhla, kuze kube sekuphele abantu bonke ukuphuma emzini.
Wathi ukumkani kuSadoko, Yibuyisele ibhokisi likaThixo edolobhaneni; uma iNkosi engithande, uzongibuyisela futhi angibonise ibhokisi nendawo yayo.
Kodwa uma ethi, Ngingakujabuleli wena, khona-ke lapha ngikhona; akwenze ngami lokho okubona ukuthi kulungile.
Wathi ukumkani kuTsadoki umbingeleli, Ingabe ungumfundi owaziyo izinto azenzayo uNkulunkulu? Yiya edolobhaneni ngokuthula, wena noAhimahazi unyana wakho, noYonathani unyana ka-Abhiyathar.
Ngizobe ngilinde ezindaweni zokudlula emfuleni ezindleleni kuze kube yilapho ngithola umlayezo kusuka kuwe okhuluma ngalokho okuqhubekayo.
Wathi uTsadoki noAbhiyathari babuyisela ibhokisi likaThixo eYerusalem, bahlala khona.

UDavide wanyuka waya eMfuleni wama-Olivi, ekhala emehlweni lapho ehamba khona. Wagqoka ikhanda lakhe, wahamba ngezandla zakhe zodwa; futhi bonke abantu ababenabo bagqoke ikhanda labo, bathandaza lapho behamba khona.
Wathi uDavide, sithi, U-Ahitofeli ungumunye walezo zikhulu ezifuna ukulwa no-Absalomu. Wathandaza uDavide, wathi, Nkosi yami, ngicela ukwenze isinqumo sika-Ahitofeli sibe yingozi.

Kwathi lapho uDavide efike esiphethweni somfula, lapho abantu bethandaza khona kuThixo, ngabona ukuthi uHushayi umArki ufika ukubhekana naye, enezicathulo zakhe zilahlekile, nenyama phezu kwekhanda lakhe.
Wathi uDavide kuye, Uma uhamba nami, uzongibiza umthwalo;
kodwa uma ubuyela edolobhaneni, uthi ku-Absalomu, Ngizoba ngumkhonzi wakho, ukumkani; ngibe umkhonzi wobaba wakho, kodwa manje ngizoba umkhonzi wakho; khona-ke uzongisusa isinqumo sika-Ahitofele.
Bakhona nawe khona lapho uTsadoki noAbhiyathari, abapristi; khuluma kubo konke okubona endlu kabukhosi.
Bheka, izingane zabo ezimbili zikhona nabo: uAhimahazi unyana kaSadoko, noYonathani unyana kaAbhiyathari; thumelani kubo konke okubonayo.
Wafika ke uHushai, umngane kaDavide, edolobhaneni, ngesikhathi uAbsalomu efika eYerusalem.

UDavide wadlula eduze kophahla oluphezulu, khona-ke kwafika uSiba, umkhonzi kaMephiboshethi, wambhekana naye, enezinkomo ezimbili ezishisayo, ezithwale amakhowe angumakhulu amabili, namakhowe ayizinkulungwane, nezithelo zehlobo eziyikhulu, nebhodlela eligcwele iwayini.

Wathi ukumkani kuZiba, Ziyini lezi? Waphendula uZiba, wathi, Izinkomo ziyimpahla yomndeni wakwakumkakhe, ukuze bahambe ngazo; nenyama kanye nezithelo zehlobo ziyimpahla yabangane, ukuze ba echukumise; futhi iwayini liyimpahla yomuntu onqabile esiqhingini, ukuze anywe.
Wathi ukumkani, Uphi unyana kankosi yakho? Waphendula uTsiba ukumkani wathi, Yabona, useJerusalema; ngoba uthe, Namuhla abantu bakaSirayeli bazongibuyisela ibukhosi bukayise.
Wathi umbingeleli ku-Ziba, "Izinto zonke ezithunyelwe nguMephiboshethi manje ziyizinto zakho." Wathi umbingeleli ku-Ziba, "Ngizibophezela kuwe. Ngizokujabulela njalo, umkakhe ukumkani."
Kwafika uDavide ukumkani eBahurim, khona-ke kwaphuma owesifazane wesizwe sikaSawule, igama lakhe belinguShimehi unyana kaGera, waya emzini wakhe, wavuma uDavide.
Wakhipha amatshe kuDavide, nakwabo bonke abaphathi bokumkani uDavide; kodwa bonke abantu, namadoda amakhulu, aye ngakwesokudla kwakhe nakwesobunxele kwakhe.
Wathi uShimeyi, lapho enquma khona, phuma, phuma, wena obulalayo, wena umuntu ongalungile!

UNkulunkulu ukulethela wena igazi lonke lomndeni kaSawule, wena owawungukumkani endaweni yakhe; futhi manje iNkosi unqume ukunika ukumkani uAbsalomu, unyana wakho. Thola sewuphelile ngenxa yobubi bakho, ngoba ungumshoshi!
Wathi u-Abhishai, unyana kaZeruya, kukumkani, Kungani na ukuthi isilwane esifile sibulale umkakhe ukumkani? Ngizohamba ngiyithathe intamo yakhe.

Wathi ukumkani, Ingabe le nto ingumsebenzi wenu yini, nina oonyana baka-Zeruya? Uma efuna ukungibulala; ngoba iNkosi wathi kuye, Ubulele uDavide. Ngawuphi umuntu ongeke ambuze ukuthi, Kungani na ukwenza lokhu?

Wathi uDavide ku-Abhishai, nakwabo bonke abakhonzi bakhe: "Lo ndodana wami, igazi lami nenyama yami, ifuna ukungibulala; futhi lo mntu waseBhenjamini usekhona, ukuze akwenze lokhu. Uzohamba naye, futhi uzoma, ngoba iNkosi wakhuluma kuye.
Kungenzeka ukuthi iNkosi abone ukubi okungenziwa ngami, futhi anikeze lutho oluhle endaweni yokunambitheka kwami namhlanje.
UDavide namadodana akhe baqhubeka behamba ngendlela; uShimeyi ke ehamba ngaphesheya komfula, emgqeni obhekene naye, ephazamisa, ephoqa amatshe kuye, ephoqa umhlabathi entwasahlobo.
Wafika khona ukumkani, naye wonke abantu ababenabo, ephazamiseke kakhulu; waphumula khona.
Wafika uAbsalome, naye wonke amadoda aseSirayeli, eYerusalem; no-Ahitofeli waye naye.
Wafika uHushai, umngane kaDavide wase-Arkhi, ku-Absalomu, wathi kuye: Ubukhosi buphile! UMbuso buphile!
Wathi uAbsalomu kuHushayi, Ingabe lokhu kungenxa yobuhlobo bakho nomngane wakho? Kungani na ungena nomndeni womngane wakho?
Wathi uHushai ku-Absalomu, Akunjalo; kodwa umuntu okhethiwe nguYehova, nalaba bantu, namadodana wonke aseSirayeli, lowo ngizowuhlala naye.
Ngabe ngizokhonza yini? Ngabe ngeke ngisebenzele unyana? Ngokungafani nalokho engikwenzela ubaba wakho, ngizokwenza nawe.
Wathi uAbsalomu ku-Ahitofeli, Thola isiphakamiso; yini okufanele siyenze?

Wathi u-Ahitofele ku-Absalomu, Yidle namadodakazi kababa wakho, awashiyele ukulondoloza indlu; khona-ke bonke isiSirayeli bazokutshela ukuthi udadewabo unenkani nawe; futhi wonke umuntu osebenza nawe uzobe enamandla kakhulu.
Bamisa khona itente ku-Absalomu, esitezi sendlu. Wahlala u-Absalomu namadodakazi kayise, phambi kwamehlo eSirayeli bonke.
Ngaleso sikhathi, isinqumo sika-Ahitofeli sathathwa njengegama likaThixo; ngaso sonke isikhathi uDavide noAbsalome bacabanga njalo ngesinqumo sika-Ahitofeli.
Wathi u-Ahitofele ku-Absalomu, Ngizokhetha abantu abangumakhulu amabili nanhlanu, ngihambe ekuseni ngilandele uDavide.
Ngizomuhlasela lapho elahlekile, futhi ehloniphekile. Ngizokwenza akhathazeke, futhi bonke abantu bakhe bazohamba; ngizobulala ukumkani kuphela,
futhi ngizobuyisela abantu bonke kuwe; futhi uma umuntu olandela wena efile, khona-ke wonke umuntu uzobuya, futhi abantu bonke bazobe bekhululekile.
Wabona uAbsalome, nabaholi bonke bakaSirayeli, ukuthi lokhu kulungile.
Wathi uAbsalomu, Ngisho noHushayi umArhithi kuthiwani, sibone ukuthi yini akushoyo.
Wafika uHushayi, wathi uAbsalomu kuye, U-Ahitophelele unqume lokhu; kufanele sikwenze yini lokho akushoyo? Uma kungenjalo, sithi.
Wathi uHushai ku-Absalomu, Icebiso elinikezwe ngu-Ahitopheleli namuhla alihle.

U-Hushayi wathi, "Uyazi ubaba wakho namadodana akhe. Banamandla amakhulu, futhi bavame ukubizwa ngokuthi yi-mother bears, noma i-mother bears whose cubs have been stolen. Plus, your father is experienced in the field.
Ngokuba manje ukhona, mhlawumbe ufihlakele emgodini noma endaweni ethile. Uma abantu bakho bebulawa ekuqaleni kokulwa, umuntu owaziyo lokho uzothi, 'Abakhonzi baka-Absalom babulawa!'

Ngaleyo ndlela umuntu onamandla kakhulu, onenhliziyo efana nengulube, uzolahleka umoya wakhe; ngoba bonke isiSirayeli bayazi ukuthi ubaba wakho ngumuntu onamandla amakhulu, nalabo abakhona naye bangamadoda anamandla.
Ngikucebisa ukuthi uhlanganise nawe wonke amaSirayeli, kusukela eDan kuze kube eBheri-shebha, njengamatshe eduze kolwandle ngosayizi; wena uzoba nomkhosi.
Sizohlasela uDavide lapho etholakala khona, futhi sizowela phezu kwakhe njengokuthi imvula ikhuphuka phezulu emhlabeni; ngeke kushiyeke umuntu ngamunye kubo, uDavide namadodana akhe.
Uma efika enhliziyweni yedolobha, izwe lonke laseSirayeli lizoletha izibopho kulo dolobha; sizolimaza leli dolobha emfuleni, kuze kungashiwo khona itshe elincane.

Wathi uAbsalomu, namadodana onke aseSirayeli, Incomo kaHushai waseArkhi ingcono kunayo yonke incomo ka-Ahitofele; ngoba kwakuyisinqumo sikaYehova ukulahla isiphakamiso esihle sika-Ahitofele, ukuze uYehovasenze kube nzima ku-Absalomu.
Wathi uHushai kuTsadoki noAbhiyathari abapristi, ethi, U-Ahitofele wacebisa uAbsalomu namadoda amakhulu aseSirayeli ukuthi bakwenze lokhu; kodwa ngibacebise ukuba benze lokhu.

Kusukela manje uthumelele izindaba kuDavide ngokushesha, uthi kuye, Ungase uhlale usuku lonke ezindaweni zokudlula emfuleni esiqhingini; vuka udlule emfuleni, ukuze kungapheleli ukumkani nomphakathi wonke owakhe.
UYonathani no-Ahimaze balinde e-Enrogele; kwathi uma intombazane encane iphuma ifike ibatshele, khona-ke bebuya babetshela uNdunankulu uDavide, ukuze bangabonakali befika emzini.
Kwababona umshado, wabatshela uAbsalomu. Besuka ke labo bobabili ngejubane, befika eBahurim, endlwini yomntu othile, owayenesiqu esincane emgwaqeni wakhe; bahla khona.
Wathatha indodana yakhe isigqoko, yamisa phezu komnyango wefuleyi, yamisa imbewu phezu kwayo, ukuze akukho muntu owaziyo ukuthi bakhona.

Bafika emakhazeni abakhonzi baka-Absalomu, babuza uwesifazane ukuthi: Uphi uAhimahazi noYonathani? Waphendula umbhishobhi wathi, Bedlula emfuleni. Bonke labo madoda awawatholanga, wabuya waya eYerusalem;
Baphuma ebhishi, bafike betshela uDavide ukumkani, bathi kuye: "Qhubeka uhambe ngejubane phezu komfula; ngoba Ahithophelele wanikeza isiphakamiso mayelana nawe."
Wavuka uDavide, naye wonke umuntu owayenaye, wadlula iYordan. Kwafika isikhathi sokuphuma kwelanga, bonke abantu badlule iYordan.

U-Ahitofele, lapho ebona ukuthi isinqumo sakhe asikusebenziswe, wamisa isikelemu sakhe, waya ekhaya lakhe, waya edolobhaneni lakhe. Walungisa izinto zakhe, wehlisa ikhanda lakhe, wafa, wabanjwa emgodini kayise.
Wayefika uDavide eMahanayim. UAbsalomu wadlula umfula iYorodani, naye wonke amadoda aseSirayeli.

U-Absalomu wabeka uAmasa njengomphathi womkhosi endaweni kaYowabhi. (U-Amasa ube ngunyana womuntu okuthiwa yi-Ithra, umSirayeli, owashada no-Abigayili, intombi kaNahashi, inkosikazi kaZeruya, indodana kaYowabhi).
USirayeli no-Absalome bamisa isibhedlela ezweni laseGiliyadi.
Kwafika uDavide eMahanayini, noShobi unyana kaNahashi waseRabha yama-Amoni, noMakhire unyana kaAmiyeli waseLodebari, noBarzilayi owaseRogelemi eGileyadi.
Bathi: "Sizothola izindlu, namabhodwe, nezitsha zeqhwa; futhi sizothola ingulube, noshizi, nomhluzi, nenyama ethosiwe, nezithelo ezithosiwe,
futhi amakhowe, nenyama yomnqumo, nezingulube, nobisi lwezinkomo, uDavide namadodana akhe azowadla; ngoba bethi, Abantu bazokhala kakhulu, nabo bayaphazamiseka, nabo bayaphuza emanzini esiqhingini.
UDavide wabala amadoda aye naye, wabeka abaphathi phezu kwamakhulu namakhulu, nangaphezulu kwamakhulu.

Wathumela abantu, wabahlukanise ngamaqembu amathathu; uYowabhi wayephethe iqembu lesithathu, no-Abhishai udadewabo uYowabhi, unyana kaZeruya, wayephethe iqembu lesithathu, no-Itai waseGiti wayephethe iqembu lesithathu. Ubukhosi besithi kubo: "Ngizophuma ngihamba nani.

Bathi abantu kuye, Ungaphumanga; ngoba uma sihamba, ngeke babhekene nathi; futhi uma isigamu sethu sifa, ngeke babhekene nathi; kodwa wena ufana namaphesenti ayishumi ethu; ngakho kungcono kuwe ukuba uhlale edolobhaneni, ube nosizo lwethu.
Wathi kubo ukumkani, Ngizokwenza konke okungekuhle emicabangweni yenu. Wahlala khona ukumkani eduze kwesango ledolobha; futhi wonke umkhosi waphuma, ngamakhulu namakhulu amawaka.
Wathi ukumkani kuYowabu, no-Abhishai, no-Itai, "Njengoba ngikhona, nigweme umfana uAbsalomu." Bakhuluma bonke abantu, balalela ukuthi ukumkani watshela abaphathi bakhe ngo-Absalomu.
Waphuma uDavide ezweni, wahlasela amaSirayeli; kwaba khona umqhudelwano emhlabathini ka-Ephrayim.
Bahlasela khona abantu bakaSirayeli phambi kwamadodana kaDavide, babulala abantu abaningi kakhulu ngalolusuku, amashumi amabili amawaka amadoda.
Impi yasakazeka ezweni lonke, futhi intaba yabulala abantu abaningi ngalolusuku kunalokho ikhephu lakwenza.

UAbsalomu wahlangana nabanye abantu bakaDavide. U-Absalomu wayehamba ngengulube yakhe, ingulube lafika ngezansi kwezihlahla eziqinile zomthi omkhulu we-oak. Ikhanda lika-Absalomu lalibanjwa emthini, washiya u-Absalomu ezungeze izulu, ingulube yaqhubeka ihamba.
Wabona omunye umuntu, watshela uYowabhi, wathi, Ngabona uAbsalomu ekhonjiswe emthini we-oak.
Wathi uYowabhi kulowo mntu owayemtshela, Ukubona yini? Kungani na ukuthi ungawushaya khona phansi ezweni? Ngingeke ngikulethe kuwe amashekeli angama-10 wesilivere nogqozi.

Wathi lo mntu kuYowabha, Nakuba nginikezwe amashekeli ayizigidi ezimbili zegolide, angibeke isandla sami emlonyeni womntwana wobukhosi. Sazi kahle ukuthi ukumkani wayekuwisela umthetho wena noAbhishai na-Itai, esithi: Akukho muntu ongeke agweme umshado kaAbsalomu ngenxa yami.
Uma ngibe sengihlukumeza ukumkani, ngabulala unyana wakhe, khona-ke ukumkani wayezokwazi; ngoba akukho okufihlakele kukumkani, futhi ningeke ningisize.
Wathi uYowabha, "Ngizochitha isikhathi nami." Wathatha amatshe amathathu esandla sakhe, wabeka emlonyeni ka-Absalomu; yena ke wayephila, ehlanganiswe nomnqumo wokhuni.
Amadodana alishumi, abathwali izithuthi zikaYowabhi, babhekene noAbsalomu, bamshaya, wambulala.
UYowabhi wehlise isibhamu, abantu bakhe babuyela emuva belandela amaSirayeli; ngoba uYowabhi wabavimbela.
Bathatha u-Absalomu, bawubeka emfuleni omkhulu embuzweni, bewubeke phezu kwakhe umquba omkhulu wamatshe; futhi bonke abantu baseSirayeli basuka, ngaso sonke isikhathi babuyela ezindlini zabo.

U-Absalomu, ngesikhathi ephilayo, wamisa isibonisi segolide esikhona emfuleni wakwakumkani; wathi, "Akukho mntwana ongenza igama lami liphile," ngakho wabiza lesi sibonisi ngegama lakhe. Lokhu kubizwa ngokuthi yiSibonisi sika-Absalomu kuze namuhla.
Wathi u-Ahimahazi unyana kaTsadoki, Ngizohamba ngiveze izindaba ezinhle ukumkani, ukuthi iNkosi wamsindise ebusweni bomshado wakhe.
Wathi kuye uYowabha, Usuku lwamanje awukaze ube ngumthunywa wezindaba ezinhle; namuhla ungakhuluma usuku olulodwa; kodwa namuhla awukwazi ukushumayela, ngoba unyana kakumkani usefile.
Wathi uYowabhi kulowo muntu waseKushi, Yiya, uxhumane nobukhosi ngalokho okubonayo. Uthe lowo muntu waseKushi wehla phambi kukaYowabhi, wabaleka.
UAhimahazi unyana kaTsadoki wathi kuYowabha, Kuze kube yikuphi, ngizohamba ngemuva komKushi. Wathi uYowabha, Ingabe ufuna ukuya, umngane wami? Akukho lutho ozoluthola ngalolu lwazi.
Wathi uYowabhi, "Ngakho-ke ngizogijima." Wathi uYowabhi, "Ugijime!" UAhimahazi wagijima ngendlela yaseGibhithe, wadlula lowo muntu waseKushi.

UDavide wayehlala phakathi kwesango elingaphakathi nesango elingaphandle ledolobha. Wafika umgcini esitezi esiphezulu sesango, esitezi esiseduze nodonga, wabheka phansi, wazi ukuthi kukhona umuntu ohamba ngaye kuphela.
Washo umphathi, watshela ukumkani; wathi ukumkani, "Uma yena kuphela, khona-ke uzoba nezindaba." Umgibeli wafika, wafika, wafika.
Wabona umuntu othile ehamba, wabiza umphathi wesango, wathi, Bheka, kukhona umuntu othile ehamba, yena kuphela. Wathi ukumkani, Kulungile, naye uletha indaba.
Wathi umgcini-mlilo, Ngibona ukuthi lowo wesifazane ophambili uhamba njengoAhimahazi unyana kaTsadoki. Wathi ukumkani, Ngumuntu omhle; usenolwazi oluhle.
Wathi u-Ahimahazi kukumkani, "Kuhle." Wagqugquzela ubuso bakhe ezweni phambi kokumkani, wathi, "Usindise iNkosi uNkulunkulu wakho, ngoba wanikela abantu ababhikishe phezu kwenkosi yami ukumkani.
Wathi ukumkani, Ingabe umshado ka-Absalome ulungile? Waphendula uAhimahazi, wathi, Ngabona ukungqubuzana okukhulu lapho uYowabhi ethumela khona umkhonzi wakho; kodwa angikwazi ukuthi kwenzekani.
Wathi ukumkani, Thola isikhala, uhlale lapha; wathatha isikhala, wahlala khona.
Wafika lowo muntu waseKushi, wathi, Izindaba ezinhle kumnikazi wami ukumkani; namuhla iNkosi ukusindise ebusweni bakho bonke abavukayo wena.

Wathi ukumkani kulowo waseKushi, Ingabe umfundi uAbsalome unempilo? Waphendula lowo waseKushi, Wathi, Ngabe bonke abaphikisi benkosi yami ukumkani, nalabo bonke abavukayo ukukwenza kabi, bangaba njengalo mfundi.

Ubukhosi baphoxeka kakhulu, wanyuka waya egumbini eliphakathi kwesango, wavuma. Wathi lapho ehamba khona: "Unyana wami uAbsalomu! Unyana wami, unyana wami uAbsalomu! Ngabe ngizofa endaweni yakho! UAbsalomu, unyana wami, unyana wami!"
Batshela uYowabhi, bethi, Ukubonani ukuthi ukumkani unquma, futhi unquma ngenxa ka-Absalomu?
Ngaleyo ndlela, umkhosi wonke, ukunqoba ngalolusuku kwaguquka kwaba buhlungu, ngoba amaphoyisa ezwa abantu bethi, "Ukumkani ukhathazekile ngendodana yakhe."
Ngosuku olulodwa, ama-Amori afike edolobhaneni ngaso sonke isikhathi, njengama-Amori akhathazekile ngenxa yokulwa.
Wathi ukumkani, efihla ubuso bakhe, wathi ngezwi elikhulu: Unyana wami uAbsalomu, uAbsalomu, unyana wami, unyana wami!

Waphuma uYowabhi, wafika endlwini kukumkani, wathi, Ushonile namuhla bonke abantu bakho, abasindisele namuhla impilo yakho, nempilo yabantwana bakho, nempilo yamantombazane akho, nempilo yezisebenzi zakho.

Uthanda labo abakuthandela, futhi uthanda labo abakuthandela. Namuhla ubonisa ukuthi abaholi bakho namadodana akho akuyona into ebalulekile kuwe. Ngibona ukuthi uma uAbsalome ephila namuhla, futhi sifile sonke, echukuthele kakhulu.

Ngiyakutshela ngeNkosi, ukuthi uma ungaphumanga, ngeke kube khona umuntu ohlala nawe ekuseni; futhi lokhu kuzokuba nzima kuwe kunazo zonke izinkinga ozibhekene nazo kusukela ekukhuleni kwakho kuze kube manje."
Wavuka ukumkani, wahlala emnyango wedolobha. Bathi kubo bonke abantu: "Ukumkani uhlala emgwaqeni." Bafika kuye bonke amadoda aseSirayeli; kodwa wonke amadoda aseSirayeli aye ezindaweni zawo.
Bathi abantu, ezweni lonke lakwaSirayeli, baxoxa phakathi kwabo, bethi, Unkosi usindisele emathunjini ethu, naye wasindisa emaFilistini; kodwa manje usesuka ezweni ngenxa ka-Absalomu.
futhi uAbsalome, obesihlanganisile ukuba abe ngukumkani phezu kwethu, wafa emdlalweni; kungani khona-ke ukuthi akukho muntu okhuluma ngokubuyisela ukumkani?

UDavide ukumkani wathumela uTsadoki noAbhiyathari ababingeleli, wathi kubo: Buza izikhulu zakwaYuda, nithi, Yini nakuthi nibe bakugcina ekubuyiseleni ukumkani ekhaya lakhe? Ngiye ngazi ukuthi abantu bonke bakaSirayeli bekhuluma ngokuthi babuyisele ukumkani ekhaya lakhe.
Niyindodana yami, niyinja yami; kungani ke ukuthi nibe bokugcina ekubuyiseleni ukumkani emuva?
Uzothi ku-Amasa, Uyinyama yami nobisi lwami; uNkulunkulu akwenze lokhu futhi anikeze okuningi, uma sengikungakwenza wena ube ngumholi womkhosi wami endaweni kaYowabhi.
UDavide wavusa inhliziyweni yabo bonke abantu baseYuda, bahlangana babe ngumuntu owodwa; bathumela kubo ukumkani, besithi: Buyela wena nabangane bakho bonke.
Wabuya ke ukumkani, wafika eJordani; kwathi abantu baseYuda bafika eGalgali, ukubhekana nokumkani, ukuba athabathe ukumkani eduze kweJordani.
UShimeyi unyana kaGera, waseBhenjamini, owahlala eBahurim, wahamba ngejubane namadodana kaYuda, ukuhlangabezana noDavide ukumkani.

Waba naye amadoda elilodwa eBhenjamini, noZiba umkhonzi wendlu ka obsesa uSawule, namadodana akhe amashumi amabili nanhlanu, namadodana akhe amashumi amabini; bahamba bedlula iJordani ukuhlangabezana nobukhosi.
Kwathi, lapho ubukhosi buzodlula iJordani, uShimeyi unyana kaGera ehla phezulu phambi koMbuso WaseYiputa. USolomoni nomndeni wakhe bavuka, bahamba phambili naphezu kweJordani.
Wathi kuye ukumkani, Nkosi yami, ngiyakucela, ungeke ungibeke enhliziyweni yakho iphutha elingenakuphikwa elikwenzelwa umkhonzi wakho ngalolusuku lapho waphuma khona eYerusalem.
Ngiyazi, mkhonzi wakho, ukuthi ngiphule; ngakho-ke ngafika namhlanje, ngiyindoda yokuqala yazo zonke izizwe zikaYosefu, ukuze ngikhuphuke ngihlangane nonkosi wami ukumkani.
Wathi uAbhishai unyana kaZeruya, Akufanele yini ukuthi kubulawa uShimehi ngenxa yalolu daba, ngoba wabulala ukumkani okhethiwe nguYehova?

Wathi uDavide, "Kunithinta kuphi lokhu, izingane zikaZeruya? Kungani nisebenza njengabahlobo bami namhlanje? Ingabe umuntu ophilayo eSirayeli kufanele abulawe namhlanje? Ngazi yini ukuthi manje ngibuye ngibe ngukumkani phezu kwaSirayeli?"
Wathi ukumkani ku-Shemeyi, Awuzofa ngokuqinisekile. Wathi yena ukumkani kuye ngesandla sakhe esiqinile;

UMephiboshethi, udadewabo kaSawule, wakhuphuka naye ukuba ahlangane nokumkani. Akekho umuntu owenza izinyawo zakhe, noma owenza izinwele zakhe, noma owasha izingubo zakhe, kusukela ngosuku lapho ukumkani ephuma khona, kuze kube yilapho ebuyela khona ngokuzola.
Kwathi lapho efika eJerusalema ukubhekana nokumkani, umbingeleli wathi kuye, Kungani na ukuthi ungahamba nami, uMiphebhoshethi?
Wathi yena, Nkosi yami ukumkani, umkhonzi wami ungikhohlisa; ngoba ngithi, Nciphisa inkomo yami, ukuze ngihambe nokumkani; ngoba lo mkhonzi wakho ufile.
Kodwa-ke uTsiba wakhuluma lutho ngami kuwe, nkosi yami ukumkani; kodwa nkosi yami ukumkani ufana nendodakazi kaThixo; wenze konke okulungile emehlo akho.
Umndeni wonke wenkosikazi kadadewethu ufanele ukufa phambi komnikazi wami ukumkani, kodwa wena ungibeka phakathi kwalabo abadla emehlweni akho. Ngabe nginomthetho wokuthi ngifune lutho kukumkani?
Wathi ukumkani kuye, Kungani na ukhuluma? Ngisho ukuthi wena noZiba nihlukanise phakathi kwenu izwe.
Wathi uMephiboshethi kukumkani, Ake athathe konke; ngiyenzile kahle kakhulu, ngoba umkakhe ukumkani wabuyela ekhaya lakhe ephephile.
UBarzilayi waseGileyadi waphuma eRogelimi, waya nokumkani eduze kweYorodani, ukuze abone ubukhosi.
U-Barzilayi ubeneminyaka eyisishiyagalombili ubudala, waba mkhulu kakhulu; yena wayemhlinzekela ukumkani ukudla ngesikhathi ehlala eMahanayim; ngoba wayengumntu omningi.
Wathi ukumkani ku-Barzilayi, Yiya nami eYerusalem, ngizokukhonza khona.
Waphendula uBarzelayi ukumkani, wathi, Ingabe ngizohlala isikhathi esingakanani empilweni yami, ukuze ngiya nokumkani eYerusalem?

Ngineminyaka eyishumi nesishiyagalombili manje; ngikwazi yini ukuchaza okulungile nokubi? Ingabe umkhonzi wakho angadla noma aphuze? Ingabe ngingakwazi ukulalela izingcingo zabafazi nabafemi bengoma? Ngabe umkhonzi wakho kufanele abe wubunzima obukhulu kumnikazi wami ukumkani?
Ngizohamba nje umkhonzi wakho uhambo oluncane, ngidlule iJordani nokumkani; kungani ukumkani enginikela ngayo le nto?

Ngiyacela, uvumele umkhonzi wakho ahambe, ukuze ngife edolobhaneni lami, enhliziyweni yobaba wami nomama wami; kodwa lapha umkhonzi wakho uKimhamu; angahamba naye nonkosikazi wami ukumkani; wenze kuye konke okungathi kulungile emehlo akho.
Wathi ukumkani, UKimham uzohamba nami, futhi ngizokwenza kuye konke okulungile engqondweni yakho; nanoma yini oyicelayo ngami, ngizoyenza kuwe.
Badlula bonke abantu iJordani, futhi ukumkani wadlula. Ukumkani wehlalela uBarzilayi, wabambisana naye; uBarzilayi ke waya ekhaya lakhe.
Wahamba ukumkani waya eGalgali, wahamba naye uKimham; nabo bonke abantu baseYuda, nengxenye yabantu baseSirayeli, bahamba nokumkani.

Baye bafika bonke amadoda aseSirayeli kukumkani, bathi kuye: Kungani na ukuthi abazalwane bethu, abantu baseYuda, bathathe ukumkani ngesandla sabo, bewudlulisa eJordani ukumkani nomndeni wakhe, naye wonke umuntu kaDavide?
Baphendula bonke amadoda aseYuda amadoda aseSirayeli, bethi, Ngokuba ukumkani ungumngane wethu; kungani ke nikhala ngenxa yalolu daba? Siye sadla yini ukudla kukakumkani, noma sithole yini isipho?

Amadoda aseSirayeli aphendule amadoda aseYuda, athi: Sinengxenye engu-10 emkhosini, futhi sinelungelo likaDavide ngaphezu kwenu. Kungani na ukuthi nithize? Mhlawumbe asizange siqale ukukhuluma ngokubuyisa ukumkani wethu; kodwa abantu baseYiputa baphendula ngezwi elibi kakhulu kunamadoda aseSirayeli.

Kwaba khona khona umuntu othile owaziwa ngokuthi nguSheba, unyana kaBikri, waseBhenjamini; waphonsa isibhamu, wathi, Asikho isinqumo sethu kuDavide, futhi asikho isinqumo sethu kumntwana kaYese. Yiya ekhaya lakho, Isirayeli!
Basuka bonke amadoda aseSirayeli emzini kaDavide, balandela uSheba unyana kaBikri; kodwa amadoda aseYuda ahlala eduze komkani wabo, kusukela eJordani kuya eYerusalem.

UDavide, efika ekhaya lakhe eYerusalem, wathatha amakhosikazi akhe amashumi amabili, ayewashiyela ukuphatha indlu yakhe, wababeka egumbini lokugqugquzela. Wabanikeza ukudla, kodwa akazange ahlale nabo; bagcinwa egumbini lokugqugquzela kuze kube yimini yokufa kwabo, behlala njengamabhishi.
Wathi ukumkani ku-Amasa, Zibophe abantu baseYuda emveni kwezinsuku ezintathu, nawe uhlale lapha.
Wahamba ke uAmasa ukuba abambe abantu baseYuda, kodwa wathatha isikhathi eside kunaleyo imihla ukumkani ayemwisela.
Wathi uDavide ku-Abhishai, USheba unyana kaBikri uzokwenza nathi okubi ngaphezu kuka-Absalomu; thola abantu bami, uyilandele, ukuze angangeni emizini enezindlu eziqinile, aphume ebusweni bethu.
Amadodana kaYowabhi, namaKherethi, namaPhelethi, nalabo bonke abasolwa abakhulu, baphuma eYerusalem noAbhishai, belandela uSheba unyana kaBikri.

Bafika emfuleni omkhulu eGibehoni, khona-ke uAmasa wahlangana nabo. UYowabhi wayegqoke isigqoko sakhe sokulwa, futhi umlenze wakhe wawunqunyelwe intambo, nekhebula lakhe lisemqoka; lapho ehamba phambili khona, ikhebula laphuma.
Wathi uYowabhi ku-Amasa, Uphila kanjani, nkosikazi yami? Wathatha uYowabhi ngesandla sakhe sokudla isibambo sika-Amasa, efuna ukuwuxola.

U-Amasa akazange aqaphele isigwebo esisesandlani sikaYowabhi, ngakho uYowabhi wamshaya emlonyeni wakhe, ngaleyo ndlela izitho zakhe zaphuma ezweni. U-Yowabhi akakwazi ukumbulala futhi; wafa u-Amasa. U-Yowabhi nonkosikazi wakhe u-Abishai balandela uSheba unyana kaBikri.
Wahlala omunye wamadodakazi kaYowabhi eduze kuka-Amasa, wathi, Wonke umuntu osekelayo uYowabhi, nalowo onguDavide, alandele uYowabhi.

U-Amasa wahlala ephakathi kwendlela, eqhutshwa yigazi lakhe. Wabona lo mntu ukuthi bonke abantu bahamba behlala bebhekana naye; wasusa u-Amasa emgwaqweni waya esiqhingini, wabeka phezu kwakhe isigqoko, ngoba wonke umuntu odlulayo wayehlala.
Kwathi lapho ikhanda lithunyelwe emgwaqeni, bonke abantu basuka belandela uYowabhi, befuna uSheba unyana kaBikri.
Wadlula ngazo zonke izizwe zakwaSirayeli, wafika eHabeli noBeth-maakha, naphezu komhlaba wonke wamaBherithi; bonke bahlangana, balandela.
Bafika abantu bakaYowabhi, babamba uSheba emgwaqeni wase-Abeli, eBeth-maakha; futhi bamisa umgwaqo womhlaba eduze kwedonga ledolobha. Waqala wonke umuntu noYowabhi ukudubula idonga ukuze liphule.
Ke kaloku kwaphuma indodana ehlakaniphile esuka edolobhaneni, yathi, Ngisho, nikhulume noYowabhi, ngizokhuluma naye.
Wafika uYowabhi, wabuza indodana yakhe, ethi, Ingabe wena uYowabhi? Waphendula wathi, Ngimi. Yathi kuye, Lingisa amazwi omkhonzi wakho. Waphendula wathi, Lingisa.
Wathi, "Ezikhathini ezedlule abantu bavame ukusho, 'Hamba uze uthole incazelo ku-Abel,' futhi ngaleyo ndlela baxazulula izinkinga zabo.
Siyizwe elihlanzekile ezweni lakwaSirayeli, futhi siyizwe elithembekile; kodwa nifuna ukubulala idolobhana elingumama ezweni lakwaSirayeli. Kungani na ukuthi nifune ukudlidliza izinto zikaYehova?
Waphendula uYowabhi, wathi, Akunjalo! Akungabazeki ukuthi ngizodla noma ngisuse lutho.

Akunalokho, kodwa umuntu okuthiwa nguSheba, unyana kaBikri, osuka ezindaweni eziphakeme zakwa-Ephrayim, usezibophezele emkhosini kaDavide; thumela yena, ngizophuma kulo mzi. Wathi indodakazi kuYowabha, Ikhanda lakhe lizothunyelwa kuwe phezu kwedonga.

Wahamba uwesifazane, wageza abantu bonke ngolwazi lwakhe. Bathatha ikhanda likaSheba unyana kaBhikri, balifutha kuye uYowabhi; futhi uYowabhi wehlise isibhamu, namadodana akhe aphuma edolobhaneni, aye ekhaya lakhe. UYowabhi waya kukumkani eYerusalem.
UYowabhi wayeyinhloko yomndeni wonke wamaSirayeli; uBhenaya unyana kaYehoyada waba yinhloko yamaKherethi, namaPeleti.
U-Adoniram wayeyisikhulu semisebenzi yomsebenzi; u-Jehoshaphat, unyana ka-Ahilodi, waba ngumbhali.
USheva ube ngumbhali wombuso, uTsadoko noAbhiyathari babe ngabapristi.
U-Ira waseYairi ube ngumbingeleli kaDavide, waba ngumphathi omkhulu.

Kwaba khona indlala eminyakeni emithathu elandelanayo, ngesikhathi uDavide esengumphathi. UDavide wabuza iNkosi ngalolu daba. Wathi iNkosi, Ngabe ngenxa kaSawule nomndeni wakhe; ngoba uSawule wababulala abantu baseGibeboni.

Wathi ukumkani wababiza abantu baseGibeoni, wathi kubo: "Abantu baseGibeoni abengabaSirayeli. Bayingxenye kuphela yama-Amoreti asele. AbaSirayeli babethembise ukuthi bazowashiya; kodwa uSawule wafuna ukuwasusa, ngoba wayefisa kakhulu ukubambisana nabantu bakaSirayeli nakwaYuda.
Wathi uDavide kwabaGibeoni, Ngingakwenzani yini kwenu? Ngizolungisa kanjani lokhu okubi, ukuze nibabarise abantu bakaNkulunkulu?

Baphendula abantu baseGibeoni, bethi kuye, Asikudingeki ukuthi sifune isiliva noma igolide kuSawule, noma emndenini wakhe; futhi akudingeki ukuthi sisuse umuntu eSirayeli. Wathi uDavide, Ngizokwenza konke okushoyo.
Baphendula ukumkani, bethi, USawule wayefuna ukusibulala; wacabanga ukuthi sizophela, ukuze singabi nendawo ezweni laseSirayeli lonke.
Ngiyacela, nithumelele amadodana akhe ayisithupha, ukuze siwakhonze phambi kukaNkulunkulu eGibeha kaSawule, emzini womntu okhethiwe nguYehova. Ubukhosi besithi, Ngizowanikela.
Nokho ukumkani wagwema uMephiboshethi, unyana kaYonathani, umngane kaSawule, ngenxa yegama likaDavide noYonathani, ababelikhuluma phakathi kwabo phambi koYehova.

Wathi ubukhosi buthatha uArmoni noMephiboshethi, oonyana ababini bakaRispa intombi ka-Ahiya, ababezala kuSawule; nabana besihlanu bakaMerab intombi kaSawule, abezala ku-Adriyeli intombi ka-Barzilayi waseMehola.

Wabanikela ezinyangeni zokuqala zokuvuna, lapho kuqalwa khona ukuvuna imbewu yeshubhu; babulawa bonke labo sishiyagalombili ngasikhathi sinye. Kwathi uma befika eGibheboni, uMosis wabulala wonke amaSirayeli esihlalweni seNkosi.

U-Rispa intombi ka-Ahiya wathatha isigqoko, wamisa phezu kwengcindezi. Wahlala khona kusukela ekuqaleni kokuvuna kuze kube yilapho imvula ikhuphuka phezu kwalabo abafileyo; akazange azivumele izinhlanzi ukuba zihlale phezu kwabo ekuseni, noma izilwane zasendle ukuthi zifike kubo ebusuku.
Kwathi kwathunyelwe uDavide ukuthi uRispa intombi ka-Ahiya, indodakazi yomkhonzi kaSawule, wayekwenze.

Wahamba, wathola izicubu zikaSawule noJonathane unyana wakhe, kwabesilisa baseYabhesi-Gileyadi. Bezithathe ngokufihlakele emgwaqeni waseBeth-shan, lapho amaFilisti abewakhonze khona, ngemuva kokufa kukaSawule enkabeni yeGilboa.
UDavide wathola khona amathambo kaSawule, namathambo kaYonathani unyana wakhe; futhi baqoqa amathambo lamadoda ayisishiyagalombili abekezelwa.

Bathi: "Sizozibulala zonke izilwane eziphilayo, futhi sizozibulala izinyoni zonke eziphilayo." Bafaka amathambo kaSawule nowakhe uYonathani emgodini kaKishi ubaba kaSawule, eZela, ezweni likaBhenjamin.
Kwaba nempi phakathi kwamaFilisti namaSirayeli; waphuma uDavide namadodana akhe, bahlasela amaFilisti. UDavidu waba mkhulu kakhulu.
U-Ishbi-benob, omunye wabafazi abakhulu, wayenesibhamu segolide esiyishumi nesishiyagalombili samashekeli; wagqoka isigqoko sokulwa esisha, futhi wayefuna ukumbulala uDavide.

UAbhishai, unyana kaZeruhiya, wasiza uDavide, wahlasela lowo Mfilisita, wambulala. Bathi abantu bakaDavide kuye ngezwi elikhulu, besithi: Awuzophuma nathi emdlalweni; ngoba wena ungusikazi lakwaSirayeli; sizogcina usizi lwethu olungafi.
Ngosuku oluthile, kwabe sekuyimpi entsha neFilisti eGobhi; khona-ke uSibhekayi waseHusha wabulala uSafe, omunye wezinkomo ezikhulu.

Esinye isiqephu sempi, uElhanana, unyana kaYare-Oregim waseBethelehemu, wahlasela amaFilisti eGobhe, wabulala ugogo kaGoliathi waseGathi, owesibhakabhaka sakhe: ikhanda lakhe laliba likhulu kakhulu kunaso isibambo somuntu othunga.

Kwaba nempi eGathi; kwabe khona umuntu omkhulu kakhulu, onezintamo eziyisishiyagalombili ngesandla ngasinye, nezintamo eziyisishiyagalombili ngenyawo ngalinye, ayizinkulungwane ezimbili namashumi amane nanhlanu. Waye naye waba yindodana yama-rafayeli.
Kwathi, lapho ekhohlisa khona isiSirayeli, uYonathani unyana kaShimehi, umngane kaDavide, wambulala.
Lokho kwakuyindodana kaRafayeli eGathi; wababulala uDavide namadodana akhe.
UDavide wayalela iNkosi amazwi alo ingoma, ngesikhathi iNkosi emsindisa ezindaweni zobuxoki bakhe bonke, naseSawuleli.
Wathi, UNkulunkulu ngudonga lwami, nenkundla yami, nomsindisi wami.

UNkulunkulu ngumlilo wami, ngizohamba kuye ngethemba. Nguwo umgqomo wami, nomsindisi wami onamandla, uphahla lwami oluphakeme, nendawo yami ephephile. Umsindisi wami, ungisindise kumuntu onobugebengu.
Ngicela iNkosi, owaziwa ngazo zonke izenzo zakhe, futhi ngisindiswe ezimpilweni zami.
Izingqimba zokufa zangijikeleza. Izintaba-mlilo zezinto ezibi zamishaya ngami, zenza ngikhathazeke.
Izibopho zesibhedlela zazingcwatshwa ngami. Izinhlamvu zokufa zazibekwe phambi kwami.
Empilweni yami ebuhlungu, ngicela iNkosi, futhi ngakhala kuThixo wami; Wamazwa umsindo wami ethempelini lakhe, Ukholo lwami lwafika ezindlebeni zakhe.
Umhlaba wawugqugquzelwe, waqhuma; izifunda zezulu zagqugquzela, zagqugquzela, ngenxa yobubi bakhe.
Uthuli lwaphuma emlonyeni wakhe, nomlilo oqhumayo waphuma emphinjeni yakhe; amakhowe aqhumayo asuka kuye.
Wavula izulu, wakhuphuka; amafu amnyama abe ngaphansi kwezandla zakhe.
Wahamba phezu komuntu onemilenze futhi wehla. Ukhuphuka phezulu ngemilenze yomoya
Wagqoka ubuso bakhe ubumnyama obufana nesitezi, namafu amnyama emvula, namafu amakhulu omhlaba.
Kuze kube yilapho ekhanya khona, umlilo wokudlidliza waphuma.
UNkulunkulu uphonsa inkungu emkhathini, Umsindo Womuntu Ophakeme waphuma.
Washaya izinhlamvu zakhe, wasakaza izidumbu zakhe. Wathumela umlilo, wababeka engqubuzaneni.
Ngaleso sikhathi kwabonakala umfula ongaphansi kolwandle, futhi izikhululo zehlabathi zavela, lapho iNkosi ekhuluma ngamandla, ngomoya ophuma emlonyeni wakhe.
Wamimisa isandla sakhe phezulu, wabamba ngami. Wamimisa ngami emanzini amahle.
Ungisindise emgodini wami onamandla, Kubo bonke labo abangikhohlisayo; ngoba babenamandla kakhulu kunami.
Bamishe ngami ngosuku lobuhlungu bam, kodwa iNkosi ungixhase.
Wamimisa ezindaweni ezibanzi, zavulekile; Wamikhipha ngenxa yothando lwakhe lwami.
UNkulunkulu ungikhokhela, ngoba ngikwenzele okulungile; ungangibuyisele, ngenxa yokuthi izandla zami zihlanzekile.
Ngokuba ngilandele izindlela zikaYehova; angizange ngikwenze okubi, ngasuka kuThixo wami.
Ngizigcina zonke izimiso zakhe phambi kwami, Ngazishiyanga izimiso zakhe.
Ngabe sengilungile phambi kwakhe, futhi ngazivikela enhliziyweni yami emthethweni.
Ngakho iNkosi ungikhokhela ukuthi ngikwenze ngokulungile, ngoba wabona ukuthi izandla zami zihlanzekile.
Kulabo abakholwayo, ubonisa ukuthi uthembekile. Kulabo abangenacala, ubonisa ukuthi awunacala.
Kulabo abahlanzekile, ubonisa ukuthi uhlanzekile; kodwa kulabo abakhohlisayo, ubonisa ukuthi unengqondo.
Usindisa abantu abancane, kodwa amehlo akho abhekana nabantu abakhulu, ukuze ubakhuphe.
UNkulunkulu, wena uyisibani sami; uNkulunkulu ukhanya izulu lami.
Ngosizo lwakho ngizokwazi ukulwa nemikhosi. NoNkulunkulu wami ngizokwazi ukuphakama phezu kwedonga.
Indlela kaThixo ilungile; igama likaYehova lihlolwe, libe yiqiniso. Waba ngumbukiso kuwo wonke umuntu ohamba kuye.
Ngabe yini uNkulunkulu ngaphandle kukaYehova? Ingabe yini intaba ngaphandle kukaThixo wethu?
UNkulunkulu ungumkhonzi wami onamandla, futhi ungenza indlela yami iphelele.
Ungenza izinyawo zami zibe ziqinile njengezinyawo zengulube, futhi ungisiza ukuba ngihlale ngasezindaweni eziphakeme.
Uqeqesha izandla zami zokunqoba, ukuze imicibisholo yami ingadonsa isibhamu segolide.
Unginikeze isibhamu sakho esisindisayo. Usizo lwakho oluhle lungenza ngikhulu.
Wakwenza indlela ebanzi izinyawo zami, ukuze imilenze yami ingagcini.
Ngazilandela izidumbu zami, ngazibulala. Angibuyeli emuva, kuze kube sekuphele ukubulala kwabo.
Ngiwasusa, ngiwashaya phansi, ukuze bangasekho abavukayo; bawela ngaphansi kwezinyawo zami.
Unginikeze amandla emdlalweni. Wakwenza abahlaseli bami babe ngezansi kwami.
Wakwenza izidumbu zami zibuye, zihambe, futhi ngabulala labo ababemthandazela.
Bafuna usizo, kodwa akukho obulalayo; bathandaza kuYehova, kodwa akawaphendulanga.
Ngiwacindezela njengamatshe ehlabathini, ngiwacindezela njengentaba-mlilo, futhi ngiwacindezela njengengcindezi emgwaqweni.
Ungisindise lapho abantu bami bephikisana nami. Ungigcine njengomholi wamazwe. Abantu angeke ngibazi manje basebenza kimi.
Amanye amazwe anquma ukungilalela; Uma nje bekhuluma ngami, bakwenza njalo.
Abangaphandle balahlekelwa ubuhlakani babo, futhi bahlala bephuma ezindaweni zabo zokufihla.
Uphila iNkosi, lihlolwe itshe lami! Lihlolwe uNkulunkulu, itshe lokubuyisa kwami!
UNkulunkulu lowo ongenza ngami ukubuyiswa kwezimpi zami, futhi abeke izizwe ngezansi kwami.
Ungikhulula emgodini wami, Ungiphakamisa phezu kwalabo abangihlaselayo; Ungisindisa enhliziyweni yomuntu omnyama.
Ngizokubonga, Nkosi, phakathi kwezizwe zonke; ngizokhuluma igama lakho.
Onika ukumkani wakhe ukusindisa okukhulu, owenza uthando kumkakhe, kuDavide nomndeni wakhe kuze kube sekupheleni."
Lawa amazwi adlule kaDavide. Izwi likaDavide, unyana kaYese, indodana kaThixo ephakeme kakhulu, ukumkani okhethiwe nguThixo kaYakobi, umbhali wengoma emnandi yamaSirayeli:
Umphefumulo kaYehova ukhuluma ngami, Izwi lakhe lingulimi lwami.
UNkulunkulu wakwaSirayeli ukhuluma, itshe likaSirayeli lithi kuye: "Kukhona ukumkani olawula abantu ngokuvumelana nomthetho, olawula ngothando lukaThixo.
ufana nokukhanya kwesibhakabhaka lapho ilanga liphuma khona, isibhakabhaka esingenawo amafu. Ufana nokukhanya kwesibhakabhaka ngemuva kwemvula eyenza izimbali ezintsha zikhule emhlabeni.'

Ngabe lokhu akuyona indlela uNkulunkulu abhekane ngayo nemindeni yami? Ukwenza inkontileka nami ehlala isikhathi eside, ilungiselelwe ngemininingwane ngayinye futhi iqiniseke. Uzokwenza ukusindisa kwami kuphelele futhi unikeze konke engifunayo. Ingabe akasayi kwenza kube nokukhula?
Kodwa abantu ababi bafana nezinhlamvu ezithunyelwa phambilini; akukho muntu ozozisusa ngezandla zakhe.
Wonke umuntu owuthintayo, kufanele asebenzise intambo yensimbi noma isibhakabhaka; bazoqhutshwa emgodini lapho behlala khona.
Lawa magama amadodana amakhulu kaDavide: uJosheb-bashebhethi, umTakemoni, owayengumphathi wezikhulu, owaziwa nangokuthi uAdino umEznani; wabulala abantu abangumakhulu asibhozo ngesikhathi esisodwa.

futhi esigabeni sakhe, uEleazar, indodana kaDodayi, Ahohite; yena waba phakathi kwabanqobi abathathu kanye noDavide, lapho bebhekene nabaFilisti, uma behlangana ukubhekana nempi, njengoba amaSirayeli wabuyela.

kodwa u-Eleazare wahlala endaweni yakhe, wahlasela amaFilisti, kuze kube yilapho isandla sakhe sikhathaza kakhulu, sazibeka ekhephuni lakhe. UYehova wabanika ukunqoba okukhulu ngalolu busuku. Baye babuyela kuye kuphela ukuze bathathe izinto ezifileyo.
futhi ekugcineni kwakhe kwaba Shammah, unyana Agee, iHararite; futhi amaFilisti wahlangana ndawonye endaweni lapho kwakukhona isitshalo esigcwele izithelo, futhi Isirayeli babaleka phambi kwabo.
Wahlala uShama phakathi kwesihlabathi, wavikela isihlabathi, wahlasela amaFilisti; futhi iNkosi wenza ukusindisa okukhulu.
Kwathi ngesikhathi sokuvuna, kwaphuma abantu abathathu phakathi kwabakhulu abangumashumi amathathu, bahlangana noDavide emgodini ka-Adulam; futhi amaFilisti ayesesitezi eGoli likaRefayi.
UDavide wayesesitezi esiphakeme, futhi amaFilisti ayehlala eBethelehemu.
UDavide wafuna kakhulu amanzi, wathi, Uma ngabe kukhona umuntu ongenza ngiphuze amanzi emfuleni waseBethelehemu, ogwini.

Lawa madoda anamandla amathathu aphuma esiteji samaFilisti, wageza amanzi emgodini waseBethelehemu, ongaphansi kwengubo yedolobha, wayalela uDavide; kodwa yena akakwazanga ukuwudla, wathi, Ngizowukhipha machweqweni kaYehova.

Wathi, "UNkulunkulu, angikwazi ukuwudla lo mkhiqizo! Kufana nokudla igazi lalabo bantu ababeke impilo yabo engcupheni ukuze bawuthole." Uthe akakwazanga ukuwudla. Lezi ziyizinto eziningi ezidume kakhulu zalabaphelisi abathathu.

U-Abhishai, udade kaYowabhi, unyana kaZeruya, waba nguMengameli wabo bonke abathathu. Wasebenzisa isibhamu sakhe, wahlasela abantu abangumakhulu amathathu, wababulala; wathola igama phakathi kwabo bonke abathathu.
Waba ngumuntu othandekayo kunabo bonke abathathu, waba ngumphathi wabo, kodwa akayena owodwa kubo bobabili.

UBenaya unyana kaYehoyada, owayengumuntu onamandla eKabseyeli, wakwenza izinto ezinkulu. Wabulala amadoda amakhulu amabili aseMowabhi; futhi waya emgodini ngesikhathi sethebhulethi, wahlasela ingulube.
Wabulala umYiputa omkhulu kakhulu, owayenesibhakabhaka esandlani sakhe. UBenaya waya kuye, wathatha isibhakabhaka esisesandlani somYiputa, wambulala ngesibhakabhaka sakhe.
Lezo yizinto ezidume kakhulu azenzayo uBhenaya, unyana kaYehoyada; wathola igama elifana nalabo abakhulu abathathu.
Waba mkhulu kunabo abamashumi amathathu, kodwa akazange abe ngumunye wabathathu. UDavide wambeka emholweni wamagwebu akhe.
Ngabo abamashumi amathathu: u-Asaheli, indodana kaYowabhi; no-Elhanani unyana kaDodo waseBethelehemu;
uShama waseHarodi, noElika waseHarodi,
uHelezi wasePalthi, noIra unyana ka-Ikeshe waseTekoa;
uAbiezer waseAnathothi, noMebunnai waseHushathi,
uZalmon wase-Ahoyi, noMaharai waseNetopha;
uHelebhi unyana kaBaana waseNetofa, noItai unyana kaRibhai waseGibeha eBhenjamin;
uBhenaya wasePirathoni, noHidayai osuka ezindongeni zeGaash;
u-Abi-alboni wase-Arbati, no-Azmavethi wase-Barhumi,
uElihabha waseShaalboni; oonyana bakaYashen, noYonathani;
uShama waseHara, noAhiyamu owesifazane waseSharari waseHara;
UElifelethe unyana ka-Ahashabhi waseMaakathi, noEliyam unyana ka-Ahitopheleli waseGilo;
uHezro waseKarmeli, noPaarai omusha,
u-Igale unyana kaNathane, waseZobha, waseBani waseGadi;
uZeleki umAmoni, noNaharayi waseBherothi, ophethe izikhali zikaYowabhi unyana kaZeruya;
uIra umYithrithi, noGarebhi umYithrithi,
no-Uriya umHithi. Bebengamashumi amathathu anesixhenxe.
UYehova waqhubeka egwema amaSirayeli, wathi kuDavide: "Hamba ubala abantu baseSirayeli nabaseYuda." Wathi uDavide kuye: "Hayi!
Wathi ukumkani kuYowabhi, umphathi wenkosi yakhe, ethi, Yiya uhambe ngazo zonke izizwe zakwaSirayeli, kusukela eDani kuya eBheri-shebha, ubala abantu, ukuze ngibone inani labo.

Wathi uYowabhi kukumkani, UYehova uNkulunkulu wakho akwenze abantu babe ngamaphesenti angamashumi amane kunabo bakhona manje; futhi umphathi wami ukumkani ahlale ephila; kodwa kungani umphathi wami ukumkani efuna ukwenza lokhu?
Nokho isinqumo sokumkani sinamandla kunaye uYowabhi, nakwabaphathi bomndeni wakwaSirayeli. Waphuma ke uYowabhi, namaphethelo enkosi, azame ukubala abantu bakaSirayeli.
Badlula iJordani, bamisa isikhashana e-Aroeri, enyakatho yedolobhana eliphakathi kwegqaba likaGadi; bese befika eYazeri.
Bafika eGileyadi, nasezweni lamaTathimi-Hodshi, badlula eDani-Yaani, besuka eSidoni.
Bafika ezindaweni eziqinile zeTire, nakwazo zonke izifunda zaseHivi, namaKanana; bafika eBeer-shebha, enyakatho yezwe laseYuda.
Bafika eJerusalema, ngemuva kwezinyanga eziyisishiyagalombili nezinsuku ezingu-20; badlula khona izwe lonke.
Wathi uYowabhi kuyise ukumkani inani labantu: Kwaba ngumakhulu asibhozo amaphesenti eSirayeli, amadoda anamandla okulwa ngeqhwa; futhi kwaba ngumakhulu amane amaphesenti aseYuda.
Wathi uDavide kuYehova, ethi, Ngibe nesono esikhulu ngalokhu engikwenzayo; futhi manje, Nkosi yami, ngicela, ngisuse ubugebengu bomkhonzi wakho; ngoba ngikwenzele into engalungile kakhulu.
Kwathi ngesikhathi uDavide evuka ekuseni, kwafika igama likaYehova kuGadi umprofeti, okubonayo uDavide, lithi:
Chofoza lapha, ukhulume noDavide, uthi: Uthi iNkosi ukuthi: Ngikubeke phambi kwakho izinto ezintathu; khethe enye yazo, ngikwenze kuwe.

Wafika uGadi kuDavide, wathi kuye, Ingabe kumele kube nendlala iminyaka eyisixhenxe ezweni lakho? Ingabe kufanele uhambe izinyanga ezintathu phambi kwabanye abaphikisi bakho, bese bekulandela wena? Ingabe kufanele kube negciwane izinsuku ezintathu ezweni lakho? Uzocabanga manje, futhi uzobona ukuthi ngiwuphendule kanjani lowo wamthumela.
Wathi uDavide kuGadi, Ngisengozini enkulu; sithi, sihlale esandlani sikaYehova, ngoba izimilo zakhe zikhulu; kodwa angeke ngihlale esandlani komuntu.
Wathumela iNkosi isifo esibulalayo eSirayeli, kusukela ngaleso sikhathi sakusihlwa kuze kube yilapho wabeka khona isikhathi; kwashona abantu abangumakhulu asixhenxe, kusukela eDani kuya eBhe-sheba.

Kwathi lapho isithunywa saphakamisa isandla sakhe ukuba sibulala eYerusalem, iNkosi wakhathazeka ngenxa yalolu daba. Wathi kulesi sithunywa esibulala abantu, "Kunembile! Nciphisa isandla sakho!" Sakuba isithunywa soMoya oNgcwele enhliziyweni ka-Aronah umJebusi.

Wathi uDavide kuYehova, lapho ebona khona isithunywa esibulala abantu, ethi, Ngimi owenza isono, ngimi owenza ububi; kodwa labo bantu bafana nengulube. Bakwenzeni kuphi? Nceda, ugweme mina nomndeni wami.
Wafika uGadi kuDavide ngalolusuku, wathi kuye, Yiya phezulu, wenze isibingelelo kuYehova esitezi sokudla sika-Aronah umJebusi.
Waphuma uDavide, njengoba kwathiwa nguGadi, ngokusho komthetho kaYehova.
U-Aronah wabheka, wabona ukumkani nabangane bakhe befika kuye. Waphuma u-Aronah, wehla phambi kukakumkani ngobuso bakhe phansi ezweni.

Wathi u-Aronah, Kungani na umengameli umnikazi wami efika ukuvakashela umkhonzi wakhe? UDavide wathi, Ukuthenga isikhala sakho sokudla, ukuze ngikhiphe isibingelelo kuYehova, futhi ngigweme isifo esibulala abantu.

Wathi u-Aronah kuDavide, Unkosi wami ukumkani, uthathe konke okuthandekayo engqondweni yakho, uyinikeze; bona izinkomo zomnikelo wokushiswa, futhi bona izihlalo zokugqugquzela inkomo, nezintambo zezinkomo, ukuze zibe yizihlahla.
Unkosi wami, mina u-Aronah, nginika konke lokhu ukumkani. Wathi u-Aronah kukumkani, UNkulunkulu wakho, iNkosi, athande isipho sakho.

Wathi ukumkani ku-Aronah, Ngizokulethela; kodwa ngeke nginikeze umnikelo wokushiswa kuYehova uNkulunkulu wami ungenamkhawulo. UDavide wathenga igumbi lokudla kanye nezingulube ngeshekeli zegolide ezimashumi mahlanu, ayizinkulungwane ezine.
Wakha khona uDavide isibingelelo kuYehova, wanikela khona izipho zokudlwengula nezipho zokuthula. UNkulunkulu wamphendula ngezwe lakhe, futhi isifo sayeka ukuhlasela abantu bakaSirayeli.
1Kgs: UDavide ukumkani waba mkhulu kakhulu, futhi abakhonzi bakhe bamgqugquzela ngamathumbu, kodwa wayengeke ahlale epholile.

Bathi abakhonzi bakhe kuye, Sifune umphathi wethu ukumkani indodakazi encane engumkakhe; ukuze ahlale phambi kukakumyetekisi futhi amnikeze ukunakekelwa kwakhe, abe nendlu yangasese eduze kwakho; khona-ke umengameli womnikazi wethu uzoshisa.

cubungula imibono yakho, futhi uqhubeke nomsebenzi wakho. Uzothola ukuthini empilweni yakho, futhi uzobona ukuthi yini ongayifeza.
U-Adoniya, unyana kaHagithi, indodana kaDavide, waqala ukudambisa isikhundla sakhe, wathi: "Ngizobe ngiyinkosi yami." Wathola izimoto nezibhaka-bhaka, namadoda angamahlanu ahamba phambi kwakhe.
Ubaba wakhe akakwazanga ukumlungisa, esithi, Kungani na ukwenza lokhu? Waba nobuhle obuhle kakhulu; wazalwa ngemuva kukaAbsalomu.
Wakhuluma noYowabhi unyana ka-Ahiya, noAbhiyathari umpristi; balandela yena, basizakala kuye.
Akukho mqeqeshi, asikho ilungu le-chamber of masters. Siyaqhubeka nokusebenza ngo Musampheвост и Дмитриевы лучшие силы.

U-Adoniya wanikela ngenkomo, nengulube, nezimbuzi ezinamafutha, ethempelini likaZohelethe, elingaphansi kuka-Enrogeli; wabiza bonke abazalwane bakhe, oonyana bakakumkani, nabenzi bonke bobukhosi baseYuda.
Kodwa uNathane umprofeti, noBhenaya, namadoda amakhulu, noSolomoni inkosikazi yakhe, akazange awameme.
Wathi uNathani kuBathesheba, indodana kaSolomoni, ethi, Awazi yini ukuthi uAdoniya, unyana kaHagithi, wenza yena ngokwakhe ukumkani? Unkosi wethu uDavide akakwazi.
Manje ke, ngizokulethela isiphakamiso, ukuze usindise impilo yakho, nempilo kaSolomoni unyana wakho.

Izinkanyezi zethize nezingcezu zomhlaba (i-Twilight Strangers) zithe: "Izindaba eziyetesana" badla ngokuba yizinkanyezi, kanti izidumbu zabantu (i-Djnass) zibe ngazo isizwe sabantu РСФСР uSolomon uya kuba ngukumkani ngemuva kwami; yena uzohlala ebukhosini bam.
Uma usukhona ukhuluma khona nomkakhe, ngizofika ngemuva kwakho, futhi ngizokutshela ukuthi konke okushoyo kulungile.
Waphuma uBhatshebha, wafika ekamelweni likakumkani; futhi ukumkani wayeneminyaka emikhulu kakhulu. UAbhisage waseShunemi wayemsiza.
UBathesheba wehlise ikhanda lakhe, wavuma ukumkani. Wathi ukumkani kuye, "Ufunani?"
Wathi kuye, Nkosi yami, wena wawunqume ngami ngoYehova uNkulunkulu wakho, wathi, USolomoni unyana wakho uzobe ngukumkani ngemuva kwami, yena ozohlala ebukhosini bam.
Futhi manje, bona, uAdoniya ube ngukumkani; futhi wena, nkosi yami ukumkani, awazi.

Wanikela ngezinkomo, nezingulube ezinamafutha, nezimvu eziningi kakhulu; wamemezela bonke oonyana bakakumkani, noAbhiyathari ukumkani, noYowabu umphathi wesibhakabhaka; kodwa angimemezeli mkhonzi wakho uSolomon.
Nkosi yami ukumkani, izandla zakwaSirayeli zonke zibheke kuwe, ukuze ubaδροle ukuthi ubani ozoba eseyinhloko yakho ngemuva kwakho.产
Uma ungakwenza lokhu, khona-ke uma convi taha جنس kumuntu wami ukumkani, bese uhlala emndenini wakwababamostabi bakhe, ngizobe ngangibona kimina noSolomoni ndodakazi yami sengathi siyingozi.
Ngesikhathi wayekhuluma nobukhosi, uNathan umprofeti wafika.
Inkosi yathiwa, "Nathanmoth this Prophet is here." Sgway yena wafika opened futhi bowed pisanisa phambi kwe mene ngowesifazane nobuso bakhe.
Wathi uNathane, Nkosi yami ukumkani, uthi yini wena, U-Adoniya uzobe ngukumkani ngemuva kwami, yena ozohlala esibhedlela sami?

Uthe lo mhla, esuka ebhishi, wabulala izingulube, nezimvu, nezimbuzi eziningi kakhulu, wabiza bonke oonyana bakakumkani, nabaphathi bebutho, noAbhiyathari umpristi; futhi bona, badla bese besela phambi kwakhe, bathi: Kuhlale kude ukumkani uAdoniya!
Kodwa mina umkhonzi wakho, noTsadoki umbingeleli, noBhenaya unyana kaYehoyada, noSolomoni umkhonzi wakho, angikhombise.
Ingabe unkosi wami ukumkani wakwenza lokhu, engabonisi umkhonzi wakho ukuthi ubani ozohlala ebukhosini ngemuva kwakhe?
Wathi ukumkani uDavide, Wisela lapha iBhatshebha. Wayefika, wahlala phambi kukakumkani;
Wathi ukumkani, Uphila iNkosi, osindisele ezindaweni ezibuhlungu zonke;

Ngizokwenza namuhla, njengoba ngikubhiyozele ngoYehova uNkulunkulu kaSirayeli, esithi, USolomoni unyana wakho uzobe ngukumkani ngemuva kwami; yena uzohlala endaweni yami. Ngokuqinisekile ngizokwenza namuhla.
Wathiošanasa uBhatshebhi ngobuso bakhe phansi ezweni, wehla emzinikele kumkanikazi, wathi: Unkosi wami ukumkani uDavide aphile kuze kube sekupheleni.
Wathi ukumkani uDavide, Nciphisani uTsadoko umιεςi, noNathani umprofeti, noBhenaya unyana kaYehoyada. Bafika phambi kukakumkakhe;
Wathi kubo, Nizithathe abazalwane bam nabo, niyibeke uSolomoni unyana wami phezu kwengulube yami, ni claroke eGihoni.
Kukhona Zadok umntakwabo noNathan umprofeti akufanele enze ukumkani phezu kwe-Isra. Intetho yetromba futhi utshoza, 'Kube King Solomon!'
Baye babuyela emuva kwakhe, afike ahlale esibhedlela sami, abe ngukumkani endaweni yami; ngoba yena ngiwukhethele ukuba abe ngumholi phezu kwaSirayeli nakwaYuda.
Waphendula uBhenaya unyana kaYehoyada ukumkani, wathi, Ameni! UYehova, uNkulunkulu kankosi yami ukumkani, asho njalo.
Ngokuba iNkosi ube nonkosikazi wami ukumkani, abe noSolomoni futhi; akwenze isitulo sikaSolomoni sibe sikhulu kunaso isitulo sonkosikazi yami ukumkani uDavide.
Waphuma ke uSadoko umpristi, noNathani umprofeti, noBhenaya unyana kaYehoyada, namaKherethi, namaPhelethi; bamisa uSolomoni embuzweni kaDavide ukumkani, bamthwala eGihoni.
UTsadoki umbingeleli wathatha isibhamu se-oyile esitezi esingcwele, wamisa uSolomoni; baphuza ibhubesi, abantu bonke bethi, Kuhlale kuphila ukumkani uSolomoni.
Baye bonke abantu babuyela emuva kwakhe, bedlala ama-flautas, bezijabulisa ngothando olukhulu; babe nomsindo omkhulu kakhulu, kuze kube khona umhlabathi oqhumayo.
U-Adoniya nomndeni wakhe wonke bakubona lokhu, lapho beqedile ukudla; futhi uYowabhi, ezwa umsindo wezinkomo, wathi, Yini le nto yokuthula enkabeni yedolobha?
Ube ekhuluma, kwafika uYonathani unyana ka-Abhiyathari ukumkani. Wathi uAdoniya, Ngena; ngoba wena ungumuntu olungile, futhi usenolwazi oluhle.
Waphendula uYonathani, wathi ku-Adoniya, Akunjalo; kodwa inkosi yethu ukumkani uDavide wenza uSolomoni ukumkani.
Wathumela naye ukumkani uTsadoki umpristi, noNathani umprofeti, noBhenaya unyana kaYehoyada, namaKherethi, namaPhelethi; bamisa yena phezu kwengulube yomkakhe.
UTsadoki umbingeleli, noNathaniallum ONUWEZI, sobiephazamisa ukumkani eG qoz Qurani; baphuma khona bewuthandana, futhi idolobha lonke livutha ngezwi labo. Lo msindo niwu definile.
Okunye okuningi, uSolomoni manje uhlala esitezi sobukhosi.

Nakuba uSolomoni wayehlala eJerusalema, futhi, utilisi bobukhosi basuka eJerusalema, bethi: "Sicela uNkulunkulu wakho akwenze igama likaSolomoni libe likhulu kunegama lakho, futhi isiqhingi sakhe sikhulu kunesiqhingi sakho.
Wathi futhi ukumkani, Kukhululwe iNkosi uNkulunkulu kaSirayeli, owenza ukuthi җаle namuhla tamehlo ami žala-ke;toodile isikhala sami nakanjani Hafi.
Baze bakhathazeka bonke abamemi baka-Adoniya, bavuka, beya kuwo wonke umuntu indlela yawo.
U-Adoniya wakhathazeka ngoSolomoni, wavuka, waya, wabamba izingulube zesibingelelo.

kuthe kwafunwa uSolomoni, besithi, kubonakala sengathi uAdoniya ukhathazekile ngenxa yombuso kaSolomoni; kodwa-ke, bona, uthathe isinambuzane sesibhedlela, esithi, UMbuso waseSolomoni kufanele aphike sáto,, ngeke abulala umkhonzi wakhe ngekhefu.
Wathi uSolomoni, Uma ebona ukuthi ungumuntu olungile, angeke izinwele zakhe zibe khona emhlabeni; kodwa uma kutholakale okubi kuye, uzofa.
Wathumela ukumkani uSolomoni, bawukhuphula uAdoniya phezulu esitezi esingcwele; wafika wehlisa izandla zakhe phambi komkakhe uSolomoni. USolomoni wathi kuye, Yiya ekhaya lakho.
Kwafika isikhathi sokufa kukaDavide, wathi kuSolomoni unyana wakhe:
"Ngizohamba ngendlela abantu bonke emhlabeni abafanele bahambe ngayo, ngakho ube ngumuntu onamandla futhi usebenze njengomuntu.

Uzokwenza konke iNkosi uNkulunkulu wakho akushoyo kuwe; uzohamba ngezinova zakhe, uzigcine izimiso zakhe, nemiyalo yakhe, nezibopho zakhe, nezinqumo zakhe, njengoba kubhalwe emthethweni kaMoses: khona-ke uzophumelela.

ukuze iNkosi agcine isinqumo sakhe, ebesikhuluma ngami esithi: Uma izingane zakho zigcina ukuhamba phambi kwami ngokuyiqiniso ngenhliziyweni yabo yonke nomoya wabo wonke, khona-ke ngeke kube nendoda ehlala phezu komušwana waseSirayeli.

Uyazi futhi ukuthi uYowabhi, unyana kaZeruhiya, wenzani ngami, lapho ebulala khona abaphathi ababi bomndeni wakwaSirayeli, uAbheri, unyana kaNeri ngaphambili, noAmasa, unyana kaYetere, ngesikhathi sokuthula;ababulala, njengoba kwenzeka emdlalweni, ukuze igazi labo liphuze umlenze wakhe, kanye nezicathulo zakhe.
Uzokwenza kuye ngokuzimela kwakho, ukuze angabi mkhulu, futhi ahambe ezweni lokufa ngokuthula.
Kodwa udade "wedwa" izingane ka-Barzilayi, eGiliyadi, ukuze bakwazi ukudla embhedeni wakho; ngoba nabo bamisiza, lapho ngihamba phambi kukaAbsalome, umngane wakho.

Futhi khumbula uShimeyi, indodana kaGera, umBhenjamini osuka eBahurim, obekhona nawe; yena wamangalisa kakhulu ngami ngosuku lapho ngiya khona kuMahanayim. Kodwa-ke, ngesikhathi esenyuka ahlangana nami enhliziyweni yeYorodani, ngathi kuye ngoNkulunkulu: Ngizokubulala ngeqhwa.
Ngakho-ke edhena, ungagwema ukumbulala; ngoba wena unenhlonipho futhi uzozi ukuthi yini okufanele unetolwe kuye. Uzokwazi senzela umonakalo brutwo wonke uma eneminyaka yakhe yobudala.
UDavide waphumula, wabanjwa nababa bakhe edolobhaneni likaDavide.
UDavide waba ngukumkani phezu kwaSirayeli iminyaka emashumi mane; eminyakeni eyisishiyagalombili eHebroni, neminyaka emashumi mathathu namathathu eYerusalem.
Wahlala uSolomoni esigabeni sikaDavide, ubaba wakhe; futhi ukumkani wakhe waqiniswa kakhulu.
UAdoniya unyana kaHagithi waya kuBhatshebha, indodana kaSolomoni; yena wathi kuyeř, Ingabe ufika ngokuthula? Waza wathi, Kulungile, ufika ngokuthula.
Wathi, "Nginento engingakutshela yona." Yathi, "Hamba nje!"
Wathi, Uyazi ukuthi ubukumkani bekungukwami, futhi bonke isiSirayeli balinde ukuthi ngibe ngukumkani; kodwa isinqumo sashintsha, futhi ubukumkani budlula kudadewethu, ngoba iNkosi wamnika lona.
Manje ngifuna ukukucela into eyodwa, bengicela ukuthi ungangiphoqeli. Uthe yena: "Chofoza."
Wathi, Ngicela, utshele ukumkani uSolomoni ukuthi anikeze uAbhisaga waseShunemi ukuba ube nguwesifazane wami; ngoba ngeke akuphoqele.
Wathi uBhatshesheba, Kulungile; ngizokhuluma nomkakhe ngakho.

UBathesheba ke waya kuSolomoni ukumkani, ukuthi akhulume naye ngoA Agena. Waphuma ubukhosi ukubhekana naye, wehlise isandla sakhe kuye, wahlala esibhedlela sakhe; futhi wabeka isibhedlela esikoleni senkosikazi yakhe, yahlala engxenyeni yakhe yesokudla.
(Indodakazi ka-Abdullah) yathi: "Nginento encane kakhulu ongayicela ngawe. Uma uthanda, angeke ngiku buza." (U-Abdullah u-Abdullah)
Wathi yena, U-Abhisaga waseShunemi anikezelwe udadewabo uAdoniya abe ngumkakhe.

Waphendula uSolomoni ukumkani, wathi kunkosikazi yakhe: Kungani na ucela uAbhisaga waseShunemi ukuba abe ngunkosikazi ka-Adoniya? Uzofuna naye ubukumkani, ngoba ungudadewethu omkhulu; futhi noAbhiyathari umpristi, noYowabu unyana kaZeruya, bakhona.
Wathi ukumkani uSolomoni: UNkulunkuluβρα جنس, futhi akwenze lokhu nokunye, uma uAdoniya e Sandile lutho ngalesi sifiso sakhe.
Ngokuba iNkosi ungiqinisile ebukhosini bukaDavide ubaba wami, wangisinika indlu yokumkani, njengoba wathi; ngakho-ke, njengokuphila kukaYehova, uAdoniya uzofa namuhla.
Wathi uSolomoni ukumkani wathi kuBhenaya unyana kaYehoyada; yena wabulala uAdoniya, waza wafa.

Wathi ukumkani ku-Abhiyathari umbingeleli, Yiya eAnathothi, ezweni lakho; ngoba wena ungumuntu ofanele ukufa; kodwa namuhla ngeke ngikufane nawe, ngenxa yokuthi wathabatha isikhokelo sikaYehova uThixoubaba wami uDavide, futhi waba nesibopho ngazo zonke izinkinga abe nazo ubaba wami agubha.
USolomoni wasusa uAbhiyathari, ukuze angabi ngumbhishobhi kaYehova, ukufeza amagama kaYehova, ayekhuluma ngawo ngendlu kaEli eShilo.
Wafika uYowabhi, wabaleka waya ekhempini kaYehova, washikama izingulube zesibingelelo; ngoba uYowabhi wayeyilungu lika-Adoniya, kodwa akazange abe yilungu lika-Absalomu.
Batshela uSolomoni ukumkani, bethi, UYowabhi uhambe ekhempini kaYehova, futhi, bona, uhlala eduze kwesibingelelo. Wathumela ke uSolomoni uBhenaya unyana kaYehoyada, esithi, Yiya ugweme.
Wafika uBhenaya esitezi sikaYehova, wathi kuYowabhi: "Kuthe ukumkani, 'Thinakela!'" UYehobha waphendula wathi: "Akekho; ngizofa lapha." Ke yena uBenayahi waya kum DAVID (Full Version)
Wathi ukumkani kuBhenaya, Yenza njengoba esho; ugweme, uyigcine, ukuze kungabikho lutho phakathi kwami nomndeni wakwababa wami ngenxa yegazi elingenacala elibiwe nguYowabha.

UNkulunkulu uzokwenza ukuthi igazi lakhe libuyiselwe kuye; ngoba wahlasela abantu ababi, abangcono kunaye, nabagqugquzeleka kakhulu, wabulala labo bantu ababi, uAbheri unyana kaNeri, umphathi wesizwe samaSirayeli, noAmasa unyana kaYetere, umphathi wesizwe samaYuda, agubha uDavide, ubaba wami.
Igazi labo lihlale kuYowabhi nomndeni wakhe kuze kube sekupheleni; kodwa uDavide, nomndeni wakhe, nendlu yakhe, nesihlalo sakhe, iNkosi unikeze ukuthula kuze kube sekupheleni.
Waphuma uBhenaya, unyanadzi ka-Yehoyada, waivimba uYowabhi, wambulala; wabanjwa ekhaya lakhe, ezweni elimnyama.
Wabeka uBhenaya, unyana kaYehoyada, emkhosini endaweni kaYowabhi; wabeka noTsadoki ukumkani endaweni ka-ebiyathari.
Wathumela ukumkani, wabiza uShimeyi, wathi kuye, Ukwakha ekhaya eYerusalem, uhlale khona; ungaphumanga kuphi naphi.

Wathi uShimeyi kumkakhe, Kulungile lokhu; njengoba utheórni wami ukumkani esho, njalo-ke ngizokwenza umkhonzi wakho. Uszike wahlala eYerusalem iminyaka emide.

Ngonyaka owodwa namashumi amathathu, kwasuka tahalavi ababili eShimeзынга ku-Akishi unyana kaMa snaka, ukumkani waseGathi; futhi babikezela izindaba zakhe, besithi: Akubonakali yini abakhonzi bakho baseGati?
Waphuma uShimeyi, wamisa "wedwakazi" lakhe, waya eGathi ku-Akishi, ukuze akwazi ukubhekana nabakhonzi bakhe; wahamba, waveza abakhonzi bakhe eGathi.
Batshela uSolomoni ukuthi uShimehi usesuka eYerusalem waya eGathi, wabuyela.

Wathumela ukumkani, wabiza uShimeyi, wathi kuye, Angikubekeli wena emthethweni kaYehova? Ngikutshele, ngithi, Ngosuku oluthile lapho uphuma khona uhambe, uzofa ngokuqinisekile. Uthi kuye, Kulungile lokho okushoyo; ngizokwenza.
Ngabe ke, kungani ungamtholanga iNkosi isibopho sakho, nomthetho engiwuwisele kuwe?
Wathi futhi ukumkani kuShimeyi: Uyazi intliziyo yakho konke okubi Kurte wakwenza uDavide, uyise wami; ngakho-ke ngokumanje iNkosi uyakukhokhela iphutha lakho eliphansi.
USolomoni ukumkani uzoba mkhulu, futhi isitulo sikaDavide sizobe siqinile phambi koYehova kuze kube sekupheleni.
Wathi ukumkani kuBhenaya, unyana kaYehoyada; yena waphuma, wabulala uShimehi, waza wafa. Ngalokhu kwaqiniswa ubukumkani ngaphansi kwesandla sikaSolomoni.

USolomoni wahlangana noFaro, ukumkani waseMiziphu, wamnika Agenele, indodana kaFaro, wamfaka edolobhaneni likaDavide, kuze aqedele ukwakha indlu yakhe, nendlu kaYehova, nedonga elijikeleze iYerusalem.
Abantu ke baqhubeka benikela emadolobheni aphezulu, ezindaweni eziphakeme; ngoba ithempeli lalinguNkulunkulu alikade likhiwa.
USolomoni wathanda iNkosi, ehamba ngemithetho kaDavidembur udadewabo uDavide;licishe nje, wanikela ngamadini, wafumisa uvumba ezintabeni Winni.
Wahamba ukumkani waya eGibeoni, ukuze anikela khona; ngoba lapho kwakuyindawo ephezulu kakhulu. USolomoni wanikeza amadini omlilo ayizigidi ezingu-1 kuleyo ndawo yokubhema.
EGibeboni, iNkosi wabonakala kuSolomoni emphupheni ngobusuku; wathi uNkulunkulu, Thola konke ofuna ukuthi ngikunike.

Wathi uSolomoni, Ukwenzele umkhonzi wakho uDavide, ubaba wami, uthando olukhulu neqiniso, njengoba ehamba phambi kwakho ngeqiniso, nobulungisa, nangomphefumulo ophelele; futhi wenza kuye lolu thando olukhulu, wukunikeza indodana ehlala esihlalweni sakhe sobukhosi ngalolu busuku.
Futhi manje, Nkosi uNkulunkulu wami, uFATHILE umkhonzi wakho ukuba abe ngu Kurthi endaweni kaDavide ubaba wam; kodwa ngincane kakhulu, angikwazi ukuhamba.
Ngiyabona umkhonzi wakho ephakathi kwabantu bakho abakhethiwe, isizwe esikhulu kakhulu, abantu bayo abaningi kakhulu.
Ngiyacela, nginike umkhonzi wakho intamo eyaziyo, ukuze ngikwazi ukuphatha abantu bakho, ukuthi ngihlukanise phakathi kokuhle nokubi; ngoba ngubani ongakwazi ukulawula abantu bakho abaningi?
Wathanda iNkosi ukuthi uSolomoni wacela lokhu.

Kodwa-ke, uma unquma ukuthatha isinqumo esifanele ngokuya ngezinto ozifunayo kanye nezidingo zakho, uzokwazi ukufeza imiphumela engcono kakhulu yebhizinisi lakho ngaphandle kokukhathazeka nganoma yimiphi imiba Pensions.
Ngizokwenza lokho okushoyo, ngizokunika inhliziyo ehlakaniphile nokuqondayo. Akubekho umuntu ofana nawe ngaphambilini, futhi ngeke kube khona umuntu ofana nawe emuva kwakho.
futhi ngizokunika nalokho ongakucela wona, kanye nemali, kanye noбіреzo; kuze kube yilapho uhlala khona, ngeke kubekho umbuso ofana nawe.
Uma uhamba ngezinqumo zami, ugcine izimiso zami nemiyalelo yami, njengoba wahamba ngawo uDavide, ubaba wakho, ngizokusindisa usuku lwakho.

Wavuka uSolomoni, wakubona ukuthi kwakuyiphupho; wabuyela eYerusalem, wahlala phambi kwebhokisi lesivumelwano sikaYehova, wanikela ngezipho ezibomvu, nezipho zokuthula, walungiselela isidlo sabaphathi bakhe bonke.
Ngosuku olulodwa, kwafika amadodana amabili owesifazane kukumkani, wahlala phambi kwakhe.
Wathi omunye wabo, Ngicela, Nkosi yami, ngihlala efulethini elifanayo nami nowesifazane lowo; futhi ngakhulelwli ingane lapho wayekhona.
Izinsuku ezintathu ngemuva kokuzalwa kwengane yami, le ndodawirirana nayo yazala inganeлежа. Sihlala ndawonye. Asikho isisebenzi esisha efulethini ngaphandle kwethu.
Ngobusuku unyana wowesifazane washona, ngenxa yokuthi wajika phezu kwawo.
Wavuka ephakathi kwemini, wathatha unyana wami enhliziyweni yami, ngangihlala ngifile; wabeka emlenzeni wakhe, wabeka unyana wayo ofile emlenzeni wami.
Kwathi lapho ngivuka ekuseni ukuze ngidlale unyana wami, ngabona ukuthi ufile. Kodwa lapho ngabhekana naye ngokucophelela emini, ngabona ukuthi akuyena lo mntwana engiwuzalile."

Wathi uwesifazane owodwa, Hayi; yena ophilayo ngunyana wami, futhi lowo oyilete yiwe. ਉਦukazi badla isidlo sakusihlwa, baphuza ikhofi kanye nokudla okunomsoco. Uwo wesifazane wokuqala РСФСР wathi: Hayi!
Wathi ke ukumkani, Omunye wenu uthi: Lo unyana wami ophilayo, futhi lo ndodana yakho obefile; kanti owodwa wathi: Hayi! Usonhlalakahle wena, kodwa lowo mntwana wam.
Wathi ukumkani, Ninikele ikhebula. Bathe ke banikela ubukhosi ngekhebula;
Wathi ukumni, "Qhathanisa umntwana ophilayo ngezintathu, futhi unike inhlamvu eyodwa kwesinye, futhi inhlamvu enye."

Wathi indodakazi yomuntu ophilayo, ngenxa yokuthanda kwakhe unyana wakhe,owoł utilisa ukumkani, ethi, Ngicela, Nkosi yami, ngikulethe yena umntwana ophilayo; ungawubulalanga. Wathi lowesifazane owodwa, Angeke abe wami, noma ube wena; udibanise phakathi!
Wathi ukumkani, "Ninikele indodakazi ephilayo kulowo wesifazane, futhi ningambulala; yena ubaba wakhe."
Wathi wonke amaSirayeli, lapho ezwa khona isinqumo sikakumkani, wamangalisa kakhulu; ngoba bebona ukuthi uNkulunkulu ubemnikeze umcabango wokuphatha.
UMbuso WaseSolomoni wawulawula wonke amaSirayeli.
Lawa abaholi bakhe: uAzariya unyana kaTsadoki, waba ngumpristi.
UElihorefi no-Ahiya, oonyana bakaShisha, babe ngababhali bobukhosi; uJehoshaphat, unyana ka-Ahilodi, waba ngumphathi wezincwadi.
UBhenaya unyana kaYehoyada ube yisikhulu somkhosi, noSadoko noAbhiyathari babe ngabapristi.
U-Azariya unyana kaNathani waba nguMengameli wesifundazwe; noZabhude unyana kaNathani ube ngumpristi, umcebisi omkhulu wombuso.
U-Ahisare wayephethe indlu; u-Adoniram, unyana ka-Abda, waba mkhulu kunabo bonke abantu.
USulaimane wayenezindaweni ezingu-11 zokuphatha phezu kwazo zonke izizwe zaseSirayeli. Banikeza ukudla kwenkosi nomndeni wakhe. Wonke umuntu kufanele ahlinzeke ngokudla kunyanga eyodwa yonyaka.
Lawa amagama abo: uBhe-hu, ezindaweni eziphakeme zaseEphrayi.
uBhe-dekeri, eMakazini, noShaalbim, noBethe-shemeshi, noElon Bethhanani.
uBheneheshedi, e-Arubhothi; futhi iSokho, nezwe lonke laseHefer, kwakunguwe.
u-Abinadabu, ezindaweni eziphakeme zonke zeDori; wayeyindodakazi kaTafati, intombi kaSolomoni.

UBahana unyana ka-Ahilodi, eTaanakhe, naseMegido, naphezu kwazo zonke izifunda zaseBhethe-sheani, eziseduze neSarethani ngezansi kweYizreeli, kusukela eBhethe-sheani kuya ku-Abele-mehola, kuze kube yiJokmeam.

uBhenengebere, eRamoti-gileyadi; izifundazwe zikaYahiri, unyana kaManase, ezinguGileyadi, zabe zikhona kuye, kanye nesifundazwe sikaArgobhe, esiseBhashani, nezifundazwe zayo ezinkulu eziyisishiyagalombili, ezinezindlu zangasese, namabhodlela esiliva emaphethelweni azo.
u-Ahinadabhi, unyana ka-Ido, eMahanayim.
u-Ahimahazi, eNaphtali; wayeyindodana kaBhesemathi, intombi kaSolomoni usizi.
uBahana unyana kaHushai, eAshere naseBealothi.
uJehoshafati unyana kaFaru, e-Issakhareni.
uShimeyi unyana ka-Ela, eBhenjamini.
UGebere unyana kaUri, eGileyadi, izwe likaSihon ukumkani wama-Amori, noOg ukumkani waseBhashani; yena kuphela owayengumphathi wendawo yonke.
Amadodana kaYuda namakhosikazi aseSirayeli ayefana nenhlabathi ethekwini laselwandle ngobukhulu; babedla, bairanje oynaya.

USolomoni waba ngukumkani phezu kwazo zonke izizwe, kusukela emfuleni i-Euphrates, kuya ezweni lamaFilisti, kuze kube yilapho kufike khona umkhawulo waseMisri; banikela umnikelo kuSolomoni, basebenza kuye yonke imihla yakhe.
Umndeni kaSolomoni wawudinga ngosuku olulodwa amakhowe amashumi amathathu esiliva, namakhowe angamashumi ayisishiyagalombili egolide,
ingulube ezingu-10, inkomo engu-20 maximela, nenyamakazi eyizinkulungwane ezimbili, kanye nezilwane zasolwandle, namagagasi, amabhokhwe, nezinhlanzi.
Walawula phezu kwazo zonke izizwe ezisenyakatho yomfula i-Ephrathi, kusukela eTiphasha kuze kube eGaza, phezu kwazo zonke izizwe ezisenyakatho yoMfula; wagcina ukuthula kuwo wonke amacala.
UYuda noIsrayeli bahlala bephephile, kusukela eDan kuze kube eBheri-shebha, imindeni ngayinye ngaphansi kwesihlahla sikaviniga sayo, nangaphansi komnqumo wayo, yonke imihla kaSolomon.
USolomoni wayenamahhashi amashumi amane amawaka emoto yakhe, namabhayisikili ayizigidi eziyisithupha.

Lawa maphethelo esifundazweni ahlinzeka ngokudla uSolomoni, kanye nalabo bonke abadla embhedeni wakhe; wonke umuntu enyangeni yakhe wahlinzeka ngalolu hlobo lokudla. Baqinisekisa ukuthi akukho okulahlekile.
Bafaka futhi i-barley nestraw for the cart horses and the hand horse to the flock of her share pisanka, nga enza wonke umuntu wenza umjovo wakhe.
UThixo wamnika uSolomoni ubuhlakani obukhulu kakhulu, nokuqonda, nengqondo ebanzi njengengcindezi eselwandle.
USolomoni ube nenhlonipho enkulu kunayo yonke inhlonipho yabantu baseMpumalanga, nangaphezulu kwazo zonke iziniranjebe zaseYiputa.
Waba nolwazi ngaphezu kwanoma ubani, ngaphezu kuka-Ethan wase-Ezrahi, ngaphezu kuka-Heman, no-Kalkoli, no-Darda, oonyana bakaMaholi; wathola igama phakathi kwezizwe zonke.
Wakhuluma izinkondlo eziyizigidi ezintathu, wabhala izingoma eziyinkulungwane nesihlanu.

Wakhuluma ngezitshalo, kusukela emthini omkhulu we-allum ONUWE eLi sobiebonini kuze kube yilapho i qoz Quran tänk encane ekhula ngaphandle kwedonga. Wafundisa futhi ngezinyoni, izinhlanzi, izilwane eziphilayo lovela phansi.
Kwafika abantu abavela kuwo wonke amazwekazi, ukuba balalele ubuhlakani bukaSolomoni; kwabařa bonke amakhosi ehlabathini, laba kwaziwa ubuhlakani bakhe.
UHirame, ukumkani waseTire, wayemthanda uDavide nsuku zonke. Ke kaloku, lapho ekubona ukuthi uSolomoni ubewe ngukumkani endaweni yobaba wakhe, wathumela abaphathi bakhe kuSolomoni.
uSolomoni wathumela lo myalezo emuva kuHiram:

Uyazi ukuthi uDavide, ubaba wami, akakwazanga ukukwakha indlu igama likaYehova uNkulunkulu wakhe, ngenxa yokulwa kwakhe nezitha zakhe ezingokwesobunxele, kuze kube yilapho iNkosi ewazibeka ngaphansi kwezinyawo zakhe.
Kodwa manje iNkosi, uNkulunkulu wami, unginikeza isikhala ngaso sonke isikhathi; akukho umfowabo, futhi akukho buhlungu.

Ngabona ukuthi ngicabanga ukwakha indlu igama leNkosi, uNkulunkulu wami; njengokuthi iNkosi wathi kuDavide ubaba wam: Unyana wakho ozobeka endaweni yakho emgodini wobukhosi bakho, yena uzokwakha indlu igama lami.

Ngiyakucela, uvumele ukuthi kuqhutshekwe imithi yama-kedar eLibanoni; futhi labo abasebenza nami bazosebenza nalabo abasebenzela wena; futhi ngizonikeza labo abasebenzela wena noma yini ongayisho; ngoba uyazi ukuthi asikwazi ukuvuna izihlahla njengabaSidoni.
UHirame, lapho ezwa amazwi kaSolomoni, wavuya aranwa kakhulu, wathi, Kubhekwe iNkosi namuhla, ngoba ebemnike uDavide umntwana owaziyo phezu kwalesi sizwe esikhulu.
UHirame waphendula uSolomoni, wathi, Kuthe kwafika kuye konke okuthunyelwe kimi; ngizokwenza yonke into oyifunayo ngokhuni lwesiqalo, nokhuni lwezinkomo.

Abasebenzi bami bazowakhuphula eLibanoni kuya emfuleni, futhi ngizowabeka eziqhingini, ngizowasusa emfuleni, kuze kube yilapho ukhetha khona; laphonjani ngizozihlukanisa khona, nawe uzoziqoqa; futhi wena uzongizwa ngalokho engikufunayo, ukunika ukudla imindeni yami.
UHirame wanikela kuSolomoni izihlahla zesedari nezihlahla ze-cypress, ngazo zonke izinto afunayo.

USolomoni wamnika uHirame amakore ayishumi nesishiyagalombili asendaweni yengulube, ukuze abe yindawo yokudla emndenini wakhe, namakore ayisishiyagalombili amafutha omnqumo. Lo msebenzi uSolomoni wawenza uHirame ngonyaka ngamunye.
