Uthi, "Kulungile, uNkosi, ngikucela ukuthi uphendule izithandazo zomkhonzi wakho nomphakathi wakho waseSirayeli, lapho bethandaza kulesi siqhingi; uphendule ezulu, endaweni yokuhlala kwakho, uphendule, ukhulule.
Uma umuntu ekhohlisa umngane wakhe, futhi ephoqwa ukuba aphe Bakucela ukuthi aphike, bese efika ephuza isipho phambi kwesiqokobhe sakho kulo ndlu;
khona-ke, lalela ezulu, ukwenze, ugweme phakathi kwabakhonzi bakho; ugweme owinile ngokufanele kwakhe, futhi ugweme ongawinili ngokufanele kwakhe.
Uma abantu bakho isiSirayeli behlaselwa phambi komshado wabo, ngenxa yobubi babo kuwe, bese bebuyela kuwe, beveza igama lakho, bethandaza, becela usizo kulowo ndlu;
usazise emazulu, ukhulule isono sabantu bakho baseSirayeli, ubabuyisele ezweni olinikeze abababa babo.
Uma isibhakabhaka sivalwe, kungasekho imvula, ngenxa yokuthi abantu bakho babusile kuwe; uma bethandaza ngaleso sifundazweni, beveza igama lakho, bese bebuyela emthethweni wabo, sithi, uma ubababula,

usazise emazulwini, ukhulule isono samakhonzi akho nabantu bakho baseSirayeli, ubafundise indlela efanele yokuyihamba, futhi unciphise umswakama phezu kwezwe olinikeze abantu bakho ukuba libe yindawo yabo.
Detaljerne er en kort oversigt over de vigtigste seværdigheder og højdepunkter, så skal du gå videre til næste trin. Derefter følger den korte vejledningen, som fører dig direkte til dit hotel.
noma yimuphi umuntu, wonke abantu bakho isiSirayeli, uma ethandaza, uma ecela usizo, ngaso sonke isikhathi lapho eqonda khona inkanuko yenhliziyo yakhe, futhi efaka izandla zakhe kule ndlu;

khona-ke ulalele emazulwini, endawo yakho yokuhlala, ukhulule futhi wenze; enze wonke umuntu ngokuya ngalokho akwenzayo, njengoba uyazi inhliziyo yakhe; ngoba wena kuphela owazi inhliziyo yabantu bonke.
Bazokuhlonipha wena yonke imihla abaphila ngayo phezu kwezwe olibanikileyo ababa bethu.
Naphezu kwalokho, noma ngabe isizwe esingaphandle, esingasekho ezweni lakho iSirayeli, sizofika eduze ngenxa yegama lakho.
Bazokhuluma ngegama lakho elikhulu, nesandla sakho esinamandla, nomlenze wakho oqinile; uma befika bathandaza kulesi ndlu:

khona-ke ulalele ezulu, endaweni yokuhlala kwakho, wenze konke okuzokubiza ngawo lo mngane wakho; ukuze zonke izizwe zezulu zikwazi igama lakho, zibe nokuthula nawe, njengabantu bakho isiSirayeli; futhi bayazi ukuthi igama lakho libizwa ngalo indlu yami engiyenze.
Uma abantu bakho bephuma emkhosini babhekane nabaphikisi babo, ngaso sonke isikhathi lapho uwathumela khona, bese bethandaza kuYehova bebheke lo mzi owazikhethele wona, nendlu engiyise igama lakho;
khona-ke ulalele umthandazo wabo kanye nezingcezu zabo ezulu, futhi ubasize banqobe icala labo.
Uma bekwenza isono kuwe, (njengoba akukho muntu ongeke akwenzele isono), futhi uphoxeke kubo, wabanikela ebusweni bezi televizoru zabo, ukuze bathathe abacwaningi babo babe yimindeni yabo;
bese bebuyela ezandleni zabo ezweni lapho bathunyelwe khona, bese bebuya becela usizo kuwe khona, bethi, Sithole isono, sakwenza okubi, sasebenza ngokungemthetho;

uma bebuyela kuwe ngenhliziyo yabo yonke, nangomphefumulo wabo wonke, ezweni lalabo ababoshwa kulo, bese bethandaza kulowo hlangothi lwezwe lakho, owalinika ababuphikisi babo, nedolobha elikhethiwe, nendlu engiyinile igama lakho;
khona-ke ulalele ukuthandaza kwabo nokucela kwabo ezulu, lapho uhlala khona, futhi ubasize banqobe icala labo.
Uzoyisabalalisa abantu bakho abaye bakwenza okubi kuwe, uzobasusa bonke ubugebengu babo. Uzoyisabalalisa labo abawathathayo, ukuze babe nenhlonipho kuwe.
Bakho abantu bakho na bieni lakho, owabakhipha eYiputa, phakathi kwe aplikacij SABI..
Lapha amehlo akho azobe evulekile emithandazelweni yomkhonzi wakho, nasen nadumeni lwakho laseSirayeli, ukuwalalela ngaso sonke isikhathi lapho bekhuluma kuwe.

ngoba wena uwazikhethela ukuba babe impahla yakho, phakathi kwazo zonke izizwe zomhlaba, njengoba uthe ngesandla sakho umkhonzi wakho uMoses, lapho wakhipha khona obaba bethu eYiputa, Nkosi yethu iNkosi.

Kwathi lapho uSolomone eqedile ukuthandaza lo mthandazo wonke, nokwenza lezi zicelo kuYehova, wahlala phambi kwesihlalo somlilo sikaYehova, lapho wayekade ehleli khona emgodini wakhe, ngezandla zakhe ezingcolisa phezu kwesibhakabhaka.
Wahlala khona, wabasabisa bonke ibandla lakwaSirayeli, wathi ngezwi elikhulu:

Ngiyabonga iNkosi, ngenxa yokuthi wanikeza isikhala abantu bakhe baseSirayeli, njengoba esho; akukho igama elilodwa elaliphazamiseka phakathi kwazo zonke izindaba ezinhle awazenzile ngoMosesi umkhonzi wakhe.
UYehova, uNkulunkulu wethu, abe nathi, njengokuba ube nabantu bethu bokuqala; asikushiyenga, asikushiye.
Uphinde alungise inhliziyo yethu kuye, ukuze sihambe zonke izindlela zakhe, Bakugcine izimiso zakhe, namalungiselelo akhe, nezibopho zakhe, awawisela amadodana ethu.
Lezo zinto ngizibiza ngazo kukaNkulunkulu, zihlale eduze kukaYehova uNkulunkulu wethu ekuseni nakusihlwa, ukuze asize umkhonzi wakhe nomphakathi wakhe waseSirayeli, ngokwezidingo zansuku zonke.
Futhi kuzozi zonke izizwe zezulu ukuthi iNkosi nguye uNkulunkulu, akukho omunye.
Ngiyakucela ke, ukuthi nihlaledzile iNkosi uNkulunkulu wethu, nihambe ngezimiso zakhe, nigcine amalungiselelo akhe, njengamanje.
Wathi ukumkani, naye wonke amaSirayeli naye, wanikela ngenhlanhla kuYehova.
USolomoni wanikela izipho zokuthula kuYehova, izinkomo ezingu-22, nezimvu eziyinkulungwane neshumi nambili. Ngaleyo ndlela ukumkani kanye nabo bonke abantu bakaSirayeli bamisa indlu kaNkulunkulu.

Ngomhla owodwa lowo ukumkani wamisa indawo ephakathi kwendlu yangasese, eyayingaphambili kwendlu kaYehova; ngoba khona lapho wanikela khona ngezipho ezibomvu, nezipho zokudla, nenyama yezi iminikelo yokuthula; ngoba isibingelelo sesiliva esibhekene noNkulunkulu sabancane ngokwanele ukuthi sikwazi ukuzifaka.

Wakwenza njalo uSolomoni, naye wonke amaSirayeli naye, ibandla elikhulu kakhulu, lavela lapho kufike khona iHamati enyakatho, nalapho kufike khona umfula waseMisri entshonalanga; bakwenza njalo phambi koYehova uNkulunkulu wethu izinyanga ezisixhenxe, nezinsuku eziyisixhenxe, nsuku ezilishumi elinane.

Ngosuku olulandelayo, uSolomoni washiya abantu besuka ezindaweni zabo. Babhikelela ukumkani, babuyela ezindlini zabo, bevumile, bevumile ngenhliziyo yabo, ngenxa yobulungisa bonke obewenzayo iNkosi kumkhonzi wakhe uDavide, nakwaSirayeli abantu bakhe.
USolomoni ke waqedela ukwakha indlu kaYehova, nendlu yobukhosi; futhi konke okuzofuna ukukwenza uSolomoni, akwenzela.
Wabonakala iNkosi kuSolomoni kathathu, njengokuba wabonakala kuye eGibheyoni.

Wathi iNkosi kuye, Ngikuphendulile ukuthandaza kwakho, nokucela kwakho ngami; ngiyingcwelele le ndlu oyenzayo, ukuze ngibeke khona igama lami kuze kube sekupheleni; amehlo ami nezinhliziyo zami zizohlala khona njalo.
Futhi wena, uma uhamba phambi kwami, njengokuba wahamba ngawo uDavide, ubaba wakho, ngenhliziyo ecacile, wenze okulungile, wenze konke engikushoyo, ugcine izimiso zami nemithetho yami;
ngizoqinisa isikhala sakho sobukhosi phezu kwaSirayeli kuze kube sekupheleni, njengokuthi ngasho kuDavide ubaba wakho, esithi, Uzoba nendodana ehlala esihlalweni sobukhosi sakwaSirayeli.
Uma ke, wena noma izingane zakho, nisuka engangilandelani, ningagcinanga imiyalo yami nemithetho yami engibeka phambi kwenu, kodwa niya kukhonza izitha zakwamanye amazwe, nizibophezele kuzo;
ngizowususa uSirayeli ezweni enihlelwe lona; futhi indlu le, engiyingcwelele igama lami, ngiyoyishiya. USirayeli uzoba yizinkolelo-binkolelo nezimanga phakathi kwamazwe onke.
Ngokuba le ndlu ikhulu kakhulu, wonke umuntu odlula kuyo uzokhathazeka, futhi uzophuza utshwala; futhi bazothi, Kungani na ukuthi iNkosi akwenze lokhu kule ndawo nele ndlu?

Bazophendula bathi, Ngenxa yokuthi bashiye iNkosi uNkulunkulu wabo, owakhipha obaba babo ezweni laseYiputa, bethwala izitha zakwamanye amazwe, babezibophezela kuzo, bezikhonza; yingakho iNkosi wazisa phezu kwabo konke okubi.
Wathatha uSolomoni iminyaka eyishumi nesishiyagalombili ukukwakha lezi zindawo ezimbili, indlu kaYehova nendlu yobukhosi.

UHiramu ukumkani waseTire wayemnika uSolomoni izihlahla zesiqalo, nezihlahla zezinkomo, negolide, njengoba efuna. Wathi uSolomoni ukumkani wamnika uHiramu izindawo eziyishumi nambili ezweni laseGaliliya.
UHirame waphuma eTire, ukuze abone amadolobhana aSolomoni ayemnikezile; kodwa awathandanga.
Wathi, "Udade wami, yini uhlobo izifunda ukuthi usinikele?" Ngakho wabiza leyo ndawo Land of Kabul, okungukuthi, enhle ngalutho, futhi kulokhu ibizwa ngokuthi namuhla.
UHirame wathumela ukumkani italente elilodwa neshumi nambili legolide, elingamashumi amabili namathani.
Lokho wumlando womsebenzi owenziwe nguSolomoni ukumkani, lapho ekwakha khona indlu kaYehova, nendlu yakhe, neMilo, nodonga lweYerusalem, namadolobhana aseHazori, neMegido, neGezeri.
UFaro, ukumkani waseYiputa, wahlasela uGezere, wawuthatha, wawucima, wabulala abaKanani abahlala khona, wanikela lo mzi njengesipho somtshali-zimali kunkosikazi kaSolomoni, intombi yakhe.
USolomoni wakwakha iGezere, futhi wakwakha iBetho-horoni ephansi,
noBahalathi, noThamari, ezweni lakhe elisha.

Wakwakha namadolobha onke amagatsha akhe, namadolobhane emoto yakhe, namadolobhana ebhayisikili lakhe; futhi konke okwenze wafuna ukukwenza eYerusalem, naseLibanoni, kanye nezwe lonke elingaphansi kombuso wakhe.
Kwabe sekusele abantu abase-A Indikwi, namaHethi, namaPerizi apparte,somisiwe, namaJebhusi; kodwa labo bantumalienga kwabaSijuša.
Babe yimindeni yamazwe amaSirayeli angeke akwazi ukuwabulala ngokuphelele. USolomoni wabacindezela ukuba basebenze njengezihlwele, futhi namanje namuhla.

KwabeSirayeli ke, uSolomoni akazange abeke wonke umuntu emkhondweni wakhe; bebengamadodana akhe, nabaphathi bakhe, nabangane bakhe, nabahlengikazi bakhe, nabagqugquzeli bezimoto zakhe, namabhayisikili.
Kwabaošanasi bomsebenzi kaSolomoni, abangamakhulu amahlanu namashumi mahlanu, abaqondisa abantu abasebenza nemisebenzi.
USolomoni wakwakha iMilo, ngemuva kokuba inkosikazi kaFaro yasuka edolobhaneni likaDavide iye emzini owawuyindlu yakhe.

USolomoni wanikela ngamadini omlilo, namaallum ONUKA, izikhathi sobiethathu ngonyaka, esitezi esi qoz Quran tänko, ebesiwukwakha iNkosi; wakhipha futhi umnqumo phambi kukaNkulunkulu. Waqedela ke indlu definitely.
USolomoni ukumkani wenza futhi izinqanawa e-Eziongebere, eduze kwe-Elath, enkabeni ye Produk, endaweni yaseEdom.
UHirame wathumela abantu bakhe, abahamba ngezinqanawa, abakwaziyo ilwandle, ukuba basebenze ezindaweni zokuhamba ngesikebhe nabangani bakaSolomoni.
Bahambaošanasa e-Ofiri, babuya bethwala uSolomoni italente zegolide ezingumakhulu mahlanu namashumi amabini.
Wathi unkosikazi waseShebha, lapho ezwa ukuthi uSolomoni use Bakube mkhulu ngenxa yegama likaYehova, wafika waya kumhlola ngezinto ezinzima.

ke wafika eYerusalem, nomphakathi omkhulu kakhulu, nama-apile aphathe izithako eziphuzayo, negolide eliningi kakhulu, namatshe abalulekile. Wa isina uSolomoni, wakhuluma naye ngazo zonke izinto ezikhona engqondweni sáto.
USolomoni waphendula yonke imibuzo yakhe; akukho lutho olukude kakhulu emkhosini, angeke amcacise.
Unkosikazi waseShebha, lapho ebona ukuthi uSolomoni unengqondo, wabheka indlu yakhe ayenze,

futhi ukudla kwetafula lakhe, nokuhlala kwabaphathi bakhe, nabangane bakhe abagqoke izicathulo zabo, nabagibeli bakhe, nezipho zakhe ezibomvu azenzayo ethempelini likaYehova; walahlekelwa yinhliziyo yakhe.
Wathi kuye ukumkani, Kulungile konke ongingakutshela ngaye ezweni lami ngezinto zakho, nekhono lakho.

Angikaze ngiyikholwa le nto, kuze ngifike ngiyibone ngamehlo ami; futhi ngabona ukuthi iningi layo alikabikho lithiwe kimi; kodwa ubuhlakani bakho nezimali zakho zikhulu kakhulu kunazo zonke izindaba engizazi.
Kuhle kakhulu abantu bakho! Kuhle kakhulu labo abaphathi, abahlala njalo phambi kwakho, belalela ubuhlakani bakho!

Ngiyabonga kuYehova uNkulunkulu wakho, ngoba ethandana nawe, ukuthi akubeke phezu kwesitulo sakwaSirayeli; ngenxa yokuthi iNkosi uthanda amaSirayeli kuze kube sekuphele isikhathi eside, wakwenza wena ukumkani, ukuze wenze isinqumo nomthetho.

Wanikeza ukumkani italente elilodwa neshumi nambili zegolide, namalitha ayisikhombisa amafutha omnqumo, nezinye izinto eziwusizo eziningi kakhulu, namatshe amahle. Akukho othile owanikela ngezinto eziwusizo ezifana nalezo urapekazi waseSheba awanikeze ukumkani uSolomoni.
Iinqanawa zikaHirame, ezithwala igolide kusuka e-Ofiri, zazithwala nemithi ye-almug claro, namatshe amahle kakhulu kusuka e-Ofiri.
Le ntokazi yasebenzisa i-almug wood ukwenza ama-railinges ethempelini lenkosi kanye nepalazi elisemthethweni, kanye nokwenza ama-harps nama-lyres ahlotshaniswa nomculo.
USolomoni ukumkani wamnika unkosikazi wase-Shebha konke okufunayo, yonke into ayeyifunayo, ngaphandle kwazo zonke izinto akazange azinikeze; wabuyela ezweni lakhe yena nomndeni wakhe.
Wonke unyaka kwafika kuSolomoni italente legolide elinamakhulu ayisishiyagalolunye, namashumi amathandathu anesithandathu.
dan, - ser ni umo...rettento de cada um!- esquema a seguir na sua vida.
U Thyošanase wakwenza amagilavu amakhulu ayizinkulungwane ezimbili, egolide elitsheni elihlanganisiwe; amashekeli ayikhulu nesishiyagalombili wegolide kwafakwa kumagilavu asinawo.

Wakwenza futhi izigqoko ezincane ezingumakhulu amathathu, ezenziwe ngegolide elihlanganisiwe; ngayinye yazo isisindo sayo saba ngama-mines amathathu egolide, amashumi amahlanu amakhilogremu. Wazibeka emzini wemithi yaseLibanoni.
Wakwenza ukumkani isibhedlela esikhulu segolide, wasiza ngegolide elihle.

Isikhundla sayo sinezinhlangothi eziyisishiyagalombili, futhi icala laso linezingxenye ezimbili ezijikelezayo. Kwaba khona izinyawo ezihamba ngakwesobunxele nakwesokudla kwesihlalo; kwabe kukhona ingulube ehlala eduze kwezinyawo zonke.
Kwabekho izimvu ezingu-12 zahlala emadolobhe maxime, ngayinye engxenyeni yazo zonke izinyathelo. Akukho lutho olufana nalo lwakhiwa kulo lonke elaseMpumalanga.

Wonke umbhoshongo wokudla kaSolomoni waba ngugolide, futhi zonke izitsha zendlu yomlilo waseLibanone zaba ngugolide oluhlanzekile; akukho lutho okwenziwa ngesiliva, ngoba isiliva lathathwa njengento encane ngesikhathi sikaSolomoni.
Kwabekho izikebhe zokuhweba zakumkakhe elwandle, nazo zonke izikebhe zikaHirame; ngonyaka owodwa-ke kwabuya izikebhe, zithwale igolide, nesilivere, nezinkomo, nezingulube, namapheya.
USolomoni ukumkani waba mkhulu kunabo bonke abaphathi bomhlaba, ngemali nolwazi.
Abantu abavela kuwo wonke umhlaba bafuna ukuvakashela uSolomoni ukuze babone ubuhlakani obubeka uNkulunkulu enhliziyweni yakhe.
Kusukela ngonyaka kuya kunyaka, bonke abafikayo beletha izipho zabo: izinto zesiliva ne阐金, nama strove, žale kakhulu; futhitoodwe, nezikhali nakanjani Hafi.
USolomoni waqoqa izimoto zokugibela, namabhayisikili; waba nezigidi ezingu-1 zezimoto zogibela, namahhashi ayishumi nanhlanu amawaka. Wabeka abanye emizini yezimoto zakhe, nabanye naye eYerusalem.
Wakwenza ukuthi isiliva libe likhulu eYerusalem njengamatshe, futhi izikebhe zibe likhulu njengezihlahla zezinkomo ezisenyakatho.
Namahhashi kaSolomoni ayethuthwa eYiputa; abahwebi bakakumkani babewathenga ngamakhowe, amakhowe ngamanani.

futhi imoto ngayinye esuka eYiputa yathengwa ngeshekeli elinamakhulu ayisishiyagalombili, nenja ngayinye ngeshekeli elinamakhulu amane namashumi amahlanu. Nabo bonke abanikazi bamaHithi, nabanikazi base-Aram, bathenga kubo.
USolomoni ukumkani wathanda izifazane eziningi zakwamanye amazwe, ngaphandle kwendodana kaFaro; kwabekho nabesifazane baseMowabhi, nama-Ammonita, nama-Edomita, namaSidonita, namaHethiti.

Bavela emazweni amanye, lapho iNkosi abewisela khona amaSirayeli, wathi, "Ungaba nowesifazane phakathi kwabo, futhi bangaba nowesifazane phakathi kwenu; ngoba uma bekwenza njalo, inhliziyo yenu izoguquka ibe yimithandazo yabo." USolomoni, ke, waba nezingane ezinjalo.
Wabe namadodakazi angamakhulu asixhenxe, abezinkosikazi, namabhishobhi angamakhulu amathathu; amakhosikazi akhe awashintshile intamo yakhe.

Kwathi lapho uSolomone eneminyaka emikhulu, izifazane zakhe zashintsha inhliziyweni yakhe ilandele amanye amadini; futhi inhliziyweni yakhe ayizange iphele ngokugcwele kuYehova uNkulunkulu wakhe, njengokuba inhliziyweni kaDavide ubaba wakhe.
USolomoni walandela i-Ashtoreth, indodana kaThixo yamaSidoni, noMilkom, isidalwa esibi sama-Amoni.
Wakwenza uSolomoni okubi emehloni kaYehova, akawutholanga ngokuphelele umsebenzi kaYehova, njengokuthi uDavide, ubaba wakhe, wawutholele.
Ngaleso sikhathi uSolomoni wakwakha indawo ephakeme kaKemoshi, igugu lakwaMowabi, emfuleni obhekene neYerusalem; walungisa futhi uMoloki, igugu lakwaAmoni.
Wakwenza njalo namadodakazi akhe wonke angaphandle, abephuza uvumba, abenikela izipho ezingcwele zabo.
UYehova wagwema uSolomoni, ngenxa yokuthi intliziyo yakhe yasuka Bakubonile iNkosi, uNkulunkulu kaSirayeli, owabonakala kuye izikhathi ezimbili.
UNkulunkulu wayemwisele uSolomoni ngento leyo,ethambur uMoya oNgcwele,licisheile uSolomoni, wathi: "Uzolandela imithandazo ya Winni." Kodwa uSolomonifhi akazange alandele imithetho kaYehova.
Wathi iNkosi kuSolomoni, Ngokuba kwenzeka lokhu kuwe, futhi awugcinenga umnqophiso wami nomthetho wami engiwiselayo kuwe, ngizokunquma ubukhosi bakho, ngibunike kumkhonzi msebenzi wakho.
Kodwa-ke, ngenxa kaDavide ubaba wakho, ngeke ngikwenze ngalo lonke isikhathi sokuphila kwakho; esandlani somntwana wakho ngizoyisusa.
Kodwa-ke, ngeke ngiyiphuze ibukhosi bonke; ngizonikeza unyana wakho isizwe esisodwa, ngenxa yomkhonzi wami uDavide, futhi ngenxa yeJerusalema engikhethile lona.
UNkulunkulu wavusa umfowabo uSolomoni, uHadade waseEdomu, osuka emndenini wakwabukhosi baseEdomu.
ke lapho uDavide ehlasela khona iEdommburwa, waphuma uYowabhi, umphathi womkhosi, ukuba afake abafileyo, wabulala Winni bonke amadodana ase-Edom.
Wahlala khona uYowabha, naye wonke amaSirayeli, izinyanga ezinhlanu, kuze apheleze bonke amadodana aseEdom.
UHadade wabaleka waya eYiputa, naye nabangani bakhe abathile baseEdomi, ababesebenza kuyise; uHadade ke wayeneminyaka encane.

Wathi uAhabhi kuEliya, "Ungithola kanjani, nkosikazi yami?" UEliya waphendula wathi, "Ngikuthola; ngoba sewuthengise umzimba wakho ukuze wenze okubi emehloni kaYehova.
Uthi iNkosi: "Njengoba ngi taha جنس, ngazo zonke iziilibhi zomndeni kaAhabhi ezweni isoka kanye nomuntu ophilayo emhlabeni wonke,
futhi ngizokwenza indlu yakho ibe njengendlu kaYarobhoamu unyana kaNabati, nendlu kaBhasha unyana ka-Ahiya; ngenxa yokuthi ungisizise, wakwenza isiSirayeli sigweme.
Futhi nge-Yezebeli, kusho iNkosi, Izinyoni zizodla i-Yezebeli esitezi se-Jezreeli.
Okufa edolobhaneni lakwa-Ahabhi uzodla izinja, futhi okufa emhlabathini uzodla izinhlanzi."
Akubekho umuntu ofana noAhabhidzi, owathengisa yena ukuba akwenzeivimbi emehlo kaYehova, ngenxa yowesifazane wakhe uYezebeli.
Wakwenza izinto ezibuhlungu, wakhonza amatshe, ngokufana nalokho ababekwenza Kurti, abantu iNkosi abewasusa phambi kwabaSirayeli.
Kwathi lapho uAhabhi ekhuluma ngalolu cingo, waxosha izigqoko zakhe, wagqoka igxathu negxathu, wahamba engadli ukudla; wahlala egxathu negxathu, wahamba ngesandla sakhe.
Ke kaloku kwafika igama likaYehova kuEliya waseTishbi, lithi,

Ubone ukuthi uAhabhi wanyamalala phambi kwami? Ngenxa yokuthi wanyamalala, ngeke ngikulethe lesi simo esibi ngesikhathi sakhe sokuphila; ezikhathini zowesifazane wakhe ngizolilethela phezu kwendlu yakhe.
Ngeminyaka emithathu kwakungekho umkhosi phakathi kweSyria ne-Israel.
Ngonyaka wesithathu, uJehoshaphat, ukumkani wakwaYuda, wehla ebhekane nokumkani wakwaSirayeli.
Wathi ukumkani wakwaSirayeli kwabakhonzi bakhe, Niyazi ukuthi iRamoti-gileyadi yiyo yethu; kungani ke sihlala singenalutho ukuze siyibuyisele emkhosini waseSiriya?

Wathi kuJehoshaphat: Uzohamba nami ukubhekana no Ramoth-gileyadi? Waphendula uJehoshaphat ukumkani wakwaSirayeli, wathi: Ngizohlala nawe yonke indlela; abantu bami njengasabantu bakho, namabhayisikili ami ngamabhayisikili akho;
Wathi futhi uJehoshaphat kukumkani wakwaSirayeli, Ngisho manje, ngicela, buza iNkosi.

Wathi ukumkani wakwaSirayeli, eqoqa abaprofeti, abantu abangamakhulu amane, wathi kubo, Ngiya emkhosini eRamoti-gileyadi, noma ngiyibeke phansi? Baphendula bathi, Yiya; ngoba iNkosi uzowanikela engcupheni yobukhosi.
Wathi ke uJehoshafati, Ingabe akukho lapha umprofeti kaYehova ukuze siwubuze?

Waphendula ukumkani wakwaSirayeli, wathi ku-Jehoshaphat: "Kukhona umuntu owodwa ongeke siwubuze iNkosi ngaye; kodwa ngimthanda, ngoba akusho lutho oluhle ngami, kodwa lutho olubi: nguMikaya unyana ka-Imla." U-Jehoshaphat wathi: "Akufanele umkakhe akhulume njalo."
Wathi ukumkani wakwaSirayeli, ebiza omunye wabaphathi bakhe, wathi, Thola ngokushesha uMikaye unyana ka-Imla.

Ubukhosi baseSirayeli, noJehoshaphatsi ukumkani wakwaYuda, begqoke izicathulo zabo zobukhosi, behlala ezindaweni zabo eziphakeme, ngaphesheya komgwaqo waseSamariya; futhi bonke abaprofeti bekhuluma ngezulu phambi kwabo.
UZedekiya, unyana kaKenanaha, ubewenza amabhodlela ensimbi, wathi, Uthi lokho iNkosi: Ngawo la mabhodlela uzodlidliza aSirayeli, kuze baphele.
Bathi nabo bonke abaprofeti ngalolu lutholo, besithi: "ENgwayelele eRasethi-gileadi pisanisa; ngobamedu iNkosi uzoyinikela emkhonweni woiye."
Wathi kuye umthunywa odlule ukubiza uMikhaya, Thola ukuthi bonke abaprofeti bakhuluma ngezwi elilodwa, besho okubi ukumkani; ngikucela, sithi ilizwi lakho lifanane nabo, bese ukhuluma ngokubi.
Wathi uMikaya, Uphila iNkosi ukuthi ngizokhuluma lokho okushoyo iNkosi.

Wafika kuye ukumkani, wambuza ukumkani wathi: "Mikhaya, kufanele sihambe eRamoti-gileyadi ukubhekana nokulwa, noma televizora?" UMika waphendula wathi: "Hamba uphumelele; ngoba uNkulunkulu uzoyišola emkhosini."
Wathi ukumkani kuye, Ingabe ngizokubiza ngamazwi aphikisayo, ukuthi ungamitshela lutho ngaphandle kweqiniso ngegama likaYehova?

Wathi uMika, Ngabona bonke isiSirayeli besakazeka emadolobheni amakhulu, njengamakhoboka angeke abe nomnikazi; futhi iNkosi wathi, Leyo ndoda ayinakho umphathi; ahambe wonke umuntu ekhaya lakhe ngoxolo.
Wathi ukumkani wakwaSirayeli kuYehoshafati, Angikushonga yini kuwe ukuthi akakhuluma ngami lutho oluhle, kodwa okubi?
Wathi uMika, Yiqiniso, lalela ilizwi likaYehova: Ngibona iNkosi ehlala esihlalweni sakhe sobukhosi, namadodana onke omhlaba abhekene naye ngakwesokudla kwakhe nokwesobunxele kwakhe.
Wathi iNkosi, Nguwubani ozoba nomsindo kuAhabhi ukuba ahambe eRamoti-Gileyadi, ukuze afe khona? Omunye wathi luthosziki, omunye wathi olunye.
Ke kaloku kwaphuma umphefumulo, wahlala phambi koYehova, wathi, Ngizowukhohlisa.
Wathi iNkosi, Ngabe yini? UMoya wathi, Ngizophuma ngibe ngumphefumulo weqiniso emlonyeni wabaprofeti bakhe bonke. Wathi iNkosi, Uzowukhohlisa, futhi uzophumelela; iya, yenza.
Ngakho-ke manje, iNkosi wabeka umphefumulo okhohlisayo phakathi kwalabo bonke aba Rusizi bakho. Untetho kaMoya oyiNgcwele ithi: "INkosi ifuna ukubazva."
UZedekiya unyana ka-Kenanaha wafika, wehlisa umlomo wakhe emlonyeni kaMikhaya, wathi: Ngayiphi indlela edlula ngayo umoya woNkulunkulu ngami ukukhuluma nawe?
Wathi uMikaye, Uzokwazi ngalolu busuku lapho uzama ukufihla egumbini elingaphakathi.
Wathi ukumkani wakwaSirayeli, Thola uMikaya, uyithumelele kuAmoni umphathi wedolobha, noYo Produkгесo owesifazane.
Nithi, Lokho kusho ukumkani: Beka lo muntu ezindaweni zokugcina izinto Bakunikeze ukudla okuncane namanzi ambalwa kuze ngibuye ngempilo.
Wathi uMikhaya, "Uma usubuya ngokunewirirana, khona-ke scart: UNkulunkulu akakhuluma * ngami." Aphinde wathi, "Hlathini lokhu, bonke abantu!
Baye ke ukumkani wakwaSirayeli, noJehoshafati ukumkani wakwaYuda, beya eRamoti-gileadi.

Wathi ukumkani wakwaSirayeli kuYehoshafati, Ngizoshintsha isithombe sami, ngiye emidlalweni; kodwa wena ugqoke izicathulo zakho. Uthe ke ukumkani wakwaSirayeli washintsha isithombe sakhe, waya emdlalweni.
U Thyošanas, ukumkani waseSiriya, wabatshela abaphathi bezimoto zakhe, ukuthi: Ungadlalwa nomuntu oncane noma omkhulu, ngaphandle kukakumkani wakwaSirayeli.
Bathe abaphathi bezimoto bebona uJehoshafati, bathi, "Kuyinto yena ukumkani wakwaSirayeli!" Baphinde babhekana naye; kodwa uJehoshafati wavuma.
Kwathi lapho abaphathi bezimoto bebona ukuthi akayena ukumkani wakwaSirayeli, babuyela emuva.

Nokho omunye umuntu washaya umcibisholo ngaphandle kokusukela, wehlisa ukumkani waseSirayeli phakathi kwempahla yakhe yokulwa. Wathi uūri kulowo ophethe isithunywa sakhe: "Buyisela emuva, ngisuse em zaini; ngoba sengilahlekile."
Impi yaqhubeka yonke imihla. Ubukhosi babeka isibhamu sawo esibhekene nabase-Aram, wafa ngaleso sikhathi; futhi ugazi olusuka emlonyeni wakhe lwawela phezu komhlaba wesibhamu.
Uma ilanga liphuma, kwafika umdzibaniso phakathi komkhosi, beiasondeza ukuthi: "Umuntu ngamnye abuye edolobhaneni lakhe; umuntu ngamnye abuye ezweni lakhe!"
Wafa ke ukumkani, wathunyelwa eSamariya, wazalelwa khona.
Bahlanza imoto yakhe eභාවni laseSamari,wirirake amakati اماتлежа ubisi lwakhe; futhi Amadodakazi ageza khona, njengokuthi kaYehova.
Okunye konke okwenze uAhabhi, nezinto zonke azenzayo, kanye nendlu yezinkomo ayeyenzayo, namadolobha akhe onke ayewenzayo, akubona bonke babhalwe encwadini yamaqiniso wamabukhosi bamaSirayeli?
Wafa uAhabhi, waba ngukumkani uAhaziya unyana wakhe.
UJehoshaphat, unyana ka-Asa, waba ngukumkani wakwaYuda ngonyaka wesine kaAhabhi ukumkani wakwaSirayeli.

UJehoshafati ubeminyaka imashumi amathathu anesihlanu ezelwe, lapho eqala ukumkani; waba neminyaka eyishumi nambili nesishiyagalombili engukumkani eYerusalem. Ubaba wakhe wayenguAzuba intombi kaShilhi.
Wahamba yonke indlela ka-Asa ubaba wakhe, akazange ayishintshe; wakwenza okulungile emehlo kaYehova; kodwa izindawo eziphakeme azisuswa; abantu baqhubeka benikela khona, befutha khona inkungu.
UJehoshaphat wakwenza nokuthula nomphathi waseSirayeli.
Okunye konke okwenze uJehoshafati, nemisebenzi yakhe enamandla, nezimpi zakheописано ли в книге летописей царей Иуды?
Wakhipha ezweni labo abase-Israeli, ababehlala khona ngesikhathi sikaAsa ubaba wakhe, laba madodana asendaweni yo claro.
Ngaleso sikhathi kwakungekho ukumkani e-Edom; kwaba khona umphathi.
U olduk فضای Hele彼 انحصارe e-Ophire ukuthenga igolide massimathizo, kodwa akazange azi mô Умdabukazi; ngoba izikhephe zalahleka e-Ezion-Geber.
U-Achani tsime, uyaxosha. U-U-U-U-činka-U-U-U-U-U-U-U-U-U-U kakala u-U- dojsta-u-U-U-U-U-U-U-U-U förståsССРI)
Waphumula uJehoshafati, washiswa nababa bakhe edolobha maximeni likaDavide umzali wakhe. UYoram unyana wakhe waba ngukumkani esikhundleni sakhe.
UAhaziya, unyana ka-stehen "ubukhosi baseSirayeli" eSamariya ngonyaka oyisixhenxe yeshumi nesishiyagalombili kaJehoshafati ukumkani waseYuda; waba ngukumkani wakwaSirayeli iminyaka emibini.
Wakwenza okubi emehloni kaYehova; walandela indlela yobaba wakhe noyise, nendlela kaYarobohami unyana kaNabati, owakwenza isiSirayeli siphele.
Wakhonza uBhaali, wathandaza kuye; wehlaza inhliziyo kaYehova, uNkulunkulu wakwaSirayeli, ngazo zonke izinto azenzayo ubaba wakhe.
2Kgs: Ngemuva kokufa kuka-Ahabhi, izwe likaMowabi lahlasela amaSirayeli.

UAhaziya wehla ngefenisha yegumbi lakhe eliphakeme eSamariya, wavuvuka kakhulu. Wathumela abantu, wathi kubo, Yeni nibuze uBaale-zebhubu, iNkosi yase-Ekron, ukuthi ngizophiliswa yini ngalesi sifo sami.

Wathi umbingeleli kaYehova kuEliya waseTishbi, Yikhuphule, uye ukuhlangabezana nabathunywa bakakumkani waseSamariya, uthi kubo, Ingabe akukho uNkulunkulu eSirayeli, ukuthi niye nibuze uBaale-zebhubu, iNkosi yaseAkron?
Ngako oko, kusho iNkosi ukuthi: Uzophuma ebhedini ohlala kulo, awukwazi ukubuyela emuva; kodwa uzofa ngokuqinisekile. Wahamba ke uEliya.
Kwathi lapho abathunywa bebuyela kuye, wathi kubo: "Yintoni ekwenzeni nibuye?"

Bathi kubo, Umuntu ufike ukubhekana nathi, wathi kuthi: "Yeni nibuye kukumkani owasithumelayo, nithi kuye, UNkulunkulu uthi lokhu: Ingabe akukho uNkulunkulu eSirayeli, ukuthi uthumelele abantu ukuba babuze uBaale-zebhubu, uNkulunkulu ka-Ekron? Ngakho ngeke ukhuphuke esibhedlela lapho uhlala khona; uzofa ngokuqinisekile."
Wathi kubo ukumkani, Kubukeka kanjani lowo muntu owafika ukubhekana nani, wakhuluma nalowo mbhalo?
Baphendula bathi, Wabe ngumntu onezinwele, nogqozi lwesikhumba ekhanda lakhe. Wathi ukumkani, Lowo nguEliya waseTishbi.

Wathumela kuye ukumkani umphathi wesibhakabhaka, namadoda akhe amashumi mahlanu; waphuma waya kuEliya, futhi yena wayesesitezi esiphezulu somfula, wathi kuye, Umuntu kaThixo, ukumkani uthi, Thola phansi.

UEliya waphendula wathi kulowo mphathi: "Uma ngimuntu kaThixo, khona-ke umlilo ukhuphuke esibhakabhakeni, uwudle wena namadoda akho amashumi amahlanu." Umlilo wehla esibhakabhakeni, wawudla lowo mphathi namadoda akhe amashumi mahlanu.
Wathumela ke ukumkani omunye umphathi weshumi nambili, nomadodana akhe amashumi amahlanu. Wathi kuye uEliya, Umuntu kaThixo, ukumkani uthi, Thola phezulu!

UEliya waphendula wathi, "Uma ngingumuntu kaThixo, khona-ke umlilo kufanele usetshenziswe phezulu ezulu, ube yiwo wena kanye nabantu bakho abangumashumi mahlanu." Umlilo kaThixo wehla phezulu ezulu, waba ngumlilo kulowo owayengumphathi wezikhulu eziyishumi nambili kanye nabantu bakhe abangumashumi mahlanu.

Wathumela ke ukumkani umphathi wesithathu wezikhulu eziyisishiyagalombili, naye namadoda akhe ayisishiyagalolunye; waphuma lowo mphathi wesithathu, wavuka, wajika imilenze yakhe phambi kukaEliya, wamcela, wathi kuye, Umuntu kaThixo, ngicela, ubone ukuthi impilo yami, nokuphila kwalabo bantu abangumashumi mahlanu abasebenza kuwe, kuyinto ebaluleke.
Umlilo wehla esibhakabhakeni, wabulala abaphathi abathathu bokuqala namadoda abo; kodwa manje, ngicela, usize impilo yami.
Wathi umbingeleli kaYehova kuEliya, Thola ngezansi naye; ungamkholeli. UEliya ke wavuka, waphuma naye kuye ukumkani.

Wathi uEliya kuye ukumkani, UNkulunkulu uthi lokhu: "Uthumelele abathunywa ukubuza uBaale-zebhubu, iNkosi yase-Ekron? Ingabe kukhona uNkulunkulu eSirayeli ongawubuza lowo mbuzo? Ngokuba wenze lokhu, awuzokhuphuka esibhedlela ohlala kuso; uzofa."

Wafa ke uAhaziya, ngokusho kwamazwi kaYehova ayewatshela uEliya. UYoram waba ngukumkani endaweni yakhe, ngenxa yokuthi akazange abe nendodana; kwaba ngomnyaka wesithathu kaYoram, unyana kaJehoshafati, ukumkani wakwaYuda.
Okunye okushiwo nguAhaziya, konke okwenze, akubonakali kubhalwe encwadini yezindaba zamakumkani baseSirayeli?
Kuze kube yilapho iNkosi engeke athathe khona uEliya esibhakabhakeni, uEliya noElisha besuka eGalgali.
Wathi uEliya ku-Elisha, Uhlale lapha, ngiyakucela; ngoba iNkosi ungithumelele eBheteli. Wathi uElisha, Uphila iNkosi nokuphila kwakho, ngeke ngikushiye. Baye behla bahamba ndawonye eBheteli.
Baphuma ke abafundi bamaprofeti eBhabheli, bafika ku-Elisha, bethi kuye, Uyazi ukuthi iNkosi uzowuthatha umphathi wakho namuhla phezu kobuso bakho? Wathi uElisha, Ngiyazi; ungakhuluma ngalokho.
UEliya wathi kuye, Elisha, hlala lapha, ngiyakucela; ngoba iNkosi ungithumela eJericho. Wathi uElisha, Kuphila iNkosi nokuphila kwakho, ngeke ngikushiye. Baye befika eJericho,
Bafika khona abaprofeti eJericho, bakhuluma noElisa, bethi kuye, Uyazi yini ukuthi iNkosi uzowuthatha namuhla umphathi wakho phezu kwakho? Wathi yena, Ngiyazi; ungakhuluma ngalokho.
Wathi uEliya kuye, Nceda uhlale lapha; ngoba iNkosi ungithumelele eYordan. Wathi uElisha, Uphila iNkosi nokuphila kwakho, ngeke ngikushiye. Bahamba ke labo bobabili.
Bahamba abantu abangumashumi mahlanu emindenini yamaprofeti, behlala eduze kwabo; uEliya noElisa ke bahlala emfuleni iYorodani.
Wathatha uEliya isigqoko sakhe, wasigqugquzela, wehlisa amanzi; futhi amanzi ahlukaniswa ngakwesokudla nakwesobunxele, badlula bonke bemi phezu komhlaba omnyama.
Badlula, wathi uEliya ku-Elisha, Uthi yini ukuthi ngikwenze wena ngaphambi kokuba ngithathelwe kude nawe? Waphendula u-Elisha wathi, Ngicela, ngithole ingxenye emibili yomoya wakho.
Wathi uEliya, Ucela lutho olunzima; kodwa uma ungibona lapho ngithathwa kude nawe, uzowuthola; kodwa uma ungangibonanga, awukwazi ukuwuthola.
Behamba bekhuluma, kwafika phakathi kwabo imoto yomlilo namabhayisikili omlilo; uEliya wanyuka ezulu emfushaneni wezulu.
UElisha wakubona, wathi, "Ubaba wami, ubaba wami, izimoto zakwaSirayeli, namabhayisikili kaSirayeli!" Akekho okwazi ukuwubona. Wathatha uElisha izingubo zakhe, wazazixosha zibe yizimbili.
Wathatha isigqoko, esiwela emlenzeni kaEliya, wabuyela, wahlala enkabeni yoMfula iJordani.
Wathatha isigqoko esiboshwe nguEliya, washaya amanzi, wathi, Ukhona yini iNkosi, uNkulunkulu kaEliya? Washaya amanzi, ahlukaniswa ngakwesokudla nakwesobunxele; uElisha wadlula.
Kwathi lapho ibandla lamaprofeti eJericho, elibhekene naye, likubona, lathi, Umoya kaEliya ukhona phezu kuka-Elisha. Bafika bewuhlangana naye, babhujiswa phansi phambi kwakhe;

Bathi kuye, Thola, thina abakhonzi bakho sinabantu abangumashumi amahlanu abanothando; ngicela bahambe bafune unkosi wakho; kungase kube ukuthi umphefumulo kaYehova uwuthathe, wawubeka emfuleni othile, noma emgodini othile. Wathi uElisha, Akunjalo, ungabathumeli.
Wathi, "Thumelani." Bathumela abantu abangu-50; bafuna iminyaka emithathu, kodwa abakwazi ukuwuthola uEliya. Uthe ke yena kubo: "Ngubani na lowo umuntu?
Babuyela kuye, futhi yena wayehlala eJericho. Wathi kubo, Ngabe angikutsheleni ukuthi ningayihamba?
Bathi abantu baseJericho ku-Elisheha, Thola, nkosi yami, indawo yalo mzi iyindawo enhle, njengoba ubona; kodwa amanzi angcolile, futhi izwe alikwazi ukuvuna.
Wathi uElisha, Ninikele isitsha esisha, nibeke khona umhluzi. Bamwilela ke.
Waphuma waya emfuleni, wabeka khona ukhilimu, wathi, UNkulunkulu uthi lokhu: "Ngiwuphilise lo lwandle; ngeke liphinde libe yingozi yokufa, noma kube yingozi yokulimala kwezwe."
Wathi uElisha, "Kulungile," futhi amanzi ahlala ehlanzekile kuze kube manje.
Kwathi lapho, uElisha wanyuka waya eBhethiyeli; futhi ngesikhathi esehamba ngendlela, kwaphuma abantu abancane emzini wakhe, bemxwayisa, bethi, Yiya phezulu, wena omnyama! Yiya phezulu, wena omnyama!
Wabheka emuva, wababona, wathi kubo ngegama lika-Yehova: kwaphuma khona izinyoni ezimbili zezilwanyana zasendle ezisuka emfuleni, zabulala abantu abangumashumi amane nabini.
Wasuka khona khona uElisha, waya emfuleni iKarmeli, wabuyela khona eSamari.
UYoram, unyana ka-Ahabhi, waba ngukumkani wakwaSirayeli eSamari, ngonyaka weshumi nambili nesishiyagalombili kaJehoshafati ukumkani wakwaYuda; waba neminyaka eyisithupha.
Wakwenza okubi emehloni kaYehova, kodwa hhayi njengokuthi ubaba wakhe nodadewabo babekwenzela; wasusa isibonisi-mlilo sikaBahali, ebesenziwe ngubaba wakhe.
Kodwa-ke, waqhubeka nokwenza izigebengu zikaYarobhoamu unyana kaNabati, owenza amaSirayeli azinikele; akaze ahambe kuzo.
UMesha ukumkani wakwaMowabi wayenezinkomo eziningi, wanikela kukumkani waseSirayeli ngomnyaka owodwa izingulube ezingu-100, nezingwevu zezinkomo eziyi-100.
Kwathi, ngemuva kokufa kuka-Ahabhi, ukumkani wakwaMowabi wehlisa isandla sakhe emkhosini wamaSirayeli.
Ngaleso sikhathi ukumkani uYoram waphuma eSamariya, waqoqa wonke amakhosi aseSirayeli ukuba abe yimpi.

Wathumela uJehoshafati ukumkani wakwaYuda, esithi, Ubukhosi baseMowabhi buphumile ngami; ungahamba nami yini ukubhekana noMowabhi? Wathi yena uJehoshafati, Ngizohamba; ngizoba nawe yonke indlela; abantu bami njengabantu bakho, izimvu zami njengezimvu zakho.
Wathi uYoram, Ngayiphi indlela sizohlasela? Waphendula uYoram wathi, Ngosihlabathi seEdom.
Waphuma ke ukumkani wakwaSirayeli, nokumkani wakwaYuda, nokumkani wakwaEdom; bahamba nsuku ezisixhenxe, futhi kwakungekho amanzi emkhosini, nakwizinto eziphilayo eziya nabo.
Wathi ukumkani wakwaSirayeli, Akunjalo! UYehova uhlanganise phakathi kwethu abaphathi abathathu, ukuze asize eMowabi.

Wathi uJehoshafati, Ingabe akukhona lapha umprofeti kaYehova, ukuze sibuze iNkosi ngaye? Waphendula omunye wabaphathi bakakumkani wakwaSirayeli, wathi, Kukhona lapha uElisha unyana kaShafati, owenza amanzi ezandlani zikaEliya.
Wathi uJehoshafati, Izwi likaYehova likhona naye. Baphuma khona ukumkani wakwaSirayeli, noJehoshafati, nokumkani waseEdom, ukuba babone.

Wathi uElisha kukumkani wakwaSirayeli, Ingabe kunento engiyenzayo nawe? Iya kumaprofeti kababa wakho nomama wakho. Waphendula ukumkani wakwaSirayeli wathi, Akunjalo; ngoba nguYehova owenza ukuba kube khona phakathi kwethu abaphathi abathathu, ukuze asize amaMowabi.
Wathi uElisha, Uphila iNkosi wemikhosi, uNkulunkulu obengisebenzela yena, ukuthi uma sengingeke ngicabangele uJehoshafati ukumkani wakwaYuda, angikwazanga ukubheka wena, futhi angikuboni.
Kodwa manje, ngithole umuntu odlala i-harp. Nokho, lapho edlala khona i-harp, kwafika amandla kaYehova kuElisha;
Wathi, Lokho kusho iNkosi: Nciphisa izintaba-mlilo kulo mfula wonke.
Uthi iNkosi, Awubonanga umoya, awubonanga imvula; kodwa lo mfula uzogcwele amanzi; nizodla, nize nezilwane zenu, nenyama yenu yonke.
Le nto ilula kakhulu kuYehova; futhi uzobanikela phambi kwenu noMowabi.
Uzonqoba yonke idolobhana elihlanganisiwe, nanoma iyiphi inqaba eqinile; futhi uzophula wonke umnqumo omuhle, futhi uzovala zonke izimpophoma, futhi uzolimaza yonke indawo enhle ngemigodi.
Kwathi ekuseni, ngesikhathi sokudla isiphuzo sakusihlwa, kwafika amanzi asuka enkabeni yeEdomu; izwe lonke lagcwele amanzi.

Kwathi lapho abantu bonke baseMowabhi beva ukuthi abakumkani bafika ukubhekana nabo emdlalweni, babizwa wonke umuntu okwaziyo ukugqoka isibhamu, kusukela engumntwana kuze kube ngumdala, futhi babekwa emigwaqweni.
Bavuka ekuseni, babona ukuthi ilanga likhanya phezu kwamanzi. Amadodana kaMowabi asentshonalanga yalesi siqhingi ebona amanzi emnyama njengegazi.
Bathi, Igazi likhona; kungenxa yokuthi abaphathi baphikisane, babulalana. Ngakho-ke, wena uMowabi, sihambe sithathe konke okusele kubo.
Kwafika amaMowabi esibhedlela samaSirayeli, futhi amaSirayeli aqala ukunqoba amaMowabi; abaSirayeli bahlasela izwe, babulala amaMowabi.

Babulala amadolobhana. Wonke umuntu wakhipha itshe ezindaweni ezingcono zonke kuze kube yilapho zihlotshiswe khona. Bavala yonke imifula, basusa yonke imihlahla emihle. I-Kir Hareseth kuphela eyashiywa namagquma ayo aqinile, kodwa abantu abane-slings babhekene nayo futhi bahlasela.
Uma ukumkani wakwaMowabi ebona ukuthi ukulwa luyaqhubeka, wathatha abantu abangumakhulu asixhenxe abasebenza ngeqhwa, afuna ukudlula kuye ukumkani wase-Edom; kodwa bekungaphumelelanga.

Wathatha unyana wakhe omdala, ongeke abe ngukumkani esikhundleni sakhe, wamnikela njengomnikelo wokushiswa phezu kwedonga ledolobha. Kwaba khona inkohliso enkulu ezweni lakwaSirayeli; babuyela ezweni labo.

Kwathi lapho, indodakazi yomuntu oyedwa emndenini wamaprofeti yashaya uElisha, yathi kuye, Umkhonzi wakho, indodana yami, wafa; futhi uyazi ukuthi wayemthanda iNkosi; kodwa manje yena okhokhela imali yakhe uyafika athathe izingane zami ezimbili abe ngabangani bakhe.
Wathi kuye uElisha, Ingabe ngikwazi ukukwenza yini? Yazise ukuthi uneni ekhaya lakho. Wathi yena, Asikho lutho enhliziyweni yakho, ngaphandle kwebhodlela elincane le-oyile.
Wathi uElisha, Yiya, thola iziqhingi ezingenalutho kulabo bonke abangani bakho; thola konke okwaziyo.
bese uya kungena, uvale umbhede ngemuva kwakho wena nezingane zakho, uthele i-oyile kuwo onke amabhodlela; uma egcwele ngalinye lawo, uyibeke endaweni.
Ingabe wayeyindodana yakhe noma indodakazi yakhe, kuxhomekeke kuye. Baye banikela ngezinto eziningi kuye, futhi yena wageza.
Wathi kuyise, "Ninikele ibhodlela elinye." Wathi yena, "Akunabo amabhodlela angaphezu kwalokhu," futhi uphethiloli wayeka ukudlula.
Waye waya, watshela umuntu kaThixo. Wathi yena, Iya, thengisa i-oyile, ukhokhele inkontileka yakho; wena nezingane zakho niphile ngalokho okusele.

Kwathi ngosuku olulodwa, uElisha waya eShunem; kwabekho khona indodana enkulukazi, yamangalisa uElisha ukuthi ahlale khona, aphuze ukudla. Ngaleso sikhathi, lapho ehamba khona, wahlala khona ephuza ukudla.
Wathi kumfazi wakhe, Ngiyazi ukuthi lo mntu ohlala esiya nathi, ngumuntu ongcwele kaThixo.
Sivule igumbi elincane esitezi, sibeke khona isibhedlela, nethebulethi, nesihlalo, nesibani, ukuze ahlale khona lapho efika kuthi.
Ngosuku oluthile uElisha wafika, wehla egumbini lakhe eliphakeme, wahlala khona.
Wathi kuGehazi, umkhonzi wakhe, Wisela lo mfazi waseShunemi. Wamwisela uGehazi; waya, wahlala phambi kwakhe.

Wathi uElisha kuGehazi, Uthi kuye: "Uya ezweni elinzima kakhulu ngenxa yethu; yini okufanele sikwenze kuwe? Ingabe singakhuluma ngowenkosi, noma ngomphathi wezwe?" Wayephendula wathi, "Ngihlala phakathi kwabantu bam."
Wathi uElisha, Ingabe singakwenza yini kuye? Waphendula uGehazi wathi, Yabona, ayikho indodana yakhe, nowesifazane wakhe udala.
Wathi uElisha, Wisela yena. Wamwilela uGehazi, wahlala emgwaqweni.
Wathi uElisha, Ngonyaka ozayo ngaleso sikhathi, uzobe unendodana emlenzeni wakho. Yathi yena, Hayi, nkosi yami, umuntu kaThixo, ungamkhohlisi umkhonzi wakho.
Uwesifazane wakhulelwa, wazalelwa unyana ngonyaka olandelayo ngaleso sikhathi, njengoba uElisha abemtshele.
Wakhula lo mntwana, kwathi ngosuku oluthile waphuma waya kubaba wakhe, owabe esebenza nabahlengikazi abavuna inkomo.
Wathi ubaba wakhe, Intamo yami, intamo yami ibuhlungu. Wathi ubaba wakhe kulowo osebenza naye, Yazisa umkakhe.
Wathi umkhonzi wakhe, "Njengoba udadewabo ufile," wathatha udadewabo, waya kumkakhe. Udadewabo wahlala embhedeni wakhe kuze kube yisikhathi sokudla.
Wayemthwala, wabeka phezu kombhede womntu kaThixo, wavala umngcele, waya ngaphandle.
Wayibiza indodana yakhe, wathi, Ngicela, ngithumelele omunye wabakhonzi, nowesifazane, ukuze ngihambe ngejubane kuye umuntu kaThixo, ngibuye.
Wabuza, "Yini uhambe kuye namhlanje? Ayikho inyanga entsha noma iSabbath." Yathi, "Kuzolungile konke."
Wathi, Uzohamba, uhambe ngokushesha; ungenzi lutho ngaphandle kokuthi ngikutshele.
Waphuma ke, wafika kumuntu kaThixo emfuleni iKarmeli; futhi lapho umuntu kaThixo ebona khona ngasenyakatho, wathi kuGehazi umkhonzi wakhe, Thola lo mfazi waseShunemi!
Uzohamba ubhekane naye bese ubuza yena, 'Ulungile yini? Umama wakho ulungile yini? Ingane yakho ilungile yini?'" Waphendula wathi, "Konke kulungile."

Kwathi lapho efika emfuleni kulowo muntu kaThixo, wathatha izinyawo zakhe. Wafika uGehazi ukuba ayise; kodwa lowo muntu kaThixo wathi, Ushiyeke; ngoba inhliziyo yakhe ibuhlungu kakhulu, futhi iNkosi ungifihla, angibonisi ukuthi kungani.
Wathi yena, "Ngabe ngikucela indodana, nkosi yami? Angikushonga yini kuwe: 'Ungaba nethemba'?"

Wathi uElisha ku-Ghehazi, Nciphisa izicathulo zakho emlenzeni wakho, uze uthathe isandla sami esihambayo, uyeke; uma uhlangana nomuntu, ungawubonga; futhi uma umuntu ekubonga wena, ungawuphendulanga; ubeke isandla sami esihambayo phezu kobuso bomntwana.
Wathi udadewabo, Uphila iNkosi nokuphila kwakho, ukuthi ngeke ngikushiye. Wavuka ke uElisha, walandela yena.
Wahamba uGehazi phambi kwakhe, wabeka intambo phezu kobuso bakhe; kodwa kwakungekho msindo, futhi kwakungekho lutho oluphilayo. Wabuyela ebhekana noElisa, wathi kuye, "Umuntu akavumi."
Uthe uElisha efika ekhaya, ngabona umfana esefile phezu kombhede wakhe.
Waphuma uElisha, wavala umlango ngemuva kwabo bobabili, wathandaza kuYehova.
Uthe wafika embhedeni, wehla phezu komntwana, umlomo nomlomo, amehlo ngamehlo, nezandla ngezandla. Ube esemqoka kuye, umzimba womntwana wawuqala ukufudumeza.
UElisha wavuka, wahamba eduze kwendlu kathathu. Wabuyela emuva, wehlisa izandla zakhe phezu komntwana. Umntwana wehlaza izikhathi ezisixhenxe, wavula amehlo akhe.
UElisha wabiza uGehazi, wathi, Vimbela lo mfazi waseShunemi. Wamwisela ke; kwathi lapho efika khona, uElisha wathi, Thola unyana wakho.
Wayefika, wawela emadolo akhe, wehla phansi ezweni; wathatha unyana wakhe, waya ngaphandle.

UElisha wabuyela eGalgali. Kwabe sekuyindlala ezweni, futhi ibandla lamaprofeti lihlala phambi kwakhe. Wathi kulowo mkhonzi wakhe, Thola isiqalo esikhulu emlilweni, ulungiselele ukudla kwalabo bamaprofeta.

Omunye wabo waphuma ezindaweni zokuqoqa izitshalo. Wathola i-vine yasendle futhi waqoqa ama-currants asendle amaningi njengoba izigqoko zakhe zazikwazi ukuwagcina. Wabuyela emuva waza wawamisa emgodini we-stew, engawazi ukuthi ziyini.
Bathi, "Umuntu kaThixo," waphendula uMosis, "ukufa kukhona esiqandisini;" futhi akazange akwazi ukuwadla.
Wathi uElisha, Ninikele inkomishi yenkukhu. Wayibeka esiqandisini, wathi, Nciphisa kubo abantu, ukuze baphuze. Nokho kwakungekho lutho olubi esiqandisini;
Kwafika umuntu osuka eBhaali-shalisa, ethwala umnqumo woshizi wama-20 emlonyeni womntu kaThixo, kanye nezithelo ezitshalwe kuqala; wathi uElisheha, Nciphisa kubo abantu ukuthi baphile.
Wathi umkhonzi wakhe, Ingabe ngizobeka lokhu phambi kwamadoda amakhulu? UElisha wathi, Nciphisa abantu ukuthi baphile; ngoba iNkosi uthi, Bazodla, futhi bazogcina.
Wabeka ke phambi kwabo; badla, futhi kwashiywa, njengokuthi iNkosi wathi.

UNaamani wayengumphathi wemikhosi kakumkani wase-Aram, futhi umnikazi wakhe wayemhlonipha kakhulu, ngoba iNkosi wabanika isivivinyo i-Aram ngesandla sikaNaamani. Wabe ngumuntu onamandla, kodwa ube nesifo sesikhumba esibizwa ngokuthi yi-leprosy.
Bafika eSirayeli abahlaseli baseSiriya, bathathe indodakazi encane yaba yindodana yowesifazane kaNaamani.
Wathi kunkosikazi yakhe, Uma ngabe umnikazi wami efika kulowo mprofeti waseSamariya, angawuphilisa ukoma kwakhe.
Wahamba uNamane, watshela ukumkani umnikazi wakhe, wathi, Uthi yini lo mfana waseSirayeli?

Wathi ukumkani wakwa-Aram, Yiya, ngizothumela incwadi kumkakhe waseSirayeli. UNaamani ke waya, wathabatha emlonyeni wakhe amakhilogremu ayishumi nesishiyagalombili zesiliva, namashekeli ayisithupha egolide, nezigqoko eziyisixhenxe zokushintshana izicathulo;
Wathumela umbiko ukumkani wakwaSirayeli, lathi: "Ngakho-ke ngithumelele wena umkhonzi wami uNaamani, ukuthi unciphise isifo sakhe sokuwa."

Uma ukumkani wakwaSirayeli efunde lo mbhalo, waxosha izigqoko zakhe, wathi, Ngami yini uNkulunkulu? Ingabe ngizobulala, futhi ngizosindisa? Kungani na le nto ithumela kuye umuntu ukuba aphiliswe umkhuhlane wakhe? Ubona ukuthi ufuna ukungishaya ngesandla.

Kwathi lapho uElisha, indodana kaThixo, ekwazi ukuthi ukumkani wakwaSirayeli ukhiphe izigqoko zakhe, wathumela kuye, esithi, Kungani na ukhiphe izigqoko zakho? Thumela lo muntu kum, ukuze wazi ukuthi kukhona umprofeti eSirayeli.
Wafika uNamane, namahhashi akhe, nemoto yakhe, wahlala emgwaqeni wendlu kaElisha.
UElisha wathumela umthunywa kuye, wathi kuye, Iya, uhlanzeke izikhathi ezisixhenxe emfuleni iJordani; isikhumba sakho sizobuya sihle, futhi uzohlanzeka.

UNaamani wagwema, wasuka, wathi, Ngicabanga ukuthi uzophuma ngami, futhi uzohlala khona, futhi uzobiza igama likaYehova uNkulunkulu wakhe, futhi uzophakamisa isandla sakhe phezu kwalo mhlaba, futhi uzowuphilisa umkhuhlane wami.
Ingabe imifula yaseDamaskus, i-Abana ne-Farfar, ayikho engcono kunawo wonke amanzi aseSirayeli? Ngangikwazi yini ukugeza khona, ukuze ngihlanzeke? Uthe ke wabuyela emuva, wehla emlonyeni.
Bafike ke abakhonzi bakhe, bakhuluma kuye, bethi, Ubaba, uma umprofeti ekusho kuwe lutho olukhulu, awuzange ukwenze yini? Ngakho-ke, kungani ungakwenza, uma kusho kuwe nje, Hlala uhlanzeke?

Wathi uNaamani, waphuma, wehlisa izandla zakhe emfuleni iJordani izikhathi ezisixhenxe, ngokusho komthetho womntu kaThixo; futhi isikhumba sakhe sabuya sihlanzekile, safana nesikhumba somntwana omncane, wahlanzwa.

Wabuya uNaamani, yena nendodana yakhe yonke, waya kulowo muntu kaThixo, wahlala phambi kwakhe, wathi, Namuhla ngiyazi ukuthi akukho uNkulunkulu emhlabeni wonke, ngaphandle kwaSirayeli; manje ke, ngiyakucela, thola isipho kumkhonzi wakho.
Wathi uElisha, Uphila iNkosi, uNkulunkulu wami, ukuthi ngeke ngiyithathe. Wathi yena uNamane, "Uzoyithatha yini?" Wathi, "Ngizoyithatha."

Wathi uNaamani, Uma kungenjalo, ngicela, gramatiza umkhonzi wakho ukuba athathe imbewu eyanele ukuthwala amabhungane amabili; ngoba namuhla namanje umkhonzi wakho akazonikela ngomnikelo wokushiswa, noma ngesonka, kunoma yimuphi uNkulunkulu, ngaphandle kukaYehova.

Ngalokhu nje, iNkosi alungise umkhonzi wakho; ngoba uma umphathi wami ephuma ethempelini lika-Rimon ukuba abukele, ehlala enhliziyweni yami, khona-ke nami ngibukele khona. Uma ngibukela ethempelini ka-Rimon, iNkosi alungise umkhonzi wakho ngalesi sizathu.
Wathi kuye uElisha, Iya ngoxolo. Waphuma ke uNaamani, wahamba uhambo oluncane.

Wathi uGehazi, umkhonzi ka-Elisha, indodana kaThixo, engqondweni yakhe, Inkosi yami ishiye lo Naamani waseSiriya ahambe ngokulula kakhulu, engathathenga okuthunyelwe kuye; ngiphila uNkulunkulu, ngizohamba ngemuva kwakhe, ngithole lutho kuye.
UNaamani, lapho ebona umuntu ehamba ngemuva kwakhe, waphuma esihlalweni sakhe, wahlangana naye, wathi, "Kulungile yini konke?"

Wathi uGehazi, Kulungile; umnikazi wami ungithumelele ukuthi ngithi, Amehlo ami abona amantombazane amabili asuka ezindaweni eziphakeme zakwaEfraim afika kum; ngiyakucela, ngibanike isiliva lama-shekeli ayishumi nambili, nezigqoko ezimbili.

Wathi uNaamani, Ngisho, ngikucela, thola ama-shekeli ayishumi nesishiyagalombili. Wathi kuGehazi, Ngubani na lowo? Uthe wabeka imali emigodini emibili, kanye nezigqoko ezimbili zokudla, wabanika abakhonzi bakhe ababini; bathwala phambi kwakhe.
Ke kaloku, lapho efika khona uGehazi, wazithola ezinyaweni zabangane bakhe, wazifihla ekhaya; wabasusa abantu, basuka.
Wafika uGehazi, wahlala phambi komnikazi wakhe. Uthe uElisha kuye, "Uyaphi, uGehazi?" Waphendula wathi, "Umkhonzi wakho akazange ahambe kuphi naphi."

Wathi kuye uElisha, Ingabe umphefumulo wami awukho nawe, lapho lo mntu ekhuphuka emgodini wakhe ukubhekana nawe? Ingabe manje yisikhathi sokuthatha imali, nokugqoka, nezihlahla zezithelo ze-olive, nezivini, namaqanda, nengulube, nabakhonzi, nabangani?
Ngakho-ke isifo sikaNaamani sizothiwa kuwe, nomndeni wakho, kuze kube sekupheleni kosuku. Kwathi lapho uGehazi ephuma emzini kaElisheha, wathola ukuthi isikhumba sakhe simhlophe njengethebhu.
Wathi umndeni wamaprofeti ku-Elisha, Thola, indawo lapho sihlala khona eduze kwakho incane kakhulu kuthi.
Sihambe sifike emfuleni iJordani, sithole khona wonke umuntu umnqumo wokhuni, sivule khona indawo yokuhlala. Wathi uElisha, Yiya!
Wathi omunye kubo, Sicela uhambe nathi, thina abakhonzi bakho. Waphendula uElisha, Ngizohamba.
Wahamba ke nabo. Bafika eJordani, baqala ukuvuna izihlahla.
Uma omunye wabo eshaya umnqumo, ikhanda lensimbi le-axe liwela emanzini. Wavuya wathi, "Oh, akunjalo, umphathi! Yathathwe!"
Wathi lowo muntu kaThixo, "Yawela kuphi?" Wamukhombisa khona indawo. UElisha wamisa inkomishi, wayifaka emanzini, yakwenza insimbi ihambe.
Wathi, "Yithathe." Uthe lowo mntu waphakamisa isandla sakhe, wathatha.
Kwathi lapho ukumkani wakwa-Aram ehlasela amaSirayeli, wakhuluma nabantu bakhe, wathi, Ngizomisa isibhedlela lapha nalaphaya.
Umuntu kaThixo wathumela ukumkani wakwaSirayeli, esithi, Khumbula ukuthi ungadlulanga endaweni leyo; ngoba ama-Aram asuke ehla khona.
Wathumela khona ukumkani wakwaSirayeli ezweni, lapho umuntu kaThixo abemxwayisa ngawo; futhi uElisha wayemxwayisa njalo; wahlala khona ukumkani, angeke ahlale isikhathi eside.
Umkhuluwa waseSirayeli wakhathazeka kakhulu ngalolu daba, wabiza abaphathi bakhe, wathi kubo: "Ngubani phakathi kwethu osuka emkhosini wakwaSirayeli?"
Wathi omunye wabaphathi bakhe, Akukho muntu, nkosi yami ukumkani; kodwa uElisha, umprofeti eSirayeli, yena oveza ukumkani waseSirayeli amazwi akhuluma ngawo ekamelweni lakho.
Wathi ukumkani, Yeni nibone ukuthi ukhonaphi, ukuze ngithumelele abantu ngiwuthathe. Bathi kuye, Yabona, useDothani;
Wathumela khona amabhayisikili, nama-carriages, nemikhosi eminingi; befika ekuseni, bajikelezisa umzi.
Kwathi lapho umkhonzi womntu kaThixo wavuka emini, waphuma, wabona isibhamu, namabhubesi nezithuthi zokulwa zijikeleze idolobha. Wathi, "Akekho, uMengameli, yini okufanele siyenze?"
Wathi uElisha, Musa ukukhathazeka; ngoba labo abakhona nathi baningi kunalabo abakhona nabo.
Wathandaza uElisha, wathi, Nkosi, ngiyakucela, uvule amehlo akhe, ukuze abone. Wavula iNkosi amehlo owesifazane; wabheka, wabona amatshe egcwele izinja nezimoto zomlilo ezijikeleze uElisha.
Kwathi lapho behla kuye, uElisha wathandaza kukaNkulunkulu, wathi: "Nceda, cindezela labo bantu ngamehlo amnyama." UYehova wababulala ngamehlo amnyama, njengoba uElisha esho.
Wathi kubo uElisha, Ayikho le ndlela, nalowo mzi; landelani ngami, ngizokulethela kulowo muntu ofuna wona. Wabaholela eSamariya.
Bafika eSamari, wathi uElisha, Nkosi, vula amehlo labo ukuthi babone. Wavula iNkosi amehlo abo, bebona, bona, bephakathi kweSamari..
Kwathi lapho ukumkani wakwaSirayeli ebona khona labo, wathi ku-Elisheha, Ubaba wami, ngabe ngiwabulala?

Wathi uElisha, Ungawabulalanga; ngabe uzowabulala yini abantu obabambisene nabo ngeqhwa lakho, noma ngempucuko yakho? Nciphisa ukudla kwabo nokudla kwamanzi, ukuze baphile futhi baphuze, bese ubavumela ukuthi bahambe beya kunkosi yabo.
Wabalungiselela khona ukumkani isidlo esikhulu, badla futhi baphuze; wavumela ukuthi bahambe beya kumnikazi wabo. Kwathi ngemuva kwalokho, amabutho aseSirayeli awazange afike ezweni likaSirayeli.
Ngaleso sikhathi, uBhe-hadadi ukumkani wakwaSirayeli waqoqa wonke umkhosi wakhe, waya eSamariya, waba yimiphakathi.

Kwaba khona ашezi elingenakulinganiswa kulo mzi, kuze kube yilapho ikhanda lengulube lithengwa ngegolide eliyisishiyagalombili, futhi isipuni esincane senyama yenganekwane lithengiswa ngesiliva elilodwa.
Kwathi lapho ukumkani wakwaSirayeli ehamba phezu kwedonga, kwaphuma indodakazi eyodwa ikhala kuye, isithi, Usizo lwami, nkosi yami ukumkani.
Wathi yena, Uma iNkosi engakusizalanga wena, ngizokusiza kanjani? Ingabe nginenyama esuka emgodini, noma iwayini elivela emgodini?
Wathi ukumkani kuye, Yini le nto? Yathi yena, Uwesifazane lowo wathi kimi, Ninikele unyana wakho ukuthi siwudle namuhla; kodwa ngoLwesihlanu sizodla unyana wami.
Sawubhaka unyana wami, sawudla. Kwafika usuku olulandelayo, ngathi kuye, Ninikele unyana wakho siwudle; kodwa yena wafihla unyana wakhe."
Kwathi lapho ukumkani ekhuluma ngalolu cingo lomkakhe, waxosha izigqoko zakhe; futhi ngesikhathi ehamba phezu kwedonga, abantu babheka, babona ukuthi unezigqoko ezingwevu ngaphansi kwezigqoko zakhe.
Wathi, UNkulunkulu angikwenze lokhu futhi amnike okuningi, uma uElisha unyana ka-Shafati egcina ikhanda lakhe emlenzeni wakhe namuhla.

UElisha wayehlala ekhaya lakhe, futhi abakhulu bedolobha babehlala naye. Wathumela umthunywa phambi kwakhe; kodwa ngaphambi kokuba umthunywa afike, uElisha wathi kubo: "Ubonani ukuthi lo mfowabo uthumela umuntu ukuba athathe ikhanda lami? Bheka, uma umthunywa efika, vulani ifasitela, niyivalwe ngaye. Ingabe akuyona inkulumo yokuhamba kwenyawo lomnikazi wakhe enhliziyweni yakhe?"
Wayekhuluma nabo uElisha, lapho umthunywa efika kuye. Wathi ukumkani, Kusuka kukaNkulunkulu lokhu okubi; kungani ngilinde iNkosi namuhla?

Wathi uElisha, "Dlulisa ilizwi likaYehova; kusho iNkosi ukuthi: Ngosuku olulandelayo ngalolu sikhathi, emnyango waseSamariya, ilitha elilodwa lomhluzi lizothengwa ngeshekeli elilodwa lemali, futhi ilitha elilodwa loshizi lizothengwa ngeshekeli elilodwa lemali."

Waphendula lo mphathi, owesifazane owawusesandlani sokumkani, wathi kulowo muntu kaThixo: Uma iNkosi evula amafasitela esibhakabhakeni, ngabe kungaba khona lokhu? UElisha waphendula wathi: "Uzokubona ngamehlo akho, kodwa awukwazi ukuwadla."
Kwabe kukhona abantu abangu-ne abanesifo sokoma, behlala emgwaqweni wokungena edolobhaneni. Bathi phakathi kwabo: "Ngabe kufanele sihlale lapha kuze sife?

Uma sithi, Siyaye edolobhaneni, sizofa khona; ngoba kukhona indlala kulo dolobha. Uma sihlala lapha, sizofa nathi; ngakho-ke, siyaye emkhosini wamaSirayeli, futhi sizophuma; uma besisishiya, sizophila; kodwa uma besisibulala, sizofa ngale ndlela.
Bavuka besuka emini, bafika emgwaqeni wamaSirayeli. Bafike esiphethweni somgwaqeni, futhi kwakungekho muntu lapho.

Ngokuba iNkosi wakwenza isizwe sama-Aram sibone isibhakabhaka semoto, nesibhakabhaka samahhashi, isibhakabhaka somkhosi omkhulu. Bathi phakathi kwabo: "Njengoba ukumkani wakwaSirayeli ekhokhele amakhosi aseHiti, namadodana aseMiziphu, ukuba abe phezu kwethu."
Besuka ke, baphuma emini, beshiya amatende abo, namabhayisikili abo, namahhashi abo; beshiya isibhedlela njengoba sakhona, besuka ukuze bagcine impilo yabo.

Bafika labo abafileyo emgwaqeni, baphuma esitezi esisodwa setente, badla baphuza; bathatha khona isiliva negolide, nezigqoko, baye bazifihla. Babuya befika ethebeni elilodwa, bathatha khona futhi, bazifihla.

Bathi phakathi kwabo, Akulungile lokhu esikwenzayo; ngoba namuhla ngusuku lwezindaba ezinhle, futhi siyazigcina. Uma silinde kuze kube ekuseni, sizoba necala; ngakho-ke thina sizohamba senze izindaba endlu kakumkani.

Baye ke, baphoqa abaphathi bamasango edolobhaneni, bethi kubo, Safika esibhedlela samaSirayeli, futhi ngabona ukuthi kungekho muntu khona, futhi akukho msindo womuntu; kwakukhona kuphela izimvu nezingulube eziboshwe, nezindawo zokuhlala zahlala njengezikhona.
Abagcini beminyango baphoqa ukuthi kuthunyelwe izindaba, kwathi kwathunyelwe ngaphakathi kwepalati kabukhosi.

Wavuka ukumkani ekuseni, wathi kwabaphathi bakhe, Ngizokutshela ukuthi abaSirayeli bakwenzani. Bayazi ukuthi sifile indlala; ngakho besuka eqenjini, bafihlakele emazweni, bethi, Uma abantu bakaSirayeli bephuma emzini, siyawathatha aphile, siyofika emzini."

Waphendula omunye wabaphathi bakhe, wathi: Kuzothatha abantu abahlanu ezinyathelweni eziboshwe kulo mzi; ngoba uma befa, ngeke kube nzima kubo phakathi kwabaSirayeli bonke ababoshiwe, noma phakathi kwabo bonke abafileyo; futhi siyabathumela sibone ukuthi kwenzekani.
Bathatha khona izithuthi ezimbili ezinezimvu, ukumkani wabathumela kulandela isizwe sama-Aram, wathi, Yeni nibone.
Balandela amaSirayeli, bafika emfuleni iJordani. Indlela yonke yagqokwa izicathulo namathuluzi amasha, abewakhipha amaSirayeli lapho behamba ngejubane. Babuya abathunywa, batshela ukumkani.

Baphuma ke abantu, bathatha yonke into esiteshini sama-Aram; futhi imitha elilodwa lomhluzi yathengwa ngeshekeli elilodwa lemali, nemitha elilodwa loshizi lathengwa ngeshekeli elilodwa lemali, njengokuthi iNkosi abesho.
Ubukhosi bubeke umphathi, ohlangothini lwakhe belubhekene naye, ukuba abambe isango; kodwa abantu bamphikisa emnyango, wafa, njengokuthi umuntu kaThixo, lapho ukumkani enqoba ukuwubona.

Kwathi, njengoba umuntu kaThixo esho kuye ukumkani, esithi, Ngosuku olulodwa ngaleso sikhathi, imitha eyodwa yoshizi izothengwa ngeshekeli elilodwa lemali, nemitha eyodwa yobisi elihlanzekile lizothengwa ngeshekeli elilodwa lemali emgwaqeni waseSamari.
Waphendula lo mphathi, wathi kulowo muntu kaThixo: Uma iNkosi evula amafasitela esibhakabhakeni, ngabe kungase kwenzeke lokhu? Wathi uElisha, "Uzokubona ngamehlo akho, kodwa awukwazi ukudla."
Lokhu kungenxa yokuthi kwaba njalo kuye. Abantu bampompa emgwaqeni, futhi wafa.

UElisha wayekhuluma nomkakhe, owesifazane owayemsindisile unyana wakhe, wathi kuye, Yiya, wena nomndeni wakho, uyeke ukuhlala lapho ungathola khona indawo yokuhlala; ngoba iNkosi unqume ukuba kube nendlala iminyaka eyisixhenxe, futhi iyafika kule lizwe.
Wavuka uwesifazane, wakwenza ngokusho kwelizwi lomntu kaThixo; waya, yena nomndeni wakhe, wahlala ezweni lamaFilisti iminyaka eyisixhenxe.
Kwathi, lapho iminyaka eyisikhombisa iphele, wabuyela ezweni lakwaFilisti; waya kukumkani, wathi kuye, Ngikubuyisele indlu yami nomhlaba wami.
Kwathi lapho ukumkani ekhuluma noGehazi, umkhonzi womntu kaThixo, wathi, "Ngubani na ongazitshela zonke izinto ezinkulu azenzayo uElisha?"

Kwathi, lapho ekhuluma ukumkani ukuthi uElisha wavusa umntwana ofile, yafika indodana yakhe, icela ukumkani indlu yayo, nembewu yayo. Wathi uGehazi, "Unkosikazi wami umkakhe, lo ngumkakhe, futhi lo ngumntwana wakhe, owasindisa yena uElisha."

Wabuza ukumkani indodana yakhe, yathi kuye: "Ubani lo muntu?" Wathi ukumkani kuye: "Nceda ubuyisele zonke izinto zakhe, kanye nezithelo zesizwe sakhe, kusukela ngosuku lapho ephuma khona kuze kube manje."
UElisha waya eDamaseka, uBhe-hadadi ukumkani waseSiriya ubenesifo. Batshela ukumkani bethi, "Umuntu kaThixo ufike lapha."
Wathi kuHazayeli, Thola isipho esandla sakho, uye ukubhekana nomuntu kaThixo, ubuze iNkosi ngaye, uthi: Ngizophiliswa yini ngalolu hlobo lwesifo?

Wahamba uHazayeli ukuhlangabezana noElisa, wathatha umklomelo ovela eDamaseki, impahla engcono yonke, yafakwa ezimvu ezingamashumi amane; wafika wahlala phambi kwakhe, wathi, Unyana wakho uBhe-hadadi, ukumkani waseSiriya, ungithumela ukuthi ngibuze, Ngizophiliswa yini ngalesi sifo?
Wathi uElisha kuye, Iya, sithi kuye, Uzophiliswa ngokuqinisekile; kodwa iNkosi ungibonisa ukuthi uzofa ngokuqinisekile.
UElisha wabhekana noHazayeli, kuze kube sengathi uHazayeli akakhululeki; khona-ke umuntu kaThixo waqala ukulele.

Wathi uHazayeli, "Iyini le nto oyikhala ngayo, nkosi yami?" UElisha waphendula wathi, "Ngabe ngiyazi ukuthi uzokwenza kanjani abantu bakaSirayeli? Uzobeka izindlu zabo eziqinile emlilweni, futhi uzowabulala abancane babo ngeqhwa, futhi uzama ukubopha izingane zabo, futhi uzozivula izibeleko zabo."
Wathi uHazayeli, Ingabe umkhonzi wakho angakwenza lutho olukhulu lokhu, yena ongeke abe yinja? Wathi uElisha, UNkulunkulu ungibonisa ukuthi uzoba ngukumkani waseSira.
UHazayeli washiya uElisha, waya kunkosi wakhe. Wathi yena uBhe-hadadi kuye, "Uthi yini wena uElisha?" Waphendula uHazayeli, "Wathi ukuthi uzophilile."
Kwathi ngosuku olulandelayo, uHazayeli wathatha isigqoko, wamisa emanzini, wamgoqa phezu kobuso bakhe, waya ekufa; waba ngukumkani endaweni yakhe.
Ngonyaka wesishiyagalombili kaYoram, unyana ka-Ahabhi, ukumkani wakwaSirayeli, kwaba nguYoram, unyana ka-Jehoshaphat, ukumkani wakwaYuda, waba ngukumkani wakwaYuda.
Ubeminyaka imashumi mathathu nambili ezelwe, lapho eqala ukumkani; waba neminyaka esibhozo engukumkani eYerusalem.
Wahamba ngendlela yamabukhosi baseSirayeli, njengokuthi umndeni ka-Ahabhi wawuhambe ngayo; ngoba washada nenkosikazi ka-Ahabhi; wakwenza okubi ebusweni bukaYehova.
Kodwa-ke, iNkosi akafuni ukucima iYuda, ngenxa kaDavide umkhonzi wakhe; ngoba wayethi ukuthi uzonika uDavide nezingane zakhe isibani kuze kube sekupheleni.
Kwathi lapho uYoram engumnikazi, iEdom yabuya yaphikisana nombuso kaYuda, yakhetha ukumkani wayo.
Wahamba uYoramu, naye nemoto yakhe yonke, waya eZairi; futhi amaEdomi ayemjikeleza yena namadoda amakhulu emoto yakhe. Wavuka ngobusuku, wahlasela labo bantu, wabuyela ehholo lakhe.
Ngaleyo ndlela iEdom yaphuma ngaphansi kwesandla sikaYuda, kuze kube ngalolu suku; futhi neLibna yabuya ngaleso sikhathi.
Okunye okushiwo nguYoramu, konke okwenze, akubonakali kubhalwe encwadini yamaqiniso kakumkani wakwaYuda?
Waphumula uYoramu, wabanjwa nababa bakhe edolobhaneni likaDavide. UAhaziya unyana wakhe waba ngukumkani esikhundleni sakhe.
Ngomnyaka weshumi nambili kaYoram, unyana ka-Ahabhi, ukumkani wakwaSirayeli, waba ngukumkani ezweni laseYuda uAhaziya, unyana kaYoram.
UAhaziya ubeneminyaka eyishumi nambili ubudala lapho eqala ukumkani; waba ngukumkani ngonyaka owodwa eYerusalem. Umzali wakhe wayengu-Ataliya, intombi kaOmri ukumkani wakwaSirayeli.
Wahamba ngendlela yomndeni ka-Ahabhi, wakwenza okubi emehloni kaYehova, njengoba bekwenze umndeni ka-Ahabhi; ngoba wayeyindodana yomndeni ka-Ahabhi.
Wahamba noYoram, unyana ka-Ahabhi, ukubhekana noHazayeli ukumkani wakwaSira, eRamoti-gileyadi; futhi amaSira abulala uYoram.

Wabuyela ukumkani uYoram eJezreyeli, ukuze aphilise izicubu zakhe, abaAram babembezele kuye eRama, lapho ehlasela khona uHazayeli ukumkani wakwaAram. UAhaziya unyana kaYoram, ukumkani wakwaYuda, wehla waya eJezreyeli ukuvakashela uYoram, unyana ka-Ahabhi, ngoba wayesele ebuhlungu.
UElisha umprofeti wabiza umuntu othile emndenini wamaprofeta, wathi kuye, Yibeke iingubo zakho emgodini wakho, uze uthathe lesi sitsha esincane se-oyile, uye eRamoti-gileyadi.
Uma ufika khona, thola uYehu unyana ka-Jehoshaphathi, unyana ka-Nimshi; uye kuye, uyisuse phakathi kwabangane bakhe, uyifake egumbini elingaphakathi.
bese uthatha ibhodlela le-oyile, uyiphuze phezu kwekhanda lakhe, uthi: Uthi iNkosi ukuthi: Ngikukhiphe wena ukumkani phezu kwaSirayeli; khona-ke uvule umbhede, uhambe, ungaseki.
Wahamba ke lo mntwana, umprofeti omncane, waya eRamoti-gileyadi.
Kwathi lapho efika khona, wabona abakhulu bezwe behlala ndawonye. Wathi, "Nginento engifuna ukukusho kuwe, umphathi." UYehu wathi, "Ubani phakathi kwethu?" Waphendula wathi, "Uwe, umphathi."
Wavuka ke uYehu, waya endlwini; wageza i-oyile phezu kwekhanda lakhe, wathi, Uthi lokhu iNkosi, uNkulunkulu kaSirayeli: Ngikusindisile ube ngukumkani phezu kwabantu bakaYehova baseSirayeli.
Uzobulala indlu kaAhabhi umnikazi wakho, ukuze ngibuyele ku-Yezebeli igazi labakhonzi bami abaprofeti, negazi lalabo bonke abakhonzi bakaYehova, ayewabulalayo.
Umndeni wonke ka-Ahabhi uzofa, futhi ngizocima bonke amadodana ka-Ahabhi ezweni laseSirayeli, owesifazane nowesifazane.
Ngizoyenza indlu ka-Ahabhi ibe njengendlu kaYarobohamu unyana kaNabati, nendlu kaBhasha unyana ka-Ahiya.
Izinyoni zizodla uJezebeli ezindaweni zaseYizreyeli, futhi ngeke kubekho umuntu ozoyibulala. Wavula khona umbhede, wabaleka.

Waphuma ke uYehu, wafika kwabezindaba benkosi yakhe. Wathi omunye wabo kuye, Ingabe konke kulungile? Kungani na le ndoda ephazamisayo ifike kuwe? Waphendula uYehu wathi, Uyazi lowo muntu nohlobo lwezinto akhuluma ngazo.
Wathi uYehu, Ukhuluma kimi, esithi, Usho lokhu uNkulunkulu kaYehova: "Ngikupheka wena ube ngukumkani phezu kwaSirayeli."
Baphoqeleka ukuba baphuze, ngaso sonke isikhathi, wonke umuntu ugqoko lwakhe, wamisa ngezansi kukaYehu esitezi esiphansi; baphonsa isibhamu, bethi, UYehu ungumnikazi.
UYehu unyana ka-Jehoshaphat, unyana ka-Nimshi, wakwenza inkohlakalo ngoYoram; (uYoram ke wayeseRamoti-gileyadi, yena noSirayeli bonke, ngenxa yoHazayeli ukumkani wakwa-Aram.

Ke kaloku ukumkani uYoram wabuyela eJezreyeli, ukuze aphilise izicubu zakhe, ababembulala ngazo abantu baseSiriya emdlalweni noHazayeli ukumkani waseSiriya. Wathi uYehu kuye, Uma ungumngani wami, ngeke kube khona umuntu ophuma enhliziyweni yedolobha, afike eJezreyeli.
UYehu wehla ekhemisi lakhe, waya eJezreeli; ngoba uYoramu ubelele khona lapho, ehlukumezeke. UAhaziya ukumkani wakwaYuda wayesele evakashele uYoramu.
Wathi uYoram, "Thumela umuntu ohamba ngebhayisikili ukubhekana nabo, futhi uthi, 'Kuphephile yini ukuthi nifika?'"

Waphuma umuntu ohamba ngebhayisikili, wabhekana noYehu, wathi, "Ubukhosi buthi, 'Kuphephile yini ukubuya kwakho?'" UYehu wathi, "Iyini inkinga yakho ngokuthula? Yiya ngasenyameni yami!" Waphendula umphathi wendawo, esithi, "Umthunywa ufike kubo, kodwa akabuyeli."
Wathumela ke ukumkani umshayeli wesithathu, wafika kubo, wathi, "Ukumkani uthi, 'Kuphephile yini ukuthi nifike?'" UYehu wathi, "Ngabe kuphephile ukuthi nifike? Yiba ngezansi kwami!"
Wathi umgcini, "Ufike kubo, kodwa akabuyanga. Ukuhamba kwakhe kufana nokuhamba kuka-Yehu unyana kaNimshi; uhamba njengomuntu okhohlakelayo."

Wathi uYoramu, "Nciphisa imoto yami." Yaphuma khona imoto kaYoramu ukumkani wakwaSirayeli, noAhaziya ukumkani wakwaYuda, wonke umuntu ebhasini lakhe, ukubhekana noYehu; bahlangana naye ezweni likaNabhothi waseJezreeli.

UYoram, lapho ebona uYehu, wathi kuye: "Ufika kanjani ngokuthula, Yehu?" Wathi uYehu, "Ngabe kukhona ukuthula, uma i-Izebeli, umyeni wakho, enezinhlamvu zakhe zobuhlakani, nezinhlamvu zayo zokuzibulala?
UYoram washintsha isithuthi sakhe, wehla, wathi kuAhaziya, Kuyingozi, uAhaziya.
Ke kaloku uYehu wehlise isibhamu sakhe, washaya uYoram phakathi kwekhanda lakhe; ibhodlela ladlula enhliziyweni yakhe, waba mnyama ebhasini lakhe.

Wathi uYehu ku-Bidkari, umphathi wezimoto zakhe, Yithathe, uyithule ezweni likaNabhoti waseJezreyeli; khumbula ukuthi ngihamba wena nami ngemuva kukaAhabhi ubaba wakhe, futhi iNkosi wakhuluma ngalolu daba kuye, esithi:

Ngabona igazi likaNabhothi, negazi labantwana bakhe, ngoLwesibili odlule, kusho iNkosi; futhi ngizokukhokhela ngalesi siqhingi, kusho iNkosi; ngakho-ke uthathe, uwuthule kule mhlaba, njengokuthi iNkosi wathi.

UAhaziya, ukumkani wakwaYuda, lapho ebona khona lokhu, wehla waya emgwaqeni wase-Beth-hagana; uYehu ke wamlandela, wathi: "Lola naye!" Bamushaya emgwaqweni wakhe wokuhamba ngemoto, lapho bephuma khona eGuri, enhliziyweni ka-Ibleyam. Wahamba waya eMegido, wafa khona.
Abaphathi bakhe bamthwala eJerusaleme, bayamzingela nobaba bakhe emgodini wakhe, edolobhaneni likaDavide..
UAhaziya waba ngukumkani wakwaYuda ngonyaka wesishiyagalombili kaYoram, unyana ka-Ahabhi, ukumkani kwabaSirayeli.
Wafika uYehu eJizreyeli. Kwathi lapho iJezebele ikubona lokhu, yabeka amazinyo ayo, yamisa inwele zayo, yabheka ngaphandle kwefasitela.
Kwathi lapho uYehu efika ngesango, wabiza wathi, Ufika kanjani ngokuthula, uZimri, obulala umnikazi wakho?
UYehu wabheka phezu kwethenda, wathi, "Ngabe kukhona ongisekelayo? Ngabe kukhona ongangixhasa?" Bathi abaphathi bendlu ka-Ahabhi, ababili noma abathathu, babheke phansi kuye.
Wathi uYehu, Nciphisaneni naye. Bawukhuphula, waphuma umfutho wegazi lwakhe edonga, nakwibhayisikili; ibhayisikili lalimaza ngaye.
Wafika uYehu, wadla, waphuza; wathi ke, Yeni nizibonele le ndoda elahlekile, niyibulale; ngoba ube yinkosikazi yakhe.
Kwathi lapho behamba ukumfihla khona, bathola ukuthi akukho okushiwo ngaphandle kwekhanda lakhe, nezinyawo zakhe, nezandla zakhe.
Babuyela, batshela uYehu. Wathi yena, Lokho wukuthi ilizwi likaYehova elinikezwe umkhonzi wakhe uEliya waseTishbi, esithi, Ezindaweni zaseJezreyeli izinja zizodla inyama kaJezebeli.
futhi isidumbu sikaJezebeli sizoba sengathi udoti ezindaweni zomhlaba, ezweni lika-Yezreyeli; kuze kube khona umuntu ongathi, Lokho nguJezebeli.
UAhabhi wayenezingane eziyisixhenxe eSamari. Wabhala uYehu incwadi, wabathumela eSamari, kwabaphathi baseJezreyeli, nabakhulu, nabangani baka-Ahabhi, wathi:
Futhi, uma lo mbhalo ufika kuwe, bese ubona ukuthi izingane umnikazi wakho zikhona nawe, futhi imoto yakho, kanye izikebhe, kanye nedolobha elinezinqaba, kanye nezikhali.
Bakhethe lowo ongcono, onobuhlakani phakathi kwabantwana bakankosi yenu; banikeze isikhundla sikababa wakhe, ninqobe umndeni kankosi yenu.
Baze bakhathazeka, bethi, Amakhosi amabini awakwazi ukubhekana naye; sizokwazi kanjani?

Wathumela ke umphathi wendlu, nomphathi wedolobha, nabakhulu, nabangani bakhe, kuYehu, bethi, Siyabe abakhonzi bakho; sizokwenza konke okushoyo kuthi. Sizokwenza umuntu abe ngukumkani; yenza konke okubukeka kukuhle emehlo akho.

UYehu wababhalela incwadi yesithathu, wathi kubo, Uma ningami, futhi uma nikhuluma ngamazwi ami, nizongiletha ikhanda lamadodana omnikazi wenu eJezreyeli ngoMsombuluko ngalolu sikhathi. Abantwana bakakumkani abangumashumi asixhenxe bakhulelwa ngabantu abakhulu bedolobha.
Wafika lo mbhalo kubo, bathatha oonyana bakakumkani abamashumi asixhenxe, babulala bonke, babeka izindlebe zabo ezitsheni, bamthumela kuye eJezreyeli.
Kwafika umthunywa, watshela uYehu, wathi, Bathole izinhlangothi zabantwana bakakumkani. Wathi uYehu, Nizibeke emgodini wedolobha ezindaweni ezimbili, kuze kube ekuseni.

Kwathi safika isihlwa, waphuma uYehu, wahlala phambi kwalabo bonke abantu, wathi, Akunalutho kuweni; ngiyakutshela ukuthi ngibeke isandla sami phezu komnikazi wami, ngawubulala; kodwa ngabaphi labo bonke abawubulalayo?
Uzokwazi lokhu, ukuthi akukho lutho elingenayo iNkosi elikhuluma ngalo phezu kwendlu ka-Ahabhi; iNkosi wenza lokho akushoyo ngomlomo womkhonzi wakhe uEliya.
Wabulala uYehu bonke abaseJezreyeli abasele kuAhabhi, nabenzi bakhe bonke, nabangane bakhe, nababapheki bakhe; akazange ashiye umuntu ophila.
Waphuma uYehu waya eSamariya, wafika eBhethe-ekedi, lapho ababusi bemisa khona izinkomo zabo.
Wathola abazalwane baka-Ahaziya ukumkani wakwaYuda, wathi kubo, Nibani na? Baphendula bathi, Siyindodana ka-Ahaziya; safika ukuvakashela oonyana bakakumkakhe, namantombazane owesifazane.
Wathi uYehu, "Bathabathe bahlala!" Bathabathe bahlala, babulala abantu abangumashumi amane nabini efulethini laseBethe-ekhedi; akazange ashiye omunye wabo.

UYehu, lapho ephuma khona, wahlangana no-Yonadabu unyana ka-Rekabhi, ehamba ukubhekana naye. Wakubonga yena uYehu, wathi kuye, "Ungithandela kanjani, njengoba ngikuthandela wena?" Waphendula uYonadabu wathi, "Ngangithandela." Wathi uYehu, "Uma ungumthandeli wami, nginike isandla sakho." Wayinika isandla sakhe, futhi uYehu wamphakamisa ebhasini.
Wathi uYehu kuye, Yiya nami, ubone ukuthi ngiyithanda kanjani iNkosi. UJonadabu wahamba naye ekheshi lakhe.
Wafika ke uYehu eSamariya, wabulala bonke abashiwo nguAhabhi eSamariya, wabasusa ngaso sonke isikhathi, njengokuthi iNkosi wathi kuEliya.
UYehu waqoqa bonke abantu, wathi, UAhabhi wakhonza uBahali kancane; uYehu uzowukhonza kakhulu.

Ngokuba, namuhla, hlanganisa bonke abaprofeti baka-Baali, nabenzi bakhe bonke, nababingeleli bakhe bonke; uqiniseke ukuthi akukho muntu ongekho, ngoba ngizonikela isiphuzo esikhulu ku-Baali. Nalowo ongafikanga, uzofa. "Akekho, kodwa uYehu wazama ukuwakhohlisa, ukuze asuse bonke abanikeli ka-Baali.
Wathi uYehu, Bukelani isibingelelo esingcwele kuBahali. Bathi ke, Bukelani.

UYehu wathumela ezweni lonke laseSirayeli, bafika bonke abakhonzi bakaBhaali; akukho muntu oshiyekile kubo. Basuka bengena endlini kaBhaali, kuze kube gcwele kusukela esiphethweni esisodwa kuya kwesiphequluli esisodwa.
Wathi uYehu kulowo ophethe izigqoko, Thola izigqoko kubo bonke abakhonzi bakaBhaali; wathola futhi izigqoko kubo.

Wathi uYehu, noYonadabu unyana ka-Rekabu, befika ethempelini likaBhaali; wathi uYehu kubo bonke abakhonzi bakaBhaali, Khumbulani futhi nibonane ukuthi akukhona lapha phakathi kwenu nanoma ngubani okhonzayo iNkosi, ngaphandle kwabakhonzi bakaBahali.

Baphuma ke, bangenisa amadini namadini okushiswayo; futhi uYehu ubebeka abantu abamashumi asibhozo ngaphandle, wathi kubo, Uma umuntu eshiya omunye walabo abantu engikulethelani ukuthi ahambe, uzofa ngempilo yakhe.

Ke kaloku, lapho uYehu eqedile ukunikela ngenhlanhla yokusindisa, wathi abaphathi bakhe nabasebenzi bakhe: "Ngena, babulala labo; angeke kube khona umuntu ophumayo." Bawabulala ngeqhwa. Bakhipha izicubu zabo, bafika egumbini elingaphakathi lendlu kaBaali.
Bakhipha amatshe angcwele ethempelini likaBaali, bawuthutha umlilo kuwo.
Baphula itshe elingcwele likaBaali, bavala isibhedlela sikaBaali, bayiguqula ibe yindawo yokugeza abantu, futhi iyikhona namanje.
Ngalokho uYehu wasusa uBhaali eSirayeli.
Kodwa-ke, uYehu akasukanga ezimpini zikaYarobhoamu, unyana kaNabati, awenza izizwe zaseSirayeli zihlupheke; waba nezinkomo zegolide eBhabheli naseDani.

Wathi iNkosi kuYehu, Ukwenze kahle ukuthi wenze okulungile emehlo ami; ngazo zonke izinto ezisenhliziyoni zami ungenzele indlu ka-Ahabhi; ngakho isizukulwane sakho sizohlala esibhedlela sakwaSirayeli kuze kube yiminyaka emihlanu.
Kodwa-ke, uYehu akazange acabangele ukuba ahambe ngenhliziyo yakhe yonke emthethweni kaYehova, uNkulunkulu wakwaSirayeli; akasukanga ezinkingeni zikaYarobhohamu, owenza amaSirayeli abe nezinkinga.
Ngalezi zinsuku iNkosi waqala ukuncipha amaSirayeli, futhi uHazayeli wabahlasela emazweni abo onke.
Wathatha izwe elasenyakatho-mpumalanga yeJordani, lonke izwe likaGiliyadi, lakwaGadi, nakwaRubheni, nakwaManase, kusukela eAroeri, enhliziyweni kaArnon, kuze kube yiGiliyadi noBashana.
Okunye okushiwo nguYehu, konke okwenze, nemisebenzi yakhe yonke, akubona bonke kubhalwe encwadini yamaqiniso kamakhosi aseSirayeli?
UYehu waphumula, wabanjwa eSamari; uYohahazi unyana wakhe waba ngukumkani endaweni yakhe.
UYehu waba ngukumkani phezu kwaSirayeli eSamari, iminyaka eyishumi nambili nesibhozo.
U-Athaliya, ubaba kaAhaziya, lapho ebona ukuthi unyana wakhe ufile, wavuka, wabulala wonke amalungu omndeni wakwabukhosini.

Kodwa uYoshuwa, intombi yokumkani uYoramu, inkosikazi kaAhahazi, wathatha uYohashi, unyana kaAhahazi, wamfihla phakathi kwabaphathi abazobulawa, wamfihla yena nowesifazane wakhe ekamelweni lokuphumula; akazange amthole uAthaliya, futhi akafanga.
Wahlala uYoashi nenkosikazi yakhe, efihlakele endlwini kaYehova iminyaka emihlanu; kodwa i-Athaliya yaba ngukumkani wezwe.

Kwathi ngonyaka wesixhenxe, uYehoyada ukumkani wathumela abambe abaphathi bezikhulu ezingu-makhulu, namaKareti, nabahlengikazi; wabangenisa endlwini kaYehova, wakwenza khona umshado nabo, wababeka emkhondweni endlwini kaYehova, wabonisana nabo unyana wokumkani.
Wathi kubo, Kulokhu okufanele nikwenze: isithathu senu esiphumayo ngeSabhati kufanele sigcine indlu kakumkani; kanti isithathu senu esiphumayo ngoMsombuluko kumele sigcine indlu kakumkani.
Omunye wesithathu uzobe esitezi se-Sur Gate, futhi owesibili wesithathu uzobe esitezi se-gate ngasemva kwamagwebu. Uzoshintshana ukuvikela ithempeli.
Lawa maqembu amabili phakathi kwenu, aphumayo ngeSabhati, azogcina indlu kaYehova emkhondweni wobukhosi.
futhi, uhlale phezu kwakhe, ngaso sonke isikhathi; futhi, uma kukhona umuntu ohamba phambi kwakho, kufanele abulawe; futhi, uma kukhona umuntu ohamba phambi kwakhe, kumele abulawe.

Bakwenza njalo abaphathi bezikhulu ezingu-makhulu, ngokuya ngawo wonke amalungiselelo kaYehoyada umbingeleli. Bathatha bonke abantu babo, labo abaphumayo eSabhati nalabo abasukayo, bafika kuYehoyada umbingeleli.
Wathi umbingeleli wabanika abaphathi amabhomu, namabhande, ayewo ukumkani uDavide, akhona ethempelini likaYehova.

Bathi abaphathi, ngaso sonke isikhathi wonke umuntu enesibhamu sakhe esandlani sakhe, bahlala phezu komkakhe, kusukela engxenyeni esenyakatho yendlu kuya engxenyeni esentshonalanga, phambi kwesibingelelo nendlu.
Wakhipha uYehoyada unyana kakumkani, wabeka phezu kwakhe isibhakabhaka, wamnika nencwadi yesivumelwano; bakwenza ube ngukumkani, bampompa ukhilimu. Baphoqa izandla zabo, bethi, Uphile ukumkani!
U-Athaliya, lapho ezwa khona izingcingo zezinkomo nezingcingo zabantu, waphuma waya esihlalweni sobukhosi sikaNkulunkulu.

Wabheka, wabona ukumkani ehlala eduze kombhoshongo, ngokwesiqalo; futhi amakhomishini namaphoyinti akhona eduze kukakumkani; nabantu bonke bezwe babezijabulisa, bephuza amaphoyinti. U-Athaliya wehlisa izigqoko zakhe, wathi, Kuyingozi! Kuyingozi!

Wathi uYehoyada, umbingeleli, kwabaphathi bamakhulu, abaphethe isibhakabhaka, esithi, Yikhuphele phandle phakathi kwezinqwaba zempi; nanoma ubani olandela yena, abulalane naye. (Ngenakho umbingeleli wathi, Akufanele abulawa endlwini kaYehova.)
Ngaleyo ndlela bathathela isandla sayo, yadlula emgwaqweni wokungenisa izikebhe ezindaweni zepalace, wabulawa khona.
Wakwenza uYehoyada isivumelwano phakathi kweNkosi, nokumkani, nabantu, ukuthi bazobe abantu bakaYehova; wakwenza futhi isivumelwano phakathi kukakumkani nabantu.

Kwathi abantu bonke belizwe bafika ethempelini likaBhaali, balimaza ithempeli lakhe, namathafa alo, nama-altare akhe, babulala uMathan, umbhishobhi kaBhaali, phambi kwamathafa. UYehoyada ukumkani wabeka izigwegwe endlwini kaYehova.

Wathatha abaphathi bezikhulu ezingu-makhulu, nama-karethi, nabahlengikazi, nabo bonke abantu basezweni, bakhuphula ukumkani ethempelini likaYehova; baphuma ngesango labahlengikazi befika endlwini yobukhosi. UMbuso wakwaSirayeli wahlala esihlalweni sobukhosi.
Abantu bonke bezwe baphumula, futhi umzi wawuhlanzekile; ngoba u-Athaliya wabulawa ngeqhwa endlwini kabukhosi.
UYowashe ubeneminyaka eyisikhombisa ubudala lapho eqala ukumkani.
Ngomnyaka wesixhenxe kaYehu ukumkani wakwaSirayeli, uYowashe waba ngukumkani; walawula iminyaka emashumi mane eYerusalem. Ubaba wakhe wayengu-Zibiya waseBeersheba.
UYowashe wakwenza okulungile ebusweni bukaYehova yonke leminyaka uYehoyada, umbingeleli, abemfundisa yona.
Kodwa-ke, izindawo eziphakeme azisuswa; abantu baqhubeka benikela khona, futhi befutha khona.

Wathi uYoashi kwababhishobhi, Nciphisani zonke izikweletu zezimali ezithunyelwa endlwini kaYehova, izimali zokubalwa kwabantu, nezimali zezibopho, nazo zonke izikweletu zezimali ezithunyelwa ethempelini likaThixo.
Kuzothathwa izimali ngaye wonke umpristi, kulabo abantu asebenza nabo; futhi uma uthola iyiphi inhlekelele endlwini yakho, uyilungise ngayo.
Kwathi ngonyaka ombili nesithathu wokubusa kukakumkani uYoashi, ababhishobhi abazange balungise indlu.

Wathi ukumkani uYowashi, wabiza uYehoyada umpristi, namanye amabhishobhi, wathi kubo, Yini ukuthi ningawulungisanga lo monakalo wendlu? Ngakho-ke, akufanele nithathe imali kulabo abasebenza kwenu; zinikele ukuwulungisa indlu.
Ababhishobhi bavuma ukuba bangaqoqi imali eningi kubantu, futhi ukuthi bangaba nesibopho sokulungisa ithempeli labo.
