Wathi uYehoyada, umpristi, wathatha ibhokisi elilodwa, wakwenza ukuvuza emlonyeni walo, wayibeka ecaleni lesibingelelo, ngakwesokudla lapho bephuma khona endlwini kaYehova. Babeka kulolu bhokisi zonke izikweletu ezithunyelwa endlwini kaYehova, ababhishobhi abagcina isingeniso.
Uma bebona ukuthi izimali ziningi ebhokisini, khona-ke kwafika umbhali wokumkani nombingeleli omkhulu, babala izimali ezithunyelwe endlwini kaYehova, bazibeka emigodini yabo.
Baye banikela imali elinganiselwe ezinyaweni zalabo abaphatha umsebenzi wendlu kaYehova, futhi laba bantu bakhokhela abaholi bezindlu, nabakhi, ababesebenza emsebenzini wendlu kaYehova,
futhi bathenga imithi, namatshe aqoshiwe, ukuze balungise indlu kaYehova, kanye nanoma yini edingekayo ukuwulungisa.

Ngalemali eyafakwa ethempelini likaYehova, akufanele kwenziwe amabhodlela esiliva, noma izitsha zokudla, noma izinkomishi, noma amabhungane, noma nanoma yiziphi izinto zegolide noma zesilivere ezisetshenziswa endlwini.
Kuye kwakhokhelwa labo abasebenza, basebenzisana nabo ukulungisa indlu kaYehova.
Abazange babuze abantu abalawulayo ukuthi benze i-accounting yemali enikezelwe kubo ukukhokhela abasebenzi, ngoba babe nobuhlakani obuphelele.
Imali yomnikelo wesono, nemali yomnikelo wokudla, ayikho eyafakwa endlwini kaYehova; yaba yiyo yamabhishobhi.
Ngaleso sikhathi uHazayeli ukumkani wakwa-Aram wahlasela iGathi, wayithatha. Wacabanga ukuhlasela iYerusalem.

Wathi uYoashi, ukumkani wakwaYuda, wathatha zonke izinto ezingcwele, abazukulu bakhe, uJehoshafati noYoramu noAhaziya, abakumkani bakaYuda, babezinikela ngazo, kanye nezipho zakhe, negolide lonke elalitholakala ezindaweni zokugcina zendlu kaYehova, nasezikhungweni zendlu yakhe, wayalela kuHazayeli, ukumkani waseAram. UHazayeli ke wehla eYerusalem.
Okunye okushiwo nguYohashi, konke okwenze, akubonakali kubhalwe encwadini yamaqiniso wamabukhosi bakwaYuda?
Abaphathi bakhe baphikisana naye, babulala uYoashi eBeth-Milo, enhliziyweni yendlela eya eSila.
Amadodana akhe abulala uYozabadi unyana kaShimeathi, noYozabadi unyana kaShomeri. Waphumula, wabulawa, washiswa nababa bakhe edolobhaneni likaDavide; waza waba ngukumkani uAmasiya unyana wakhe.
Ngomnyaka weshumi nambili nesithathu kaYowashi unyana kaAhaziya ukumkani wakwaYuda, uYehohazasi unyana kaYehu waba ngukumkani phezu kwaSirayeli eSamari; waba neminyaka eyisixhenxe nesikhombisa.
Wakwenza okubi emehloni kaYehova; walandela izinkinga zikaYarobhoamu, unyana kaNabati, owazenza izizwe zakwaSirayeli zihlupheke; akazange azihambe.
UYehova wagwema amaSirayeli, wabashiya emkhosini kaHazayeli ukumkani wakwa-Aram, noBhehadadi unyana wakhe, iminyaka eminingi.
UYehohaza wathandaza kukaNkulunkulu, futhi iNkosi wamphendula; ngoba wayebona ukuthi ukumkani waseSirayeli ubewenza abantu bakaSirayeli.
UYehova wabanika amaSirayeli umsindisi; baphuma ngaphansi kwesandla sama-Aram, futhi amaSirayeli ahlala ezindaweni zawo ngokuphephile, njengangaphambili.
Kodwa-ke, abasukanga emibiweni yomndeni kaYarobhoamu, owakwenza amaSirayeli ahlupheke; baqhubeka beyenza; futhi itshe lika-Ashere lahlala liseSamariya.

Umkhosi kaYehohahazi wawumisiwe, waba ngamabhayisikili amashumi amahlanu, namabhasi ayisithupha, namadoda angamakhulu amabili; ngoba ukumkani waseSirayeli wayewabulala labo abaseleyo, wabeka phezulu njengamatshe esikhathi sokudla.
Okunye okushiwo nguYehohahazi, konke okwenze, kanye nempumelelo yakhe, akubonakali kubhalwe encwadini yamaqiniso kakumkani bakaSirayeli?
Waphumula uYowahazi, washiswa eSamari; waba ngukumkani esikhundleni sakhe uYowashi unyana wakhe.
Ngomnyaka weshumi nambili nesishiyagalolunye kaYoashi ukumkani wakwaYuda, uYoashi unyana kaYehohahazi waba ngukumkani phezu kwaSirayeli eSamari; waba neminyaka eyishumi nanye nesikhombisa.
Wakwenza okubi emehloni kaYehova; akasukanga kuzo zonke izinkinga zikaYarobhoamu, unyana kaNabati, owenza amaSirayeli ahlupheke; waqhubeka ezenza.
Okunye okushiwo uYoashi, konke okwenze, kanye nobukhulu bakhe, nokuthi wabhekana kanjani noAmasiya ukumkani wakwaYuda, akubonakali kubhalwe encwadini yamaqiniso kakumkani bakaSirayeli?
Wafa u Rephaki, waba nguyise kaYoashi. UYerobohabhi wathatha indawo yakhe; futhi uYoashi wa葬wa eSamariya namakhosi aseSirayeli.
UElisha waba nesifo esibulalayo. UYowashe ukumkani wakwaSirayeli wehla waya kuye, wavuya phezu kwakhe, wathi, "Ubaba wami! Ubaba wami!" Wathi, "Izimoto zakwaSirayeli, namabhayisikili awo!"
Wathi uElisha kuye, Thola isibhamu namabhodlela; wathola ukumkani isibhamu namabhodlela.
Wathi uElisheha kukumkani wakwaSirayeli, Thola umcibisholo esandla sakho; wabeka izandla zakhe phezu kwezandla zomkani.

Wathi uElisha, Vula ifasitela elibheke enyakatho; wavula. Wathi uElisha, Thola, wathola. Wathi uElisha, Lokho wumphikisi wokuthula kaYehova, umphikisi wokuthula waseSirayeli! Uzobulala amaSirayeli e-Afeki, kuze kube yilapho.
Wathi uElisha, Thola amabhodlela. Kwathi lapho athola khona amabhodlela, uElisha wathi kuye, Ugweme izwe ngazo; wagwema izwe izikhathi ezintathu, wehle.

Umuntu kaThixo wehlulekile kuye, wathi: Kufanele uhlasele izwe izikhathi eziyisithupha noma eziyisishiyagalombili; khona-ke ubewunqoba wonke amaSirayeli; kodwa manje uzowahlasela amaSirayeli izikhathi ezintathu.
Wafa uElisha, washiswa. Kwaba khona amaqembu eMowabi ahlasela izwe ngaso sonke isikhathi sonyaka.

Kwathi, lapho abantu baseSirayeli bebulale umuntu, babone iqembu lamadoda ahlaselayo. Babeka isidumbu salowo muntu emgodini ka-Elisha, futhi lapho isidumbu salowo muntu sifinyelela emathunjini ka-Elisha, lo muntu waphila, wahlala emehlweni akhe.
UHazayeli ukumkani waseSirayeli wacindezela amaSirayeli zonke izinsuku zokubusa kukaYehohaza.

Kodwa iNkosi waba nenhlanhla nabantu bakaSirayeli, gramatisa kubo; wabhekana nabo ngenxa yomnqophiso wakhe noAbrahama, noIsake, noYakobi; akazange afune ukuwabulala, futhi akazange awasuse phambi kwakhe kuze kube yilapho.
Wafa uHazayeli ukumkani wakwa-Aram; waba ngukumkani esikhundleni sakhe uBenhadadi, unyana wakhe.

UYowashe unyana kaYehohazazi wabuyisela kuBhe-hadadi, unyana kaHazayeli, izidolobhana, abezithathele uHazayeli empilweni yakhe, ezisuka kuYehohazazi ubaba wakhe. Wahlasela uBhe-hadadi izikhathi ezintathu, wathola kabusha izidolobhana zikaSirayeli.
Ngomnyaka wesibili kaYowashi unyana kaYehohaza, ukumkani wakwaSirayeli, waba ngukumkani waseYuda uAmasiya unyana kaYowashi.
Ubeminyaka imashumi amabili anesihlanu ezelwe, lapho eqala ukumkani; waba neminyaka eyishumi nambili nesishiyagalolunye engukumkani eYerusalem. Umkakhe wayenguYehohadini waseJerusalema.
Wakwenza okulungile emehlo kaYehova, kodwa hhayi njengokuthi uDavide, ubaba wakhe, akwenze; wenza konke okwenze uYowashi, udadewabo.
Kodwa-ke, izindawo eziphakeme azisuswa; abantu baqhubeka benikela khona, futhi befutha khona.
Uma nje ethola ukulawula okuqinile kombuso, wakhipha abaphathi ababulale ubaba wakhe umkweluleki.

Kodwa izingane zalabo ababulalayo, awazibulala; njengoba kubhalwe encwadini yomthetho kaMoses, lapho iNkosi ewiselayo, esithi, Abazali bangafa ngenxa yabantwana babo, nabantwana bangafa ngenxa yabazali babo; wonke umuntu azofa ngenxa yomonakalo wakhe.
UAmasiya wabulala abantu abangumakhulu ayisishiyagalombili base-Edom eGoli leNhlanzi, wathatha iShela ngempi, washintsha igama layo libe yiYokteyeli, kuze kube namuhla.
UAmasiya wathumela abathunywa kuYoashi, unyana kaYehohazazi, unyana kaYehu, ukumkani wakwaSirayeli, esithi, Thola, sibhekene ngobuso nobuso.

UYowashe ukumkani wakwaSirayeli waphendula uAmasiya ukumkani wakwaYuda, wathi, Inkomo eLibanoni yathumela inkosikazi eLibanoni, isithi, Nciphisa indodana yakho kumntwana wami ukuba abe ngumkakhe. Kwafika khona inkomo yasendle eLibanoni, yaphula inkomo,
Uthi, "Kulungile ukuthi uhlasele iEdomu, futhi manje ufisa ukudubula; jabulela igama lakho, kodwa uhlale ekhaya lakho. Kungani na ucela isivivinyo, ukuze ugweme wena noYuda?"
UYoashi ukumkani wakwaSirayeli waya, wabhekana naye noAmasiya ukumkani wakwaYuda emdlalweni eBhethe-shemesi, elizweni laseYuda.
USirayeli wahlasela uYuda, futhi amadoda aseYuda ahambe, wonke umuntu ekhempini yakhe.

UYoashi ukumkani wakwaSirayeli wathatha uAmasiya ukumkani wakwaYuda, indodana kaYoashi, intombi kaAhahazi, eBhethe-shemesi. Wafika eYerusalem, wehlisa idonga layo kusukela emgwaqeni kaEfrayim kuya emgwaqweni wesikhunta, ingxenye eyinkulungwane nesishiyagalombili yamakomidi.
Wathatha yonke igolide nesilivere, nazo zonke izinto ezifunwa endlwini kaYehova, nasezinkundla zendlu yobukhosi; wathola futhi abasolwa, wabuyela eSamariya.
Okunye konke okwenze uYowashe, nemisebenzi yakhe, nendlela ayezama ngayo noAmasiya ukumkani wakwaYuda, akubona bonke babhalwe encwadini yamaqiniso kakumkani bakaSirayeli?
Waphumula uYoashi, wabanjwa eSamari, phakathi kwabavikeli bakaSirayeli; waza kwaba nguYerobohabhi unyana wakhe ukumkani endaweni yakhe.
UAmasiya unyana kaYowashi, ukumkani wakwaYuda, waphila iminyaka eyisishiyagalombili ngemuva kokufa kukaYowashi unyana kaYehohazazi ukumkani wakwaSirayeli.
Okunye okushiwo nguAmasiya, konke okwenze, akubonakali kubhalwe encwadini yezindaba zamakumkani baseYuda?
Bakwenza isinqumo kuye eYerusalem, waphuma waya eLakhishi; bathumela abantu emuva kwakhe eLakhishi, babulala khona.
Wathunyelwa ngebhayisikili, wabulawa eYerusalem, edolobhaneni likaDavide, nomndeni wakhe wonke.
Abantu bonke baseYuda bathatha uAzariya, owayeneminyaka eyisishiyagalombili ubudala, bamenza ukumkani endaweni kaAmaziya ubaba wakhe.
UAzariya wakwakha i-Elathi, wayibuyisela ezweni lakwaYuda, ngemuva kokufa kukayise ukumkani.
Ngonyaka oyisishiyagalombili kaAmasiya, unyana kaYowashi, ukumkani wakwaYuda, uYarobohami, unyana kaYowashi, waba ngukumkani phezu kwaSirayeli eSamari; waba neminyaka emashumi amane nanye.
Wakwenza okubi emehloni kaYehova; akasukanga kuzo zonke izinkinga zikaYarobhoamu, unyana kaNabati, azenzayo izizwe zakwaSirayeli.

Wabuyisela umkhawulo wamaSirayeli, kusukela lapho kungena khona iHamati enyakatho, kuze kube ulwandle olufihliwe enyakatho; ngokwelizwi likaYehova, uNkulunkulu wakwaSirayeli, elalishumayelwa ngumkhonzi wakhe uYona umprofeti, unyana kaAmithai, waseGathi-heferi.
Wayebona iNkosi ukuthi bonke abantu baseSirayeli bahlupheka kakhulu, nalabo abamnyama nalabo abamhlophe; kwakungekho umuntu osiza amaSirayeli.
UNkulunkulu akazange akhulume ukuthi uzosusa igama lakwaSirayeli ezweni; ngakho wabasindisa ngesandla sikaYarobhoamu unyana kaYowashi.

Okunye konke okwenze uYarobhoamu, zonke izinto zakhe, nekhono lakhe, nokuthi wahlasela kanjani, nokuthi wabuyisela kanjani eDamaseki noHamati kwaSirayeli, akukhona yini lokhu okubhalwe encwadini yamaqiniso kamakhosi aseSirayeli?
Waphumula uYarobhoamu, wagcwaliswa namakhosi aseSirayeli; waba ngukumkani esikhundleni sakhe uZekariya unyana wakhe.
Ngomnyaka weshumi nambili nesishiyagalolunye kaYerobohabhi ukumkani wakwaSirayeli, uAzariya unyana kaAmasiya waba ngukumkani ezweni laseYuda.
Ubeminyaka ilishumi elinamihlanu ezelwe, lapho eqala ukumkani; waba neminyaka eyishumi nambili nesishiyagalombili engukumkani eYerusalem. Ubaba wakhe wayenguJekoliya waseYerusalem.
Wakwenza okulungile emehlo kaYehova, ngokwezinto zonke azenzayo uAmasiya ubaba wakhe.
Kodwa-ke, izindawo eziphakeme azisuswa; abantu baqhubeka benikela khona, futhi befutha khona.
UYehova wabulala ukumkani ngendlala kuze kube ngusuku lwakhe lokufa; wahlala ekhaya elilodwa, futhi uYothamu unyana wakhe waba ngumphathi wendlu yakhe, elawula abantu bezwe.
Okunye okushiwo ngu-Uzariya, konke okwenze, akubonakali kubhalwe encwadini yamaqiniso wamabukhosi baseYuda?
U-Azariya waphumula, wabanjwa nababa bakhe edolobhaneni likaDavide; uYothamu unyana wakhe waba ngukumkani esikhundleni sakhe.
Ngomnyaka weshumi nambili nesishiyagalombili ka-Uzariya ukumkani wakwaYuda, uZekariya unyana kaYarobhoamu waba ngukumkani kwabaSirayeli eSamari; wahlala iminyaka emihlanu.
Wakwenza okubi ngamehlo kaYehova, njengokuthi kwakwenzela obaba bakhe; akasukanga ezimpini zikaYarobhoamu unyana kaNabati, azenzayo izizwe zaseSirayeli.
UShalumu unyana ka-Yabheshi wenza isizwe noZekhariya, wamshaya phambi kwabantu, wambulala, waba ngukumkani endaweni yakhe.
Okunye konke okwenze uZekariya, akubonakali kubhalwe encwadini yamaqiniso kamakhosi aseSirayeli?
Wathi iNkosi kuYehu, "Izingane zakho zizohlala ebukhosini bamaSirayeli kuze kube yiminyaka emihlanu."
Ngomnyaka weshumi nambili nesishiyagalombili ka-Uziya ukumkani wakwaYuda, uShalumu unyana kaYabheshi waba ngukumkani eSamari; waba ngukumkani enyanga eyodwa.
UManaheme unyana kaGadi wehla eThirsa waya eSamariya, wahlasela khona uShalumu unyana kaYabheshi, wambulala, waba ngukumkani endaweni yakhe.
Okunye okushiwo nguShalumu, nokuthi ukwenze kanjani, akubonakali kubhalwe encwadini yamaqiniso kaMasipala wamaNdiya?

Ngaleso sikhathi, uManaheme waphuma eTirsa, wahlasela iTipsa, nalabo bonke abakhona kuyo, kanye nezindawo ezingaphansi kwayo. Wahlasela iTifsa, ngoba abantu bayo bengeke bavule amasango abo kuye; wavula zonke izifazane ezikhulelwe kuzo.
Ngomnyaka weshumi nambili nesishiyagalombili ka-Uzariya ukumkani wakwaYuda, uManahemu unyana kaGadi waba ngukumkani phezu kwaSirayeli eSamari; waba neminyaka elishumi.
Wakwenza okubi emehloni kaYehova; akazange ahambe kuzo zonke izinsuku zakhe eziphilayo, ezindaweni zobubi zikaYarobhoamu unyana kaNebhati, owenza amaSirayeli abe nesono.
Wafika khona uPul, ukumkani wase-Ashuri, wahlasela izwe. UManaheme wamnika uPul amalitha ayishumi nesishiyagalombili esiliva, ukuze asize uPul, futhi agcine umkhosi wakhe.
UManaheme wathatha imali ezweni laseSirayeli, wabeka wonke umuntu ocebile ngeshekeli elilodwa legolide. Wayinikeza ukumkani wase-Ashuri; ngakho ukumkani wase-Ashuri wehla, akahlalanga ezweni.
Okunye okushiwo nguManaheme, konke okwenze, akubonakali kubhalwe encwadini yamavesi wamabukhosi baseSirayeli?
UManaheme wafa, uPekahiya unyana wakhe waba ngukumkani esikhundleni sakhe.
Ngomnyaka weshumi elinesihlanu ka-Uzariya ukumkani wakwaYuda, uPekahiya unyana kaManahemu waba ngukumkani phezu kwaSirayeli eSamari; wahlala iminyaka emibini.
Wakwenza okubi emehloni kaYehova; akasukanga ezindlwaneni zikaYarobhoamu unyana kaNabati, azenzayo izizwe zakwaSirayeli.

UPekahiya unyana kaRemaliya, omunye wabaphathi bakhe, wakwenza inkohlakalo kuye. Wahlasela uPekahiya eSamari, esitezi esiphakeme sendlu yakhe, namadodana akhe amashumi amahlanu aseGiliyadi; wambulala yena no-Argobhe no-Ariye, waba ngukumkani endaweni yakhe.
Okunye okushiwo nguPekahiya, konke okwenze, akubonakali kubhalwe encwadini yamaqiniso kamakhosi aseSirayeli?
Ngonyaka oyisishiyagalombili kaUzariya ukumkani wakwaYuda, uPekahi unyana kaRemaliya waba ngukumkani phezu kwaSirayeli eSamari; waba neminyaka eyishumi nambili.
Wakwenza okubi emehloni kaYehova; akasukanga ezindlwaneni zikaYarobhoamu unyana kaNabati, azenzayo izizwe zakwaSirayeli.

Ngosuku lukaPeka ukumkani wakwaSirayeli, kwafika uTiglatha-pilesere ukumkani waseAshuri, wahlasela iIyon, noAbeli-beth-maakha, neYanoa, neKedesh, neHazori, neGileyadi, neGalili, lonke izwe likaNaphtali; wabathwala ezweni laseAshuri.
UHosheya, unyana ka-Ela, wenza inkohlakalo noPekahi, unyana ka-Remaliya; wahlasela naye, wambulala, waba ngukumkani endaweni yakhe, ngonyaka weshumi nambili kaYothamu, unyana kaUziya.
Okunye okushiwo nguPekahi, konke okwenze, akubonakali kubhalwe encwadini yamaqiniso wamabukhosi baseSirayeli?
Ngomnyaka wesibili kaPeka unyana kaRemaliya waba ngukumkani wakwaSirayeli, uYothamu unyana kaUziya waba ngukumkani waseYuda.
Ubeminyaka imashumi amabili anesihlanu ezelwe, lapho eqala ukumkani; waba neminyaka eyishumi nanye nesishiyagalombili engukumkani eYerusalem. Umzali wakhe wayenguYerusha intombi kaTsadoki.
Wakwenza okulungile emehlo kaYehova, ngokwezinto zonke azenzayo uUziya ubaba wakhe.
Kodwa izindawo eziphakeme azisuswa; abantu baqhubeka benikela khona, befutha khona. UYothamu wakwakha isango eliphezulu ethempelini likaYehova.
Okunye okushiwo nguYothama, konke okwenze, akubonakali kubhalwe encwadini yamaqiniso kakumkani wakwaYuda?
Ngalezi zinsuku iNkosi waqala ukuthutha uResini ukumkani wakwa-Aram, noPekahi unyana kaRemaliya, ukuba bahlasele iYuda.
Waphumula uYothamu, wabanjwa nababa bakhe edolobhaneni likaDavide ubaba wakhe. UAhazi unyana wakhe waba ngukumkani esikhundleni sakhe.
Ngomnyaka weshumi nesishiyagalombili kaPekahi unyana kaRemaliya, ukumkani wakwaSirayeli, waba ngukumkani ezweni laseYuda uAhahazi unyana kaYothamu.

UAhazi ubeminyaka imashumi amabili ezelwe, lapho eqala ukumkani; waba neminyaka eyishumi nanye nesishiyagalombili engukumkani eYerusalem. Akakwenzanga okulungile phambi kwamehlo kaYehova uNkulunkulu wakhe, njengokuthi wayekwenze uDavide, umzali wakhe.
Wahamba ngezinqumo zamakhosi aseSirayeli, wabeka unyana wakhe emgodini, ngazo zonke izinto ezingcolile zomhlaba, azenzayo izizwe ebezithunyelwe nguYehova phambi kwamadodana kaSirayeli.
Wanikela, wamisa uvumba ezindlini eziphakeme, nasezintaba-mlilo, nangaphansi kwanoma yimuphi umnqumo oluhlaza.
Ngaleso sikhathi wafika uResini ukumkani wakwa-Aram, noPeka unyana kaRemaliya ukumkani wakwaSirayeli, ukuhlasela iJerusalema; bahlaba umxhwele uAhashe, kodwa abakwazi ukumnqoba.
Ngaleso sikhathi uRezin, ukumkani wase-Aram, wabuyisela i-Elathi ezweni lase-Aram, wakhipha khona abantu baseYuda; futhi abaEdomu basuka e-Elathi, behlala khona kuze kube manje.

U-Ahahazi wathumela abathunywa kuTiglathi-pilesere ukumkani wakwa-Ashuri, esithi, Ngiye umkhonzi wakho nonyana wakho; phuma usindise ebusweni bukakumkani baseSirayeli, nakwakumkani bamaSirayeli, abangihlasela.
U-Ahazi wathatha isiliva negolide elitholakala ethempelini likaYehova, nasezikhungweni zendlu ka-Ahazi, wayalela ukumkani wakwa-Asiriya njengesipho.
Wathi ukumkani wase-Ashuri, Uzohlasela iDamaseki, uzoyinqoba, uthathe abantu bayo abafileyo eKire, wabulala noRezini.
Ukumkani uAhazi waya eDamaseki ukubhekana noTiglatha-pilesere ukumkani wakwa-Ashuri, wabona khona isibingelelo; wathumela kuUriya umpristi isithombe sesibingelelo, nezithombe zayo zonke.
UUriya, umbingeleli, wakwakha isibingelelo, ngokusho kwazo zonke izifanekiso zokumkani Ahazi owawuzithumelele kusuka eDamasku; wawuqedile ngaphambi kokufika kukakumkani Ahazi eDamasku.
Kwathi lapho ukumkani ebuya eDamaskus, ebona isibingelelo, wenyuka waya kuso, wanikela phezu kwayo.
Washisa isonka sakhe esiqhumayo, nomnikelo wakhe wokudla, wageza umnikelo wakhe wokudla, wafafaza emgodini igazi lezinto zakhe zokuthula.
Wakhipha isibingelelo sesiliva esibe phambi koYehova, wayisa ebusweni bendlu, phakathi kwesibingelelo esisha nesibingelelo soNkulunkulu, wayibeka ngasenyakatho yesibingelelo esisha.

Wathi ukumkani uAhazi ku-Uriya umpristi, ethi, Kulesi sibhedlela esikhulu esitshalwe kabusha, usindise isiphuzo sokudla sakusihlwa, nesiphuzo sokudla sakusihlwa, kanye nesiphuzo sokudla sikakumkani, nesiphuzo sokudla sakhe, neziphuzo zokudla kwabantu bonke basezweni; futhi ufafaze phezu kwayo igazi lonke lesiphuzo sokudla, neziphuzo zokudla, neziphuzo zeziphuzo zabantu bonke baselizwe; kodwa isibhedlela sesiliva singami uma ngicela.
UUriya umbingeleli wenza konke okumwise ngawo ukumkani uAhazi.

UMbuso Wase-Ahazi wasusa amapaneli engxenyeni yezinhlamvu zegolide, wasusa amabhodlela azo. Wathatha ibhodlela elikhulu legolide elibizwa ngokuthi yiMfula, lalimaza izingulube zegolide ezilibambe, waligqugquzela phezu kwesisekelo setshe.
Wakhipha futhi umgwaqo wosuku lokuphumula, owakhiwa ethempelini, kanye nomnyango wangaphandle wobukhosi ethempelini likaYehova, ukuze athande ukumkani wase-Ashuri.
Okunye okushiwo ngu-Ahahazi, konke okwenze, akubonakali kubhalwe encwadini yamaqiniso kabukhosi baseYuda?
Waphumula uAhazi, washiswa nababa bakhe edolobhaneni likaDavide; uHezekiya unyana wakhe waba ngukumkani endaweni yakhe.
Ngomnyaka weshumi nambili ka-Ahazi ukumkani wakwaYuda, uHoshea unyana ka-Ela waba ngukumkani phezu kwaSirayeli eSamari; waba neminyaka eyithoba.
Wakwenza okubi emehloni kaYehova, kodwa akazange akwenze ngokufana namadodana aseSirayeli angaphambili kwakhe.
UShalmanesera ukumkani wakwa-Ashuri wahlasela uHoshea; uHoshea waba ngumkhonzi wakhe, wamnika imali ngonyaka wonke.

Kodwa ukumkani wakwa-Ashuri waqonda ukuthi uHoshea ekwenza isinqumo kuye. UHoshea wathumela abathunywa kuSo, ukumkani waseYiputa, wathi: "Uzoyeka ukunika umkhonyovu ukumkani wakwa-Ashuri, njengoba wenza ngonyaka nonyaka;" ngakho ukumkani wakwa-Ashuri wathatha uHoshea, wambeka emgodini.
Ke kaloku ukumkani wase-Ashuri waya ezweni lonke, wafika eSamariya, wayibamba iminyaka emithathu.
Ngomnyaka wesithoba wokubusa kukaHoshea, ukumkani wakwa-Ashuri wahlasela iSamariya, wabathwalisa amaSirayeli e-Ashuri, wababeka eHala, naseHabhori emfuleni waseGozani, namadolobhana aseMedi.

Lokhu kwakwenzeka ngenxa yokuthi abafundisi bakaSirayeli babephumile kuYehova, uNkulunkulu wabo, owabasusa ezweni laseYiputa, ngaphansi kwesandla sikaFaro, ukumkani waseYiputa, bakhonza amadini amanye.
Bahamba ngezimiso zezizwe, azenzayo iNkosi phambi kwabo, kanye nezimiso zabakumkani bakaSirayeli, ababeziqala ukwenza.
Bathi, "Sizokwenza konke lokhu; sizokwakha izindlu eziphakeme ezindaweni zabo zonke, kusukela enkabeni yedolobhana elincinane, kuze kube emzini omkhulu onezindonga."
Bamisa amatshe angcwele, namatshe e-Ashere, ngaso sonke isiqhingi esiphezulu, nangaphansi komhlaba wonke omnyama.
Bashisa umlilo emadolobheni aphezulu onke, njengokuthi izizwe ebezizikhuphe phambi kwabo iNkosi, bakwenza izinto ezibi, bephula inhliziyo kaYehova.
Bakhonza amathoyizi, okuthi iNkosi abewatshela ukuthi: "Ungakwenza lokhu."

Wathi iNkosi wabatshela amaSirayeli namadodana kaYuda, ngesandla samaprofeti bakhe bonke, ngalabo ababonayo, esithi, Buyele ezindaweni zenu ezibi, nigcine imiyalo yami, nezimiso zami, ngokugcwele umthetho engiwiselayo kubazali benu, nomthetho ongithumelele wena ngomsebenzi wami wamaprofeta.
Bathi ke, bangakutholi ukulalela; bakwenza ikhanda labo libe liqinile, njengamababa abo, ababengakholwa kuYehova uNkulunkulu wabo.

Bakhohlisa izimiso zakhe, namalungiselelo akhe, ayewamisa nababa babo, nezivivinyo zakhe awazibophezele kuzo; balandela izinto ezingenalutho, babe yizinto ezingenalutho; bakwenza ngokwezinto zakwamanye amazwe asendaweni yabo, okuthi iNkosi wabawisela umthetho ngazo, ukuthi bangazisebenzisi.
Basuka emibalweni yonke kaYehova uNkulunkulu wabo; bakwenza izinkomo ezimbili ezenziwe ngodonga, ne-ashere; basola zonke izinkanyezi zezulu, bakhonza uBhaali.
Babeka oonyana babo nezingane zabo emlilweni, basebenzisa amaphupho, namagqugquzeli, bathengisa izandla zabo ukuba benze okubi emehloni kaYehova, ukuze bamkhulise.
UYehova wehluleke kakhulu ngabaseSirayeli, wabasusa phambi kwakhe; kwashiwo nje isizwe sikaYuda kuphela.
Kodwa-ke, iYuda nayo ayigcinenga imiyalo kaYehova uNkulunkulu wabo; bahamba ngezimiso zakwaSirayeli.
Ngalokho, iNkosi wabasusa bonke abazalwane bakaSirayeli, wababulala, wabanikela esidlangalaleni, kuze kube yilapho awakhupha ebusweni bakhe.

Kwathi lapho iNkosi emisa amaSirayeli emndenini kaDavide, bakwenza uYarobohabhi unyana kaNabati waba ngukumkani wabo. UYarobohabhi wasusa amaSirayeli ekutholeni iNkosi, wababangela ukuba benze isono esikhulu.
AbaSirayeli baqhubeka behamba ngazo zonke izigebengu zikaYarobhoamu azenzayo; abasukanga kuzo.

kuze kube yilapho iNkosi esusa amaSirayeli phambi kwakhe, njengokuthi washo ngaso isandla sabo bonke abakhonzi bakhe abaprofeti. Bathunyelwe amaSirayeli emazweni abo, bathunyelwe eAshure, kuze kube namuhla.
Ubukhosi base-Ashuri bakhipha abantu eBhabheli, naseKutha, naseAvwa, naseHamati, naseSefarwayim, babeka emazweni aseSamariya endaweni yamaSirayeli; bathatha iSamariya, bahlala emizini yayo.
Esikhathini sokuqala lapho behlala khona, bangeke babe nokuthula kukaNkulunkulu; ngakho iNkosi wathumela phakathi kwabo izingulube, zababulala.

Bathi ke kubo ukumkani wase-Ashuri, besithi, Abantu abawuthukile owababeka ezindaweni zaseSamariya awazi imithetho kaThixo waleli lizwe; ngakho wathumela phakathi kwabo amakhoboka, futhi bona, ayawabulala, ngoba bangawazi imithetho kaThixo.
Wathi ukumkani wase-Ashuri, Yazisa omunye wabapristi abathunyelwe khona; ahambe ahlale khona, afundise abantu umthetho kaThixo waleli lizwe.
Wabuya ke omunye wababingeleli, abathunyelwe eSamariya, wahlala eBhetheleli, wafundisa abantu ukuthi bangabe bathandaza kuYehova.
Kodwa izwe ngalinye lakwenza izitha zayo, zazibeka ezindaweni eziphakeme, ababezenza abantu baseSamariya, izwe ngalinye emizini yawo lapho behlala khona.
Abantu baseBhabheli bakwenza iSukhothi-benothi; abantu baseKutha bakwenza uNergal; abantu baseHamati bayenza iAshima.
Aba-Avithi bakwenza iNibhazi neTarthaki, futhi aba-Sepharvithi bakhipha izingane zabo emlilweni, zibe ngumnikelo ku-Adrammelekhe no-Anamelekhe, amasiko ase-Sefarvayim.
Bathi, "Sizobhekana nawe," futhi bathathe abapristi eziphakeme, kusukela phakathi kwabo bonke abantu, futhi wanikela kubo ezindaweni eziphakeme.
Bakhonza iNkosi, kodwa bakhonza futhi amasiko abo, ngokwezimiso zazo zonke izizwe, lapho besuka khona.

Bahamba ngemithetho yabo yangaphambilini, kuze kube ngalolusuku; bangeke babe nenhliziyo engcwele kukaNkulunkulu, futhi bangazi imibandela yakhe, noma izimiso zakhe, noma imfundiso yakhe, noma umyalo wakhe, awawuthi kubo uYakobi, owabiza igama lakhe ngokuthi uSirayeli.
Wakwenza iNkosi umhlangano nabantwana bakaSirayeli, wathi kubo, Musani ukukhonza amadini amanye, noma niwukhonze, noma niwusebenzele, noma niwunikela kuwo.
UNkulunkulu kuphela owazibophezela kuye, owenza ukuthi nikhuphuke ezweni laseYiputa ngesandla esinamandla, nesandla esiqinile; yena kuphela ozowukhonza; yena kuphela ozowusola, uzowunikela.
Uzobhekana nomthetho wakhe, nemithetho yakhe, nezimiso zakhe, nemiyalo yakhe, awabhalela wena, ukuze uyigcine yonke imihla.
Umthetho wami engiwenza nani, ningawukhohlwa; futhi ningazibophezela emikhosini yabanye.
Uzokhonza iNkosi uNkulunkulu wenu; yena uzokusindisa ebusweni bomshayeli wakho wonke.
Kodwa abazange balalele. Baqhubeka belandela imikhuba yabo yakudala.
Ngakho-ke lezi zintokazi zathandaza kuYehova, futhi zakhonza izigodlo zabo; nabantwana babo, nabantwana bezindodana zabo, bakwenza njalo, njengabababa babo, kuze kube ngalolusuku.
Ngomnyaka wesithathu kaHoshea unyana ka-Ela, ukumkani wakwaSirayeli, kwaba nguHezekiya unyana ka-Ahazi ukumkani wakwaYuda.
Ubeminyaka imashumi amabili anesihlanu ezelwe, lapho eqala ukumkani; waba neminyaka engama-29 engukumkani eYerusalem. Umkakhe ubizwa ngokuthi nguAbi, indodana kaZekariya.
Wakwenza okulungile emehlo kaYehova, ngokwezinto zonke azenzayo uDavide, ubaba wakhe.

Wasusa izindawo eziphakeme, waphonsa amatshe angcwele, waphula izihlahla ze-Ashera; waphonsa futhi ibhodlela legolide, uMoses ayelile; ngoba kuze kube ngalolu sikhathi abantu baseSirayeli babewuthutha umnqumo kuwo; kwabizwa ngokuthi yiNehushtani.
UHezekiya ubeke ithemba lakhe kuYehova, uNkulunkulu kaSirayeli; kwaba khona othile ongafana naye phakathi kwamakhosi onke eYiputa, angaphambili kwakhe, namuva kwakhe.
Wazibophezela eNkosini, akazange ashintshe ukulandela kwakhe; wagcina imiyalo kaYehova, abewisela yona kuMoses.
Waye naye iNkosi, waphumelela kuwo wonke umsebenzi wakhe. Wayeka ukumkani wakwa-Ashuri, akazange amkhonze.
Wahlasela amaFilisti kuya eGaza nasezindaweni zayo, kusukela esitezi esincane sokubuka kuze kube yidolobha elikhulu elinabantu.
Ngomnyaka wesine wokumkani uHizekiya, (lokhu kwaba wunyaka wesixhenxe kaHoshea, unyana kaEla, ukumkani wakwaSirayeli), wafika uShalmanesera, ukumkani wakwa-Ashuri, waya eSamariya, wayibamba.
Ngonyaka wesishiyagalombili kaHizekiya, wunyaka wesithoba kaHoshea ukumkani wakwaSirayeli, iSamari yathathwa yi-Ashuri; kwathi lapho kudlule iminyaka emithathu, iSamari yathathwa.
Ubukhosi base-Ashuri bathwala amaSirayeli baya e-Ashuri, babebeka eHala, naseHabori, emfuleni waseGozani, namadolobhana aseMediya.

Lokhu kwakwenzeka ngenxa yokuthi abazange balalela izwi likaYehova uNkulunkulu wabo, kodwa baphula umhlangano wakhe, ngazo zonke izinto awisenzileyo uMoses, umkhonzi kaYehova; abangakutholi ukulalela, bangakutholanga.
Ngonyaka oyisishiyagalombili kaHezekiya ukumkani, wafika uSenhakeribhi ukumkani wakwa-Ashuri, waya kuwo wonke lamadolobha aseYuda anezindlu eziqinile, wawathatha.

UHezekiya, ukumkani wakwaYuda, wathumela kukumkani wase-Ashuri eLakishi, esithi, Ngiphumile; shiya ngami, ngizokulethela konke okushoyo. Wathi ukumkani wakwa-Ashuri kuHezekiya, ukumkani wakwa-Israyeli, ukuthi akulethe igolide elinamathani ayishumi nambili, nesiliva elinamathani ayisishiyagalombili.
Wathi uHizekiya wanikela ngegolide lonke elitholakala endlwini kaYehova, nasezikhungweni zendlu kayise.
Ngaleso sikhathi uHizekiya wasusa igolide elisuka emafasiteleni ethempelini likaYehova, nemilenze yawo, igolide ebelihlanganisiwe nguHizekiya, wamnika ukumkani wakwa-Ashuri.

Wathumela ukumkani wakwa-Ashuri uRahabhi, noRahabhethi, nomphathi wakhe, esuka eLakhishi waya kuHezekiya ukumkani waseYerusalem, namadoda amakhulu amaningi; bafika eJerusalema, bahlala emgodini wamanzi ophezulu wolwandle, enkabeni yomhlaba wokuhlanza.
Babiza ukumkani, waphuma uEliyakabhi unyana ka-Hilkiya, umphathi wendlu, noShebna umbhali, noYowahi unyana ka-Asaphe, umbhali, ukubabona.
Wathi kubo uRafeki, Nithi kuHezekiya: Usho lokhu ukumkani omkhulu, ukumkani wakwa-Ashuri, uthi: Yini le nto oyithembela ngayo?
Uthi unesiqiniseko futhi unamandla okulwa, kodwa la mazwi awukho lutho. Ubani ongathembela kuye, ukuthi unentshisekelo yokungcolisa?
Bheka, uthembela eYiputa, emgodini ophukile wokuhamba; uma umuntu ehleli phezu kwalo, lizoluka isandla sakhe. Ufana noFarawo ukumkani waseYiputa kuwo wonke umuntu onethemba kuye.

Kodwa uma ngithi kuwe, Sithembele kuYehova uNkulunkulu wethu? Akuyena yini lowo owakhipha amathempeli akhe aphezulu nama-altare akhe, uHizekiya? UHizekiya akabi wathi ezweni laseYuda naseYerusalem, Nizibophezele esihlahleni esinjalo eJerusalema?
Manje ke, ngithi kuwe, bhekana nonkosi wami, ukumkani wase-Ashuri; ngizokunika izimvu ezingu-elilodwa, uma ungakwazi ukuletha abahamba ngazo.
Ingabe ungakwazi ukubuyisela emuva umphathi oncane phakathi kwabakhonzi bakankosi yami? Kodwa-ke, ubeke isandla sakho eYiputa ngenxa yezimoto namabhayisikili!
Futhi, ngabe ngafika ngihlasela le ndawo, ukuze ngiyibhubhise, ngaphandle kukaYehova? UNkulunkulu wathi kuye, Yiya phezu kwalolu lizwe, uyibulala.

Wathi uEliyakimu, unyana kaHilkiya, noShebna, noYoha, ku-Arphaxadi, Ngiyakucela, ukhulume nabangani bakho ngesiArami, ngoba siyazi; futhi ungakhuluma nathi ngesiHebhere, abantu abasesitezi esiphezulu bezwa.

Waphendula uRafeki, wathi, Ingabe umnikazi wami ungithumelele kumphathi wakho, nawe kuphela, ukuthi ngikhulume la mazwi? Okusho ukuthi, wathumela kulabo abantu abasesitezi esiphezulu; bona nabo bazodla izinyama zabo, futhi bazodla isisu sabo, njengawe.
Wathi uRafeki, ehlala khona, wathi ngesiHebhere, Yizani igama lomphathi omkhulu, umphathi wase-Ashuri!
Uthi lo mfana, Musani ukuxoshwa nguHezekiya, ngoba akakwazanga ukuxosha nisuka emandleni am.
Akufanele uHizekiya akwenzeni nithembe kuYehova, athi, UNkulunkulu uzosikhulula; lo mzi awuzothunyelwa emkhosini kakumkani wase-Ashuri.

Ungamtholi uHizekiya; ngoba lokhu kusho ukumkani wakwa-Ashuri, uthi: Ukwenzeni isivumelwano nami, nizophuma nimi, nidla wonke umuntu izimbali zakhe zewayini, nemithi yakhe yesivinini, niphuze amanzi emgodini wakhe,

kuze ngifike, ngikuthatheni izwe elifana nezwe lenu, izwe lembewu newayini elisha, izwe lenyama nezihlahla zezinkomo, izwe lezithelo ze-olive nengulube. Khetha ukuphila, hhayi ukufa; futhi ningawutholi umsindo kaHizkiyahi, uma ekhohlisa nithi, UNkulunkulu uzosisindisa.
Ingabe kukhona iNkosi yezwe elishalile izwe layo ngaphansi kwesandla sikakumkani wase-Ashuri?
Ngawaphi amasiko aseHamati, ne-Arpadi? Ngawaphi amasiko aseSepharvayim, neHena, ne-Iva? Basindise yini iSamariya esandla sami?
Yikuphi phakathi kwazo zonke izitha zalezi zindawo, okwaziyo ukusindisa izwe lakhe ngami? Ngabe iNkosi angasindisa kanjani iJerusalema ngami?"
Abantu ke banyamalala, bangaphendulanga lutho; ngoba ukumkani ubewisela umyalo, esithi, Ungawuphenduli.

UEliyakamu unyana ka-Hilkiya, umphathi wendlu yasebukhosini, noShebna umbhali, noYowa unyana ka-Asaphu, umbhali wezincwadi, bafika kuHezekiya, begqoke izicathulo zabo zilahlekile, baveza kuye amazwi ka-Arpaksade.
Kwathi lapho uHezekiya ukumkani ekubona khona lokhu, waxosha izigqoko zakhe, wagqoka igxathu negxathu, waya endlwini kaYehova.
Wathumela uEliyakamu, ophethe indlu, noShebna umbhali, namadoda amakhulu ebandla lamaBhenjamini, bonke begqoke izingwegwe, kuIsaya umprofeti unyana kaAmozi.
Bathi kuye, UHizekiya usho lokhu: Namuhla usuku lobuhlungu, nokuhlukunyezwa, nokugxekwa; thina sifana nomkakhe ongeke akwazi ukubeletha, kodwa asinamandla okubeletha.

Kungenzeka ukuthi iNkosi, uNkulunkulu wakho, alalele amazwi kaRafeki wonke, owawuthunyelwe ngunkosi wakhe, ukumkani wakwa-Ashuri, ukuba abusise uNkulunkulu ophilayo; kungabonakala ukuthi iNkosi, uNkulunkulu wakho, agweme amazwi akhe, awavamile; ngakho ke thandaza ngenxa yethu encane esihlala yona.
Bafika abaphathi bakakumkani uHezekiya kuIsaya,
Wathi uIsaya kubo, Nithi kunkosi wenu, Usho lokhu iNkosi: Musa ukukhathazeka ngezinhlamvu ozibonayo, ngazo zonke izinkolelo abakhonzi bakakumkani wase-Ashuri bakhuluma ngami.
Ngakho, ngizobeka umphefumulo kuye; futhi uma ethola izindaba, uzobuya ezweni lakhe; futhi lapho, ezweni lakhe, ngizobulala yena ngekhebula. "
U-Arpaksade, lapho ezwa ukuthi ukumkani wakwa-Ashuri ushiye iLakishi, wabuyela, wathola ukumkani ehlasela iLibna.
Kwathi lapho ukumkani wakwa-Ashuri ekubona ukuthi uTirhakha, ukumkani wakwa-Ethiopia, usephuma ekulwa naye, wathumela abathunywa kuHezekiya, esithi,
Nithi kuHezekiya ukumkani wakwaYuda, Nithi: UNkulunkulu wakho, okholwa kuye, angakukhohlisa, ekhuluma ukuthi, IYerusalem ngeke inikezelwe emkhosini kakumkani wase Ashuri.
Ngiyabona ukuthi ufunde lokho abakwenzayo amakhosi ase-Ashuri ngazo zonke izizwe, bezibulala ngokugcwele. Ingabe wena uzosindiswa?
Ingabe ama-Amori, namaGozi, namaHarani, namaRezephi, nalabo base-Eden abahlala eTelasare, basindiswe yimimoya yamazwe amakhosikazi ami ayewabulala?
Ukhona yini ukumkani waseHamati? Ukhona yini ukumkani waseArpadi? Ukhona yini ukumkani waseSepharvayim, neHena, ne-Iva?"
Wathatha uHizekiya incwadi enhliziyweni yabathunywa, wayifunda; wanyuka waya endlwini kaYehova, wayivulela phambi koYehova.
Wathandaza uHizekiya kuYehova, wathi: UHulumeni, uNkulunkulu wakwaSirayeli, ohlala phezu kwamakherubi, wena kuphela uNkulunkulu wazo zonke izizwe zezulu; wena owenza izulu nezulu.
UNkulunkulu, uvule amehlo akho, ubone; lalela amazwi ka-Senhakeribi, owawuthumelele ukucasuka kukaNkulunkulu ophilayo.
Kulungile, Nkosi yami, ukuthi ubukhosi base-Ashuri babulala zonke lezi zizwe nezindawo zabo.
Babeka amatshe abo emlilweni, ngoba angeke abe ngamatshe, kodwa ukhuni nomlilo owenziwe ngezandla zabantu; ngakho-ke izwe laseAsiriya likwazile ukuwabulala.
Ngakho manje, Nkosi yethu uNkulunkulu wethu, sisindise esandla sakhe; ukuze zonke izizwe zezulu zikwazi ukuthi wena kuphela, Nkosi yethu, uNkulunkulu.
UIsaya unyana ka-Amozi wathumela kuHizekiya, esithi, Uthi lokhu iNkosi, uNkulunkulu kaSirayeli: Ngokuba ubulawe ngami mayelana noSanheribi ukumkani wakwa-Ashuri, ngikulalela.
Lakho igama iNkosi awakhuluma ngalo, ethi: Indodakazi yaseSiyone iyakuxosha, idlala nawe; idolobha laseJerusalema lishaya ikhanda lakhe phezu kwakho, uma usuhamba.
Ubani owenza ubuhlungu, nokwenqaba? Ubani owenza izingcezu, nokubona phansi ngothando olukhulu? Wabe nguMngcwele kaSirayeli!

Uthi, Ngezimoto zami eziningi, ngifike emifuleni ephakeme kakhulu, ezindaweni eziphezulu zeLibanoni; ngawususa umnqumo wayo ophakade, namaqabunga akhe angcono; ngafika emaphethelweni ayo, ezindaweni zayo ezibomvu.
Ngithole izimpophoma, ngadla amanzi azo; ngizitshisa zonke izintaba zaseYiputa ngezinyawo zami. UNkulunkulu wathi:
Awazi yini? Kudlule isikhathi eside ngiyilungiselele. Ezikhathini zakudala ngiyihlela, futhi manje ngiyenza ikwenzeke. Ngikuvumele ukuthi uguqule imiphakathi ethengwe ngamatshe ibe yizintaba-mlilo.

Ngakho abantu babo balahlekile amandla abo, bakhathazekile, bakhohlwa. Babe njengamaqabunga ezindaweni zomhlaba, njengezitshalo eziluhlaza, njengezihlahla zendlu yasemadolobheni, ezishisayo ngaphambi kokuba zikhule.
Ngiyazi lapho uhlala khona, futhi lapho uphuma khona, futhi lapho ufika khona; ngizi ukuthi ukhathazekile kimi.

Ngenxa yobugebengu bakho ngami, futhi ngenxa yokuthi ngikuvile ukukhuluma kwakho okudumile, ngakho-ke ngizobeka isibhamu sami emlonyeni wakho, nentambo yami emphinjeni yakho, futhi ngizokubuyisela emuva ngendlela osuka kuyo.

Nalokhu kuzoba yisibonakaliso kuwe, wena uHizekiya: Lo nyaka uzodla okuvela ngaso; nonyaka olandelayo uzodla okuvela kuso; kodwa ngonyaka wesithathu uzotshala, uzovuna, uzotshala izivini, uzodla imbewu yazo.
Nabo abasolwa, nalabo abashiywe ezweni likaYuda, bazophinde babeke izitshalo zabo eduze komhlaba, futhi bazokhiqiza imbewu phezulu.
Bazophuma eJerusalema abantu abafileyo, nalabo abaphilile bazovela emfuleni iSiyone. Uthando lweNkosi luzokwenza lokhu.
Ngako oko iNkosi uthi ngalolu daba lokumkani wase-Ashuri: Akuzofika kulo mzi, akawuthuli khona umcibisholo wakhe; ngeke afike kuwo ngendwangu, futhi ngeke akhiphe izingcezu zodonga phezu kwalo.
Uzobuyela ngendlela asuka ngayo; ngeke afike kulo dolobha, kusho iNkosi.
Ngizovikela lo mzi, ngiwusindise, ngenxa yami, futhi ngenxa yomkhonzi wami uDavide.'

Ngaleyo busuku waphuma umprofeti kaYehova, wabulala esiteshini sama-Ashurini abantu abangamakhulu amathathu anamashumi asibhozo anesihlanu amawaka. Bavuka basuka emveni kwemini, futhi bona, kwakukhona izicubu ezifile kuwo wonke indawo.
USanheribi ukumkani wakwa-Ashuri wehla, wabuyela ekhaya lakhe, waya eNineve.

Kwathi, ngesikhathi ekhonza ethempelini likaNisroki uNkulunkulu wakhe, uAdrammeleki noSharezere, oonyana bakhe, bambulala ngeqhwa, baphuma besuka ezweni lase-Ararati. UEsarhadoni, unyana wakhe, waba ngukumkani endaweni yakhe.
Ngaleso sikhathi uHizekiya waba nesifo sokufa. Wafika kuye uIsaya umprofeti, unyana ka-Amozi, wathi kuye, Uthi lokho iNkosi: Nquma izinto zakho, ngoba uzofa; ngeke uzizwe ungcono.
UHezekiya wabheka ubuso bakhe edonga, wathandaza kuYehova,
Ngicela, Nkosi yami, khumbula manje ukuthi ngihamba phambi kwakho ngeqiniso ngenhliziyweni yami yonke, futhi ngakwenza okulungile ebusweni bakho.
Ngaphambi kokuba uIsaya ahambe esitezi esiphakathi, kwafika igama likaYehova kuye, lithi:

Uzobuyela, ukhulume noHezekiya, uthi: UNkulunkulu, uNkulunkulu kaDavide umzali wakho, usho lokhu: Ngiye ngakulalela ukuthandaza kwakho, ngakubona inkanuko yakho; ngiza kukuphilisa. Ngosuku olulandelayo uzoya ethempelini likaYehova.

futhi ngizongeza ezinsukwini zakho iminyaka eyisishiyagalombili; futhi ngizokusindisa wena nalesi sixeko emkhosini kakumkani wase-Ashuri. Ngizovikela lesi sixeko ngenxa yami, ngenxa yomkhonzi wami uDavide.
Wathi uIsaya, Nciphisa isiphuzo sezinkomo. Bayithatha, bayibeka phezu kobuhlungu; futhi uHezekiya waphiliswa.
Wathi uHizekiya kuIsaya, Ingabe yini inkomba yokuthi iNkosi uzongiphilisa, nokuthi ngizokwehla ethempelini likaYehova ngosuku olulandelayo?
Wathi uIsaya, Lolu phawu oluvela kuYehova, ukuthi uNkulunkulu uzokwenza lokhu akushoyo: Ingabe isithunzi sizohamba phambili izinyawo eziyishumi, noma sizobuyela emuva izinyawo eziyishumi?
Wathi uHizekiya, Kuhle kakhulu ukuthi isithunzi sihambe izingcezu ezingu-10 phambili; kodwa ngizoyibuyisela emuva izingcezu ezingu-10.
UIsaya umprofeti wayalela iNkosi, wakwenza isithunzi sibuyela emuva izinyawo eziyishumi eziphezulu esitezi sika-Ahaze.
Ngaleso sikhathi uMerodakhi Baladani, unyana kaBaladani, ukumkani waseBhabheli, wathumela umbiko nomnikelo kuHezekiya; ngoba wayefundile ukuthi uHezekiya ubefile.

UHizekiya wamukela labo, wababonisa konke okukhona ezindaweni zakhe zokugcina izinto, isiliva, negolide, nezithako, nophethiloli oluhle, namathuluzi akhe, nanoma yini ekhona ezindaweni zakhe zokugcina izinto; kwakungekho lutho enkundleni yakhe, noma emlandweni wakhe wonke, uHizekiya engababonile.
Wafika uIsaya umprofeti kuHezekiya ukumkani, wathi kuye, Bathi yini labo bantu? Bavela kuphi? UHezekiya waphendula wathi, Bavela ezweni elisendaweni enkulu, eBhabheli.
Wathi uIsaya, Babonani endlu yakho? UHezekiya wathi, Babone konke okusendlini yami; akukho lutho ezindleleni zami engingeke ngibabonisele.
Wathi uIsaya kuHizekiya, Ngisho ilizwi likaYehova:
Ngiyabona ukuthi izinsuku zizofika, lapho konke okukhona endlu yakho, nalokho obaba bakho abawuqoqe kuze kube ngalolusuku, kuzothunyelwa eBhabheli; ngeke kushiyeke lutho, kusho iNkosi.
Bazothathwa nabangani bakho, abazaliswe emndenini wakho; futhi bazobe ngabaphathi endlu kakumkani waseBhabheli.
Wathi uHizekiya kuIsaya, Lilungile ilizwi likaYehova olikhulumayo. Wathi ke uHizekiya, Ingabe ngeke kube khona isiqiniseko nokuthula emini yami?
Konke okushiwo nguHizekiya, namandla akhe wonke, nokuthi wenza kanjani i-aquarium, nodonga oluletha amanzi edolobhaneni, akukabhalweni ekhishini lezindaba zamakumkani baseYuda?
UHezekiya wafa, uManase unyana wakhe waba ngukumkani endaweni yakhe.
UManase ubeneminyaka engu-12 ubudala lapho eqala ukumkani; waba ngukumkani eYerusalem iminyaka eyishumi nambili nesishiyagalombili.
Wakwenza okubi emehloni kaYehova, walandela izinto ezingathandeki zazo zonke izizwe, azenzayo iNkosi phambi kwabantwana bakaSirayeli.

Wakwakha kabusha izindawo eziphakeme, ayise uHizekiya ayezisusa, wamisa izibingelelo kuBahali, wakwenza i-ashere, njengoba wayeyenze uAhabhi ukumkani wakwaSirayeli; wabheka phansi, wakhonza zonke izinkanyezi zezulu.
Wakha izibhedlela endlwini kaYehova, lapho iNkosi ebethi khona, EYerusalem ngizobeka igama lami.
Ezindaweni ezimbili zangaphakathi zendlu kaYehova, wakha izibingelelo ezibomvu zonke ezingcezu zomhlaba.

Wabeka unyana wakhe emgodini, wasebenzisa amaphupho, wazama ukucabanga ngezinkanyezi, wabhekana nalabo abanezinhlamvu zomoya, nalabo abanezinhlamvu zezulu. Wakwenza okubi kakhulu emehlo kaYehova, wamangalisa uNkulunkulu.

Wathatha i-ashere eyingqayizivele, ayenze yona, wayibeka ethempelini, lapho iNkosi ebemtshela khona uDavide noSolomoni unyana wakhe, esithi, Endlwini lendlu, naseJerusalema, engikhethele kuyo zonke izizwe zakwaSirayeli, ngizobeka igama lami kuze kube sekupheleni.

futhi ngeke ngiphinde ngishiye izandla zakwaSirayeli zihamba ngasohlangothini oluthile ezweni engilile kubaba babo, uma nje begcina ukukwenza konke okungiwisela umthetho ngalo, njengoba umkhonzi wami uMosis awisenzile.
Kodwa abantu abazange baphendule, ngoba uManase wabakhohlisa ukuba benze okubi kakhulu kunazo zonke izizwe, azenzayo iNkosi phambi kwamadodana kaSirayeli.
Wathi iNkosi ngezandla zabangane bakhe abaprofeti, wathi,

UManase ukumkani wakwaYuda wenza lezi zinto ezingathandeki, wakwenza okubi kakhulu kunabo bonke ama-Amori abahlala lapha phambi kwakhe; futhi wabangela ukuba izwe laseYuda lizinikele ngezinhlamvu zakhe.
Ngako oko utsho iNkosi, uNkulunkulu kaSirayeli, esithi, Khayi, ngizoletha indlala eYerusalem naseYuda, kuze kube yilapho wonke umuntu okubonayo, izindlebe zakhe zibe zinde.

Ngizoyilinganisela iYerusalem ngentambo yami yokulinganisa, eniyibeke eSamariya, nentambo yami yokulinganisa, eniyibeke emndenini ka-Ahabhi; futhi ngizoyihlanza iJerusalema, njengokuthi umuntu ahlanze isidlo, ayihlanze, ayishintshele phansi.
Ngizoshiya isibopho sabantu bam, labo abasele, ngibamise ezinyaweni zababi babo; nabo bonke ababi babo bazowabulala, futhi bathathe izinto zabo.
ngenxa yokuthi bakwenze lokho okubi ngamehlo ami, futhi bemicindezela kusukela kuleso sikhathi abangababa babo baphuma eYiputa kuze kube manje.

UManase wabulala futhi abantu abangenacala, kuze kube yilapho egcwele khona iYerusalem ngegazi labo, kusukela esiphethweni esisodwa kuya kwesiphequluli esisodwa; ngaphandle kwedhambi lakhe eliwenza amaYuda aphume kulo, ukwenza okubi ngamehlo kaYehova.
Uma kukhulunywa ngezinye zezinto azenzayo uManase, nezenzo zakhe zonke, kanye nobubi bakhe, kubonakala sengathi konke lokhu kubhalwe encwadini yamaqiniso kakumkani wakwaYuda.
Wafa uManase, wabanjwa efulethini lakhe, efulethini likaUza. UAmoni unyana wakhe waba ngukumkani esikhundleni sakhe.
UAmoni ubeneminyaka eyishumi nambili ubudala lapho eqala ukumkani; waba ngukumkani iminyaka emibini eYerusalem. Ubaba wakhe wayenguMeshulemeti, intombi kaHaruzi waseYotbha.
Wakwenza okubi ngamehlo kaYehova, njengokuthi uManase ubaba wakhe abewenza.
Wahamba yonke indlela owawuhamba ngayo ubaba wakhe, wakhonza amatshe afana nalawo abewakhonza ubaba wakhe, wayazinikela kuwo.
Wasuka elandela iNkosi, uNkulunkulu wakwababa bakhe, akahamba ngezindlela zikaYehova.
Abaphathi baka-Amoni bahlela ukulwa naye, babulala ukumkani endlu yakhe.
Kodwa abantu basezweni babulala bonke labo abaphikisayo ukumkani uAmoni; futhi abantu baselizwe bakwenza uYosiya, unyana wakhe, waba ngukumkani endaweni yakhe.
Okunye okushiwo nguAmoni, konke okwenze, akubonakali kubhalwe encwadini yezindaba zamakumkani baseYuda?
Wagcwaliswa emgodini wakhe, efulethini lika-Uza. UYosiya unyana wakhe waba ngubukhosi esikhundleni sakhe.
UYosiya ubeneminyaka eyisishiyagalombili ubudala lapho eqala ukumkani; waba ngukumkani iminyaka engu-31 eYerusalem. Umzali wakhe wayenguYedida, indodana kaAdaya waseBozkhathi.
Wakwenza okulungile emehlo kaYehova, wahamba yonke indlela kaDavide, ubaba wakhe; akashintshi ngakwesokudla noma ngasekhohlo.
Ngonyaka oyisishiyagalombili wombuso kaYosiya, uYosiya wathumela uShafani, indodana ka-Azaliya, indodana kaMeshulamu, umbhali, endlwini kaYehova, wathi,
Hamba ufike ku-Hilkiya, umpristi omkhulu, uyeke ukulinganisa imali eyafakwa endlwini kaYehova, leyo abaphathi bezindonga ababeyiqoqe kubo bonke abantu.
Bazobeka kuwo amehlo labo labo abaphatha umsebenzi wendlu kaYehova, babeke kuwo amehlo abo labo abalungisa umsebenzi wendlu kaYehova.
labo abasebenza ngokhuni, nalabo abaqambi, nalabo abakhi izindonga; bathenge futhi imithi nodonga olucwebezelayo, ukuze balungise indlu.
Akudingeki ukuthi bacabange ngemali abayitholayo, ngoba bahlala bethembekile."
Wathi uHilkiya, umbingeleli omkhulu, kuShafani umbhali, esithi, Ngithole incwadi yomthetho endlwini kaYehova. Wanikela incwadi kuShafani, wafunda yona.
Waphuma uShafani umbhali, waya kukumkani, wathi, Abaphathi bakho bakhiphe imali etholakalayo endlwini kaYehova, bayidlulise ezinyaweni zalabo abaphatha umsebenzi wendlu kaYehova.
Wathi uShafani umbhali kuye ukumkani, ethi, UHilkiya umbingeleli wanikeza incwadi. Wafunda yona uShafani phambi kokumkani.
Kwathi lapho ukumkani ekhuluma ngamazwi encwadini yomthetho, waxosha izigqoko zakhe.
Wathi uSolomoni kuHilkiya ukumkani, no-Ahikamu unyana kaShafani, no-Akhobore unyana kaMikaya, no-Shafani umbhali, no-Asaya umkhonzi wobukhosi:

Hamba nibuze iNkosi ngami, nalabo bantu, namaYuda onke, ngezinto ezibhalwe kulolu ncwadi oluthunyelwe; ngoba indlala kaYehova ikhulu kakhulu, futhi ihlukumele phezu kwethu, ngenxa yokuthi ababa bethu abazange balalele amazwi alo ncwadi, besenza konke okubhalwa kulo.

UHilkiya umbingeleli, no-Ahikamu, no-Akhobore, no-Shafane, no-Asaya, baya ku-Hulda umprofeti, indodana ka-Salumu, unyana ka-Tikwa, unyana ka-Harhasha, ophethe izigqoko zobukhosi; wahlala eJerusalema, ezindaweni ezintsha.
Wathi kubo, Usho lokhu iNkosi, uNkulunkulu kaSirayeli: Nithi kulowo muntu owabathumelela kuye:
Uthi iNkosi ukuthi, Bheka, ngizoletha umonakalo phezu kwalo mhlaba nomphakathi walo, ngokwezinto ezibhalwe encwadini ebeyifunda ukumkani wakwaYuda.
Bamishe ngami, bamisa umlilo emadini amanye, ukuze bandise inkanuko yami ngezinto zabo zonke ezenziwe ngamazandla abo; ngakho indlala yami izoqhuma phezu kwalo mhlaba, futhi ngeke iphele.
Kodwa kukumkani wakwaYuda, owabathumela ukuthi nibuze iNkosi, nithi kuye, UNkulunkulu kaSirayeli uthi lokhu mayelana namazwi awaziyo:

Ngokuba inhliziyweni yakho yanyamalala, futhi ukhohlakele phambi koYehova, lapho ukuzwa khona lokho engikushoyo ngalolu dolobhana nalabo abahlala kulo, ukuthi bazoba yindawo yokuhlukunyezwa, nendawo yokulaliswa; nawe waxosha izigqoko zakho, wakhala phambi kwami; ngakho ngikuphendule, kusho iNkosi.
Ngalokhu, bheka, ngizokususa uhlale nababa bakho, uzogqugquzelwa ngokuthula; futhi ngeke ubone izinkinga zonke, engizozisa ngazo kule ndawo. Bathi ke kubo ukumkani.
Wathumela ukumkani, wabiza bonke abakhulu baseYuda nabaseYerusalem; bafika behlangana naye.

Waphuma ukumkani waya endlwini kaYehova, naye wonke amadoda aseYuda, nalabo bonke abahlali baseYerusalem, namabhishobhi, namaprofeti, nabo bonke abantu, kusukela kulowo oncane kuye kulowo omkhulu; wafunda emlonyeni wabo zonke izindaba zencwadi yesivumelwano esithunyelwe ethempelini likaYehova.

Wahlala ukumkani eduze kombhoshongo, wakwenza isivumelwano phambi kweNkosi, ukuthi uzolandela iNkosi, futhi uzogcina izimiso zakhe, nezibopho zakhe, namalungiselelo akhe, intliziyo yakhe yonke, nomoya wakhe wonke, ukuze aphumeze amazwi lesivumelwano esibhalwe kulolu ncwadi. Abantu bonke bavuma ukuba bagcine lesi simo.

Wathi ukumkani kuHilkiya, umbingeleli omkhulu, nakubabhishobhi abathathu, nabenzi bomnyango, ukuba basuse ethempelini likaYehova zonke izinto ezihlelwe uBahali, ne-Ashere, nezinkanyezi zonke zezulu; wazibonela ngaphandle kweJerusalema, emadolobheni aseKidrone, wazisa inkungu yazo eBhethiyeli.

Wasusa ababhishobhi basezizwe zakwamanye amazwe, abaholi bezizwe zakwaYuda ababebamise ukudlidliza uvumba emadolobheni aseYiputa naseJerusalema; wasusa nalabo abadlidliza uvumba kuBaali, nelanga, nenyanga, namaplanethi, nezinkanyezi zonke zezulu.

Wathatha i-ashere, yaphuma ethempelini likaNdikhoyo, waya emfuleni uKidron, ngaphandle kweYerusalem; wayishiya khona, wayithambisa ibe yimpuphu, wakhipha umhlabathi wayo phezu kwezidumbu zamadodana asekhaya.
Waphula futhi izindlu zamadodakazi, ezikhona ethempelini likaYehova, lapho abesifazane bezigqoka khona izingubo ze-Ashera.

UYosiya wakhipha bonke ababhishobhi emadolobheni aseYiputa waya eYerusalem, wasusa izindawo eziphakeme lapho bephuza khona insindiso, kusukela eGibeha kuya eBheri-shebha. Waphula izindonga zezingqimba zokungena emgwaqeni kaJoshua, umphathi wedolobha, okungukwesobunxele uma uphuma emgwaqeni womzi.
Abaphazamisi bezindawo eziphakeme abakwazi ukukhonza emgodini kaYehova eYerusalem, kodwa badla ubisi olungaphekiwe phakathi nabangani babo abaphazamisi.
Wakwenza iTophethi, eGoli lika-Ben Hinnom, ibe yindawo engafanele ukukhonza kuyo, ukuze akukho muntu ongakwaziyo ukunikela khona unyana wakhe noma intombi yakhe emlilweni kuMoleki.

Wasusa amabhayisikili, amakhosi aseYiputa ayewalungiselela ilanga, awabeka emgwaqweni wokungena ethempelini likaYehova, eduze kwendlu yomphathi okuthiwa nguNathani-meleki, enhliziyweni. UYosiya wavala izithuthi zomlilo ezilungiselelwe ilanga.

Izindawo zokubopha ezingcwele, ababezilungisa abavikeli baseYuda phezu kwendlu yangasese ka-Ahashe, uMbuso Wasendulo wawuzikhuphula phansi; futhi izindawo zokubopha ezingcwele, azenzayo uManase ezindaweni ezimbili zangaphakathi zendlu kaYehova, wazigqugquzela khona, waza wazisa emfuleni iKidron.

Nasezindaweni eziphakeme ezibhekene neYerusalem, ezisenyakatho-mpumalanga yeNtaba Yokufa, uMbuso WaseSolomoni wakwaSirayeli wawuzisusa; wazenza iAshtorethi, into engathandeki yamaSidoni, noKemoshi, into engathandeki yamaMowabi, noMilkom, into engathandeki yamaAmmoniti.
UYosiya waphula izikhonkwane ezingcwele zegolide, wasusa amatshe e-Ashere, wagqoka izinso zabantu phezu kwazo zonke izindawo zazo.

Waphula futhi isibingelelo esiseBetheleli, nendawo ephakeme ayenze ngayo uYarobhoamu, unyana kaNabati, lowo wabangela amaSirayeli ukuba abe ngudlame; wabulala indawo ephakeme, wayisusa ibe yimpuphu, wayala i-Ashera.

UYosiya wabheka, wabona amagobho asesitezi esiphakeme; wakhipha amathambo emagobhoni, wawushisa phezu kwesibingelelo, ukuze angeke kube khona umuntu okhuluma ngalo, njengoba iNkosi esho ngomlomo womntu kaThixo, owaveza lezi zinto zangaphambili.
Wathi uYosiya, Iyini le nhloko yomlilo engiyibonayo? Bathi kuye abantu bedolobha, Liyithambo lomntu kaThixo osuka eYuda, owakhuluma ngalezo zinto ozikwenzela isibingelelo esikhona eBheteli.
Wathi uYosiya, Yishiyeni; akukho muntu ozoba nenyama yakhe. Bagcina khona inyama yakhe, kanye nenyama yomprofeti owafika eSamariya.
Wasusa futhi uYosiya zonke izakhiwo zezindawo eziphakeme ezindaweni zakwaSamariya, azenza iziphathimandla zakwaSirayeli, ukuze ziphazamise inhliziyo kaYehova; wenza kuzo konke okwenze eBheteli.
Wabulala bonke ababhishobhi bezindawo eziphakeme zalezo phezu kwama-altari abo, washiswa amathambo abantu phezu kwama-altari abo; wabuyela eYerusalem.
Wathi ukumkani kubo bonke abantu, Nigcine iPasha kuYehova uNkulunkulu wenu, njengoba kuchaziwe kulolu ncwadi lwesivumelwano.
Akuzange kube khona iPasha enjalo, kusukela kulezi zinsuku abavikeli bephatha isiSirayeli, kuze kube yizo zonke izinsuku zamakhosi aseSirayeli, namasiko aseYuda.
Ngonyaka oyisishiyagalombili wokumkani uYosiya, kwadlalwa iPasha leyo kuYehova eYerusalem.

UYosiya wasusa nalabo abakhuluma ngezinkanyezi, nabamangali, nabangani bezindlu, nezinhlamvu zegolide, nazo zonke izinto ezibi ezabonakala eYiputa naseYerusalem, ukuze agcine amazwi omthetho abhalwe encwadini kaHilkiya umbingeleli, owathola ethempelini likaYehova.
Akubekho ukumkani ofana noYosiya, phambi kwakhe, noma ngemuva kwakhe, owamukele iNkosi inhliziyweni yakhe yonke, nomphefumulo wakhe wonke, namandla akhe wonke, ekwenzeni konke umthetho kaMoses.
Naphezu kwalokho, iNkosi akazange abuyisele emuva inkohliso yakhe enkulu, inkohliso yakhe eyandayo ezweni laseYuda, ngenxa yazo zonke izinto azenzayo uManase zokumkhaza.
Wathi iNkosi, Ngizowususa noYuda phambi kwami, njengokuba ngiwasuse amaSirayeli; futhi ngizowususa lo mzi engiwukhethele iYerusalem, nendlu leyo, indawo lapho ngathi khona: Lizoba khona igama lami.
Okunye okushiwo nguYosiya, konke okwenze, yini na, akubhalweni encwadini yamaqiniso wamabukhosi baseYuda?

Ngosuku lokubusa kukaYosiya, uFaro-nekho, ukumkani waseYiputa, wafika eMfuleni i-Ephratha, ukuze asize ukumkani wakwa-Ashuri. UMosis uJosiya waphuma ukubhekana naye; kodwa lapho ehlangana naye eMegido, wambulala.
Amakhosi akhe ayemthwala emoto yakhe, asuka eMegido waya eYerusalem, washiswa emgodini wakhe. Abantu bezwe bathatha uYehohazazi unyana kaYosiya, bamenza ukumkani endaweni yobaba wakhe.
UYohahazi ubeneminyaka eyishumi nambili nesithathu ubudala lapho eqala ukumkani; waba ngukumkani eminyakeni emithathu eYerusalem. Ubaba wakhe wayenguHamutali intombi kaYeremiya waseLibna.
Wakwenza okubi emehloni kaYehova, ngokwezinto zonke ababezenza abazali bakhe.

UFaro-nekho wamveza emgodini eRibla, ezweni laseHamati, ukuze angeke abe ngukumkani eYerusalem; wabeka phezu kwaYuda imali yegolide eyishumi nesishiyagalombili sekhilogramu, negolide elilingana nekhilogremu.
UFaro-nekho wenza uEliyakamu, unyana kaYosiya, ukumkani endaweni kaYosiya ubaba wakhe, washintsha igama lakhe abe nguYehoyakimu. Wathatha uYohahazi waya eYiputa, wafa khona.

UYehoyakim wanikeza uFaro imali yesiliva negolide, njengoba efuna; ukuze akwenze lokhu, waqoqa izimali zezwe. Wakhipha wonke umuntu imali yesiliva negolide, ngokuya ngezinto zakhe, ukuba azinike uFaro Nekho.
UYoyakimu ubeminyaka imashumi mahlanu nesihlanu ezelwe, lapho eqala ukumkani; waba neminyaka eyishumi nanye engukumkani eYerusalem. Ubaba wakhe wayenguZebida intombi kaPedaya waseRuma.
Wakwenza okubi emehloni kaYehova, ngokwezinto zonke ababezenza abazali bakhe.
Ngosuku lokubusa kukaYehoyakimu, uNebhukadnezare ukumkani waseBhabheli wahlasela izwe; waba ngumkhonzi wakhe iminyaka emithathu, wabuyela emuva, wehla phezu kwakhe.

UYehova wathumela phezu kwakhe amaqembu eBhabheli, namaqembu aseAram, namaqembu aseMowabi, namaqembu aseAmoni; wabathumela ukuba babhubhise izwe laseYuda, njengokuthi iNkosi abewisela umthetho ngamehlo abakhonzi bakhe abaprofeti.
Lezo zinto zafika kuYuda ngenxa yomthetho kaYehova, ukuze azisuse phambi kwakhe, ngenxa yamaphutha kaManase, ngazo zonke izinto awazenzayo;
futhi ngenxa yegazi elingekho emthethweni alifuthayo; uManase wagcwalisa iJerusalema ngegazi elingekho emthethweni, futhi iNkosi akafuni ukulixolisa.
Okunye okushiwo nguYehoyakim, konke okwenze, akubonakali kubhalwe encwadini yamaqiniso kakumkani wakwaYuda?
Wafa uYehoyakimi, waza waba ngukumkani uYoyakini unyana wakhe.
Nokho ukumkani waseMisri akabuyanga ezweni lakhe; ngoba ukumkani waseBhabheli wathatha izwe lakhe lonke, kusukela emfuleni waseMisri kuya emfuleni u-Efrayi.
UYoyakimu ubeneminyaka eyisishiyagalombili ubudala lapho eqala ukumkani, waba ngukumkani eminyakeni emithathu eYerusalem; indodana ka-Elnathani yaseJerusalema yaba ngumzali wakhe.
Wakwenza okubi ngamehlo kaYehova, ngokwezinto zonke azenzayo ubaba wakhe.
Ngaleso sikhathi abaphathi bakaNebhukadnezare, ukumkani waseBhabheli, bahlasela iYerusalem, babambe umzi.
UNebhukhadnezare, ukumkani waseBabiloni, waya kulo mzi yena ngokwakhe, kanti abaphathi bakhe beyibhekene nayo.

Waphuma uYehoyakimu, ukumkani wakwaYuda, waya kukumkani waseBhabheli, yena nenkosi yakhe, nabangani bakhe, nabaphathi bakhe, nabaholi bakhe. Ngomnyaka wesishiyagalombili wokubusa kwakhe, wathathwa uYehoyakimu ngukumkani waseBhabheli.
UNebhukadnezare wathatha zonke izimpahla zendlu kaYehova, nendlu yobukhosi; waphula zonke izinto zegolide, azenzayo uSolomoni ukumkani wakwaSirayeli ethempelini likaYehova, njengokuthi iNkosi, wathi.

Wabathatha bonke abantu baseYerusalem, nabaholi bonke, na gramatisi bonke, namadoda amakhulu onke, amashumi amabili amawaka, nalabo bonke abasebenza ngesandla, nabakhiqizi bensimbi; washiya kuphela abantu abancane ezweni.
UNebhukadnezare wathatha uYehoyakini waya eBhabheli, nabazali bakakumkani, namabhishobhi kakumkani, nabaphathi bakhe, nabantu abakhulu bezwe; wabathwala bonke emaJerusalema waya eBhabheli.

Wathatha ukumkani waseBhabheli abantu abangumakhulu asixhenxe abanamandla amakhulu, namaphesenti ayisishiyagalombili ochwepheshe bezinsimbi nabahlengikazi; bonke labo babe ngabomvu kakhulu, bekulungele ukulwa.
Ubukhosi baseBhabheli bakwenza uMatania, umngane wakhe, abe ngukumkani endaweni yakhe, bashintsha igama lakhe libe yiZedekiya.
UZedekiya ubeminyaka imashumi mahlanu nanye ezelwe, lapho eqala ukumkani; waba neminyaka eyishumi nanhlanu engukumkani eYerusalem. Ubaba wakhe wayenguHamutali intombi kaYeremiya waseLibna.
Wakwenza okubi ngamehlo kaYehova, ngokwezinto zonke azenzayo uYehoyakim.
Lokhu konke kwakwenzeka eYerusalem naseYuda, ngenxa yengcindezi kaYehova, kuze kube yilapho awazikhipha khona phambi kwakhe; futhi uZedekiya wakhohlisa ukumkani waseBhabheli.

Ngomnyaka wesithoba wokubusa kwakhe, ngomhla wama-10 wenyanga, ngosuku lweshumi lonyaka, uNebhukadnezare ukumkani waseBhabheli waya eYerusalem, yena nomkhosi wakhe wonke; bamisa isibhedlela phezu kwalo mzi, babenza amatshe okulwa ngaso lonke.
Lo mzi ugcinwe ngaphansi kwengcindezi kuze kube yiminyaka eyishumi nanye yombuso kaSidekiya.
Ngomhla wesishiyagalombili wenyanga yesine, indlala yaba namandla kakhulu emizini; kwaba sengathi akukho ukudla okusele abantu.

Wathi uHezekiya, "Uzothatha isandla sakho," futhi wavala umgwaqo phakathi kwengqalasizinda ezimbili, lapho etholakala khona igadi lobukhosi. (Naphezu kwalokho, amaBhenjamini kwakukhona phezu komgwaqo) futhi wathatha isandla sakhe, futhi wavala umgwaqo phakathi kwengqalasizinda ezimbili, lapho etholakala khona igadi loMbuso.
Kodwa ibutho laseBhabheli lalandela ukumkani uZedekiya, wafika kuye ezindaweni eziseduze neJericho; futhi wonke amaphoyisa akhe washiya yena, wahlukaniswa.
Bathatha ukumkani, bamthwala kukumkani waseBhabheli eRiblah; khona-ke wagwetywa icala.
Babulala oonyana baka-Zedekiya phambi kwakhe, baphuca amazinyo ka-Zedekiya, bagwema imilenze yakhe izintambo zegolide, bamthwala eBhabheli.

Ngonyaka oyisishiyagalombili kaNabukodonozoro ukumkani waseBhabheli, ngomhla wesixhenxe wenyanga yesithupha, kwafika eYerusalem uNebuzaradani, umphathi wezigwegwe, owayengumholi womkakhe waseBhabheli.
Wamisa umlilo ethempelini likaYehova, nendlu kaNdikhoyo, namakhaya onke aseYerusalem; nanoma iyiphi isakhiwo esibalulekile wamisa umlilo.
Wonke umkhosi waseBabiloni ngaphansi komphathi wendawo yokugqugquzela waphonsa phansi amadonga ajikeleze iYerusalem.
UNebuzaradani, umphathi wezigwegwe, wathatha amanye amalungu omphakathi asele edolobhaneni, nalabo abathuthukile kuye ukumkani waseBhabheli, kanye neminye imindeni yabo, waya ejele.
Nokho uMengameli wezokuphepha washiya abanye abantu abancane ezweni, ukuba basebenze emavinini nasezikhungweni.
Izingqoba zesiliva, nezisekelo zegolide, nebhodlela elikhulu legolide elibizwa ngokuthi yilwandle, elikhona ethempelini likaYehova, abaBabiloniyi bazibhoboza zonke izinsimbi zazo, bazisa eBhabheli.
Bathathe futhi amabhodwe, nama-shavels, nama-wick trimmers, nama-spoons, kanye nazo zonke izinto zegolide ezisetshenziswa emisebenzini yethempelini.
Wathatha umphathi wezigwegwe amabhodwe omlilo, namabhodlela okubhaka, konke kwenziwa ngegolide elihlanzekile noma ngesilivere elihlanzekile.
Insimbi yezinhlamvu ezimbili, nolwandle olulodwa, nezisekelo, azenzayo uSolomoni ethempelini likaYehova, yayinzima kakhulu ukuba ilinganiswe.

Intambo ngayinye yamamitha ayisishiyagalombili ubude. Intambo ngayinye imitha elilodwa nesithupha ubude, futhi yahlobisa ngazo zonke izinhlangothi ngenethiwekhi yama-granate egolide. Intambo yesithathu nenethiwekhi yayo yayifana neyesibili.
Wathatha umphathi wezigwegwe uSeraya, owayengumbingeleli omkhulu, noZefaniya, owayengumbingeleli wesithathu, nalabo abathathu abagcina isango.

Wathatha, phakathi kwabantu abasele edolobhaneni, umphathi ophethe imindeni yezokulwa, namadoda amahlanu abhekene nobukhosi, nombhali wesikhulu somkhosi, owabamba abantu belizwe emdlalweni, namantombazane angamashumi ayisishiyagalombili phakathi kwabantu belizwe, ababekhona edolobhaneni.
U-Nebuzaradani, umphathi wezigwegwe, wabathatha bonke, wabathumela kukumkani waseBhabheli, eRibla.
Wababulala khona eRibla, ezweni laseHamati, ukumkani waseBhabheli; futhi abantu baseYuda bathunyelwe ezindaweni ezingaphandle kwezwe.
UNebhukhadnezare ukumkani waseBhabheli wabeka uGedaliya, unyana ka-Ahikamu, unyana kaShafani, ukuba ngumphathi wabo bonke abantu abewashiya ezweni laseYuda.

Bafika ke kuGedaliya eMizpa, bonke abaphathi bamabutho, namadoda abo, ukuthi ukumkani waseBhabheli wamisa uGedaliya ukuba nguMengameli; kwaba khona uIshmayeli unyana kaNethaniya, noYohananu unyana kaKareha, noSeraya unyana kaTanhumethi waseNetofa, noYazaniya unyana kaMaakathi, nabo amadoda abo.
Wathi uGedaliya kubo, namadodana abo: "Ungabakhombi abaphathi baseBhabheli; hlalani kulolu lizwe, nisebenzele ukumkani waseBhabheli, futhi kuzobe sekuhle kuwe."

Kwathi ngonyaka wesixhenxe, kwafika uIshmayeli unyana kaNethaniya, unyana kaElishama, owesifazane wendlu yasebukhosini, namadoda alishumi naye, wahlasela noGedaliya, wababulala yena nemindeni yabo, kanye nabantu baseYuda nabaseBhabheli ababenaye eMizpa.
Wathi wonke umuntu, oncane nomkhulu, kanye nabaphathi bemikhosi yabo, basuka ezweni laseMisiya; ngoba babekhathazekile ngenxa yamaBhabheli.

Ngomnyaka weshumi nambili nesishiyagalolunye wokuboshwa kukaYehoyakimu ukumkani wakwaYuda, ngomhla wama-27 wonyaka oyisithupha uMerodaki waba ngukumkanikazi waseBhabheli; ngaleso sikhathi wasusa isandla sikaYehoyakimu ukumkani wakwaYuda emgodini.
Wakhuluma naye ngobuqotho, wabeka isikhala sakhe esiphakeme kunaso sonke sabaphathi abakhona naye eBhabheli.
UYehoyakimu wasusa izigqoko zakhe zokuhlukunyezwa, wadla ukudla efulethini likakumkani zonke izinsuku zakhe.
Umbuso wamnika umnikelo wokudla nsuku zonke, kuze kube yilapho ehlala khona.

uKenani, noMahalaleli, noYaredi,
uEnoki, noMethusela, noLamekhi,
UNowa, noShem, noHami, noYafeti, oonyana bakaNowa.

UMizrayimu waba ngumzali wamaLudi, namaAnami, namaLehabi, namaNaftukhi,
AmaPathusi, namaKasluhhi (abaFilisti basuka kubo), namaKaftorithi.
UKanana waba ngumzali kaSidon, umzali wakhe omkhulu, noHeti.
Waba ubaba wamaJebhusi, nama-Amori, namaGigegashi,
amaHivithi, namaArkhithi, namaSinithi,
nama-Arvadite, nama-Zemarite, nama-Hamatite.

uHadoram, noUzale, noDikla,
u-Ebhali, no-Abhimeleki, no-Sheba,
U-Ofiri, no-Hawila, no-Yobhab; labo bonke babe yindodana kaJoktan.
Imindeni kaShem: uShem, no-Arfashade, no-Shela,
no-Ebheri, no-Pelege, no-Rehu,
uSerugi, noNakhore, noTera,
futhi Abram, obizwa ngokuthi Abraham.
Oonyana baka-Abrahama babengu-Isakha no-Ishmayeli.
Lokho kwakuyiminyaka yabo. Uyise ka-Ishmayeli wayenguNebayothi, noKedari, noAdbeeli, noMibsham,
neMishma, neDuma, neMasha, neHadadi, neThema,
Babo oonyana baka-Ishmayeli: uJeturu, noNafishi, noKedema.
UKetura, indodakazi ka-Abrahamu, wazala uZimrani, no-Yokshani, no-Medan, no-Midiyani, no-Ishbhaki, no-Shua. Oonyana baka-Jokshani: uSheba no-Dedani.
Oonyana bakaMidiyani: u-Epha, no-Epher, no-Hanoch, no-Abida, no-Eldaa; labo bonke babe yizingane zikaKetura.
UAbrahamu wazala uIsake. Oonyana bakaIsake: uEsau no-Isirayeli.
Oonyana baka-Esau: uEliphazi, noRehuweli, noJeushi, noYalamu, noKora.
Oonyana baka-Eliphazi: uTeman, noOmar, noZephi, noGatham, noKenaz, noTimna, noAmaleki.
Oonyana bakaRehuyeli: uNahati, noZeraha, noShama, noMiza.
Oonyana bakaSeiri: uLothane, noShobhali, noSibeoni, noAna, noDishon, noEzer, noDishan.
Oonyana baka-Lothani: uHori noHomam; indodakazi ka-Lothani: iThimna.
Oonyana bakaShobhali: uAliyani, noManahati, noEbali, noShefi, noOnam; oonyana bakaSibeoni: uAhiya noAna.
Unyana ka-Ana uDishon. Unyana ka-Dishon nguHamran, no-Eshban, no-Ithran, no-Keran.
Oonyana baka-Ezer: uBhilehan, noZawan, noYaakan; oonyana baka-Dishan: uUz noAran.
Nalaba bamakhosi abalawula ezweni lase-Edom, ngaphambi kokuba kubekho ubukhosi phakathi kwabantwana bakaSirayeli: uBela unyana kaBheori; igama ledolobha lakhe lalinguDinhaba.
Wafa uBela, waba ngukumkani bayramaila uYobhab unyana kaZeraha waseBozra.
UYobhab wafa, waba ngukumkani esikhundleni sakhe uHusam wasezweni zari-Temani.
Wafa uHusham, waba ngukumkani esikhundleni sakhe uHadade unyana kaBedade. UHadade wahlasela amaMidiyani emazweni aseMowabi; igama ledolobha lakhe lakunguAviti.
Wafa uHadade, waba ngukumkani esikhundleni sakhe uSamla waseMasreka.
Wafa uSamla, waba ngukumkani esikhundleni sakhe uSawule waseRehobothi eMfula.
Wafa uShawule, waba ngukumkani esikhundleni sakhe uBaale-hanana, unyana ka-Akhobori.
Wafa uBhala-hanana, waba ngukumkani esikhundleni sakhe uHadade; igama ledolobha lakhe lakunguPahi; indodakazi kaMatredi, inkosikazi kaMezahabi, yaba ngumkakhe.
Wafa uHadade. Abaphathi bezindlu zakwaEdom: uTimna, noAliya, noJethethi,
ne-Aholibhama, ne-Ela, ne-Pinoni,
uKenazi, neTemani, neMibsari,
Ama-Magdiyeli, nama-Iram; labo babe ngabaphathi baseEdom.
Bami oonyana bakaSirayeli: uRubhen, noShimeoni, noLevi, noYuda, noIssakhar, noZebuloni,
uDani, noYosefu, noBhenjamini, noNaphtali, noGadi, noAsere.
Oonyana bakaYuda: uEr, noOnan, noShela; labo bathathu bazalwa nguwesifazane waseKanana, intombi ka-Shua. UEr, umzali omkhulu kaYuda, wayebi emehloni kaYehova; ngakho wabulala iNkosi.
UTamari, indodakazi kaYuda, wazala uPerezi noZeraha kuye; bonke oonyana bakaJuda babehlanu.
Oonyana bakaPerezi: uHezron noHamuli.
Oonyana bakaZera: uZimri, noEthan, noHeman, noKalkoli, noDara, bonke abahlanu.
Unyana kaKarmi ngu-Ahara, owabangela ubuhlungu kumaSirayeli, ngokudlwengula izinto eziboshwe kuThixo.
Unyana ka-Ethan nguAzariya.
Abantwana abazalwa nguHeshron: uYerahmeel, noRam, noKhalebe.
URam waba ubaba ka-Aminadabhi; u-Aminadabhi waba ubaba ka-Nahshon, owayengumholi kwabaseYuda.
UNahshon ube ngubaba kaSalma, futhi uSalma ube ngubaba kaBowazi.
UBowazi waba ngumzali ka-Obedi, no-Obedi waba ngumzali ka-Yese.
Uyise kaYese, umzali wakhe uElibham; owesibili uAbinabahu; wesithathu uShimea;
owakwesine uNathaniyeli, owasihlanu uRadai,
u-Ozem owamashumi amabili, noDavide owamashumi ayisithupha.
Nabo abazalwane babo: uSeruya no-Abihayeli; nabenabathathu oonyana bakaSeruya: uAbhishai, noYowabha, no-Asaheli.
U-Abhigayeli wayeyinkosikazi ka-Amasa; ubaba ka-Amasa waba nguJether, umIsrayeli.
UKalebe unyana ka-Heshron wazalwa izingane ngu-Azuba indodana yakhe, no-Jeriothi; futhi oonyana baka-Azuba: uYeshere, noShobabu, noArdon.
Wafa uAzuba, uKalebe washada noEphratha; yena wazala uHure.
UHure waba ngumzali ka-Uri, no-Uri waba ngumzali ka-Bezalele.
UHeshron ubeneminyaka engu-60 ubudala, washada nenkosikazi kaMakhire, indodana kaGileyadi; yena wamzala uSegub.
Wazalelwa nguSegub uYahiri, owayengumphathi wezifunda ezingu-23 ezweni laseGileyadi.
Kodwa amaGeshuri nama-Aram athathe izifundazwe zikaYahiri, neKenathi nezifundela zayo; ziyizindawo eziyisishiyagalombili. Lokho konke kwaba yizingane zaMakhire, ubaba kaGiliyadi.
UHezron wafa eKalebe-ephratha; indodana yakhe, uAbiha, yazala uAshure, owayengumzali kaTekoa.
Oonyana bakaJerahmeel, umzali wokuqala kaHeshron: uRam, umzali wakhe wokuqala, noBuna, noOren, noOzem, noAhiya.
UJerahmeel wayenenkosikazi eyesibili, igama layo nguAtara; yena ubaba ka-Onam.
Oonyana baka-Ram, umzali ka-Yerahmeel: uMaazi, noYamini, noEkeri.
Oonyana baka-Onam: uShamai noYada; oonyana ka-Shamai: uNadab noAbishuri.
Uwesifazane ka-Abishure wabizwa ngokuthi u-Abihail, wazala uAhban noMolid.
Oonyana bakaNadabhi: uSheledi no-Aphayami. Wafa uSheledi, engeke abe nendodana.
Unyana ka-Apayim ngu-Ishi, unyana ka-Ishi ngu-Sheshan, unyana ka-Sheshan ngu-Ahlai.
Oonyana bakaYada, udade ka-Shamai: uYetere noYonathani. Wafa uYetere, engazali izingane.
Oonyana bakaYonathani: uPelethe, noZaza; labo bamadodakazi kaYerahmeel.
USheshan akazange abe namadodakazi, kodwa ube nezingane. Kwabe kukhona umkhonzi waseMisri okuthiwa uJarha.
USheshan wamnika uJarha, umkhonzi wakhe, intombi yakhe ukuba ibe nguwesifazane; wazala uAtayi.
U-Attai ube ngubaba kaNathani. U-Nathani ube ngubaba kaZabadi.
UZabadi waba ngumzali ka-Eflale, futhi u-Eflale waba ngumzali ka-Obedi.
U-Obedi waba ubaba ka-Yehu, no-Yehu waba ubaba ka-Azaria.
UAzariya waba ubaba kaHelezi, noHelezi waba ubaba kaEleasa.
UEleasa waba ngumzali kaShishmai; uShishmai waba ngumzali kaShalum.
UShalumu waba ngumzali kaJekamiya; uJekamiya waba ngumzali kaElishama.
Oonyana bakaKalebe, udadewabo kaYerameyeli: uMesha umzali wakhe wokuqala, owayengubaba kaZipho; noMaresha uyise, owayengubaba kaHebron.
Oonyana bakaHebroni: uKora, noTaphuwa, noRekemu, noShema.
UShema waba ubaba kaRahamu, ubaba kaYorekhamu; uRekemi waba ubaba kaShamai.
Unyana kaShamai nguMahoni. UMahoni ube ngubaba kaBeth-zur.
U-Epha, indodakazi kaKalebe, wazala uHaran, noMoza, noGazeze; uHaran ube ngubaba kaGazeze.
Oonyana bakaJahadi: uRegem, noYothani, noGeshani, noPeleti, noEfa, noShafa.
UMahaka, indodakazi kaKalebe, wazala uShebere noThirhana.
Wazala futhi uShafa, indodana kaMadmana, noSheva, indodana kaMakbena neGibeha; indodana kaKalebe yayingu-Aksha.
Lokho kwakuyindodana kaKalebe. Oonyana bakaHure, umzali wesifazane sikaEfrata: uShobhali, ubaba kaKiriyati-yearimi;
noSalma, ubaba kaBethelehemu; noHarephu, ubaba kaBhethe-gaderi.
UShobhali, ubaba kaKirihati-yearimi, waba nezingane ezinguHarohe naphezu kwamadodana kaMenuhothi.
Namadodakazi kaKirihati-yearimi: ama-Ithrithi, nama-Puthi, nama-Shumati, nama-Mishrai; namadodakazi kaZora, namadodakazi ka-Eshtaoli.
Amadodana kaSalma: abantu baseBethelehemu, nabaseNetofathi, nabaseAtrothi-bethe-Yowabhi, nengxenye yamaManahati, namaZori.
Nabo ababhali, abahlala eJabhesi, ngomndeni wabo: amaTirathi, namaShimeati, namaSukati; labo abaKenisi abavela kuHamathi, ubaba wemindeni yamaRehabhi.
Lawa ke amadodana kaDavide azalwa kuye eHebroni. Omkhulu wakhe uAmron, owaziwa ngokuthi uAhinoamu waseJezreeli; owesibili uDaniyeli, owaziwa ngokuthi uAbihayeli waseKarmeli.
owesithathu uAbsalomu, owazalwa nguMahaka, intombi kaTalmai ukumkani waseGeshuri; nowesine uAdoniya, owazalwa nguHagithi.
usihlanu nguShefatiya, owaziwa ngokuthi yi-Abital; osithandathu nguYitreyamu, owaziwa ngokuthi yi-Egla, indodana kaDavide.
Lawa mahlanu azalwa nguDavide eHebron, lapho waba khona iminyaka eyishumi nesishiyagalombili namasonto ayisishiyagalombili; futhi eYerusalem waba neminyaka engamashumi amathathu anesihlanu.
Bazalwa kuye eYerusalem: uShimea, noShobhab, noNathane, noSolomoni. Ubaba wabo wayenguBatshua, intombi ka-Amiyeli; bona babehlanu.
Kwabekho futhi uIbhari, noElishama, noElifelethe,
uNoga, noNefegi, noYaphia,
uElishama, noEliyada, noElifelethe; labo abathoba.
Lawo wonke amadodana kaDavide, ngaphandle kwamadodakazi akhe. Udadewabo uThamari.
Unyana kaSolomoni waba nguRehoboam, unyana kaRehoboam waba nguAbiha, unyana kaAbiha waba nguAsa, unyana kaAsa waba nguJehoshafati.
Unyana kaJehoshafati nguYoramu, unyana kaYoramu nguAhaziya, unyana kaAhaziya nguYoashi.
Unyana kaYoashi nguAmasiya, unyana kaAmasiya nguAzariya, unyana kaAzariya nguYothamu.
Unyana kaYothamu ngu-Ahazi, unyana kaAhazi ngu-Hizekiya, unyana kaHizekiya ngu-Manase.
Unyana kaManase nguAmoni, unyana kaAmoni nguYosiya.
Oonyana bakaYosiya: uJohanane owayengumzali, noYehoyakime owesithathu, noZedekiya wesithathu, noShalumu wesithupha.
UYehoyakime: uJekoniya unyana wakhe, noShedekiya unyana wakhe.
Oonyana bakaJekoniya, owathathwa ejele: uShealtiyeli indodana yakhe;
noMalkiram, noPedaya, noShenazare, noJekamiya, noHoshama, noNedabiya.
Oonyana bakaPedaya: uZerubabele, noShimeyi; oonyana bakaZerubabele: uMeshulamu, noHananiya; nonkosikazi wabo, uShelomitha.
Waba noZerubabele oonyana abahlanu: uHashubha, noOhele, noBerekiya, noHasadiya, noJushabhe-heshedi.
Abantwana bakaHananiya: uPelatiya, noYeshaya, nabangane bakaRefaya, nabangane ba-Arnan, nabangane ba-Obadiya, nabangane ba-Shekaniya.
Unyana ka-Shekaniyahu ngu-Shemahiya; u-Shemahiya waba nezingane eziyisishiyagalombili: uHatushi, no-Igale, no-Bariya, no-Nearya, no-Shafati.
Oonyana bakaNearya abathathu: uEliyonani, noHizekiya, noAzrikam.
Oonyana bakaEliyonai babeyisixhenxe: uHodaviya, noEliyasibhi, noPelaya, noAkubu, noYohanani, noDelaya, noAnani.
Amadodana kaYuda: uPerezi, noHeshroni, noKarmi, noHuri, noShobali.
URehaya unyana kaShobale waba ngumzali kaJahati, noJahati waba ngumzali ka-Ahumai noLahadi; lezi ziyimindeni yamaSorathi.
Nalaba bazalwa nguyise ka-Etham: uJezreyeli, noIshma, noIdbash; igama lowesifazane wabo lalinguHazelelponi.
Wazalwa nguPhenuyeli uGedori, wazalwa nguEzeri uHusha; labo babe yizingane zikaHhure, umzali wokuqala kaEfrata, owayengumzali kaBethelehemu.
U-Ashure, ubaba kaTekoa, wayenezingane ezimbili: uHela noNaara.
UNahara wazala uAhuzam, noHepher, noTemeni, noHahashtari. Babo oonyana bakaNahara.
Oonyana bakaHela: uZerethi, no-Izhar, no-Ethan.
UHakhozi ube ngubaba ka-Anubhi noZobhebha, futhi waba ngumzali wezizwe zika-Aharheli unyana kaHarum.
UYabheze waziwa ngaphezu kwabazalwane bakhe; indodana yakhe yabiza igama lakhe ngokuthi uYabheze, isithi, Ngimzalile ngebuhlungu.

UYabhezi wathandaza kuThixo wakwaSirayeli, wathi, Ngicela, ngikuthande, usize izwe lami likhule; isandla sakho sihlale sinye nami, futhi ugcine umonakalo ngami, ukuze angabi nobuhlungu. Wathi uNkulunkulu wamnika owawufunayo.
U-Chelub, udade ka-Shuhah, ube ngubaba kaMehir, owayengubaba ka-Eshton.
U-Eshton waba ngumzali ka-Beth-rapha, no-Paseha, no-Tehina, owayengumzali ka-Ir-nahashe; labo bamadodana kaReka.
Oonyana bakaKenazi: uOthniyeli noSeraya; unyana kaOthniyeli nguHathathi.
UMeonothai waba ubaba ka-Ofra; uSeraya waba ubaba kaYowabhi, owasungula iGeharashimu, eGoli lalabo abasebenza ngezandla; ngoba abantu bayo babezimele.
Oonyana bakaKalebe, unyana kaJefune: ngu-Iru, no-Elah, no-Naham; unyana ka-Elah ngu-Kenaz.
Oonyana bakaJehaleleli: uZipho, noZifa, noTiriya, noAsareyeli.
Oonyana bakaEzra: uYetere, noMerede, noEfere, noJaloni; futhi indodana kaMerede yazala uMiriam, noShamai, noIshbha, owayengubaba ka-Eshtemoa.
Wazala uYaredi, indodana kaGedori, no-Ebheri, indodana kaSokho, no-Yekutiyeli, indodana kaZanoa; labo babe yizingane zikaBitiya, intombi kaFaro, owayeyindodakazi kaMerede.
Namadodakazi kaHodiya, inkosikazi kaNahhamu, abe yindodana kaKehila waseGarmi, no-Eshtemoa waseMaakathi.
Oonyana bakaShimoni: u-Amnoni, no-Rina, no-Benhanani, no-Tiloni; oonyana baka-Ishi: uZohete, no-Benzohete.
Oonyana bakaShela, unyana kaYuda: uEr, ubaba kaLekha, noLadeha, ubaba kaMaresha, kanye nemindeni yalabo abasebenza ngendwangu eBetha-ashbha.
Kwabekho noYokim, namadodana kaKozeba, noYoashi, noSaraphi, abaphathi baseMowabhi, kanye noYashubi-Lehem. Lezo zinto zivela ezinyangeni zakudala kakhulu.
Balokhu behlala eNethaim, neGedera; babehlala khona, basebenzela ukumkani.
Oonyana bakaSimeoni: uNemuyeli, noYamini, noJaribi, noZeraha, noShawuli.
USawule unyana kaShalumu, noShalumu unyana kaMibsham, noMibsham unyana kaMisma.
Abantwana bakaMishma: uHamuyeli unyana wakhe, noZakhuri unyana kaHamuele, noShimehi unyana kaZakhuri.
Kwaba nguShimeyi oonyana abalishumi elinamihlanu, nezingane eziyisithupha; kodwa abazalwane bakhe abazange babe nabantwana abaningi, futhi umndeni wabo wonke wawungenakuba mkhulu njengezwe likaYuda.
Bahlala eBhe-shebha, eMolada, eHazari-shuali,
noBhila, noEzem, noTholadi,
noBethuyeli, noHorma, noZiklagi,
I-Beth-markabhothi, ne-Hazari-shushimi, ne-Beth-biri, ne-Shaaraim; lezi ziyizindawo zabo kuze kube uDavide waba ngukumkani.
Izifundela zabo zaziyi-Etham, ne-Ayin, ne-Rimon, ne-Token, ne-Ashan; izifundazwe ezihlanu.
kanye nezifundela zonke ezibhekene nalawo madolobhana, kuze kube yiBaali. Lawa amakhaya abo, futhi bagcina incwadi yomndeni wabo.
noMeshobhab, noYamelekh, noYosha unyana kaAmasiya,
uYoweli, noYehu intombi ka-Yoshibiya, intombi kaSeraya, intombi ka-Asiyeli;
uEliyonani, noYakhobha, noYeshohaya, noAsaya, noAdiyeli, noYesimiyeli, noBenayai,
noZiza unyana kaShiphi, unyana kaAloni, unyana kaJedaya, unyana kaShimri, unyana kaShemaya.
Lawa madoda abizwa ngamagama lapha babe ngabaphathi bezizwe zabo. Imindeni yabo yakhula yaba enkulu.
Baye behamba kuze kube yilapho kungena khona iGedori, enyakatho-ntshonalanga yelali, befuna indawo yokudla izimvu zabo.
Bathola khona ubisi oluningi, oluhle kakhulu. Izwe livulekile, lihlanzekile, liphephile. Abantu abathile baseHami babehlala khona ngaphambilini.

Bafika ke labo abagqugquzelwe ngegama, ezikhathini zikaHizekiya ukumkani wakwaYuda, bahlasela amaHamithi, namaMeunithi ahlala khona, babulala wonke umuntu ohlala khona, kuze kube namhlanje; bahlala endaweni yabo, ngoba kwakukhona khona indawo yokudlelisa izimvu zabo.
Basuka kubo eSimeoni, abantu abangumakhulu ayisishiyagalombili basuka ezweni eliphakeme laseSeiri; abaphathi babo bekunguPelatiya, noNearya, noRefaya, noUziyele, oonyana baka-Ishi.
Babulala bonke amanye ama-Amaleki, labo abafileyo; bahlala khona kuze kube ngalolusuku.

Lokho kwakunguRubhen, umzali wesifazane sikaSirayeli. Ube ngumzali wesifazane, kodwa ngenxa yokuthi wahlangana nowesifazane wesifazane kayise, ilungelo lakhe lokuzalwa komzali wesifazane lanikezwa izingane zikaYosefu, unyana kaSirayeli; ngakho-ke uRubhen akabhaliswa encwadini yomndeni njengomzali wesifazane.
UYuda waba mkhulu kunabo bonke abazalwane bakhe, waphuma kuye umphathi; kodwa uYusufu wayeyindodana yokuqala.
Oonyana bakaRubhen, umzali wesifazane sikaSirayeli: uHanok, noPalu, noHezron, noKarmi.
Abantwana bakaYoweli: uShemaya unyana wakhe, noGoge unyana kaShemaya, noShimeyi unyana kaGoge,
uMika unyana kaShimeyi, noRehaya unyana kaMikha, noBhaali unyana kaRehaya,
noBhera unyana kaBahali. UTiglathi-pilesere ukumkani waseAshuri wathatha uBhera, waba ngumholi wesizwe sikaRubhen.
Abazalwane bakhe, ngokwemindeni yabo, ngokusho komlando womndeni wabo: uJeyeli umholi, noZekariya,
noBela unyana ka-Aza, unyana ka-Shema, unyana ka-Yoweli; bahlala ezweni elisuka e-Aroere kuya eNebo, naBaale-meoni.
Enyakatho-mpumalanga, bahlala kuze kube yilapho isiqhingi sifinyelela khona emfuleni i-Euphrates; ngoba izingulube zabo zazikhulu kakhulu kunaleli lizwe laseGiliyadi.
Kwathi lapho uSawule engumkani, baphuma behlasela amaHagirithi, bababulala, bahlala ezitezi zabo, ngaso sonke isiqhingi saseGiliyadi esisempumalanga.
Bahlala ezweni laseBhashani, kuze kube yiSalekha, isizwe sikaGadi.
UYoweli wayeyinhloko, noShafamu ube yisibili, noJanani noShafati eBhashani.
Abazalwane babo, ngomndeni wabo: uMikayeli, noMeshulamu, noShebha, noYorai, noYahan, noZiha, noHebhere; bonke babeyisithupha.
Babo oonyana baka-Abhihayeli, indodana kaHuri, indodana kaJaroa, indodana kaGileyadi, indodana kaMikayeli, indodana kaYeshishayi, indodana kaYaho, indodana kaBuzi.
U-Ahi unyana ka-Abdiyeli, unyana ka-Guni, waba nguMengameli wemindeni yabo.
Bahlala eGiliyadi, naseBhashani, namadolobhana ayo, nakwazo zonke izifunda zaseSharon, kuze kube yilapho befika khona.
