Bonke labo babhalwa encwadini yomndeni kaJothamu ukumkani wakwaYuda, noYarobhoamu ukumkani wakwaSirayeli.

NaseRubheni, naseGadi, nengxenye yesifundazwe sikaManase, kwaba ngamaphesenti angama-44 amakhulu mane, anamakhulu ayisishiyagalombili namashumi amathandathu, abantu abanobukhazikhazi obukhulu, abathwala isibhakabhaka nesikhefu, nabashaya umcibisholo; bonke baqeqeshiwe empilweni.
Baye bahlasela amaHagirithi, namaJethuri, namaNafishi, namaNodabi.

UNkulunkulu wabasiza empilweni yabo, wabeka esidlangalaleni amaHagirithi nalabo bonke abaye basebenza nabo; ngenxa yokuthi bekhala kuThixo emdlalweni, futhi iNkosi wabaphendula, ngoba babethembele kuye.
Bathatha izilwane zakwaHagari, izinkomo ezingu-50, nezimbuzi eziyinkulungwane ezimbili namashumi amahlanu, namabhungane angama-2; futhi bathathe abantu abangaphezu kukakhulu elilodwa lamakhulu.
Abazobi abaningi babulawa, ngoba ukulwa kwakuwuNkulunkulu. Bahlala kulolu mhlaba kuze kube sekuphele ukuboshwa kwabo.
Ingxenye yesizwe sikaManase yahlala kulolu mhlaba, yakhula ikhule, yasuka eBhashani iye eBaale-Hermon, neSenire, nasentaba iHermon.
Lawa abaholi bemindeni yabo: u-Epher, no-Ishi, no-Eliyeli, no-Azriyeli, no-Yeremiya, no-Hodaviya, no-Yahediyeli; labo babemadodana amakhulu, abantu abadumile, abehluleli bezindlu zabo.
Baye bakwenza okubi kuThixo wabababa babo, belandela izitha zezizwe zezwe, labo iNkosi abewabulala phambi kwabo.

UNkulunkulu wakwaSirayeli wavusa uPul, ukumkani wase-Ashuri, okuthiwa nguTiglatha-pilesere, ukumkani wase-Ashuri. Wathatha amakhosikazi kaRubhen, namadodakazi kaGadi, kanye nengxenye yomkhosi kaManase, waya eHala, noHabori, noHara, noMfula iGozani, kuze kube namuhla.
Oonyana bakaLevi: uGershoni, noKohati, noMerari.
Oonyana bakaKohati: uAmram, no-Izhar, no-Hebron, no-Uziyeli.
Oonyana baka-Amram: u-Aron, noMoses, noMiriam; oonyana ka-Aron: uNadabhi, no-Abihu, no-Eleazar, no-Ithamari.
U-Eleazare waba ubaba kaPhinehasi, futhi Phinehasi waba ubaba kaAbishuwa.
U-Abishua ube ngubaba ka-Bukki. U-Bukki ube ngubaba ka-Uzzi.
U-Uzi waba ngumzali kaZerahiya, no-Zerahiya waba ngumzali kaMeraiothi.
UMeraiothi waba ubaba ka-Amariya; u-Amariya waba ubaba ka-Ahitubhi.
U-Ahitubhu waba ubaba kaSadoko, no-Sadoko waba ubaba ka-Ahimaase.
U-Ahimaas waba ubaba ka-Azariya, no-Azariya waba ubaba ka-Yohanan.
UJohhanan ube ngubaba ka-Azariya, owayesebenza njengombhishobhi ethempelini likaSolomoni eYerusalem.
UAzariya waba ngumzali ka-Amariya, u-Amariya waba ngumzali ka-Ahitubhu.
U-Ahitubhu waba ubaba kaSadoki, no-Sadoki waba ubaba kaShalumu.
UShalumu waba ubaba kaHilkiya; uHilkiya waba ubaba kaAzariya.
UAzariya waba ubaba kaSeraya, noSeraya waba ubaba kaYozadaka.
Wathathwa uYosadaki waba ngumuntu oqashiwe, lapho iNkosi ethumela khona abantu baseYuda nabaseJerusalema emgodini kaNabukodonozor.
Oonyana bakaLawi: uGershoni, noKohati, noMerari.
Lawona amagama oonyana bakaGershoni: uLibni noShimehi.
Oonyana bakaKohati: uAmram, no-Izhar, no-Hebron, no-Uziyeli.
Oonyana bakaMerariya: uMahli noMushi. Lokho kungenxa yezindlu zakwaLevi, ngokuya ngemindeni yabo.
Abantwana bakaGershoni: uLibni unyana wakhe, noYahati unyana kaLibni, noZima unyana kaYahati,
noYowa unyana kaZima, noIdo unyana kaYowa, noZeraha unyana kaZeraha, noYeterai unyana kaZeraha.
Abantwana bakaKohati: u-Aminadabhi unyana wakhe, no-Kora unyana ka-Aminadabhi, no-Asiri unyana ka-Kora,
uElkana inkosi ka-Asire, noEbyasaphe inkosi ka-Elkana, noAsiri inkosi ka-Ebyasaphe,
UTahati unyana ka-Asiri, noUriyeli unyana ka-Tahati, noUziya unyana ka-Uriya, noShawuli unyana ka-Uziya.
Oonyana baka-Elkana: uAmasai noAhimothi.
Abantwana baka-Elkana: uZofai unyana wakhe, noNahati unyana kaZofai,
UElibha unyana kaNahati, noYerohamu unyana kaElibham, noElkana unyana kaYerohamu.
Oonyana baka-Samuweli: uJoyele, owayengumzali wakhe, noAbiha, owayengumunye.
Oonyana bakaMerari: uMahli, noLibni unyana kaMahli, noShimehi unyana kaShimehi, noUza unyana kaShimehi,
noShimea unyana kaUza, noHagiya unyana kaShimea, noAsaya unyana kaHagiya.
Baye labo abeka uDavide abaphathi bezingoma ethempelini likaYehova, ngemuva kokuba ibhokisi lithole indawo yokuphumula.
Basebenza bahlala phambi kwendlu kaYehova, esitezi sokubambisana, kuze kube wusuku lapho uSolomone ekwakha khona indlu kaYehova eYerusalem; basebenzela umsebenzi wabo ngokuhlukana kwabo.
Lawa amadoda asebenzela, nabangane babo. Emndenini wakwaKohati kwaba nguHeman umculi, unyana kaYoweli, unyana kaSamuweli,
indodana kaElkana, indodana kaYerohamu, indodana kaEliyeli, indodana kaToha,
unyana ka-Zuphi, unyana ka-Elkana, unyana ka-Mahati, unyana ka-Amasai,
indodana ka-Elkana, indodana ka-Yoweli, indodana ka-Azariya, indodana ka-Zefaniya,
unyana kaTahathi, unyana ka-Asiri, unyana ka-Ebyashafi, unyana kaKora,
indodana ka-Izhar, indodana ka-Kohati, indodana kaLevi, indodana kaSirayeli.
Wahlala ngakwesokudla kwakhe uAsaphe, umngane kaHeman; uAsaphe ube ngunyana kaBerekiya, unyana kaShimea,
unyana ka-Mikayeli, unyana ka-Baaseya, unyana ka-Malkiya,
unyana ka-Ethni, unyana ka-Zerah, unyana ka-Adaiah,
unyana kaEthane, unyana kaZima, unyana kaShimeyi,
unyana kaJahati, unyana kaGershoni, unyana kaLevi.
Ngakwesobunxele kukaHeman, kwabekhona abazalwane babo abasuka emndenini wakwaMerari; umholi wabo uEthan, indodana kaKishi, indodana kaAbdi, indodana kaMaluku;
unyana kaHashabiya, unyana kaAmasiya, unyana kaHilkiya,
indodana ka-Amzi, indodana ka-Bani, indodana ka-Shemer,
indodana kaMahli, indodana kaMushi, indodana kaMerari, indodana kaLevi.
Abazalwane babo, amaLevi, babe nemisebenzi yonke yendlu kaThixo, esitezi esiphezulu.

U-Aron nonyana bakhe banikela emgodini womnikelo wokushiswa, futhi basindisa uvumba emgodini womlilo, besenza yonke imisebenzi yendawo engcwele kakhulu, enza ukuxoshwa kwabaSirayeli, ngokwemithetho kaMoses umkhonzi kaThixo.
Lokho umndeni ka-Aron: uEleyazare unyana wakhe, noPhinehase unyana ka-Eleyazare, noAbishuwa unyana ka-Phinehase,
uBukhi unyana ka-Abishuwa, noUzi unyana ka-Buki, noZerahiya unyana ka-Uzi,
uMeraiothi unyana kaZerahiya, noAmariya unyana kaMeraiothi, noAhitubhu unyana kaAmariya,
noSadoko unyana ka-Ahitubhi, noAhimahazi unyana ka-Ahitubi.
Lezi ziyizindawo ezihlala kuzo izingane zika-Aron, ezindaweni zokuhlala zezwe labo. Izingane zika-Aron, ezisuka kumndeni wakwa-Kehati, zathola inkontileka yazo ngesinqumo.
Wabanika iHebroni, ezweni likaYuda, nezindawo zayo zokudlela ezijikeleze.
Izindawo ezisendaweni zomhlaba kanye nezifundela ezijikeleze lo dolobhana, zanikezwa uKalebe unyana kaJefune.
Wabanika oonyana baka-Aron iHebroni, isixeko sokuzivikela, neLibna, neYatiri, ne-Eshtemoa, ngazo zonke izifunda zayo,
iHilen neDebiri, ngayinye namagatsha ayo;
ne-Ashan, ne-Beth-shemesh, ngayinye inendawo yayo yokudla.
Ezweni likaBhenjamin, iGebha nezindawo zayo zokudlela, ne-Alemethi ne-Anathothi; zonke izizwe zesiKahati zathola izidolobhana ezilishumi elinamithathu.
Okunye kwamadodana kaKahati kwaba yizindawo ezingu-10, ezakhiwe ngezinhlanga zengxenye yesizwe sikaManase.
Namadodana kaGershoni, ngokwemindeni yabo, athola ezweni lika-Issakare, nezwe lika-Asere, nezwe likaNaphtali, kanye nengxenye yezwe likaManase eBhashani, idolobhana elilodwa nesithathu.
Namadodana kaMerari, ngokwenkundla yabo, athola izizwe ezilishumi elinambini, ezweni likaRubhen, nasezweni likaGadi, nasezweni likaZebulun.
Bathi ke abazalwane bakaSirayeli banikeza amaLevi la madolobhana kanye nezifunda zawo.
Babanikela ngazo izizwe zakwaYuda, nakwaSimeoni, nakwaBhenjamin, izidolobhana ezishiwo ngegama labo.
Ezinye izizwe zesiKahati zathola imiphakathi esuka ezindleleni zikaEphrayimi.
Wabanikeza iShekhem, idolobhana losizo, ezindaweni eziphakeme zakwaEphrayim, neGezeri, ngalinye linezindawo zayo zokuhlala;
ne-Yokmeam, ne-Beth-horon, ngazo zonke izihlahla zayo;
ne-Ayaloni, neGathi-rimoni; ngayinye inendawo yayo yokudlela.
Engxenyeni yesizwe sikaManase, kwabe sekusele imindeni yamaKahati: uAner noBhileham, ngaye ngamunye nezindawo zakhe zokudla.
Nakwabenzi-Gershoni, kwaba yimiphakathi elandelayo: Emndenini wengxenye yesizwe sikaManase, iGolani eBhashani, neAshtarothi, ngazo zonke izifunda zayo.
Esifundazweni sika-Issakha, iKedesh neDaberathi, ngazo zonke izifunda zayo;
neRamothi, ne-Anem, ngayinye nezindawo zayo zokudlela.
Ezweni lika-Asere: iMashale noAbdon, ngalinye nezindawo zayo zokudlela;
neHukok, neRehobho, ngayinye inendawo yayo yokudla.
Esifundazweni sakwaNaphtali: iKedesh eGalilile, neHamoni, neKiriyatayim; ngayinye yazo izifunda zayo.
Amanye amaLevi, oonyana bakaMerariya, bathola ezweni likaZebulun: iRimono neTabhori, ngazo zonke izifunda zayo.
Ezweni lakwaRubheni, ngasenyakatho yeJordani ebhekene neJericho: iBeseri esiqhingini, neYahaza; ngaso sonke isizwe izintaba zayo;
kanye neKedemothi, neMefaathi, ngayinye inendawo yayo yokudla.
Esifundazweni sikaGadi: iRamothi eGileyadi, neMahanayim; ngasinye sazo sinemifula yayo;
neHeshboni, neYazeri, ngayinye nezindawo zayo zokudla.
Waba nguIssakhar oonyana abangu-ne: uThola, noPua, noYashubu, noShimron.

Oonyana baka-Tola: uUzi, noRefaya, noYeriyeli, noYamai, noIbsham, noShemuweli; labo babe yinhloko yamakhaya abo emndenini ka-Tola, abantu abanothando olukhulu. Ezikhathini zikaDavide imindeni yabo yaba ngamaphesenti angamashumi amabili nambili anamakhulu ayisishiyagalombili.
Unyana ka-Uzi ngu-Izrahiya; unyana ka-Izrahiya ngu-Mikayeli, no-Obadiya, no-Yoweli, no-Ishiyaha; bonke abahlanu babe ngabakhulu.
Umlando wabo womndeni ubonisa ukuthi babe namadoda angama-36 alungiselelwe umkhosi, ngoba babenezifazane nezingane eziningi.
Abazalwane babo, phakathi kwezizwe zonke zakwa-Issakhar, abantu abanamandla okulwa; bonke labo ababhaliswe ngomndeni wabo babe ngamaphesenti ayishumi nesishiyagalombili namakhulu asithoba.
UBhenjamin wayenezingane ezintathu: uBela, noBekhere, noJediayeli.
UBela wayenezingane eziyisishiyagalombili: u-Ezbon, noUzi, noUzieli, noJerimothi, noIri; babe yibo abakhulu bemindeni yabo, abantu abanobukhazikhazi obukhulu.
Oonyana bakaBekheri: uZemira, noYoashi, noEliyezeri, noEliyonani, noOmri, noYeremote, noAbiha, noAnathothi, noAlemethe; labo bonke babe oonyana bakaBekheri.
Izinkontileka zabo zomndeni zidlulisa izikhulu zemindeni yabo kanye namaphesenti angama-20, amawaka angu-200 okulwa.
Unyana kaJediyayeli nguBhilahan; unyana kaBhilahan nguJeush, noBenjamin, noEhud, noKenana, noZethan, noTarshish, noAhisahar.
Ngabo bonke oonyana bakaJediayeli, abaphathi bezindlu zabazali babo, kwaba ngumakhulu asixhenxe aneshumi nesishiyagalombili amawaka namakhulu amabili anamandla amakhulu angaphuma emkhosini.
U-Shuphim no-Huppim babe yizingane zika-Ir; u-Hushim ube yindodana ka-Aher.
Oonyana bakaNaphethali: uJahaziyeli, noGuni, noJezeri, noShalumu; laba bazalwa nguBhila.
UManase wazalwa ngu-Asriyeli, owesifazane wase-Aram; naye wazala uMakhire, owayengubaba kaGileyadi.
UMakhire wathatha indodakazi emndenini wamaHuphimi, nomndenini wamaShupimi; igama lenkosikazi yakhe lakunguMahaka; futhi igama lowesifazane wakhe lalinguZelofehadi.
UMahara indodana kaMakhire wazala unyana, wathi igama lakhe nguPereshe. Igama lomyeni wakhe bekunguSheresh; oonyana bakhe babe nguUlam noRakemu.
Unyana ka-Ulam, uBedan. Lokho kwakuyindodana kaGileyadi, indodana kaMahiri, indodana kaManase.
UHamolekhethi, udadewabo kaGileyadi, wazala uIshodi, noAbiezer, noMahla.
Oonyana baka-Shemida: uAhiya, noShekem, noLikhi, noAniyam.
Amadodana kaEphrayimi: uShutela unyana wakhe, noBerede unyana kaShutela, noTahata unyana kaBerede, noEleada unyana kaTahata, noTahata unyana kaEleada;
UZabadi unyana kaTahathi, noShutela unyana kaZabadi; no-Ezeri no-Elehadi, oonyana bakaEfraim, babulawa ngabantu baseGathi abazalwa kulolu lizwe, lapho bekhuphuka bezibulala izinkomo zabantu.
UEfrayim, ubaba wabo, waba nomsindo ngenxa yabo iminyaka eminingi; kwafika nabangane bakhe ukuthi bamphikisise.
Wahlangana nowesifazane wakhe futhi, wakhulelwa, wazalelwa unyana; wathi igama lakhe nguBeriya, ngenxa yobuhlungu obukhona emndenini wakhe.
Unkosikazi ka-Ephrayi uShera; yena wakwakha iBethe-horon ephansi nephezulu, noUzen-Shera.
Amadodana kaBeriya: uRefa inkosi yakhe, noReshefi inkosi yakhe, noTela inkosi yakhe, noTahani inkosi yakhe,
uLadani unyana kaTahani, noAmihudi unyana kaLadani, noElishama unyana kaAmihudi,
UNun unyana kaElishama, noYoshuwa unyana kaNun.

Umhlaba wabo, izindlu zabo, waba nguBhethele nezindawo zayo ezincane, noNaaran enyakatho, noGezere enyakatho nezindawo zayo ezincane, noShekheme nezindawo zakhe ezincane, kuze kube yi-Aza nezindawo zake.
Nasezindaweni zakwaManase: iBhethe-shean, neTaanakhi, neMegido, neDore, nezifundela zawo; izingane zikaYosefu, unyana kaSirayeli, zazihlala ezifundazweni zalo.
Oonyana baka-Ashere: u-Imna, no-Ishwa, no-Ishivi, no-Beriya; umngane wabo nguSera.
Oonyana bakaBeriya: uHebhere, noMalkhiyeli, owayengubaba kaBirsayi.
UHebhere waba ngumzali kaYaflethi, noShomeri, noHothami, noShua umkakhe.
Oonyana bakaJaflethi: uPasha, noBimhali, noAshwathi; labo bayizindodana kaJaflethi.
Oonyana bakaShomer: uAhi, noRoha, noHubha, noAram.
Oonyana bakaHelemu, udadewabo: uZofa, no-Imna, no-Sheleshe, no-Amali.
Oonyana bakaSofa: uSuha, noHarnefere, noShuhali, noBeri, noImra,
iBezer, neHod, neShama, neShilshah, neIthran, neBhera.
Oonyana bakaJethere: uJefune, noPispa, noAhara.
Abantwana baka-Ulla babe nguArah, uHanniel, noRizia.

Lawa madodana ka-Asheri, abaholi bezindlu zababa babo, abezinja ezinamandla zokulwa, abaqondisi abanekhono. Amanani abo emindenini yabo ayeyizigidi eziyisishiyagalombili nesishiyagalolunye, abantu abakwaziyo ukungena emkhosini.
Unyana kaBhenjamin omkhulu kwaba nguBela. Owesibili waba nguAshbele, wesithathu waba nguAhara,
uNoha owakwesine, noRafa owamashumi amane.
Oonyana bakaBela: uAdare, noGera, noAbihude,
u-Abishuwa, noNaamani, no-Ahoha,
uGera, noShefufan, noHiram.
Lawa madodana ka-Ehud, abe yibo abakhulu bemindeni ehlala eGibeha, abathunyelwe eManahati.
UNamane, no-Ahiya, no-Gera; u-Gera waba ngumzali ka-Uza no-Ahihud.
UShaharayime waba nezingane ezweni lakwaMowabi, ngemuva kokuthi ashiye izifazane zakhe, uHushimu noBaara.
NgoHodeshe indodana yakhe, wazala uYobhab, noSibiya, noMesha, noMalkham,
UJehuzi, noShakiya, noMirma; labo babe yindodana yakhe, bebengabakhulu bezindlu zakwababa.
Ngo-Hushime waba no-Abitub no-Elpaali.
Oonyana baka-Elpaali: uHebhere, noMisham, noShemede. UShemede wakwakha iOno, neLodi, nezifunda zawo.
UBeriya noShema babe yinhloko yamakhaya abahlala e-Ayaloni; bona bakhipha abantu baseGathi.
no-Ahiya, no-Shashaki, no-Yeremota,
uZebadia, noAradi, noEdere,
UMikayeli, no-Ishpa, no-Yoha, babe yizingane zikaBeriya.
uZebadia, noMeshulamu, noHizekiya, noHebhere,
U-Ishmerai, no-Izliya, no-Yobhab, babe yizingane zika-Elpaali.
noYakhimu, noZikri, noZabdi,
uEliyeni, noZilethai, noEliyeli,
U-Adaiah, no-Beraiah, no-Shimrath; labo bamadodana kaShimeyi.
u-Ishan, no-Ebheri, no-Eliyeli,
no-Abdon, no-Zikri, no-Hanani,
uHananiya, noElam, noAnothiya,
U-Ifediya no-Penuyeli babe yizingane zikaShashaki.
uShamsherai, noShehariya, noAthaliya,
UYareshiya, noEliya, noZikri, babe yizingane zikaYerohamu.
Bonke labo babe ngabaholi bezindlu zakwababa babo, ngokusho komlando wabo wemindeni yabo; bebengabaphathi; bahlala eYerusalem.
EGibeboni kwahlala uJeyeli, ubaba kaGibeboni; igama lesifazane sakhe lalinguMahaka.
Umzali wakhe wayenguAbdon. Okunye kwabantwana bakhe kwaba nguZure, noKishe, noBhaali, noNadabhi,
uGedori, noAhiya, noZekeri,
noMiklothi, ubaba kaShimea; bona nabo bahlala eduze kwabangane babo eYerusalem.
UNeri waba ubaba kaKishi; uKishi waba ubaba kaSawule; uSaule waba ubaba kaYonathani, noMalkishuha, noAbinabadi, no-Eshbhaali.
Unyana kaYonathani waba nguMeribi-bhaali; uMeribi-bhaali ube ngumzali kaMika.
Oonyana bakaMikha: uPithoni, noMeleki, noTareya, noAhaza.
UAhazi waba ubaba kaYehodada; uYehodada waba ubaba kaAlemethe, noAzmawethe, noZimri; uZimri waba ubaba kaMoza.
UMoza waba ubaba kaBineya; unyana kaBineya ube nguRafa, unyana kaRafa ube nguEleasa, unyana kaEleasa ube nguAseli.
Waba ngu-Aseli oonyana abangusithandathu; amagama abo wu-Azrikam, noBoheru, no-Ishmayeli, no-Shearya, no-Obadia, no-Hanan; labo bonke babe yizingane zika-Aseli.
Oonyana baka-Esheki, udadewabo, ngu-Ulam owayengumzali wakhe, no-Jeushi owesibili, no-Elifelethe wesithathu.
Amadodana ka-Ulam abe yimikhosi enamandla, akwazi ukubopha amabhubesi; babe nezingane eziningi nabangane abakhulu, abantu abangamakhulu amabili namahlanu. Lawo wonke amadodana kaBhenjamin.
Futhi bonke isizwe samaSirayeli bahlukaniswa ngezinhlanga zabo, futhi bona, lokhu kubhalwe encwadini yamaNdiya amaSirayeli. Namadodakazi kaYuda athathwe ezweni laseBhabheli, ngenxa yobugebengu babo.
Abantu bokuqala ababuyela ezweni labo, nasezindaweni zabo, babe yimiSirayeli ejwayelekile, nababhishobhi, nalabaLevi, nalabo abasebenza ethempelini.
Bakhona abantu abavela ezifundweni zakwaYuda, noBhenjamini, noEfraim, noManase, bahlala eYerusalem.
KwaYuda kwakunguUthai unyana ka-Amihude, unyana ka-Omri, unyana ka-Imri, unyana ka-Bani; waba yindodana kaPerezi, unyana kaJuda.
KwabeSiloni kwaba ngu-Asaya, umzali wakhe, naye nonyana bakhe.
Ngabo oonyana bakaZera, uYehuyeli; ngabo bonke abazalwane bakaYuda, kwaba ngumakhulu mane anamashumi asithoba.
Ezweni likaBhenjamin, uSalu unyana kaMeshulam, unyana kaHodaviya, unyana kaHasenuaha.
futhi u-Ibneya unyana kaYerohamu, no-Ela unyana kaUzi, unyana kaMikri, no-Meshulam unyana kaShefatiya, unyana kaRehuweli, unyana ka-Ibneya.
Nabangane babo, ngokubhaliswa kwemindeni yabo, kwaba ngumakhulu ayisishiyagalolunye, anamahlanu nesithupha; labo bonke babe yinhloko yamamndeni wabo.
Ngabo ababingeleli: uJedaya, noYoharibi, noYakini.
futhi uAzariya, indodana kaHilkiya, indodana kaMeshulamu, indodana kaTsadoki, indodana kaMerayothi, indodana ka-Ahitubhu; uAzariya wayengumphathi wendlu kaThixo.

Kwabekhona uAdaiah, indodana kaYerohamu, indodana kaPashure, indodana kaMalkiya; kwabekhona uMaasai, indodana kaAdiyeli, indodana kaJazera, indodana kaMeshulam, indodana kaMeshilemith, indodana kaImer.

Ngabo bonke ababhishobhi, abe yikhulu elilodwa nenkulungwane nesishiyagalolunye namashumi ayisithupha; babe ngabaholi bezindlu zababa babo, abantu abanolwazi oluhle kakhulu emisebenzini yokuphatha indlu kaThixo.
KwabeLevi kwakunguShemaya unyana kaHashubu, unyana kaAzrikam, unyana kaHashabhiya, owesifazane waseMerariya.
futhi uBakbakar, noHeresh, noGalal, noMatania unyana kaMikha, unyana kaZikhri, unyana kaAsaphe.
Kwabekhona noObadiya unyana kaShemaya, unyana kaGalalu, unyana kaJeduthuni; kwabekhona noBerekiya unyana kaAsa, unyana kaElkana, owahlala ezindaweni zakwaNetophathi.
Abaphathi bezingcingo: uShalumu, no-Akubu, no-Talmoni, no-Ahimani, nabangane babo; uShalumu wayengumholi wabo.
Kusukela ngaleso sikhathi bahlala emgwaqweni wobukhosi osuka enyakatho, babe ngabaphathi bezindonga zesibhedlela samaLevi.

UShalumu unyana ka-Kore, unyana ka-Ebyashaphe, unyana ka-Kora; nabangani bakhe, omndeni wakhe, abakwa-Korahi, babe ngabaphathi beminyango yendlu yokuphumula; njengoba uyise wabo abephethe isikhundla sokuba ngabaphathi bokungena emgodini kaYehova.
Ngaleso sikhathi uPhinehasi, unyana ka-Eleazaru, wayeyisikhulu salabo abagcina isango; futhi iNkosi waba naye.
UZekariya, unyana kaMeshelemiya, waba ngumphathi wesango emnyango wesitezi sokuhlangana.

Kwaba khona amadoda amashumi amabili aneshumi nambili, abakhethiwe ukuba abe ngamagoli emaphethelweni, futhi babhaliswa ngomndeni wabo ezindaweni zabo. UDavide noSamuweli okubonayo wabeka kubo izikhundla zabo.
Bathi ke, bona nabangane babo, babe abaphathi bezindonga zendlu kaYehova, ikhaya lesitezi.
Abagwebi babe ngakwesobunxele, ngakwesokudla, ngakwesokunxele, ngasentshonalanga, nasentshonalanga.
Abahlobo babo ezindaweni zabo babezofika ngasikhathi sinye futhi bahlukanise umsebenzi wabo ngezinsuku ezisixhenxe ngosuku.
Nabo abakhulu abangu-ne abaphathi bezindonga, labo abaLevi, babekwa phezu kwazo zonke izibhedlela nezindawo zokugcina izinto endlwini kaThixo.
Bahlala busuku bonke ethempelini likaThixo, ngoba bekufanele bayigcine, futhi bekufanele bayivule ekuseni.
Baningi kubo abebephethe izinto ezisetshenziswayo emkhondweni, bezibala lapho zifakwa khona, futhi lapho zikhishwa khona.
Abanye babekwa ngaphansi kwempahla, nakwezinye izinto ezingcwele zonke, nenyama ehlanzekile, newayini, nophethiloli we-olive, nofuzo, nezithako.
Kodwa abanye ababhishobhi babe yilabo abaxhuma izithelo.
Kwabe kukhona uLevi okuthiwa nguMatithiya, umzali kaShalumu waseKora, owabekwa ukubhaka inkomishi yomnikelo wokudla.
Ezinye zazo izihlobo zabo, ezisuka emndenini wakwa-Kehati, zaziphethe ukulungiselela ubisi olungcwele ngeSabhati ngalinye.
Bakhona abaculi, abaholi bezindlu zakwaLevi; bahlala ezindlini zendlu kaThixo, bengenamsebenzi othile, ngoba babe nemisebenzi yabo ekuseni nasebusuku.
Bonke labo babe ngabaholi bezindlu zakwaLevi, ngokusho komlando wabo wemindeni yabo; bebengabaphathi; bahlala eYerusalem.
EGibeboni kwahlala uJeyeli, ubaba kaGibeboni; igama lesifazane sakhe lalinguMahaka.
Owesifazane wakhe uAbdon, nabangane bakhe nguZuri, noKishi, noBahali, noNeri, noNadab,
noGedori, noAhiyo, noZekariya, noMiklothi.
UMiklothi waba ubaba kaShimeam; nabo bahlala ndawonye nabangane babo eYerusalem.
UNeri waba ubaba kaKishi; uKishi waba ubaba kaSawule; uSaule waba ubaba kaYonathani, noMalkishuha, noAbinabadi, no-Eshbhaali.
Unyana kaYonathani waba nguMeribi-bhaali; uMeribi-bhaali ube ngumzali kaMika.
Oonyana bakaMikha: uPithoni, noMeleki, noTareha, noAhazi.
UAhazi waba ubaba kaJara; uJara waba ubaba kaAlemethe, no-Azmavethe, noZimri; uZimri waba ubaba kaMoza.
UMoza waba ngumzali kaBineya; uBineya ubengumntwana kaRefaya, uRefaya ubengumntwana kaEleasa, uEleasa ubengumntwana kaAseli.
Waba ngu-Aseli oonyana abangusithandathu; amagama abo wu-Azrikam, no-Bokheru, no-Ishmayeli, no-Shearya, no-Obadiya, no-Hanan. Babo oonyana ka-Aseli.
Bahlasela amaFilisti amadoda aseSirayeli; amadoda aseSirayeli esuka phambi kwabo, babulawa abantu abaningi emfuleni iGilboa.
Balandela amaFilisti uSawule nezingane zakhe, babulala uYonathani no-Abinabadi no-Malkishuha, izingane zikaSawule.
Ukulwa kwabe kunzima kakhulu ngaseSauli. Amadodana ka-Abhisalome ayemthola, wagwema.

Wathi uSawule kulowo wesifazane ogqoke isibhamu sakhe, Nciphisa isandla sakho, bulala ngaso; ngoba uma ungakwenza lokhu, bangafika labo abangenakutholwa ikhanda, bangisindise; kodwa lowo wesifazane wakhathazeka kakhulu ukuba akwenze njalo. Wathatha uSawule isandla sakhe, wehla kuso.
Wabona umthwali wezikhali ukuthi uSawule usefile, wavuka waya ekhephuni lakhe, wafa.
Wafa uSawule, nabantwana bakhe abathathu; nomndeni wakhe wonke waba mnyama.
Babona bonke amadoda aseSirayeli asendaweni yaseGileyadi ukuthi abantu baphuma, futhi ukuthi uSawule nezingane zakhe zifile, bashiya amadolobhana abo, babaleka; kwafika amaFilisti, bahlala kuwo.
Kwathi ngosuku olulandelayo, lapho befika khona amaFilisti ukuze bagqoke abafileyo, bathola uSawule nezingane zakhe zilele emfuleni iGilboa.
Bathatha ikhanda lakhe, nempahla yakhe yokuzivikela; bathumela abantu ezweni lonke labaseFilisti, ukuthi bathuthuzele amatshe abo, nomphakathi wabo.
Babeka izikhali zakhe ethempelini likaThixo wabo, bamisa ikhanda lakhe ethempelini likaDagon.
Bathe bonke abantu baseYabhesi-Gileyadi beva ukuthi abaFilisti bakwenzani noSawule,

Bahamba bonke abantu abanamandla, bathatha isidumbu sikaSawule nesibindi samadodana akhe, bazisa eYabheshi; bafihla amathambo abo ngezansi kwe-tabernakulum eYabheshi, bachitha izinsuku ezisixhenxe bengenakudla.
Wafa uSawule, ngenxa yokuthi wakhohlisa iNkosi; ngoba akazange alalele ilizwi likaNkulunkulu, kodwa wabuza indodana yowesifazane okhuluma ngezinkanyezi.
Ngalokho iNkosi wambulala, wabeka ukumkani kuDavide, unyana kaYese.
Bahlangana bonke isiSirayeli kuDavide eHebroni, bethi, Thola, thina sigazi lakho nonyama wakho.

Ngaleso sikhathi, nalapho uSawule engumnikazi khona, wena ubewukhiphayo uSirayeli, wababuyiselayo; futhi iNkosi uNkulunkulu wakho wathi kuwe, Uzophatha abantu bami baseSirayeli; nawe uzobe ngummengameli phezu kwabantu bam baseSirayeli.

Bafika khona bonke abakhulu bakaSirayeli kukumkani uDavide eHebroni, wakwenza khona uDavide umhlangano nabo phambi koYehova; bamwisa waba ngukumkani phezu kwaSirayeli, njengokuthi iNkosi wathi ngamazwi kaSamuweli.
Wahamba uDavide, naye wonke amaSirayeli, waya eYerusalem (iJerusalema libizwa ngokuthi yi-Yebush), lapho behlala khona abaJebhusi.
Bathi abantu baseJebhusi kuDavide, Uzongena lapha kangako; kodwa uDavide wathatha isakhiwo esiqinile saseSiyone, futhi sabizwa ngokuthi yidolobha likaDavide.
UDavide wathi, "Uma umuntu ehlasela amaJebhusi, kufanele abe nguMengameli weqembu." UYowabhi unyana kaZeruhiya waphuma kuqala, waba nguMengameli.
UDavide wahamba waya esitezi esiphakeme, sabizwa ngokuthi yidolobha likaDavide.
Wakwakha idolobha ngaso sonke isikhathi, kusukela eMilo kuya kuyo yonke indawo; futhi uYowabhi walungisa isibopho sedolobha.
UDavide waqhubeka ekhula, waba mkhulu; futhi iNkosi wemikhosi waye naye.
Baye labo abakhulu phakathi kwamadoda amakhulu anamandla, ayenawo uDavide; nabo bonke amaSirayeli babe nesandla esiqinile kuye, ukuba abe ngukumkani wakhe, njengokuthi iNkosi wathi kuSirayela.
Lokho wuhlu lwamabhishobhi anamandla kaDavide: uYashubham, owaseHakmoni, owayengumholi wabathathu. Wasebenzisa isithunywa sakhe, wabulala abantu abangumakhulu amathathu emdlalweni owodwa.
Walandela ngawo uEleazaru, unyana kaDodo wase-Ahohi, owayengumunye wabanqobi abakhulu abathathu.
Waye noDavide ePasdamini, lapho abaFilisti behlangana khona ukubhekana nempi; kwakukhona khona indawo egcwele imbewu yeshubhu; futhi isizwe samaSirayeli sahamba phambi kwabaFilisti.
U-Elazare noDavide bahlala phakathi kwendawo, beyivikela, babulala amaFilisti; futhi iNkosi wabanika ukusindisa okukhulu.
Baphuma abathathu kubo bonke abaholi abamashumi amathathu, bafika kuDavide esihlalweni esigabeni sase-Adulam; futhi amaFilisti ayesesitezi esiseNtaba yamaRefayi.
Wayekhona uDavide esitezi esiphakeme, futhi amaFilisti ayeseBethelehemu.
UDavide wafuna amanzi, wathi, Uma ngabe kukhona umuntu ongenza ngiphuze amanzi emfuleni waseBethelehemu, ogwini lwesango.

Lawa madoda amathathu ahlasela amaFilisti, wageza amanzi emgodini waseBethelehemu, wayalela uDavide; kodwa uDavide akakwazanga ukuwudla, wathi: "Uzowudonsa kukaNkulunkulu." Wathi uSawule: "Kulungile, ngikubonile, futhi ngikubone.

Wathi uDavide, "Ungilungise uNkulunkulu ukuthi ngikwenze lokhu! Ngizodla yini igazi lalabo bantu abathathele impilo yabo engozini?" Ngokuba bathatha impilo yabo engozini ukulithola, uDavide akazange alidle. Lokhu kwakungumsebenzi onamandla wale mikhosi emithathu.
U-Abhishai, udade kaYowabhi, waba nguMengameli wabo bonke abathathu. Wasebenzisa isibhamu sakhe wabulala abantu abangumakhulu amathathu; waba negama phakathi kwabo bobabili.
Wabe uhlonishwa kakhulu kunabanye ababini abathathu, waba ngumphathi wabo, kodwa akayena owodwa kubo bobabili.

U-Benaya, unyana ka-Yehodaya, owayengumuntu onamandla kakhulu, wakwenza imisebenzi emikhulu eKabtseeli. Wabulala amadoda amakhulu amabini aseMowabhi, waphuma emgodini ngesikhathi sekhephu, wabulala ingulube.

Wabulala umYiputa, owayemde kakhulu, amamitha ayisishiyagalombili namashumi amane. UmYiputa wayenesihluku esiqinile njengenkomishi yombukiso; kodwa uBhenaya waya kuye enesibhakabhaka kuphela, wathatha ihluku esandla somYiputa, wambulala ngalo.
Lezo zizinto ezidume kakhulu zikaBhenaya, unyana kaYehoyada; wathola igama phakathi kwalabo abakhulu abathathu.
Waba mkhulu kunabo abamashumi amathathu, kodwa akazange abe ngumunye wabathathu. UDavide wambeka engqondweni yabo bonke abantu bakhe.
Kwabekho namadoda amakhulu, afana no-Asaheli udade kaYowabhi; no-Elhanani unyana kaDodo waseBethelehemu;
uShamothi umHarori, noHelezi umPeloni;
u-Ira unyana ka-Ikeshe waseTekoa, no-Abiezer waseAnathothi;
uSibhekai waseHushathi, noElai waseAhohi;
uMaharayi waseNetofa, noHeledi unyana kaBaana waseNetofa;
UIthai unyana kaRibhayi, waseGibeha eBhenjamini; noBenaya wasePirathoni;
uHurai, osuka ezindongeni zeGaashe; uAbiyeli umArbati;
uAzmavethi waseBaharumi, noEliabha waseShaalboni;
Oonyana bakaHashemi umGizoni; uYonathani indodana kaShagi, umHarani;
u-Ahiyamu, indodana ka-Sakare waseHara; u-Eliphali, indodana ka-Ure;
uHepher waseMekerathi, noAhiya wasePeloni;
uHezero waseKarmeli, noAyarayeli unyana ka-Ezbai;
uJoyele, umngane kaNathani; noMibhare, unyana kaHagri;
uZeleki umAmoni, noNaharayi waseBherothi, ophethe izikhali zikaYowabhi unyana kaZeruhiya;
uIra umYithrithi; uGarebhi umYithrithi;
uUriya umHithi, noZabadi unyana ka-Ahali;
U-Adina unyana kaShisha, waseRubheni, owayengumholi wamaRubheni; naye wayenendodana emashumi amathathu.
uHanani unyana kaMahaka, noYoshafati umMithini;
UUziya wase-Ashtarothi, noShama noJeyeli, oonyana bakaHothamu base-Aroeri;
uJediyayeli unyana kaShimri, noJoha umngane wakhe waseTizi;
uEliyeli waseMahabhi, noYeribayi noYoshaviya, oonyana baka-Elnaamu, noIthama waseMoabi;
uEliyeli, noObedi, noYasiyele waseMezobhayi.
Lawa amadoda afike kuDavide eSikelage, lapho efihla khona ngenxa kaSawule unyana kaKishi; babe phakathi kwamadoda amakhulu asiza uDavide emkhosini.
Babe begqoke izibhamu, futhi bakwazi ukushaya izinhlamvu noma ukubamba amatshe ngesandla sabo sokudla noma sesobunxele. Beyilungu lemindeni kaSawule eyisizwe sikaBhenjamin.
Waba ngu-Ahiezer umholi wabo, noYoashi unyana ka-Shemaya waseGibeha; no-Iziyeli no-Peleti unyana ka-Azmavethi; no-Beraka; no-Yehu owaseAnathothi;
U-Ishmaya waseGibeboni, owayengumuntu onamandla phakathi kwabathathu, waba nguMengameli wabothathu; noYeremiya, noYahaziyeli, noYohanani, no-Yozabadi waseGedara;
u-Eluzayi, no-Yerimothi, no-Behaliya, no-Shemariha, no-Shefatiya umHarufi;
nakwa-Elkana, no-Ishiya, no-Azareli, no-Yozere, no-Yashobham, abaKori;
noYoyela, noZebadia, oonyana bakaYerohamu baseGedori.

Kwaba khona namadoda athile ezweni laseGadi, wahlangana naye uDavide emgodini wakhe esiqhingini. Babantu abadumile kakhulu(a) abaqeqeshiwe ukubhekana nokulwa, abakwaziyo ukusebenzisa isibhakabhaka nesibhakabhaka; futhi isikhumba sabo safana nesikhumba sengulube, futhi bahamba ngokushesha njengama-gazels emadolobheni.
u-Ezere waba nguMengameli, no-Obhadiya ube yisibili, no-Elihabhi ube wesithathu,
Mishmannah wesithathu, uYeremiya wesithupha,
uAtayi wesishiyagalombili, uEliyeli wesishiyagalolunye,
uYohanane wesishiyagalolunye, uElzabade wesithoba,
uYeremiya owamashumi amabili, noMakbannai owamashumi amathathu.
Lawa amadodana kaGadi, abe yibo abaphathi bemikhosi; umncane kubo wathatha abantu abangamashumi amabili, nomkhulu wabo waba nezigidi.
Badlula emfuleni iYorodani ngonyaka wokuqala, lapho umfula ugcwele zonke izintaba zakhe; bahlasela bonke abahlali ezindaweni ezisempumalanga nasezikhungweni.
Kwafika namanye amadoda asuka eBhenjamini naseYuda, waya kuDavide esitezi esiphakeme.

Waphuma uDavide, wabhekana nabo, wathi kubo, Uma nifika ngempilo, ukuze ningisize, ngizohamba nani; kodwa uma nifika ukuthi ningifake ezimpi(i)ni, nakuba kungekho monakalo engiwenzayo, khona-ke uNkulunkulu wakwababa bethu angabona, agweme.

Wafika uMoya ku-Amasai, umholi wabo abathathu, wathi: Sikhona wena, uDavide; sikhona nawe, unyana kaYese. Ukuthula, ukuthula kuwe, nokuthula kubo bonke abakusizayo; ngoba uNkulunkulu wakho usiza wena. UDavide wabajabulela, wababeka njengezikhulu zamadodana akhe.

Kwaba khona nabanye abantu baseManase, ababeya kuDavide, lapho ehamba namaFilisti ukubhekana noSawule; kodwa uDavide namadodana akhe akazange awasize amaFilisti. Ke kaloku abaphathi bamaFilisti baxoxa ngalokhu, wathumela kuye, bethi, Uma ebuyela kumnikazi wakhe uSawule, ngeke kube ngekhanda lethu.

Kwathi lapho uDavide ehamba eSikelage, kwafika naye amadoda asuka kuManase: uAdna, noYozabadhi, noYediayeli, noMikayeli, noYozabadhi, noElihu, noZilethai; wonke umuntu waba nguMengameli wamakhulu aseManase.
Basiza uDavide ukubhekana nalabo abahlaselayo, ngoba bonke babe ngamagoli anamandla kanye nabaphathi emikhosini yakhe.
Ngosuku nosuku kwafika abantu ukusiza uDavide, kuze kube khona umkhosi omkhulu kuye, njengemkhosi kaThixo.
Lawa amanani endodana yomndeni kaSawule, abafika kuDavide eHebroni, ukuthi bayidlulise kuye ubukhosi bukaSawule, njengokuthi iNkosi.
Ezweni lakwaYuda kwafika abantu abangumakhulu amathandathu, anamashumi ayisishiyagalombili abaqeqeshiwe emkhosini, bezigqoka amagilavu namatshe.
Ngabo-Simeoni kwafika amaphesenti ayishumi nesishiyagalombili, abantu abaqeqeshiwe empilweni.
KwaLevi kwaba ngumakhulu amane, anamakhulu ayisithupha.
UYehoyada, umphathi wendlu ka-Aron, wafika naye abantu abangumakhulu amathathu anamakhulu ayisishiyagalombili;
futhi uTsadoki, owesifazane ongumnqobi onamandla, wafika, naye namadodana akhe amashumi amabili namabini.
NaseBhenjamini, isizwe sikaSawule, kwafika abantu abangu-elilodwa nenkulungwane ezintathu; ngoba kwabaningi kubo ababehlala emndenini kaSawule.
Ku-Ephrayim kwakukhona abantu abakhulu, abanomlando emiphakathini yabo, abangamaphesenti angamashumi amabili anamakhulu ayisishiyagalombili.
Engxenyeni yesizwe sikaManase kwafika abantu abangu-18, abakhethiwe ngegama, ukuba bafike babe ngukumkani uDavide.
Ezweni lika-Issakare kwakukhona abaholi abangamakhulu amabili, abakwaziyo ukuqonda izingcezu zesikhathi, ukuthi yini okufanele bayikwenze isiSirayeli; bonke abazalwane babo balandela umthetho wabo.
Ezweni likaZebuloni kwakukhona amadoda amashumi amahlanu anamakhulu amahlanu, abantu abaqeqeshiwe empilweni, abanezinto zonke zokuzivikela; bonke babe yindodana kaDavide.
NgaseNaphtali kwaba ngukhulu elilodwa, namaphesenti amashumi amathathu nesishiyagalombili, abathwala amagobolondo namaphiko.
KwaDani kwaba ngamaphesenti angama-28 namaphesenti angama-600, alungiselelwe ukulwa.
Kusuka ku-Ashere kwafika amaphesenti angamashumi amane, abaqeqeshiwe empilweni.
Ngasenyakatho yeJordani, eRubheni nakwaGadi, nasengxenyeni yesizwe sikaManase, kwaba ngumakhulu amahlanu anamashumi amabini amawaka, agqoke zonke izinhlobo zezikhali.

Bonke labo bamadoda anamandla, abakwaziyo ukubhekana nempi. Bafika eHebroni, befuna kakhulu ukwenza uDavide ukumkani phezu kwabaSirayeli bonke. Nabo bonke abantu baseSirayeli babe nombono wokwenza uDavide ukumkani.
Bahlala khona noDavide izinsuku ezintathu, bedla nokuphuza; ngoba abazalwane babo babebalungiselelile ukudla.

Nalabo abasenyakatho yabo, kuze kube yi-Issakhar, noZebuloni, noNaphtali, babeletha ukudla ezimvuni, nezingulube, nezinkomo agqugquzelayo, namakhowe. Kwaba khona ubisi oluningi, namajikijolo, namakhowe, newayini, namafutha omnqumo, namakhowe, namakhowe afile; kwaba mnandi kakhulu eSirayeli.
UDavide wakhuluma ngalezo zinto namadodana akhe amakhulu, namadodana akhe amakhulu, nabantu bakhe bonke.

Wathi kubo bonke isibingelelo samaSirayeli, Uma kulungile emehlo enu, uma kuyiNkosi iNkosi uNkulunkulu wethu, sithumelele abafowethu nabangane bethu emazweni onke aseSirayeli, namabhishobhi namaLevi ezifundeni zabo nezifundazwe zazo, ukuthi bafike nathi.
Ake siyibuyisele nathi ibhokisi likaThixo wethu, ngoba asizange siyifune lapho uSawule engumphathi.
Ingqungquthela yonke yavuma ukwenza lokhu, ngoba wonke umuntu wacabanga ukuthi kuyinto efanele ukwenziwa.
UDavide waqoqa wonke amaSirayeli, kusukela emfuleni iShihore eYiputa, kuze kufike eHamati, ukuba athathe isibuko sikaThixo kusuka eKiriyati-yearim.

Wahamba uDavide, naye wonke amaSirayeli, waya eBhala (leyo yiKiriyati-yearimi yaseYuda), ukuba abuyisele ibhokisi likaYehova uNkulunkulu, ohlala phezu kweqhwa lakhe phakathi kwezikerubi, ibhokisi elibizwa ngegama lakhe.
Bathwala ibhokisi likaThixo emgodini omusha, besuka endlwini ka-Abinadaba; uUza noAhiyo babehamba ngomgodi.
UDavide namaSirayeli wonke bedlala phambi kukaThixo ngesandla sabo sonke, ngokudlalwa kwama-harps, nama-lyras, nama-tamburins, nama-cymbals, nama-trumpets.
Bafika esitezi sokudla sika-Chidon, izingulube ziqhekekile; uUza waphakamisa isandla sakhe ukuba aqinise isithuthi.
UYehova wagwema kakhulu u-Uza, wambulala ngenxa yokuthi egqoke isibambo; waza wafa khona lapho phambi kukaThixo.
UDavide wagwema, ngenxa yokuthi iNkosi wayewugweme uUza; ngakho kwabizwa igama lesi sifundazwe ngokuthi iPerezi-Uza kuze kube manje.
UDavide wakhathazeka ngoNkulunkulu ngalolusuku, wathi, Ngabe ngizoyifaka kanjani ibhokisi likaThixo endlwini yami?
Ngakho uDavide akayihambisanga ibhokisi kuye edolobhaneni likaDavide, wayisa endlwini ka-Obedi-edomu waseGathi.
Ibhokisi likaThixo lahlala emndenini ka-Obedi-edomu, ekhaya lakhe, iminyaka emithathu; futhi iNkosi wabambisana nendlu ka-Obedi-edomo, nazo zonke izinto zakhe.
UHirame, ukumkani waseTire, wathumela abathunywa kuDavide, namatshe aseduzane, nabenzi bezindonga, nabenzi bamapulangwe, ukuba bamkhiphe indlu.
UDavide waqonda ukuthi iNkosi wamenza ukumkani phezu kwaSirayeli, futhi ukuba ubukumkani bakhe bukhulu ngenxa yabantu bakhe baseSirayeli.
UDavide washada namanye amabhishobhi eYerusalem, waba nezingane eziningi.
Lawona amagama abo abazalwa kuye eYerusalem: uShamua, noShobabu, noNathani, noSolomoni,
uIbhare, noElishuwa, noElpelethe,
uNoga, noNefegi, noYaphia,
noElishama, noBhiliyada, noElifelethe.
Kwathi lapho abaFilisti beva ukuthi uDavide usayinwe ukumkani phezu kwamadodana kaSirayeli onke, bakhuphuka bonke abantu baseFilisti ukumlandela. UDavide wakwazi lokhu, waphuma wababheka.
Bafika amaFilisti, bahlasela iGoli lika-Refayi.
UDavide wabuza uNkulunkulu, wathi, Ngizoya ngihlasela amaFilisti? Ingabe uzobanikela phambi kwami? Waphendula iNkosi wathi kuye, Yiya, ngibanikela phambi kwakho.

Waphuma uDavide namadodana akhe, wafika eBhaali-perazime, wababulala khona. UDavide wathi, "UNkulunkulu uphonsa izitha zami ngesandla sami, njengokuthi amanzi aphonsa ipayipi"; ngakho kwabizwa igama lesi sifundazwe ngokuthi iBhaali-perazime.
Bashiya khona amaFilisti amadini abo, uDavide wabeka umthetho ukuba aqhume.
Baphinde bahlasela amaFilisti idolobhana.
UDavide wabuza uNkulunkulu. Wathi uNkulunkulu kuye, Ungawahlasela ngaphesheya; buyela emuva kwabo, uwahlasele ngaphesheya kwezintaba-mlilo.
Uma ubona umsindo wokuhamba ezindaweni eziphezulu zezintaba-mlilo, khona-ke uzophuma ukuhlasela; ngoba uNkulunkulu usephuma phambi kwakho, ukuze ahlasele amaFilisti.
Wakwenza uDavide njengokuthi uNkulunkulu wamwisela, wahlasela amaFilisti kusukela eGibeyon kuya eGezeri.
UDavide wathola igama ezweni lonke, futhi iNkosi wabangele ukukhathazeka ngaye kuzo zonke izizwe.
Wakha uDavide izindlu zakhe edolobhaneni likaDavide, walungiselela indawo yodoti kaThixo, wamisa itente layo.
Wathi uDavide, Akukho muntu ozothwala ibhokisi likaThixo ngaphandle kwabaLevi; ngoba labo abakhethiwe nguYehova ukuba bathwale ibhokisi likaNkulunkulu, ukuze basebenze naye kuze kube sekupheleni.
UDavide waqoqa wonke amaSirayeli eYerusalem, ukuba akhuphule ibhokisi likaYehova, lifike endaweni ayeyilungiselele.
Wabiza bonke abazalwane baka-Aron nalabaLevi, wathi:
Ezinganeni zikaKohati, uUriyeli owayengumholi, nabangane bakhe abangamakhulu amabili namahlanu.
Ngabo oonyana bakaMerariya, uAsaya owayengumholi, nabangane bakhe abangamakhulu amabili namahlanu.
Ngabo oonyana bakaGershoni, uYoweli umholi, nabangane bakhe abangamakhulu amathathu anamashumi amane.
Ngabo oonyana baka-Elizaphane, uShemaya umholi, nabangane bakhe abangamakhulu amabili.
Kumadodana ka-Hebroni, uEliyeli owayengumholi, nodadewabo abamashumi asibhozo.
Ngabo oonyana baka-Uziyeli, uAminadabi owayengumholi; nabangane bakhe babemakhulu amabili namahlanu.
UDavide wabiza uTsadoki noAbhiyathari ababingeleli, namaLevi, uUriyeli, noAsaya, noYoweli, noShemaya, noEliyele, noAminadabhi.
Wathi kubo, Niyinhloko zezingane zakwaLevi; ziningcwele niwe nabangani benu, ukuze nikhuphule isibambo sikaYehova uNkulunkulu kaSirayeli, nifike endaweni engiyilungiselele yona.
Ngaleso sikhathi sokuqala, niyiLevi, akunandaba nalokho; ngakho iNkosi uNkulunkulu wethu wagwema ukuthukuthela kuthi; sathi siyambuza ukuthi sikwenze kanjani.
Baphoqeleka ke abapristi nabaLevi ukuba bahlanze izandla zabo, ukuze bakhuphule ibhokisi likaYehova uNkulunkulu kaSirayeli.
Bathwala amaLevi ibhokisi likaThixo ezindaweni zazo, ngezinkomishi, ngokusho komthetho kaMoses, ngokwelizwi likaYehova.
Wathi uDavide kubaholi bamaLevi, ukuthi babeke phakathi kwabazalwane babo abadlali bemiculo, abadlala ama-harps, nama-harp, nama-cymbals, nabadlali bemisindo ejabulisayo.
Bathi abaLevi bamisa uHeman, indodana kaYoweli, noAsaphe, indodana kaBerekiya, abazalwane bakhe; namaMerari, abazalwane babo, uEthan, indodana kaKushaya.

Nabo abahlobo babo, abalandelayo ngokulandelana kwabo: uZekariya, noBeni, noYahaziyeli, noShemiramoth, noYehiyeli, noUnni, noEliabhi, noBhenaya, noMaasihiya, noMatithiya, noEliphelehu, noMikneya, na-Obedi-edomu, noJeyeli, abaphathi bezinsiza.
Abaculi, uHeman, noAsaphe, noEthane, babedlala ama-cymbals esiliva.
UZekariya, no-Aziyeli, no-Shemiramoth, no-Yehiyeli, no-Unni, no-Elibham, no-Maaseya, no-Banaiah, badlala ama-harps aphezulu, abizwa ngokuthi yi-Alamoth.
UMatithiya, noEliphelehu, noMiknehiya, noObedi-edomu, noJeyeli, noAzaziya, babephethe ama-lairi ahamba ngezinga eliphansi, abizwa ngokuthi yiSheminithi.
U-Kenaniya, owayengumholi wabaLevi, wayephethe udaba lwezingoma, futhi wafundisa abaculi; ngoba wayenekhono.
U-Berekiya no-Elkana babezogcina ibhokisi.
UShebhaniya, noYoshafati, noNethaneli, noAmasai, noZekariya, noBhenaya, noEliyezeri, abapristi, babephuza amabhungane phambi kwebhokisi likaThixo; uObhede-Edom noYehiya babegcina ibhokisi.
Waye ke uDavide, namadoda amakhulu aseSirayeli, nabaholi bezinkulungwane, besuka endlwini ka-Obedi-edomu, bethwasa isibambo sesivumelwano sikaYehova.
Banikela ngezinkomo ezisixhenxe, nezimvu ezisixhenxe; ngoba uNkulunkulu wasiza amaLevi athwala ibhokisi lesivumelwano sikaYehova.
UDavide wagqoka isibhakabhaka selinen, nalabo bonke abaLevi abathwali isibambo, nabaculi, noChenaniya, umphathi wengoma; futhi uDavide wagqoka i-ephod yelinen.
Ngaleyo ndlela bonke isiSirayeli bakhuphula ibhokisi lesivumelwano sikaYehova, ngezwi lothando, nezwi lezinkomo, nezwi lezimpondo, nama-cymbals, nama-harps, nama-piano.

Kwathi lapho ibhokisi lesivumelwano sikaYehova lifika edolobhaneni likaDavide, uMikhayeli intombi kaSawule, ebheka ngaphesheya kwefasitela, wabona ukumkani uDavide enqoba nokudlalwa, wagwema yena emlonyeni wakhe.
Bafaka khona ibhokisi likaThixo, bamise phakathi kwehholo uDavide abelile lona; futhi banikela ngenhlanhla ngomnikelo wokushiswa nomnikelo wokuthula kukaNkulunkulu.
Kwathi, lapho uDavide eqedile ukunikela ngenhlanhla yokudlwengula nezenhlanhla zokuthula, wabambisa abantu ngegama likaYehova.
Wabanikeza bonke abantu baseSirayeli, amadoda nabesifazane, inkomishi eyodwa yenkomo, nengxenye eyodwa yemifino, nengxenye eyodwa yezithelo.
Wabeka abanye abaLevi ukuba basebenze phambi kwebhokisi likaYehova, ukuthi bakhulume, babonga, futhi bathokozele iNkosi, uNkulunkulu wakwaSirayeli.

UAsaphe waba nguMengameli, uZekariya ube yindodana yakhe; futhi uJeyeli, noShemiramoti, noYehiyeli, noMatithiya, noElibha, noBhenaya, noObedi-Edom, noJeyili, babezidlala izingoma ezidumile nezingqungquthela. UAsaphe wayezidlala ngezinhlamvu.
UBenaya noYahaziyeli, abapristi, babemele baphuze amabhungane njalo phambi kwesiqokobhe somthetho kaThixo.
Waqala uDavide ngalolu busuku ukubiza uAsaphe nodadewabo, ukuba bathande iNkosi ngolimi olunjalo:
Babongani iNkosi, nibize igama lakhe; sithi ezizwe zonke izinto azenzayo.
Hamba ukhulume naye, Hamba ukhulume naye, Ukhuluma ngemisebenzi yakhe yonke emangazayo.
Yiba nomhlomulo ngegama lakhe elingcwele, Lijabule inhliziyo labo abafuna iNkosi.
Thola iNkosi nobunamandla bakhe, Thola yena njalo.
Khumbula izinto zakhe ezimangazayo azenzayo, izibonakaliso zakhe, nezigwebo zakhe awakhulumayo,
Niyimbewu yomkhonzi wakhe uSirayeli, niyizingane zikaYakobi, abakhethiwe bakhe.
UNkulunkulu wethu, yena iNkosi; Izigwebo zakhe zibonakala emhlabeni wonke.
Khumbulani umnqophiso wakhe kuze kube sekupheleni, isinqumo sakhe sosuku nosuku.
Lo ngumthetho wakhe owenza noAbrahama, kanye negunya lakhe elingu-Isake.
Wakwenza kube yimithetho kuYakobi, ibe ngumthetho ohlala njalo eSirayeli.
Wathi, Ngizokulethela izwe likaKanana njengengxenye yakho yomhlaba.
Nakuba bekungabakho nabani na phakathi kwenu owaziyo ukuthi iNkosi yenu, uSomandla, uyayithanda le ndawo?
Bahamba besuka ezweni elilodwa besiya kwelinye izwe, besuka emzini owodwa beya komnye.
Akazange avumele umuntu ukuthi awabise. Wabatshela ubukhosi ngenxa yabo:
Musa ukubopha abangcwele bami, futhi ungabi nento ebuhlungu kumaprofeti ami.
Umhlaba wonke, ingomani kuYehova; Buza usindiso lwakhe ngosuku ngalunye.
Batshele izizwe ubuhle bakhe, Bakhulume zonke izinhlanga ngezimanga zakhe.
Umkhulu iNkosi, ngaphezu kwazo zonke izinto ezidume kakhulu; kufanele athandeke phezu kwazo zonke izitha.
Amasiko asezizwe onke afana nezinhlamvu, kodwa iNkosi wenza izulu.
Ubuhle nobudume bubhekene naye, amandla nothando bugcwele indawo yakhe yokuhlala.
Ninikele iNkosi, nizinhlanga zezizwe, ninikeze iNkosi ukudumisa nokunamandla!
Ninikele iNkosi igama lakhe, ninikeze umnikelo, nifike phambi kwakhe; niwukhonze iNkosi ngobuhle bendawo yakhe engcwele.
Umhlaba wonke, cindezela phambi kwakhe. Izwe lihlala liqinile. Akufanele lishintshwe.
Nazithokozele izulu, futhi izwe lijabule; Nathi phakathi kwezizwe zonke, UNkulunkulu unguMlawuli.
Ulwandle nezinto zonke ezingaphakathi kulo, kufanele ziqonde; izihlahla nezinto zonke ezingaphakathi kuzo, kumele ziqonde.
Uma kunjalo, izihlahla zesihlabathi zizojabula phambi koYehova; ngoba yena uzofika agweme umhlaba.
Ngiyabonga kuYehova, ngoba ulungile; Uthando lwakhe luhlala kuze kube sekupheleni.
Uthi, Sisindise, Nkosi yethu uNkulunkulu wokubuyisana kwethu; Sihlanganiseni, sisindise emazweni, ukuze sibonga igama lakho elingcwele, futhi sijabulise ngokukubonga.
Lola iNkosi, uNkulunkulu kaSirayeli, kuze kube sekupheleni kosuku. Bathi bonke abantu, Amen, baloba iNkosi.
Washiya khona uDavide uAsaphe nodadewabo, phambi kwesiqokobhe sesivumelwano sikaYehova, ukuba basebenze khona njalo, ngaso sonke isikhathi.
Washiya no-Obedi-Edom, nabangane bakhe abamashumi mane anesibhozo, ukuba basebenze nabo; no-Obedi-Edom unyana kaJeduthuni, no-Hosa babe ngabaphathi besango.
UDavide washiya uTsadoki umbingeleli, nabangane bakhe ababingeleli, phambi kwendlu kaYehova, ezindaweni eziphakeme eGibeyon.

ukuze ba kwenzeke ngokuqhubekayo, ngasekuseni nakusihlwa, ukuthi banikela ngenhlanhla ngomnikelo wokushiswa kuYehova phezu kwesibingelelo sokudla okuncibilikayo, ngokwezinto zonke ezibhalwe emthethweni kaYehova, owawuthi kuSirayeli.
Ngabo uHeman, noJeduthuni, nabanye abakhethiwe ngegama labo, ukuba babonga iNkosi, ngokuba uthando lwakhe luhlala njalo.
UHeman noJeduthuni babephethe amabhubesi, nama-cymbals, namanye amathuluzi wokudlalwa kwengoma kaThixo. Oonyana bakaJeduthuni babehlala emnyango.
Basuka bonke abantu ezindaweni zabo, uDavide wabuyela ezindaweni zakhe, ukuze asize imindeni yakhe.
Wathi uDavide kuNathani umprofeti, lapho ehlala khona ekhaya lakhe: "Njengoba ngihlala endlini yesedari, kodwa isibambo somthetho kaYehova sihlala esitezi."
Wathi uNathani kuDavide, Ukwenze konke okusenhliziyoni yakho; ngoba uNkulunkulu unguwe.
Kodwa ngaleyo busuku ilizwi likaThixo lafika kuNathani. UNkulunkulu wathi,
Iya, utshele umkhonzi wami uDavide, ukuthi, Uthi iNkosi lokhu: Awuwukwakha yini indlu yami ukuze ngihlala kuyo?

Ngangihlalanga ekhaya kusukela ngosuku lapho ngakhipha khona amaSirayeli eYiputa, kuze kube manje; kodwa ngihamba ngisuka emgodini ngiye emgodini, futhi ngisuka endaweni yokuhlala ngiye endaweni yokuhlala.

Ngaphi na lapho ngihamba khona nabantu bonke bakaSirayeli, ngathi yini kunoma ubani wabo bonke abavikeli bezwe lami engiwiselayo ukuba abe ngumlimi walo, ngithi, Kungani na ukuthi ningangikha indlu yesedru?
Ngakho manje uzokutshela umkhonzi wami uDavide, uthi, Uthi lokho iNkosi wamaSirayeli: Ngikuthathe wena emgwaqeni, elandela izinkomo, ukuze ube ngumholi phezu kwabantu bam baseSirayeli.
Ngibe nawe kuwo onke amadolobha owahamba kuwo, ngazibulala zonke izitha zakho phambi kwakho; futhi manje ngizokwenza igama lakho libe likhulu, njengegama labo abakhulu emhlabeni.
Ngizobeka indawo abantu bam, isiSirayeli, ngibatshale khona; bazohlala ezweni labo, futhi ngeke baphazamiseke nhlobo. Abantu ababi bangawacindezeli kangako, njengoba bekwenze ekuqaleni,
Ngikutshela ukuthi uNdikhoyo uzokwakha indlu kuwe, nomndeni wamabukhosi, njengoba bekwenze kusukela kuleso sikhathi lapho ngabeka khona abaphathi phezu kwabantu bam, isizwe sikaSirayeli.
Uma ubudala bakho buphelile, futhi uyalala nabantu bakababa bakho, ngizomisa umzali wakho endaweni yakho, ovela emilenzeni yakho; futhi ngizoqinisa ibukhosi bakhe.
Uzokwakha indlu yami, futhi ngizokwenza isikhala sakhe sihlale isikhathi eside.
Ngizobe ngubaba wakhe, naye uzobe ngumntwana wami; futhi ngeke ngiyisuse inhlonipho yami kuye, njengokuthi ngiyisuse emkhosini wakho ongaphambili.
futhi ngizomisa phezu kwendlu yami nobukhosi bam kuze kube sekupheleni; isikhala sakhe sizohlala njalo.
Wathi uNathani kuDavide konke amazwi kaYehova ephupheni lakhe.
Wafika uDavide ukumkani, wahlala phambi koYehova, wathi, Ngibani na mina, Nkosi yami uNkulunkulu? Ingabe yini ikhaya lami, ukuthi ungisize ngifike lapho?
Ngiyabona ukuthi lokhu akuyona into encane ngamehlo akho, uNkulunkulu, futhi ukhuluma ngendlu yomkhonzi wakho; ungenza kimi njengomuntu omkhulu kakhulu, Nkosi kaNkulunkulu.
Ngizokwazi yini ukukutshela okuningi, ngoba usize umkhonzi wakho ngale ndlela? Uyazi umkhonzi wakho.
Nkosi, ngenxa yomkhonzi wakho, futhi ngenxa yenhliziyo yakho, wenza konke lokhu okukhulu, ukuveza zonke lezi zinto ezinkulu.
Nkosi, akukho muntu ofana nawe, futhi akukho uNkulunkulu ngaphandle kwakho, ngokwezinto esizibonayo ngezindlebe zethu.

Ingabe kunezwe elilodwa ezweni elifana nabantu bakho baseSirayeli? UNkulunkulu waphuma ukuwasindisa abe ngabantu bakhe, ukuze ukwenze igama lakho, wenze izinto ezinkulundekile. Wakhuphula izizwe phambi kwabantu bakho, owabasindisele emazweni aseMijiphu.
Wakwenza abantu bakho baseSirayeli babe impahla yakho kuze kube sekupheleni; wena, iNkosi, waba nguThixo wabo.
Ngokuba manje, Nkosi yami, izwi lakho elishoyo mayelana nomkhonzi wakho nomndeni wakhe, lihlale likhona kuze kube sekupheleni; wenze njengoba usho.

Futhi igama lakho lihlale liqinile, libe lihle kuze kube sekupheleni; futhi bathi: UYehova wezizwe zonke, uNkulunkulu wakwaSirayeli, nguNkulunkulu waseSirayeli; futhi indlu yomkhonzi wakho uDavide ihlale iqinile phambi kwakho.
UNkulunkulu wami, wena owazise umkhonzi wakho ukuthi uzowulungisa umndeni wakhe; ngakho-ke umkhonzi wakho wathola inhliziyo yakhe ukuthandaza kuwe.
Nkosi, wena uNkulunkulu; usho lokhu okulungile kumkhonzi wakho.
Ngokuba sekuyintando yakho ukubhekela indlu yomkhonzi wakho, ukuze ihlale phambi kwakho kuze kube sekupheleni; wena, Nkosi, uyibhekele, futhi izobe iyibhekile kuze kube sekupheleni.
UDavide wahlasela amaFilisti, wabeka isandla sakhe phezu kwabo, wathatha iGati nezindawo zayo ezingaphansi kwayo ebusweni beFilisti.
Wahlasela futhi amaMowabi; abaMowabi babe ngabakhonzi bakaDavide, benikeza umnikelo.
UDavide wahlasela uHadarezere ukumkani waseZobha, eHamati, lapho ehamba khona uHadarezere ukubeka isandla sakhe emfuleni i-Efrayi.
UDavide wathatha kuye izimoto ezingu-1, namabhayisikili angu-7, namadoda ahamba ngezinyawo angama-20; uDavide wabulala wonke amabhayisikili, ngaphandle kwamabhasi ayikhulu.
Bafika abaArami baseDamasku ukusiza uHadarezere ukumkani waseZoba; uDavide wabulala abantu abangumakhulu mahlanu namashumi amabili.
UDavide wabeka amaqembu emkhosini wama-Aram eDamaseka, futhi ama-Aram waba ngabakhonzi bakaDavide, akhokhela umnikelo wakhe. UYehova wamsindisa uDavide lapho aye khona.
UDavide wathatha izigqoko zegolide, abaphathi bakaHadarezere babezithwala, wabazisa eYerusalem.

UDavide waya eTibhathi naseKuni, emadolobheni kaHadarezere, wathola igolide eliningi; futhi uSolomoni wasebenzisa leli golide ukwenza i-tank enkulu yegolide ebizwa ngokuthi yilwandle, namahlombe, nezinto zegolide zethempelini.
UThowu ukumkani waseHamati, ezwa ukuthi uDavide wahlasela wonke umkhosi kaHadarezere ukumkani waseZoba.

Wathumela uHadoram, unyana wakhe, kuye ukumkani uDavide, ukuthi amhlelele, futhi amuhlele ngenxa yokulwa kwakhe noHadarezere; ngoba uThou ubelokhu ehlasela uHadarezere. UHadoram waba nesigqoko segolide, nesigqoko sesiliva, nesigqoko sensimbi.
Wazinikela ngazo uDavide ukumkani kuYehova, kanye negolide nesilivere ayeyithola emazweni onke: eEdomu, naseMowabhi, nakwa-Amoni, nakwaFilisti, nakwa-Amaleki.
U-Abhishai unyana kaSeruya wahlasela ama-Edomi, amakhulu ayisishiyagalolunye, eGoli laseSalt.
Wabeka amaqembu e-Edom, futhi bonke abantu base-Edom babe ngabakhonzi bakaDavide. UYehova wasiza uDavide ngaso sonke isikhathi lapho ehamba khona.
UDavide waba ngukumkani phezu kwamaSirayeli onke, ewenza umthetho nomthetho kuwo wonke abantu bakhe.
UYowabhi unyana kaSeruya ube yisikhulu senkosi; noJehoshafati unyana ka-Ahilodi waba ngumbhali.
USadoko unyana ka-Ahitubhi, no-Abimeleki unyana ka-Abhiyathari, babe ngabapristi; uShavusha ube ngumbhali.
UBenaya unyana kaYehoyada waba nguMengameli wamaKherethi nawamaPhelethi, ababambe isibhamu sobukhosi; futhi oonyana bakaDavide babe ngabaphathi abakhulu emkhosini.
Wafa uNahashi ukumkani wakwa-Amoni, waba ngukumkani unyana wakhe endaweni yakhe.

Wathi uDavide, Ngizobonisa inhlonipho kuHanuni unyana kaNahashi, njengoba ubaba wakhe engenza inhlonipho kimi. UDavide wathumela abantu ukuba amusize ngenxa yokufa kukayise. Bafika abakhonzi bakaDavide kuHanun, ezweni lama-Amoni, ukuba amusize;

Bathi abakhulu baka-Amoni kuHanoni, Ingabe uDavidhi ehlonipha ubaba wakho ngokuthumelela labo bantu ukukuthokozisa? Akekho othile ovela ezindlini zakhe oza ukubheka izwe, noma ukulihlola, noma ukulibulala.
Wathi uHanuni, athabathe abakhonzi bakaDavide, wamisa imilenze yabo, wasusa izigqoko zabo eziphakathi kuya emadodeni abo, wabashiya besuka.
UDavide wathumela abathunywa ukuwamukela, ngoba babengabaza kakhulu. Wathi kubo ukumkani, Bahlale eJericho kuze kukhule izingulube zenu, bese niya ekhaya.

Babona amadodana ka-Amoni ukuthi abagxekile uDavide, wathumela uHanun namadodana ka-Amoni igolide elingenamakhulu amathathu, ukuze baqeshe izithuthi namabhayisikili eMesopotamia, naseAram Maaka, naseZoba.
Baqasha izimoto ezingu-32, kwafika ukumkani waseMahaka naye nomkhosi wakhe, bamisa isibhedlela eMedeba. Namadodakazi ka-Amoni ahlangana emizini yabo, waphuma ukulwa.
UDavide, lapho ekhuluma ngalolu daba, wathumela uYowabu nomndeni wakhe wonke, abantu abanamandla.
Baphuma oonyana baka-Amoni, bamisa isikhundla sokulwa emgwaqweni wokungena edolobhaneni labo; kodwa abaphathi abafikayo behlala icala labo ezweni.
UYowabhi, ebona ukuthi kukhona iqembu elibhekene naye phambi kwakhe, neqembu elibhekene naye emuva kwakhe, wakhetha abantu abangcono kunabo bonke amakhosi aseSirayeli, wabamisa bebhekene nabaAram.
Wabeka amanye amaqembu emkhosini ngaphansi kwesandla senkosikazi yakhe, uAbhishai; bamisa isikhundla sokubhekana namadodana ka-Amoni.
Wathi uYowabha, Uma i-Aram inamandla kunami, wena uzongisiza; kodwa uma izingane zika-Amoni zinamandla kunawe, ngizokusiza.
Uhlale unamandla, sihlale sinamandla ngenxa yezwe lethu, futhi ngenxa yamadolobhana kaThixo wethu; kodwa iNkosi akwenze konke okulungile emehlo akhe.
Waphuma uYowabhi, nomndeni wakhe, ukubhekana nama-Aram; futhi ama-Aram awahamba phambi kwakhe.
Babona amadodana ka-Amoni ukuthi ama-Aram ahambe, wahamba nabo phambi kuka-Abhishai udadewabo uYowabhi, babuyela edolobhaneni labo. Wabuya uYowabhi eYerusalem.
Babonama-Aram ukuthi bahlaselwe nguSirayeli, bathumela abathunywa, bahlanganisa ama-Aram asuka ngaphesheya komfula i-Euphrates; noShofakha, umphathi womkhosi kaHadarezere, wayehamba phambi kwabo.
Bathi kuDavide, waqoqa wonke amaSirayeli, wadlula iYordan, waya kubo, wamisa isigungu esibhekene nabase-Aram, bahlaselana naye.

Kodwa amama-Aram ahambe phambi kwaSirayeli. UDavide wabulala eSirayeli abantu abangumakhulu asixhenxe abahamba ngezithuthi, namadoda amakhulu angumashumi amane ananye; wabulala futhi uShofakhi, umphathi wenkosi yabo.
Babona bonke abakhonzi bakaHadarezere ukuthi bahlaselwe ngabaSirayeli, bakwenza uxolo noDavide, babe ngabakhonzi bakhe; futhi amaAram akazange aphinde asize amadodana ka-Amoni.

Ngonyaka omusha, lapho amakhosana ephuma emkhosini, uYowabhi waphuma, wahlasela izwe lakwa-Amoni, waya eRabha, wavala indawo yayo. UDavide wayehlala eYerusalem; futhi uYowabhi wahlasela iRabha, wayibulala.

Wathatha uDavide isibhakabhaka esisekhanda lomkani wabo, esiyigolide elingamakhilogremu ayishumi nesishiyagalombili, elinabantu ababili abakhulu; kwabe kuyinqwaba yezinto ezisezingeni eliphakeme, zafakwa phezu kwekhanda likaDavide. UDavide wathatha nempahla enkulu kakhulu emzini.

Wakhipha wabantu abahlala khona, wabeka ezindaweni zabo, wabasiza ngezinkomishi zensimbi, nezingqimba zensimbi. UDavide wenza njalo kuwo wonke amadolobhana ka-Amoni; wabuyela uDavide nomndeni wakhe wonke eYerusalem.
Kwaba khona ukulwa namaFilisti eGezeri. Ngaleso sikhathi uShibekai waseHushathi wabulala uSipai, owesifazane wesiRafayi; futhi abaFilisti bahlaselwa.
Kwaba khona uElhanana, unyana kaYahiri, wahlasela amaFilisti, wabulala uLahmi, umngane kaGoliathi waseGethi. ULahmi wayenesihluku esiqinile njengenkomishi yombukiso.

Kwaba nempi entsha eGathi, kwabe kukhona umuntu omkhulu kakhulu, onezintamo eziyisishiyagalombili ngesandla ngasinye, nezintamo eziyisishiyagalombili ngenyawo ngalinye, ayizinkulungwane ezimbili namashumi amane nanhlanu zonke; naye waba yindodana yamaGayi.
Kwathi, lapho ekhohlisa amaSirayeli, uYonathani unyana kaShimea, umngane kaDavide, wambulala.
Lawa madoda asuka ku-Rafa, eGathi; wababulala uDavide nabangani bakhe.
U-Satani wehla ezweni laseSirayeli, waholela uDavide ukuba abala abantu baseSirayeli.
Wathi uDavide kuYowabhi, nakubaphathi babantu: "Hambani nibala amaSirayeli kusukela eBeer-shebha enyakatho kuze kube eDani enyakatho; nizongitshela inani labo, ukuze ngizi ukuthi bangaki."

Wathi uYowabha, UYehova aphinde abantu bakhe abe ngamaphesenti angamashumi amabili kunalabo abakhona manje; inkosi yami ukumkani, bangabe bonke abakhonzi bakho? Kungani na ukwenza lokhu? Kungani na ubeka isono phezu kwaSirayeli?
UYowabhi waphuma, waya ezweni lonke lakwaSirayeli, wabuyela eYerusalem. Wathi uYowabhi kuye: "Kulungile, ngizokutshela ukuthi yini ongayikwenza?"
UYowabhi waveza uDavide inani eliphelele lamadoda; kwabe yizigidi ezingu-100 abantu abakwaziyo uku одговараιο, futhi isizwe samaSirayeli bonke kwakuyiminyaka eyishumi nesishiyagalombili.
Kodwa uYowabhi akayibala isizwe sikaLawi noBenjamini; ngoba lo mthetho wokumkani wawungathandeki kuYowabhi.
UNkulunkulu akathandani nalokho okwenzekile, ngakho wagwema iSirayeli.
Wathi uDavide kuThixo, Ngibe nephutha elikhulu ngalokhu engikwenzayo; kodwa manje, ngiyakucela, ngisuse ubugebengu bomkhonzi wakho; ngoba ngikwenze ngengqondo encane kakhulu.
Wathi iNkosi kuGadi, umbona kaDavide,
Chofoza lapha, ukhulume noDavide, uthi: Uthi iNkosi ukuthi: Ngikubeke phambi kwakho izinto ezintathu; khethe enye yazo, ngikwenze kuwe.
Wathi uGadi kuye uDavide, wathi kuye, UNkulunkulu uthi: Khetha wena:

noma unyaka owodwa wendlala, noma amasonto amathathu okuhlukunyezwa phambi kwabanye bakho, nekhebula labo likulethe wena; noma usuku olulodwa ikhebula likaYehova, nobhubhu olukhulu ezweni lenu, futhi isithunywa sikaYehova sibulala bonke abantu bakaSirayeli. Ngokuba cabanga ukuthi ngiphendule yini lowo wandithumela.
Wathi uDavide kuGadi, Ngisengozini enkulu kakhulu; kodwa ngibe sesandlani sikaYehova, ngoba izimilo zakhe zikhulu kakhulu; angibe sesandlani somuntu.
Wathumela iNkosi isifo esibi phezu kwaSirayeli, safa abantu abangumakhulu asixhenxe eSirayeli.

Wathumela uMoya oyiNgcwele isithunywa ukuba sibulala iYerusalem. Kwathi lapho isithunywa sizoyibulala khona, iNkosi wabheka, wakhathazeka ngenxa yalo monakalo, wathi kulesi sithunywa esibulala abantu: "Kunembile; hlala!" Umoya kaMoya oNgcwele ubesesitezi sendlu ka-Ornani umJebusi.

UDavide waphakamisa amehlo akhe, wabona isithunywa sikaYehova sikhona phakathi komhlaba nezulu, nesibhamu esiboshwe esandlani sakhe, sibekwe phezu kweYerusalem. Wathi uDavide nabaholi bakhe, abagqoke izicathulo ezingwevu, bahlaliswa ngobuso babo phansi.

Wathi uDavide kuThixo, Ngabe angikaze ngithi abantu babalolwe? Ngiye ngawulungisa umsebenzi wami; kodwa labo bantu bafana nengulube. Bakwenzeni yini? Nkosi yami, uNkulunkulu wami, ngicela isandla sakho sihlale phezu kwami, kanye nomndeni wami, futhi akufanele kube nalolu bhubhu phakathi kwabantu bakho.
Wathi umprofeti kaYehova kuGadi, ukuthi akhulume noDavide, athi, Yiya ukwakha isibingelelo kukaNkulunkulu esitezi sokudla sika-Ornani umJebusi.
Wahamba uDavide, njengoba wathi uGadi, ngegama likaYehova.
U-Ornani, lapho enqoba khona inkomo, wabheka emuva, wabona isithunywa; naye nomndeni wakhe wonke bafihla.
Kwathi lapho uDavide efika khona, wabheka uOrhana, wambona. Waphuma emgodini, wehla phambi kukaDavide ngobuso bakhe phansi.
Wathi uDavide ku-Ornani, Ngithengise lendawo yokudlidliza, ukuze ngikhiphe phezu kwayo isibingelelo kuYehova; ngiyithengise ngentengo egcwele, ukuze isifo siphele phakathi kwabantu.

Wathi u-Ornani kuDavide, Uyithathe; futhi umnikazi wami ukumkani akwenze konke okubona ukuthi kulungile emehlo akhe; bona, ngizokunika izinkomo ukuze zibe izipho ezibomvu, namabhodwe ukuze abe imithi yomlilo, nengulube ukuze ibe isiphuzo sokudla; ngizokunikeza konke.
Wathi ukumkani uDavide ku-Ornani, Akunjalo, kodwa ngizokunikeza intengo egcwele; angiyithathe into yakho, ngiyinike iNkosi, futhi angizonikela ngesonka esiqhumayo esingadingeki.
Wathi uDavide wanikela ku-Ornana ngegolide elingaphezu kwamakhilogremu ayisishiyagalombili.
Wakha khona uDavide isibingelelo kuYehova, wanikela khona ngezipho ezibomvu nezipho zokuthula; wathandaza kuYehova, waphendula ngomlilo osuka esibhakabhakeni sesibingelelo esibomvu.
Wathi iNkosi kulowo wesifazane, wabeka isibhamu sakhe emgodini wayo.
Ngaleso sikhathi, lapho uDavide ebona ukuthi iNkosi wamphendula emgodini ka-Ornani umJebhusi, wanikela khona.
Ikamelo likaYehova, uMosis ayelilungiselela ezweni elimnyama, nesitezi esiphezulu somnikelo wokushiswa kwakungulapho emzini ophakeme eGibeyon.
Kodwa uDavide akakwazanga ukuya khona ukubuza uNkulunkulu, ngoba wayekhathazekile ngenxa yekhebula lesithunywa sikaYehova.
Wathi uDavide, Le yindawo lapho indlu kaThixo iNkosi izobe ikhona khona, futhi le yindawo lapho isibingelelo somnikelo wokudla sizoba khona khona kwaSirayeli.
Wathi uDavide, aqoqe bonke abangaphandle ezweni laseSirayeli; wabeka phakathi kwabo abaholi bezindonga, ukuba bacwebeze izindonga zokwakha indlu kaThixo.
UDavide wanikeza inani elikhulu lensimbi, ukuze kwenziwe izikhonkwane, nezintambo zeminyango yamasango, kanye negolide elingaphezulu kunalokho okungenzeka ukulilinganisela.
Wabanikeza futhi izihlahla zeqhwa, ezingenakubalwa; ngoba abantu baseSidon neTire babethumelela uDavide izihlahla zeqhwa eziningi.

UDavide wathi, "USolomoni, unyana wami, ungumfundi oncane; futhi indlu edingekayo ukuba ikhiwa kuYehova kumele ibe mkhulu kakhulu, ibe negama elikhululabalalisa emhlabeni wonke; ngakho ngizoyilungiselela." UDavide walungisa izinto eziningi ngaphambi kokuba aphele.
Wabiza uSolomoni, unyana wakhe, wathi kuye ukuthi avule indlu kuYehova uNkulunkulu kaSirayeli.
Wathi uDavide kuSolomoni, Unyana wami, ngangifuna ukukwakha indlu igama likaYehova uNkulunkulu wam.
Kodwa kwafika igama likaYehova kum, lithi, Uthe wageza igazi elikhulu, wabhekana nemibhikisho emikhulu; awuzokwakha indlu ngegama lami, ngoba uthe wageza igazi elikhulu phezu komhlaba phambi kwami.

kodwa uzozala indodana, izobe yindoda yokuthula; futhi ngizonikeza ukuthula kuzo zonke izitha zakhe ezingqondweni zakhe. Igama lakhe lizoba nguSolomoni, futhi ngizonikela ngokuthula ezweni lakwaSirayeli ngesikhathi sakhe sokubusa.
Uzokwakha indlu ngegama lami; yena uzobe ngumntwana wami, futhi mina ngizoba ngubaba wakhe; futhi ngizoqinisa isikhala sobukhosi bakhe phezu kwaSirayeli kuze kube sekupheleni.
Manje ke, unyana wami, iNkosi abe nawe, akwenze kube lula kuwe, ukwakha indlu kaYehova uNkulunkulu wakho, njengoba wathi.
futhi iNkosi akunikeze ubuhlakani nokuqonda, uma ekwenza ube phezu kwaSirayeli, ukuze ugcine umthetho kaYehova uNkulunkulu wakho.
Uzophumelela, uma nje ubhekana nokwenza zonke izimiso nezibopho, azenzayo iNkosi uMoses ezweni lakwaSirayeli; ube namandla, ube nomphefumulo oqinile. Musa ukukhathazeka, ungabi nenhliziyo ebuhlungu.

Ngabona ukuthi ngisebenze kakhulu ukulungiselela indlu kaYehova, ngathola igolide lamathani angama-3, nesilivere amathani angamashumi amathathu anesihlanu, kanye nobhedu namafutha omnqumo angeke kubhekwe ngenxa yobukhulu bawo; futhi ukhuni namatshe ngiyawahlinzekela wena.
Unabasebenzi abaningi: abacutha amatshe, abakhonzi, nabakhangisi, nanoma yiluphi uhlobo lomsebenzi oqeqeshiwe nganoma iyiphi imisebenzi.
Igolide, nesilivere, nesiliva, nensimbi, ziningi kakhulu, zingacaci; qhubeka ukwenze, futhi iNkosi abe nawe.
Wathi uDavide kubo bonke abakhulu baseSirayeli, ukuthi basize uSolomoni unyana wakhe, wathi kubo,

UYehova, uNkulunkulu wakho, akakho nawe? Wakulethela isikhala ngazo zonke izinhlangothi zakho; wanikela abantu belizwe elingezansi kwami; futhi leli lizwe lise ngaphansi kwesandla soNkulunkulu nesobantu bakhe.

Manje ke, lungisa intliziyo yakho nomoya wakho ukuba ulandele iNkosi uNkulunkulu wakho; zulazula ukwakha indawo engcwele kaYehova uNkulunkulu wakho; bese ufaka isibambo sesivumelwano soNkulunkulu, nezinto ezingcwele zoNkulunkulu, endlwini ebeka igama loNkulunkulu.
Kwathi lapho uDavide esemncane, ephila iminyaka emide, egcwele impilo, wakwenza uSolomoni, unyana wakhe, ube ngukumkani phezu kwaSirayeli.
Waqoqa bonke abakhulu bakaSirayeli, namaLevi namadodakazi abo.
AbaLevi, abaneminyaka engama-30 ubudala nangaphezulu, babalwa ngomuntu ngamunye; kwaba ngamaphesenti angama-38.
Wathi uDavide, Ngabo amashumi amabili nanhlanu amawaka azobe ephethe umsebenzi wendlu kaYehova, namakhulu ayisishiyagalombili abe ngabaphathi nabavikeli.
Amakhulu amane azobe abaphathi bezindonga, futhi amakhulu amane azobonga iNkosi ngezinhlamvu zengoma engizenzayo ukubonga.
UDavide wahlukanisa amaLevi abe ngamaqembu, ngokuya ngemindeni yabantwana bakaLevi: uGershoni, noKohati, noMerari.
NgaseGershoni kwaba nguLadani noShimeyi.
Waba nguLadani oonyana abathathu: uJehiyeli owayengumholi, noZethamu noYoweli.
Waba nguShimeyi oonyana abathathu: uShelomothi, noHaziyeli, noHarani; labo babe yinhloko yamakhaya kaLadan.
Oonyana bakaShimehi: uYahati, noZina, noJeushi, noBeriya; labo banezingane zikaShimehi.
UYahathi wayengumholi, uZiza ube yindodana yesithathu. Kodwa uJehushi noBeriya babengenabantwana abaningi; ngakho bahlukaniswa babe mndeni owodwa, nendlu eyodwa.
Waba nguKohati oonyana ababini: uAmram, no-Izhar, no-Hebron, no-Uziel.

Onyana baka-Amram: u-Aron noMoses. U-Aron nabangane bakhe bahlukaniswa, kuze kube sekupheleni, ukuze bahlanze izinto ezingcwele kakhulu, ukuthi baphuze insindiso phambi koYehova, ukuthi basebenze kuye, ukubambisane ngegama lakhe kuze kube sekupheleni.
Kwathi uMosis, indodana kaThixo, wabala oonyana bakhe njengomndeni kaLevi.
Oonyana bakaMosesi: uGershom noEliezer.
Amadodakazi kaGershoni aholwa nguShebuyeli.
UEliezere akazange abe nomunye unyana, kodwa uRehabhia waba nezingane eziningi kakhulu.
Abazali baka-Izhar babeholwa nguShelomith.
Oonyana bakaHebroni: uJeriya owayengumholi, noAmariya owesibili, noYahaziyeli wesithathu, noJekameam wesithupha.
Oonyana baka-Uziyeli: uMika owayengumholi, noIshiya owesibili.
Oonyana bakaMerari: uMahli noMushi; oonyana kaMahli: uEleazar noKishi.
Wafa u-Eleazari, akazange abe namadodakazi; waba nezingane ezincane, wazenza izihlobo zabo, izingane zikaKishi.
Waba nguMushi oonyana abathathu: uMahli, noEdere, noYeremota.

Baye labo oonyana bakaLawi ngokwemindeni yabo, abakhulu bezindlu zakwababa babo, ngokusho kokubalwa kwamagama kwabo, babalwa ngomuntu ngamunye, kusukela eminyakeni eyishumi nambili nangaphezulu, abasebenza umsebenzi wokuphatha endlwini kaYehova.
Wayethi uDavide, UYehova, uNkulunkulu kaSirayeli, unikeze isikhala abantu bakhe, futhi uzohlala eYerusalem kuze kube sekupheleni.
Ngaleyo ndlela abaLevi abazokwazi ukuthwala itabernakele, noma iyiphi into esetshenziswa kuyo.
Ngokuya ngemiyalelo kaDavide, abaLevi abaneminyaka eyishumi nambili nangaphezulu babalwa.

Umsebenzi wabo wukuthi basebenze ndawonye namadodakazi ka-Aron, emisebenzini yendlu kaYehova, bebhekene nezindlu zangaphandle, nezindawo ezingemuva, nokuhlanza zonke izinto ezingcwele, nokwenza yonke imisebenzi yomsebenzi wendlu kaThixo.
Babe nesibopho sokudla okungcwele embhedeni, noshizi oluhle lwezinto zomnikelo wokudla, namakhowe ancane ayenziwe ngaphandle kobisi, nezitsha zokupheka, nokuxubana kwazo zonke izinto zokulinganisa.
Bahlala njalo ekuseni, bebonga nokuzinikela kukaNkulunkulu, futhi bahlale njalo ebusuku.

Basizakala ngazo zonke izipho eziboshwayo kuYehova, ngezinsuku zosuku lokuphumula, namaholidi enyanga entsha, nakwezinye izinsuku zosuku olulodwa; basebenza phambi kukaNkulunkulu ngokuqhubekayo, ngokwenani elifanele.
Lawa amaLevi athatha umsebenzi wesitezi sokuhlangana, nowendawo engcwele, nabangane babo, oonyana baka-Aron, ukuze basebenze endlwini kaYehova.
Lawa amaqembu omndeni ka-Aron. Oonyana baka-Aron: uNadab, no-Abihu, no-Eleazar, no-Ithamari.
Bafa ke uNadabhi noAbhihu phambi kukababa wabo, bengenabantwana; khona-ke uEleazarhi noIthamari babe ngabapristi.
Wabahlukanisa uDavide, ngesandla sikaSadoko, owesifazane wase-Elazar, no-Akhimeleki, owesifazane wase-Ithamari, yaba ngamaqembu ahlukene.
Bahlukaniswa ngale ndlela: abaphathi bezindlu zakwaElazare babe yishumi nanye nesishiyagalombili, futhi abaphathi bezindlu zakwaIthamari babe yisikhombisa.
Bawahlukanisela ngokuhluza, ngenxa yokuthi kwaba phakathi kwamadodana ka-Elazar nendodana ka-Ithamari abaphathi bendawo engcwele, nabaphathi bakaThixo.

UShemaya unyana kaNethaneli, umbhali, owayengumLevi, wabhala amagama abo phambi kukakumkani, nabangaphathina, noTsadoki umbingeleli, noAhileleki unyana kaAbhiyathari, nabakhulu bezindlu zakwababa ababingeleli, namaLevi; imindeni yabo yahlukaniswa ngezinhlamvu ezimbili: imindeni ye-Eleazar nemindeni ye-Ithamari.
Iphutha lokuqala laphuma kuYoyaribi, lesibili kuJedaya,
isithathu kuHarim, nesishiyagalombili kuSeorim,
isihlanu kuMalkiya, isithandathu kuMiyamina,
isishiyagalolunye kuHakoshe, isishiyagalombili kuAbiha,
isithoba kuYeshua, esiyishumi kuShecaniya,
eyeshumi nambili kuEliashib, eyeshumi nambili kuYakim,
ishumi nambili ku-Hupha, neshumi nambili ku-Yeshebhebhab,
isishiyagalombili kuBilgah, isishiyagalolunye ku-Imer;
ishumi nesishiyagalombili ku-Heziri, ishumi nesishiyagalolunye ku-Happizezi;
eyeshumi nanye uPethahiya, eyishumi nambili uJehezkele,
eyeshumi nambili uYakhini, eyisikhombisa uGamuli,
ishumi nambili nesithathu kuDelaya, neshumi nambili nesithupha kuMaaziya.
Lokho kwakungumsebenzi wabo, lapho bephuma khona endlwini kaYehova, ngokuya ngemithetho ka-Aron, ubaba wabo, njengoba iNkosi, uNkulunkulu kaSirayeli, abemwisele umthetho ngayo.
Lawa amanye amadodana ka-Lawi: kumadodana ka-Amram, uShubhayeli; kumadodana ka-Shubhayeli, uJedeya.
Ngabo oonyana baka-Rehabhia kwaba nguIshiya, owayengumholi.
Kwaba-Ishari kwaba nguShelomothi, kwabesilisa baka-Shelomothi kwaba nguYahati.
Oonyana baka-Hebroni: uYeriya omkhulu, noAmariya wesithathu, noYahaziyeli wesithathu, noJekameam wesithupha.
Unyana ka-Uziyeli ube nguMikha, noShamire waba yindodana ka-Mikha.
Udadewabo uMikha wayengu-Ishiya, nomndeni ka-Ishiya waba nguZekariya.
Oonyana bakaMerariya: uMahli noMushi. Unyana kaYaaziah, uBheno.
Amadodana kaMerariya, asuka kuYahaziya, nguBeno, noShoham, noZakur, noIbri.
U-Eleazare, owazalwa nguMahli, akazange abe nabantwana.
EKishi kwavela uJerahmeel, unyana kaKishi.
Oonyana bakaMushi: uMahli, no-Edere, no-Yerimothi; labo abaLevi ngokubhaliswa kwabo ngezinhlanga zabo.

Babeka iziqhamo phambi kukaDavide ukumkani, noTsadoki, noAhileleki, nabaholi bezindlu zakwababa babo phakathi kwababhishobhi nalabaLevi, kanye nezihlobo zabo, izingane zika-Aron; imindeni yendodakazi encane nendodakazi ekhulu.

UDavide, kanye nabaphathi bamabutho, bamisa abanye onyana baka-Asaphe, noHeman, noJeduthuni, ukuba babe yimisebenzi ekhethekile; bekhuluma ngezwi, bedlala ama-harps, nama-lyras, nama-cymbals. Lakho inani lamadoda asebenza kule misebenzi:
Ngabo oonyana baka-Asaphu: uZakhuri, noYosefu, noNethaniya, noAsarela; labo babe ngaphansi kwesandla sika-Asaphu, abaprofetisa ngaphansi kwesandla somkwembu.

Ngabo oonyana bakaJeduthuni: uGedaliya, noZeri, noYeshaya, noShimeyi, noHashabhiya, noMatithiya, abasithandathu bonke; babe ngaphansi kwesandla sikaJedutuni ubaba wabo, okhuluma ngezwi elisha, ebonga futhi ethokozele iNkosi.
Ngabo oonyana bakaHeman: uBukhiya, noMatania, noUziyele, noShebuyeli, noJerimothi, noHananiya, noHanani, noEliyata, noGiddalithi, noRomamthi-Ezer, noYoshebekasha, noMalothi, noHothiri, noMahasiothi.
Bonke labo babe yindodana kaHeman, okubonayo ukumkani; njengoba uNkulunkulu esho ukuthi uzomqinisa; futhi uNkulunkulu wamnika uHeman oonyana abalishumi elinambini nezingane ezintathu.

Lawo wonke amabhishobhi aye ngaphansi komthetho wababa babo, ekwenzeni umculo endlwini kaYehova, ngezinkomo, nezingcweti, nezigcawu, ekusebenzeni kwendlu kaThixo; noAsaphu, noJeduthuni, noHeman, bengaphansi komthetho wobukhosi.
Bonke labo, nabangane babo, bonke abaqeqeshiwe, abakwaziyo ukungoma kukaNkulunkulu, babemakhulu amabili, anamanci asibhozo.
Bonke bathwebula izinkontileka zomsebenzi wabo, abancane nabadala ngokufanayo, umfundi nomfundi ngokufana.
Isipho sokuqala safika ku-Asaphe, kwaba nguYosefu; nesipho sesibili safika ku-Gedaliya, nabangane bakhe nabantwana bakhe, abalishumi elinambini.
Ingxenye yesithathu yaba nguZakhuri; yena, noonyana bakhe nabangane bakhe, babe yishumi nambili.
Ingxenye yesine yaba ngu-Izri; yena, noonyana bakhe nabazalwane bakhe, babe ngamashumi amabili.
Isihlanu saphuma kuNethaniya; yena, noonyana bakhe nabazalwane bakhe, babe yishumi nambili.
Ishumi nesishiyagalombili lafika kuBhukukiya; yena, noonyana bakhe, nabangane bakhe, babe ngamahlanu.
Ishumi nesishiyagalombili lafika ku-Yesharela; yena, noonyana bakhe nabazalwane bakhe, babemashumi amabili namahlanu.
Ishumi nesishiyagalombili kwaba nguYeshaya; yena, noonyana bakhe nabazalwane bakhe, babe ngamahlanu.
Ishumi nesishiyagalombili lafika kuMatania; yena, noonyana bakhe nabazalwane bakhe, babemashumi amabili namahlanu.
Ishumi lafika kuShimeyi; yena, noonyana bakhe nabazalwane bakhe, babe yishumi nambili.
Ishumi nalinye laphuma ku-Azareli; yena, noonyana bakhe nabazalwane bakhe, babe yishumi nambili.
ishumi nambili kuHashabiya; yena, noonyana bakhe nabazalwane bakhe, babe yishumi nambili.
ishumi nambili kuShubhayeli; yena, noonyana bakhe, nabazalwane bakhe, babe yishumi nambili.
Ishumi nambili lafika kuMatithaya; yena, noonyana bakhe nabazalwane bakhe, babe yishumi nambili.
ishumi nambili lafika kuYeremota; yena, noonyana bakhe nabazalwane bakhe, babe yishumi nambili.
Ishumi nanye nesithandathu lafika kuHananiya; yena, noonyana bakhe nabazalwane bakhe, babe yishumi nambili.
ishumi nesishiyagalombili kuYoshbekasha; yena, noonyana bakhe nabazalwane bakhe, babe yishumi nambili.
Ishumi nesishiyagalombili lafika kuHanani; yena, noonyana bakhe nabangane bakhe, babe ngamahlanu.
ishumi nambili kuMalothi; yena, noonyana bakhe nabangane bakhe, babe yishumi nambili.
Ishumi nambili lafika kuEliyata; yena, noonyana bakhe nabazalwane bakhe, babe yishumi nambili.
ishumi nambili elilodwa lafika kuHothire; yena, oonyana bakhe nabangane bakhe, babe lishumi linamibini.
Okuyisishiyagalombili kwaba nguGiddalthi, namadodana akhe nabangane bakhe, amashumi amabili nanhlanu.
ishumi nambili nesithathu kuMahasiothi; yena, noonyana bakhe nabazalwane bakhe, babemashumi mabini namahlanu.
ishumi nambili nesine lafika kuRomamthi-ezere; yena, noonyana bakhe nabazalwane bakhe, babe ngamahlanu.
Lawa maqembu ama-portiers: ku-Korah, uMeshelemiya unyana ka-Kore, owesifazane wabantwana baka-Asaphe.
Oonyana bakaMeshelemiya: uZekariya omkhulu, noYediyayeli wesithathu, noZebadia wesithathu, noYatniel wesithupha,
uElam wesithupha, noYohanane wesishiyagalombili, noElihoheni wesixhenxe.
Oonyana baka-Obedi-edomu: uShemaya owayengumzali, noYozabadi wesithathu, noYoha wesithathu, noShakare wesithupha, noNethaneli wesishiyagalombili,
u-Amiyeli wesishiyagalombili, no-Issakare wesishiyagalolunye, no-Pehuleti wesishiyagalombili. UNkulunkulu wayemsindise kakhulu u-Obedi-Edom.
UShemaya unyana wakhe wayenamadodakazi, abe yinhloko yamakhaya abo, ngoba babe ngamadoda anamandla.
Oonyana bakaShemaya: uOthni, noRefayeli, no-Obhedi, no-Elzabadi; nabangane babo, uElihu no-Semakiya, abantu abanamandla.
Bonke labo babe yindodana ka-Obedi-edomu, bona nabantwana babo nabangani babo, abantu abanamandla omsebenzi; kwaba ngu-Obedi-edomu amashumi ayisishiyagalombili nabini.
UMeshelemiya wayenezingane eziyisibhozo nesishiyagalombili, nabangani bakhe, abantu abanamandla.
UHosa, owesifazane waseMerari, ubenamadodakazi; uShimri wayengumholi, nakuba akazange abe ngumzali wokuqala; kodwa ubaba wakhe wakwenza waba nguMengameli.
uHilkiya owesibili, noTebaliya wesithathu, noZekariya wesithupha. UHosa wayenezingane nabangane abamashumi amathathu.
Lawa maqembu amaphoyisa asesitezi sokuqala, kanye namadodana abo, babe nemisebenzi yabo yokukhonza endlwini kaYehova, njengabo bonke abazalwane babo.
Baqala ukuqoqa izinkontileka ngesango ngalinye, imindeni ngomndeni, abancane nabadala.
Ukheshi lomnyango wasempumalanga lwafika kuShelemiya, futhi babeke ukheshi kuZekariya unyana wakhe, umcebisi owaziyo; nokheshi lomnyango wasenyakatho lwafika kuye.
Isango laseNtshonalanga lafika ku-Obedi-Edom, nendlu yokugcina ifike kubo.
Isango laseNtshonalanga, nesango leShalekethi, elisendaweni ephakeme, labekwa ngu-Shuphim noHosa. Abagwebi bahlala ndawonye.
AbaLevi abasithandathu behlala enyakatho, nabanhlanu basentshonalanga, namahlanu asempumalanga; futhi kwabekhona ababili ngasikhathi sinye emgodini.
Enkantolo engxenyeni yasenyakatho, kwakunezintathu enhliziyweni yendlela kanye nezimbili enkantolo.
Lawa maqembu ama-portiers asuka emindenini yamaKora namaMerariya.
Abazalwane babo abaLevi, ngaphansi kuka-Ahiya, babe nesibopho sazo zonke izimpahla zendlu kaThixo, nazo zonke izimpahla zomnikelo wesono.
ULadani waba yindodana kaGershoni, esuka ku-Ladani; uJehiyeli wayeyinhloko yomndeni wakwa-Ladani umGershoni.
UZethamu noYoweli, udadewabo, oonyana bakaJehiyeli, babe ngabaphathi bezitolo zendlu kaYehova.
Emindenini ka-Amram, no-Izhar, no-Hebron, no-Uziyeli:
UShebuyeli, owesifazane waseGershoni, unyana kaMosesi, wayeyisikhulu esiphezulu sazo zonke izimpahla.
Abangane bakhe ngoEliezere: uRehabiya unyana kaEliezere, noYeshaya unyana kaRehabiya, noYoram unyana kaYeshaya, noZikri unyana kaJoram, noShelomothi unyana kaZikri.

UShelomothi, nodadewabo, babe ngowezo zonke izimpahla zempahla ethengiswayo, eyanikezwa nguNdunankulu uDavide, nabaholi bezindlu zakwababa, nabaphathi bamakhulu namakhulu, nabo bonke abaphathi bemikhosi.
Banikela ngezinto ezithathwe emdlalweni, ukuze balungise indlu kaYehova.

Nakho konke uSamuweli okubonayo, noSawule unyana kaKishi, no-Abheri unyana kaNeri, noYowabu unyana kaZeruhiya, bekwahlulela ngokuzinikela kwabo kukaNkulunkulu; nakho konke bonke abantu ababezinikela, kwaba ngaphansi kwesandla sikaShelomothi nabangani bakhe.
Kwabe yibo abase-Izhari: uKenaniya nonyana bakhe, ababesebenza emisebenzini yendlu kaThixo; babe ngabaphathi nabaqondisi kwaSirayeli.

Kulabo base-Hebroni, uHashabhiya nabazalwane bakhe abakhulu kunamakhulu ayisishiyagalombili, abantu abanothando, babe ngabaphathi gestuιοra aseSirayeli ngaphesheya kwezilwandle kweYordana ezweni laseYiputa; bamadodana amakhosikazi aseJordani.

Kwaba-Hebroni kwaba nguJeriya, owayenguMengameli, ngokwezinkolelo zomndeni wabo. Ngonyaka omashumi amane wokubusa kukaDavide, kwafunyanwa izinkolelo zomndeni ka-Hebroni, futhi kwatholakala phakathi kwabo abantu abanamandla amakhulu eJazeri eGiliyadi.

UYeriya ubenezinkanyezi ezingu-2, abantu abanolwazi olukhulu, abaphathi bezindlu zabazali. UDavide ukumkani wababeka ngaphesheya kwezintaba zeRubheni noGadi nengxenye yesizwe sikaManase kunoma yisiphi isinqumo esiphathelene noNkulunkulu nomkakhe.
