Nalokhu wuhlu lwamadodana kaSirayeli asebenza emkhosini, abezinhloko zemindeni yabo, nabaphathi bamakhulu namakhulu, nabangani babo, nabo bonke abaqondisi babo; basebenza emkhosini ngazo zonke izinto, ngokuya ngezigaba zabo, eziphumayo nezifikayo ngenyanga ngayinye, ngonyaka wonke.
Ngesigaba sokuqala, ngonyaka wokuqala, kwaba nguYashobhamu unyana kaZabediyeli; nakwisigaba sakhe kwabekhona abantu abangumakhulu amabili nanhlanu.
Wabe yindodana ka-Perezi, waba nguMengameli wamabhishobhi onke empilweni yonyaka wokuqala.
Engxenyeni yakhe yenyanga yesithathu kwaba nguDodayi u-Ahohati; engxenyeni yakhe kwakunguMiklothi owayengumholi; engxenyeni yakhe kwakukhona abantu abangumashumi amabili anane amawaka.
Umphathi wesithathu wesizwe, wenyanga yesithathu, uBhenaya unyana kaYehoyada umpristi; futhi eqenjini lakhe kwabekho abantu abangumashumi amabili anane amawaka.
Lo mbhishobhi uBhenaya waba ngumuntu onamandla phakathi kwabo abamashumi amathathu, waba ngumphathi wabo amashumi amathathu; eqenjini lakhe u-Amizabadi, unyana wakhe, wayengumphathi.
Owesine kunyaka wesithathu ube ngu-Asaheli, udade kaYowabhi; ngemuva kwakhe kwaba nguZebadia unyana wakhe; emkhakheni wakhe kwabekhona abantu abangumashumi amabili nanhlanu amawaka.
Umphathi wesishiyagalombili wenyanga yesishiyagalombili ube nguShamuthu u-Izrahiyethi; emkhosini wakhe kwakungumashumi amabili anane amawaka.
Owesixhenxe kunyaka wesishiyagalombili ube ngu-Ira unyana ka-Ikeshi waseTekoa; emkhosini wakhe kwabengamawaka amabili nanhlanu.
Umphathi wesixhenxe wenyanga yesixhenxe uHelezisi umPheloni, waseEphrayim; nakwisigaba sakhe kwaba ngamaphesenti angamashumi amabili anane amawaka.
Oyisishiyagalombili sonyaka wesishiyagalolunye uSibhekai umHushathi, waseZera; nakwisigaba sakhe kwaba ngamaphesenti angamashumi amabili nanhlanu amawaka.
Owesine kunyaka wesithoba ube ngu-Abiezer waseAnathothi, waseBhenjamin; nakwisigaba sakhe kwaba ngamaphesenti angamashumi amabili anane amawaka.
Owesishiyagalombili wenyanga yesishiyagalombili uMaharayi waseNetofa, waseZera; nakwisigaba sakhe abantu abangumashumi amabili anane amawaka.
Oweshumi nalinye lonyaka oyisishiyagalombili ube nguBenaya uPirathoni, wase-Ephrayim; futhi ngohlobo lwakhe kwaba ngamaphesenti angamashumi amabili nanhlanu amawaka.
Oyishumi nambili lonyaka oyisishiyagalombili ube nguHeledi waseNetofa, wakwa-Othniyeli; ngohlobo lwakhe kwabengamakhulu amabili nanhlanu.
Lawa abaholi bezizwe zakwaSirayeli: ku-Rubhen, uEliyezeri unyana kaZikhri; ku-Shimeoni, uShefatia unyana kaMahaka;
kuLevi, uHashabhiya unyana kaKemuyeli; kumadodana ka-Aron, uTsadoki;
KwaYuda, uElihu, owodwa wabahlobo bakaDavide; kwa-Issakare, uOmri unyana kaMikayeli;
KwaZabuloni, uIshmaya unyana ka-Obadi; kwaNaphtali, uYeremota unyana ka-Azriyeli;
ku-Ephrayim, uHosheya unyana ka-Azaziya; engxenyeni yesizwe sikaManase, uYoweli unyana kaPedaya;
Ngaphezu kwengxenye yesizwe sikaManase eGiliyadi, uIdo unyana kaZekariya; ngaphezu kukaBhenjamin, uYashiyeli unyana kaAbheri;
NgoDani, uAzareli unyana kaYerohamu; labo babe ngabaphathi bezizwe zaseSirayeli.
UDavide akazange abala labo abaneminyaka eyishumi nesishiyagalombili nangaphezulu; ngoba iNkosi wayethe, ukuthi uzokwenza amaSirayeli abe ngamaplanethi ezulu.

UYowabhi unyana kaZeruhiya waqala ukubala, kodwa akaqedi; ngoba kwafika inkohliso ezweni lakwaSirayeli ngenxa yokubalwa kwabo. Ngakho-ke inani labo lonke alibhalwenga encwadini yamaqiniso kaDavide ukumkani.
UAzmavethi unyana ka-Adiyeli waba nguMengameli wezitolo zobukhosi; noYonathani unyana kaUziya waba nguMengameli wezitolo ezisendaweni, nasezifundeni, nasezindaweni zasemadolobheni, nasezinqaba.
UEzri, unyana ka-Chelub, wayephethe abasebenzi basezimboni abasebenzela izwe.
UShimeyi waseRama wayephethe izivini; uZabdi, umSifemi, wayephatha iwayini elivela ezivinini.
UBaale-hanani waseGederi wayephethe izihlahla ze-olive, nezitshalo zezinkomo ezisenyakatho; uYoashi wayephatha amaphethini e-olive.
UShithayi waseSharon wayephethe izinkomo ezidla imbewu eSharon; uShafati unyana kaAdlai ubephethe izinkomo ezisezigodini.
U-Obile u-Ishmayeli wayephethe izinkomo, no-Yehdeyahu waseMeronothi wabaphatha amakhoboka, no-Yazizi u-Hagri wabaphatha izimvu.
Bonke labo babe ngabaphathi abaphatha izinto zikaMkani uDavide.
UYonathani, udadewabo kaDavide, waba ngumqondisi, nomuntu owaziyo, nombhali; futhi uYehiyeli unyana kaHakmoni, waba ngumphathi wabantwana bakakumkani.
U-Ahitofeli ube ngumcebisi wobukhosi, uHushai wase-Arkhi waba ngumndeni kankosi.
Emva kuka-Ahitofele kwafika uYehoyada unyana kaBhenaya, noAbhiyathari; uYowabu ke waba nguMengameli womkhosi wombuso.

UDavide wabiza bonke abakhulu bakaSirayeli eYerusalem, abaholi bezizwe, nabaphathi bemikhosi esebenza ubukhosini, nabangane bamakhulu, nabangamakhulu, nabaphathi bomhlaba wonke, nempahla yonke yombuso, nabantwana bakhe, nabasebenzi bendlu yakhe, namadoda amakhulu, nabo bonke abantu abanothando olukhulu.

UDavide ukumkani wehla, wathi, Ningilalele, inkosikazi yami nezwe lami: Nginethemba lokwakha indlu yokuphumula ibhokisi lesivumelwano sikaYehova, ibe yindawo yokubeka izinyawo zikaThixo wethu; futhi ngacabanga ukuyenza.
Kodwa uNkulunkulu wathi kimi, Awuzokwakha indlu igama lami, ngoba ungumuntu wempi, futhi usuphuzile igazi.

Kodwa iNkosi, uNkulunkulu kaSirayeli, wandikhethela emndenini wami wonke, ukuba ngibe ngukumkani phezu kwaSirayeli kuze kube sekupheleni; wakhetha isi(i)sizwe sakwaYuda ukuba ngumholi, futhi ezweni lakwaYuda wakhetha imindeni yababami. Ezinganeni zabazali bam, wathanda kakhulu ukungikwenza ngibe ngukumkani phezu kwaSirayeli bonke.
UYehova wandinika oonyana abaningi, kodwa kubo bonke wakhetha uSolomoni unyana wami, ukuba ahlale embhedeni wombuso kaYehova phezu kwaSirayeli.
Wathi kuye: USolomoni unyana wakho, yena ozokwakha indlu yami nezindlu zami; ngoba ngiwukhethele ukuba ngumntwana wami, futhi ngizoba ngubaba wakhe.
Ngizogcina ubukumkani bakhe kuze kube sekupheleni, uma eqhubeka esenza izimiso zami nemithetho yami, njengamanje.

Ngakho manje, phambi kwabaSirayeli bonke, ibandla leNkosi, emazwini kaThixo wethu, gcinani ukuthi nigcine yonke imiyalo kaYehova uNkulunkulu wenu, ukuze niyithathele lona elizweni elilungile, nilidlulisele ezindleleni zenu ngemuva kwenu kuze kube sekupheleni.

Futhi wena, nkosi yami uSolomoni, yazi uNkulunkulu kababa wakho, uyisebenzele ngenhliziyo yakho yonke, nangemphefumulo othandekayo; ngoba iNkosi unquma zonke izinhliziyo, futhi uyaqonda wonke amaphupho nemibono. Uma umfuna, uzotholakala; kodwa uma umshiya, uzokususa kuze kube sekupheleni.
Khumbula ukuthi iNkosi ukukhethile wena ukuba ukwakha indlu ibe yindawo yakhe engcwele; ube ngumuntu onamandla, uyeke umsebenzi.
UDavide wanikeza uSolomoni, unyana wakhe, izithombe zodonga lwendlu kaThixo, nezindlu zayo, namagumbi ayo okugcina izinto, namagumbi alo aphezulu, namagumbi alo angaphakathi, nendawo yokugquma.

Wathi uSolomoni kuYoshuwa: "Njengoba umphefumulo wakho usesikhumbeni sakho, thola izithombe zezinto zonke ezingaphakathi ethempelini likaYehova, nezindawo zokugcina izinto ethempelini likaThixo, nezindawo zokugcina izinto ezingcwele.

Wathi uSolomoni kuMoses: "Njengoba ungenawo umsebenzi wokuphatha indlu kaYehova, futhi awukwazi ukuphatha zonke izinto ezisetshenziswayo endlwini kaYehova, ungasebenzisi isandla sakho sokudla noma isiphuzo; ngoba uMoya oNgcwele uyasebenza.

Wathi kuye ukuthi iyiphi inqwaba yegolide okufanele isetshenziselwe zonke izinto zegolide ezisetshenziswa ehlobo ngalinye lenkonzo, nokuthi iyiphi inqwaba yesiliva okufanele isetyenziswe kuzo zonke izinto zesilivere ezisetshenziswa ehlobo ngalinye lenkonzo.

Wathi uMoses kuSolomoni: "Uzosebenzisa igolide, ukuze wenze izibani zegolide nezibani zazo, ngokwesisindo sazo zonke izibani nezingcingo zazo; futhi uzosebenzisa isiliva, ukuze wenze isibani segolide nesibani sayo, ngokuya ngemisebenzi yaso sonke isibani.
Wathi kuye ukuthi iyiphi inqwaba yegolide ongayisebenzisa ngethebulethi ngayinye yokudla okungcwele, nokuthi iyiphi inqwaba yesilivere ongayisebenzisa ngethebula lesiliva.
Wathi kuye ukuthi zingaki igolide elihlanzekile ukuze lisebenzise ama-forks wenyama, amabhodwe okubhaka, nama-pitchers, nokuthi zingaki igolide nesilivere ngalinye legolide nesilivere.

Wathi kuthiwa uMoses watshela uSolomoni inani legolide elihlanzekile elizosetshenziswa emgodini womlilo, kanye nohlobo lwesithuthuthu samakherubi egolide, aveza amaphiko abo phezu kwebhokisi lomhlangano kaYehova.
Wathi uDavide, Ngasesandla sikaYehova kubhalwe konke lokhu kwami; futhi wangenza ngiqonde zonke izimo ezincane.

Wathi uDavide kuSolomoni, unyana wakhe, Ube namandla, ube nothando olukhulu, wenze umsebenzi; ungakhathazeki, futhi ungabi nenhliziyo ebuhlungu; ngoba iNkosi uNkulunkulu, uNkulunkulu wami, uzobe nawe; akakushiyeli, akakushiya, kuze kuqedwe yonke imisebenzi yomsebenzi wendlu kaYehova.

Bheka, imindeni yamabhishobhi namadodana eLevi ikhona yonke imisebenzi yendlu kaThixo. Nabo bonke abantu abafisayo, abanekhono ngaso sonke isikhathi sokwenza umsebenzi, bazosebenza nawe; futhi abaholi nabo bonke abantu bazokwenza konke okushoyo.

Wathi uDavide ukumkani kubo bonke isibingelelo, USolomoni unyana wami, owakhethiwe nguThixo, ungumntwana, akakwazi ukucabanga; futhi le misebenzi ikhulu kakhulu; ngoba leli ndlu alikho elinamuntu, kodwa liyiNkosi iNkosi uNkulunkulu.

Ngamandla ami onke ngilungiselele indlu kaThixo wami, igolide ngezinto zegolide, nesilivere ngezinto zesilivere, nesiliva ngezinto zesiliva, nensimbi ngezinto zensimbi, nokhuni ngezinto zokhuni; futhi ngilungiselele amatshe e-onyx, namatshe okudweba, namatshe amhlophe anemibala eminingana, nezinye zonke izinhlobo zamatshe amahle kakhulu, namatshe omnqumo.

Naphezu kwalokhu konke, ngenxa yokuthi ngithanda indlu kaThixo wami, ngabona ukuthi nginikela ngezinto zami zegolide nesilivere endlwini kaThixo wami, ngaphezu kwayo yonke into engiyilungiselele lendlu engcwele.
Ngabona ukuthi ngizonikela ngegolide elingaphezu kwekhulu lamatoni eOfiri, nesiliva elingaphezu kwezinkulungwane ezimbili namashumi amane amatoni, ukuze ligqoke izindonga zezindlu;
futhi ngemisebenzi yonke yegolide nesilivere, ukuze yenziwe ngalabo abasebenza ngayo; ngakho-ke, ngubani na othanda ukunikela ngokugcwele kuYehova namuhla?
Bathi abaphathi bezindlu zabazali, nabaphathi bezizwe zakwaSirayeli, nabaphathi bamashumi namakhulu, nabaphathi bemisebenzi yobukhosi, banikela ngokuzithandela.

Banikela, ukuze kwenziwe umsebenzi wendlu kaThixo, ngegolide elinamathani ayikhulu nesishiyagalombili, nezigidi ezingu-10 zezinhlamvu zesiliva, namathanethi angama-340 esilivere, nobhedu elinamakhulu amathathu anamashumi ayisithupha amatonela, namafutha omnqumo ayizinkulungwane ezintathu.
Wonke umuntu obenezitshe ezisezingeni eliphakeme, wazisa emgodini wendlu kaYehova, engqondweni kaYehiyeli umGershoni.
Baze bajabulela abantu, ngenxa yokuthi abaphathi babo babenikela ngokuzithandela; ngoba babenikela kuYehova ngenhliziyo yabo yonke. Nakumkani uDavide wathokozela kakhulu.
UDavide wabonga iNkosi phambi kwenkundla yonke, wathi: "Kukuhloswe wena, Nkosi, uNkulunkulu kaSirayeli ubaba wethu, kuze kube sekupheleni!

UNkulunkulu, ubukhulu bakho, nekhono lakho, nobuhle bakho, nokuzinikela kwakho, nokunethezeka kwakho; konke okusezulu nasenhlabathini konke kuyinto yakho. Ubukhosi bakho, Nkosi yami, bukhona kuwe; wena omkhulu kunabo bonke.
Imali nenkundla zivela kuwe, futhi wena ulawula zonke izinto; amandla nokuzibophezela kuyisandla sakho. Ungenza wonke umuntu abe mkhulu, futhi unciphisa bonke.
Futhi manje, Nkosi yethu, sikubonga, futhi sibonga igama lakho elingcwele.
Ngabe ngibani mina, nokuthi bangaki abantu bam, ukuthi sikwazi ukunikela ngokuzithandela ngale ndlela? Zonke izinto zivela kuwe, futhi thina sikulethela isandla sakho.
Sifana nabangani bakho, nabahleli ezindaweni ezahlukene, njengabababa bethu bonke; izinsuku zethu emhlabeni zifana nesithunzi, azihlalanga.
Nkosi yethu, uNkulunkulu wethu, le mali yonke esiyilungiselele ukukwakha indlu igama lakho elingcwele, ivela esandla sakho, futhi yiyo yonke.

Ngiyazi, Nkosi yami, ukuthi uhlola inhliziyweni, futhi uthanda ubuqotho bomuntu; ngakho ngazinikela ngazo zonke lezi zinto ngenhliziyo ehlanzekile; futhi manje ngibona ngokunethezeka ukuthi abantu bakho abakhona bayakunikela.
Nkosi, uNkulunkulu wababa bethu uAbrahama noIsake noSirayeli, ugcine lokhu engqondweni yabantu bakho kuze kube sekupheleni, futhi uqinise intliziyo yabo kuwe.
USolomoni unyana wami, unike umphefumulo ophelele, ukuze agcine imiyalo yakho, nezibopho zakho, nezimiso zakho, futhi akwenze konke okudingayo ukukwakha indlu engiyilungiselele.
Wathi uDavide kubo bonke isibingelelo, "Namuhla nibonga iNkosi uNkulunkulu wenu." Ke bonke isibingelelo sabonga iNkosi uNkulunkulu wababa babo, babhujiswa phambi koNkulunkulu nobukhosi.

Ngosuku olulandelayo banikela ngenhlanhla nomnikelo wokushiswa kuYehova, izinkomo ezingu-1, nezimvu eziyi-1 gestuιοra, izingulube zibe ngamaphesenti angu-1, kanye neminikelo yawo yokuphuza; futhi imindeni yakwaSirayeli ibe nemikhosi eminingi.

Badla baphuza phambi kukaNkulunkulu ngalolu busuku, bethokozela kakhulu. Bakwenza uSolomoni, unyana kaDavide, waba ngukumkani wesibili; bampompa phambi kukaYehova ukuba abe ngumholi, bampompa noTsadoki ukuba abe ngumpristi.
Wahlala uSolomoni esihlalweni sobukhosi sikaYehova, waba ngukumkani endaweni kaDavide, ubaba wakhe; waphumelela, futhi amaSirayeli onke amlalela.
Bonke abaphathi, nabanqobi abakhulu, nabo bonke oonyana bakaNdunankulu uDavide, bamemezela ukuthi bazobe behlonishwa nguNdunankulu uSolomon.
Wakwenza iNkosi ukuba mkhulu kakhulu uSolomoni phambi kwamehlo wonke amaSirayeli, wamnika ukuphakama kobukhosi obukhulu kunanoma yimuphi ukumkani waseSirayeli owangaphambili kwakhe.
UDavide unyana kaYese waba ngukumkani phezu kwamaJuda wonke.
Iminyaka engu-40 walawula phezu kwaSirayeli; iminyaka eyisikhombisa eHebroni, futhi eminyakeni engamashumi amathathu nathathu eYerusalem.
Wafa emshadweni omnandi, ephila ubomi obude nobuhle. USolomoni unyana wakhe waba ngukumkani esikhundleni sakhe.
Zonke izinto azenzayo uDavide ukumkani, kusukela ekuqaleni kuze kube sekupheleni, zingakabhalweni ezincwadini zikaSamuweli umfundi, nezincwadi zikaNathani umprofeti, nezincwadi kaGadi umfundi?
Lokhu konke ukuphatha kwakhe, nekhono lakhe, nezimo zakhe, nalokho okwenzekile kuye, nakwaSirayeli, nakwezo zonke izizwe zezindawo.
